tei:div.tei:p: ༷ ri

rgyud 'bum/ () (92)0717 'phags pa don yod pa'i zhags pa'i cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po/ 3don yod pa'i zhags pa/ 3don yod pa'i zhags pa sgrub pa'i cho ga 15nags sgrub pa'i cho ga 74'khor lo'i zhags pa sgrub pa'i cho ga 93pad+ma'i zhags pa'i sgrub pa'i cho ga 96rdo rje'i zhags pa las thams cad bgyid pa sgrub pa'i cho ga 103don yod yid bzhin nor bu'i zhags pa chen po sgrub pa'i cho ga 105ral gri sgrub pa'i cho ga 121sbrul gyi zhags pa sgrub pa'i cho ga 123mdung rtse gsum pa'i zhags pa sgrub pa'i cho ga 127zhags pa dang ri mo sgrub pa'i cho ga 130me dgug pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga 132sbyin sreg gi cho ga 1761

ri mo'i sku gzugs sgrub pa'i cho ga dang cho ga zhib mo/ 203dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhib mo/ 208rigs sngags kyi cho ga zhib mo rim par phye ba'i cho ga 215bdug pa'i cho ga 237nor bu bsgrub pa'i cho ga 277bum pa sgrub pa'i don yod pa'i cho ga 288'jig rten pa sgrub pa'i cho ga 299'jig rten las 'das pa'i sgrub thabs kyi cho ga 345pad+ma gtsug tor gyi dkyil 'khor gyi snying po gsang sngags grub pa'i cho ga 420sdig pa thams cad 'gegs pa tsan+dan gyi bdug pa bsgrub pa'i cho ga 453las thams cad bsgrub pa'i thig le dang ril bu bsgrub pa'i cho ga 459mi snang bar bya ba ril bu sgrub pa'i cho ga 465sbyin sreg gi cho ga'i sgrub thabs/ 469sgrub pa'i dngos grub bla na med pa'i cho ga rmongs pa chen po'i cho ga 478dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dang sgrub thabs kyi cho ga 482ras ris sgrub pa'i cho ga dang sgrub thabs kyi cho ga gnaphyag rgya'i cho ga dang sgrub thabs kyi cho ga 495gsang sngags rim par phye ba'i cho ga dang bsgrub pa'i cho ga 500pad+ma gtsug tor gyi rdo rje chen po'i snying po gsang ba/ 507sdig pa dang sgrib pa zad par bya ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i cho ga 513bzlas pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i cho ga 526khrus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 528nor bu'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 532mig sman gyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 5362

bdug pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 540sman gyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 551nor bu'i ril bu sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 559don yod pa chen po rnam par 'phrul pa'i dkyil 'khor sgyu ma lta bu'i cho ga 567don yod pa'i zhags pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi rig sngags 'chang ba'i cho ga578mtshan ma bri ba'i phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 604sbyin sreg gi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 609rang gi gzugs brnyan bya ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 616khro bo'i rgyal po sgrub pa'i cho ga 644bsdur mchan/(756) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(928)

chagaci༄ mi sbyicu ri da/r+sāshā rdo rdo ste/chos tshe cing sne'u —3 gyi ne1 — — — sdo cho ༵ ji ga ri ci ngami bye / ci ṇi4pho nga ngos /shes shuX7du skerdo chi ci ri / cho sa lha tsho mi dri—— —ste lte cig rna tres mdzo do ri la snye ga ji sne ci mi ra mi ga snyo —nyi ji ga gce ni ri dri — rib lta de tsho —— — mi ci rnye 4 tho — ci sto ———— —— — — dza ཿmi ༄/ /don yod zhags pa'i gsang sngags ches/ /don rnams sbyor mdzad 'jig rten dbang / /

cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po/1༄ska /rgya gar skad du/ ār+sā nyanamo gha pā sha kulpa rā dzā / bod skad du / 'phags pa don yod pa'i zhags pa'i cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po/ bam po dang po/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i rmedadus gcig na/bcom ldan 'das ri bo po ta 5la na6/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi pho brang shing sā 7la dang / ta ma la dang / tsam pa ka dang / mya ngan 'tshang dang /a ti mug ta ka sna tshogs mang pos legs par brgyan na pa na/ dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po brgya stong dang / byang chub sems dpa' sa ya bye ba brgya stong phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu dang thabs cig 9tu bzhugs te/ gnas gtsang ma'i rigs kho//bye/ /ji)/ ///tho ()(1 //// ///bye /byebye/ lha bu brgya nga phrag du mas ngas su ba ra 11 nga mdun sa bltas pa na/92—3

dbang phyug dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / tshangs pa dang / lha'i bu rnams kyi 1dbang du mdzad nas chos ston par mdzad do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug stan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig 2tu gzar nas/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs cite/ thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/ bcom ldan 'das zig la ba de 6logs su 'dzum pa'i bzhin gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to / /bcom ldan 'das gang 'di don yod pa'i zhags pa'i 7rgyal po'i snying po zhes bgyi ba namachis te/ bdag gis bskal pa dgu bcu rtsa gcig gi sngon logs su 'jig rten gyi khams rnam par blta 9bar/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal po las mnos nas/ 'di ltar bdag gis dbang phyug dang /dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa 1 lha'i bu rnams dang / gnas gtsang ma'i lha'i bu brgya stong phrag mang po bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dzin du stsal 1 rinas/ bdag gis rmongs pa ma mchis pa'i ye shes bkod pa la sogs 12te ting nge 'dzin brgya stong phrag bcu thob par bgyis lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di ltar yang sa phyogs gang du snying po 'di spyod pa'i sa phyogs der1 /dbang phyug dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / tshangs pa 1 la sogs pa lha'i bu khri nyis 1zhestong bsrung khob dang / bskyab pa dang /1 sba ba'i slad du gnas par rig par bgyi lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das gang na don yod pa'i phun sum tshogs pa'i snying po 'di spyod pa'i sa phyogs de mchod rten du yang 18bkur bar 'gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das sems can de dag ni sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya 519stong phrag du ma 2 la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed par 'gyur lags so/ /92—4

gang zhig don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po 'di nyan 1par bgyid na/ bcom ldan 'das sdig pa spyod pa'am/ sdig pa'i chos kun tu spyod pa'am/ 'phags pa la skur 2pa 'debs pa'am/ dam pa'i chos spong ba'am/ mnar med par gzhol ba'am/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad spong ba de 'gyod par 'gyur zhing / ma 'ongs pa na sdom pa 'thob 4par 'gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das re shig 5de nyid kyis zhag gcig smyung 6ba bgyis te/ bzlas brjod bgyis na/ tshe 'di nyid la las de rnam par dag pa dang / gtugs pa dang / bsal 7bar 'gyur ro/ /rims nyin gcig pa'am/ rims nanyin gnyis pa'am/ nyin gsum pa'am/nyin bzhi pa'am/ de bzhin du rims nyin bdun pa'am/ mig nad dam1 /rna ba'i nad dmanya1/ 12sna'i nad dam/ so dang 1 mchu'i nad dam/ lce dang rkan nyu gyi nad dam/ snying nad dam/ lto 15nad dam ro rgyab dang rked sapa'i nad dam/ yan lag gam 17nying lag gi nad dam/ gzhang 'brum mam18/ pho ba'i nad dam/ tshad pa'am/ lag pa dang 19/ rkang pa'i nad dam/ sna nad dam / klad pa'i 21nad dam / sha bkra chen po'am/ sha gzig gu'am/mdze na 'am/ rkang shu'am/ 'brum bu 2 phra mo'am/ lhog pa'am/ mtshan par rdol ba'am/ 'brum bu'am/ brjed 25byed dam/ byad dam/ gzhan gyis bgyis pa'i gsod pa'am/ 'ching ba'am/ rdeg 27pa'am/ skrod 2 pa'am/bden pa ma lags pas skur pa 'debs pa'am/ bcom ldan 'das mdor 2 na lus kyis 29gdung ba'am/ sems kyis ri gdung ba'am/ rmi lam ngan pa'i las de yongs su gtugs par gyur 1na/ sems can dag pa lhag par rinadad pa 92—5

rnams kyis 1yongs su byang bar 'gyur ba lta nismos kyang ci 'tshal/ bcom ldan 'das gal te 'khor bzhi'am/ rigs bzhi las gang dag sgyu ②dang / g.yo dag gis 4)don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po 'di nyan par bgyid/ 'dzin par bgyid / 'chang bar bgyid/ klog par bgyid/ 'dri (5)bar bgyid/ 'drir ⑥'jug par bgyid/ kun chub par bgyid/ sems can gzhan la yang sgrogs 6)par bgyid cing / tha na dud 'gro'i skye gnas su gtogs pa rnams kyi rna bug tu gtad den/ rna bar bzlas (9)brjod bgyid la/ rdo rje'i tshig 'di rnams sems par bgyid de/ skur pa ma mchis pa dang / gzugs ma mchis pa dang / rnam par mi rtog pa dang / kun tu 7'byung ba ma mchis pa dang / ring du 'gro ba (mem mchis pa dang / bgyid pa ma mchis pa dang / gos pa ma mchis pa dang /sems mnyam pa nyid dang / ma 1 brang ba dang / phung po lnga dang bral ba ste/rnal 'byor 'dis 1nasangs rgyas rjes su dran pa bsgom ༄par bgyid na/ de la phyogs bcu nas sangs rgyas stong zhal ston par mdzad par 'gyur zhing / nongs pa 'chags par 'gyur ba la sogs pa rgyas par sbyar ro/ /glegs bam du bgyis te khyim na 'chang bar tshabagyid dam/ rje dpon gyis skrag pas bgyis yisam/1 bzhad 18gad tsam gyi 19rgyus nyan sri )par bgyid na/ bcom ldan 'das mkhas pas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi mthus/ de dag gi rna khung du sgra de grag 2 pa legs par 'tshal bar bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das dper na skyes bu ༷ ge'aga' zhig gis tsan dan nams / ga bur ram gla rtsi zhig la khros sam/ yongs su smad de rdo la btags 2 nas/ bdag nyid la byugs na tsan dan nam/ ga bur ram/ gla rtsi de 'di snyam du 'dis bdag la khros sam/ yongs su smad 92—6

pas dri mnam par mi bgyi'o snyam du mi sems kyi/ gzhan du na de nyid la dri bda' 1)bar bgyid lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin du bdag gi don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po 'di yang gang su yang rung bas/ bzhad 2gad tsam gyis ③zhes bya ba rgyas par sbyar ro/ /bcom ldan 'das g.yo dang sgyus mchod par ④bgyid na yang de nyid sems can dmu rgod 5)dag gi dge ba'i rgyur 'gyur lags so/ /gang dang gang du skye bar 'gyur bar tshul khrims dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab dang / bsod nams kyi tshogs kyi dri dang bral bar mi 'gyur te/ tshul khrims kyi dri bda' (6)bar bgyid 7)lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das gang yang rigs kyi bu'am 98)rigs kyi bu mo'am/ dge slong pha'am 97dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen ⑩pa'am/ dge bsnyen nyunyama'am/ de las gzhan pa'i sems can su yang rung bas/ don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po'i ched du yar nyanango'i tshes brgyad la smyung (1)ba bgyis te/ gzhan mi smra bar don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po lan bdun snyibazlas brjod bgyid 35na/ bcom ldan 'das des tshe 'di nyid la phan yon nyi shu rtsa gcig 'thob 7par 'gyur te/ nyi shu rtsa gcig gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ de'i lus la nad rnams 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de'i lus la las kyi dbang gis nad rnams byung na lho yang myur du zhi bar 'gyur zhing /lus mdangs dang ldan pa dang yid du mchi 18bar 'gyur ro/ /skye bo mang po'i snying du 16sdug pa dang / dbang po sbas par 'gyur ro/ /de'i don rnams 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de'i don grub pa yang chom rkun 3 7gyis mi 'phrogs te 1/zhugs kyis mi 'tshig —— chab kyis mi 'tshal rgyal po'i mthus dbrog na par rngo mi thogs 32par 'gyur ro/ /de'i las nasakyi mtha' rnams rgyas 27par 'gyur te/92—7

ser bas ma lags so/ /chab kyi 'jigs pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur te/ rlung dang char gyi 'jigs pa ma lags so/ /don yod pa'i zhags 6)pa'i snying po thal ba'amanas / chu la lan bdun bzlas brjod bgyis nas/ zhing gi phyogs mtshams dang steng 'og tu bcing ba bgyis na gnod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar 'gyur ro / /gzi brjid dang mdangs 'phrogs ri ripar rngo (3)mi thogs 5par 'gyur zhing sems can thams cad kyi snying du sdug pa dang yid la 6)'thad par 'gyur ro/ /de la dgra'i 'jigs pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de la dgra'i 'jigase pa byung ( peyang myur du zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /de la mi ma lags pa'i 'jigs pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur ten/ byad kyi 'jigs pa ma lags mkha' 'gro ma'i 'jigs pa ma lags te / de la nyon mongs pa dang nye ba'i nyon mongs pa drag po 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro / /me 9dang mtshon dang / dug gis 'gum par mi 'gyur ro/ /de la yang lha rnams kyis rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par bsrung 3 tshob dang / skyob pa dang sbed pa'i phyir gnas par 'gyur ro/ /gang dang gang du skye bar 'gyur bar byams pa dang snying rje dang dga' ba dang btang snyoms dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur te/ de la phan yon nyi shu rtsa gcig po 'di dag 'thob 11par 'gyur lags so/ /gzhan yang chos brgyad 'thob par 'gyur te brgyad gang zhe na/ 'gum pa'i dus su 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dge slong gi gzugs su mngon sum du zhal ston par 'gyur ro/ /bde bar 'chi ba'i dus byed 12par 'gyur ro/ /lta ba 'khrul par mi 'gyur ro/ /lag pa mi g.yob pa dang rkang pa mi g.yob pa dang bshang gci 1 ma mchis pa dang khri'i steng du 'chi ba'i dus byed 8par 'gyur ro/ /dran pa shin tu nye 'bar gnas par 'gyur ro/ /kha 7bub tu 'chi ba'i dus byed be92—8

par mi 'gyur ro/ /'gum pa'i dus na yang spobs pa mi bas par 'gyur ro/ /de yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang du smon pa der skye bar 'gyur zhing 1tshodage ba'i bshes (snyeganyen dang yang rige'abral bar mi 'gyur ro/ /nyin gcig 4)bzhin du dus gsum du lan gsum du (5)bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /chang dang sha dang kun 6dong dang ke'u dang sgog skya (7)dang / 'dres pa dang / lhag rol dang / 'di rnams khyad par du don du gnyer bas spang bar bgyi'o/ /don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yang sems can rnams la mthu 8mchis pa dang / mthu ma mchis par tsho)'tshal bar bgyis nas bsgrag yopar bgyi'o/ /slob dpon gyis dpe 37mkhyud mi bgyi'o/ /'di ltar dri ma dang bral zhing phrag dog dang tu ser sna spangs pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams lags te/ sems can rnams kyi don bgyi ba'i slad du sangs rgyas kyi byang chub 'thob (1 par 'gyur bas / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mtshogs kyi nang du gtogs so/ /byang chub ces bgyi ba ni shes rab lagasasku/ sems dpa' zhes bgyi ba ni thabs lags teyi/ chos 'di gnyis sems can rnams kyi don bgyi ba'i slad du 1 kho nas thob pa lags so/ /gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag la rjes su gnang na / 'di ltar bdag gis 3 snying po 'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan sngar 'khor bzhi rnams dang gzhan sdig pa spyod pa rnams kyi don dang / sman pa dang bde ba'i 4)slad du bsgrag 3 7par bgyi'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sems can dag pa rdu7de'i dus 3rtal bab par shes na khyod na smros shig /de bzhin gshegs pas rjes su yi rang bar mdzad zin te/ phyi ma'i tshe phyi ma'i 92—9

dus na/ byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa can rnams la pha'i bya ba byed par 'gyur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mig mi 'dzums (1)par bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis phyag bgyis pa rnam par grol ba'i dkyil 'khor skye bo mang po la sman pa dang / skye bo mang po la bde ba dang / 'jig rten la thugs brtse ba dang / skye bo'i tshogs chen po'i don du bdag la gsan du gsol/ dus gsum du gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang sangs rgyas dang / 'phags pa nyan thos kyi dge 'dun 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang /da ltar byung ba thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang dag par song ba rnams dang /yang dag par zhugs 2pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sha ( )ra dwa ti'i bu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byams pa la sogs pa ste 0byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thugs 5)rje chen po dang ldan pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ oṃ tsa ra tsa ra no/ tsi ri tsi ri/ tsu ru tsu ru/e h+ye hi ma hā kā 75ru ṇi na ka /tsi ri tsi ri/ mi ri mi ri/ tsu ru tsu ru/ ma hā kā 9ru ṇi kā ya/ si ri si ri/ tsi ri tsi ri po ri pi ri be ri bi ri ma hā pad+ma hāstadzi/ ka la ka la/ ki /1li ki li/ ku lu ku lu/ ma hā shud dha ⑫satwa / bud dh+ya bud rgya1lha/ dhā ba dhā ba/ ka ṇa ka ṇa/ ki ṇi ki ṇi/ ku ṇa ku 92—10

ṇa / pa ra ma shud dha 0)satwa/ ka ra ka ra/ ki ri ki ri/ ku ru ku ru/ ma hāshā/ ma māsta(yi/ tsa la tsa la/ sañtsa la sadzoni la/ bi tsa la bi byurga la(8 skyes ṭa ṭa / e ṭa ṭa/ bha ra bha ra/ bhi ri bhi ri/ bhu ru bhu ru/ e h+ye nyi ma hā kā 547ru ṇi ga⑤ /ma hā (7pa shu ⑦pa ti be sha dha ra/ dha ra dha ra/ sa ra sa ra tsa ra tsa ra/ ha ra ha ra/ ha hā ha tā(kye/ hi tī hi tī/ hu hū hu hū/ oṃ kā ra 9brah+ma / be ṣa 0dha ra/ dha ra dha ra(rmi/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ ta ra ta ra/sa ra sa ra/ pa ra pa ra/ tsa ra tsa ra/ rasmi sha ta 12sa ha sra pra ti maṇ+ḍi 18ta/sha rī rā yiya/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ ta pa ta pa/ bha ga wān35/ sau tsham ā dritutshi /ya ma ba ru ṇa/ ku be ra/ bra dz+ren+d+ra ṛ yirnye'i de ba ga ṇa/ a nyu)byu rtsi zhu 7ta tsa ra ṇa lha/su ru su ru/ tsu ru tsu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ pu ru pu ru/ san da ku mā ra/ ru dra(rte / bā sa ba/ bisnu dha na bā(snye/ de ba ṛ ṣi rdu )nā ya ka /ba hu bi bi dha/be ṣa (gedha ra/ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ( 9ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ tha ra tha ra gha ra gha ra/ ya ra ya ra/ la ra la ra/ ha ra ha ra/ ma ra ma ra/ pa ra pa ra/ba ra ba ra/ ba ra dā ya ka /sa man+ta a ba zhu 7lo ki ta( —5/ bi lo ki ta mu/ lo ke gu shwa ra ma he shwa ra hunye/ mu hu mu hu/ mu ru mu ru/ mu ya mu ya/ muñtsa muñtsa/bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis dpal sa gsum gyi lha rnams dang /zhu ) bdag dang / sems can thams cad 'jigs pa thams cad dang / gnod pa thams cad dang / 'tshe ba thams cad dang / gdon thams cad las srungs ji rteshig /srungs 'a shig /gsad rinyapa dang / bcing ba dang / brdeg pa dang / bsdigs pa dang /39 rgyal po dang / chom zhe po dang /rkun po dang / me dang / chu dang / dug dang / mtshon las yongs su thar 92wa 11

bar mdzad pa/ ka ṇa ka ṇa(1)/ ki ṇi ki 〉(gyi/ ku ṇa ku ṇa/ tsa ra tsa ra/yin /dri ya/ ba snyel bo sgyi 55)ga /tsa turā6 (neras t+ya saṃ bra kā sha ka /ta pa ta pa/da ma da ma/ sa ma sa ma/ ma sa ma sa sku/ ma hā ta mo3n+dha / kā ra/ bi dha ma na ṣa/ ṭa pā ri9skur mi tā pa ri pū (7ra ka /mi li mi li/ ṭa ṭa ṭa ṭa/ ṭha ṭha ṭha ṭha(lha/ ṭi ṭi ṭi ṭi/rte/ ṭu ṭu ṭu ṭu/ e ne ya tsam kri ta 4)pa ri ka ra0/e h+ye hi/ yī shwa mir ma he shwa tsor/ ma hā bhū tsho 7ta ga ṇa saṃ bhañdza ka /ku ru ku ru / pa ra pa ra/ ka ra ka ra/ ka ṭa ka ṭa/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/ bi shud dha/ bi ṣa 12ya/ bā si 1rten ma hā )kā ( lharu ṇi ka /shwe ta ya rto ( gepa bī 4)ta/ rat+na mu (snyeku ṭa/ mā lā ni dha ra/ sarba zhukhudz+nyā shi ra/ si kṛ nu 7ta mu so ku ṭa/ mā lā 0dha ra/ma hādhū ta/ ka ma lā lo kṛ (steta/ ka ra dha rā nu ya/ dh+yā (rten sa mā nustesnyi/ bi mo skok+ṣa/ a ra'apra zi kai pya( 2/ ba hu satwa san+ta hi 87pa ri pā tsa ka /ma hā kā ru ṇi ka /sarba kurma ā ba 4)ra ṇa gi bi sho dha ka sarba byā (rtedhe pa ri mo (stetsa ka /sarba ā shā 5pa ri pū snyur ka /sarba satwa sdo snas mā shā sa na (sheka ra/ na mo stu te swā hā/bklags ce pas las thams cad 'grub ri )par 'gyur ro/ /dus gsum du bzlas brjod bgyis na/ mtshams 47med pa lnga byang (2bar 'gyur zhing / las kyi sgrib pa thams cad ri kyang yongs su dag par 'gyur ro(snye/ /mtshams sgonyebacad sgonyepa la sro snani / a ga ri ru'i bdug pa'am/ thal ba dang shuge/ chab bam/ yungs kur 4 dīdang / seng ldeng gi phur bu la sogs pas so/ /rims thams cad la (nyuni skud pas so/ /nad thams cad la ni mar ram/ 'bru mar ram/ chab la bzlas brjod bgyis te gtor bar bgyi'o/ /byad dgrol ba la ni sngosamatshon gyis so/ /lto na 6 ba la ni srung ba'i skud spyo pas so/ /dug bsad tsi pa la ni sa'am chab kyis 92—12

so / /mig nad la ni skud pa dkar pos rna ba la gdags par bgyi'o/ /so na ba la ni shing ka 3)ra bī (gyira'i so shing gis so/ / mtshams bcad ri pa ni/ tshon (4)sna lnga'i skud pa la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod bgyis te/ seng ldeng gi phur bu bzhi la bcings nas/ phyogs bzhir gzugs par bgyis na/ mtshams chen po bcing bar (ge'agyur ro/ /thams cad srung 6 ba la (7)ni skud pa'am/ chab bam thal bas so(8)/ /gdon thams cad la ni tshon sna lnga'i skud pas so/ /rims thams cad la ni skud pa dkar pos so/ /g.yan pa dang / khyi rngo 99nodang /lhog 7pa dang / mgrin ⑩pa 'gags pa thams cad la ni sbrang rtsi 1rnyedang / pi pi ling sres hu)pas so/ /mig nad la ni nyu cidri chu'amatshog/ shing bal sha'i chu'am/shing mngar gyi yichus so/ /rna ba'i nad la ni 'bru mar gyis so/ /'thab pa dang /'thab mo dang / rtsod par tu 'gyed pa dang / skur 1)pa 'debs pa thams cad la ni chab la bzlas nyu9brjod bgyis te/ kha bshal bar bgyi'o/ /dpung dang yul dang rgyal srid dang / yul 'khor thams cad bsrung ‘ rtab la ni bum pa gang ba gzhag 87la gos gtsang na ma bgos pas mchod pa rgya chen po bgyis nas/bklag shustepar bgyis na zhi ba chen por 'gyur ro/ /des 2 yang chab kyis gtor bar bgyis te/ sems can thams cad la srung 22ba bgyis par 'gyur lags sol 9 / /yams kyi nad dang gnod pa dang 'tshe ba thams cad zhi bar bgyid pa dang / glags lta ba rnams la ni tsan dan la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod bgyis te/ snying gar 2 byug par bgyi'o/ /mtshams med na pa'i las thams cad bas par bgyi ba ni/ rtag tu bzlas brjod kyis so/ /khyim bsrung 39ba la ni pad+ma'i sbyin sreg rme )gis so/ /sems can thams cad bskyang ba dang / 'byung 92—13

po'i 'jigs pa dang / gdon thams cad 0)bsrung ②ba la ni tsan dan gyi sbyin sreg gis 5)so/ /dza ya dang bi dza ya dang / na ku li ④dang / ghan dha (snyen gu li dang / ba ru ni dang / tsi gra 77ba ru ṇi dang / a bha ya ba ni (7dang /yin dra 58)ba ni dang / lhan dha pri (9)yang ku tshedang / rgya spos dang / tsakra dang /ma hā 17tsakra dang /snye/ bin+tu kān 1geta dang / so ma ra dzi dang / su nan da tso rnams la lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis te/ nor bur bgyis nas spyi bo'am / dpung 15pa la btags 9pas bsrel bar bgyi'o/ /khye'u rnams la ni mgul par sna ro/ /bu mo rnams la ni sta nyugezur nas nyurtete/ dpal dang ldan par bgyid pa dang / bkra mi shis pa rab tu zhi bar bgyid pa'i nor bu 'di bsrel zhu na thams cad las bsrung ba stobagyis par 'gyur ro/ /dug dang mes mi tshugs lags so/ /dug gis snyeganod pa bskyed par 2mi 'gyur ro/ /skyes na yang gnod pa bskyed sa0par mi bgyid cing / myur du zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /gdon rnams zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /rlung dang 'brug dang ser ba gcad nunyepa dang / chab kyi rgyun dang / ser ba bzlog pa 25la ni shing ka ri ra bī zhushera'i lcug mas te(rte/las thams cad bgyid pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs zhu byedabang phyug gi snying po grub pa dam pa ma bsgrubs 1par las 'di rnams bgyid par 'gyur lags so/ /de nas bsgrub rtapar 'tshal na thang sku'i cho ga zhu ni ras la lhag ma ma yin pa'i tshon (nyertsis / sangs rgyas dang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi 2dbang phyug gi nilhagazugs brnyan ral pa'i thor tshugs dang e na ya'i pags zhu pa dang / phyugs bdag gi cha lugs 'chang ba she/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan zhu)pa bri bar bgyi ste/ri mo mkhan gso sbyong can 'drir ri )stsal bar bgyi'o/ /de nas sgrub pa pos (7sku 92—14

gzugs de'i spyan sngar ba'i lci ba'i dkyil 'khor bgyis te/ me tog dkar po'i sil ma bkram la/ spos kyis bkang ba'i snod brgyad gzhag par bgyi'o/ /sna brgyad pa'am drug cu 6)rtsa bzhi pa'am/ gzhan yang lha bshos sha dang / khrag dang ma 'dres pa bshams shing drangs la/ a ga (2)ru'i bdug pas bdugs te/lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /nyin zhag gcig 5)gam/ nyin zhag gsum du smyung ba (gebagyis nas zas dkar gsum 'tshal te/ dus gsum du khrus bgyis nas/ gos gtsang ma (5)bgos na/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bdag nyid mchis nas/ bsams (7pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bgyid do/ /ldong ros sam/ mig sman la bzlas brjod bgyis te/ mig la bskus thon de nas mi gda' bar gyur nas nam mkha' la mchi bar 'gyur zhing don yod pa'i (8)ye shes bkod pa thams cad (9)zhes bgyi ba'i ting nge 'dzin 'thob 1 par 'gyur te/ ci 'tshal ba de bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /17de nas hunye'agrub pa'o / /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces nyu2bka' stsal nas/ byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang / gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu de dag dang / mi mjed nyi④kyi bdag po tshangs pa dang /dbang phyug dang / dbang phyug chen po'i lha'i bu rnams yi rangs tenya5/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 8gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /don yod pa'i zhags pa rdzogs so// //de bzhin gshegs pa rgya mtsho rab 'byam nya thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs 92—15

dbang phyug stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig nyu)tu gzar nas/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas9gyi/ nyi ma'i 'od ltar 'od zer stong 'phro zhing / 'od zer sna tshogs pa ge'agyed pa'i lus kyis bcom ldan 'das ga la ④ba de ri logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de(6)/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor rgyas shing ⑦rdzogs la zhi ba/ bzhin 'dzum pa'i bzhin gyis byams pa dang / snying rje chen po'i 98rimathu yid la byed pas(she/ rigs bzhi'i yo )'jig rten la phan pa dang /snying brtse 11bas don thams cad grub par rig /2sngags 'chang /snyernams kyi 8bla na med pa'i tshade kho na nyid grub pa mchog sbyin pa thob par bya ba'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag la don yod pa'i rgyal po'i cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po chen po'i snying po 'di mchis te/ 'di pad+ma rgya chen po'i dkyil 'khor de kho na 7nyid chen po'i nyu 7snying por 'phags pa snying por gyur pa/ de kho na nyid grub nyagepa pad+ma 517dam pa dkyil 'khor chen po 'di phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags dang / snying po rim par phye ba gsang ba dam pa rnam par grol ba'i dkyil 'khor dam tshig dang / sgrub ḍo )pa gsang ba 'di/bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar bsgrag 27par bgyi'o/ /lha dang / klu dang /gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang /mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye na chen po dang / mi ( —snyemang po'i 'khor chen po'i mdun k+ṣ-i rigedang / rig sngags grub pa'i lha'i dkyil 'khor 25gyi mdun 'dir 25yang bsgrag tri bhepar bgyi'o/ /gang yang dbang phyug dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / tshangs pa dang / lha dang gshin rje dang / chu lha 2nyadang / lus ngan dang / drang srong gi tshogs dang / zla ba dang / nyi ma dang / skar ma'i tshogs dang rgyu skar dang /92—16

rig ①sngags 'chang grub pa'i lha mo rnams kyi mdun ②du de kho na nyid kyi snying po yang dag pa 'jig rten las 'das pa/ dngos grub sgrub pa bklags (kyepas grub pa dang / bsgoms ④pas grub (5)pa bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar rig 6)sngags chen po 'chang ba'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor (peba'i mdun du de kho na nyid kyi snying po gsang ba dam pa bsgrags shing 2brjod par bgyi'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya (9)thub pa'i tu phobasod nams stong gis brgyan (1pa mtshan dang dpe byad rnams kyis rnam par spras pa/ phyag dpung pa'i mdog gser gyi kha dog lta bu 'od zer 'phro ba du ma'i phreng nyunyab dang / spos kyi glang po che'i sna lta bu'i phyag brkyang ste/snye/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi spyi bor bzhag nas klad yipa la byugs te / 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sems can dag pa dam pa tshesnying rje chen po dang ldan pa khyod smros shig /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis yibyin gyis brlabs te/ ngas kyang da nyu )ltar byin gyis rlob kyis tunyekhyod gsang ba dam pa'i dam tshig smros shig /phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis rjes su yi rang zhing hu)byin gyis brlabs shu 7pa gang gā'i tsho ri klung 3)'bum phrag bye ba 8)brgya stong gi bye ma'i rdul phra rab snyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis kyang byin gyis brlabs shing rjes su yi rang bar mdzad do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis phyogs bcur bltas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar rang gi snying po de kho na nyid gsang (geba'i gsang sngags 'di dag gsol to/ /oṃ pad+ma hasta/ ma hā a mo gha pā sha dunyesā dha lke 9ya sa ma 2 ya hri da yan 28tsa ra tsa ra hūṃ/ don yod pa'i ru zhags pa'i rang 92—17

bzhin gyi gzungs 6)kyi snying po yin no/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po (mi'aphags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis chagasang ba'i snying po 'di brjod ma thag tu ri'i rgyal po po ta (gel 'di brag dang / nags tshal dang / rtsi ⑤shing du bcas pa dang / ri rab khor yug dang / khor yug chen po dang bcas pa rnams 56)rnam pa drug tu rab tu g.yos shing lha'i gnas rnams kyang 7ldeg par gyur te/ thams cad 'dar 'dar por ⑧gyur to/ /klu'i gnas dang /gnod sbyin dang / srin po'i gnas rnams kyang 'khrug 6)par gyur to/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i rlabs kyang 'khrug par gyur to/ /chu gter rnams kyang 'khrug par gyur to / /de ma thag tu phyogs bcu na sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs brnyan bzhugs pa rnams kyis legs so zhes bya ba byin tenya sku/ 'di skad ces kyang bka' stsal to/ /rgyal ba'i bdag nyid du skyes (7pa don yod pa'i zhags pa'i 'ortegasang ba'i snying po bklags 3 pas 'grub pa bla na med pa smras pa legs so legs so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sems pa 19dag pa khyod kyis gsang ba bklag 8pa'i cho ga de kho na nyid sgrub pa rgyas pa dang bcas par smros shig /spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das gsang ba'i snying po'i gzungs 'di lan cig tshebarjod pa tsam gyis de'i mod la phyogs bcu tha dad pa nas gang gā'i 7klung sa 9/snyeya bye ba brgya stong gi bye ma snyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyag brkyang ste/ spyi bor khya)bzhag nas legs so zhes bgyi ba'i sgra gsungs te/ gsungs pa tsam gyi mod la sngon bskal pa brgya stong du bsags pa'i sgrib pa rnams nyams par bgyid/ zhig par bgyid do ri / /sdig pa thams cad dang / nad thams cad dang / de bzhin du gnod 92—18

pa zhi bar bgyid do/ /sdig pa dang sems can gdug ①pa rnams dang / phas kyi rgol ba rnams ②dang / mi mdza' nu)ba rnams 'jig ④par bgyid de(5)/ 'di la the tshom ⑥mi bgyi'o/ /rtag tu 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mchog rdzisbyin blta ⑧'tshal bar 'gyur lags so/ /rig sngags 'di'i 6)cho ga sgrub 7pa ni 'di yin te/ rig sngags 'chang gtsang mar gyur pas shin tu khrus bgyis tehum/gos gtsang ma bgos par nyagebagyi'o/ /byams pa dang / snying rje yid la bgyis pas 'byung po thams cad la mchog tu snying brtse bar bgyi'o/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi ri yonyemo'i gzugs la mchod par bgyi'o/ /me tog dang ske/ bdug pa dang / dri dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / mar me dbul bar bgyi'o/ /tshes brgyad dam/ tshes bcwa tsolnga la sgrub (snyepa'i bzlas brjod kyi cho ga bgyi'o/ /ri mo'i gzugs kyi mdun du thog mar skyil tsomo krung tu 7bcas nas don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po lan brgya 8rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyi'o / /tshig gzhan mi smra bar khro bo'i rgyal po brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis te chab dang / yungs kur (rtegyis dbang bskur du )bar bgyi'o/ /phyag rgya bcing bar bgyi ste/ lan nyi shu rtsa ri glegacig gdon par ( gebagyi'o/ /gsang sngags kyis ni dbang bskur (2bar bgyi'o/ /phyag rgyas kyang dbang bskur bar bgyi'o / /de'i 'og tu don yod pa'i zhags 8 ripa'i gsang ba'i dam tshig gi snying po stong rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /bzlas brjod bton 9 snyepa tsam gyis de'i mod la don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po khro bo'i rgyal po dang bcas pa 'bum 'gyur du bzlas brjod bgyis par 'gyur ro/ /bzlas brjod rdzogs nas ri mo'i gzugs 'bar zhing sa yang g.yo bar 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs 92wa 19

dbang phyug gi lus las 'od zer sna tshogs pa 6)'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /don yod pa'i zhags pa ②lag na thogs pa'i zhags pa 'bar bar 'gyur zhing / rig sngags 'chang snying dga' ba dang / spyi bo'i gtsug 'bar bar 'gyur ro/ /'di ni grub pa'i rtags yin no (7zhes grub pa'i rtags dang legs so zhes bya ba'i sgra 'byin te④/ don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snyi nga po'i cho ga zhib mo'i phyag rgya 'grub (snyepar 'gyur ro/ /de nas dgos pa thams cad dang las thams cad brjod pa tsam gyis de'i mod la 'grub par 'gyur lags so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sa ya bye ba brgya stong gang gā'i 96)klung gi bye ma snyed (7)dang mnyam pa'i phyag gser gyi kha dog 'dra bas /spyi bo'i gtsug 5)tu 'jog par rmi lam du mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi rang bzhin gyi lus shin tu dri ma dang bral ba nya 7yongs su dag pas dri ma med pa'i bdag nyid kyi lus rang bzhin gyis (7mdun du /2mchis par 'gyur ro/ /mchog thams cad stsol bar 'gyur ro/ /rnam pa thams cad du tsho//grub pa stsol bebar 'gyur ro/ /don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po nyugecho ga zhib mo'i phyag rgya grub pa stsol bar 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar snying las skyes pa'i bu bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi byang chub thob kyi bar du yongs su skyong bar bgyid do/ /de lta bas na/ 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can gyi dkyil 'khor mtha' dag yongs su rdzogs pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing legs par brgyan tshepa byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor 11ba dang bcas pa na/ khang pa brtsegs nyu pa legs par brgyan pa'i seng ge'i khri'i tsho(mchog la 'phags pa rgyal ba 'od dpag med 'od zer brgya stong phrag 'bum 'phro ba'i sku ( )bzhugs shing chos ston pa blta 21bar 'tshal na/ rig na sngags 'chang des legs par bkrus te/92—20

gtsang mar gyur pas gos gtsang ma bgos te/ cho 'phrul gyi zla ba yar gyi 0)ngo la byams pa'i sems dang / snying rje'i ②lhag pa'i bsam pas gus pa dang / dad pa dang / zhe (8)sa dang / bla mar bgyi'oli/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi ri mo'i gzugs la ci (ge'abyor pa (6)me tog dang / bdug pa (7rwadang / dri dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / gos dang /lhab lhub dang / ba dan gyis mchod par bgyi'o(8)/ /tshes brgyad nas tshes bcu gsum gyi bar la ('o)zas dkar gsum 'tshal bar bgyi'o/ /ri mo'i gzugs kyi mdun du nyin gcig bzhin dus gsum du don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po lan nyi shu rtsa gcig dang / tshig gzhan mi smra bar khro bo'i rgyal po'i hu )snying po dang /nye ba'i snying po brgya 37rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis nas/ ri mo'i gzugs de nyid kyi mdun du mchis nas nyal bar bgyi'o/ /mchod yon dang yon chab dus gsum du dbul bar bgyi'o3ge/ /a ga /tshosheru dang / tsan dan dang / du ru ska skodang / gu gul gyi tsheme tog khu ba dang bcas pa gla rtsi dang lhan cig bsres nas blang yibar bgyi'o/ /dgug nya pa'i sngags lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis te(she/ don yod khams gsum rnam par grags/ /bdug pa'i rgyal po bla na med/ /gang phyir bdugs 37pa tsam gyis ni/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams su bdug pa'i sprin chen po 'khrigs pas rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /dri 3 ci'akhrigs pa de dag gis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / lha dang / klu dang /gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang /mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa rnams la/ dri 92—21

chen po'i mchod pa dang / bdug pa chen po'i mchod pa bgyis par 'gyur zhing /de dag thams cad dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /gang yang dud 'gro'i skye gnas su gtogs pa'i sems can gang dag gis bdug pa'i dri tshor na de dag thams cad ngan song du skye bar 'gyur ba'i las kyi sgrib pa rnams yongs su gtugs par 'gyur ro/ /'thab pa dang / 'thab mo dang / mu ge dang / rtsod pa dang /'gyed pa dang / nang 'khrug pa dang / 'khrugs ①pa dang / rmi lam ngan pa dang / yams kyi nad dang / gnod pa dang / 'tshe ba dang / gdung ba dang / mi bde ba thams cad dang / nad thams cad ②zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /rlung dang / ser ba dang / grang ba dang / tsha ba'i sprin thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /sdig pa thams cad 'jig par 'gyur ro/ /byad dang / g.yengs ③byed dang / sngags kyi sbyor ba thams cad dang / dug dang / dbyig dug dang / dug sbyar ma thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /gdon thams cad dang /brjed 94)byed thams cad dang / rims dang bza' nyes dang / bgo phyinyes dang / gnod sgrib (5)dang / nad thams cad 'jig par 'gyur zhing / rmi lam ngan pa thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /(7)gnod ltas (nyathams cad bdug pa'i dris 'bros par 'gyur3ste/ 'jig 7par 'gyur/ 'gyes par 'gyur te/byang chub kyi snying po la mchis kyi 37bar du lan 'ga' yang tshugs par mi 'gyur ro / /bdug pa'i rgyal po 'di rtag tu sbyar bar bgyi'o/ /'di ltar tshes bcu bzhi'i nub mo mchis la/ don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po brgya rtsa brgyad dang 62/ khro bo'i rgyal po brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /zas dkar gsum gyi gtor ma ci 'byor pa dbul bar bgyi'o/ /snying po dang nye ba'i snying po 92—22

stong ①ma brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis la/ dri dang 'bru mar gyi mar me dbul bar bgyi'o / /ri mo'i gzugs de nyid kyi ②mdun du nam langs kyi bar ②mchis nas nyal bar bgyi ste④/ rmi lam du dbyig gi mdzod (snyemathong ngam/ bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams gzhal med khang dang bcas/ rin po che'i shing dang bcas/ rin po che'i ri dang bcas/6) rdzing dang bcas/ gnas dang bcas9)/ khang pa brtsegs pa (8)dang bcas/ gzhal med khang dang bcas/6) rdzu 'phrul dang cho 'phrul dang / rnam par 'phrul pa dang bcas pa mthong ngam/ de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor /rtacing —/ khang pa brtsegs 3lhapa na bzhugs la lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po 'khor dang bcas pa mthong ngam/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag med de yang / rig sngags 'chang de la dbugs 'byin par mdzad cing legs so zhes bgyi ba yang stsol bar mdzad deturte/ kye skyes bu dam pa khyod kyis rig sngags 'chang gi skyes bu'i byed pa (nyusnyemang du byas pa dang / khyod kyis dge ba'i rtsa ba mang du bskrun 7pa dang / khyod kyis lhag 15par mang du byas pa dang / khyod kyis bya ba gang yin pa byas pa dang / khyod kyis don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po rnam par grol ba'i dkyil 'khor phyag rgya chen po dang /gsang sngags rnam par phye dzaba'i snying po sgrub pa ni grub zin te/ legs so legs so/ /khyod rig sngags 'chang gi sangs rgyas nyid du gyur cig(/ /khyod 'di nas ma 'ongs pa'i mngal gyi skye ba blangs te/ tshe brjes 38nas nga'i sangs 92—23

rgyas kyi zhing du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub kyi snying po la thug gi bar du sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi 6)zhing du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes phyag g.yas pa 2spyi bor 'jog par 'gyur / 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub thams cad stsol cing 'jig rten las 'das pa'i 'o)dngos grub sgrub pa ste/ 'di ni dam pa sgrub pa yin no zhes bdag gnyid pasad nas dga' bar mthong ste/ sgrib pa thams cad dang bral zhing yongs su dag par 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bram ze'i gzugs kyis mdun na mchis par 'gyur zhing 'dod pa thams cad kyi mchog stsol bar 'gyur ro/ /gzugs kyi ri mo de yang 'bar zhing 'od zer 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /yon tan brgya (6)stong mang po gzhan yang 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten pa'i phun sum tshogs pa yang 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /skye bo dang rgyal po dang / blon po dang / bram ze dang / khyim bdag thams cad dbang du 'gyur zhing cher (7)mchod par 'gyur ro/ /dge sbyong dang bram ze rnams las 8)don yod pa'i grub pa chen po thob (14par 'gyur ro/ /grub pa chen po bla na med pa'ang 'thob tu )par 'gyur ro/ /nyin gcig bzhin du nyunyedus gsum du phyag rgya bcing bar bgyi'o/ /de nas tshes bcu bzhi la thog mar dge sbyong dang bram ze rnams la ci 'byor pa'i yon dang bcas pa'i mchod ston stsal bar bgyi'o/ /de nas bdag nyid longs spyad (3par bgyi'o/ /gang gi tshe yang sangs rgyas la blta ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' la blta ba dang huste/ lha rnams la blta bar 'tshal ba na/ de'i tshe bdug pa'i rgyal po la dgug pa'i gsang sngags lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod bgyi nyu 〉ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bdug 7par bgyi'o/ /bdug pas bdugs tshapa tsam gyi mod la 92—24

zhal ston par 'gyur zhing / dge ba'am mi dge ba thams cad dam/ nyams pa'am bri ba de ①thams cad bsrung (27bar 'gyur ro/ /ji tsam che'i mthar thug gi bar du gsung ba'amatshu/ 'gro ba'am 'ong ba gsung bar 'gyur ro(ri)/ /de nas gsang sngags kyi cho ga dang / sgrub ri pa'i don dang las kyi cho ga yang ji lta ba bzhin du bshad par bgyi'o/ /o pad+ma dha ra a mo gha tsho6)dza ya de tsu ru tsu ru swā hā/don yod pa'i rgyal po'i 57nye ba'i snying po'i gsang sngags so/ /oṃ pad+ma pā sha dha rā rinasaya / a mo gha ba ra sastso da ya hūm̐/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye tho)chen po dang / mi dang / mi ma yin pa la sogs pa bskul rnguba'i gsang sngags te/ bdug pa'i rgyal pos bdugs nyurtenas chab dang / yungs kur nyurtabasres pa (gel lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod bgyis nas/ phyogs bcur gtor bon thams cad bskul bar lobagyis par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ tre+e lo kya a bh+ya skyahā na a mo gha pā sha /pad+ma bi lo ki ta nyu tsho.u yan+tu/rte/ bhu ba ne su ra/ su ru su ru/bi ma le 6)rtsu/ dgug 7pa'i gsang sngags te/ gu gul gyi bdug pa la ru1lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis nas chu dang me tog bsres pas phyogs bcur gtor bar bgyi ste/ thams cad nas dgug pa dam pa grub pa lags 2rteso/ /oṃ pad+ma bhu dza ma hā pā sha dhā na ra ṇi man+t+ra yā rdu )mi/ a mo gha pā sha dgeyan+tu bhu ba swā hā 9/mu ru mu ru hūm̐/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang / dkyil 'khor thams cad na gnas pa'i lha tshogs la sogs pa spyan drang ba'i ri gsang 92—25

sngags te/ ril ba spyi blugs dang / chab dang / me tog dang / tshems shing la bdug pa'i rgyal pos bdugs hunyete/ thams cad la lan brgya ②rtsa brgyad bzlas (gubarjod bgyis te④/ thams cad spyan drang ba'i rig sngags so/ /o pad+ma a mo gha (5)badz+ra a dhiṣ+ṭha 6)na/ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ sa'i dkyil 'khor bcing ba ste/ chab dang yungs kur 9)la lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod ⑧bgyis nas sa la gtor na(9)/ dpag tshad sum brgyas (2 kun nas 'khor ba'i sa'i dkyil 'khor rdo rjer byin gyis brlab tu)par 'gyur ro/ /de thams cad bsrungs pas 12ni rdo rje sra ba'i sems su 'gyur ro/ /dgra rnams kyis mi mthong ba dang /bgegs dang / log 'dren dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang /'byung po dang / sha za dang / brjed byed dang / ro langs dang / mkha' 'gro ma dang /3ge 'dod dgur bsgyur /tiba'i gzugs can thams cad kyis mi mthong ste/ rnam pa thams cad du mi mthong bas rdo rje ltar tsom bar yi'agyur ro/ /oṃ a mo gha pā ḍa/ sha pad mot+ta rme/ster sing hā/ san+tu ṭi si ri si ri hūm̐/ gdan gyi gsang sngags te yungs kur nyartel stong rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis te sa la gtor na/ pad+ma chen po'i gzhal yas khang gi gdan du byin gyis brlabs so )nas legs par phul bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la rin po che sna bdun las byas pa'i seng ge'i gdan du byin gyis brlabs nas (1legs par phul bar 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags 'chang gis rang gi stan la chab dang / yungs kur 2snyel lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod bgyis nas gtor te/ rig sngags 'grub pa'i na pad+ma'i stan gsang ba'i gsang sngags so/ /oṃ ma hā kā (sten ṇi ka (25pad+ma a mo gha 9 ༷pā sha dṛ bha badz+ra 2 tsho.a dhiṣ+ṭha te 28byu ru bhu ru bhan dha zhu)re swā 92—26

hā / dkyil 'khor mtha' dag na khyim dang / nags tshal dang / kun dga' ra ba dang / gtsug lag khang dang / bsti 6)gnas dang / 'chag sa dang /phug dang / dgon pa dang / gnas bsang ②ba'i phyir dri chab dang / yungs kur ⑧la lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis nas gtor bar bgyis te/gnas su gtogs pa thams cad bsang rgyab chen po bgyis par 'gyur ro/ /nyes par bgyid pa dang / bgegs dang / log 'dren dang / gnod sbyin dang /srin po dang / 'byung po thams cad 'bros par 'gyur te(she/ gnas bsang (6)ba'i gsang sngags so/ /oṃ pad+ma a mo gha ( pā she na sa man+ta (gyid sha hu༄su dik+ṣu ngosi mā ban dha (2ya/ tu ru tu ru hūm̐/ lcags kyi phur bu sor brgyad pa'i tshad lnga la/tshon 8sna lnga'i skud pas dkris te/ lan stong rtsa rme/snyebargyad bzlas brjod bgyis nas phyogs bzhir gzugs par bgyi'o/ /lnga pa ni dbus kyi gzhir (snyegazugs par bgyi ste/ rgyang grags bdun 'khor 8bar mtshams tsobacing ba bgyis par nyu sna'agyur ro/ /ji srid du phur bu ma phyung phonyeb de srid du mtshams chen hunyepo bcing ba khu )bgyis par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ a mo gha maṇ+ḍa la ban+t+ra 37ya sa marnye ri rten/ pad+ma ma hā pad+me dhu ru dhu ru swā hā/ dkyil 'khor bcing ba ste/ dri chab dang / yungs kur (snyel lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis nas dkyil 'khor mtha' dag dang / de bzhin du 'og dang steng du yang gtor te/ dkyil 'khor chen po bcing bar kyi stebagyis par 'gyur tezhun/ bgegs dang / log 'dren dang /gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / 'byung po dang / 9 sha za mchi bar 'os pa thams cad kyis mchi bar mi 'gyur ro/ /sems can gdug pa dang / lha 'am/klu gdug (nyepa gang su ( snyeyang rung ba de dag thams cad zil gyis mnan 8)par 92—27

'gyur ro/ /'jig rten pa'i bgyi ba ngan pa dang / sngags ngan pa dang /sems 0stengan pa dang / bgyid ②pa ngan pa thams cad yongs su spangs par ①'gyur ro/ /o a mo gha pa ri shud (gedhe sho dha ya sa marnye na/ dhi ri dhi ri shud dha ⑤sa twa (yem hā (7ripad+me hūm̐/ 'dis ba'i rnam lnga la lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis tshanasate/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa'i cha mtha' dag na/ gtsug lag khang ngam/dgon pa'am/ bya ji)bas sam/ zurgang cigang ngam/ 'chag sa'am/ gnas sam/tshal lam/ nags tshal lam/ skyed (9)mos tshal lam/ kun dga' ra ba'am/brang tsosa'am/ skyabs sam/ khang pa la gtor 37na stong pa'am/ mi stong pa'am / 'dam rdzab dang / mi gtsang ba dang / phyag dar gyis gang ba dang /'byung po dang / sha za dang / yi dgas 1gel sogs te rigs ngan pa thams cad yongs su spangs par 'gyur ro/ /gtsang ba khyasnyedag par 'gyur ro/ /gnas gtsang bomar 'gyur ro/ /bdag nyid la dbang bskur (snyen bza' 8nyes dang /bgo lho 7nyes dang / gnod ltas 3)dang / gnod sgrib kyi (6gnas ngan pa thams cad yongs su dag par 'gyur ro/ /gtsang ma dag par 'gyur ro/ /mi gtsang ba gtsang 2 bar 'gyur ro/ /tshangs par spyod pa ma lags pa tshangs par na/spyod par 'gyur ro/ /bsnyen gnas ma bgyis pa ni bsnyen gnas bgyis par 'gyur ro / /de la lha thams cad bsrung ( rteb dang / bskyab 32pa dang sba ba bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /dbang phyug dang dbang phyug chen po dang / tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / khyab 'jug chen po 3 tshodang / gshin rje dang / chu lha dang /lus ngan la sogs pa bsrung ri geb dang / bskyab pa dang / sba ba'i slad du/rtag tu rjes su 'brang bar 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten pa zhu5thams cad kyi ( )snying du 92—28

sdug pa dang / mchod par 'os par 'gyur ro/ /tshig btsan 6)par 'gyur ro/ /nad thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /sdig pa dang / sgrib pa dang /gnod ②pa la sogs pa thams cad las yongs su thar bar 'gyur ro/ /phyogs bzhir kun tu gtor na 'thab pa dang 'thab mo dang / rtsod pa dang / 'gyed pa dang / mu ge dang mi ngas dang / yams kyi nad (gyidang / gnod pa dang /'tshe ba dang / 'khrug pa thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /nyin gcig zhi)bzhin du skubadag nyid la dbang bskur (yeram/ reg par bgyid zhi na/ rig sngags dang phyag rgya 6)dang / dkyil 'khor gyi rim par dbye ba dang las chen po 'grub (pepar 'gyur ro/ /don yod pa'i grub pa chen po 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /gang dang ⑩gang du mchis pa de dang der cher (7mchod par 'gyur ro/ /thams cad kyis mi zlog (9par 'gyur ro/ /nyin gcig nyunyebazhin gzhal med khang rgya chen po bkra zhing rnam par bkra yib chen po rmi lam du mthong ba dang / rnam pa thams cad du mchog rgya chen po 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /dge sbyong dang / bram ze dang /rgyal tsorigs dang / khyim bdag dang / rgyal po dang / blon po dang /btsun mo'i 'khor 8dang bcas pa thams cad dbang du 'gyur zhing 1 tshomachod par 'os par 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu gtsang mar 32spyod par tsho)gtsang zhing 2 byedag par 'gyur ro/ /rtag par dus kun tu 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug blta ninya'atshal bar 'gyur ro/ /'dod pa thams cad kyi 3lhemachog stsol sa bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med rmi lam du rtag tu mthong zhing shi 'phos tsho tsunas kyang snye'ajig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /oṃ pad+me sa ra sa ra tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha ma hā zhu'us 92—29

mo gha sa ma ya ②swā hā/ gsang ba chen po'i dam tshig gi ②gsang sngags so/ /oṃ bi pu la pad+ma a mo gha pra (mis ra pra stibi sha tu/ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ 'jug pa'i gsang sngags so/ /o a mo gha a nu sha ya ma hā 5gepad+ma ban dhu yire hūṃ/ slob ma'i gsang sngags so/ /oṃ a mo gha pad+ma shi khe tsano/tu ru tu ru/ tiṣ+ṭha (kyebadz+ra ban dhe swā hā/spyi gtsug kyi)bcing ba'i gsang sngags song/ /lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas so/ /oṃ a mo gha pad+ma dza lo ta tshuk+ṣi pa/ bhi ri bhi ri hūm̐/ chab bteg pa'i gsang sngags te/lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas so/ /oṃ a mo gha bi ka ṭa saṃ 44bha ra pad+ma ā tsos ṇi 8dza la pa skoti/ ku ru ku ru hūm̐/ bum pa'i gsang sngags te skyelan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas so/ /oṃ pad mo pra sa ra a mo gha bi ma le bha ra bha ra swā hā/ chab kyi rgyun gyi gsang sngags te/ lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas so/ /oṃ a mo gha pad+me su ⑩ pad+me/pūr+ṇa nyunyeka re dhi ri dhi ri bi ma hu7le swā hā/ lag pa'i gsang sngags te/ lag pa gnyis la lan stong sum̐ 7rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis nas/ dkyil 'khor dang gsang sngags dang / phyag rgya dang / cho ga zhib mo dang / bsgrub pa'i dgos pa thams cad bgyi ste/ sgrub pe thams cad la bsgrub par bgyi zhing las 0thams cad la dus thams cad du bgyi'o/ /oṃ a mo gha bi ma le dzi hā gra zhu)rma sho dha ni saṃ sho dha ya dha ra dha ra bi ma le ༷ —5pad+ma ka du ma la dzi hā ri snyesu hā/ lce sbyang ba'i gsang sngags te/ dri chab la lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis te( 9/ kha bshal la lce'i dri ma yongs su dag par 'gyur ro/ /pad+ma dang / ku mu da'i 'orte'adab ( nam dang / 'dra bar lce mnyen 37par 'gyur ro/ /so dang rkan so byedang mgul zhu7pa yongs su dag par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ a mo gha na dha bsti zhigesu ru su ru pra bhu ru di ri bya gan dhi zho snapad+ma pra bho swā 8nyahā/ gsang sngags 'dis khar stsal ba'i 92—30

ku'i ②ta sa man+ta a ba (gyelo kā ( ya na ma s+t+ri ④ya ba⑤/ a dhiṣ+ṭha ta a mo gha pad+me/ tsa ra bi gtsa ra sañtsa ra hūm̐ hūm̐/ de ma thag tu dus gsum la rnam par lta 97)ba don yod pa'i rgyal po pad+ma 'bar ba (8)gsal ba'i cho 'phrul dang bcas pa'i phyag rgya'i rgyal pos shin tu phra ba'i rdul dang mnyam pa'i dus gsum du gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 6)zhing mang po mtha' dag cher g.yos par 'gyur ro/ /dus gsum du gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gi sku las 'od zer sna tshogs 'bum phrag brgya stong du ma dag byung tshopho nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad rab tu dgyes 17shing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing la mdzad pa'i thugs rje chen pos phyag gser gyi kha dog lta bu brkyang dzigenas/ rig sngags 'chang gi spyi bor 'jog par 'gyur ro/ /sgrub tu pa dam pa don yod pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyis/ byin gyis brlabs pa stsol bar 'gyur ro/ /dbang phyug dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / tshangs pa dang / lha'i bu dang /gshin rje dang / chu lha dang / lus ngan dang / khyab bdag dang / kun 'gyed tsogazhon nu la sogs pa lha rnams srung tsheb dang / skyob pa dang / sbed par tu snabagyid par 'gyur ro/ /phyag rgya bcings pa tsam gyi mod la sdig pa dang /sgrib pa thams cad dang / 'jigs pa brgyad rnams dang / chad pa thams cad las yongs su thar bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i grub pa yid du mchi bar 'gyur ro/ /las thams cad bgyid pa'i phyag rgya thams cad du mchog lags 38par grags pa lags so/ /don yod dam tshig mchog grags pa/ /pad+ma rgyas pa'i phyag rgya bcing / /mdzub hurtemo gung mo zu rnams pad+ma lcags kyu'i tshul du bgyis 21la/sen ( 2mo mnyam par gzhag pa'i phyag rgya 'di bstan te/ rnam par grol ba'i 92—47

dkyil 'khor rtse (17ba'i phyag rgya 'dzin pa'i gsang sngags 'di brjod do/ /oṃ a mo gha pad māṃ tshog ku sha sa ma na ri yān/ griṇ+ḍa griṇ+ḍa / dha ra dha ra/ ma hā satwa ⑤hūm̐ / phyag rgya bcings te ༷6)bcings ma thag tu'am/ bzlas pa ④tsam gyis dus gsum du gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyis legs so zhes bgyi ba stsol bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad dgyes 85pa dang / mnyes pa dang / rab tu dgyes pa dang / tshim pa dang /thugs dgyes ri9)pa skye bar 'gyur zhing / rig sngags 'chang la thugs rje chen po rgyas pa'i snying po grub pa dam pa stsol bar 'gyur zhing / yang nas yang du mthong ba stsol bar 'gyur ro/ /mchog thams cad stsol bar 'gyur ro/ /don yod pa'i zhags pa'i 1 dam tshig grub pa stsol bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi nyu1gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhib mo phyag rgya dang gsang sngags 'dzin pa rnam par grol ba'i dkyil 'khor gzung 49ba tsam gyis dam tshig (rterjes su 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /thams cad du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 8phyag rgya dang dam tshig 'tshal bar 'gyur ro / /thams cad du dgos pa'i gsang sngags 'grub 8par 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mchog sbyin pa rtag tu blta 'tshal skyabar 'gyur ro/ /lag mthil pad+ma ltar bgyis la mdzub nyu 7mo gung mo rdo rje ltar bgyi zhing / mthe 18chung brkyang ba'i phyag rgya ni/ /pad+ma 'chang la bdug pa dang / /me tog 19la sogs dri rnams dang / /phreng ba byug pa phye ma dang / /ba dan gos dang rgyan dang ni/ /gtor ma mchod yon rab tu dbul/ /bum pa gang ba'i dri sogs dang / /tshon skud sna lnga tshon dbye'o ci/ /gzhan yang zas ni sna tshogs la//92—48

phyag rgya 'di ni kun la mchog /'di ni dbul ba'i phyag rgyar gsungs/ /thams cad du ni don yod mchog /go bar bgyi ba'i 4)phyag rgya 'di(ge/ /pad+ma'i phyag gis byin gyis brlabs(8)/ /gung mo 0nor bus (5)dkris pa lta bu'i phyag rgya 'di ni bag tsha ba med pa'i pad+ma rin po che'i phyag rgya lags te/ 'di ni grub pa dam pa lags so/ /spyan drang ba'i gsang sngags ni(6)/ oṃ a mo gha pad+ma ma hā sa t+ya ā (7)ya tu mi ha (8)maṇ+ḍa le/ bi ri bi ri bi ri kyi)pad+ma bhu dze swā hā/ dus gsum gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /gsol ba gdab pa'i gsang sngags teyi/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / /phyag na pad+ma gsol gdab dgug /lha rnams kun dang de bzhin du/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni lha rnams dgug /phyag rgya 'di ni bcings pa yis/ /phyogs bcu kun gyi sangs rgyas dang / /de bzhin byang chub sems dpa'ang 'du/ /lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang / /dri za lha min de bzhin du/ /nam mkha' lding dang mi 'am ci/ /lto 'phye chen po nyid dag steta / /de kun skad cig 'du 'gyur zhing / /bsrung (2ba'i phyir ni som nyi med / /lag pa rdo rje'i tshul du bzhag la lag pa'i mthe'u nyugechung rnams pad+ma'i mtshams su bya ste/ gung mo rnams yid tsam bskums rngupa'i phyag rgya mabacings pa ni / grub ldan 'di ni phyogs bcing tshadang / /dkyil 'khor bcing bar bgyis pa 6)yi/ /bsrung /sheba'i las la 19bag tsha med/ /phyag rgya 'di ni bcings zhu tshotsam dang / /gsang sngags stong ni bzlas tsam gyis/ /dpag tshad bdun ni khor yug tu/ /mtshams bcing 2)dkyil 'khor bcing ba na dang / /bsrung sheba'i las ni bgyis par 'gyur( d+ku/ /oṃ a mo gha badz+ra dṛ bhā sa pad+ma ban dha sa marnye na ma hā sa man+ta rak+ṣan+tu rmā 2zhe/ tsu ru tsu ru hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas don yod phyag rgya ste/ /grub 92—49

ldan sems can kun smra na/ /don yod pa yi 1)phyag rgya ni②/ /khyad par 'phags pa gzhan yang bstan(gyi/ /rdo rje thal mo sbyar nas sor mo rnams mnyam par bzhag ste ni/ srin lag kha gdengs (5)la sor mo rnams yid tsam bskums dupa ni/ don yod sna tshogs rgyal po yi/ /pad+ma'i phyag rgya chen por bsgragasal / /phyag rgya 'di ni las kun dang / /'jug pa'i las kun sbyar ba dang / /dkyil 'khor phyag rgya mchog kun gsungs/ /phyag rgya 'di ni bzung 6)tsam dang / /gsang sngags dam pas bsrungs (9rabagyis nas3 no/ /rig sngags 'chang ba 'jug par 'gyur/ /dus gsum gshegs pa rnam thar pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa grub par 'gyur/ /oṃ badz+re badz+re'iste/ a dhiṣ+ṭha te pad+me dhibi shwa rū hunyepa dha re/ dha ra dha ra hūm̐/ pra be sha tu s+t+ri ya ṅgā nu nye rag da tson dha 7ri tu ṭi yonaswā hā/ phyag rgya 'di ni bcings tsam gyis/ /de nyid grub pas phyogs bcu yi/ /sangs rgyas zhing ni rnam drug tu/ /g.yo bar 'gyur ba nyashesom nyi med/ /phyag na pad+ma'i lus 'bar nas/ /mgu ba chen po 'byung bar 'gyur/ /rig sngags 'chang la 'dzum bzhin gyis/ /rtag tu lta 1/zhing mdun na mchis/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni zhing kun dang / /mtho ris sgo rnams 'byed par 'gyur/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis gnas rnams na/ /gnas pa'i lha rnams sgo 'byed cing / /sum cu rtsa gsum gnas sgo na / /gnas pa thams cad sgo 'byed do/ /bde can du )'jig rten khams dag ni / /sgo na gnas pa sgo 'byed do/ /phyag rgya 'di ni bcings tsam gyis/ /gnas kun tu ni 'jug par 'gyur/ /phyag rgya sdig pa thams cad 'phrogasgonye /nye ba'i nyon mongs thams cad 'joms/ /sdug bsngal kun las rnam par grol/ /gnod pa thams cad 'jig na par bgyid/ /dmyal ba bcu drug rnams las thar//92wa 50

phyag rgya ①bcings pa tsam gyis ni/ /mi bzad 'jigs pa brgyad rnams dang / /nyes byas thams cad 'jig ②par byedabya/ /dmyal ba'i sgo ni gcad ④par 'gyur / /mi bzad 'jigs las bsgral ⑤bar 'gyur/ /phyag rgya 'di ni mthong tsam gyis/ /mtshams med lnga ni bgyis pa dang / /sdig pa kun las rnam par thar / /sems can kun las yirtag tu sdug /de bzhin gshegs kun byin gyis rlob/ /phyag rgya ⑦'di ni (nyamathe bo'i rtse 7mo cung zad bkug la bzung ⑩ste/gung mo pad+ma'i ral pa'i tshul du bgyis te'onyu/ spyi bo'i ral pa sa yonyel bzhag pa ni pad+ma'i ral 8pa'i phyag rgya lags te/ 'di ni don yod pa'i zhags ⑩pa zhes bsgrags 7te/ sems can thams cad la sman pa'i slad du/ gsang sngags 'di brjod par bgyi'o/ /oṃ a mo gha pad+mo dza ⑩le bi sho dha ya rtsu/ bi ri bi ri bi ma le swā hā/ phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag nas chab dag gis bkrus tsonas gtsang mas gsang sngags 'di/ brgya tunyertsa brgyad du bzlas nas su/ /phyag rgya gsang sngags tu)dogs med pas/ /rtag tu bkrus pa'i mod tsam gyis/ /mi gtsang ba ni gtsang bar 'gyur / /mi gtsang spyod pa gtsang ba dang (3 bye/ /tshangs spyod ma yin tshangs spyod 'gyur / /mi thub pa ( )ni thub par 'gyur/ /bsod nams phung po so lha bzhin 'bar / /zla ba nyi ma bzhin du mdzes/ /'jig rten kun snying rtag tu sdug /gsang sngags bla na med pa 'grub/ /grub pa don yod zhags pa yi/ /don yod de nyid grub 3par 'gyur/ /lha rnams kun ni 'du 'gyur te/ /bsrung 8 )ba'i phyir ni som nyi med/ /mgon po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ /sems pa tsho cigemachog sbyin dag pa po/ /mchog sbyin rgyun du thams cad du/ /nyi ma re re mthong 'gyur zhing / /tshe 'phel rtag tu nad med 'gyur/ /de bzhin mgu dang rgyas 92—51

par 'gyur/ /thams cad du ni las 'grub ste6)/ /gnod pa kun las rnam par grol / /sdig pa kun las rnam par thar/ /thams cad du ni bkra shis mchog /khrus kyi rnam pa 'di dag ni/ /don yod khrus kyi mchog yin no/ /lag gnyis bsdams la rinatsho'og tu bstan/ /srin lag gnyis yud (btsam bskum (gepa ni pad+ma'i nor bu phyag rgya lags te/ kun nas kyang ni mnyam par bzhag(5) /phyag rgya ting 'dzin lta bu 'di/ / skyil mo krung 67bcas mchis nas su/ /phyag rgya ⑦'di dag bcing bgyis zhing /ri/ /mnyam par gzhag nas gsang sngags bzlas/ /bcings pa tsam gyi 9)mod nas ni/ / skyil krung 1 )rdo rje lhun mnyam 7'gyur/ /kun nas go char gyur nas ni/ /bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad dang / /gnod sbyin srin po 'byung por bcas/ /lha min mkha' lding gis mi mthong / /phyogs dang phyogs kyi mtshams 12dag tu/ /de dag thams cad rgyang ring 'bros/ /bgegs med par ni las 'grub pas/ /bzlas pa'i las la som nyi med/ /oṃ a mo gha badz+ra dṛ 12nye pad+me shwa ra hūm̐/ thal mo mnyam par sbyar la mdzub yimo dang gung mo bkug nas/ mthe bo gepad+ma kha phye ba ltar bgyis tetshe/ don yod pa'i dbang phyug rgyal po'i phyag rgya'o/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi mdun du gsang sngags dang phyag rgya bcing bar nyu rdzobagyi'o/ /oṃ pad+me shwa ra a mo gha ba ra dā/ bi ri bi 18ri swā hā/ 'dis thog mar bzlas brjod nyi shu rtsa gcig bgyi'o / /de'i 'og tu phyag rgya bcings nas/ don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po de kho na nyid sems pa'i 19bsam pa rtse gcig tu ( bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /lan cig bzlas kāpa tsam gyi mod la/ dus gsum du rgyun du gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas 'bum phrag brgya stong gang gā'i sa klung gi bye ma snyed sortedang mnyam pa g.yo bar 92—52

'gyur zhing / de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis/ rig sngags 'chang de la legs so zhes bgyi ba 46pa ①bar 'gyur ro/ /dbugs 'byin par mdzad do/ /rig (7sngags 'chang de la 'od zer sna tshogs gtong bar lamadzad do/ /mgon po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dran par bgyis pa tsam gyi ④mod la mdun du mchis par 'gyur ro/ /'di ltar bcings pa tsam gyis pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro / /pha rol tu phyin pa bcu dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres (5)pa bcwa 3)brgyad dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin (7gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /mi 'jigs pa bzhi thob ⑧par 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad 6)yongs su dag pa thob 3 )par 'gyur ro/ /phyag rgya 'di bcings la don yod pa'i rgyal po'i snying po dran par bgyis pa tsam gyi mod la/ yon tan dang phan yon rnams 'thob 47par 'gyur ro/ /bzlas brjod brgya rtsa brgyad bgyis la phyag rgya brgya rtsa brgyad bcings nas/ zhag gcig smyung 6)ba bgyis te bzlas brjod bgyis na/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bdag nyid kyi rang bzhin du mdun na kyi mchis nas/ rig sngags 'chang chal legs so zhes bgyi tsob 465 te/ rig sngags 'chang legs so legs so / /'di ni bzlas brjod kyi dam pa yin no/ /zhes dpung pa g.yas pa brkyang ba'i lag pas rig sngags 'chang gi spyi bor bzhag nas/ dbugs 'byin par mdzad de mtshur shog bu gang 'dod pa'i mchog slongs shig dang sbyin no/ /khyod rjes su bzung zhing lho tshobyin gyis brlabs nya pas nga'i bu rig sngags 'chang gi thu bor gyur cig /rig sngags 'chang khyod kyis don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po 92wa 53

grub pas/ rnam par grol ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyag rgya rim par dbye ba dang /cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po la brtan par gyis shig /snying rje chen po'i sems kyis sems can thams cad la goms par gyis shig /khyod 'di nas ma 'ongs pa'i mngal du gnas nas/ shi 'phos te 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du 'gro bar 'gyur zhing / khyod pad+ma'i nang du rdzus 0)te skyes nas/ rgyan (mithams cad kyis brgyan (5)cing mtshan dang dpe byad kyis rab tu brgyan ④pa/ byang chub kyi snying po'i mthar thug gi bar du tshe dpag tu med par 'gyur ro/ /'di ltar tshig gzhan mi smra bar lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis te/ du phyag rgya brgya rtsa brgyad bcings pas/(6) lan stong rtsa brgyad tshang nas tshunam mkha' la mchi bar 'gyur ro/ /don yod pa'i (87rnam par 'phrul pa rnam par dag pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor los sgyur 59bar 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags 'chang 'bum phrag bye ba brgya ⑩stong phrag bcwa 11brgyad kyis yongs su bskor tugebar 'gyur ro/ /tshe dpag tu ma mchis par 'gyur ro/ /don yod 3 rgya cher snang ba zhes bgyi ba'i rdzu 'phrul 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /rdzu 'phrul gang gi mthus stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams su 10dpung pa bskum tshupa las brkyang pa tsam gyis mchi zhing slar ldog par 'gyur7/ bzlas brjod brgya tu)stong bgyis la phyag rgya brgya stong bcings na/ tshe 'di nyid la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang 'dra bar 'gyur ro/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge tunye'adzin gyis rnam par rol pa'i don yod pa'i mig yongs su dag pa 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /dbang phyug dang dbang phyug chen po dang / tshangs pa dang / lha'i bu dang / drag po dang / dbang po dang / nyi ma dang / zla ba dang / gzhon nu dang / gshin rje dang / chu lha 92—54

dang ske/ lus ngan la zhi)sogs pa'i gzugs sna tshogs mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /klu'i rgyal po'i gzugs rnam pa sna tshogs kyi bar du mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /ji (milta ji ①ltar sems can rnams 'dul bar 'gyur ba ④de lta de lta bu'i gzugs mthong bar 'gyur te/ 'di ni 'jig rten pa'i bzlas brjod sgrub pa 'bum lags so/ /'bum bzlas pas 'jig rten las 'das (nyapa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad na/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mngon sum du snang ba'ang ⑥mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la 9)lung bstan pa 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub kyi snying po la thug gi bar du phyir mi ldog par byin gyis rlabs kyis byin gyis 8)brlabs par 'gyur ro/ /phyag rgya bcings te skyil mo krung 6)bcas nas/ sems can tho )thams cad la brtse ba dang /'byung po thams cad la byams pa dang / snying rje'i (1)sems kyi rang bzhin gyis don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po lan cig nya bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /bzlas brjod bgyis ma thag kho nar lan drug brgya rmo bzhi bcur bzlas brjod bgyis par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dbugs 'byin pa nyugemadzad cing dran pa dang / blo gros dang / gzi brjid lus la 'jug par bgyid do/ /bzlas brjod bgyis pa tsam gyi (8mod la pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /ri mo'i sku gzugs de la tsheyang 'od zer 'byung bar 'gyur ro / /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug yongs su dag pa'i bdag nyid rmi lam du mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /mchog thams cad stsol bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i las kyi sgrib pa thams cad yongs su dag par 'gyur ro/ /sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad yongs su bsal 1 ba dang / gtugs par 'gyur ro/ /nad thams 92wa 55

cad spangs par 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten pa'i dgos pa sgrub yo)pa rnams kyi dam pa thams cad 'grub par 'gyur bas sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa bsgom ②par bgyi'o / / //'phags pa don yod pa'i zhags pa'i cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po/ bam po gsum pa/ thal mo lhan cig bsdams (57te sbyar la/ rtse mo yid tsam bkug ste khar gtad la srin lag gnyis phyir 'gyed cing / gung mo pad+ma lta ④bur bgyis te / sngags 'di brjod do/ /o tu ru tu ru pad+me a mo gha sid dhi ⑤rgyu/ phyag rgya 'di ni don yod 'grub(6)/ /las rnams grub dang ldan pa yi/ /'di ni bcing ba bgyis pa yis/ /kun rig myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /myur du ston pa stsol 'gyur te/ /rnyed dka' don yod grub pa mchog /mchog kun rab tu stobs (pepar 'gyur/ /'jig rten 'das pa kun de bzhin 59)'jig rten pa/ /sgrib pa thams cad las ni rnam par grol/ /bsod nams phung po tsodag ni rtag tu 'phel / /bkra shis sgra ni 'byung bar 'gyur ba'o/ /lha rnams rtag tu bsrung ⑩bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje bcings pa the shin tu bcing / /rtag tu sems ni brtan ⑫por bgyi/ /mdzub nyurwamo dag ni yid bskums nas7/ /snying po 8dag ni tunyerab tu brkyang / /don yod pa'i pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor phyag rgya dang / snying po gsungs pa dang / pad+ma'i dbang phyug gi phyag rgya las dang don thams cad 'grub lhonyepa'i gsang sngags de nyudzadag thams cad 3 sdugasungs nas/ de nas don yod pa'i rgyal po 21gsungs pa/ oṃ a mo gha skṛ tsho shed ya/ pad+me dha ra dha ra pad+ma dha ra ma hā maṇ+ḍa 2 la ṣ+ṭṛ 3 chod ya hūm̐/ snying po phyag rgya 'di ni bcings pa yis(nye/ /pad+ma 'chang ba'i don yod snying po yi/ /grub pa de nyid yang dag som nyi med/ /thams cad 92wa 56

du ni las rnams thams cad dag /de ni grub par 'gyur te som nyi med/ /shin tu gsang ba'i phyag rgya gzung hu)/ /shin tu gsang ba'i gsang sngags bzlas/ /shin tu bkru bas gos gtsang gyon(mi/ /gtsang ma'i sems kyis 'chang bgyid cing / /sems can kun la brtse zhi)gyur nas/ /rtag tu bla ma gus par bsgomache/ /rtag tu shin tu dang bgyi zhing / /pad+ma'i ⑤phyag la dga' bar bgyi/ /myur du las 'grub myur du ni/ /pad+ma 'chang dang sangs rgyas 'grub(6)/ /myur du 'jig rten dbang phyug 'thob/ /myur du sems can kun phan ldan/ /lag pa g.yon pa brkyang ba 57)tsam gyis khar pad+ma'i tshul du bzhag la lag pa bsgyur nas/ mdzub 2mo gyen du bsgreng mthe bo 5)yid tsam bkug la lag hu )pa g.yas pa brkyang ste/nya/sor mo rnams pad+ma'i tshul hurtedu gzhag la/ mthe bo /2yid tsam bkug ste/ gung mo don yod pa'i zhags par 8bgyi ba ni/ don yod pa'i zhi ba'i cho ga pho chen po'i mig sems can thams cad la byams pa'i sems dang / snying rje'i bdag nyid can lags 7te/ gsang sngags 'di brjod do/ /oṃ pa shu pa ti pā sha the snadha ra sa ha sra rasmi tu)pra ti mni hu)ta kā ya/ ā kur+sha ṇi saṃ tso zhu2 da ni/ bhu ru bhu ru/a mo gha pā (1sha sid dhi hūm̐/ phyag rgya 'dis gsang sngags lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas so/ /de nas don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po bzlas nas/ lag pa g.yas pa /nu zhags pa'i phyag rgya'i tshul du brdeg dzodagecing slar yang rang gi gnas su gzung lugezhing / gsang sngags lan bdun bzlas te/ lan bdun du yang brdeg 25go / /don yod rgyal po bzlas pas zhudzini/ /bsam pa mchog tu dag pas bgyi/ /bzlas pa tsam gyi mod la ni/ /don yod rinu zhags pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /byang chub thams cad dgug zhu)pa dang / /mod la ( khesangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur/ /gzhan 92—57

yang dgos pa sna tshogs dag /ci ltar yid la bsams 6)pa bzhin/ /mod la grub pa bla 55med dang / /med la thams cad dgug nipar 'gyur/ /lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin 47dang / /dri za lha min nam mkha' lding / /mi 'am ci dang lto 'phye che/ /rig sngags 'chang la blta 55)ba'i phyir/ /thams cad de yi mod la 'du / /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad dag /de nyid gzigs pas gzigs par 'gyur/ /rig sngags 'chang la phyag bgyi'i phyir/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'du bar 'gyur/ /mgon po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ /mchog sbyin spyi bor phyag 'jog 'gyur/ /yongs su dag pa'i bdag nyid kyi/ /rang bzhin mod la ston par mdzad/ /gang dag mnar med song ba dang / /sems can mtshams med lnga bgyid ri nodang / /gang dag 'phags la skur ⑦'debs dang / /gang dag dam chos spong ba dang / /phyag rgya 'di mthong 'dzin 'jug gam/ /bcings pas mod (8)la sdig pa kun/ /'jig 'gyur mod la 'dren pa mthong / /phyag rgya bcings pa tsam gyis ni/ /dgos pa thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /phyag rgya 'di ni mthong tsam dang / / gsang sngags zlos 6)par bgyid pa dang / /rig sngags 'chang ba mthong ba de/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang ni/ /mngon du mthong bar blta 7bar bya/ /tshe rabs brgyud nyu1par bskal pa ni/ /brgya dang stong du bsags pa yi/ /sdig pa las kyi sgrib pa rnams/ /phyag rgya bcings sam mthong tsam gyis/ /de kun 'byung 5she'agyur som nyi med/ /thal mo lhan cig dam par hu/sbyar te/ mkhas pas pad+ma'i tshul du bgyis la mdzub phonamo nor bur nyugebagyis te gung mo yid tsam zhig skyabakug pa ni / yid bzhin gyi nor bu chen po'i rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo ste lag pa spyi bor brkyang 92—58

nas spyi bor dbang bskur ba ①stsol ba'i gsang sngags 'di brjod do/ /oṃ s+t+ri ya dhā ②nu ga tal/ a bhi lik+ṣañtsa tu/ sarba s+t+ri ya dha(she/ a bhi (6)te kiḥtso) pad+ma ma ṇi su pad+me/ a mo ghi sarba ta thā ga gta/ a dhi 7khri te hūm̐/ 'dis dbang bskur 4) ba tsam gyis/ rig sngags 'chang la de bzhin gshegs pa /mthams cad kyis dbang bskur tu)bar 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi 3)phyag gis dbang bskur 7bar 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags 'chang gi bya ba byed pa'i 8rgyal po chen por 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags 'chang thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa thams cad rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten thams cad kyi gtso bo gcig pu'i yiganas su 'gyur ro/ /spyi gtsug rdo rje'i tu)pad+ma bcing / /rtag tu sor mo'i rtse mo brkyang / /mdzub tu)mo lcags kyu'i tshul du bgyi'o⑩/ /rang gi gdong gi khro gnyer bzhin/ /khro bo'i rgyal po'i phyag rgya ste(3 / /las kun sgrub par bgyis 67pa yi/ /thams cad sgrub byed ni phyag rgya ste/ /kun sgrub dam pa'i so gsang sngags pas/ /'di dran sgrub ( ༄pa kun kyi mchog /o kro dha rā dzā ( gedha ma ( gahā/ a mo zhu nyagha ha na ha (sten/ sarba duṣ+ṭa 20/na hūm̐/phyag rgya 'di dran tsam gyis kyang / /mthu chen po yi zhu tshogasang sngags kyis/ /gdug du)pa kun ni rnam 'jig ste/ /ri rab kyang ༄ )ni snyil (snyebar bgyid/ /phyag rgya bcing ba du )bgyis pa yis/ /sdig pa thams cad 'jig par bgyid/ /sems can gdug dudang gdug pa'i klu/ /bgegs dang log 'dren gdug ri5pa ste/ /de dag thams cad zhi bar 'gyur/ /phyag rgya bcings pa 'a 7tsam gyis ni/ /thams cad dbang du gyur nas mchis/ /lha dang mi dang dge sbyong dang / /bram ze rgyal rigs gang lags pa/ /thams cad dbang du gyur nas ni/ /mchis 92wa 59

par 'gyur ba ri1)som nyi med/ /rgyud ni rtag tu mnyam gzhag la/ / mthe bo mnyam (5du bteg nas ni/ /gung mo yis ④ni gung mo nyid/ /yid tsam bkug nas bsgreng ( stabar bgyi/ /'di ni pad+ma chen po yi/ /lha mo sgrol ma'i phyag rgya ste/ /grub pa bla na med pa (5yi/ /thams cad kyi ni dam pa lags/ /thal mo pad+ma'i tshul du sbyar/ /mthe bo rdo ninyid ni brkyang bgyis la/ /mthe 3)chung yid tsam bkug pa ni/ /dkar sham chen mo'i phyag rgya ste/ /'di ni kun grub bla na med/ /rdo rje'i tshul du thal sbyor (8ridam bcings shing / /shes rab can gyis g.yas pa'i lag bsgyur 9ril/ /khro gnyer bzhin ni de bzhin khro ba dang / /phyag rgya chen po kun 'dod rab tu sbyin/ /lag pa gnyis kyis thal sbyar brkyang nas ni/ /gsang ba de brkyang sna rigung mo bskum 11nas ni32/ /mthe chung brkyang tunyenas lcags sgrog 7pad+ma yibla/ /tshul du snying ga'i tsoganas su gzhag par bgyi/ /phyag rgya 'di ni phyag rgya che/ /phyag rgya 'di ni bcings pa yis/ /dkyil 'khor kun nas lha dag dang / /dkyil 'khor lha kun dga' bar 'gyur/ /thams cad 'tshogs tho bheshing 'du ba dang / /kun gyis bsrung tu bgyid som nyi med/ /phyag rgya 'di nyid bshig nyu9nas lag pa ni/ /thal 2 sbyar pad+ma'i tshul bzhin legs pu nyebyas te/ /snying gar chogegazhag pa gnod sbyin 22pho nya mos 7/ /'di ni phyag rgya lags par legs par bsgrags de/ /dang por 9rdo rje khu tshur legs bcangs tri la/ /gung mo lhag ma skum 22zhing mthe bong gzhag /pad+ma sa tshul gyi bzhin dran sgrol bdun khri )gyi/ /grub pa kun gyi bla med phyag rgya 'di/ /sdig pa thams cad 'jig cing nyon mongs kun / /nad kun nye bar zhi ba ra/som nyi med/ /don yod pa yi grub (nyepa bla 69med kyis ri ri/ /cho ga zhib mo thams cad rab tu 'grub snye/ /lag pa gnyis ni 92—60

mnyam bzhag stel/ /rdo rje'i tshul du pad+ma (mibacing / /mdzub ①mo bskum ④pa bgyis nas ni/ / mthe bo (5)yang ni dgug (6)par bgyi/ /'di ni rta mgrin phyag rgya ste/ /cho ga zhib mo'i pad+ma lags/ /pad+ma'i latshul du thal mo sbyar/ /mdzub (shemos 'khyud po)la gung mo ni/ /lcags kyu'i tshul du bsgreng bar bgyi/ /don yod zhags pa'i phyag rgya 'di/ /rgya mtsho'i klong yigi kha lta bu(sto/ /rdo rje za ba nyid kyis gsungs / /'di ni las kun bgyid pa po4nya/ /grub pa kun gyi (/2bla na med/ /phyag rgya 'di ni mdzub 6stemo'i mthe bo geganyis/ /lcags sgrog ⑩lhag ma bkug nyunyenas pad+ma'i tshul/ / snying ga'i yosheganas su gzhag pa mgrin tu7sngon gyi/ /'di ni dogs ( )med las kun phyag rgya lags/ /lag gnyis pad+ma'i khu tshur te/ /g.yas g.yon du ni bzhag nas su/ /kun nas zhi ba'i bzhin du gzhag /byams pa'i mig gnyis bgyis pa (nyani/ /zhal ni bcu gcig phyag rgya ste/ /de bzhin kun gyis mi so)thub pa'o/ /mthe bo gemanyam par mnyam bgyis ( )la/ /sor mo'i rtse mo bskums (nyepa dang / /mdzub rdu6mo gnyis ni pad+ma'i tshul/ /rig pa'i dbang phyug phyag rgya lags( tsho/ /phyag rgya 'di nyid dbus su ni/ /'khor lo'i tshul du mdzub dzozhushemo bskum( khye/ /g.yon pa brkyang ba dbang chen gyi/ /phyag rgya 'byung po thams cad 'joms / /lcags sgrog dam du bgyis nas ni/ /lag pa gnyis pa brkyang zhu )nas kyang / /snying gar (7bzhag pa'i phyag rgya ste/ /'di ni rgyun du gshin rje lags/ /lag pa g.yon pa brkyang sa nas su/ /sor mo sgreng ( snyeba'i thor tho dgugacirwa /g.yas pa snying gar rdugebazhag nas su/ /mthe bo snyudang ni mthe chung dgug( rme /lhag ma rnams ni brkyang 8)bgyis te/ /'di ni chu lha'i phyag rgya ste/ /klu kun dgug 67pa'i mchog lags so/ /lag pa gnyis ni bsdams bgyis la/ /sor mo 92—61

phyin ka (1)log tu sbrel/ /g.yas pa dang ni g.yon pa dag /snying ga'i (miganas su gzhag bgyi ste/ /phyag rgya 'di ni lus ngan gyi/ /gnod sbyin thams cad skrag par bgyiri ri/ /lag pa g.yas pa spyi bor yang / /mthe bo mdzub ④mo dgug ⑤bgyis la/ /lag pa g.yon pa brkyang (6)nas su/ /mdzub dumo gyen du bsgreng ⑧ba ni / /'di ni tshangs pa'i phyag rgya ste/ /thams cad du ni las sgrub pa'o/ /phyag rgya 'di nyid g.yas pa yi/ /mthe chung sor mo dgug dzi)bgyis te/ /drang srong 31gas kyi phyag rgya 'di/ /lha rnams kun gyis phyag bgyis pa'o/ /lag pa gnyis ni dam bcings la/ /lta nyu )sdug 'khor lo'i phyag rgya ste/ /lha min thams cad 'gugs 11pa yi/ /khyab 'jug phyag rgya 'di zhes gsungs/ /g.yas pa bī (stedza pu (nyerar bgyi/ /g.yon pa rtse gsum tshul du bgyi/ /mthe bo tsomathe chung bskum 8pa ni / /'byung po thams cad bskrad gebagyid pa/ /'di ni grag pa'i tu —3phyag rgyar gsungs / /g.yas pa khu tshur bcings tsha/shenas su/ /mdzub 7mo brkyang phunas g.yon pa ni/ / dkur bsten 31khu tshur bcangs (rtenas gzhag /sor mo rnams ni brkyang bar bgyi/ /drag po rgyun du lta zhu bgyid pa/ /de bzhin lha yi sde dpon gyi / /gzhon nu phyag rgya 'di zhes gsungs/ /gyen du lag pa gnyis brkyang (stenas / /sor mo gsum ni brkyang bgyis te9 gi/ /mthe bo mdzub 6nyemo dgug 6)pa ni / /'od zer stong dag 'phro bgyid pa/ /'di ni nyi ma'i phyag rgya lags/ /phyag rgya 'di nyid sor mo gsum/ /bkug nas sor mo gnyis gnyis brkyang / /skar ma'i tshogs kyis mdzes gyur pa/ /'di ni zla ba'i phyag rgyar gsungs/ /gsang sngags chen po'i 2/phyag rgya 'di dag ni/ /las dang don kun grub pa bsgrub par bgyid/ /sdig pa thams cad spong zhing nyon mongs kun/ /nyams 92—62

par bgyid cing sgrib pa thams cad 'byang / /las kun zad par byed (1)cing don yod pa'i/ /las sgrub don yod grub (5)pa 'grub par 'gyur/ /o pad+ma tā re tā rā ④ya/ pad+ma bhu dze hūm̐/ o ma hā pad+me shwa raṃ (4)ge / hu ru hu ru (5)swā hā/o skṛ ⑥ku ṭi pad+me ta ra ta ra hūm̐/ oṃ pad+me paṇ+ḍa (per bā si ni/ kuṇ+ḍa kuṇ+ḍa (guswā hā/oṃ a mo gha pad+ma ba ra de sid rgya sid ṣ+ṭha tu 5)rtsu/ oṃ sarba tsitra ga mi /7ni a bha nyunyaya ro 'dri ṇi hūm̐/ oṃ a mo gha ni tā blare tā rā yoya pad+me bhu dze hūm̐/ oṃ dā ru la ⑩ru la pad+me a mo gha hūm̐/ oṃ ba ḍa ba mu khe ni krin tā nyu 3ya duṣ+ṭa tshonan hūm̐/ oṃ pad+me nī nyurtel kuṇ+ḍi shwa zhu ra/ bhu ru bhu ru rgyu 1/ oṃ sau mya zhurtab da ne pra si ta shu sa ༷ )ya hūm̐/oṃ pad+me shwa ri sā dhā 6steya hūm̐/ oṃ a mo ghi shwa re sogartsu/ oṃ sa ma ri ta re zhigata re hūm̐/ oṃ nā ga pad+ma ni hūm̐/zhu 7 o ya'i dhi (3)pa ti ri —6mu ru mu ru hūm̐/ oṃ a mo ghi brah+ma ra te hūm̐/ oṃ shi ri ba ( )ra de ri7a mo gha bhu dze hūm̐/ o a mo gha sa)rā dza pad+ma nā sa bhe/sa ra sa ra sa man+ta bhu dze tsho ri kāswā hā/ oṃ ru dra ci ru nyaṭi mi li mi li swā hā/ oṃ sha ka da ti dha re a mo gha ba ti sa)swā hā/ oṃ sa ha khri(sra ki ra ṇi sdo 7rtsu ru hi cenaswā hā/ oṃ sau ci ma brasmre 0rtsu/ de bzhin phyag rgya gsang sngags gsungs pa 8steyang / /phyag rgya tha dad gsang sngags tha dad sgrub/ /gsang sngags 'chang gis ci rigeskad gsungs pa'i las/ /rtag tu kun bgyid mdor 47na thams cad bgyid/ / gtsang ma ri tshospyod pa gtsang 4shem dag /legs bkrus gtsang rtama'i gos bgos nas/ /dri zhim dri yis dpung pa dang / /lag pa yan lag byugs nas su/ /phyag rgya lan re bcings pa na/ /gsang sngags lan re bzlas par nirtabagyi/ /phyag rgya dag ni bcings pa dang / /gsang sngags bzlas pa'i mod la ni/ /brgya 5lhastong phrag ni 'bum phrag 'bum/ /phyag rgya ci dag ni bcings par 'gyur/ /phyag rgya ne bcings 92wa 63

pa bgyis pa na/ /bsod nams kyi phung po chen po dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas dnge byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis lung bstan pa dang /byin gyis brlabs par 'gyur ro/ /lha thams cad kyis legs par bsrung 0)bar 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten thams cad kyi mchod gnas gcig pur ②'gyur ro/ /'jig rten thams cad kyi bla ma gcig pur 3)'gyur ro/ /dkyil 'khor gyi phyag rgya'i cho ga ñtsa)rim par phye ba 5dam tshig thams cad la zhugs par 'gyur ro/ /tshe dpag tu ma mchis par 'gyur ro/ /don yod pa'i rig sngags 'grubashonyapar 'gyur ro/ / tshig btsan 7dpar 'gyur ro/ /dran pa dang blo gros bag tsha ba ma mchis par 'gyur ro/ /blo gros thogs pa ma mchis par 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mchog sbyin pa mdzad pa (8)rtag tu lta lhonye'atshal bar 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu dam pa stsol 1 )bar 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu dgra dang phas kyi rgol ba dang / mi mdza' 11ba dang gdug pa dang / rab tu gdug pa thams cad pham par bgyis par 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu thams cad du rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / 'byung po dang / sha za dang / bgegs dang nyuge/ log 'dren dang / lha ma yin dang / klu thams cad mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa chen po thams cad la bag tsha ba ma mchis par 'gyur ro//rgyal po dang / blon po dang / btsun mo'i 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad dbang du gyur nas mchis par 'gyur ro/ /thams cad gtso bo gcig pur rkyunye'agyur ro/ /thams cad du 1 bla ma'i gnas gcig pur 35'gyur ro/ /tshe ring bar 9'gyur ro/ /nad thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /skyon gyi dri ma dang / ser sna dang / phrag dog thams cad dang bral nyu tshobar 'gyur ro/ /92wa 64

legs par dran zhing lus shin tu yongs su dag par 'gyur ro/ /'chi ba'i dus kyi ①mod la de bzhin gshegs pa mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mthong bar 'gyur zhing / de dag thams cad kyis dbugs 'byin par 'gyur te/ rigs kyi bu khyod 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du song shig (0ces shin tu dran pa nye bar gzhag nas dus bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /dmyal ba'i sgo thams cad bcad par 'gyur ro/ /ngan song gi 'gro ba thams cad las yongs su grol bar 'gyur ro/ /'di nas ma 'ongs pa'i mngal du skye bar mi 'gyur ro/ /skye ba na rtag tu skye ba dran par 'gyur ro/ /thams cad du pad+ma las rdzus ②te skye bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub kyi snying po la thug gi bar du sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing rigadu mchi bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'jig rten dbang phyug sprul pa yi/ /phyag rgya'i rtags ni brjod par bgyi(snye/ /khru gang kho na'i tshad dag gis(rme/ /dkyil 'khor lham pa chu)bri bar bgyi/ /gang zhig mthong ba'i mod tsam gyis/ /dga' ba dang ni mgu bar 'gyur/ /sdig pa kun las grol ba dang / /de nyid dag ni grub par 'gyurañtsaste/ /rgyun du gang gis go cha yis/ /rtag tu go cha ri9 bgos par 'gyur/ / go cha'i 3 stago ni 'bar ba dang / /mdzes pa rtag tu stsol bar 'gyur/ /cho ga zhib mo legs grub ste3lha/ /gsang sngags bla med thams cad 'grub/ /phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor bris tsam gyis/ /gnod sbyin srin po 'byer bar 'gyur/ /mthong ba tsam gyis gdon kun dgatu /'jig par 'gyur te som nyi med/ /gnod pa kun las grol 'gyur te/ /nad kun las kyang de bzhin no/ /pha rol dpung ngam rang dpung ngam/ /mi thub pa yi dgra tsho kun las/ /rtag tu legs par rgyal bar bgyid/ me+e/ /rtag tu gdon 3592—65
