las bsrung 0)ba dang / /dus kun du yang 'grub par 'gyur/ /rig sngags 'chang rnams bde bgyi (7phyir/ /de nyid dam pa 'grub 'gyur zhing / /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang gil/ /phyag rgya'i mtshan ma mtshon cha dag /dgos pa kun gyi rjes mthun (gepar/ /gang dang gang du bkod pa dag /de dang der ni phyag rgyar 'gyur/ /pad+ma kha phye ⑤zhes bgyi ba'iyi/ /pad+ma 'dab ⑦mas mdzes ⑧pa dang / /kun nas 'khor bar 'bar ba'i phreng ⑨/ /rnam par rtog pa med par bgyi/ /phyag rgya 'di kun srog las byung / /'di dag thams cad 'bras bu stsol / /rdo rje rtse gsum rdo rje'i mda'/ /dkyil 'khor pad+ma rdo rje dang / /pad+ma'i phreng ba 1 chirdo rje'i mtshan/ /pad+ma rab gnas pad+ma gnyis/ /rtag tu pad+ma legs par bgyid/ /pad+ma'i khu tshur de bzhin du/ /pad+ma'i mdzub 7mo pad+ma bgyings12 / /pad+ma'i lcags kyu hu thal mo sbyar/ /pad+ma'i lcags sgrog ④pad+ma'i gzebasko / /rtag tu 7pad+ma sems dpa' 1nadang / /nor bu pad+ma rdo rjer gsungs/ /don yod pad+ma de bzhin du/ /pad+ma'i ral gri pad+ma'i dril(nye/ /rtse gsum zhes bgyi gtun 37shing 'chang / /nor bu dbyug pa me tog dbyug /de bzhin zhags pa bdun 'dzin 2 nodang / /chu srin 'dzin dung (lha'akhor lo phyed(she/ /bī ( snyeng bru phyir se'u 'bru ri/ /zla 'dzin nyi ma 'dzin pa dang / / tho ba (nya'adzin dang tshems shing dang / /me tog phur ma bgrang 2phreng dang / /rdo rje rtse lnga don yod zhags//don yod grub pa de dag ste/ /thams cad pad+ma'i steng du dgod( smu/ /lag pa'i phyag rgya 'di bri ba/ /gang dang gang du dgod pa ni/ /lag pa'i phyag rgya bzhi bcu tham ri/ /'di dag kyang ni bri bar bgyi/ /kun nas kyang ni 'bar bar bgyi / /nor bu'i rgyan gyis bklubs ri1par bgyi/ /dkyil 'khor ldan pa'i ras 92wa 66

sam ni/ /ra ba'am rtsig par bgyis pa 'am/ /ci yang rung ba de dag ste0)/ /de dag mthong ba tsam gyis sam/ /mthong ba tsam gyi ②mod la ni/ /rtag tu sdig pa thams cad spong / /mnar med gnas su gtogs pa dang / /mtshams med pa ni lnga nyid de/ /thams cad skad cig tsam gyis 'byang / /sems can dag pa dran bgyid na/ /phyir mi ldog pa nyid du 'gyur/ /sems dpa' sa bcur phyirab tu gnas/ /'di ni phyir mi ldog pa'i gnas/ /gang lags (4)dkyil 'khor mthong ba ni/ /(khuspyan ras gzigs dbang mchog sbyin ni/ /yirgyun du spyi bo lag na thogs/ /gang gis phyag rgya 'di mthong ba/ /rgyun du mchog sbyin 'jig rten dbang / /rtag tu mngon sum mthong ba yis9)/ /de dag na)mtshungs te khyad 1)par 'phags/ /gsang sngags sum cu rtsa lnga'i tshig /rtag tu dran bgyid thams cad 'grub/ /de ni dus rnams kun du tu )yang / /ngan 'gror mchi bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rnam grol dkyil 'khor rab myur bar/ /myur du sangs rgyas nyid thob tunye'agyur/ /'od dpag med kyi sras po yiyige/ /thu nyunyebor 'gyur ba yi som nyi med/ /'jig rten mgon gyi thugs zhal nas/ /skyes sras rtag tu thu bor 'gyur/ /'dren ⑩pas 'di ni chos nyid dang / /chos las skyes par lung ston 7'gyur/ /gang gā'i klung sna sa ya bye ba brgya postong dang / mnyam pa'i bye ma snyed tu)kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed zhu )par 'gyur ro/ /tshad med grangs med dpag tu med pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /gang gis 2glesug par phyag rgya dang gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di mchis par gyur na/ phyag rgya 'di las sa'adi lta bu'i phan yon mang zhing che ba mchis par bsgrags 2)so/ /de la 92—67

gsang sngags ni/ o a mo gha man 6)dza li mi li (9tsi li hūm̐/ oṃ a shā sa yak+ṣa ṇa ②bi ga te hūm̐/ oṃ a bha (4)ya ba ra de ḍi ris)rtsu/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ a dhiṣ+ṭha te dhi ri snyi ri hūm̐/ oṃ pad+ma hre 56)da ya myukhri tsu)rtsu/ oṃ bi sa ra bi sa ra sarba mā lān ta rā dzā ya tshon)rtsu/ oṃ badz+rem+bha hu ru hu ru hūm̐/ri9) o e ku ⑩sha a mo gha ā mar+sha ya ⑩sbyi/oṃ ka ba tsa ya 12tu ru tu ru sna rtsu/ oṃ a mo gha yishe ka yili mi li urtsu/ oṃ a mo gha tsin 7tā ma ni /8tu ri sna tu ri hūm̐/ oṃ a mo gha ma ṇi 6 )tsi li tsi li hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra tu ṭi tsi li hūm̐/ oṃ a mo gha hro zhu1da ya tsa ra tsa ra shud dha satwa 'argyu/ oṃ gho ṣa ( steb ti tsi ṭi tsi ṭi lhun / oṃ bibyā kha ḍa 25ga sbyin zhunyaya sha trun ()rgyu/ oṃ tri ma la pa ri shud dhe bhi 38ṭi bhi ṭi hūm̐/ oṃ su ru su ru hūm̐/ o ma ṇi ma ṇi hūm̐/ oṃ put+pa (7ba ti dza ye hūm̐/ oṃ bho dhi tsit+ta ཿpā sha dha ra dha ra zhu)rgyu/ oṃ pad+ma pā ri gesha bi shud dhe rtsu/oṃ badz+re pā ri rishe bha ba tu mu ru mu ru hūm̐/ oṃ tsin+ta snyem ṇi pā zhu)sha ba ra (nyede hūm̐/ o tsakra pā sha zhunaswa ni ra bhā sa/ta ka dhu ru dhu ru hūm̐/ oṃ tri shu li gu pā sha 0bi lo ka tā sh+yir ya hūm̐/ oṃ nā ga pā sha ban rinadha ya kun+ta ya duṣ+ṭa (snyen ga ṇa (nye'o sha pa tā ⑩ya hūm̐ / oṃ dza cho lod bha ba dha rā snyeya hūm̐/ oṃ tsan dra ce bi ma le bi sho dha ya an dha ka 5 ra rasmi ba re hūm̐/ oṃ shrī 51bo dha ya hūm̐/ oṃ bi dza ya pūr+ṇa 4)pa re hūm̐/ oṃ pha lod bha bai ri tu re hūm̐/ oṃ pūr+ṇa ma ṇa ḍa ri rile dza ya sgogergyu/ oṃ sa ha sra 6'arasmi ki ra ṇi hūm̐/ oṃ sarba duṣ+ṭa ri na pra ha ra shā sā ya 58rgyu/ oṃ man bi sho dha ya mā lā bi ma le hūm̐/ oṃ put+pa ba ti su gan dha ba re hūm̐/ oṃ pā ni)sha sa ha sra gu ni ṭaṃ )te k+ṣa ṇa k+ṣa ṇa hūm̐/ oṃ badzod k+ṣe pa su tsi mu kha 61ci ṭi tsi ṭi sdo ju/ oṃ a mo gha a pra ti ha ta pā ni sha hāste gyi hūm̐/ oṃ sarba tra a mo gha sid dh+ya sid dh+ya rdzoshesā tsodha ya hūm̐/ lag pa'i snyo phyag rgya 'di dag dang / /de bzhin gsang sngags phyag rgya dag / lan 92—68

cig bzlas (1)pa tsam dang ni/ /phyag rgya mthong ba kho nas kyang ②/ /sdig pa thams cad mod la 'joms/ /myur du sangs rgyas nyid 'thob ⑧'gyur/ /cho ga zhib mo myur du 'grub/ /don yod zhags pa rnam (gegrol ba'i(snye/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa (7'grub par 'gyur/ /de la mtshon cha'i phyag rgya ni/ nor bu rin po che dang / me tog dang / pad+ma dang / ril ba spyi blugs dang / nor bu'i phreng 47)ba dang / bgrang phreng du byedang / dung dang / 'khor lo dang / dbyug to tsa)dang / mdung thung dang / rdo rje dang / rtse gsum pa yidang / rtse gsum kha gdengs dang / mtshon shag ti /7dang / rdo rje dang / dgra sta dang / rtse gsum pa dang (3/ yinaganyis pa 1 )dang / nor bu dang / nyugematshon shu yili dang /las kyi rdo rje dang / yid bzhin nor bu dang / mtshon cha dang / be con 1 snadang / dbyug pa dang / dbang phyug chen po'i rtse gsum dang / ral gri dang /zhags pa dang / lcags kyu dang / sprul dang / ljon shing dang / byi ru dang /dgra sta dang / 'khor lo dang / dgra sta yu ba sbom po can dang / lag pa dang / gtsug phud dang / nor bu sgron ma dang / 'od dang / 'od zer dang / gtun shing dang / 'phyang 1nyamo nyug pa nyu)dang / dgra sta dang / snod zlum po dang / bum pa (2 snadang / brag dang / ri dang / lhun po dang / sbrul 'khyil pa dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / chu srin dang / nya dang /ru 0sbal dang / g.yung drung 52'khyil pa dang / rig 3)sngags kyi dkyil 'khor dang / rig ( stesngags dang / phyag rgya dang / rtse gsum dang / dkyil 'khor dang / ral gri dang / gri dang / pad+ma'i phreng ba dang / rtse gsum dang / mu sun (nyadi dang / mtshon rtse gcig pa dang / phyag rgya bzhi pa da dang / mche ba 92wa 69

bzhi dang / zlum po dang / dung dang / 'khor lo dang / rdo rje dang / rtse gsum dang / dung dang / nor bu'i dung dang / pad+ma'i dung dang / u dha ①dang / gos dang / seng ge'i gdong dang / shang shang te'u ②dang / ka la ping ka dang / ngang pa dang / bzhad dang / khrung khrung dang / rma bya dang /gshin rje'i dbyug pa dang / gdong bzhi pa dang / dkyil 'khor bzhi dang /rtse gsum dang / bum pa gang ba dang / zla laphyed dang / nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang / zla ba'i 'od dang /(ge pad+ma bzhi dang / pad+ma gsum dang / rgya mtsho dang / me tog dang / phur ma dang / glegs bam dang / ri dgas kyi g.yang gzhi 45ridang / rdo rje lcags sgrog dang / rta babs dang / lhung bzed dang / chos gos dang / 'khar gsil yidang / so mangs ⑦dang / kha khyer dang / ska narags dang / gtsug 6)phud dang / mchod phyir thogs dang /phreng ba chen po dang / gru gsum dang / kun nas rdo rje sde dang / phyag rgya mtshon cha 'di dag ni/ /'jig rten 'dren pas gsungs pa bzhin/ /rnam grol dkyil 'khor gsang ba 'di/ /don yod zhags pa'i cho gar dran/ /ras sam gos sam rtsig 7pa 'am/ /ci yang rung ba 'dri tunyebagyid pas gye/ /dogs med legs la 1 legs 'byor pas/sge/ /mtshon tsogasal kun du 7pad+mar gzhag /phyag rgya kun nas 'bar bar bgyi/ /thams cad srog las byung bas ni(chu/ /don dang las rnams kun stsol 12cing / /phyag rgya mod la sdig pa 'phroganyurte /de ni mod la 'bras bu sterardu / /'dren pa 'jig rten dbang phyug kun/ /phyag rgya 'di ni byin gyis brlabs/ /sangs rgyas kun dang shākya ( —)yi/ /rgyal po de bzhin gshegs pas brlabs rte/ /de lta bas na mkhas pas su/ /rtag tu kun nas mtshon 92—70

bcangs na/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni dgyes 'gyur te/ /sras kyi thu bor som nyi med / /phyag rgya rim byed dam pa 'chang ba gang / /'jig rten mgon po'i sras kyi thu spyibor 'gyur/ /don yod zhags pa'i snying po gsang ba yi/ /rnam par grol ba'i snying po bla na med/ /phyag rgya dang ni gsang sngags dam pa dag② /'di 'chang ba la myur du 'grub ②par 'gyur/ / de nas ④don yod pa las thams cad pa ⑤dang / rjes su mthun ⑥pa'i zhags pa bdun bshad par bgyi ste/de nyid grub pas ci lta bu'i3)/ /cho ga'i cho ga bsgrub pa bzhin/ /so so so sor 'tsham pa yi/ /de dag kun ni rtogs par bgyi/ /de nyid grub pa'i ci lta bu'i/ /mtshan nyid gzugs ni ci bzhin pa/ /de nyid bsgrubs pas (8)zhags pa ni/ /skud pa lnga las 'grub 'gyur te/ /gsang sngags 'dzin pas 6)mod la ni/ /'grub par 'gyur la 7som nyi nyu7med/ /ras skud pad+ma'i skud pa dang / /arka hu3kha che dar dag gisatunye/ /skud pa 8shun pa'i skud pa ste/ /skud pa 'di dag bkal tunyenas de kho na nyid kyi cho ga dang cho ga zhib mo bsgrubs (9pas zhags pa /rteras skud kyi rgyu las blangs te/ tshad bzhin bkal 3)nas rtag tu smyung ‘/—1ba bgyis la legs par bkrus pa/ gos gtsang ma can tshangs par spyod pas zas dkar gsum 'tshal nas gnas gtsang ma'i phyogs su don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po mdor na byams pa'i sems dang ldan pas dran par bgyi'o/ /de nas shin tu mnyam par gzhag pas brgyad bsgril hūṃ 3 du bkal te/ don yod rgyal po ri mthal mo sbyar bas pad+ma kha phye ba thogs pa ral pa'i thor tshugs kyis bzhugs pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis bklubs du napa'i lus phyed pa 35sor bzhi pa'i tshad 3stebagyi'o/ /bgyis nas gzugs rnam pa gsum du 2gebagyis te/ des pa'i gzugs dang /92wa 71

khro gnyer (1)gyi bzhin dang / khro bo'i rgyal po'i gzugs te/ dngul lam gser las bgyi'o/ /de nas zhags pa srid kyi tshad khru bcu drug pa zhags pa'i thor to gcig na)rdo rje rtse gsum pa dang / skyu ru ra lhan cig sbrel ①ba gdags par bgyi'o / /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis yar gyi ngo'i tshes bcwa ⑤lnga'am tshes brgyad la legs par bkrus 57te gos gtsang ma bgos nas zhag gcig mchis te⑤/ skyil mo krung (77bcas nas sangs rgyas la mchod pa rnam (kyepa sna tshogs bgyis te/tshig gzhan mi smra bar zhags pa la lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /de nas stong rtsa brgyad tshang ba dang / stan bzang po bshams nas/ de'i steng du zhags pa gzhag par bgyi'o/ /don yod pa'i zhags pa'i phyag rgyas 6)dbang bskur bar bgyi'o/ /me tog dang / bdug pa dang / dri dang /7 phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / ba dan bzang po la sogs pas mchod par bgyi'o/ /a ga 11ru dang / tsan dan dang / du ru ska'i bdug yo pa dbul bar bgyi'o/ /mar me yang dbul bar bgyi'o/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis yungs kur nyusnyel lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod bgyis te/ zhags pa'i steng du gtor bar bgyi'o/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi ri mo'i gzugs la yang ci 'byor bas 3rimachod par bgyi'o/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis zhags pa de'i mdun du skyil mo krung nyugebacas te/ ma 'khrugs (7pas gdugs rtse'i 1 bar du mchod pa bgyis nas bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ / yungs kur tsore re la bzlas brjod re re 19bgyis te/ zhags pa'i steng du gtor 6 )zhing stong rtsa brgyad tshang gi bar du gdugs re re mchis par bgyi ste/ rngo ci thogs (1pas gdugs rtse'i 22bar du bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /mchod pa 6)bgyi'o/ /kha zas ngan 92—72

pa spang bar hu)bgyi'o/ /lhag ma dang sbags (mipa spang bar bgyi'o/ /gos gtsang ma bgo bar bgyi'o/ /stong rtsa brgyad tshang chanas zhags pa 'bar bar 'gyur te/gal te 'jig rten pa'i grub na ni me'i kha dog tu 'bar bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te 'jig rten las 'das pa'i (7grub na ni/ kha dog sna tshogs 'bar bar 'gyur ro / /don yod pa'i lus de yang 'bar bar 'gyur ro/ /sgra 'byung bar 'gyur te / rig sngags 'chang legs so (5)legs so/ /khyod kyis 'jig rten las 'das pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi zhags pa 'di grub kyis56ste/ khyod kyis rtso)byang chub kyi sems bla na med pa khug cig(8) /pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang / pha rol tu phyin pa bcu'i khongs su gtogs pa yongs su rdzogs par gyis shig /'on te 'jig rten pa'i sgrub 9tshon ni yid bzhin gyi nor bus bsams 1 )pa ci lta ba bzhin du yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /ci ltar yid la bsams shing nyurtasmon pa bzhin lag hu)pas 'phangs na gsang sngags kyis thams cad 'grub nyu par bgyid deyi / thams cad bkug par 'gyur ro/ /phyogs gang dang gang du 'phangs pa de logs su don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po lan khubadun bzlas par bgyis te17/mod la bsams nyu 7pa thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /gal te mtshams med pa lnga bgyis pa'am mnar med par mchi ba 38zhig na yang de'i legs par 'grub par 'gyur te/ de la yid gnyis dang / som nyi bskyed par mi bgyi'o/ /khro gnyer 19gyi bzhin gyis gang du 'phangs na/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang /dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye rdu )chen po dang / mi dang / mi ma yin pa rnams bkug nas/ rig sngags 'chang gi mdun du mchi bar 'gyur zhing / ci srid 'tsho'i rurtabar du bran bzhin 92—73

du mchis par zhi)'gyur ro/ /rgyal po dang blon po dang / btsun mo'i 'khor thams cad mchis par 95)'gyur ro/ /'jig rten thams cad kyis cher mchod par 'gyur ro/ /gang gi don du zhags pa 'phangs pa'i don de 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /khro bo'i rgyal po'i zhags pa la khro bo'i rgyal po lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod bgyis nas 'phang bar bgyi'o/ /'phangs pa tsam gyi ②mod la bgegs (4nodang log 'dren dang / gdug pa'i sems can thams cad zhags pas bcings par 'gyur ro/ /gal te 'tshal ⑤na lo'am/ lo brgya ⑥'am/ lo ⑦stong ngam/ bskal pa brgya stong gi bar du zhags pas bcings par 'gyur rodu/ /nam byams pa dang / snying rje bskyed tsa)nas/ de'i tshe don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po lan gsum bzlas 3 na phyir bkrol tunyebar 'gyur ro/ /dpung gi nang du 'phangs na dpung rnams zhags pas bcings par 'gyur ro/ /g.yul 'gyed ⑫pa'i dbus su 'phangs na mtshon cha pho dang / go mtshon dang / gzhu dang /mda' dang / mdung dang / ral gri dang / gtun shing dang / mu sin di ④dang / 'khor lo dang / thag mdung dang / mtshon cha 8thams cad dang /go cha dang / ya lad thams cad zhags pas bcings par 'gyur ro/ /chab dang yungs kur sal lan bdun bzlas brjod bgyis te/ gtor na grol bar 'gyur ro/ /zhags pa la 1 gdugs gcig bzhin ci 'byor pas mchod par bgyi'o / /gang gi don du bsams 18pa de thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /don yod pa'i zhags pa 19sgrub pa'i cho ga'o// //'on te mi snang ba bsgrub par 'tshal ( )na don yod pa'i zhags pa'i phyag rgya 92—74

lag pas bcings te/ g.yas pa dang g.yon pas gang 6)du ji skad gsungs pa bzhin zhags pa bzung srinas don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis na mi gda' ②bar 'gyur ro/ /brgya phyirtsa brgyad lan gnyis bzlas brjod bgyis na nam mkha' la mchi bar 'gyur ro/ /don yod pa'i rig sngags 'chang gi 'khor los sgyur ⑤bar 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags 'chang brgya (6ristong phrag 'bum gyis yongs su bskor ⑦bar 'gyur ro/ /lo bye ba bcur 98)'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /skra cung zad 'khyil bar 'gyur ro/ /stobs dang / brtson 'grus pha rol gyis (9)zil gyis mi gnon ⑩par 'gyur ro/ /char pa 'tshal 67bas mchod pa bgyis na ci tsam gsol ba btab pa bzhin 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /ha cang 8char pa (sheches pa dgag pa'i slad du mchod pa bgyis na char pa bkag par 'gyur ro/ /yams kyi nad dang / gnod pa dang / 'tshe ba dang / 'khrug pa thams cad dang / mi ngas thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'tshal bas rig sngags 'chang legs par khrus bgyis pa gtsang mas gos gtsang nyustem bgos la lag pas zhags pa blangs te/ gnas mthon por 'dzegs chenas don yod pa'i zhags pa'i phyag rgya dang / zhags pa bcings nas 7don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po phyogs bzhir lan bdun bzlas nas zhags pa 'phangs 'an de dag thams cad dran pa tsam gyis 'thab pa dang / rtsod pa dang / 'gyed (shepa dang / rang gi dpung dang / gzhan gyi dpung thams cad dang / phas kyi rgol ba thams cad 19dang / mi mdza' zhu snab thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /'jigs 31pa dang /yams kyi nad dang / gnod pa thams cad dang / mi ngas chen po dang mu ge'i dgon pa'i 'jigs pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /ha cang char che ba 92—75

dang / dus ma lags pa'i char dang / grang ①ba dang / rlung dang / tsha ba mi bzad rdo pa'i 'jigs pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /dpag tshad brgya gostong khor 45yug tu mtshams chen po bcing ba (snyebagyis par 'gyur ro/ /ci lta ci ltar yid la bsams 6)pa de lta de ltar thams cad 'grub par 'gyur bas/ don yod rgyal po mchod par bgyi zhing bzlas brjod bgyi gsol bar yang bgyi'o/ /mchod pa dang / gsol ba bgyis pa tsam gyi (7mod la thams cad phun sum tshogs par 'gyur te98)/ de la yid gnyis dang som nyi bskyed dzi༄par mi bgyi'o/ /cho ga zhib mo las ci skad gsungs pa bzhin las bgyid ⑩pa rnams kyis cho ga de bzhin du bsgrub par bgyi'o/ /de nas skad cig de'i mod la thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /byams pa dang / snying rje dang / dga' ba dang / btang snyoms bsgom par bgyi'o/ /sems can thams cad la mchog tu brtse 7bar bgyi'o / /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la mchod par bgyi'o/ /dkon mchog gsum la gus par bgyi'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la gus pa dang / bla mar yid la bsgom 1)par bgyi'o/ /mi gtsang ba spyod pa gtsang bar bgyi zhing yongs su dag pa'i ngang tshul can du bsgom 4)par bgyi'o/ /don yod pa'i zhags pa de kho na nyid kyi cho ga sgrub pa yid bzhin gyi yinor bu byang chub dgug par bgyi'o/ /de nas zhags pa'i 'khor lo'i cho ga sgrub pa bshad par bgyi ste/ rig sngags 'chang de kho na nyid bsgrubs 8pas phug tu 'jug pa'i bsgrub pa thams cad kyi mchog phug tu 'jug pa dang / lha ma yin gyi gnas su 'jug pa dang / mi'am ci'i gnas su 'jug pa dang / dri za'i gnas su 'jug pa dang / lha'i gnas su 'jug pa dang / nam mkha' la rgyu ba dang /92—76

sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i gnas su 'jug pa dang / 'og min gyi gnas kyi bar du 'jug pa dang / klu'i rgyal po'i gnas su 'jug pa dang / thang la rgyu ba dang /nyi ma'i gnas su 'jug pa dang / zla ba'i gnas su 'jug pa dang / skar ma (1)dang rgyu ②skar gyi gnas su 'jug pa dang / nags su 'jug pa dang /① ri la rgyu ba dang / 'bab chu chen por 'jug pa ste54)/ ji lta ji (7ltar yid la bsams ⑥pa de lta de ltar 'jig rten pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i zhags pa'i cho ga rtsibasgrub pa tshegs chung ngu dang / rtsol ba (8)chung ngus 'grub par 'gyur ro6)/ /de la yid gnyis dang / som nyi bskyed yo )par mi bya'o/ /rig tunyesngags 'chang gtsang mar gyur pas sna legs par khrus bgyis te/ gos gtsang ma bgos nas zas dkar gsum 'tshal ba3lha/ gtsang ma de kho na nyid la gus pas sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa bsgom pho )par bgyi'o/ /byams pa'i sems la /lhamanyam par gzhag nas snying rje'i bsam pa tshadag pa'i yid kyis nyu 7tshes bcu gsum nas brtsams te/ zla ba nya'i 18bar du gsal ba shin tu bkra shis pa la dus gsum du ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa 19 rnam pa sna tshogs rdu 7kyis mchod par bgyis la/ rtag tu brgya nu/rtsa brgyad pa yi/ /dus gsum rgyun du bzlas brjod bgyi / /nyin par dus gsum lan gsum ste/ /mtshan mo'i dus su lan gsum bgyi / /'khor lo zhags pa bla med 'di/ /skud pa gsum las bsgrub bgyi ste/ /ras skud pad+ma'i skud pa dang / /arga'i skud pa sum 'gyur ༷ 2du/ /de ni legs par tshad bzhin du/ /khru ni sum cu rtsa drug sa bgyi/ /'khor lo rnam pa nujigasum las bgyi/ /rgyar sogeni sor bzhi'i tshad lags te/ /snying por bcas shing mu khyud bcas / /kun nas rtsibs 25dang ldan pa dag /gser dang dngul dang zangs 92—77

las bgyi/ /chos bstan 6)legs par brgyan (0pa yi/ /bzang po'i stan ②la gzhag par bgyi/ /spos kyi dkyil 'khor me tog gi/ /sil ma bkram nas bum pa dgod/ /de bzhin mchod yon snod kyang bsham④/ /ri mo'i gzugs kyi mdun du chos kyi stan bshams 5)par bgyis pa'i steng du 'khor lo'i zhags pa gzhag par bya 56)ste/ mchod pa bgyis la bsams ⑦pa ci lta ba bzhin du dus gsum du lan brgya tsho༄87rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /de nas tshes bcwa yi)lnga'i zla ba nya ba nyurtal nyin zhag gcig mchis par gyur pas/ tshig gzhan mi smra bar 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi ri mo'i gzugs la mchod pa bgyi zhing / bdug pa rnam pa gsum ponyunya/ a ga 5)ru dang / tsan dan dang / gu gul rnams 'bul sna bar bgyi'o/ /ri mo'i gzugs kyi mdun du ④chos kyi stan mchis pa la mngon du phyogs te mchis nas/ don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po stong rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis te/ yungs kur snyire re la bzlas brjod bgyis pas zhags pa'i steng skyedu gtor bar bgyi'o/ /stong rtsa brgyad tshang nas zhags pa 'bar ba'i 1 'khor lo nam mkha' la mchis nas 'bar zhing lding bar 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags 'chang gi lus kyi stod dang / spyi bo nas 'od zer 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /ri mo'i gzugs las legs so zhes bya ba'i sgra 'byin par 'gyur ro/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis hu don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po'i nyu/'khor lo zhags pa'i cho ga rgya chen po 'di 'grub ( 3par 'tshal bar bgyi'o/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis mchod pa chen po bgyis la/ don yod khro bo'i rgyal po lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyi ste(skye/ de'i 'og tu rig sngags 'chang gis na zhags pa blang bar bgyi'o/ /lag pa g.yon pa 'khor lo'i phyag rgya'i 92—78

tshul du bcing bar bgyi zhing / g.yas pa zhags pa'i phyag rgya dang 'khor lo'i tshul la brten nas blangs te/ don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po brjod nas phyogs bzhir 'phang bar bgyi'o/ /de nas phyogs bcur khro bo'i rgyal po lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /de nas bdag nyid kyi lus la dbang bskur (1)ba'i tshul du lan bdun du bskor ri bar bgyi'o/ /de nas phyag rgya'i tshul du bskor (snyeb tsam gyi mod la 5gerig sngags 'chang 'khor los sgyur 55)ba'i dbang bskur ⑥bar 'gyur ro/ /dam pa chen po 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /'khor los sgyur (7ba'i rgyal po chen po legs mthong rang gi gzugs kyis (3)mdun na mchis nas / rig sngags 'chang gi (9)rkang pa spyi bos blangs nas 'di skad ces kyang smra bar 'gyur te/ rig sngags 'chang gis (1 )ci bka' stsal ba de bgyi'o zhes ci bsgo tsho1ba'i don de dang de thams cad bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /bran ni yonarang bzhin gyis thams cad du las bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gi gnas su 'jug par 'tshal bas/ 'di ltar nub gsum du tsho)mchis par gyur pas / zhags pa'i phyag rgya lag pas blang bar bgyi'o/ /phug ligi sgo gang lags pa der zhags pa lan gsum du bskor skabar bgyi'o/ /don yod pa'i rgyal po bzlas brjod bgyis te/ zhags pa gdab par bgyi'o/ /zhags pa btab pa tsam gyi mod la gnas kyi phug gi sgo thams cad phye bar 'gyur ro/ /'khrul 'khor dang —/ gtan ⑩pa dang / phug dang / 'bab chu chen po dang / gseg 1 ma dang / 'bab chu dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / lam mi bde ba thams cad bsal tu)ba dang / bcom pa dang bshig par 'gyur ro/ /gtan /smyo pa dang / sgo glegs dang / 'khrul 'khor dang / lcags sgrog rnams dum bu 92—79

dum bur bcad 0)cing gyes par 'gyur/ nyams par 'gyur/ 'jig par 'gyur ro/ /shin tu dag pa dang shin tu dri ma med pa(mi/ shin tu rgya che ba'i gzhal med khang 'byor pa rnam par 'phrul pa dag mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /rin po che sna tshogs kyis (5)bkra ba rin po che sna bdun gyis brgyan ④pa'i gnas/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi ljon shing gis brgyan (7pa'i gzhal med khang mthong bar 'gyur ro / /me tog sna tshogs kyi ra ba shin tu dri zhim po'i ⑥gzhal med khang mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis lag pa'i zhags pa dang / 'khor lo'i phyag rgya'i tshul mngon sum du bgyis nas/ don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po bzlas te 'jug par bgyi'o/ /rig sngags 'chang gnas su zhugs pa tsam kho nas gnas mchog de yang rnam pa drug tu 'gul ba dang / g.yo ba dang / ldeg pa dang / 'ur 'ur chem chem ste (7)lha'i 'od zer gyi snang ba chen pos snang bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang 'jug par bgyi'o/ /de nas don yod pa rnam par dag pa dri ma med pa zhes bgyi ba'i sman/ bud med kyi gzugs lha'i rgyan gyis brgyan 87pa/ lha'i gos kyi rgyan gyis bklubs (1)pa kha dog bzang po rgyas pa / mchog dang ldan pa/ lha'i gzugs chen po 'chang ba bī dza pū (3 ra thogs pa mchi bar 'gyur ro/ /sman bud med kyi gzugs 'chang ba de mthong ba tsam kho nas dpag tshad gang tsam nas/ gzi brjid thams cad dang / stobs thams cad nye bar bsgrub par bgyi'o17/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis don yod pa'i 'khor kyi lo'i zhags pa mdun du bcing bar bgyi stenyanye/ mthong ba tsam gyi yimod la de'i stobs dang / brtson 'grus dang / gzi brjid nyams par 'gyur ro/ /mthu chung bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas bud med de rgod (gepa dang / o zhes bgyi 92wa 80

bas gnon 6)par bya'o②/ /khro bo'i rgyal po bzlas par bgyis te①/ kha bub tu skyel ④nas chab 'byung bar 'gyur te chab de la reg (gepar mi bgyi'o/ /don yod rgyal po bzlas par ⑥bgyi ste/ de nas mig tshugs kyis blta bar bgyid na/rig sngags 'chang gis zhags pas bzhu bar bgyi'o/ /de'i 'og tu bdud rtsi'i chab 'byung ste blang bar bgyi 4)byug par bgyi'o/ /kun tu byugs pa tsam gyis nam mkha' la mchi bar 'gyur te/ thog mar rlung gi phung po nas 'dzegs ⑧par 'gyur ro/ /mig la byugs na 97)phyogs bcu thams cad du gtogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing de'i gzhal med khang dang / gnas ⑩rnam par 'phrul pa dang / gang dag bzhugs shing gzhes (glel 'tsho ba dag ci ltar lag mthil na mchis pa de bzhin du mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /gang dag yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa dang / gang dag 'das pa dang /39 gang dag ma byon pa dang / gang dag da ltar byung ba dang / sangs rgyas pa 4)rnams dang / gang dag ring bsrel ④snying po'i mchod rten chen po'i srog shing gi tshogs can dag dang / de bzhin du ci ltar 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa de dag thams cad mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /bdag nyid la kun nas byugs te/ des byugs pa tsam gyis pags 8pa'i mdog lha'i gser dang tso'adra bar 'gyur ro/ /skra sngo la cung zad 'khyil bar 'gyur ro/ /mig lha'i ut+pa la sngon po mchog 'dra bar 'gyur ro/ /tshe lha'i bskal 4 pa brgya stong du 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags 'chang gi 'khor los sgyur lhosheb 'bum phrag brgya stong phrag bcwa 47brgyad kyis yongs su bskor bar 'gyur ro / /lha'i bu mo brgya bzhi bcu dang / mi'am ci'i bu mo dang / rig sngags 92—81

'chang gi bu mo gang gā'i 6)klung gi bye ma brgya stong phrag 'bum snyed kyis yongs su bskor bar 'gyur ro/ /ci ltar yid la bsams ②pa dang / yid la brnag ③pa tsam gyis lha'i zas kyi mchog ro brgya ④dang ldan pa dag mdun medu 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /lha'i btung ba chen po bdud rtsi'i ro bro ba dag 'byung bar 'gyur ro / / byang chub kyi snying tshane po la thug gi bar du ⑦'khor los sgyur ⑧ba'i rgyal po chen po legs mthong ri9)mdun nas rgyug par byed ⑩do/ /dgra thams cad dang /bgegs dang / log 'dren thams cad bcom pa dang / nyams pa dang /gtugs (spepa dang / gshegs phonyepa dang / btsal 8ba dang / gyes pa dang /phye 8mar bgyis par 'gyur ro/ /yang na sman gyi bud med de'i skra kun bton ⑫te / ska mirags su bgyis nas bcing bar bgyi'o/ /gang du bcings pa de yang rin po che sna bdun du 'gyur ro/ /gang du zhugs ⑩pa thams cad mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /de la lha thams cad gnas 'cha' bar tunye'agyur ro/ /klu thams cad dang / lha ma yin /rtathams cad dang / mi'am ci thams cad dang / rig sngags 'chang thams cad de'i dbang du mchi bar ( ) 'gyur ro/ /'khor de thams cad byang chub kyi snying po la thug gi bar du de'i phyi bzhin rjes su 'brang bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gnas su 'jug par 'tshal zhing slar yang ldog par 'tshal na sman gyi bud med de dang gtam mi bgyi/ reg 2 par mi bgyi bar lag pa'i phyag rgyas du 2gnas mchog tu 'jug par bgyi'o/ /de nas gnas thams cad na gnas pa'i bud med dang / skyes pa dang / khye'u dang / bu mo thams cad phyir byung nas mdun na sdod par 'gyur te/ kha cig gi lag na ni bum pa gang ba'o/ /kha cig gi rilag na ni 6 rigadugs so/ /kha cig gi lag na ni 92—82

lha'i gos thogs so/ /kha cig ni lha'i nor bu rin po che thogs pa'o①/ /kha cig ni dri dag go/ /kha cig ni me tog dag go/ /kha cig ni phreng ba dag go/ /kha cig ni rgyan dang lhab lhub sna tshogs thogs so/ /kha cig ni byug pa dag go/ /kha cig ni dri'i phye ma dag go/ /kha cig ni spos chus ②rin po che sna bdun gyi snod bkang srib dag go/ / kha cig ni lha'i 'bras bu sna tshogs pa dag go/ /④kha cig ni lha'i me tog sna tshogs thogs (5)te/ pad+ma dang / ku mu da yidang / pad+ma dkar po ⑦dang / man dā (8)ra ba dang / man dā 6)ra ba chen po dang / mañdzu ṣa 0ka dang / mañdzu ṣa ka 7chen po dang / mdog mdzes dang / mdog mdzes chen po dang / a ti mug ta kā khyenyedang / tsam pa ka dang / bar shi ka dang /mthon ka dang / mthon ka chen po dang / kā yonyedam pa dang / sna khyim dang /yu ti ka dang / klu'i me tog dang / kon ta dang / ghan dha snyib ra shi ma'i me tog dag thogs so/ /kha cig ni lha'i tsan dan go shir+ṣa yidang / sbrul gyi snying po'i bdug pa dang / a ga tu tshon dang / du ru ska tunyedang / ta ma la'i lo ma'i bdug pa thogs pa'o⑩/ /kha cig gi lag pa ( tan ni rma bya'i bsil 0yab thogs so / /kha cig gi lag pa na ni ral gri'o/ /kha cig gi lag pa na ni mdung thung ngo ske/ /kha cig gi lag pa na ni rdo rje dang / dgra sta dang / mda' bo che dang /mdung dang / gtun shing dang / mdung rtse gsum pa dang / gzong 3kha gnyis pa dag go/ /kha cig ni go cha dang / ya lad bgos (snyenas bsrung k+ṣ-i du )ba'i phyir kun nas 'du zhing mchi bar 'gyur ro/ /kha cig ni rin po che sna tshogs pa'i po gesnod dang / gser gyi snod dang / dngul gyi snod dag thogs pa rin po che (9sna tshogs kyi me tog dang / gser gyi me tog dang / dngul gyi me tog c-i snagis 92—83

bkang nas ①thogs te⑤/ de dag thams cad rig sngags 'chang la dbul bar bgyid dozhi)/ /rig sngags 'chang gis ④byams pa dang / snying rje chen po yid la bgyid pa dang / sangs rgyas yid la byed ⑤pas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug don yod pa'i zhags pa'i cha lugs 'chang ba yid la bgyi'o/ /mchog tu brtse ba'i 97yid la bgyid pas tshig gzhan mi smra bar dbugs dbyung bar bgyi zhing lam drang po nas 'jug par bgyi ste/ seng ge'i khri la mngon du ⑦mchis nas / don yod pa'i 'khor lo'i zhags pa thog mar seng ge'i khri'i steng du gzhag (shepar bgyi'o// //'phags pa don yod pa'i (9)zhags pa'i cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po/ bam po bzhi kyi ripa/ de'i 'og tu rig sngags 'chang rang nyid mchis nas(me/ steng du gtogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag bgyi zhing / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mchog sbyin pa 12la yang phyag bgyi'o/ /des dgra thams cad pham nyu par bgyis 7par 'gyur ro/ /gal te 'og tu phyogs nas ⑫phyag bgyis na de nas 'khor los rig sngags 'chang gi phyir rgol tsob rnams mgo gcad 1 par 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags 'chang mchis ma thag tu gnas rnam pa drug tu g.yos nas sgra chen po 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /ca co'i sgra chen po 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /lha'i rol mo'i cha byad yan lag lnga dang ldan pa dag 'bud tunyepar 'gyur ro/ /nam mkha'i lha rnams kyis kyang gzhal med khang chen po nas dbu rgyan dang / cod pan gyis rig sngags 'chang gi mgo bo la dbang bskur ()bar bgyid do/ /dbang bskur ba tsam gyi mod la rin po che sna bdun gyi char 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /gser gyi char dang gos kyi char 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /92—84

gser gyi me tog dang / dngul gyi me tog dang / lha'i me tog bkra ba ①sna tshogs kyi char dang / lha'i rgyan gyi char 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /de nas lha'i bu mos ②rin po che (misna bdun gyi snod du bdud rtsi'i bcud 'tshal te/ mchis nas 'bul ④bar bgyid do(ge/ /rig sngags 'chang gis blangs nas don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po bzlas par stibagyi'o/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis reg par bgyi'o/ /rig sngags 'chang gis (7reg pa tsam gyi ④mod la lha'i lus rnam par dag pa thob nas/ pags yonyepa'i mdog ⑩gser 'dra bar 'gyur ro/ /skra 477lhag par sngo ba dang / mig ut+pal sngon po ltar lha'i mig yongs su dag par 'gyur ro/ /tshe'i tshad lha'i bskal pa 'bum phrag brgya stong du 'gyur ro/ /gal te phyir mi ldog par 'tshal na/ de'i bcud kyis len mchog las ci tsam 'tshal sna 2ba blangs te/ lha'i chab tsan dan gyi dri dang ldan pa'i nang du zhugs nas khrus bgyi'o / /khrus bgyis pa tsam gyi mod la phug gi sgo rang 'bye tsobar 'gyur zhing /ci ltar dbang phyug chen po'i gzugs 'dra bar mthong na ni 'jig rten thams cad kyi mchod gnas kyi gtso bo gcig pur tshe'agyur ro/ /ci ltar 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bzhin du rig sngags 'chang 'di yang mchod pa dang / bkur 7ste dang bla mas bla mar bgyi ba de lta bur 'gyur ro/ /gang du bcud kyis len mchog 'dis reg na 'dzam bu chu bo'i yigaser yongs su dag par 'gyur ro/ /rtsig pa'am/ ri 'am/ ka ba'am/ ljon shing ngam/ snod dam / bum pa'am/ rdza bo'am/ gos sam/ bong ba la reg na de dag thams cad 'dzam bu'i chu bo'i tu tshogaser yongs su dag par 'gyur ba yinas/ dgos pa'i bar du 'gyur ro/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang klu mo'am/ lha mo'am/92—85

mi'am ci mo 'tshal na/ rig sngags 'chang de 0)gos gtsang ②ma bgos nas/legs par khrus bgyi'o/ /tshes brgyad ②dam/ bcu bzhi'am/ bcwa 0lnga la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi ri mo'i gzugs la mchod pa bgyis nas / nyin zhag gcig gnas par bgyi'o/ /'khor lo'i zhags pa chen po 'di chos kyi stan (1)legs par brgyan (phyirapa'i stan ⑦bzang po'i steng du gzhag par bgyi zhing mchod pa chen po bgyi ste/ de nyid kyi mdun ⑧du tshig gzhan mi smra bar/lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas te/ yungs kur khyire re nas bzlas brjod bgyis pa zhags pa'i steng du gtor bar bgyi'o/ /lan stong rtsa brgyad tshang nas 0zhags pa de yang sbrul bzhin du yongs su 'khyil la 'khor lo'i gdengs ku'i tshul du mchis par 'gyur ro/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis zhags pa blangs te⑨/ klu gnas pa'i mtsho 12'am/ mi'am ci gnas pa'i mtsho 6)'am/ lha mo gnas pa'i mtsho 'gram du mchis nas/ don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po bzlas yite/ gnas kyi nang du zhags pa 'phang bar 7bgyi'o/ /'phangs ma thag tu 7slar yang kho nar drang bar 1 stabagyi ste/ ci lta bu'i don yid la bsams pa'i tunyedon de zhags pas bcings nas/ ci ltar bsams tu)pa de bzhin du bgyi bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang ji ( )ltar yid la bsams ( nyepa'i nor ram/ dbyig gam/ gser ram / nor bu'am/ mu tig gam/ be+e ḍūr+ya'am( she/ shang dzu steka shi la'am/ byi ru'am / sa le sbram mam bu/ dngul lam/ gos sam/ chas sam/ rgyan nam/gzhan yang gzhal med khang ji nu lta bur 'byor pa can dag don du gnyer ( nyan zhags pa 'phang bar ༷ bgyi ste/ de thams cad 'dren par bgyid do/ /gang dang gang du 'phangs pa de dang der ji 38ltar yid la bsams ( 7pa de nyid shin tu 92wa 86

gsal bar yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro6)/ /dngos po gzhan du mi 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po'i rigs sam/ bram ze'i rigs sam/ (gyikhyim bdag gi rigs sam/rje'u rigs kyis ci dang geci bsams ④pa 'grub par bgyid do/ /skyes pa'am/ bud med dam⑤/ khye'u'am/ bu mo'i ming nas brjod de zhags pa 'phangs pa tsam gyi mod la zhags pas bcings nas 'dren par 'gyur ro/ /tha na ri dgas dang ske/ bya dang / seng ge dang / stag dang / glang po che dang / ma he yang 'dren par bgyid ⑥rdo/ /gang gi ming nas brjod de g.yul 9)'gyed pa'i nang du 'phangs na/ de yang zhags pas bcings nas mdun du mchis te/ ci ltar yid la bsams (kyepa de bzhin du thams cad 'grub par bgyid do/ /zla ba dang nyi ma dbab par 'tshal na yang ri9/ zla ba dang nyi ma'i mdun du mchis nas/don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po lan bdun bzlas te/ zla ba dang nyi ma'i mngon sum du zhags pa 'phangs nas slar yang drang bar bgyi ste/ zla ba dang nyi ma zhags pas bcings nas drang bar ⑩'gyur ro/ /nam mkha' las babs nas rig sngags 'chang 4tegi mdun du mchis te/ ci ltar yid la bsams tu)pa bzhin dgos pa thams cad sgrub par bgyid do/ /'on te zla ba dang nyi ma'i (3gnas su mchi bar 'tshal natshoste/ zhags pa'i phyag rgya bcings pa lag tugepas blangs te/don yod pa'i rgyal po'i yisnying po bzlas tu 7pa dang / rig sngags 'chang nam mkha' la 'phur na(she/ nyi ma dang zla ba'i stan la ci srid du 'tshal tu)bar longs spyod par 'gyur zhing / slar bde ba dang / ma snad pa dang / ma rmas ( ) pa dang / legs par 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /nags khung du 'gro bar (1'tshal na/gtsang ma legs par khrus bgyis pas/ gos gtsang ma bgo ( —rtebar bgyi zhing 92—87

nags khung 6)gi sgor lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod bgyi stezhu/ zhags pa 'phang bar bgyi'o/ /lag pas zhags pa 'phangs pa tsam gyis nags khung gi gnas kyi gzhal med khang gi klu thams cad bcings nas thams cad rig sngags 'chang gi mdun du (na)mchis par 'gyur zhing rig sngags 'chang la phyag bgyis nas/rig sngags 'chang khyod gnas chen po mchog tu zhugs shig ces smra bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis 54)don yod pa'i rgyal po'i snying po bzlas te/ lag pa zhags pa'i phyag rgyas nags khung du 'jug par bgyi'o/ /zhugs pa tsam kho nas nags kyi gnas rnam pa drug tu g.yo bar (snye'agyur zhing / dbus kyi nags kyi mtha' na rin po che sna bdun gyi rdzing lha'i chab dngas shing ༅rtog pa ma mchis pa shin tu gsal ba lha'i tsan dan gyi dri dang ldan pa ha cang mi grang ba ha cang mi dro ba reg na bde ba ro dang ldan pa/ bdud rtsi'i bcud can mchis te/ de ⑦ltar don yod pa'i rgyal po'i snying po yungs kur (8kyil lan nyi shu rtsa gcig ponyebazlas brjod bgyis nas rdzing gi dbus su zhags pa 'phang bar ⑩bgyi'o/ /'phangs pa tsam gyi 3lhamod la bud med rin po che'i 32gzugs 'dra ba tunyelha'i bu mo'i lus phyed byung nas/ lha'i me tog rnam pa sna tshogs kyis r+sha)brgyan 8cing / rin po che sna bdun gyi bum pa gang ba thogs te/ rig sngags 'chang la dbul zhing spyi bo smad de 'dzum pa dang bcas pas rig sngags 'chang la smras pa/ rje btsun rig sngags 'chang khyod ma bzhengs 7par gnas su zhugs shigazhi rme /rig sngags 'chang gis grub pa'i tshig gsum brjod par bgyi ste38/ 'jig rten pha rol gyi don dang /rig sngags 'chang nyid dang / 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub grub ste9/6/ bdag nyid kyi ma dang / sring mo dang / mngag gzhug ma zhes gar bde bar brjod la 92—88

de'i 'og tu rig sngags 'chang gis smra bar bgyi ste/ sring mo kho bo la 'jig rten pha rol gyi don byin cig ces 'jug par bgyi'o/ /de yang rig sngags 'chang khyod rang gi gnas su snoms te zhugs shig ces smra bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis lag pa zhags pa'i phyag rgyas 'jug par bgyi zhing / don yod pa'i ①rgyal po'i snying po bzlas so/ /de nas gnas chen po mchog rin po che sna bdun gyi gzhal med khang lha'i dril bu g.yer kha'i ②dra ba dang / gser dang /gos dpyangs (7pa dar gyi chun 'phyang rab tu dpyangs ④par gda' ba nas bu mo de yang nor bu rin po che chen po thogs te/ rig sngags 'chang 'jig rten pha rol gyi don du rin po che chen po bzhes shig ces 'bul 45)bar bgyid do/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis stan 56)bshams pa'i steng du zhags pa legs par yongs su bskyil 6)te/ stan du bting (8)la nor bu rin po che chen po de zhags pa'i steng du gzhag cing me tog dang bdug pa dbul bar bgyi'o/ /don yod 9rirgyal po'i snying u )po bzlas par /stobagyi'o/ /bzlas pa tsam gyi mod la zhags pa nor bu rin po che dang bcas te 'bar bar 'gyur ro/ /nor bu rin po che chen po de las kyang tso'o ma'i chab 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags 'chang gis 'o ma'i chab de las kyi blangs la skyor chu lan bdun 6du reg par bgyi'o/ /'o ma'i chab kyis reg nyusnyepa tsam gyi mod la lus thams cad dri ma dang bral zhing yongs su dag par 'gyur ro/ /don yod snang ba nor bu gzhal med kyi tsodakyil 'khor gyi 'od zer gyi dra ba hu sna'od zer zhes bgyi ba thob nas sa bcu la gnas te phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi lam 'thob nyunyepar 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi ting nge 'dzin sgyu ma lta bur 37rnam 92—89

par 'phrul pa thob par 'gyur zhing 6)/ shin tu yongs su dag pa'i bdag nyid kyi rang bzhin gyis don yod pa'i zhags pa'i cha lugs 'chang ba rig sngags 'chang gi mdun du mchis nas/ lag pa g.yas pa spyi bor bzhag ste nga'i ②rig sngags 'chang gi bu thu bo khyod kyis grol ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor sangs rgyas kyi sku yongs su dag pa 'thob bo/ /zhes dbugs 'byin par 'gyur ro/ /phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams mthong nas thams cad kyis legs so zhes bya ba'i sgra 'byin par 'gyur te/ sems dpa' chen po legs so legs②/ /khyod ni byang chub lam du zhugs/ /khyod kyis sangs rgyas nyid 'thob ste④/ /grol ⑤ba'i lam zhes bya ba (rmebasgrubs/ /'on te rig sngags 'chang nyid don du gnyer na de'i tshe gser gyi me tog stsol bar 'gyur te/ blangs la bu mo de nyid kyi spyi bor bzhag nas/ oṃ zhes bgyi bas mnan ⑦par bgyi'o/ /oṃ zhes bgyi ba'i sgra brjod nas spyi bor bzhag pa tsam gyi mod la bu mo de'i mig mchog gnyis nas mchi ma 'dzag dun)par 'gyur ro/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis blangs te nye reg bgyi'o5) / /nye reg bgyis 7pa tsam gyi mod la rig sngags 'chang gi 'khor los sgyur /skyebar 'gyur ro/ /skra nyurtecung zad 'khyil zhing (nyalag pa na 'khor lo'i zhags pa thogs te nam mkha' la mchi bar 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags 'chang bye ba 'bum phrag bcwa bibargyad kyis yongs su bskor 8bar 'gyur ro/ /tshe lo drug khri nyis stong du 'gyur zhing skye ba bdun stong rjes su dran par 'gyur ro/ /'on te gsang sngags 'chang 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub kyi cho ga slong na de'i tshe 7'di lta bur 'gyur te/ rig sngags 'chang gis bdag gi skra 'di sdoms shig ces de'i tshe bud med des skra'i ral pa bton nas/ rig sngags 'chang la 'bul ⑩ba na/ skra 92—90

thams cad blangs te dum bu gsum du bkug ①nas srad bu la mdud pa ②nyi shu rtsa gcig bgyi ste/ gcig skyibakal te/ mgo la btags pas ni ji (0ltar yid la bsams (gepa de bzhin du mig 'phrul ston par 'gyurayi/ 'bras bu dang me tog 'tshal ba tso)thams cad ston par 'gyur⑤/ bden pa ji 6)ltar 'tshal ba 7bzhin ston par 'gyur ro/ /mgul tsho/skyedu btags pas ni mi gda' bar yonyagyur nas / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / 'byung po dang / sha za dang /grul bum dang / lto 'phye tu chen po dang / mi ma yin pa rnams yidabang du gyur nas mchis par 'gyur ro/ /dpral ba la btags pas ni lha dang klu thams cad dbang du gyur nas mchis par 'gyur ro/ /dpung pa g.yas pa la btags pas ni glang po che bcu'i stobs dang ldan par 'gyur te/ phas kyi dgra bo dang mi mdza' ba dang / gdug nyunyapa thams cad kyis mi tshugs pas stobs kyis skye'akhor los sgyur ()bar 'gyur ro/ /dpung pa g.yon pa la btags pas ni rigs bzhi'i 'jig rten dbang du gyur nas mchis par 'gyur ro/ /lag pa g.yon pa la btags pas ni gang la reg pa de dbang du 'gyur zhing / bdag gi nor du 'gyur ro/ /lag pa g.yas pa la btags pas ni grong khyer gyi shar phyogs kyi sgo nas rgyal po'i sgo la thal mo lan gsum brdabs na rgyal po'i btsun mo 'khor dang bcas pa dang / grong khyer dang / yul 'khor dang / rgyal po'i pho brang dang /bud med dang / skyes pa dang / khye'u dang / bu mo dang bcas pa bdag nyid dam / nor dbang du gyur nas mchis par 'gyur ro/ /tha na dud 'gro'i skye gnas su gtogs par tunyebya tshonadang / gcan gzan rdu )dang / ri dgas dang /gdug ( nyepa dang / gzhan yang gdug nu)pa dang bcas pa'i srog chags rnams 92—91

dbang du gyur nas mchis par 'gyur ro/ /brla g.yas pa la btags pas ni tshal lam/ ser ga'am4)/ ri 'or ram/mi/ phug gam/ dgon pa'am/bsti laganas gang du zhugs te/ zhugs pa tsam gyi med la nor thams cad dang /sman thams cad dang / lha thams cad rang gi gzugs su mdun du dumachis par 'gyur ro/ /byin pa g.yas pa dang / rkang pa g.yas pa la btags pas ni/rgya mtsho chen po'i pha mthar yang rgal bar 'gyur na chu klung chen po'i chab kyis byin pa nub (2tsam du 'gyur ba (6)lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ byin pa g.yon pa la btags pas ni/ nyi ma re re bzhin 9)dpag tshad brgyar phyin nas/ dub pa ma mchis par slar yang ldog par 'gyur ro/ /brla g.yon pa la btags nas dur khrod chen por zhugs na dur khrod thams cad na gnas pa'i gcer bu pa lathams cad dbang du gyur nas mchis par 'gyur ro/ / de nas tho)rig sngags 'chang gnas 7de nyid na spyod na rig sngags 'chang des lag pa g.yon pas bum pa gang ba bzung 17zhing / lag pa g.yas pas bud med de bzung hurtenas/ gnas chen po'i mchog tu 'jug par bgyi'o/ /gnas mchog de'i dbus na lhonyerdzing me tog gi tshitshal par bkram par skabagyi ste/ rdzing der gnyis ka khrus bgyi zhing chab kyis nye reg skyabagyi'o/ /bkrus shing reg kyi snapa tsam kho nas/ 'khor lo'i tunyerig sngags 'chang zhags pa dang / 'khor los sgyur tu)ba'i rig sngags 'chang du 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags 'chang 'bum phrag bdun stong gis yongs su bskor )cing tshe bskal pa khrir 'gyur ro/ /skra cung zad 'khyil par yang 'gyur ro/ /nags kyi gnas kyi gzhal med khang bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi dpon po rgyal por 'gyur ro/ /gal te ma zhes bgyi bas don du gnyer na 27ni bu gcig pa bzhin 3rtayongs su skyong bar 92—92

'gyur ro/ /'bras dang / 'bru dang / gos dang / chas 6)dang / nor bu dang / mu tig dang / byi ru dang / gser dang / dngul yongs su 'grub (snyepar bgyid do/ /sring mo zhes bgyi bas ni dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad tshang bar nistobs par 'gyur zhing yan lag spong bar bgyid do/ /nyi ma re re zhing rgyan thams cad kyis bklubs ④pa'i lha'i bu mo khrid nas mchi bar (nya'agyur/lha'i gzhal med khang 'byor pa stobs par bgyid/ lha'i khyim dang / gzhal med khang stobs (9par bgyid do/ / mngag gzhug (7)ma zhes bgyi ba (sheni/ gang dang gang du mngag po)pa de dang der mchi bar 'gyur te/ lha'i gnas sam/ klu'i gnas sam/ gnod sbyin gyi gnas sam/ srin po'i gnas sam/ 'byung po'i gnas sam/ gzhan yang mngag gzhug yo )pa'i sgrub pa rnam pa sna tshogs yid la 67bsams 8pa bzhin (stebagyid do/ /nags sgrub pa'i cho ga'o// //de nas rig sngags 'chang thang la rgyu bar 'tshal na4༄/ gtsang ma khrus bgyis pas gos gtsang ma bgo bar bgyi/ gnas dben pa gtsang ma'i sa phyogs su dkyil 'khor gru bzhir bris skul/ dri sna tshogs kyis byug /ro sna tshogs dang ldan pa'i gtor ma bshams la/ a ga 9ru'i bdug pa bsregs te nyunanub gsum du mchis nas 'khor lo zhags pa'i lag pa'i phyag rgyas don yod rgyal po'i snying po'i tunyebazlas brjod stong rtsa brgyad bgyis te/ lan stong rtsa brgyad tshang ba dang /dkyil 'khor gyi dbus nas du ba 'byung bar 'gyur te/rto/ khro bo'i rgyal po lan bdun bzlas par (2 bgyi'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus nas skyes pa nag po chen po'i tshul mi sdug pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ skra gyen du bsgreng zhunyeb/ mgo 92—93

'bar ba/ mig dmar ba6)/ mchu ②dang lce dmar ba/ sen mo dmar ba/skra sngo ba/ dpung pa mkhrang zhing 57brtan pa/ gsus pa 'phyangs po ④mchod phyir thogs pa dang ldan pa/ mgo lnga pa sbrul ltar lce bsgyur ⑤ba/ stag gi sham ⑥thabs bgos pa/ lag pa 9)na dgra sta dang / dril bu thogs pa zhig lus phyed ⑧tsam phyung 6)nas phyogs bcur lta ⑩bar byed (7do/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis skrag par mi bla bgyi ste/ brtan 8par bgyis yil/ khro bo'i rgyal po bzlas nas / 'khor lo'i zhags pa 8'phangs te mgo bcad la khrag mang du byung ba dang / rig sngags 'chang gis khrag des lus thams cad byug ⑩par bgyi'o/ /byugs tsho/ 7pa tsam gyi mod la bdag nyid kyi yonyelus mi chod pa dang / mi shigs pas rdo rjer tu)byin gyis brlabs par 'gyur ro/ /mig gnyis phyung sum̐ )la rang gi mig phyis nas mig la bskus na (1lha'i mig tu 'gyur ro/ /rkang brus (nyete byugs na tshe bskal 32pa bcur 'gyur zhing thos pa bsags pa'i rgya mtshor 'gyur ④/ bskal pa brgya stong gi skye ba'i skye ba dang / tshe rabs dran par 'gyur ro/ /snying phyung ste ⑤'tshal na nam mkha' la mchi'o/ /khrag gis snying gar ( 'uthig le bgyis na mi gda' bar 'gyur ro/ /lce bcad na ral grir gyur nas dgra thams cad brlag zho napar bgyid do/ /gal te thang la rgyu bar 'tshal tsushen/ de'i tshe khro bo'i ( )rgyal po lan brgya nu )rtsa brgyad zhags pa dang 'khor lo la (tebazlas brjod bgyi'o/ /'khor lo zhi zhags pa du rtagasang ba'i phyag rgya'i tshul gyis thal mo sa la brdab (snyepar bgyi ste/lan gsum du thal mo brdabs pa dang / de'i 'og tu thang gi sgo dbye spegebar 'gyur ro/ /ci ltar rang gi khyim bzhin du 'jug par bgyi ste sgye/ zhugs nas slar yang mchi zhing dgos pa gzhan thams cad bgyid pa dang thang thams cad la 92wa 94

gnas pa thams cad dbang du gyur nas gnas par 'gyur ro/ /'on te nam mkha' la mchi bar 'tshal 6)na gyen du bltas nas/ don yod pa'i (gyirgyal po'i snying po yungs mar tshul lan ④stong rtsa brgyad bzlas te/ lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas phyinas/ bdag nyid la byugs te/ lag pa'i zhags pa'i phyag rgyas nam mkha' la mchi bar 'gyur zhing nam mkha'i go ⑥'byed par 'gyur ro/ /lha'i gnas su mchi bar 'tshal thon/ lha'i khyim du mchis nas zhags pas lha'i mgul (8)nas bcing bar lho)bgyi zhing don yod rgyal po'i 7snying po lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas nas / lha bcings pa gang yin hunyapa de'i ming nas brjod na lha de babs nas rig sngags 'chang gi mdun na mchis par 'gyur ro/ /tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug chen po rig sngags 'chang la tu rig sngags 'chang ci zhig don du gnyer ba de snoms shig ces smra bar 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags 'chang gis lha'i gnas su 'gro'o zhes brjod par bgyi'o/ /gal te gzhan bsams dzinapa zhig mchis na mchog thams cad 455 bar bgyid do/ /de nas lha'i gnas nas mchi ba yin/ lha'i gnas lha'i rdzu 'phrul gyis lag pa na 8thogs te⑩/ nam mkha' la mchi 4)bar 'gyur ro/ /ci srid 'tshal bar lha'i gzhal med khang chen por longs spyod par 'gyur zhing / 'on te mi 'tshal na lha'i gnas nas slar yang 'bab 8par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan ci ltar rang gi blo gros dang / yid la bsams /tsho nyepa'i dgos pa thams cad bgyid par 'gyur zhing thams cad du zhu )grub par 'gyur te/ de la som nyi dang yid gnyis bskyed zhu1par mi bgyi'o/ /'khor lo'i duzhags pa sgrub zhu)pa'i cho ga'o// //92—95

de nas rig sngags 'chang pad+ma'i zhags pa sgrub par 'tshal bas rig sngags 'chang de gtsang ma legs par bkrus (1)te gos gtsang ma bgo bar bgyi'o/ /nub gsum mchis sam/ nub lnga mchis sam/ nub gcig mchis nas rig sngags 'chang gis zhags pa'i skud pa bsgrub ②par bgyi ste/ ras kyi skud pa'am pad+ma'i skud pa be+e ḍūr+ya'i (kyekha dog lta bur tshon gyis kha bsgyur (gebar bgyi zhing khru nyi shu rtsa gcig bkal te/ de la yang pad+ma bgyis te/ rin po che sna bdun gyi 'dab 95)ma kha phye ba 56༄sor bzhi pa'i tshad kyis pad+ma gser gyi 'dab ⑦ma dang /dngul gyi 'dab du rim dang / bai ḍūr+ya 'byedang / yin 7dra nī la dang (skye/ rin po che ka 1 ti ka las bgyi zhing mu tig gis bskor ba bgyi ste/ de nas zhags pa la btags nyugepar bgyi'o/ /zhags pa'i thor to gcig la ni pad+ma'i phyag rgya gdags par bgyi'o/ /de nas legs par brgyan 'o sapa'i chos kyi stan 7bzang po bsham ⑩par bgyi'o/ /ba'i lci bas dkyil 'khor bgyis la dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dri'i pad+ma bsams 1 7par bgyi zhing / dkyil 'khor gyi steng du chos kyi stan (snyebashams la / bum pa gang bas brgyan 67par bgyi'o/ /me tog gi sil ma bkram zhing a ga 3 )ru dang / tsan dan dang / du ru ska'i bdug tsho skyupa dbul bar bgyi'o/ /mchod yon dang zhabs bsil 3)gyi snod kyang gzhag par bgyi'o/ /pad+ma'i zhags pa de yang chos kyi stan gyi steng du gzhag par bgyi'o/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi mdun du rig sngags 'chang gis skyil mo krung py-i rtebacas nas/don yod pa'i 24zhags pa'i snying po lan khri bzlas te/ bzlas pa'i yungs kur zhugere re nas de'i steng du gtor sa bar bgyi'o/ /lan khri rdzogs nas de nas tshes bcwa lnga'i zla ba nya ba'i na/nub mo mchis nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang 92—96

phyug la mchod pa 6)bgyi'o/ /zhags pa de la ②yang mchod par bgyi'o/ /don yod pa'i zhags pa'i phyag rgya bcings nas don yod pa'i rgyal po'i snying po lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzla'og/ /de nas khro bo'i rgyal po lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te/nyin mtshan gsum ④dus gsum du bzlas brjod dang mchod pa bgyi'o/ /de nas pad+ma'i zhags pa 'bar zhing kha dog sna tshogs kyi 'od zer 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /legs so legs so zhes bgyi ba'i tshig 'byin par 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi lus la kha dog sna tshogs kyi 'od zer 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas rig ⑤sngags 'chang phyag rgya'i skyil mo krung (6)gis mchis nas mig mi 'dzums shing (pebazhin 'dzum pas (8)snying rje chen po yid la bsgom yo༄par bgyi'o / /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gdong du blta stetu )/don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po lan sum stong bzlas par tu)bgyi'o/ /de'i 'og tu 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bdag nyid kyi lha'i rang bzhin mdun du mchis nas/ lag pa g.yas pa brkyang ste 42rig sngags 'chang gi spyi bor bzhag nas legs so zhes bgyi ba stsol bar 'gyur zhing / 'di skad ces kyang dbugs tshoge'abyin par 'gyur royi/ /rig sngags 'chang nga'i bu snying las skyes pa'i thu bo/bzlas brjod kyi cho ga chen po dang / mchod pa'i cho ga chen po 8'dis nga la mchod pa'i mchog byas pa dang / bzlas brjod kyi mchog dang grub pa'i mchog steskye / khyod kyis don yod rgyal po'i snying po grub cing / khyod kyis pad+ma'i zhags pa chen po grub kyis3zhe/ ci ltar yid la bsams nyu pa bzhin du 3/mchog khyer cig /khyod kyis shu )yid kyi brnag 37pa thams cad ni yongs su rdzogs par byas snye/khyod 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa rgyu ba las ni grol/ khyod skye ba dang / rga ba dang /92—97

na ba dang / 'chi ba'i mya ngan mi bzad ①pa'i 'jigs pa las thar na/ khyod dmyal ba chen po mi bzad ②pa bcu drug las ni yongs su grol/ 'jigs pa chen po mi bzad (kyepa'i sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba brgyad las ni yongs su thar/'di nas phyi ma'i skye ba'i mngal du gnas nas sdug bsngal mi bzad ④pa las shi 'phos te/ rig sngags 'chang khyod byang chub kyi snying po la thug gi bar du 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du pad+ma las rdzus ⑤te skye bar 'gyur ro/ /khyod kyi ⑥gang gā'i 3)klung 'bum phrag stong brgyad cu rtsa bzhi nisnyed kyi bye ma dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs (9ripa rnams la dge ba'i rtsa ba cher bskyed pa'i bsod nams kyi tshogs chen po dang ni ldan/ rig sngags 'chang khyod kyis lhag par bya ba mang po ni byas/ khyod rig sngags 'chang chen por ni lung bstan/ dmyal ba dang / ngan song gi 1 las kyi sgrib pa mi bzad tu)pa thams cad las ni grol gyis()/ ci ltar yid la bsams tu pa bzhin mchog khyer cig /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis ci ltar tsheyid la bsams 'apa bzhin de'i tshe mchog thob par 'gyur ro/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis pad+ma'i zhags pa de blangs te gnas gtsang mar gus pas mchod pa rgya cher bgyi'o/ /nam dgos pa de'i tshe 8zhags pa blang bar bgyi'o9 / /las thams cad bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /pad+ma ni 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 32gi lag pa g.yon 37par bzhag la/ lag pa g.yas pas zhags pa bzung sa riste/ don yod pa'i ( 1rgyal po'i snying po lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas/ sems can nam lha gang gi ming nas brjod de/ bzlas brjod brgya rtsa brgyad tshang ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' mdun na 'amachis nas dhi/'dod pa'i mchog thams cad stsol bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang 92—98

byang chub tu lung bstan ①pa don du gnyer bar 'tshal na/ rig sngags 'chang gtsang mas legs par khrus bgyis te/ gos gtsang ma bgos pas nyin zhag gcig ②mchis par ①gyur pas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la mchod pa rgya chen po bgyis nas/ pad+ma'i zhags pa de yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi phyag tu dbul bar bgyi'o/ /zhags pa'i thor to ya gcig ④gis ni rang gi mgul du btags la don yod rgyal po'i snying po lan stong rtsa brgyad tshang bar bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /stong rtsa brgyad tshang ba dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sku gser gyi mdog can rig sngags 'chang gi mdun du bzhugs phyinas zhirarig sngags 'chang gi spyi bor phyag (7༄bzhag ste dbugs 'byin par (kyemadzad 6)lung ston par mdzad yid kyi brnag pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par mdzad par 'gyur ro/ /sgrib pa dang sdig pa tshe rabs stong du bsags pa thams cad gtugs par 'gyur/ lhag ma ma lus par ⑩gtugs par gyur nas/ lus yongs su dag par 'gyur ro/ /dri ma dang bral zhing phrag dog dang / ser sna spangs par 'gyur ro/ /'di lha rinas ma 'ongs pa'i skye ba'i mngal du gnas yinas/lha dang mi'i dpal nyams su myong bar bgyis nas/ sems can thams cad kyi bla ma gcig pur tso'agyur ro/ /mchod par 'os pa dang / bla ma'i gnas su'ang ④'gyur ro/ /nad rnams dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /skye bo thams cad dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /'gum pa'i dus su phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dgongs par 'gyur7/snye/ dbugs 'byin par mdzad/ legs pa'i lam ston par yang tsomadzad par / tsho'agyur ro/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mdun na mchis nas dbugs 'byin par bgyid cing lag pa g.yas pa 92—99

spyi bor 'jog par bgyid do/ /de bde 6)bas shin tu dran pa nye bar bzhag nas lus 'dor bar 'gyur ro/ /bor ba tsam gyi mod la skal ba mnyam par ⑧bde ba can gyi (/gu'ajig rten gyi khams su skye bar 'gyur te④/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan nas(5)/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa'i lus pad+ma las rdzus 0te skye bar 'gyur ro/ /tshe rabs dran par 'gyur te/ bskal pa brgya ⑦stong gi skye ba'i tshe rabs dran par 'gyur ro/ /don yod pa'i ⑨zhags pa'i snying po rnam par grol ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyag rgya rim par dbye 6)ba'i cho ga zhib mo 'di mtha' dag rdzogs par g.yar thon yo )du bgyis nas tunyes bcu la gnas shing phyin ci log tu ma gyur pas phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam par 'phrul pa chen po dang / cho 'phrul chen pos nyu)lha'i khang pa brtsegs pa dang / gzhal med khang dang / gnas mchog dang / phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad nas / sangs rgyas kyi zhing du byang chub kyi skye snying po la thug gi bar du mchi bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams mthong ba'i chos kho na la blta 14bar 'tshal na/ rig sngags 'chang gis gnas gtsang ma'i phyogs sam/ gnas sam/ khang 7pa'am/ dgon pa'i gnas sam/'khor gyi khyams sam/ 'chag masa'am/ khang pa brtsegs pa'amayo sna/ spyil po gtsang ma phyi brdar kyi legs par bgyis pa'i sa 17phyogs su dkyil 'khor gru bzhi 'byes pa khru gang ba'amani sta/ khru do pa'i dkyil 'khor bgyi ste/ gru bzhi lham pa/grwa kun nas cha mdzes 27pa/ sa dang sbyar ba'i lci bas zhu shin du legs par phyi brdar lhabagyis la/ rtswa sngon po gnyen zhu po lta bu zhunyal mkhas pas dkyil 'khor mtha' dag gi cha dbye ba'i thig gdab par 65bgyi'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi dbus kyi ( 792wa 100

snying po la pad+ma rgya chen po 'byes 6)pa 'dab ma brgya pa/ tshon ⑤sna brgyad kyi tshon zhi)rtsis bkra bar bgyi zhing mdzes ④par bgyis la/ snying po ni rin po che ka ⑤ti ka las bgyi'o/ /pad+ma'i mtha' nor bu rin po che sna tshogs kyis (7bskor la/ grwa tso)bzhi nas kha khyer sor bzhi pa'i tshad du bgyi'o/ /pad+ma'i bar gyi zur zur du ut+pa la sngon po legs par bris la/ kha khyer (8)gyi phyi rol du tshinor bus 'khor ba'i mtha' de ⑩mtshos bskor bar bgyi'o/ /lha'i chab rin po che sna tshogs kyi gzhal med khang gis (lhamadzes par bgyis la/ chab la me tog sna tunyetshogs kyi sil ma bkod pa bya rnam pa tu sna tshogs gnas 'cha' ba ngang pa dang / bzhad dang /khrung khrung dang / ngur nyu )pa dang / shang shang te'u dang / ka la ping ka dang /bya'i tshogs kyis mdzes par bgyis la/ nya dang chu srin dang / chu srin byis pa gsod tsokun nas rten 'cha' bar bgyid do/ /mtsho'i 'gram na rin po che'i ljon shing dang / me tog gi ljon shing dang / 'bras bu'i ljon shing dang 8/ sna tshogs pa ⑩kha khyer dang bcas par bgyi'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi kha khyer gyi phyi rol na (snyelag pa dang thal mo'i phyag rgya bris la sgo bzhi rnams su rgyal po chen po bzhi bgyi'o / /de nas dbus kyi dkyil 'khor la 37pad+ma'i gdan bzang po bshams te rdu de'i steng du(1/ bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med dang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang mthu chen thob gzhag par bgyi'o/ /dkyil 'khor bum pa gang bas brgyan 'o par bgyi'o/ /me tog sil ma dang / dri dang byug pa yang dbul bar bgyi'o/ /ba dan bzang po sna tshogs kyis brgyan nu par bgyi'o/ /gtor ma dkar po dbul bar bgyi'o( bye/ /yon chab dang zhabs bsil gyi zhugesnod dang / mar me'i phreng ba dbul bar bgyi'o/ /pad+ma'i zhags pa 'od dpag 92—101

med kyi phyag tu dbul bar bgyi'o/ /rig sngags 'chang gtsang mas gos gtsang ma bgo bar bgyi'o/ /legs par khrus bgyis nas ba'i rnam lngas nye reg bgyis la zla ba nya la nyin zhag gcig ①mchis par gyur pas kha shar phyogs su bltas la ②skyil ①mo krung ④bcas te mchis nas/ lag pas zhags pa'i phyag rgya bcings te bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /byams pa dang brtse ⑤ba'i sems kyis lhag par brtson par bgyi'o/ /snying rjes (nyamachog tu brtse bar gyur pas sems can thams cad la brtse bar bgyid stin/ don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po bzlas brjod bgyis te2 / ci tsam na thun tha ma la/ 'od dpag med 'bar bar gyur nas/dkyil 'khor chen po de la ponyeyang 'od zer 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags 'chang g.yo bar gyur nas lus 'bar bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas rig ⑩sngags 'chang gis skya rengs 7shar tsam na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'phags pa 'od dpag med gser spungs 8pa lta bu de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gser gyi kha dog gis rig sngags 'a/'chang gi mdun du bzhugs yinas/ phyag g.yas pa rig sngags 'chang gi spyi bor bzhag nasatso/dbugs 'byin par mdzad cing yid kyi 7brnag pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par mdzad nas mi gda' bar gyur pa dang / shin tu rnam par dag pa dri ma med pa'i snang ba zhes bgyi nyurteba'i gnyid thob nas/ ci ltar nyal ba tunyetsam mam yimig btsum 8 ripa tsam 317gyis 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can gzhal med khang dang /gnas dang / 'jig rten dang / yul ljongs dang / byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor mtha' dag dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par mthong bar 'gyur lags so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de chos (2ston par mdzad pa yang mthong 92—102

bar 'gyur lags so/ /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor de dag thams cad dbugs 'byin par bgyid pa dang / gzhal med khang dang /① rnam par 'phrul pa dang te/ rdzu 'phrul dang / cho 'phrul thams cad mthong bar 'gyur lags so/ /'di nas ma 'ongs pa'i skye ba nas shi 'phos te(mi/ 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skal ba mnyam ②par skye bar 'gyur ro/ /skye ba'i skye ba dran par 'gyur te skye ba bdun stong rjes su dran par 'gyur ro/ /de sad nas zhags pa la lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis nas/ lag pa g.yas pas gzung nasasti/ nam mkha' la 'phur bar 'gyur ro/ /lo khrir 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /zhags pa grub pa rnams dang / rig sngags 'chang thams cad kyi 'khor los sgyur 6)bar 'gyur ro/ /'khor khri brgya (6)stong dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /pad+ma'i zhags pa sgrub pa'i cho ga'o// //de nas rig sngags 'chang rdo rje'i zhags pa bsgrub par 'tshal na/ shing shun dang / ras skud dang / kha che dar gyi skud pa mnyam ⑦du lhan cig bkal te/khru nyi shu rtsa gcig gi tshad tsam du bgyis la/ tsan dan dkar po ⑧las rdo rje sor bzhi pa'i tshad du bgyis te/ rtse lnga pa 'byung po la sogs pa'i mgo dang / sbrul gyi ska rags kyis dzi)bcings la/ klu'i birgyal po dga' bo dang nye dga' bo'i dra ba'i phreng bas (medakri ba tu bgyis nas zhags pa la gdags par bgyi'o/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gtsang mas gos gtsang ma bgo bar bya'otunye/ /legs par khrus bgyi'o / /ba'i rnam (stelngas nye reg bgyi'o/ /rtswa'i 8stan bting tsonas ri mo'i gzugs kyi mdun du lag pa g.yas pas 8zhags pa mnan tsho/nyenas/ don yod 92—103

pa'i zhags pa'i 6)snying po khri bzlas so/ /khro bo'i rgyal po'i snying po stong bzlas so//de nas zhags pa de 'bar bar 'gyur te/ de bzung nas nam mkha' la 'phur ②bar 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje'i rigs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs dang /nor bu'i rigs dang / pad+ma'i rigs gang dag lags pa de dag thams cad mdun na bzhugs 90par 'gyur ro/ /lag ( )na rdo rje dang 'dra bar gzugs dang /mthu dang / brtson 'grus pha rol gyi zil gyis ⑤mi non par 'gyur ro/ /lag na 6)rdo rje dang 'dra bar rig sngags 'chang gi dbang por 'gyur ro/ /lha'i 7lo khri nyis stong du rin)'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /las thams cad bgyid pa hukyerdo rje'i zhags pa dgra thams cad 'joms par bgyid pa'i zhags pa steng ngam 'og gar 'phangs par yid la bsams (1 )pa bzhin thams cad bcings nas dgug tunyepar bgyid do/ /phyogs bcur 'phang ste nyanakhro bo'i rgyal po bzlas nas skyes pa dang ⑫/bud med dam/ gzhan gang nya tshoci yang rung ba thams cad zhags pas bcings nas / myur du dgug 8par bgyid deyi/ som nyi mi bgyi'o/ /gal te lha'am/klu'am / gnod sbyin nam/ srin po'am/ dri za'am/ lha ma yin nam/ nam mkha' lding ngam/ mi'am ci'am/ 'byung po'am/ lto 'phye tu 〉chen po thams cad zhags pas bcings nas myur du dgug tsho/)par bgyi ste rtse1som nyi mi bgyi'o/ /zhags pa la khro bo'i rgyal po lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod bgyi ste( )/ mar gyi ngo'i 21tshes bcu bzhi'i mtshan mo nam phyed na zhags pa phyogs bzhir 'phang bar ( rtabagyi'o / /'phangs pa tsam gyi mod la bgegs dang / log 'dren khri)dang /gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / gdug pa thams cad zhags pas bcings nas / rig sngags 'chang gi mdun na mchis shing ci srid 'tsho'i 40bar du dbang 92wa 104

du gyur nas mchis te/ bran bzhin du las thams cad bgyid par 'gyur/bltas pa tsam gyis gdon thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /zhags pa la khro bo'i rgyal po lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis te/ lag pas zhags pa blangs te dur 6)khrod du zhugs na mi snang bar 'gyur zhing gnas thams cad kyi sgo dbye ②bar 'gyur ro/ /phug gi sgor mchis nas rdo rje'i zhags pas brdabs na/phug thams cad kyi sgo dbye bar (mi'agyur zhing 'khrul 'khor dang gtan ④pa thams cad dum bur 'chag (snyepar 'gyur ro/ /lam (6)ngan pa dang / mi tsongan pa dang /mi ma yin pa dang / 'bab chu ngan pa dang / sbrul dang / dbugs gdug (8)pa dang / srog chags go nas dang / gdug pa dang bcas pa'i srog chags su gtogs pa thams cad mi gda' bar 'gyur ro/ /mi drang po dang lam drang por ci ltar rang gi gnas sam/ gtsug 6)lag khang ngam/ khang pa bzhin du zhugs nas dgos pa thams cad bsgrubs te/ slar yang gnas nas phyir ldog par 'gyur rol/ /rdo rje'i 'izhags pa las thams cad bgyid pa sgrub (spepa'i cho ga'o// //de nas rig sngags 'chang nor bu'i zhags pa bsgrub par 'tshal na/ rig sngags 'chang des nor bu 'tshal dzibar bgyi ste/ rdo rje'am/ be+e ḍūr+ya'am12/shel rang 'byung cingam/ margad dmatshe/ yin dra nī skyel la tu snasor mo'i tshigs pas tu)lhag tsam shin tu phyis la67/ shin tu yongs su dag par bgyis la( )/ gser gyi me tog gi tshul du 37bgyis pa/ mu tig gis dkris pa/ ge sar kha phye gleb tsam pa ku'i me tog ci lta ba zhu)bzhin nastebagyis la/ ras bzang po'i skud pa tshon rtsi mdzes pas zhugekha bsgyur rdunyab/ shin tu tshad la bab par bkal ( tshab khru nyi shu rtsa 92wa 105

gcig pa/ sor mo gung mo'i tshad tsam gyi nor bus brgyan ①la/ thor to cig ②shos su ni nor bu'am gser las bgyis pa'i lcags kyu gdags par bgyi'o/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gtsang mas gos gtsang ma bgo bar bgyi'o/ /legs par bkrus nas ba'i rnam lngas nye reg bgyi'o/ /de'i 'og tu ri mo'i gzugs kyi mdun du spos thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor tshad dang ldan pa bgyis la grwa bzhir bum pa gang ba gzhag par bgyid ②cing / spos phor ④gyi snod bshams nas/a ga 55)ru'i bdug pa dang / tsan dan dang / du ru ska'i ⑥bdug pa dbul bar bgyi'o / /dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su chos kyi stan ⑦bzang po tshad dang ldan pa bshams la/ ba dan sna tshogs kyis (snyedakyil 'khor bskor bar bgyi'o/ /me tog (9)sil ma dang / dri dang rol mo'i 7cha byad dag dgod (1par bgyi'o/ /rig sngags 'chang gis nyurtezas dkar gsum 'tshal bar bgyi'o/ /btung tu)ba ngan pa dang / kha zas ngan pa dang / gnas ngan pa dang / lhag ma dang /spags rnams rnam par mispang bar bgyi'o/ /don yod pa'i rgyal po'i snying po 8nyi khri chig tshistong bzlas kyi tshanas/ lag pa g.yas pas chos kyi stan gyi steng du bzhag pa'i zhags pa la mnan no/snye/ /lan nyi khri chig ()stong tshang ba dang / de nas rig sngags 'chang gis khro bo'i rgyal po lan stong rtsa brgyad tshang bar bzlas te/ yungs kur zhu )re re nas dbang bskur tsobar bgyi'o/ /lan stong rtsa brgyad tshang ba dang / rig sngags 'chang gis ( sre'aphags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi ri mo'i gzugs la mchod pa rgya cher bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med dang / de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa la yang mchod pa rgya cher bgyi'o/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis tshes bcwa ( dunalnga'i nya la nyin zhag gcig smyung (9ba bgyis 92wa 106

nas mchod pa rgya hu)cher bgyis te②/ mchod pa'i yo byad gang ci yang rung ba de dag thams cad la ①re re nas don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po ④lan (9nyi shu rtsa re re nas yibazlas brjod bgyis nas dbul ba ⑦bgyi'o/ /de nas skyil mo krung (8)bcas te mchis nas/ nyin mtshan kun tu don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas te/ yungs kur 6)re re nas brdeg ( )par bgyi'o/ /lan stong rtsa brgyad tshang ba dang sa (7cher g.yo bar 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi ri mo'i gzugs las kyang 'od zer kha dog 8sna tshogs dag tso'abyung bar 'gyur ro/ /nor bu'i zhags pa de yang 'bar bar 'gyuraci/rig sngags 'chang gi mgo bo yang 'bar bar 'gyur ro/ /'bar ba tsam gyi mod la rig sngags 'chang gi lag pa g.yas pas hunyenor bu'i zhags pa blangs pa na/sgra chen po yang tso'abyung bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug lha'i bdag nyid kyi rang bzhin gyis rig sngags 'chang gi mdun na mchis par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med dang / de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs 'od kyi rgyal po'i sku gser gyi kha dog gisanyurte/ nam mkha' la rdzu 'phrul gyis bzhugs tsonas/ rig sngags 'chang la legs so zhes bgyi ba 465 bar 'gyur(she / phyag dpung pa gser gyi kha dog 'dra ba brkyang ba'i phyag gis/ rig sngags 'chang gi mgo bor bzhag nas/ rig sngags 'chang la dbugs 'byin par mdzad de/ rig sngags 'chang legs so legs so/ /khyod kyis yid bzhin gyi nor bu chen po (2 don yod pa'i zhags pa rnam par dag pa grub po/ /khyod kyis 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i las bsgrub pa'i cho ga bla na med pa 92—107

grub ste/ rig sngags 'chang gis hu)'dod dgur bsgyur ②ba thams cad de/'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi don yod grub pa yid bzhin gyi ④nor bu chen po'i zhags pa khyo)thogs nas/ rig sngags 'chang gis 'bad mi dgos par yid bzhin gyi nor bu chen po don yod pa'i zhags pa 2grub pa'i rang bzhin 'dis / 'jig rten pa yidang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dgos pa rnam pa sna tshogs sgrub ④par byed pa la ltos shig /yid la ci ltar bsams ⑧pa bzhin rdzu 'phrul dang / cho 'phrul (9)sna tshogs la ltos ⑩shig /rig sngags 'chang khyod shi 'phos nas 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du song zhigatunye /'on te bde ba can blta bar nyune'atshal lam/ ci ltar de bzhin gshegs pa la 'os pa'i lha rdzas kyi 1snyemachod par 'tshal lam/ de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa'i sprin gyis mchod par 'tshal lam/ lha'i me tog dang / lha'i dri dang / phreng ba dang /byug pa dang / phye ma dang / chos gos dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / dril bu dang / ba dan dang / lhab lhub dang / rgyan dang gos kyis ④de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod par bgyi ba tshe'atshal na/ rig sngags 'chang des spyi bo'i gtsug tu dri'i tshedakyil 'khor bgyis la me tog dang / bdug pa yang dbul lo1 sna/ /yid bzhin gyi nor bu chen po don yod pa'i zhu zhags pa'i mchog 'di / lag pa g.yon pas mnan la/ lag pa g.yas pas don yod pa 17yid bzhin gyi 3 )nor bu'i mchog bzung ( stonas/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te / 'di lta bu (2yid la bgyid na pa chen po ci 8 )lta bu'i bsam pa yid la bgyid pa de lta bu yang bsams 2snyenas/ don yod rgyal po'i snying po lan bdun bzlas te phyag bgyi'o/ /yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che 9 lhargya chen don yod pa 'di 92—108

bzlas nas/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi snying po 'di lan brgya 6)rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /byams pa chen po dang snying rje chen pos yongs su gdungs pa'i snying gis sems can thams cad la mchog tu brtse (9bar bgyis nas gsang sngags bzlas brjod bgyi'o// //'phags pa don yod pa'i zhags pa'i cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po/ bam po lnga pa/dus gsum du gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho mtha' yas pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang sangs rgyas dang /'phags pa nyan thos kyi dge 'dun 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang dag par song ba dang / yang dag par zhugs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /blo gros chen po sha gcir dwa ti'i bu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnas kyi mchog dga' ldan na gnas pa tshoge'aphags pa byams pa la sogs pa'i ku tshogs dang bcas pa'i mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde ba can gyi dkyil 'khor na bzhugs pa de bzhin gshegs pa 'phags pa 'od dpag 56)med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po snying rje chen po dang ldan pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug chen po 7tshodang / dbang phyug (8)la sogs pa'i lha'i bu gzugs sna tshogs mnga' ba spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ oṃ ma hā 6)pad+ma tsin+ta tshum ṇi ma ṇi lha/ a mo gha ma ṇi su ma ṇi/ ma hā ma ṇi/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ a lam̐ kā nyuger/ ma hā nyashes mo gha ma ṇi/ tsa ra tsa ra sañtsa ra/ ni sgyu/— )sha tsa tsa re shwa mer ma hā/ pad+ma bhu dza ba ra da/ ma hā kā tsharu ṇi 1dzhaka /ma hā bi 92—109

shwa rū ①pa dha ra/ pra ba ra ma hā bo dhi satwa ②pad+ma dha ra pad+mā ③sa na pad+ma ma ⑤ku ṭa/mā lā dha ra/ pad+ma gi ra/ pad+mā 0lo kṛ ⑥ta ta nu/ sa ha sra bhu dza ⑦sa ha sra ⑧ ne tra 0nā nā:ta/ pra ba ra ṇa0/ mu'i bi bhū ṣi tā sa ha yisra bhu dza/ dza ya dza ya / sha ta sa ha 4)sra rasmi tu)pra ti maṇ+ḍi ta sha rī ra0/ bha ra bha ra/ bi tsi ⑫tra / ā ⑩bha ra ṇa tidha ra/ ma ṇi ka na tu)ka /badz+ra bai ḍūr+ya7/ maska ( kye ta/yin dra nī tshul pad+ma rā ga bhū ṣi ⑥ta (ste sha rī ra.i/ tsi ri ⑤dzi ri be tsi dutra/tsa ra ṇa0 / ma hā bo dhi khunyesatwa ba ra dā 4)brah+ma/ bistu (nyam he shwa (1ra rū 9pa dha ra / pad+me shwa radu/ lo ke (gesha ra/ ya mādhe shwa ra/tso ba ru ṇa/ ku be ra/ ṛ ṣi ga ṇa0/ ku mā ra(rte/ se nā ba ti be sha (sridha ra/ dha ra dha ra0/ dhi sh+yiri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ ma hā 47byu ta ba sha cinadha ra/ sarba ta thā ga tā bhi ṣe ka ta (ges ma ya ma nu 4)sma ra bha ga bān(she/ pū (gyir ya me ā tā (nyeshān+ta 9 tā rā 9ya pū ra sgo )shā yā 47ya satwa 6nye na/ tadz+dza tsoya du / bā (steta ya bi rgyu4nye/ mā (nyar ya tri do ṣa mā 8)lo/ sa ra sa ra pā (shetha/ hūm̐ hūṃ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa0/ sid dh+ya sid dh+ya du / ma hā tsin+ta ma ṇi/ a mo gha pā sha dha ra/ sā (hadha ya sā rdzogedha ya/ bi pu (stsol sid dhisdo )/ ma ma tri bhu ba na di bya ༷pra yats+tsha/ ma hā kā tsoru ṇi 4)ka / bud dha bud rgya48/ bo dha ya bo 47snya ya/ saṃ bho 0dha ya4nya/ saṃ bho dha ya/dzi ma hā kyipa shu pa ti be dhiṣa padha ra/ a nan+ta dhibi kusba chaṇa(nye/ ridhi san dar+sha ya /tu ru tu ru/ ta ra ta 'u )ra67/ ga ga ne 69bi pu la bi mā na/ saṃ da ni 4)ka /na mo stu te 69bi pu la pu rgya lta/ ko shā 24dha ra/ ma hā 8 tshos mo gha sid dhe 6)rtsu hūm̐/ a bhi ṣiñtsa (7tu māṃ/ bi pu la krirti 1 )ka re swā hā/ bhu ba (1swā hā/ bhu ra bhu ba swā hā/a mo gha bi pu le swā hā/ ma hā tsin+ta ma ṇi 0sidhe swā hā/ ma hā tsin+ta ma ṇi sidhi ba 92wa 110

ra de swā hā/la sarba sid dhi ②ba ra de ②swā hā/ oṃ bi pu le shwa ra/ lo ke shwa ra④/ma hā ⑤dzin+ta ⑥ma ṇirtsi/ ma hā ④a mo gha sid dhi 6)rtsu phaṭa swā hā/ don yod nor bu'i zhags pa chen po 'di lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas ma thag tu rig sngags 'chang gi lus thams cad 'bar bar 'gyur ro/ /don yod pa'i zhags pa lag pas mnan na nam mkha'i ngos la rdzu 'phrul gyis mchi ⑩bar 'gyur ro/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge tunye'adzin dang 'dra ba'i rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul chen po ston par 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can nyunyemathong bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med kyang tshogs dang bcas/ 'khor dang bcas/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i dkyil 'khor dang / gzhal med khang mchog dang bcas pa rdzu 'phrul gyis ⑩rnam par 'phrul pa mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /bde ba can gyi ④gnas mtha' dag tu (snyemachod pa'i char yisprin gyi tshogs tho 7chen po 'byung bar 'gyur zhing /de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med kyi mthus mchod pa'i sprin chen por gnas par 'gyur ro/ /bde ba can na (nyunyeganas pa de dag thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med des/ rig sngags 'chang la legs so zhes bgyi ba 46pa bar 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags 'chang des kyang sgra de dag thams cad thos par 'gyur zhing / mchod pa'i char chen po de (6yang mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te rig sngags 'chang nam mkha' las chu 'bebs zhu )par 'tshal na/ de'i tshe bsams 0pa tsam gyis 'bebs zhu)par 'gyur ro/ /'on te mi 'tshal na nam (gemakha' de nyid na nam mkha' la grub pa dang / rig sngags 'chang thams cad kyi mchog don yod rgya ( nachen grub pa yid bzhin ( genor bu lag pa zhes bya ba'i 'khor los sgyur ( 9bar 'gyur ro/ /dpag tu ma mchis pa'i 'khor los sgyur ( rnguba'i rig 92—111

sngags 'chang gis yongs su bskor bar 'gyur ro/ /tshe bskal pa chen po brgya stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa gnyis su 'gyur ro/ /'on te babs ①na lo khrir 'tsho (snyebar 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten dbang phyug dang 'dra bar mchod pa dang gus pa chen po bgyid ( —)par 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten thams cad kyi gtso bo gcig pur ④'gyur ro/ /lha rnams kyang babs nas rig sngags 'chang de la mchod pa'i mchog rgya chen po dag bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /sems can thams cad la bu gcig pa bzhin du mngon par dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /mchod pa'i 'os su'ang (snye'agyur ro//lha thams cad kyis kyang kun tu bsrung (6)zhing phyag bgyi ba'i 'os su 'gyur ro/ /thos pa bsags pa'i rgya mtsho chen por yang tso)'gyur ro/ /gal te rig sngags 'chang phyogs bcu dus gsum thams cad kyi ༄8)de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor porab dang bcas pa rang sangs rgyas dang /'phags pa nyan thos kyi dge 'dun thams cad dang / lha dang / klu dang /gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang /mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la mngon par dad pa dang bcas pa la mchod pa bgyid par 'tshal ba'amakyi/ phyogs bcu dus gsum du gtogs pa thams cad kyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la bsod nams kyi phung po chen po yongs su rdzogs par 'tshal ba'amaXnyu/ dge ba'i rtsa ba chen po bskyed par 'tshal ba'am/ lha'i zhal 32zas kyi mchog ro bro ba'i 1lhamachog dang ldan pa'i bza' ba dang / lha'i bcud kyis len gyi mchog gis de bzhin gshegs pa dang 8/ byang chub sems dpa' dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / 'phags pa nyan thos kyi dge 'dun thams cad la bstabs par 'tshal ba'am/ sbyin pa mang 92—112

po dang / chen po gtong bar 'tshal ba'am/ nyin re zhing mchod pa'i sprin 0)bgyid par 'tshal na/ rig sngags 'chang des legs par bkrus te/ gtsang mas gos gtsang ma bgos nas/ ci 'byor pas dkyil 'khor gru bzhir (mibagyis la / bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi mdun du me tog dang / bdug pa yang dbul bar bgyi'o/ /pus dugemo btsugs ④te thal mo sbyar nas zhags pa bzung ste(5)/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad yid la bgyi'o//yid bzhin gyi (6)nor bu chen po rgya chen don yod 'di yang mchod par bgyi'o/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi snying po lan bdun bzlas par ⑦bgyi'o / /yid la bgyid pa yangs pa rgya chen po mchod pa'i sprin chen po dang /sbyin gtong chen po dang / kha zas dang / btung ba dang / dri dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / chos gos dang / gdugs dang /rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / gos dang / rgyan dang / lhab lhub dang /rgyan 'phyang (8༄dang / rol mo dang / sil snyan dang / pheg rdob pa ku9)dang /rin po che'i ljon shing dang / 'bras bu'i ljon shing dang ⑫/ me tog gi hunyeljon shing dang / mar me'i ljon shing dang / dpag bsam gyi tunyeljon shing yid la bgyis te/sri/ gsang sngags kyi gzungs bzlas nas ji chultar yid la bsams shing 7don du gnyer ba bzhin phyogs bcur 'phangs na/ de'i tshe phyogs bcu dus gsum du gshegs pa dkyil 'khor mtha' dag tu gtogs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du mkho tsoba'i yo byad thams cad ma tshang ba ma mchis par ci bsams /napa bzhin hu de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor gyi spyan sngar mchod pa'i char gyi sprin chen po 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du 92—113

mkho ①ba'i yo byad thams cad kyi mchod pa chen po ma tshang ba ma mchis pa ②'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du mthu chen po'i nor bu rgya chen don yod ②la mchod pa'i gzungs bzlas shing / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi snying po'i gzungs 'di yang nyin gcig ④bzhin du thun gsum du lan gsum du bzlas par ⑤bgyi'o/ / de nas yirig sngags 'chang gis dus gsum du gshegs pa'i ⑦'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa de dag mnyes par bgyis pa dang /mchod pa bgyis pa dang / rim gro bgyis par du'agyur ro/ /bsod nams kyi phung po'i tshogs chen po dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba chen po bskyed par 'gyur ro/ /dus gsum du gtogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa de dag thams cad kyis 5)rig sngags 'chang la dran pa dang / blo gros dang stobs dang brtson 'grus dang gzi brjid stsol yibar 'gyur royi/ /nyin gcig bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dgongs par 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug rtag tu rjes su 'brang bar 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu mchog sbyin pa mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /mthong ba'i chos la 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal 'jigs pa 'jigs su rung ba dang / skrag pa dang / dngang tib rnams tunyezhi bar 'gyur ro//nad kyis kyang gnod par mi 'gyur ro/ /rims kyis ma lags/ dug gis ma lags / dug sbyar mas ma lags/ sbyor bas ma lags/ mtshon gyis ma lags/mes ma lags/ chus ma lags teyi/ lus la ser ba 7'bab par mi 'gyur ro//dgras 'jigs par mi 'gyur te/ pha rol gyi dpung gi 7'jigs pas ma lags/pha rol gyi sde'i 'jigs pas ma lags/ phas kyi rgol ba dang mi mdza' ⑩ba'i 92—114
