'jigs pas ma lags/ lha'i 'jigs pas ma lags/ klu'i 'jigs pas ma lags te/ gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye 6)chen po dang / srin po dang / mkha' 'gro ma dang / 'dod dgur bsgyur ②ba dang / sbyor ba mo'i 'jigs pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /dpag tshad gcig gi nang tshun chad gzung ②bar mi nus shing / rgyang ring por 'bros par 'gyur te/ de la bgegs bgyid par mi 'gyur ro/ /gang dag mnar med par gnas par 'gyur ba'i sems can nam/mtshams med pa lnga bgyid pa'am/ 'phags pa la skur ba 'debs pa'am/ dam pa'i chos spong ba'am/ bskal ④pa bye bar bsags pa'i las kyi sgrib pas lus yongs su dkris pa gang lags pa de yang mthong ba'i chos la thams cad lhag ma ma lus par yongs su gtugs (gepar 'gyur⑥/ yongs su grol bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te tshig gzhan (7mi smra bar lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyid cing /smyung (kyeb lan cig 6)bgyis te/ bzlas brjod byas na de bskal tshupa bye ba phrag (nyabargya stong du 'khor bar skye ba las phyir zlog tsho par 'gyur ro/ /gzungs ()kyi bzlas (stebarjod kyis las kyi sgrib pa yonyesnga ma rnams kyang 'byang bar 'gyur zhing /bskal 7pa stong du bsags pa'i sdig pa rnams nyams par 'gyur ro/ /'khor ba'i nyes pas phyir yang gos par mi 'gyur te/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad kyis pad+ma bzhin du gos par mi 'gyur ro/ /mthong ba'i chos la sa lnga pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /bsten pa tsam mam cho ga'i bzlas brjod la nges par gnas na/phyir mi ldog pa'i gnas thob yi par 'gyur ro/ /dran pa tsam gyis pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /pha rol tu phyin pa bcu'i rjes su mchi 92—115

bar 'gyur ro/ /nyin gcig hu)bzhin du lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis na / mthong ba'i chos la kun tu bzang po nyid thob ②par 'gyur ro/ /gsang sngags dang cho ga zhib mo dang / dkyil 'khor dang duphyag rgya thams cad kyi rjes su zhugs pa dang / dam tshig thams cad la zhugs par 'gyur ro/ /yang dag par skyed 2)pa thams cad kyi rjes su 'brang bar 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags 'chang mthong ba (5)tsam gyis/ mnar med par gnas pa rnams kyi sdig pa (7rnam par 'jig par 'gyur ro/ /chung ngu na rig sngags 'chang dur khrod du zhugs nas gum pa'i rus pa'am/ gum pa'i sha'am/ gum pa'i ro rul ba'am/ chung ngu na gum pa'i gos bor ba'am/ rtsig pa'i ri mo la rig sngags 'chang de'i grib mas phog par (3)gyur na/ sems can de (2)gang dang gang gis dmyal bar gzhol bar 'gyur ba (9༄de dang de nas mod la thar nas 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur te/ de la yid gnyis sam 7som nyi bskyed 31par mi bgyid tunyen/gang dag ches mang du lhag par bgyid par 'gyur ba lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/gang tu rigs kyi bu pho'amaltoste/ rigs kyi bu mo'am/ dge slong pa'am/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen 8pa'am/ dge bsnyen ma'am7/ dad pa'i rjes su 'brang ba 'ga' zhig gzungs 'di 'chang bar bgyid dmatu 7/ brjod par bgyid/klog par bgyid/ 'don par bgyid/ sems par bgyid/ bsgom 6)par bgyid / mchod par bgyid/ bri 67bar bgyid/ 'drir 3 )'jug par bgyid na/de nges par bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro/ /mthong ba'i chos la yon tan chen po brgya stong mang po mthong bar 2lha'agyur ro/ /'di nyid bcangs na/ mthong ba'i chos la dge ba'i rtsa ba 6)92—116

thams cad dang / pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang rjes su mthun ①pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /gzungs 'di nyid re zhig ⑤kun chub par bgyis nas/ mkho ①ba'i yo byad thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur na/dgos pa mang pos grims ④par bgyid pa lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ de nas rig sngags 'chang don yod yid dugebazhin nor bu'i zhags pa bsgrubs yinas yid la bsams te/ bsams 9)pa'i las thams cad bgyis na thams cad 'grub par 6)'gyur ro/ /dgos pa dang bgyi ba thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /ci ltar 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mchog sbyin mngon sum du mthong nas/lung bstan pa bzhin du don yod pa'i yid bzhin gyi 6)nor bu'i yizhags pa 'di de bzhin du blta bar bgyi ste/ 'di la yid gnyis mi bgyi'o/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis zhags pa mgrin /bepar btags la/ lag pa g.yas pas nor bu tunyeblangs te/ lag pa g.yon pas lcags kyu blangs na mi gda' bar gyur tunyenas/gar yidaga' ba der 'jug par 'gyur te/ mtshan mo yang nor bu'i 'od kyi snang bas nyin par ci lta 8ba bzhin mthong bar tso'agyur ro'o sna/ /thams cad du lha'i gnas su 'jug pa dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci'i gnas dang / lto 'phye (shechen po'i gnas dang / ri sul gyi phug dang / ri dang / nags tshal dang /thang gi sgo rnams 'bye 19)bar 'gyur ro trī/ /thams cad du mi mngon ( lhapar zhugs nas slar ldog par 'gyur zhing ci 'tshal ba de bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /mi rnams kyi nang du lha'i tshe lo brgyar 'tsho zhurtebar 'gyur ro/ /nyon mongs pa dang / nyes pa'i 4)skyon thams cad spangs par 'gyur ro/ /'on te rig sngags 'chang gis 92—117

grub pa'i don la brtag ①par 'tshal na/ zla ba yar gyi ngo'i tshes brgyad dam/bcu bzhi la legs par khrus bgyi'o/ /gtsang mas gos gtsang ma bgo bar bgyi'o / /gtsang ma'i gnas sam/ phyogs su ba'i lci ②ba ste/ ba'i rnam lngas yongs su sbyang ①bar bgyi'o/ /gnas de'i nang logs kyi dbus su dri'i dkyil 'khor bgyi'o/ /me tog gi ④sil ma bkram zhing bum pa gang bas brgyan ⑤cing /spos sna tshogs kyis bgos (6)pa'i bdug ⑦pa gzhag par bgyi'o/ /de nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi lamadun du stan bzang 6)po bshams te / shin tu mnyam par gzhag pas zhags pa sbrul 'khyil pa'i tshul du zlum por bskyil yonas gzhag par bgyi'o/ /dbus su nor bu gzhag par bgyi'o/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis 1nyamachod par bgyi'o/ /don yod rgyal po'i snying po lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod bgyis nas/ khro bo'i rgyal po lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /de nas don yod yid bzhin gyi 7nor bu'i snying po lan brgya 3)rtsa brgyad bzlas nas/ de'i 'og tu tsan+dan dang / a ga ru dang /du ru ska'i yibadug pa dbul zhing nor bu la brtag 7par bgyi ste/ zhags pa dang / de thams cad nor bu'i nang nas gda' bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gda' ba'am/ byang chub sems dpa' gda' ba'am/ lha gda' ba'am / klu gda' ba'amatso/ gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / dri za dang /lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci gda' ba dang ⑩/ 'byung po dang / lto 'phye 1 chen po gda' ba'am/ g.yul 'gyed ky-i/)pa gda' ba'am/tshe ring ba gda' ba'am/ tshe nyams pa gda' ba'ams )/ tshe 'pho ba (nyagada' ba'am / rgyal srid gda' ba'am/ grong 'thob 2)pa'am/ yul 'thob pa'am rnye/92—118

grong khyer 'thob pa'amadhi/ dbyig dang / gser dang / nor bu dang / mu tig dang / bai ḍūr+ya ②dang / shang ka shi ⑧la dang / byi ru dang / sa le sbram dang —/ dngul dang / gos dang / lhab lhub dang / rgyan gda' ba'am/nor bsgyur rtsib smra ba dang (snye/ mig 'phrul smra ba'am/ zhing smra ba'am/ gter smra ba'am/ 'bru smra ba'am/ bud med 'phrog pa'am/ las bsgrub pa'am/gsang sngags bsgrub ⑥pa'am/ dbang du bgyi ba'am/ ngo mtshar (peb de dag thams cad nor bu'i nang nas 6)gda' bar 'gyur zhing dge ba'am mi dge ba/de khyadag thams cad kyang gda' bar 'gyur ro/ /lo'am/ lo phyed dam/gnod pa'am/ 'tshe ba'am yams sam/ mi tings sam/ mi ngas chen po'am / phyugs ngas sam/ gor ram/ rta tunyend dam/ glang po che'i nad dam / rang gi dpung ngam/ gzhan gyi dpung gi 'jigs pa dang / skrag pa chen po de dag thams cad me long gi dkyil 'khor la ci lta ba de hunyebazhin du gda' bar 'gyur lags so(nye/ /gang bsams shing yigang gnyer bar 8'grub pa'am/mi 'grub pa'am/ dge ba'am/ mi dge ba thams cad gda' bar 'gyur te/de la the tshom yidang yid gnyis dang som nyi mi bgyi ste/ dngos po don tshigazhan du mi 'gyur ro/ /char mi 'bab pa'i dus su klu'i gnas su nor bu bzhag na/ci tsam 'tshal bar char gyi rgyun 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /ha cang char ches na nam mkha' la nor bu bstan na char chen po 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /nyi ma 'char khar ()nyi ma la bstan na nyi ma babs nas mchog thams cad stsol tsobar 'gyur ro/ /zla ba tshes pa la bstan na zla ba ( )babs nas 'dod dgu zhustethams cad kyi mchog stsol bar bgyid do/ /chu klung chen por bstan na rin po che rnams 'byung bar 92—119

'gyur ro/ /nags khung du bstan na sman gyi rdzas thams cad rang gi gzugs kyis tsho1)mdun na mchis nas gang gnyer ba de len par (mi'agyur ro/ /ri phug tu bstan na sman thams cad 'bab par 'gyur te/ rigaci 'tshal ba de blang ④bar bgyi'o / /'bru'i phung po la bstan na 'bru thams cad 'du bar 'gyur te(de/gang du 'tshal ba der 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /ma mo'i gnas sam/ nag po chen po la bstan te/ spyi bo'i gtsug 97tu bzhag na nag po chen po ma mo'i tshogs kyi 7'khor dang bcas pa rang gi gzugs kyis (21mdun na mchis nas/ dbang du 'gyur zhing dgos pa thams cad 9byedang las thams cad bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po'i mngon sum du bstan na 9yan lag bzhi'i dpung dang bcas pa/ blon po'i tshogs dang bcas11/ btsun mo'i 'khor dang bcas pa/ dbyig dang /gser dang / nor bu dang / mu tig dang / bai ḍūr+ya 3rnyedang / shang ka shi la dang / byi ru dang / sa le sbram dang / dngul dang / gos dang / rgyan dang / lhab lhub dang / rgyan 'chang ba nyurtedang / khang pa dang / ngo mtshar ④du bcas pa dbang du gyur nas/ ji srid 'tsho'i 8bar du tshubasnyen bkur 9/rtebagyid par 'gyur ro/ /skye bo'i tshogs chen po'i nang du zhags pa 'phangs te/ don yod pa'i yid bzhin gyi 1 —nor bu'i gzungs bzlas na/ ci ltar 'tshal ba yid la bsams 19pa bzhin/ me tog dang 'bras bu dang / gzhal med khang gi char zhu 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal mtshan bsgreng zhi nyaba'i rtse mor bzhag ste/ rgyal rigs spyi bor dbang bskur lhab khyim gyi steng ngam khyams su bzhag la/ 'phags pa'i lam ciyan lag brgyad kyi bsnyen thunaganas kyis sems can thams cad la mchog tu brtse bar bgyid do lha/ /don yod rgyal po'i snying po lan nyi shu rtsa gcig 92wa 120

bzlas brjod bgyis nas/ khro bo'i rgyal po lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas par 1bgyi'o / /de nas don yod pa'i 'a yid bzhin nor bu'i gzungs lan brgya rtsa brgyad gsang bstod (5)de bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /lan brgya rtsa brgyad tshang ( nas/ci ltar yid la bsams ( pa bzhin char du 6'bab par 'gyur ro/ /nor 7dang /'bru dang / gos dang / lhab lhub la sogs 8pa/ me tog dang 'bras bu'i char 'bab par 'gyur ro/9)/ /'thab pa dang / 'thab mo dang / rtsod pa dang /'gyed pa dang / mu ge'i dgon pa'i 'jigs pa dang / yams dang / gnod pa de dag thams cad 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi mthus babs 7par 'gyur ro/ /thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /sems can thams cad la mi 'jigs pa stsol 3nyabar 'gyur ro/ /'jigs pa dang sha khon 12thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /gdug pa nas gcan gzan 1 khro bo 1 thams cad kyi bar du yang byams pa la gnas par 'gyur ro/ /sems can thams cad mthun 8par bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /yid kyi brnag pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /don yod yid bzhin lanor bu'i zhags pa chen po sgrub pa'i cho ga'o// //de nas rig sngags 'chang ral gri dang zhags pa bsgrub par 'tshal na/ rig sngags 'chang gis lcags chen po las ral gri sor bcu drug gi 1 tshad du bgyis la lag zungs kyi ngos la 18dngul las bgyis te/ gser gyis 'bar bar bri'o/ /shing shun gyi skud pa'am39/ arka'i skud pa dang / kha che dar gyi skud pa lhan cig tu sgril la hūṃ —1khru bcu drug byung ba shin tu tshad la bab par bkum 22pa/ bsgrub 92—121

pa'i dgos pa yongs su rdzogs pa la sum sgril du bkal bar bgyi'o/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis 1)legs par khrus bgyis te/ gtsang mas gos gtsang ma bgos (gyite/ zhags pa dang / ral gri mnan la/ lag pa g.yas pas dkyil 'khor la bzhag ste gzung (5)bar bgyi'o/ /khros pa'i gnyer gyi bzhin gyis skyil mo krung (debacas te (5)mchis nas/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi ri mo'i gzugs kyi mdun du khro bo'i rgyal po lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas par dubagyi'o/ /bzlas brjod lan stong rtsa brgyad tshang (7)nas/ ral gri 'bar bar gyur ninas/rig sngags 'chang nam mkha' la 'phur bar 'gyur zhing / ral gri grub pa'i rig sngags 'chang thams cad kyi gtso tho)bo 'khor los sgyur ⑩bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhan gyi mthus zil gyis non 17par mi 'gyur ro/ /lo khri brgyad 7stong du 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /'on te lag pa g.yon pas zhags pa bzung tshul g.yas pas ral gri bzung saste/ khros pas hūm̐ zhes bgyi bas mnan na/ mi gda' bar gyur nas/mi gda' ba dang / zhags pa dang / ral gri grub pa'i rig sngags 'chang thams cad kyi gtso bo rgyal po 'khor los sgyur 8bar 'gyur ro/ /tshe lo khri thub par 'gyur ro/ /'on te rig sngags 'chang khros pas ral gri bskor na/ bgegs dang / log 'dren 7dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po gdug yipa thams cad dang / 'byung po thams cad kyi rig sngags gcad nyeshepar 'gyur ro/ /g.yul gyi dbus su lan cig bskor (1tshen/ g.yul 'gyed pa'i mtshon cha thams cad bcad ( nyapar 'gyur/ rengs par bgyis par 'gyur te/ thams cad phyogs bcur 'byer 37bar 'gyur ro/ /dur sbyo hekhrod kyi nang du bskor ( lhen/ dur 8)khrod na gnas pa'i gdug pa rgyu ba thams cad kyi rig sngags 6stegatubs 69par 'gyur zhing /92—122

gnas thams cad stongs par 'gyur ro/ /phug gi sgor bskor ①na/ 'khrul 'khor dang sgo glegs thams cad dkrugs ②par 'gyur ro/ / sgo dang chagatan pa thams cad gtubs ④par 'gyur ro/ /gdug ⑤pa'i mi ma yin pa bar chad bgyid pa thams cad bcom par 'gyur⑥/ thal bar brlag par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang dgos pa thams cad du ⑦ci ltar 'tshal ba bzhin du bgyid par 'gyur ro / /ral gri sgrub pa'i cho ga'o// //de nas yang durig sngags 'chang sbrul gyi zhags pa bsgrub par po)'tshal na/rig sngags 'chang des skud pa lnga las bsgrubs te⑩/ tshon rtsis kha bsgyur ba'i skud pa yitshad bzhin du gtubs nyurtel/ bsgrub par shin tu 'os pa tsho/sprelas bsgrub par bgyi'o/ /de nas zas bzang po'i phye ma dang / ma dhu'i me tog dang / ra tso sa'i me tog dang / ldong ros dang / pad+ma ge sar dang / nā snyig put+pa'i dang /shing arka'i 7'o ma de (shelhan cig (7tu sbyar ba der btsag btsal 0 te/ dus gcig tu lhan cig ( nyamanyam du btags shing spyi bor legs par bsku ste(ste/ de la don yod rgyal po lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis nas/ sbrul 'khyil pa mgo gsum gyi gdengs ka can zhu)yongs su 'khyil pa gser gyis g.yogs shustepa/legs par sbrel pa ni zhags pa'i mchog lags so/ /rig sngags 'chang gis zhugelegs par khrus bgyis la/ gtsang mas gos gtsang ( 9ma bgos tekhu tsho/ ba'i lci ba'i dkyil 'khor gru du stebazhi tshad bzhin bgyis te/ dris mchod par bgyi'o/ /me tog gi sil ma dang / bum pa gang bas brgyan byupar bgyi'o/ /ba dan gyis kun nas brgyan ( )par bgyi'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi dbus kyi gnas su stan bzang 92—123

po bshams te/ de'i steng du klu'i zhags pa bskyil 0)nas gzhag (snyepar bgyi'o/ /sbrul gyi mgo'i gdengs ka dbus ma ni kha shar phyogs su bstan no②/ /dkar gsum gyi ( stegator ma gzhag par bgyi'o/ /mchod yon zhabs bsil ⑤dkar po'i snod dang / bdug pa rnam pa gsum po tsan+dan dang / a ga yiru dang /du (7)ru ska 8)rnams bsreg 59)go/ /'bras yos dang / yungs kur bkram ⑩pa'i dkyil 'khor bgyis la/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mngon sum du bzhag la mchod pa rgya chen po bgyis te/gle/ rig sngags 'chang gis skyil mo krung the bcas te/ mchis nas bzlas hunyebarjod mang du bgyi'o/ /thog mar don yod zhags pa'i snying po lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis nas/ tshangs pa dang 7/ khro bo'i rgyal po lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas 8pa'i yungs kur 7re re nas sbrul gyi mgo la gtor bar bgyi'o/ /sgrub pa thams cad tshang nas ni/ /rgyun du sbrul ni 1 'bar bar 'gyur/ /stan /snyelas zhags pa g.yo ba ni/ /sor bzhi tsam gyi tshad tsam du/ /stan 17las gyen shu 7du 'phar bar 'gyur/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis bzung 3lhanas mi gda' bar (rtegyur nas/ klu'i gnas su mchis te/ klu'i mtshor mchis na/ klu'i gnas kyi sgo rnams 'bye na)bar 'gyur ro / /rig sngags 'chang gis zhugs te don yod rgyal po bzlas nas/ sbrul gyi zhags pa lan gsum du bskor 34bar bgyi'o/ /de nas klu'i rgyal po btsun mo'i 'khor dang bcas pa mchis nas rig sngags 'chang la mngon sum (snyedu smra bas rig sngags 'chang zhugs shig ces smra bar 25'gyur ro/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis sbrul gyi 2 tshozhags pa bzung ste 2)bskor nas 'jug par bgyi'o/ / de nas rigs 29sngags 'chang gis klu'i skyon de mi mthong zhing nub par 'gyur ro/ /92—124

'khrul 'khor dang / sgo glegs dang / gtan pa 0)thams cad gtubs ②shing bcad ②par 'gyur ro/ /zhugs pa tsam gyi mod la klu'i bu mo gzugs bzang mo mdzes ④ma rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing bklubs (snyem mdzes nyam mchis nas / rin po che'i phreng (7ba thogs te/ rigs (8)sngags 'chang la dbul bar bgyid do/ /rigs po)sngags 'chang gis blangs nas spyi bo la bzhag ste/ bzhag pa tsam gyi mod 7la klu'i bu mo nam mkha' la 'phur nas nu ma gnyis nas 'o ma zags tunyepa dang / rig sngags 'chang gis bzed nyurtenas btung bar bgyi 3 ste/tshe nyi khri thub par 'gyur ro/ /skra cung zad 'khyil bar yang 'gyur ro/ /klu'i rgyal po zhes bgyi ba thams cad kyi bdag po 'khor los sgyur blabar 'gyur ro/ /mthu dang brtson tso'agrus chen pos pha rol gnon par 'gyur ro/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis sbrul gyi zhags pa bzhag la/ don yod rgyal po'i snying po shing ka ⑩ra bī ⑩ra'i lcug hu)ma la bzlas nas byab par bgyi ste/ gang dang gang gi ming nas drangs shing yid la bsams 37pas mod la ri rithams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro//char mi 'bab pa'i dus su 3)sbrul gyi zhags pa gnas zhurtemathon por bskor ri gebar bgyi ste/ lan cig bskor ri snyeb tsam gyis char gyi rgyun chen po 'bab par 'gyur rol/ /ha cang char ches pa'i ni dus su sbrul gyi zhags pa gnas mthon por bzhag na char ha cang che ba las 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /grang ba'am/ /rlung ( cingam/ser ba 'bab pa'i dus su nang par sngar sa klu'i zhags pa phyogs bzhir bskor na snye/dpag tshad brgya kho ra khor yug tu ser ba 'bab par mi 'gyur ro mu/ /grang ba'i rlung nu )dang ser ba 6)thams cad bcings par 'gyur ro/ /lo khyud 'khor tshang bar mtshams nu chen po bcings par 'gyur ro/ /nyin gcig sa bzhin don yod 92wa 125

rgyal po'i snying po lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod bgyis nas zhags pa lag pa g.yas pas brdogs ①la/ lag pa g.yon pas bskrad pa bgyis ②na/ nyin gcig chabazhin lha'i zhal zas dang / btung ba 'dod dgu ④thams cad klu'i gnas nas byung nas skye bo stong stong tsam la listsol bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i dug thams cad mthong ba tsam (7gyis dug ma lags par 'gyur ro/ /sbrul gyi zhags pa lag pa g.yas pas bzung (7)la/ lag pa g.yon pas klu bzung dunas/ dpyid dam / ston ku'amatsho)/ sprin chags pa'i dus su zhags pa ⑩bskor la khro bo'i rgyal po bzlas brjod bgyis te/ nam mkha' la 'phangs na me tog dang / 'bras bu dang / lo tog bzang po gang ci /77yang rung ba ()bzang po shin tu smin pa(nye/kha zas shin tu bzang po thams cad nam mkha'i ngos las sa la 'bab par 'gyur ro / /gal te lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bskor nasaci/ khro bo'i rgyal po lan nyi shu rtsa gcig 8bzlas brjod bgyis na/ klu'i gzhal med khang dang / gos dang /lhab lhub dang / rgyan 'phyang dang / rgyan thams cad sa tshul 'bab par 'gyur ro / /gal te rig sngags 'chang gis lan nyi shu rtsa gcig las lhag par bskor cing khro bo'i rgyal po bzlas brjod bgyis yin de'i tshe klu 'khor dang bcas pa gzhal med khang dang bcas par sa'i steng du ltung bar tunye'agyur ro/ /gal te rig sngags 'chang gis rgyal po btsun (7mo'i 'khor dang bcas pa dbang du bgyi bar 'tshal na/ zhags pa bzhag la yungs kur 5 )la don yod rgyalabyu po lan ( nyestong rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis nas bsnun la/ de nas sbrul gyi zhags pa blangs te / rgyal po'i khyim gyi phyogs gang lags pa der lhag par zhags pa bskor ( gyen/rgyal po'i btsun mo ( rte'akhor dang bcas pa dbang du gyur nas/ ji srid 'tsho'i duste92—126

bar du mchis par 'gyur ro/ /g.yul 'gyed pa na khro bo'i rgyal po bzlas brjod bgyis nas zhags pa g.yul gyi dbus su 'phangs 0)na sprul gdug pa mig bgrad ②pa/ lce bsgyur zhub mig me mdag ltar dmar ba 'byung bar 'gyur te/mthong ba tsam gyi mod la dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa phyogs bcur 'byer ④bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang ji ⑤lta ji ⑥ltar yid la bsams (7pa'i don de lta de lta dubur thams cad sgrub par byed par 'gyur ro/ /sbrul gyi zhags pa 6)sgrub pa'i cho ga'o// //de nas 'byung po'i dbang phyug gi zhags pa bsgrub par 'tshal na/ 'bri'i rtsid pa dang / rtsid pa chen po lhan cig 7tu bkal tunyeb dang / lcags las mdung 8rtse gsum pa sor bzhi'i tshad tsam du bgyis la/ de nas don yod rgyal po'i snying po lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis nas khro bo'i rgyal po lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas te/ nyin zhag gcig mchis la legs par khrus bgyis te(ste/gtsang khyims gos gtsang tsom bgo bar bgyi'o/ /zla ba mar gyi ngo'i tshes bcu buzhi'i nyin zhag gcig yigis bsgrub par bgyi'o/ /de nas mdung phonyertse gsum pa'i zhags pa blangs nas 'byung po'i dbang phyug gi 6)gzugs 'dra bar 'gyur ro//'byung po thams cad kyi bdag po lo brgya 6)stong du 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /'byung po'i gnas kyi gzhal med khang thams cad kyi bdag por 'gyur ro/ /zhags pa lag par thogs nas/ dur zhu )khrod du zhugs na/ dur 21khrod na gnas pa thams cad mdun ()du mchis te/ gnas kyi sgo thams cad 'bye du — bar 'gyur dugezhing khyod ci dgar zhugs shig ces ci 'tshal ba de zhunyebagyid par 'gyur ro/ /ro'i mgul 4 lha92—127

du btags nas khro bo'i rgyal po bzlas na ༅de nas ro langs nas ci dris pa de smra bar 'gyur zhing / ci bsgo (geb de bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /bkrol yan 'chi ④bar 'gyur ro/ /gnod sbyin gyi mgul ⑤du btags nas 6)khro bo'i rgyal po bzlas la (7)khros pas (8)drangs nas/ gnod sbyin de yang mdun du mchis nas/ rigs 6)sngags 'chang tshil rje btsun (1bka' stsol cig dang / thams cad bgyi'o zhes smra bar 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags 'chang gis khyod ji srid 'tsho'i 7bar du khro bo'i rgyal po sna mngag gzhug 7pa'i las gyis tsheshig ces smra bar bgyi ste/ bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes de nas nyin gcig skyebazhin bsgo 3)ba bgyis na/ las thams cad bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /gnod sbyin mo'i mgul tunyedu btags te/ khro bo'i rgyal po bzlas na/ gnod sbyin mo mchis nas/ rig sngags 'chang gi mdun tu)du mchis te/ rig sngags 'chang la mig mi 'dzums shu )par blta du skyezhing / rig sngags 'chang ci zhig don du gnyer zhes smra bar ( ge'agyur ro/ /rig sngags 'chang gis kho rtebo la ma dang / chung ma dang / sring mos bsgrub ༄ stepar bya ba'i dgos pa gsum byos shig ces bsgo ༷ 5bar bgyi'o/ /gal te ma zhig tu bgyid ( lhan bu gcig pa bzhin du bza' 2 tshob dang / btung ba dang / mal cha (nyadang / gos dang / nor dang / 'brus yongs su skyong bar bgyid do/ /chung ma zhig tu bgyid na/ mkho ri 6ba'i yo byad thams cad kyi dbang phyug dang bdag por bgyid cing / de dang lhag par dga' bar rtse bas phyi bzhin 'brang bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te sring mo zhig tu bgyid na/ yid la brnag pa'i 'dod pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bgyid do/ /dgos pa thams cad bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /thams cad du da1rgyug cing slar yang ldog par 'gyur ro/ /nyin gcig zhu bzhin 92—128

lhab lhub dang / gos dang / rgyan thams cad 0)stsol bar bgyid do/ /nyin gcig ②bzhin gzhan yang lha'i bu mo dag rtsed mo'i don du dgug par bgyid do/ /rnam thos kyi mgul du btags te/ khros pas drangs nas khro bo'i rgyal po'i bzlas (5)brjod bgyis na④/ de nas rnam thos mchis nas/ nyin gcig (9bzhin dong tse stong ༅stsol bar 'gyur/ gser stong stsol bar 'gyur te/ des nyin gcig (/7bzhin sbyin pa yang stsol/ bsod nams kyang bgyi'o/ /nag po chen po'i mgul (8radu btags la khro bo'i rgyal po lan bdun bzlas brjod bgyis te/ khros pas lag pa g.yas pa'i thal lcag 6)gis bdeg ⑩par bgyi'o/ /nag po chen pos sgra phyung ba dang (spre/ rig sngags 'chang skrag par mi bgyi bar 7slar yang khros pas brdeg 6gepar bgyi'o/ /de nas yimachi ma zags 7pa dang / rig sngags 'chang gis mchi ma bzed yide/ thig le bgyis na mi gda' bar gyur nas gter thams cad mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis slar 7yang thal mos brdeg tunyepar bgyis te/rte/ de nas nag po chen po khrag tu skyugs ce ripa/ rig sngags 'chang gis byugs na nam mkha' la mchis nas/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen por 'gyur ro/ /gu gul gyi bdug pas bdugs du tenas khro bo'i rgyal po bzlas ( snyen/ nag po chen po rang gi gzugs kyis mdun na mchis nas ci 'tshal ba'i mchog thams cad stsol ri chibar bgyid cing / ma mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad dbang du mchi bar ge'agyur ro/ /gzhan yang ci 'tshal ba zhugebagyid pas khri)dgos pa thams cad bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /mdung rtse gsum pa'i zhags ( pa bsgrub pa'i cho ga'o// //92—129

de nas gzhan yang ①zhags pa dang rjes su mthun pa'i ri mo'i cho ga de kho na nyid sgrub pa'i cho ga bla na med pa brjod par bgyi ②ste/ 'jig rten mgon pos sna tshogs pa'i/ /rnam pa'i kha dog gzugs bstan pal/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyisasti/ /cho 'phrul sna tshogs gzugs bstan ⑤te/ /lag pa stong dang mig stistong dang / /mtha' yas pa yi phyag rgya bstan/ /rnam pa sna tshogs pa yi ⑦gzugs / /khams gsum dag tu bstan ⑧pa ni/ /gdul bya gdul phyir gzugs bstan (7to/ /gsang ba 'di yi yigazugs bstan ⑩pa/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /rig sngags sgrub 7pa bla na medas/ /de nyid zhags pa bsgrubs miphyir ro/ /de bas rig 'dzin shes rab can/ /'jig rten pha rol rjes mthun 7pa/ /sangs rgyas nyid don gnyer ba dang / /de bzhin gshegs kun lta tsob dang / /bde 7can blta 4)bar 'tshal ba dang / /de nyid 'jig rten 'das pa yi1rte/ /'jig dbang mgon po mthong 'tshal ba(nye/ /mchog tu gus par sostobagyi ba yi/ /cho ga'i rgyal po 'di brjod kyis(ste/ /de nyid gus par dang ba shurnyedang / /shin tu dang ba ( stenyid du bgyi/ /grol ba sna tshogs 'tshal ba la / /sna tshogs pa yi gzugs bstan sate/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis grol bar 'gyur / /don yod rgyal po cho ga'i mchog /don yod grub pa'i 'jig rten 'das / /don yod 'bras bu dam pa po/ /don yod kun du grub pa 'thobadu /sangs rgyas kun gyis byin gyis brlabs/ /don yod 'jig rten 'jig rten mgon / /'jig rten dbang phyug mchog sbyin pa/ /don yod 'jig rten ci 'tshal ba/ /mchog 'tshal ba ni grub par 'gyur/ /don yod rgya chen rdzu 'phrul gyi / /cho 'phrul rnam 'phrul rgyun mi 'chad/ /de lta bas na kun bsgrims te/ /92—130

bdag nyid yongs su dag bgyis nas/ /ji ①ltar cho ga bkod ②pa bzhin/ /rjes su mthun ②par ri mo'i gzugs/ /rtag tu ri mo'i gzugs blta zhing / /zhags pa'i dugazugs ni sna tshogs dang / /de bzhin khro bo'i rgyal po dang / /rig sngags rgyal po ⑤de bzhin du/ /dkyil 'khor lha dang me lha dang / /sbyin ⑥sreg rlung lha chu lha dang / /khro bo'i gzugs dang zhi ba dang / /lha dang klu dang ⑦ston pa dang / /gnod sbyin srin po'i gzugs dang ni/ /'byung po lha min dri za dang —/ /nam mkha' lding dang mi'am cidu/ /lto 'phye lachen po'i gzugs kun du//'jig rten mgon po ⑩mchog sbyin bstan/ /gshin rje dang ni lus ngan dang / /tshangs pa khyab 'jug dbang phyug che/ /gzhon nu dbang phyug lha dang ni(nye/ /dbang phyug chen po nyi ma dang / /zla gzugs rgyu skar tshes 'grangs lha'/ /'di dag rnam pa 0sna tshogs pa'i/ /gzugs su 'jig rten mgon pos bstan8/ /sems can rnams la phan 'tshal bas/ /gdul yiba'i don du grol ⑩ba'i lam /sems can rnams la bstan pas na/ /de bas som nyi nyid mi bgyi/ /mchog tu dang bar (nyebagyi ba lags/ /ci ltar mthun (7pa'i dgos pa rnams/ /ci ltar mthun pa 6)bzhin du 'grubazhunya/ /ci ltar mthun pa ( )ri mo'i gzugs/ /ci ltar mthun (3pa'i zhags pa sgrub( ste/ /gnas 'di 6)gang du 'os pa dang / /gang du sems ni dga' bar 'gyur / /goms 0pa du shegang gi shu)phyag rgya dang / /gang gi dkyil 'khor char dbye du )ba/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang mgon/ /kun du sgrol (nyeb 'dren pa'i gtso/ /don yod 'bras bu stsol ba'o(ste/ /don yod pa yi du)grub pa thobatso/ /don yod dgos pa thams cad dang / /grub pa'i chos kyi 'khor 6)lo ni/ /mchog nyid la yang reg par 'gyur/ /zhags pa dang 92—131

ri mo bsgrub pa'i cho ga'o// //de nas don yod pa'i las dang dgos pa sgrub pa ①thams cad kyi sbyin sreg gi cho ga bshad par bya (geste/ sdig pa thams cad mod la 'phrog pa/ sgrib pa thams cad 'jig (5)par bgyid pa/ dgra thams cad 'joms pa/ bgegs thams cad rnam par 'joms pa/ gdug ④pa thams cad bzlog ⑤pa'i mchog sdig pa thams cad 'jig par bgyid pa/ dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal rtsibacu drug las grol bar bgyid pa/ 'jigs pa mi bzad pa 6)brgyad rtag tu 'phrog pa/ mi mdza' ba (85rnams 995'joms pa/ pha rol gyi dpung ldog ⑩pa'i mchog /nad thams cad 'joms pa/ mod la 'thab pa dang / 'thab mo dang / rtsod pa dang /'gyed 37pa zhi bar bgyid pa/ mu ge'i dgon 7pa 'jig par bgyid pa/ yams kyi nad dang gnod pa 'joms pa/ lha'i bde ba 'dren par bgyid pa'i mchog de kho na nyid kyi sangs rgyas sgrub pa/ sangs rgyas kyi byang chub bla na med pa'i mchog thams cad sgrub par bgyid pa/ sems can thams cad kyi thun mong mchog sbyin shin tu rnyed 12par dka' ba lha rnams rtag tu mgu skobar 'gyur ba/ klu rnams ⑫dga' ba 'thob par la'agyur ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams rtag tu nyin mtshan du gzigs par som nyi ma mchis pa/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams dga' bar 'gyur ba/ dus kun du shin tu mnyam par bzhag pas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug mchog sbyin rtag tu mchis par som nyi ma mchis par ⑩rgyal po chen po bzhi 'khor dang bcas 18blon po dang bcas pa bsrung 9/)ba'i don du thams cad du 2 rirtag tu rjes su 'brang bar 'gyur lags so/ /de nas rig sngags 92—132

'chang shes rab dang ldan pas gtsang ma'i gnas su mchis nas sbyin sreg bgyi ste7ske/ gtsang ma yi ni sa phyogs sam/ /ca co ma mchis dben par ni/ /zhi ba dang ni rgyas pa dang / /drag shul spyod pa rnams bgyi'o/ /zhi ba sems can thams cad kyi/ /don du sdig pa thams cad 'joms/ /rgyas pa rgyas pa thob (snye'agyur te/ /thams cad phun sum tshogs par 'gyur/ /dgra dang log 'dren gdug ①pa dang / /gnod sbyin srin po gsang ba partsi/ /gdug sems can rnams bred ⑧pa dang / /skrag (6)par sdigs ⑦pa drag shul spyod/ /gsang sngags sgrub ⑧pa'i sbyin sreg stepo)/ /gsang sngags sgrub pa 7bla na med/ /'jig rten 'jig rten pha rol gyi/ /sbyin sreg gi ni las bgyi'o/ /me lha'i lha dang klu dag dang / /de bzhin rig pa 'dzin pa'ang dgug /khung brkos (1de la pad+ma'i tshul//pad+ma rtag tu bri bar bgyi/ /cho ga ci bzhin khung nang gi/ /pad+ma la ni ge sar bgyi8 / /gru bzhi'am ni zlum po ste/ /de lta bu tu)ni brko 8bar bgyi/ /legs par byugs shing shin tu gnagatso /shin tu sbas shing tshad la dbab/ /tshes grangs rgyu skar nyid dag dang / /shin tu bkra shis dag la bgyi/ /bkra shis phyag rgya chen po steyi/ /bzang pos gtor ma'i las bgyi'o/ /bdug 8pa me tog la sogs pa/ /bzang po dag ni 'khor bar dgod/ /thog mar me lha bkug nas ni / /de nas sbyin sreg las rnams bgyi/ /rig sngags 'chang ba tu)gtsang gyur pa / /legs bkrus gtsang tsho/ma'i gos bgos nu stanas/ /gsang sngags bzlas khu tshepa'i cho ga bgyi/ /de la mtshams du gekyang bcing bar bgyi/ /bdag bsrung nurtegatsug tor bcing ba dang / /gzhan bsrung ( stedakyil 'khor bcing ba dang / /de bzhin grogs bgyid bsrung (nyeb dang / /rgyun du arka'i 69shing sbar zhu 7te/ /dri yi 92—133

dbul bar bgyi/ /de bzhin 'bras bu spar ①bar 'bul②/ /de nas chab kyis bsang ba ①bgyi/ /ci ltar lha rnams rim bzhin du/ /nye reg dag kyang dbul bar bgyi/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis su/ /sbyin sreg dulas ni yang dag brtsam⑤ / /dri zhim shin tu dag pa dang / /blag ⑥sha u dum bā ra ⑦dang / /sna ma'i me tog tsam pa dang / /kur ni ka ra nyid dag dang / /pad+ma ut+pal ⑧zang shing dang / /de bzhin dri bda'i tsan+dan dang / /byang chub ljon shing shing dag dang —/ / de bzhin gzhan yang dri bda'i shing / /la'on te 'bras bu'i shing mang dang —/ /sha mi shi ba'i las lags pas/ /mchod yon de bzhin rtswa yidag ste/ /de dag gis ni me sbar yinas/ /sbyin sreg gi ni las rnams 8bgyi'o/ /'bras yos tsan+dan phye ma dang / /a ga 8ru dang du yiru skayi/ /kun du ru la sogs pa dang —/ /du ru skar tshubacas spri yika dang / /spang spos pri tu)yang ku yiblangs te/ /de dag lhan cig sbyar bsres ()shing / /mar ram mar sar lhan (7cig brdzi( nye/ /don yod rgyal po'i gsang sngags ni/ /brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas me la dbul/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi mdun du lan stong rtsa brgyad kyi sbyin sreg bgyi'o/ /lan stong rtsa brgyad tshang ba dang / nam phyed na me lha rang gi gzugs 'bar bar shin tu gnas pa lags nas zhunyephyogs bcur blta ( stezhing kun du brtags nas/ rig sngags 'chang la legs so zhes bgyi ba stsol dubar 'gyur te⑩ / rig so)sngags 'chang legs so legs so/ /bdag tshim par byas pas rig sngags 'chang khyod kyis sbyin sreg gi cho ga grub kyis ku snyemachog slongs shig dang /thams cad sbyin no/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis ci lta bu'i 'dod pa'i mchog rnams blang shu)bar bgyi ste/ ci ltar blangs pa ru )bzhin thams cad stsol 92—135

rgyas kyi zhing du gtogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi 0)dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa byang chub sems dpa'i du tshogs dang nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa la ③lha'i zhal zas ro brgya (shedang ldan pa'i mchog gis bstabs par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang / nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa de dag thams cad kyis rig sngags 'chang yon bdag de'i yon sbyong bar mdzad do/ /gang gi phyir yon sbyangs nas/ skal ba dang mthun (3)pa'i tshe 'di nyid dang / gzhan du dbang phyug chen po thob 6par 'gyur ro/ /grub pa chen po'i gser gyis 'byor bar 'gyur ro/ /mdzod dang bang mdzod (7)mang pos rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dgongs par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad blta she'atshal bar 'gyur ro/ /lha thams cad kyis de la srung ⑨ba dang / skyob mipa dang / sba ba bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /de nas rgyal po btsun mo'i 'khor dang dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi dang bcas pa dbang du bgyi bar 'tshal na/ rig sngags 'chang des legs par khrus bgyis te/ gtsang mas gos gtsang ma bgos nas/ 'o thug mar dang bsres pa 'dis lan brgya rtsa brgyad sbyin sreg bgyi'o/ /sgron shing dang arka'i shing gi yam sreg 67shing gis me sbar bar 1gebagyi'o/ /sbyin sreg lan stong rtsa brgyad tshang ba dang / rgyal po btsun mo'i 'khor dang dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi dang bcas pa bdag nyid dam/nor dbang du gyur nas mchis par 'gyur ro/ /nub gsum du bgyis na/ klu'i rgyal po thams cad gnas dang 'khor du bcas pa dbang du gyur nas mchis par 'gyur ro/ /nub lngar bgyis /lhan 'byung po dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po 92—144

dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye 0)chen po dang / mi ma lags pa thams cad dang / mi thams cad 'khor dang bcas par dbang du gyur nas mchis par la'agyur ro/ /nub bdun du bgyis na rig sngags (mi'adzin thams cad dbang du gyur nas mchis par 'gyur ro/ /nub thams cad du bgyis na/ brgya byin la sogs pa (gesum cu rtsa gsum ris ( kyi lha rnams dang / lha'i bu mo'i tshogs thams cad dang gtsang ma'i lha'i bu mo thams cad babs 76)nas dbang du 'gyur tsa)te/ ji srid 'tsho'i (8nyebar du bsnyen bkur bgyid cing (9)mchis par 'gyur ro/ /zla ba nya nas brtsams te mar gyi ngo'i tshes nyi shu gsum mam gnam stong gi bar du dus gsum du lan nyi shu rtsa yigacig sbyin sreg bgyis la/ arka'i ltonyeshing gi yam sreg shing gis me (ra nas gnam stong gis rdzogs pa dang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug rang gi gzugs kyis mdun lodu mchis nas/ rig sngags 'chang tunyelegs so zhes bgyi ba stsol ④bar 'gyur te'i/ rig sngags 'chang legs so legs so/ /nga mnyes par byas kyis / rig sngags 'chang smros shig dang / mchog sbyin te gang gnyer ba de thams cad sbyin no/ /gter smra ba'am/ nor bsgyur bar hu tshosmra ba'am / zhing smra ba'am/ nam mkha' la 'gro ba'am/ mi snang bar bya ba'am/gsang sngags smra ba'am/ cho ga zhib mo 'grub /snyepa de dag thams cad sbyin no/ /rgyal po nyid dam/ blon po nyid dam/ yul bdag nyid dam/ phyug pa /7nyid dam / grong rdal py-i )'thob pa'am/ gos 'thob pa'am/ ba lang dang / rta dang / ma he dang / rnga mo dang / lug 'thob pa'am/ nor 'thob pa'am/'bru 'thob pa de dag thams cad sbyin no/ /nam mkha' la 'gro ba'am/ mi 92—145

snang bar bya ba'am/ rdzu 'phrul 'thob pa'am/ ting nge 'dzin 'thob ①pa'am/gzungs 'thob pa'am/ phyag rgya ②dang dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhib mo bsgrub pa dang ④ro langs bslangs pa'am④/ rig 'dzin sgrub ⑤pa nyid dam/ ral gri'i rig 'dzin (6)nyid dam/ nam mkha'i (spyirig 'dzin nyid dam/ phug tu 'jug pa'am / dur (8)khrod du 'jug pa'am/ nags su 'jug pa'am/ ri la rgyu ba de dag thams cad sbyin no/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis stiji ltar yid la bsams shing smras pa nya )de dag thams cad stsol bar bgyid do/ /rig sngags 'chang la bstan pa tu)tsam gyi mod la dri med don yod lta ba zhes bgyi ba lus yongs su dag pa 'thob nyugepar 'gyur ro/ /tshe brjes tsonas 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur te/ pad+ma yize ba'i dbus nas rdzus 8te pad+ma las skyes nas yiskye ba'i skye ba dran par 'gyur ro/ /don yod zhags pa'i snying po byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis phyag bgyis pa rnam par grol ba'i dkyil 'khor phyag rgya dang / dkyil 'khor rim par dbye ⑩ba dang bcas pa/ cho ga zhib mo mtha' dag hunyedang bcas pa 'di rdzogs te/ byang chub kyi snying po la thug gi bar du kha ton du gnas par bgyi'o/ /de nas la du'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga bsgrub par 'tshal na / rig sngags rka/rte'achang des kha zas la ( )la du stong rtsa brgyad bgyis la/ de nas rig sngags 'chang gis don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po lan stong rtsa ( nyabargyad bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /de nas legs par khrus bgyis te/ gtsang mas gos gtsang ma bgo bar bgyi'o/ /de nas la du mar dang bsres ( nyete sbyin sreg bgyi'o/ /shin tu dri zhim po'i shing gi yam sreg ༷ steshing gis (9me sbar bar bgyi'o/ /stong rtsa brgyad tshang ba dang me'i dbus nas khye'u zhig byung nas snod lha'i la dus bkang 92—146

nas dbul bar bgyid do6)/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis yungs kur ②la lan bdun bzlas te/ khye'u de'i lag tu dugator ro/ /khye'u des rig sngags 'chang la smras pa/ rig sngags 'chang khyod ④ci zhig don du gnyer/ rig sngags 'chang gis ⑤'dod pa thams cad byin cig ces brjod par bgyi'o/ /des smras pa/ rig sngags 'chang snod kyi la du khyer cig dang / 'dis khyod kyi dgos pa dpag tu med pa 'grub 6)par 'gyur ro/ /'di ni khyod kyi bcud kyi ( )mchog yin no/ /rig sngags 'chang long (nyashig /'di ni khyod kyi grub pa'i mchog yin noyonye/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis snod gang ba de blangs te/khye'u la yang khyed kyis kho bo'i grogs gyis shig ⑩ces brjod par bgyi'o/ / khye'u yis (7smras pa/ dgos pa thams cad sgrub 7pa'i grogs bgyi'o/ /rig sngags 'chang gang gi tshe dgos pa byung ba de'i tshe/ gu gul dang / tsan+dan lhan cig bsres la mar dang yungs kur sbyar nas8/ don yod lcags kyus ④lan bdun bzlas te sbyin sreg tsobagyi'o/ /arka'i yishing gi me sbar ro/ /sbyin sreg bgyis pa tsam gyi med la/ bdag bkug pas mod la mchis nas dgos pa thams cad bsgrub par bgyi'o/ /las tunyethams cad bgyi'o/ /ji srid 'tsho'i tu)bar du bsnyen bkur bgyis mchis (7shing bkur nu )ster spyad par bgyi'o/ /bgegs du rnyedang log 'dren dang / 'byung po dang gnod sbyin dang / srin po thams cad bzlog 6)par bgyi'o/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis sal du de la reg par bgyis na/nam mkha' la 'phur (stenas/ rig sngags 'chang gi 'arigs thams cad zil gyis gnon par 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags 'chang thams cad kyi 'khor los sgyur tsobar 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags 'chang gi py-i na'akhor los sgyur 2nyeb sa ya phrag gnyis dang /92wa 147

bye ba phrag bdun gyis yongs su bskor ①bar 'gyur ro/ /tshe'i tshad ②lha'i bskal ⑧pa drug khrir 'gyur ro/ /skra cung zad 'khyil bar yang 'gyur ro/ /la du lhung bzed kyi nang du stsal te/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi mdun ④du bzhag nas/ don yod rgyal po'i khro bos dbang bskur ⑤te/ de nas dge sbyong dang / bram ze dang / rgyal rigs dang / rje'u rigs dang / dmangs rigs dang /56swā skyes pa dang / bud med dang / khye'u dang / bu mo thams cad la stsal bar bgyi'o47sku/ /longs spyod du stsal kyang bas par mi 'gyur gyi/slar zhing ri8)'phel bar 'gyur ro(9)/ /ji srid du lhung bzed na la du mchis pa de srid du 'phel bar 'gyur te / ji zhu〉srid du skye bo 'bum 'bum mang zhing phal che nyu bar stsal kyang / gtugs par mi 'gyur ro/ /la du la don yod pa'i tunyezhags pa'i snying po lan bdun bzlas brjod bgyis na/ de'i 'og tu gang du reg pa der tshayang gser bzang por 'gyur ro/ /la du la lan bdun bzlas brjod bgyis tem/ klu'i gnas su 'phangs na de'i tshe rgya mtsho chen po mthar gtugs ⑩pa'i klu'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad dbang du gyur nas mchis par 'gyur te/ sgo 1 na char mi sna 'bab pa1rte/ bsgo ba bzhin char 'bebs par bgyid do/ /ci bsgo ba bzhin bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /ha cang char ches na ( rtebasgo ba bzhin/ ha cang char chen po 'gums par bgyid do/ /rlung dang /grang 2speb dang / tsha ba dang / ser ba thams cad bsgo so ba tsam gyis gcod ⑫par bgyid do/ /phug gi sgor la du la lan bdun bzlas brjod bgyis nas/phug gi sgor bsnun na phug gi sgo thams cad 'bye bar 'gyur ro/ /'khrul soste'akhor dang gtan pa dang / sgo glegs gyethams cad dum bur bcag par 'gyur 92—148

rol/ /gnas na gnas pa thams cad phyir byung nas/ rig sngags 'chang gi mdun du mchis te/ bsgo ba bzhin du 6)bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /nags tshang tshing gi dbus su 'phangs na/ nags tshang tshing gi gnas kyi sgo thams cad phye nas sman gyi 0rdzas thams cad rang gi gzugs kyis mdun phyin mchis par 'gyur rol/ /la du la lan bdun bzlas brjod bgyis te/ dur khrod chen po'i dbus su 'phangs na 'byung po dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang bcas pa'i gnas kyi sgo thams cad 'bye (gebar 'gyur ro/ /gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / 'byung po thams cad sgren mor gyur na(ge/ thams cad dbang du mchis par 'gyur zhing / ji srid 'tsho'i 6)bar du bsgo ⑦ba bzhin mchis par 'gyur ro//rma ma byung ba'i mi ro la(8)/ dri chab kyis khrus bgyis la la du la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod bgyis te/ lag pa gnyis su la du po)stsal la/ gos dkar pos ro g.yogs nas/ khro bo'i rgyal po chab dang 7yungs kur turnyel lan bdun bzlas nas dbang bskur turten ci dris pa de dag thams cad smra bar 'gyur te/bde ba dang lo legs pa dang / lo nongs pa dang / nad dang / gnod pa dang / 'tshe ba dang / pha rol gyi dpung dang 3nye/ phas kyi dgra bo dang / mi mdza' yiba'i 'jigs pa dang / mi ngas dang / yams kyi nad de dag thams cad smra bar 'gyur ro/ /lha'i 'jig rten du skye ba'am/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing du skye ba smra bar 'gyur zhing 8/ dmyal bar skye ba smra bar 'gyur ro/ /tshe ring tsoba'am tshe thung ba smra bar 'gyur ro/ /dus ma lags pa'i 'chi ba smra bar 'gyur ro / /gter gyi gtam smra bar 'gyur te/ nor bsgyur ⑩ba'i gtam mamatsha/snye/zhing gi gtam mam(ste/ mig 'phrul gyi gtam smra bar 'gyur ro/ /cho ga zhib mo 92—149

'grub hu)pa dang / gsang sngags 'grub ②pa dang / phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor 'grub pa (7smra bar 'gyur ro/ /mig sman 'grub pa dang ril bu 'grub pa smra bar (ge'agyur ro/ /nam mkha' la mchi ba dang / mi gda' bar bgyi ba dang /ro langs bslang (5)ba dang / rigs yim dag pa dang / dgra chad ⑦pas bcad ⑧cing dbang du bgyi ba de dag thams cad smra bar 'gyur ro/ /sgyu thabs smra bar 'gyur ro/ /nyams pa smra bar 'gyur ro/ /'phel ba smra bar 'gyur ba nas bskal pa las 'das pa'i 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa'i ⑨dang / da ltar byung ba'i bar du smra bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis 0chab kyi tunyekhar stsal la la du blangs na ro 'gyel bar 'gyur ro/ /la du la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod bgyis nas/ rgyal po'i sgor tunyebasnun na/ rgyal po'i btsun mo ⑫'khor dang bcas pa bdag nyid dam/ nor dbang du gyur nas mchis par 'gyur ro/ /grong khyer gyi sgor bsnun na/ grong khyer na gnas pa'i skyes pa'am8/bud med dam8/ khye'u dang bu mo thams cad dbang du gyur nas mchis par 'gyur zhing / nor chen po 'du ba 'grub pa thob ⑩par 'gyur ro/ /mchod pa'i gnas chen por 'gyur ro/ /la du la lan bdun bzlas brjod bgyis te/dpal lha mo chen mo'i lag par stsal na/ dpal lha mo chen mo dbang du gyur nas/nor chen po stsol cing ji srid 'tsho'i bar du mchis par 'gyur ro/ /la du la lan brgya tsho/ tshom brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis nas/ khug ma'i nang du stsal te/ mchan khung du bsrel bar bgyis te/rte/ ci tsam du bsrel tu)ba de srid du mi gda' bar gyur nas/ gang du stsal ba der 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /gang na shing gcig pa'am( bye / 'bab chu gcig par la du la ( )khro bo'i rgyal po lan brgya rtsa brgyad 92wa 150

bzlas brjod bgyis te4)/ dbang bskur phyinas shing gi drung du brdegs lan/'dod dgur sgyur ④ba dbang du gyur nas mchis par 'gyur ro/ /ci ltar bsams ⑤pa'i 'dod pa thams cad nye bar mchis nas yongs su spyod pa dang /ji srid 'tsho'i yibar du mchis ⑦par 'gyur ro/ /la du la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig (nyabazlas brjod bgyis te/ ma mo'i gnas su nag po chen po'i spyi bo'i 6)gtsug tu bzhag la7/ khro bo'i rgyal po lan bdun bzlas (7te/ chab dang yungs kur 8gyis dbang bskur ba (nyebagyis na/ de nas sbyor ba mo thams cad dang /mkha' 'gro ma thams cad dbang du gyur nas mngag gzhug ④pa las thams cad bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /la du la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas te/ nag po chen po'i lte ba'i phyogs su bzhag na ma mo'i tshogs thams cad rang gi gzugs kyis yinyemadun du mchis nas/ mchog thams cad stsol bar 'gyur ro/ /las thams cad bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /la du la lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis nas / 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi lhung bzed kyi nang du stsal te/ khro bo'i rgyal pos tshudabang bskur bgyis na/ ji srid du lhung bzed na la du mchis pa de srid du phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi spyan sngar/ lha'i zhal zas ro sna tshogs kyi ro'i mchog dang ldan pa dag 'byung bar 'gyur zhing / nyan thos dang byang chub sems dpa'i lco snatshogs kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor chen po dang bcas pa tshim par bgyis par (2'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa de dag thams cad kyis 4)rig sngags 'chang de'i yon sbyong ba mdzad par 'gyur ro / /la du la lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis te/ khro bo'i rgyal po'i 92—151
