nar thob tsho)'gyur bar/ /the tsom ②du yang mi bgyi zhing / /yid gnyis nyid kyang ma lags so/ /gtsang mas gtsang ma'i gos dag dang / /legs par bkrus ①pas las sgrub rgyabo/ /sbyin sreg bla na med 'phel ba/ /'di ni rgya chen bsam mi khyab / /ka ran rtsa ba sdong bur bcas/ /'dab ma me tog 'bras bur bcas/ /arka'i shing dang blag sha'i shing (3/ / yam sreg (nyadag gis me sbar la/ /sa bon bdun po 'bras dang bcas/ /'bras yos 9)til dang yungs kur (snyedang / /zho dang sbrang rtsi 99)mar dang ni/ /yungs mar dag dang bsres ⑩pa yi/ /sbyin sreg (spestong rtsa brgyad tshang bgyi/ /khro bo'i rgyal po lan stong rtsa brgyad kyis dbang bskur hurteb tshang ba 1snyedang / de nas don yod lcags cikyu'i rig sngags kyi rgyal po lan 8brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas/ gu gul dang ske tshe'i mi'abras bu dang / mar du sbyar bas sbyin sreg 3 bgyi'o/ /dgos pa thams cad rdzogs pa dang / de'i tshe bza' ba dang / btung ba dang / gnas mal dang / stan dang / nad kyi rkyen sman dang / yo byad dang / nor dang / 'bru dang / mdzod rmo/shedang /bang ba 'phel bar hu/yang 'gyur ro/ /gos sna tshogs dang lhab lhub dang / rgyan dang / rgyan phreng zhu )dang / me tog dang / dri dang /rdu1 phreng ba dang / byug pa rnams lhun gyis grub pa du ge'abyung bar 'gyur ro/ /dbang phyug gi 'byor pa rgya sa chen po 'thob par 'gyur zhing ji srid 'tsho'i bar du mchis par 'gyur ro/ /de nas zla ba yar gyi ngo'i tshes brgyad la nyin zhag gcig tsho cinamachis nas mig la bskus 69te / don yod zhags pa'i snying po lan dgu bcu bzlas brjod bgyis la/ khro bo'i rgyal pos dbang bskur 35nas/ don yod zhags pa'i phyag rgyas ni phyag rgya bcings te/ de nas mig la mig sman gyis sa bskus na/ nam mkha' la rdzu 92wa 161

'phrul gyis mchi bar 6)'gyur ro/ /mig sman grub ②pa'i rig sngags 'chang thams cad kyi gtso bo rgyal po 'khor los sgyur bar ②'gyur ro/ /skra ༷cung zad yang (ge'akhyil par 6)'gyur ro/ / bskal pa 0khrir 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /mig sman 'dis ⑧mig la byugs na nyin par 5)lta ba bzhin du ⑩mtshan mo mthong bar 'gyur zhing mi gda' bar yang 'gyur ro/ /'byung po dang gnod sbyin dang / srin po'i gnas thams cad du zhugs na thams cad kyi dpon por 'gyur ro// //'phags pa don yod pa'i zhags pa'i cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po/ bam po bdun pa/ mig sman 'dis yonyemig la byugs nas ma mo'i gnas su zhugs na/lha gtso bo de dag mig mi 'dzums 8par lta bar bgyid tshul khro bo'i rgyal po lan cig bzlas par ④bgyi'o/ /de nas ma mo dang tsogatso bo'i lha 7thams cad mdun du mchis nas/ mchog thams cad stsol bar 'gyur ro/ /ji srid 'tsho'i ⑩bar du las thams cad sgrub 'o par bgyid pas (snyamachis par 'gyur ro/ /ma mo'i tshogs thams cad kyis yongs su bkur zhing ( )snying du sdug par 'gyur ro/ /rtag par rgyun du bsrung zhunyab dang / bskyab pa dang / sba ba'i phyir gnas shing rjes su 'brang bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas gi ( )wang sgrub pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga brjod par bgyi ste/ don yod rgyal po grub pa yis/ /rig sngags 'chang so)ba bde myong zhing / /lha dang lha min mchod pa dang / /sgrub pa'i don kun 'grub pa dang / /dbang du gyur (nyepa dam pa dang / /mkha' la mchi ba'i dam pa dang / /mi snang shin tu rnyed sosnyedaka' dang / /mod la phug tu 'jug pa dang / /nags kyi nang du 'jug pa dang / /ri sul dag tu 'jug pa dang / /thang dag la ni rgyu ba dang / /klu gnas mtshor ni 'jug pa dang / /de bzhin chu klung cher bsgral tsodang / /rdzu 92—162

'phrul grub dang skyes pa dang / /de bzhin 'jigs dang yo)sgrib kun dang / /nad kun zhi bar bgyid pa nyid/ /sdig pa thams cad nyams par bgyid/ /g.yul ngor g.yul las rgyal bgyid de/ /rtag tu dgra kun brlag par bgyid/ /gdon rigs kun kyang tshar gcod cing / /rigs (mirnams thams cad zlog ②par bgyid/ /sngon gyi sgrib pa 'jig bgyid cing / /sdig pa thams cad nyams par bgyid/ /dbang phyug stsol cing skal ba stsol/ /nor dang 'bru rnams 'phel bar bgyid/ /'thab pa 'thab mo rtsod pa dang / /'gyed ④pa rab tu zhi bar bgyid/ /bcing ba dang ni shing sgrog dang / /khong sgril lcags sgrog phye mar rlog6) /rgyal po gdug ⑥pa khros pa yis/ /gsad ⑦par 'os pa sel bar bgyid / /da lta (kye'adi la rten po)pa na7/ /mi bdag bu sdug bzhin smra zhing / /mi bde kun las grol bar 'gyur/ /'di ni kun du sdug pa dang / /gnas kun mchis par mchod par 'os/ /lus can shin tu snying du 67sdug /rgyal po btsun mo 'khor bcas pa'i/ /rtag tu snang 1)chen dag tu 'gyur/ /dge sbyong bram ze nyid dang ni/ /rgyal rigs rje'u rigs dmangs 8rigs dang / /bud med kun dang de bzhin du/ /skyes pa khye'u dang 8bu mo yi/ /rtag tu gnang chen dag tu 'gyur / /gi 8wang bla na med pa po/ /'di la gang dag rtag brten yin/ /'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug ste/ /mchog sbyin rtag tu mchod pa tu)bgyid/ /tshangs pa khyab 'jug dbang phyug che(nye/ /nyin dang mtshan du bsrung 7ba dang / /rtag tu mchog stsol 4)phyir mchis so/ /gzhan yang lha ni mang po dang / / klu yi ( rmergyal po mthu chen dang / /'byung po gnod sbyin srin po dang / /grul bum mi min lto 'phye che/ /dri za lha min nyid dag dang / /nam mkha' lding dbang mthu 92—163

chen te0)/ /de dag thams cad bsrung ②ba yi/ /ched du nyin chadang mtshan dag tu / /rang dbang nyid kyis gnas par 'gyur/ /gi wang grub pa dam pa po/ /de ltar stobs budang ldan pa lags/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang ba yis/ /gtsang gyur legs par khrus bgyis nas/ /gtsang ma yi ni gos bgos te⑤/ /gi wang legs par bsgrubs nas su/ /dmar po chen po nyid dag dang / /gur gum dag dang mnyam sbyar la/ /zangs kyi snod du bkang yinas su/ /don yod zhags pa'i gzugs mdun du/ /stong rtsa brgyad ni tshang bzlas nas/ /rgya dar gyis ni kha 'gum (7)mo/ /de nas seng ldeng gi shing dang / arka'i shing gi yam (3)shing gis 9)me sbar la/ 'bras yos dang ⑩/ yungs kur tumedang / gu gul dang / 'bras dang / til dang bsres la/ zho dang sbrang rtsi mar du bsres te/lan stong rtsa lho brgyad sbyin sreg /rtebagyi'o/ /lan stong rtsa brgyad tshang ba dang / de nas me mizhi zhing me mdag 'phra mo yang zhi ba dang thal ba blangs te/ snod kyi nang du stsal nas de nas slar yang lan brgya 7rtsa brgyad bzlas la/ khro bo'i rgyal pos dbang bskur nya mote/ phyag rgya'i phyag rgyas kyang dbang bskur 8ro/ /de nas dpral ba'i dbus su thig le bgyis na 17nam mkha' la 'phur 6 )nas/ rig sngags 'chang chen po'i rgyal po 'khor los sgyur zhunyabar 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags 'chang thams cad kyi dpon por 'gyur 32zhing / skra du )cung zad 'khyil par yang 'gyur ro / /lo dgu khri dgu stong du 'tsho bar 'gyur zhing gnas kyi sgo thams cad rtag tu 'byed par 'gyur ro/ /dpral ba la thig le bgyis (snyen mi gda' bar gyur nas/gnas thams cad du zhugs na gnas thams cad kyi bdag por 'gyur zhing /'byung po dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po'i gnas kyi sgo thams cad 'byed 92wa 164

par 'gyur ro/ /'byung po dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po mthu dang bcas 0tshopa thams cad kyis yongs su bskor (snyenas mchis par 'gyur ro/ /ji srid 'tsho'i ③bar du bsgo ba bzhin bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /mig la bskus ④na ci ltar nyin par bzhin du mtshan mo snang zhing thams cad du gter mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /sa'i phug dang thang gi sgo phye ba mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /thang gi gnas su zhugs nas / thang gi dgos pa thams cad bgyi ⑤ste/ slar yang mchi bar 'gyur ro/ /chu klung chen po'i nang du zhugs na/ khyim dang gzhal med khang ci lta ba bzhin du mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /rin po che thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i gzhal med khang mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /chab la gnas pa gang lags pa de dag thams cad (6)dbang du gyur nas mchis par 'gyur ro/ /klu'i mtsho dang gnas su ci ltar rang gi khyim bzhin du 'jug cing 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /lus mtha' dag byugs te g.yul ngor/ g.yul 'gyed pa'i nang du zhugs na ya lad dang / go cha bgos pa bzhin du mthong nas thams cad las rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /khar bsrel te rgyal po'i pho brang du zhugs pa dzin btsun mo 'khor dang bcas pa dbang du gyur nas mchis par 'gyur ro/ /gang la tshig smras pa de dag thams cad bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /gang la blangs na (9de dag thams cad ster bar (17'gyur ro/ /gang la bsgo yib de dag 17thams cad bsgo the ba bzhin bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /khar 'chos 6nyenas/ gang dang gang du mchis pa de dang der skyes pa dang / bud med dang ske/ khye'u dang /8 bu mo thams cad bdag nyid dang 8nor dbang du gyur nas mchis par 'gyur ro/ /lag pa g.yas pa la 8byugs na su 3)reg pa de dbang du 'gyur ro/ /nor dang / 'bru 38dang / dbyig dang / bran nyunyepho 92—165

dang / bran mo dang / las bgyis pa dang / zho shas ①'tsho ba dang / mngag gzhug ②pa rnams dbang du gyur nas/ bsgo ba bzhin mchis par 'gyur ro/ /mdzub ①mo g.yas pa la bskus nas ④ser ba dang sprin dang / 'brug gi dus su sprin la mngon sum du bstan te bsdigs na grang ba dang rlung dang ser ba rnams duzhi bar 'gyur ro/ /dpag tshad gcig kho ra khor kyiyug tu zil gyis gnon ⑦par 'gyur ro/ /char ha cang 6)ches na lag pa g.yas pa sprin la mngon sum du bstan pas ha cang 6)char ches pa yigacod par 'gyur ro/ /char mi 'bab pa'i dus su lag pa g.yas pa'i lag mthil la byugs nas klu gnas pa'i mtsho'i chu la thal mo lan gsum brdabs na/ de'i mod la klu'i (7rgyal pos char 8gyi rgyun chen po gtong bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te mod la char pa tunyemi 'bebs tson de'i tshe lan lnga bdebs tshupa dang / klu de dag thams cad kyis char gyi rgyun gtong bar 'gyur ro / /gang gi tshe char pa mi 'bebs tshupa de'i tshe/ klu thams cad la klad ⑩pa'i nad 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te lan bdun bsnun na klu'i rgyal po thams cad la tshul ma yin pa'i sdug bsngal (nya'abyung bar 'gyur ro/ /klu'i rgyal po thams cad kyi rigs (6phung bar bgyis par 'gyur ro/ /gdon gyis zin pa thams cad kyi mig la bskus zhu )na/ bskus (7pa tsam gyi mod la gdon brgyad 4)khri bzhi stong rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /rims kyis thebs pa rnams kyi dpral ba la thig le bgyis na/ rims zhag gcig pa'am(nye/ nyin gnyis pa'am/ nyin gsum nga/'am/ nyin bzhi pa'i rims thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /nad kyis zin pa rnams la khrus bgyis na mod la nad thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /sha bkra dang / mdze dang / rkang shu dang / shu ba dang / g.yan pa 9 stedang /92—166

'brum bu rnams las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /lba 0)ba dang / lhog pa dang /mtshan bar rdol ②ba dang / shu ba mched pa dang / 'brum bu phra mo mched pa la byugs pa tsam gyis thar bar 'gyur ro/ /gdug ①pas zin pa thams cad la byugs pa tsam gyis mi gdug par 'gyur ro/ /dug gis myos par bgyis ④pa thams cad la 'tshal ba tsam gyi mod la (nyathar bar 'gyur ro/ /lto na ba dang /skran dang / dmu yichu dang / mchin pa na ba dang / rtsib (7logs na ba dang / snying na ba dang /du chu so na ba dang / gzhang nad dang / tshad pa dang /gcin sri ba dang / gsud pa dang yoste/ ma zhu ba dang / rtug skams ⑩la sros na 'tshal ⑩ba tsam gyi mod la zhi bar 'gyur ro6)/ /phyis lan 'ga' yang gnod par 8bgyid par mi 'gyur ro/ /mtshog stimar gi wang gi ril bu 'bagyis te/phug gi sgo dang nye bar mchis nas lag ⑩pa g.yas pa la 0byugs te/ mgo la thal mo brdabs na/ phug gi sgo rnams 'bye bar (she'agyur ro/ /bag tsha ba ma mchis par 'jug ste/ slar cung zad kyang bgegs bgyid par mi 'gyur ro/ /gnas de na gnas pa gang lags pa de dag thams cad dbang du gyur nas mdun na mchis par 'gyur ro/ /dgos pa sgrub tu)pa chen po thams cad 'grub shu )par 'gyur ro/ /rkang pa gnyis la byugs te/ me 'bar ba'i nang du zhugs na me lha rang gi gzugs kyis dumadun na hunyemachis nas lag pa nas bzung ste()/ rig sngags 'chang la rig sngags 'chang ba dag gi gzhal med khang gi gnas su zhugs shig /rig sngags 'chang gis bsgo ༷ steb thams cad bsgrub par bgyi'o zhes smra ba na / de'i tshe rig sngags 'chang gis bgyi ba ci mchis pa de bsgo bar bgyi ste/thams cad bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /dpung pa gnyis la byugs na/ glang po che 92—167

bdun gyi stobs dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /brla gnyis la byugs na tshugs pa ma mchis pa'i gyad du 'gyur ro/ /byin pa gnyis la byugs na 'bab chu chen po'i pha (1)rol tu rgal bar 'gyur ro/ /mgrin ②pa la byugs nas nags khung du zhugs na / nags khung gi gnas ji kyi sgo thams cad bye nas sman gyi rdzas thams cad rang gi gzugs kyis mdun na mchis par 'gyur ro(pe/ /ci 'tshal ba de blang ⑤bar bgyi'o/ /gi wang gi ril bu ('chibagyis te khar bsrel (7nas ri sul dang sman gshong du zhugs nas ri skad drag po lan gsum gdon par bgyi ste/ ri sul dang sman gshong gi ri9riganas gsang ba'i sgo gang dag lags ⑩pa 'bye 3)bar 'gyur zhing /de na /2gnas pa gang lags pa de dag thams cad rang rang yo gi gzugs kyis mdun na mchis par 'gyur zhing 6/ las thams cad bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /de nas rtswa 15dang shing gel pa dang / nags tshang tshing gi sman gyi rdzas gang lags pa dag rang gi gzugs kyis ⑩mdun na mchis par 'gyur zhing / gang dag gi bcud kyi mchog de dag 'dzag la/ bcud srung 6 1ba de dag kyang rang gi gzugs kyis 18mdun na mchis nas thams cad dbang du 'gyur ro/ /ci ltar 'tshal ba bag tsha ba ma mchis par dgos pa thams cad bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /snying gar (smuthig le bgyis nas snying la cung zad ci bsams ru tshopa dang / yid la bsams shing 2nyabarnag pa'i dgos pa de dag thams cad mod la 'grub nurtepar 'gyur ro/ /lto la thig le bgyis na na kha zas dang btung ( 〉ba'i ston mo 'dod dgu 8gyethams cad thob par 'gyur te/ phun sum tshogs pa thams cad lhun gyis 'grub par 'gyur ro / /rtsib logs gnyis la byugs na/ ji ni'ultar bsams shing ( rtedon du gnyer ba'i gos rnams thob sa par 'gyur ro/ /sgal tshigs la byugs na ji ri 7ltar yid la 92wa 168

bsams 0)pa'i mal dang / stan thob (27par 'gyur ro/ /rna ba la byugs sam/gnad dang gnad thams cad kyi gnas su byugs na/ ji (1)ltar bsams snyipa'i rgyan dang lhab lhub thob (snyepar 'gyur ro/ / mjug do 6)la byugs na/ rta'i bzhin pa thob ⑦par 'gyur ro/ /nyin gcig (kyebazhin nang par tshig gzhan mi smra bar gi wang gi ril bu 6)re re la don yod rgyal po'i snying po bzlas nas 'tshal te/nyi ma dang po la tshigs su bcad pa stong bklags na 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /nyin 3 skugacig bzhin nyis 'gyur du bgyis nas bklags natsho/ste/ 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /zhag bdun gyis thos tu)pa mang por 'gyur ro/ /zhag bcu bzhi 7/stebagyis na mi'am ci yimo lta bu'i sgra dbyangs su 'gyur ro/ /lan 8nyi shu rtsa gcig tu bgyis na thos pa bsags pa'i rgya mtsho chen por 'gyur ro/ /ka la ping ku'i dbyangs ltar mnyen ⑩zhing snyan la rna ba'i 1 7dbyangs su 'gyur ro/ /bu'i ched du mar dang lhan cig stsal 1nyen bya rog lta bu dang / mo sham hu7rnams kyis kyang bu rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /btson ni snarar stsal ba dang / shing sgrog dang / lcags sgrog dang /gtan pa dang / khong sgril la byugs na byugs pa tsam gyi mod la dum bu dum bur 'chag par 'gyur ro/ /'thor bar 'gyur ro/ /tshes brgyad dam bcu bzhi'am tshes bcwa ( —1lnga la don yod rgyal po'i snying po lan bdun bzlas la khro bo'i rgyal pos rang la dbang bskur nas gi ( rtewang gi ril bu 3gedang spos chab bsres pas 3gekhras bgyi'o / /khrus bgyis pa tsam gyi mod la sdig pa thams cad dang / sngon gyi sgrib pa thams cad rnam par 'jig par 'gyur ro/ /nub gsum du khrus bgyis na gsang sngags dang / phyag rgya dang / sgrub pa dang / grub pa'i mchog thams cad thob du snyepar 'gyur ro/ /phas kyi rgol ba dang / mi mdza' 35ba dang /92wa 169

gdug pa dang / sdig pa thams cad kyis mi tshugs par 'gyur ro/ /lan 'ga' yang 0)thams cad kyi ②thams cad du 'jigs pa mi 'byung zhing yongs su thar bar 'gyur ro/ /phyis lan 'ga' yang sdig pa'i dri mas gos par mi 'gyur ro / /gi (0wang gi ril bu (getil mar dang bsres te kha gdong la byugs nas ⑤rgyal po'i mdun du mchis na (7bu bzhin du pang du 'khyud ⑦nas dga' ba chen po 'thob (9pa dang / rgyal po khro bo'i 'jigs pa thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /lus thog thag tu byugs na gsad 6)par 'os pa'i lus la yang mtshon gyis phog par mi 'gyur te/ dum bu dum bur 'chag ⑩par 'gyur ro/ /mda' 'phangs na lus la 'bab ḍo/)par mi 'gyur zhing gzhu 'chag par 'gyur ro/ /gi 8wang gi ril bu mgul nyugedu btags nas 'brog dgon pa dang ri dang / nags tshang tshing bgrod dka' tsobar zhugs na chom po dang / g.yon 8can dang / rkun po dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / mi dang mi ma lags ⑩pa dang / gcan gzan nya tshogadug pa dang / sbrul gdug pa dang / dug gi (nye'ajigs pa thams cad 'byung bar mi 'gyur te/ mi gda' bar 'gyur ro/ /dpung pa g.yas pa la btags na thams cad du pha rol las rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /thams cad du mchod gnas chen por yang 'gyur ro/ /thams cad du mthu dang brtson 'grus chen po rdzi ba med pas pha rol zil gyis gnon par 'gyur ro/ /dpung pa g.yon pa la btags na skyes pa dang bud med dang / khye'u dang / bu mo thams cad kyi gnang chen du 'gyur te/ thams cad lta 'tshal bar 'gyur ro/ /mchod pa'i 'os chen por 'gyur ro/ /dgos pa mang po 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /byin pa g.yas pa la btags na dub pa ma mchis par dpag tshad stong du mchis 92—170

par 'gyur ro/ /gi nyuwang gi ril bu (kyekhar bsrel la chalag pa g.yas pas yungs kur gyis ④don yod lcags kyu ⑤bzlas nas drangs te tshig gzhan mi smra bar gnas mthon yipor 'dzegs te phyogs gang du bsams ⑦pa'i skyes pa dang /bud med dang / khye'u dang / bu mo mchis pa'i phyogs der yungs kur (gegyis gtor na mod la bkug par 'gyur te mchis par 'gyur ro/ /gal te dpag tshad brgya tsam na gnas pa zhig na yang 6)gdon mi 'tshal bar de zhag gsum gyis mchi ⑩bar 'gyur te yid gnyis mi bgyi'o/ /lag pa g.yas pa'am lag pa g.yon pa la gi (mewang gi ril bu 8btags na gang du reg par nor dang / 'bru dang /dbyig dang / nor bu yoshedang / mu tig dang / shang ka shi la dang / byi 8ru dang / sa le sbram dang / dngul dang / gos dang / lhab lhub de dag thams cad bkug nas mchis par 8'gyur te/ ci 'tshal ba de mchi bar 'gyur ro/ /bya 8tshang du zhugs nas tshang mang 7gi sgor thal mo brdabs na 'tshed pa dang 'tshed pa'i kha zas de dag (nyethams cad bkug nas mchis par 'gyur te/ ci 37'tshal ba de mchis par du )'gyur ro/ /spos 'tshong gi du nyetshong khang du mchis na tshong khang gi yo byad ( nyathams cad mchi bar 'gyur ro/ /chang 'tshong gi sgor thal mo brdabs na chang gi bum pa thams cad mchi bar 'gyur ro/ /bang ( steba'i sgor (stethal mo brdabs na 'bru thams cad bkug par 'gyur ro/ /bcud 'byin pa'i khyim du zhugs nas 'khrul 'khor la reg k+to gepar bgyid na bu ram gyi khu ba dang /sha kha ra'i glegs bu thams cad mchi bar 'gyur ro/ /gang du 'tshal ba der mngags par 'gyur ro/ /grong khyer gyi sgor mun tshab mtshub na thal mo brdabs na grong khyer na gnas pa thams cad gnyid bskyogs c-i tshopar 'gyur ro/ /dgra bo'i 92—171

sgor btab na bskrad par 'gyur ro/ /mtshon cha mkhan gyi khyim du 'phangs na mtshon cha dang / go cha rnams rengs pa dang / rmugs par bgyis par 'gyur ro / /rgyal po'i sgor btab 3)na phas kyi rgol (geb dang / mi mdza' ba sridang /sems can gdug zhi)pa thams cad bcings pa dang / rengs pa dang / rmugs par bgyis par 'gyur ro/ /dung la byugs nas gnas mthon por ⑤dus na sgra gang du grag (6)pa de dag tu 'thab pa dang / 'thab ⑦mo dang / rtsod pa dang /'gyed pa dang / byad dang / dug sbyar ma dang / dug dang / nad las yongs su thar bar 'gyur ro/ /grong khyer gyi sgor bus na yams kyi nad dang /gnod pa dang / mi ngas rinyathams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /phyugs lhas ⑨su bus na 'o ma thams cad phrogs 7par 'gyur ro/ /gang du 'tshal ba der mchi bar 'gyur ro/ /ra lug hu7gi lhas su bus na ra lug gi 'o ma srogs 8par 'gyur te / gar nyu)'tshal ba der mchi bar 'gyur ro/ /skye bo'i tshogs chen po'i dbus su bus na thams cad sgren por migyur nas gos thams cad bkug par 'gyur ro/ /rdza rnga la byugs te khyams mthon po'i steng du brdungs na grang tsob dang / rlung dang / ser ba thams cad bcings pa dang gshig 8par 'gyur te/ tshugs par mi 'gyur ro/ /dpag tshad brgya 7kho ra khor yug tu ser ba bkag par 'gyur ro/ /grong khyer ram/ yul 'khor mtha' dag tu bus na nad dang /yams kyi nad dang / gnod pa dang / 'tshe ba thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /'thab pa dang / 'thab mo dang / rtsod pa dang / 'gyed pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /mi ngas dang / mu ge'i 'jigs pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang dgos pa rnam pa sna tshogs brgya stong dag bgyid 92—172

par 'gyur te/ thams cad la sbyar bar bgyi'o/ /de nas sems can thams cad dang thun mong ba zhi ba dang / rgyas pa nad thams cad zhi bar bgyid cing sdig pa thams cad 'jig par bgyid pa/ yams kyi nad dang / gnod pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar bgyid pa/ mu 61ge'i dgon pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar bgyid pa/ 'byung po dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / gdon dang —/ brjed (mibyed thams cad brlag par bgyid pa brjod par bgyid pa'o /ri/ /rig sngags 'chang gtsang mar gyur pas legs par khrus bgyis te/ spos dri zhim pos lus byugs la/ gos gtsang ma bgos la spos dri zhim pos bsgos (4)nas byams pa'i sems la mnyam par gzhag cing / sems can thams cad la lhag par brtse ba dang / snying rje chen pos snying (5)gdungs pas sbyin sreg gi las 'di bgyi ⑥ste/ arka'i shing dang / sha mi'i 3shing dang / shing 'o ma can nam/ji ltar yang byang chub kyi shing ste/ de dag gi yam sreg 85shing gis me sbar la/'bras yos dang / yungs kur 9tshodang / pad+ma dang / pad+ma'i ldum bu dang /'dab tshim dang / zho dang / sbrang rtsi /lhadang / mar du dzinabasres pas 32sbyin sreg bgyi'o / /don yod zhags pa'i snying po stong rtsa brgyad bzlas nas/ de nas don yod zhags pa khro bo'i rgyal pos dbang bskur tenya sna/ don yod zhags pa'i phyag rgyas 8phyag rgya lan brgya 9rtsa brgyad bcing ngo / /de nas sbyin sreg gi dgos pa rnams mthar phyin pa'i med kho nar dpag tshad gcig khor yug tu yams kyi nad dang ⑩/ gnod pa dang / 'tshe ba dang / nad dang / mu ge'i dgon pa mi bzad ()pa dang / rang gi dpung dang / gzhan gyi dpung gi 'jigs pa dang /phas kyi rgol ba dang / mi mdza' ba'i /jigs pa thams cad dang / chom po 92—173

dang ske/ g.yon can dang / rkun po 6)dang / gcan gzan gdug ②pa can ①dang / sbrul dang / dug mi bzad pa dang /④ gdug ⑤pa dang bcas pa'i srog chags kyi 'jigs pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /mi tshugs par 'gyur ro/ /dpag tshad brgyar kho ra 0khor yug tu rims mi 'byung ste/ gnod pas ma lags/ nad kyis ma lags te/ gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / 'byung po dang / gdon ⑦rnams kyis mi tshugs te/ rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /'thab pa dang / 'thab dumo dang / rtsod pa dang / 'gyed pa dang / nang 'khrug dang / 'khrug pa dang / skrod 6)pa dang / mdangs gcod pa dang /'ching ba dang / sdig ⑩pa rnams kyis mi tshugs te/ rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /sems can thams cad bde bar 'gyur ro/ /shin tu lo legs shing mdangs dga' la skye bo dang / mi mang pos rab tu gang zhing (7me tog dang / 'bras bu phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ro/ /nor dang / 'bru dang / lo tog rab tu mang po 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /shin tu ro dang ldan pa dang / shin tu smin pa dang yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rtswa 8dang / shing gel pa dang / sman dang / nags tshang tshing dang / myu gu dang / rtsa 7ba dang / 'bras bu bzang po yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /phyir zhing ji srid 'tsho'i bar du yul de na ④yid du mi mchi ba'i reg skipa myong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /yul de na dge sbyong ⑩dang —/ bram ze dang / rgyal rigs dang / rje'u rigs dang / dmangs tīrigs dang / skyes pa dang / bud med dang / khye'u dang / bu mo rnams rtag tu nad ma tsho mchis par 'gyur ro/ /bde bar 'tsho 6)ba dang / yid la dga' zhing mgu bar 'gyur ro/ /byams pa dang / snying rje'i sems kyis gnas par 92—174

'gyur ro/ /lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po de dag thams cad kyang legs par bsrung 6)ba'i phyir rtag tu bsrung ②ba dang / bskyab (mipa dang / sba ba'i phyir dpag tshad brgya (gekho ra khor yug tu bsrung (gyeb dang /yongs su bskyang ba (9)dang / zhi ba dang / bde legs su bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po bzhi yang dpung dang bcas te/ yongs su skyong ba dang / srung rtsib dang —/ skyob pa dang / sbed pa (gyibagyid par 'gyur ro/ /gdug pa thams cad bzlog ⑨pa dang / srung 7ba dang / yongs su skyong bar 'gyur ro/ /dbang phyug dang / dbang phyug chen po'i lha'i bu rnams rtag par rgyun du srung (7ba dang /skyob pa dang / sbed pa tshubagyid par 'gyur ro/ /lha'i dbang po brgya byin 7sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha'i bu 'khor dang / tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang /dbang phyug chen po dang / lha'i tshogs kyi 'khor thams cad kyis yul de legs par bsrungs par yi'agyur ro/ /gzi byin stsol bar 'gyur ro/ /dpag tshad gcig kho ra khor yug tu sems can thams cad yongs su srung 9/nyeb dang /yongs su skyong bar 'gyur ro/ /dge sbyong yidang / bram ze dang / rgyal rigs dang —/ rje'u rigs dang / dmangs rigs dang / skyes pa dang / bud med dang / khye'u dang / bu mo thams cad la srung sna thob dang / skyob pa /shedang /sbed pa bgyis hu)par 'gyur ro/ /zhi ba'i las 'di'i mthus sems can thams cad sdig pa dang / sgrib pa thams cad las rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis yul de la dgongs par 'gyur ro52 ༷/ /phyogs bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' ( 〉thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa'i 92—175

tshogs thams cad yang dag par 'du bar hu)'gyur ro/ /sems can thams cad la dbugs 'byin par 42༄ston par 'tshal bar 'gyur ro/ /sems can thams cad yongs su bsrung (5)ba'i don du nyi ma dang / zla ba rgyu skar gyi tshogs dang bcas pa legs par 'byor bar 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug rtag par rgyun du skyes pa dang / bud med dang / khye'u dang / bu mo thams cad la zhebu gcig pa bzhin du dbugs 'byin par 'gyur ro/ /yongs su bsrung (5)ba dang / yid kyis 55)brnag pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bgyid par 'gyur te/ yang nas yang du blta ( bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas des zhunyesbyin sreg gi (97thal ba dang / dri chu skyo ma bgyis te phyogs bzhi kun tu dbang bskur khon mtshams chen po bcad par (1bgyis par 'gyur ro/ /nad kyis zin pa thams cad kyi nad thams cad nye bar zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /rims thams cad la thig le bgyis na rims thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /dri chab dang thal bas khrus bgyis na thams cad kyi sgrib pa dang / sdig pa thams cad rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ / btson ra na nyurnyemachis pa'am/ phyag sbal na mchis pa'i gos la bskus /lhan ral bar 'gyur ro/ /gdug pas zin pa dang / dug gis myos pa thams cad la bskus tshan gdug par mi 'gyur ro/ /me dgug pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga rdzogs so'i// //de nas pad+ma rgya tshachen po'i dkyil 'khor 'dir pad+ma'i rigs 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sga don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po rnam par grol ba'i dkyil 'khor cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po chen po brjod par bgyi ste7/ 'di ni ma 92—176

bsgrubs 6)par las brgya stong bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /tshes grangs rgyu skar bzang po dang / /shin tu bkra shis mchog dge la/ /legs par khrus bgyi ②gos gtsang bgo①/ /byams pa'i sems la mnyam par bzhag /sems can kun la brtse ④ba dang / /snying rje dam pas brgyan 55)pa dang / /don yod zhags pa'i (nyarig sngags che/ /grub pa bla med cho ga'i rgyal/ /bklags pas las rnams thams cad dag /'grub ( par bgyid de som nyi med/ /'jig rten bla ma'i snying po dag /de bzhin gang dag (8)rtag brjod na/ /lus can rtag tu mchog sbyin gyi6)/ /phyag na pad+ma rtag tu 'gyur/ /ci ltar gang gā'i bye misnyed kyi/ /sangs rgyas bye ba phrag stong la/ /bsod nams phung po khri phrag bskyed47/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba sogs 1nyepa dang / /sangs rgyas bya ba bgyid par 'gyur/ /smyung nya ba bgyis nas bzlas brjod gcig /mkhas pa'i mis 7ni brjod bgyid 7pa/ /dge slong pha dang dge slong ma/ /dge bsnyen pho mos 7de bzhin du/ /bde ba can du myur du mchis 7/ /sdug bsngal mi bzad 1)myong 'gyur ba'i/ /nyon mongs pa las thar bar 'gyur/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas byang chub 1)dag /mthong bar 'gyur 6 )te som nyi med/ /de nas don yod pa'i ( nyezhags pa'i snying po'i rmo rtecho ga ci lta ba bzhin du bzlas brjod kyi cho ga brjod par bgyi ste/ bzlas brjod kyi ni las bgyis naX nye/ /rig sngags 'chang la 7 )de nyid 'grub/ /don yod zhags pa'i gzugs brnyan gyi( snye/ /mdun du lci ba'i 7 stodakyil 'khor bgyi/ /gru bzhi kho ra khor yug tu/ /tshon ( 7rtsi dkar po zhib mo yis/ /gru bzhi lham (snyepar thig gdab bo/ /ngos bzhi rnams su sgo bzhi dag /dbus nas ngos bzhir gshis nirtesu dbab/ /tsan+dan dkar pos bri ba ni/ /dkyil 'khor mchog la pad+ma dang / /92—177

'dab brgya hu)gur gum gyis gtor zhing ②/ /pad+ma'i ze ba'i dkyil dag tu/ /ma zhom pa yi bum pa ni②/ /spos chab kyis ni bkang ba yibya/ /yungs kur 0ldan pa gzhag par bgyi/ /a ga stiru yi bdug pa dbul/ /bum pa gang bar dgod ⑦par bgyi/ /me tog sna tshogs brgyan ⑧par bgyi/ /mchod yon snod kyang bzhi ⑨gzhag go/ /rig sngags 'chang ba gtsang gyur pas0/ /gtsang ma'i gos ni bgo bar bgyi/ /legs bkrus rnam par dag pa dang / /gso sbyong dag tunyeni blangs pa dang / /dkar gsum zas ni 'tshal nas su/ /dus gsum du ni khrus bgyi'o//dus gsum bzlas brjod bgyi ba 6)ni/ /don yod zhags pa'i snying po dag /dus gsum du yang brgya rtsa brgyad/ /'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi/ /mngon sum skyil mo krung yinyebacas te/ /bzlas brjod phyag rgya bcings nas su/ /bgrang phreng yidag ni blang bar bgyi/ /mdzub tsomo dag ni mthe bo ⑩dag /brkyang yinas zhi zhing dul ba yi/ /yid kyis byams sems mnyam par gzhag /ting 'dzin brtan pas lus snyoms par/ /legs par bzhag ste tunyezhi bar lta/ /tshig gzhan mi smra bzlas brjod bgyi/ /bzlas (7brjod bgyis pa tsam gyi mod la/sa chen po g.yo ( )bar 'gyur ro/ /don yod pa'i zhags pa'i phyag rgya bcings te/phyag rgya bcings nas gyu lhas chen po yang g.yo bar 'gyur ro/ /brtan ⑤pa'i sems kyis skrag par mi bgyi'o/ /sems can thams cad la mchog tu brtse ( nyebs 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug don yod zhags pa'i chazhabs 6)mthong ba tsam du bris la/ ci tsam na khro bo'i rgyal po lan bdun bzlas so69/ /lan bdun bzlas pa tsam gyi mod la sa chen po g.yo zhing sgra 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi dpral ba nas 'od zer byung nas 92—178

kun tu snang bar 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags 'chang de yang cher snying dga' ba dang /bzhin 'dzum pa dang / shin tu rab tu dga' bas spu ①zing zhes bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi gdong du blta ②bar bgyi ste/ gdong du bltas pa tsam gyi mod la/ bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi ngos ⑧g.yas pa nas legs so zhes bya rtsiba'i sgra 'byung bar 'gyur ro / /mig sgyur ⑤bar bgyid cing kun tu legs so zhes bgyi ba'i sgra byung na⑥/rig sngags 'chang gis sgrib ⑦pa thams cad (8)rnam par dag pa thob nas lus yongs su dag pa chen po dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bye ba sa ya phrag brgya stong la dge ba'i rtsa ba (9)bskyed par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis blta 7ba'i 'os su 'gyur ro/ /lus 'jam pa dang shin tu gzhon sha chags pa dang mnyen par 'gyur ro/ /skra cung zad 'khyil pa dang mnyen pa dang / snyan pa'i tshig smra bar 'gyur ro/ /mig yongs su dag pa 'thob 7par 'gyur ros/ /lus yongs su dag pa dang / yid yongs su dag pa dang / gnyer ma dang / skra skya bo spangs par 'gyur ro/ /sems can thams cad la lta ba dag pa zhes bgyi ba'i ting nge 'dzin 'thob 8par 'gyur ro/ /ci tsam du 'dug ce yin/ 7'phags pa 8spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug rang gi gzugs ston cing dbugs 'byin par bgyid do6)/ /lag pa g.yas pa spyi bor bzhag nas mchog thams cad stsol bar 'gyur ro/ /nam mkha' la mchi ba'am/mi gda' bar bgyi ba'am/ lha'i mig 'thob pa'am/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing la blta 8ba'am/ ting nge 'dzin rab tu 'thob 1)pa'am/ gzungs ( nyerab tu 'thob zhu glepa'am / don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po'i cho ga zhib mo 'grub pa'am/92—179

gtsug lag smra ba'am/ gsang sngags smra ba'am/ thos ①pa 'dzin pa nyid dam(5 / gter smra ba'am/ nor sgyur ba smra ba'am/ mig 'phrul smra ba'am/'jig rten du 'gro ba'am/ phug tu 'jug pa'am/ klu'i gnas su 'jug pa'am/zhing smra ba'am/ gnod sbyin dgug ①pa'am/ srin po dgug pa'am/ ro langs bslang ba'am/ nags khrod du 'jug pa'am/ ri la rgyu ba'am/ grong khyer du 'jug pa'am/ sman blta ④ba'i phyir 'jug pa'am/ ral gri ⑤rig sngags 'chang nyid dam/ grub pa'i rig sngags 'chang nyid dam/ 'khor los sgyur 'chib nyid dam/ rgyal po 'thob pa'am/ yul 'thob pa'am/⑦ yul gyi bdag po nyid dam/ dpung chen po rab tu 'joms ⑧pa'am/ bskrad pa'am/rgya mtshor 'jug pa de dag thams cad stsol bar 'gyur ro/ /dgos pa grub pa thams cad stsol bar 'gyur ro/ /ci ltar gang du 'tshal bar yongs su skyong bar 'gyur ro/ /mtshams 1)ma mchis pa lnga rnams 'byung ⑩bar 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu bzlas brjod bgyis na/ sems can thams cad la lta ba sgrib pa dang bral ba dag pa zhes bgyi ba'i ting nge 'dzin 'thob (7par 'gyur ro/ /mig sman sgrub tsopar 'tshal bas/ des zla ba yar gyi ngo 32tshes brgyad yil ldong ros kyi mig sman zangs kyi snod kyi nang du stsal te/ tsan+dan gyi dkyil 'khor bgyis la/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi mdun du bzhag nas legs par khrus bgyis te gos gtsang ma bgos chenas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi mdun na skyil mo krung 8bcas te nyu tshomachis nas bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /don yod zhags pa'i phyag rgya'i mtshams /snyebacing bas mtshams bcing bar yibagyi'o/ /khro bo'i rgyal po lan bdun du chibazlas par bgyi'o/ /zas dkar gsum 'tshal bar 92—180

bgyi'o / /rigs kyi bu pho'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang yang rung bas/ 'phags pa'i ①yan lag brgyad kyi bsnyen gnas la goms par bgyis nas bzlas brjod bgyi'ol/ /bzlas brjod bgyis pa tsam gyi mod la/ zangs kyi snod 'bar ba dang ske/ rlangs pa dang / dbu ba 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de blangs nas mig la byugs na nam mkha' la rdzu 'phrul gyis mchis nas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams mthong ba dang / rig sngags 'chang phyi'akhor los sgyur ①ba chen por 'gyur ro/ /phug gi gnas phye ba thams cad mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /④gter byung ba thams cad mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /lha'i gnas thams cad kyi sgo phye ⑤ba mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /gang du 'tshal ba der mchi 6)bar 'gyur ro/ /gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / 'byung po dang / sha za dang / gdon dang / mi dang / mi ma yin pa dang / phas kyi rgol ba dang / mi mdza' ⑦ba thams cad mi gda' bar 'gyur ro/ /tshes brgyad (shedam/ bcu bzhi'am/bcwa yonyelnga la tshig gzhan mi smra bar 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi mdun du skyil mo krung 7bcas te mchis nas/ lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyi'o / /bzlas brjod bgyis pa tsam gyi 17mod la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug lha'i bdag nyid kyi rang gi 3)gzugs kyis mdun du hunyemachis nas/lag pa g.yas pa spyi bor bzhag pa dang / dri med 'phags kyi lta ba'i cho 'phrul zhes bgyi ba'i ting nge 'dzin 'thob cing / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gzigs pa'i byin gyis brlabs 8bkod pa yang dag par lta ba snang ba zhes bya ba'i rdzu 'phrul thob nas/ tshe'i tshad lha'i bskal 8pa stong du 'gyur ro/ /bdag 92—181

nyid lha'i rang bzhin thob pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyis dam pa'i chos kyi gtam gleng bar mdzad pa thos par ①'gyur ro/ /bde (geb can na gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad bsu zhuba'i slad du/ lha'i gzugs kyis mdun na mchis par 'gyur ro/ /skra cung zad 'khyil bar yang 'gyur ro/ /pad+ma snang ba'i gzhal med khang zhes bgyi ba'i zhe)khang pa brtsegs ma'i tsogazhal med khang thob par du'agyur ro/ /de nas rang gi lus rdo rje sra ba bdag nyid kyi snying po'i rang bzhin thob par 'tshal na / rig sngags 'chang des spos chab des bum pa bkang nas lan drug chakhri nyis stong bzlas na brjod bgyis te/ byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi mdun du nyin zhag gcig mchis par 'gyur bas 'khrus bgyi'o / /khrus bgyis pa tsam gyi mod la/ lus rdo rje las byung ba'i rang bzhin du 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad de la yigazigs par 'gyur ro/ /tshe lha'i lo khrir 'gyur ro/ /gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang 17/ gdon thams cad dbang du 'gyur ro/ /lha dang / klu thams cad kyi dpon por 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten pa'i dgos pa sgrub 8pa thams cad bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /dran pa tsam mam sems bskyed tshonapa tsam gyi mod la gdon thams cad dang / brjed ④byed thams cad babs nas thams cad smra bar 'gyur te/ bden pa'am mi bden pa'am yang dag pa'am/ yang dag pa ma lags pa'am/ skal ba dang ldan pa'am skal ba dang mi ldan pa'am/ byung liba'am/ ma byung ba'am/'byor pa dang / rgyas pa dang / bde ba dang / lo legs pa de 7thams cad 92—182

smra bar 'gyur ro/ /de la ①sogs te las bgyi ba thams cad bgyid par 'gyur ro / /dran ②bzhin du las thams cad rtag tu bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /yang na 'jig rten thams cad gso sor bsgral ④bar 'tshal ba'am/ thams cad dbang du gyur nas gzhag par 'tshal lam/⑤ thams cad sems can dmyal ba'am / dud 'gro'i skye gnas sam/ gshin rje'i 'jig rten las thar bar bgyi bar ⑥'tshal lam/ don yod ye shes bkod ⑦pa zhes bgyi ba'i ting nge 'dzin 'thob ⑧par 'tshal lamasti/ rnam par grol ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgrub par 'tshal lam/ don yod pa'i 8zhags pa'i snying po'i cho ga zhib mo bsgrub par 'tshal na/ rig sngags 'chang des gzugs brnyan so so ba (7bzhin du/'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug don yod pa'i gzugs su bgyis te/ral pa'i thor tshugs dang ri dgas e na ya'i pags yonyepas brgyan ()pa/ phyugs bdag gi cha lugs 'chang ba/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ skyil mo krung ⑫ngam 'greng ba dang 8drung na nor bzangs pus 8mo g.yas pa phab ⑩pa/ g.yon pa 8khro bo'i rgyal po gdong gyen du lta ba khro bo'i gzugs lag pa drug pa/ 'od dpag med kyi dbu rgyan 6)thogs pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis bklubs dhi pa thams cad ring bsrel (7dang bcas par bgyi ste/ ri'i steng gi pad+ma'i stan la mchis par bgyi'o/ /gtsang mas gos gtsang ma bgos te/ dus gsum du khrus bgyis na zhunyin zhag gcig mchis te/ rig sngags 'chang gis ba'i rnam lngas nye reg bgyi'o / /chab dang yungs kur 'gyi snyidabang bskur nunyebs/ dbang bskur libar bgyi'o⑦ / /snying rje chen pos gdungs pa'i snying gis blta bar bgyi'o/ /gal te 'di lta bu'i cho gas mi bgyid na/ bklags 6)pa tsam gyi mod la yang gyu'agrub par 92—183

'gyur na/ bzlas brjod kyi las kyi cho gas lta smos kyang ci 'tshal yang rig sngags 'chang gang zhig gang gā'i 6)klung bye ba phrag brgyad ④cu rtsa brgyad kyi bye ma dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la mchod par 'tshal lam/ blta rtsibar 'tshal lam/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya (4)chen po bskyed (gepar 'tshal lam/ sems can thams cad dge ba'i rtsa ba la rab tu gzhag par 'tshal ba'am/ thams cad kyi sgrib pa rnam par dag par bgyi bar 'tshal na/ rig sngags 'chang des dge slong pha'am/ dge slong ma'am/dge bsnyen pha'am/ dge bsnyen yima'am/ rgyal po'am/ btsun mo'am/gzhan su yang rung bas thams cad cho ga 'di bzhin bgyis te/ des ci 'byor ⑦pa'i gser las don yod pa'i zhags pa'i gzugs brnyan bgyi'o/ /de nas kha shar phyogs su bstan 58)te gzhag la gur gum gyi dkyil 'khor bgyi ste5)/ gru bzhi cha 'byes 7par li khris thig gdab par bgyi'o/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su pad+ma'i phreng ba bgyi'o/ /pad+ma'i phreng ba'i dbus su ril ba spyi blugs dang bgrang phreng tunyegazhag par bgyi'o/ /me tog sna tshogs kyis mdzes par bgyi'o/ /spos chab kyis bkang ba'i sna bum pa me tog ci 'byor pas legs par brgyan hu)pa bzhi gzhag par bgyi'o / /mchod yon 〉gyi snod lnga gzhag par bgyi'o/ /pog phor gyi snod lnga nas skas ga 9ru'i bdug pas bdug 7par bgyi'o/ /dris bsgos /shepa'i mar me bcu drug sbar bar bgyi'o/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la mchod par bgyi'o/ /me tog dang / bdug pa dang / dri dang / phreng ba'ang hurtedabul bar bgyi'o/ /'jig rten dbang phyug gi mdun du skyil mo krung dz+wa chebacas te mchis nas don yod zhags pa'i phyag rgya bcings te/ bdag nyid la dbang 92—184

bskur hu)bar bgyi'o/ /khro bo'i rgyal po lan cig bzlas brjod (thubagyi'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la dmigs pa yid la bgyis nas/ phyogs bcur yid kyis mchod cing phyag bgyi'o/ /bzlas brjod kyi phyag rgya bcings te ( tshobazlas brjod bgyi'o/ /bzlas brjod brgya rtsa brgyad bgyis pa dang sa chen po g.yo bar 'gyur ro/ /bdag nyid dga' bar gyur nas 'bar bar mthong ngo de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad kyang zhal mngon sum du ston pa nye bar ston par 55)'gyur ro/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi ral pa'i gseb 'bar bar gyur nas legs so zhes bya (6)ba'i sgra 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /lan brgya (7rtsa brgyad pa (8)lan gnyis bzlas brjod bgyis na/ grub pa chen po'i rtags ston par 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi phyag brkyang 6)nas rig sngags 'chang gi spyi bor 'jog par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gzigs pa zhes bgyi ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob par 'gyur ro / /don yod zhags pa grub ⑩pa'i rig sngags 'chang bar 'gyur ro/ /nyi ma'i rtse na de bzhin gshegs pa de dag kyang mthong bar gyur nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad ston par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /brgya rtsa brgyad pa lan gsum bzlas na 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gzugs skya rengs /lha'achar ga'i nyu dus su mdun du mchis nas pad+ma dri ma med pa zhes bgyi ba'i zhags pa stsol bar 'gyur ro/ /grub pa thams cad stsol bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyal ba 'od dpag med kyang legs so zhes bgyi ba stsol bar 'gyur ro/ /gang su yang rung bas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gzugs mthong na/ de ni /snyede bzhin 92—185

gshegs pa drug khri la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed par 'gyur ro/ /de la lha thams cad dang ske/ tshangs pa la 6)sogs te/ dbang phyug dang / dbang phyug chen po'i lha'i bu rnams rtag tu blta ②'tshal bar 'gyur ro/ /nad thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /mchog thams cad yongs su rdzogs nas/ rtag tu rjes su 'brang zhing srung (kyeb dang / skyob pa dang / sbed pa ④bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /sdig pa thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur ro// //'phags pa don yod pa'i zhags pa'i cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po/ bam po brgyad pa/ des ci 'byor pa'i gser las (nya'aphags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug don yod pa'i zhags pa byas la/ de nas zhal shar phyogs su bstan te gzhag la gur gum ⑥gyi dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa legs par mdzes ⑦pa byas te/li khris thig btab la dkyil 'khor gyi ④dbus su pad+ma bri/ pad+ma'i dbus su ril ba blang ga 5)ra dang bgrang phreng bri/ me tog sna tshogs bkram la bum pa kyispos chus bkang nyurtel/ me tog ci 'byor pas legs par brgyan 7pa bzhi gzhag /mchod yon gyi snod lnga gzhag par bya zhing / pog phor lnga nas a ga tsoru'i bdug pas bdug par bya'o/ /spos sna bcu drug dang ldan pa'i til mar gyi mar me bltam stebla/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la mchod pa bya zhing /me tog dang / bdug pa dang / dri dang / phreng 8ba dag kyang dbul bar bya'o / /'jig rten dbang phyug la mngon du phyogs te⑩/ skyil mo krung 9bcas la don yod pa'i zhags pa'i phyag rgya bcings la bdag nyid la dbang bskur 4)ro/ /khro bo'i rgyal po lan cig (7bzlas la/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad yid la byas te yid kyis phyag byas la lus kyis kyang phyag byas te/ bzlas 92—186

brjod kyi phyag rgya bcings la bzlas brjod bya'o/ /brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pas sa chen po g.yo bar 'gyur zhing bdag nyid snying dga' la 6)'bar bar snang ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad zhal nye bar ston par mdzad do/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi dbu ral pa'i gseb ②'bar zhing legs so zhes bya ba'i sgra 'byung ngo / /brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa gnyis pas ( ni/dngos grub chen po'i mtshan ma ston to/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi phyag brkyang ste④/ rig sngags 'chang gi mgo bo'i ⑤spyi bor 'jog par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la rnam par blta skyob zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin 'thob nyu)par 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags 'chang la don yod pa'i zhags pa 'grub (nyapar 'gyur ro/ /tho rangs de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gi (94)zhal ston par 'gyur⑩/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad ston par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /bzlas brjod brgya 4)rtsa brgyad gsum pas ni/ skya rengs shar ba'i dus kyi tshe/'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi yonyerang gi gzugs kyis tunyemadun na bzhugs te/ pad+ma'i dri ma med pa zhes bya ba'i zhags pa sbyin par mdzad cing /dngos grub thams cad sbyin par mdzad do/ /rgyal ba 'od dpag med legs so zhes bya ba sbyin par mdzad do/ /gang la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi skur bstan pa de8/ de bzhin gshegs pa stong phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi la dge ba'i rtsa ba skrun 8par 'gyur ro/ /lha thams cad dang / tshangs pa la sogs pa dbang phyug dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / lha'i bu rnams rtag tu lus ston 'dod ⑩par 'gyur ro/ /nad thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur ba 92—187

dang ske/ mchog thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa dang / rtag tu phyi bzhin 'brang zhing srung 1)ba dang / skyob ⑤pa dang / sba bar byed par 'gyur ro/ /sdig pa thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas dngul las 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug don yod pa'i zhags pa'i gzugs snga ma bzhin du byas pa la/tsan+dan dkar po'i dkyil 'khor du tsan+dan dkar po'i dri chab kyis bkang ba gzhag par bya zhing / mchod yon gyi snod lnga gzhag par bya'o / me tog sna tshogs pa bkram ④zhing / tsan+dan dkar po'i bdug spos kyis bdugs te/she/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la mchod par bya'o(7/ /dri sna bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis dang ldan pa'i til mar gyi mar me bltam ⑦par bya zhing / bdug zhu)spos kyi snod bzhi bcu (9)gzhag par bgyi'o/ /khro bo'i rgyal po lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod byas la tirig sngags 'chang gtsang mas gos gtsang ma bgos te/ don yod pa'i zhags pa'i phyag rgya 67lan bdun bcing ngo / /bzlas brjod kyi phyag rgya byas te/ skyil /rtemo krung 'du 'dug la lag pa g.yon pa'i mdzub ④mo brkyang ba pad+ma'i tshul du byas la/ bzlas 8brjod lan brgya 8rtsa brgyad bya'o/ /lan brgya ⑩rtsa brgyad tshang ba dang / shar phyogs nas legs so zhes bya ba'i sgra grag hunyepar 'gyur zhing hu)/ bdag nyid dga' bar snang ngo / /rgyal po blon po dang btsun mo'i 'khor ( )dang bcas pa dbang du gyur te/ ming brjod pas dpag tshad stong nas 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /thams (7cad zhu)bgyi ba ci mchis zhes bran 6)bzhin du 'gyur ro/ /gang bsgo ru ba de byed par 'gyur ro/ /de nyid bla mar 'gyur zhing cher brjod shugepar 'gyur ro/ /brgya rtsa brgyad lan gnyis bzlas pas brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug chen po dang /92—188

gshin rje dang / chu lha dang / rlung lha la sogs 01pa dbang du 'gyur (mizhing /bsgo ②ba bzhin byed par 'gyur ro/ /gang bsgo (7ba byed par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po bzhi 'khor gnod ( sbyin gyi tshogs dang bcas pa rnams dbang du 'gyur ro/ /brgya rtsa brgyad lan gsum du (6)bzlas pas nyi ma dang zla ba nam mkha' las 'bab cing mdun na 'dug 9)par 'gyur ro/ /mtshan mo'i lha dang nam mkha'i lha 'ongs nas mdun na 'dug par 'gyur zhing dbang du 'gyur ro/ /thams cad ci bgyi zhes pa'i bya ba byed cing 'dug (8)par 'gyur ro/ /brgya rtsa brgyad 5)lan bzhi bzlas pas/ klu thams cad dbang du byas par 'gyur ro7/ /rgya mtsho'i klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang / nye dga' bo la sogs pa'i bar thams cad dbang du byas par 'gyur ro/ /zangs las byas pa'i 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug don yod pa'i zhags pa la/ tsan+dan dkar po'i dkyil 'khor byas te/ me tog dmar po bkram la/ bdug spos kyi snod bzhi nas bdug par bya zhing /mar gyi mar me lnga bcu rtsa gnyis bltam 37par bya'o/ /mchod yon gyi snod bzhi bzhag la/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la mchod par lha bya'o/ /khro bo'i rgyal po lan nyi shu rtsa gcig rjes su dran par bya'o/lha/ /don yod pa'i tshuzhags pa'i phyag rgya lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bebacing bar bya'o7/ /ras la bris pa'i sku gzugs kyi spyan sngar skyil mo krung 1 tshodu 'dug stenyushe/ sems can thams cad la dmigs pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad yid la bya'o/ /phyogs bzhir byams pa'i lta bas blta nyu)bar bya'o/ /sems can dmyal ba pa 3 snadang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten dang / lha ma yin dang / yi dgas 27kyi yul thams cad yid la bya'o/ /sems can dmyal ba pa ri chen po brgyad shu yid la bya zhing snying rje'i 92—189

sems kyis blta bar bya'o/ /bzlas brjod kyi phyag rgya 6)pad+ma'i tshul du bcings te bzlas brjod bya'o/ /brgya rtsa brgyad tshang ba dang / phyogs bzhi g.yo zhing sgra grag ②par 'gyur la/ dmyal ba pa'i ①sems can de dag thams cad yongs su grol bar 'gyur ro/ /dmyal ba'i sgo thams cad bcad par 'gyur zhing /bcom pa dang thal bar brlag par 'gyur ro/ /dmyal ba'i sems can de dag bde 'gror 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /bdag nyid kyang byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal ④gyi tshor ba thams cad las yongs su grol bar 'gyur ro/ /lus kyang mtshan bzang pos brgyan ⑤par 'gyur zhing / sems can gang dag gis mthong ba de dag thams cad phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro/ /brgya rtsa brgyad lan gnyis bzlas brjod byas pas ni/ sa'i 'og gi sems can mun gnag yisnang ba dang bral ba de dag don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po'i mthus mun phyaganag (shedang bral bar 'gyur zhing / 'od zer 'byung bar 'gyur ro / /yongs su grol ba'i sems can de dag 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gnas su brdzus po)te skye bar 'gyur zhing rga ⑩ba dang / 'chi ba spangs par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du kun nas mthu 'phags pa (rmidri ma med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin 'thob tu)par 'gyur zhing / tshe bskal par (rtethub par 'gyur ro/ /shi nas bde ba can gyi yi'ajig rten gyi khams su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du/ de nyid kyi zhabs kyi ⑫drung na gnas par ⑩'gyur zhing / mya ngan thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /tsan+dan dkar po dang / gla rtsi / phodang / ga pur dang / spos kyi rigs sna tshogs gzhan dag phye ma 9/2zhib mor byas te/ yang legs par btags la/ kun tu 92wa 190

lan yo)brgya rtsa brgyad byas te/ don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po lan brgya ②rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod byas la/ khro bo'i rgyal po lan bdun bzlas brjod byas na/khyim chen po bsrung ②bar 'gyur ro/ /'thab pa dang / rtsod pa dang / khrag khrug 0thams cad dang / phyir rgol ba dang / mi mdza' (9ba thams cad dang /rims thams cad dang / yams kyi nad dang / nad 'go ba thams cad dang /gdon thams cad dang / mu ge'i gnod ⑥pa dang / mi ngas dang / skyes pa dang /5ge bud med dang / khye'u dang / bu mo'i mi ngas thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /lha thams cad kyang srung sgib dang skyob (9)pa dang sba ba byed par ⑩'gyur ro/ /dbang phyug dang dbang phyug chen po yang rtag tu phyi bzhin 'brang bar 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug kyang rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par sku ston par (mebazhed par 'gyur ro/ /sbyin sreg gi mar dang /yungs kur (snyedang / gu gul gyi sbyin sreg stong rtsa brgyad tsobyas na/ yul dang /yul 'khor dang / grong khyer dang ④/ yul gru dang / ri khrod 8dang /ljongs rnams zhi ba chen por 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi spyan sngar zla ba nya ⑩la me tog dkar po dang / gan lidha pri tunyeyang ku dang /rgya spos rnams yungs mar dang bsres te ⑩sbyin sreg stong rtsa brgyad byas na rgyal po dang ( bye/ blon po (stobatsun mo'i 'khor dang bcas pa dang / yul gru dang /grong khyer dang / grong rdal dang / ljongs dang / rta dang / glang po che dang /ba lang dang / ma he rnams dbang du 'gyur ro/ /shing shurnyes pa marga'i yam sreg shing zho dang sbrang rtsi dang / mar bsres hu)pa dang / me tog dkar po rnams las lan brgya nunyertsa brgyad sbyin sreg byas na yul gru stong 'thob (gepar 'gyur ro/ /92—198

'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi spyan sngar zho dang sbrang rtsi dang mar bsres ①pa dang pad+ma'i sdong po'i yam sreg shing rnams las brgya rtsa brgyad sbyin sreg byas na mtshan mo zad pa dang di ②na ra brgyad brgya 'thob ③par 'gyur ro/ /me tog ku mu da dang / pad+ma stisdong bu dang / rtsa ba dang / 'dab (snyemar bcas pa dang / yungs kur ⑥bsres te shing seng ldeng ⑦gi me sbar la sbyin sreg brgya (8)rtsa brgyad byas na/ log 'dren thams cad las yongs su grol bar 'gyur ro/ /zla ba yar gyi ngo 6)tshes brgyad la smyung ⑩ba bgyi ste(me/ gtsang mas khrus legs par byas la gos dkar po bgos te tsan+dan dang pri yang ku'i shing dang / 'bras yos dang —/ mar dang / yungs kur bsres 8pa'i sbyin sreg stong rtsa brgyad byas na/nam phyed kyi dus su gnod sbyin mo 'ongs nas zong lnga stong sbyin par 'gyur ro/ /zla ba mar gyi ngo 8tshes bcu bzhi la nyin zhag gcig smyung ba ④byas tesnyi/ rgya mtshor 'gro ba'i chu klung (lhagi 'gram du song la/ shing bil ba'i me sbar te/tshoshing bobil ba'i me tog dang mar dang sbrang rtsi bsres 6)pa stong rtsa brgyad sbyin sreg 7byas na/ de'i 'og tu gnod sbyin mo ( )thams cad kyis brgyan (1pa 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /nam phyed na rin po che'i za ma tog thogs nas 'ong bar 'gyur te / rig sngags 'chang des blang bar bya'o/ /gdong du mig blta bar mi ( rtebya'o//yang brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod byas pa dang rkang pa'i drung du snod bor nas btud dude rig sngags 'chang rdo ste'agum mo zhes zer ro/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis khro bo'i rgyal po pu nyelan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod bya'o/ /de nas gang gi tshe dgos pa byung ba 69de'i tshe nam phyed la dzu tshalan brgya khu)rtsa brgyad bzlas rkyo 7brjod byas na gnod sbyin mo 'ong bar 'gyur te/ dgos pa thams cad byed cing 92wa 199

dran 0)bzhin du las thams cad byed par 'gyur ro/ /zla ba mar gyi ngo (kyetshes bcu bzhi la gang na gter yod pa der song ste stong rtsa brgyad bzlas (0brjod byas la/ gtor ma'i cho ga yang gzhag par bya zhing / 'phags pa don yod pa'i zhags pa la mchod pa byas la sna ma'i me tog dang / pad+ma'i 'dab ma dang /yungs kur 54)dang / mar bsres (gepa rnams las sbyin sreg stong rtsa brgyad byas te/chu dang yungs kur (6)la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod byas nas sa la brdabs na / de'i 'og tu gter ④thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur te/ blangs la dkon mchog gsum gyi sku skal dbul bar bya zhing lhag ma rang gis blang bar bya'o/ /ba ru ra'i sashing gi me sbar la til dang / 'bras so ba dang / mar bsres pa po)las sbyin sreg stong rtsa 7brgyad byas na/ rgyal po btsun mo'i 'khor dang bcas pa dang dpung gi /kāyan lag bzhi dang bcas pa dang / nor dang / 'bru dang bcas pa dang / dbyig dang / gser dang bcas pa dbang du 'gyur te/ ji srid 'tsho'i nyu2bar du gnas par 'gyur ro/ /yungs kur (snyedakar po dang /tsam pa ku'i me tog dang / pad+ma'i yam sreg shing dang / sbrang rtsi dang / mar bsres nyu ripa'i sbyin sreg sna stong rtsa brgyad byas na yul thams cad dbang du 'gyur tsozhing / bud med dang / skyes pa dang / khye'u dang / bu mo dbang du 'gyur ro / /'bras phub lan tshwa /medang ldan pa las lan dgu bcu rtsa gcig sbyin sreg (stebyas na/ rigs bzhi'i 'jig rten dbang du 'gyur ro/ /a ga ti'i tu)shing gis me sbar la sbrang rtsi dang mar bsres ri )pa dang / arka'i du )me tog las sbyin sreg brgya ( rtartsa brgyad byas la/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la mchod pa byas na/ nyin re bzhin di rdusnyen ra brgya 'thob ( stepar 'gyur ro/ /pa la sha'i 92wa 200

yam sreg ①shing dang 'bras yos las sbyin sreg stong rtsa brgyad byas na/ gser brgya ②phyag stong thob (gupar 'gyur roli/ /dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa bya zhing bgo bsha' (snyebyas na yang 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /tshes bcwa (5)lnga zla ba nya ba 57la smyung (nyab byas te/ rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung ngam/ chu klung chen po'i nang rked 9)pa nub 7tsam du zhugs te/gle/ lan brgya tsho rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod byas nasanyurte / yungs kur tshul lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas na 8khros pas chu klung de la brdab par bya'o/ /de nas chu'i nang nas bu mo zhig byung nas rin po che mang po zhig ⑩sbyin par byed de tu ci blangs la phyed kyis dkon mchog gsum la 1snyemachod par bya zhing / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la yang mchod par /rtabya'o/ /tshes bcwa du )lnga zla ba nya ba ( spel smyung ni ba byas te/ nam phyed na bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la mchod pa byas nas/ a pa mar ga'i 3dayam sreg shing dang / sbrang rtsi dang / mar dang / sra rtsi pog sreg zhumipa la lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod byas la/ rang gi ming gis 2nasbyin sreg du lhastong byas na sdig pa ( tre thams cad las grol bar 'gyur zhing nad thams cad du nyadang / gnod pa thams cad 7las grol bar 'gyur ro ji sna/ /phyir rgol ba thams cad dang / mi mdza' ba thams cad 'jig du)par 'gyur ro/ /shing arka zhunyadang / til dang /yungs kur (sridang / gu gul dang / mar bsres nu ༷ pa las ༷shāsbyin sreg byas na/zhi ba chen por 'gyur ro/ /'bras yos dang / 'o ma dang / mar dang /yungs kur (sgyedang / tsan+dan dkar po bsres la ri musbyin sreg lan brgya ra rtsa brgyad byas na rgyas pa dang mchog tu dge bar 'gyur ro/ /tshes bcu bzhi la ka 9ra bī ra'i me tog dang / lan tshwa sna bdun bsres pa dang / shing tsher ma can gyi 92wa 201

yam sreg shing yungs mar 6)la bsres pa ②drag shul spyod par bya'o/ /char mi 'bab pa'i tshe pad+ma dang tsan+dan dang / yungs kur ②dang / mar bsres ④pa la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas te/ sbyin sreg brgya kham brgyad byas nas 7khro bo'i gsang sngags lan 97bdun bzlas (snyen ji srid 'dod pa de srid du char gyi rgyun chen po 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /thal ba de blangs la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas te nam mkha' la gtor ⑨na char yiha cang ches pa yonyezhi bar 'gyur ro/ /phyogs bzhir gtor na mtshams chen po bcad par 'gyur ro/ /sprin la mngon 8du phyogs te gtor na rlung dang / sprin dang / ser ba rnams 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gzhan gyi sde gnon 7pa ni til dang 'bras so ba'i sbyin sreg gis so//pha rol gyi dpung zlog skipa ni sa bon bdun gyi sbyin sreg gis so/ /phug sgrub pa ni mashing arka'i ⑩sbyin sreg gis tu 7so/ /arka'i hu)lo ma dang / mar bsres 4)pa'i sbyin sreg byas na phug gi sgo thams cad 'byed par 'gyur ro/ /nags su 'gro ba'i tshe ku mu da dang / rgya spos dang / yungs kur so )dang / mar bsres pas nags kyi phug gi sgo thams cad 'byed par 'gyur zhing sman gyi dngos po thams cad rang bzhin du gnas par 'gyur ro(nye/ /shing pa la sha'i me sbar te na le sham brgya stong sbyin sreg byas na( rte/ brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / nyi ma 'ongs nas mdun du 'dug par tso'agyur ro/ /sna ma'i me tog dang / ka (ster ni kā (nyera'i me tog dang / ut+pa la rnams mar dang bsres du 9pa las sbyin sreg brgya ni)stong byas na/ zla ba dang /nyi ma 'ongs nas mchog sbyin zhing lus la 'od zer btang nas nam mkha' la 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /a shwad thas yam sreg shing byas la/ shu ti dang / nye'u shing 92—202

dang glu/ arka ①dang / tsan+dan dang / yungs kur ②dang / nas dang / mar bsres ②pa las nyi ma bdun gyi dus mtshams ④gsum du sbyin sreg nyi shu rtsa gcig byas nas (nyergyal po btsun mo'i 'khor dang bcas pa dbang du 'gyur ro/ /gdon dang ske/ gnod sbyin dang / srin po thams cad chad pas bcad na 'bras so ba dang —/ yungs kur yidang / lan tshwa'i sbyin sreg bgyis 9)te/ thams cad la don yod pa'i zhags pa bcing bar (nyabya zhing khro bo'i phyag rgya dang gsang sngags lhan cig rjes su dran par bya'o/ /sbyin sreg gi cho ga'o// //de nas don yod pa'i zhags pa'i po)snying po 7cho ga'i rgyal po chen po ras kyi sku 61gzugs mthong ba tsam gyi mod la mnar med pa'i mthar thug pa dang / mtshams med pa lnga byed pa tu)byang bar 'gyur ba hu)bshad par bya ste/ ras khru do gru bzhi lham pa kha tshar ma chad pa skra med pa thag 3steran bzang ba/ shin tu dkar ba/shin tu sbyangs pa la ri mo mkhan mi smra ba'i dka' thub can bsnyen gnas la gnas pa / gtsang mas gos gtsang ma bgos pa/ zas dkar gsum za ba/ dus gsum du khrus byas pa/ lhag ma ma yin pa'i tshon rtsi stusnod sar par 7bzhag ste/pir sar ()pas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bzhengs hunyepa'am bzhugs pa'am skyil mo krung 1)du bzhugs ( )pa bri bar bya ste/ ral pa'i thor tshugs kyis brgyan ( )pa/ e ne (3ya'i pags du nyepa bsnams pa/ phyugs bdag gi 3 7cha lugs 'chang ba/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag bcu drug pa zhal zhi sasnyeb / spyan phye ba/ dbu rgyan la rgyal ba 'od dpag med bzhugs du 5pa/ zhal g.yas pa'i thor tshugs la zla tshes kyis brgyan hu 7pa/ phyag gnyis rdo rje'i thal mo 92—203

sbyar ba las gyen du pad+ma'i tshul du bya'o/ /phyag gnyis thur du kun tu zhal gyi phyag rgya (1)bya'o/ /phyag gnyis bzlas (7brjod kyi phyag rgya byas la mdzub ②mo g.yas pa brkyang ste/ pad+ma'i tshul du byas la bar na bgrang phreng ④'dzin pa ⑤bya'o/ /phyag gnyis don yod pa'i zhags pa'i phyag rgya bya'o/ /phyag gcig na rtse gsum pa⑥/gnyis pa na pad+ma/ gsum pa don ⑦yod pa'i (8)zhags pa'i glegs bam/ bzhi pa na yostedon yod pa'i zhags pa/ zhags pa tha mal pa 'dra ba/ lnga pa dbugs 'byin pa/ drug pa na 7ril ba spyi blugs/ bdun pa na rin po che 0sna tshogs kyis bkang ba'i snod/ brgyad pa na me tog sna tshogs kyi snod thogs par bya zhing /'od nyu2'dom gang gis brgyan (snyepa sku me tog sna tshogs kyis skyibakra bas mdzes par bya'o / /ri po ṭa 8la'i khang pa brtsegs ⑩pa shin tu mdzes 7pa/ gru bzhi lham pa/ka ba bzhi zug pa/ khri 'phang stegs bu mdzes pa dang ldan pa/ rin po che ()sna tshogs kyis phortemadzes par brgyan so )pa/ pad+ma'i phreng du nyebs mdzes par byas pa/rdo rje'i phreng du rnyebs brgyan ( nyepa/ me tog sna tshogs dang chu shing gi yal gas mdzes par byas la( ste/ g.yas logs kyi steng na nyi ma/ g.yon logs na zla ba/gnas gtsang ma'i rigs nunyekyi lha'i bu dag lag na (9me tog sna tshogs mang po thogs te/ bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byed par ( rtebya'o/ /ri pad+ma 'dra ba zhig snying pos mdzes par byas shing / sdong po dang ldan pa/ mtshos mdzes (shepar byas pa/ mtsho nyas gang zhing chu srin ma ka ra dang (rte/ bzhad dzu )dang shang shang te'u dang / ngur pas brgyan du)pa/ nor bu rin po che sna tshogs kyis legs par brgyan pu rtepa'i ri de'i steng du pad+ma'i gdan dang seng ge'i khri bya'o/ /g.yas phyogs kyi phyi rol khang pa'i gnas su dbang phyug bya'o/ /g.yon du dbang phyug 92wa 204

chen po rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan par zhi)bya'o/ /nang gi gnas su 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug go/ /g.yas su 'phags ma sgrol ma lus btud de 'dzem phyibag dang bcas pa bya'o/ /g.yon du dri med 'gro lag pa dbugs 'byin pa dang nor bzangs ⑤pus mo btsugs par gebya'o/ /pad+ma'i snying po'i dbus kyi (geganas su khro bo'i rgyal po khros pa'i gzugs can/ lag pa bzhi pa'i (5)lag na mtshon cha thogs pa ste(pe/ zhags pa dang / dbyug to dang / rtse gsum dang / pad+ma'o/ /pad+ma'i gdan (8)la skyil mo krung phyed (97bcas pa nyu )lus cung zad btud pa/ mgo bo'i /lhasteng g.yas g.yon du drang srong bstod rabs byed pa bya'o/ /de nas 'og gi g.yas g.yon du rdo rje'i zom chen po/ lag na rdo rje'i tshogs mang po 'dug pa dang / gshin rje 32dang / chu lha dang / rlung lha dang / dbang po dang / lha'i tshogs dag bya'o/ /g.yas phyogs kyi mtsho dang /ri'i bar du brgya byin dang tshangs pa bya'o/ /g.yon phyogs su rgyal po chen po bzhi go cha bgos pa bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu pho nya mo nyusnyepad+ma'i rigs mdzes ma lag pa 'brel pa yibya'o/ /lha mo dpal mchen mo mudang / dbyangs ldan ma dang /'jigs byed ma dang / mtshan mo'i lha nyu dang / sa'i lha mo dang / lo tog gi lha mo bya'o/ /dbang phyug gi drung du khro gnyer can bya'o/ /dbang phyug chen po'i drung du gos dkar mo'o/ /ri dang / pho nya mo'i 18bar du srin mo ral yirtagacig na snama'o / /ri'i khor yug tu shunagru bzhi rin po che sna bdun gyis spras 2)pa bya zhing /ljon shing dang / lcug du ma sna tshogs dang / me tog gis brgyan cing / byumatshe'u mdzes pa/ me tog sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa dang nag/ seng ge dang /stag gis gang ba dang / klu'i phru 50gu dang / grul bum dag bya'o/ /g.yon du 92wa 205

gsang ba chen po 0)lnga bya'o/ /'og tu klu'i ④rgyal po chen po ②lnga bya'o/ /thams cad brag gi stan dang / lag na rin po che'i me tog gi phor pa thogs te/bcom ldan 'das la blta ④bar bya'o/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi zhabs kyi (nyedrung du rig gyusngags 'chang pus ⑦mo btsugs ⑤te/ lag na me tog dang / pog phor thogs pa bcom ldan 'das la blta ⑨bar bya'o/ /steng gi bang rim du thub pa chen po rgyal ba 'od dpag med dang ⑩/ shākya'i rgyal po dang / 'jig rten dbang po'i rgyal po bya'o/ /ras kyi sku gzugs 'di mthong ba tsam gyi mod la/ tshe rabs brgya tu)stong du mnar med pa bsags pa dang /mtshams med pa lnga'i las byas 8pa de dag thams cad 'jig par 'gyur/ rnam par 'jig par 'gyur zhing / sems can de dag thams cad kyang yongs su grol bar 'gyur na/ sems can dag pa rnams lta ci smos/ dad pas mos pa rnams dang / dkon mchog gsum mchod pa don du gnyer ba de dag ni/ tshe 'di nyid la 'bras bu che ba dang / phan yon mang po dag tu shes par bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gang gā'i 4)klung gi bye ma snyed 8bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi'i drung du dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed 8par 'gyur zhing / de dag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /ras kyi sku gzugs 'di mthong ba ni 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug don yod pa'i zhags pa'i gzungs kyi ⑩snying po dngos su mthong ba yin no/ /ras kyi yisku gzugs 'di mthong ba tsam gyis 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dgongs par 'gyur zhing sku yang ston par 'gyur ro/ / nyam thag yi pa tsam gyi mod la sku ston par 'gyur zhing mchog thams cad sbyin par 'gyur ro/ /don yod pa'i zhags pa'i 4)gzungs kyi 92—206

snying po 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /nad kyis thebs pa dang / nad tshabs chen pos gzir ba 6)dang / nad sna tshogs dang / sdug bsngal (gebargya stong gis dkrugs ②pa de dag thams cad kyis stimathong ba tsam gyi mod la/ nad thams cad dang / sdug bsngal ⑤thams cad dang / gdon 6)thams cad ⑦yongs su grol bar 'gyur zhing / sgrib pa dang / nad dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /tha na dud 'gro'i skye gnas su gtogs pa dag kyang / mthong ba tsam gyi mod la yongs su grol bar 'gyur ro/ /ras kyi sku gzugs 'di 'khor mang pos mchod pa dang /bkur sti chen po dang / sil snyan dkrol (sheb mang po dang / gdugs dang /rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan gyis 59)legs par brgyan par bya stebo/ grong khyer chen po'am/ rgyal po'i pho brang ngam/ gtsug 17lag khang ngam/ ljongs sam/khyim mamatunye/ grong du zhugs nas kyi ras kyi sku gzugs bzhugs pa tsam gyi mod la/'thab 8pa dang / rtsod 8pa dang / 'thab tsomo dang / khrag khrug dang / mu ge'i dgon pa dang 7/ mi ngas dang / rang gi dpung dang / gzhan gyi dpung gi 8'jigs pa zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / 'byung po dang / sha za dang / srul po dang / lus srul po dang / skem 37byed dang / brjed byed dang / ༄ grib gnon zhi bar 'gyur zhing / bde ba dang / lo legs pa dang / dga' ba dang / mi mang po bde ba mang bar 'gyur ro/ /dga' ba dang yid bde ba mang bar 'gyur ro/ /pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi rjes su 'gro (1bar 'gyur ro/ /'di mthong ba tsam gyis shi 'phos nas (stethams cad bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /bskal tsho )pa stong phrag bdun cu'i shustetshe rabs su tshe rabs dran par 'gyur ro/ /pad+ma'i 'od dri ma med 92—207

cing rnam par dag pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos ma thob pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /pad+ma rab tu gnas pa zhes bya ba'i rig sngags 'chang gi 'khor los sgyur hu)ba nyid 'thob ②par 'gyur ro / /ri mo'i sku gzugs bsgrub pa'i cho ga dang cho ga 6)zhib mo'o// //de nas don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po'i cho ga zhib mo chen po'i dkyil 'khor bshad par bya ste/ chu klung gi 'gram mamartsi/ pad+ma'i mtshe'u'am(5)/ ut+pa la'i mtshe'u'am(7/ me tog gi skyed tsu)mos tshal lam/ 'bras bu'i kun dga' ra ba'am / khang bzangs sa gzhi dag 58༄cing sa gzhi (9)yongs su sbyangs pa/ rtswa ⑩dang shing bal dang / skra dang / phub ma dang / sol ba dang / phyag dar gyi phung po dang / gyo mo dang / shing dang / bong ba dang / gseg (1ma dang /thod pa'i rus pas nyu)gang ba tsho/nyernams spangs pa'i sa gzhi'i 49phyogs na mtshe'u tu gedang / 'bab chu dang / 'bab chu byang phyogs nas 'bab pa dang / nye ba na chu yod cing shin tu mdzes pa/ lho phyogs dang / byang phyogs dang / nub phyogs dang / shar phyogs gang na ljon shing gis mdzes par byas pa'i/ gang nyams dga' ba kha dog dang / gzi byin du ldan pa'i gnas de lta bu rnyed nas chu dang yungs kur 1 tshol bzlas 18te/ kun du gtor ro/ /sa gzhi 16de lta bu sbyang ba ni mchog yin no/ /khro bo'i rgyal po shu 5yungs kur zhu la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas te / phyogs bzhir gtor na(sto/ kun nas dpag tshad brgya tshun chad phyogs bcing ba shusnyedang dkyil 'khor bcing ba dang / mtshams bcing ba byas par 'gyur ros )/ /sdang ba thams cad dang / bgegs dang / log 'dren thams 92wa 208

cad 0)skad cig kyang mi gnas par phyogs bzhir byer te 'dong ngo (mi/ /srog chags sdang ba dang / sdang ba'i sems (5)dang / sdang rgyaba'i gcan gzan lakhro bo gang yin pa de dag thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur zhing lha thams cad srung bar 'gyur ro/ /gnas kyi phyogs der mkhas pas dkyil 'khor byas teyi/ gru bzhi lham pa ngos re re zhing khru sum cu (7)rtsa gnyis gzhal bar bya zhing (8da/ cha 'byes kyi)pa gru bzhi pa 7cha mnyam zhing mdzes pa yonyasgo bzhi dang / rta babs bzhir ldan pa/ 'bras kyi phye ma'i tshon 1)sna bzhir sbyar la/ de nas turnyedakyil 'khor bri skobar bya ste/ tshon sna chalnga'i thig skud kyis 7thig btab nas/ tsan+dan dkar po'i phur bu btab ste/ zla ba yar gyi ngo'i nyunyetshes brgyad dam/ tshes bcwa yi lnga'i tshes dzo/)grangs dang / rgyu skar bzang po bdams rdo 7te/ dkyil 'khor gyi mchog bri bar bya'o/ /dang po ni dkar pos bri'ori sto/ /gnyis pa ni rdzo snyedamar pos so/ /gsum pa ni ( )ser pos so/ /bzhi pa ni nam mkha'i kha dog gis so/ /lnga pa ni mig sman gyi kha dog gis te/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus kyi snying po 'jigs pa med pa 'cha rnam par mdzes shing / gsal bar pir sar 39pa dang tshon 69dang snod sar ( )pas bri bar bya ste/ dkyil 'khor sdo 8gyi snying por pad+ma 'dab zhu)ma stong pa kho ra nu )khor yug stegs bu dang bcas pa bri zhing / pad+ma'i phreng ba tshon ()gyis mdzes pa bris la/ de'i dbus su sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thub sa pa chen po shākya'i cinargyal po dang / 'od dpag med dang / 'jig rten dbang po'i rgyal po gzhag go / /g.yas su mgon po 'jig rten dbang phyug don yod pa'i zhags pa'i cha byad 'chang ba gsang sngags kyi rjes su 'brang bar (gebya'o/ /g.yon du phyag na rdo rje rnga yab dang / rdo rje thogs pa bzhin khro gnyer can 'od 'bar bas bskor (mi92wa 209

ba'o / /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi drung du lha mo sgrol ma dang /dri med 'od 'phro bya'o①/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi 'og tu dkar sham chen mo ①dang / gos dkar mo dang / dkar mo chen mo lag na dbyug pa dang / ril ba spyi blugs thogs pa'o/ /de'i 'og tu srin mo ral pa gcig pa (gyimache ba gtsigs ④pa thod pa'i phreng ba thogs pa/ sbrul gyi mchod phyir thogs pa lag pa bzhi pa/ lag pa g.yas g.yon gnyis na rdo rje dang / dgra sta dang —/ g.yas pa'i gung mo lha dang / log 'dren la bsdigs par ⑤bya'o/ /g.yon du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bram ze'i cha lugs 'chang ba ral pa'i thor tshugs kyis bzhugs pa/ 'od dpag med kyi thor tshugs kyis dubargyan par (7)bya'o/ /g.yas g.yon du dbang phyug dang / dbang phyug chen po bya'o / /de'i 'og tu dpal lha mo dang / lha mo dbyangs can (8)ma dang / mtshan mo'i lha mo dang / sa'i lha mo dang / lo thog 7gi lha mo dang / 'bras bu dang me tog gi 7lha mo bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu khor (7yug tu gshin rje dang / chu lha dang /rlung lha la sogs pa bya'o/ /ral pa'i thor tshugs kyis brgyan 8pa'i drang srong gzhag par bya'o/ /grwar 6)rgyal po chen po cibazhi go cha bgos pa gzhag par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi snying po'i dbus dang bar bar tsodu lcags kyu dang / dgra sta dang / rdo rje dang / dbyug pa dang / zhags pa dang / lcags sgrog bya'o/ /phyi rol du tshangs pa dang / drag po dang / lha mo u ma dang / tshangs pa'i drung du lha mo 8dbyangs ldan ma khros pa'i gzugs can no/ /de yonaganyis kyi bar du dbyug pa dang / ril ba spyi blugs bri bar bya'o/ /grwa gcig tunyetu don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po'i rnam 37par grol ba'i dkyil 'khor kyi chos kyi rnam grangs 92wa 210

gzhag go/ /grwa gcig ①tu shi bā ba ha gzhag go/ /de nas shar phyogs kyi sgor khro bo rta mgrin 'jigs su rung ba'i mig can gzhag go/ /lho phyogs kyi sgor rdo rje chen po ki ③li ki la (0zhes bya ba/ rdo rje rnam par 'dren pa/ lag na rdo rje dang /dgra sta dang / zhags pa thogs par (7bya'o/ /nub phyogs kyi sgor pho nya mo pad+ma'i (gerigs mdzes ma lag pa pad+ma'i rtse mo nas 'dzin par bya'o/ /byang phyogs kyi sgor rdo rje chen po zom zhes bya ba'i tshogs lag na rdo rje dang zhags pa thogs pa (6nyebya'o / /de nas 'jug pa'i 3)sgo nas gser gyi bum pa spos chus bkang ste dar las bcings la rnam (kyepa thams cad dang / me tog gi phreng bas brgyan 6)nas bsam pa ci lta ba bzhin du dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bzhag ste/ steng du sna ma'i me tog gi gdu bu gzhag par bya'o/ /tsan+dan dang / gur gum dang / gla rtsi dang / ga bur gyi chu dang / pog phor bzhi gzhag cing / a ga 7ru'i bdug pas bdug go/ /tshon sna lnga'i ras kyi srad bu mchod phyir gyi srad bu tshad du byas la / gser gyi yang mig rtse gsum can gdags par bya zhing / thor to gcig 67tu me tog pad+ma'i gdub kor dang mu tig dang 7rin po ches spras pa/ zlum por bskyil la tu bum pa'i steng du bzhag la mchod pa dang / bsnyen bkur libyas te yungs kur tugel don yod pa'i nyi zhags pa'i snying po lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas te( —tsho/de la gdab par bya'o/ /tsan+dan dang / ga bur dang / gla rtsi'i 6)phye mas bsgos rdo/r+sha/la bsgo nu )bar bya'o/ /sgo bzhi'i gnas su dri chab kyis bkang ba'i bum pa dang /zas dkar gsum gyi gtor ma gzhag par bya zhing gser ( nyadangul gyi mchod yon gyi snod sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / spos chus bkang ba brgyad dang / spos chu dkar pos bkang ba brgyad gzhag par bya'o/ /ro dang dri sna tshogs kyis bkang ba 92—211

brgyad 0)dang / zho dang / 'o ma dang / spos chus bkang ba brgyad dang /gtor ma la sogs pa dbul ba sna brgyad dang / dbul ba sna ②drug cu rtsa bzhi pa rnams sha dang / khrag dang / kun dudong dang / ke'u dang / kha zas ngan pa dang / btung ba ngan pa spangs te/ gtsang mas gtsang ma sbyar bar bya'o/ /me tog sna tshogs kyi gcal dgram ④par bya zhing / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang la/ lda ldi dang / ba dan gyis brgyan par bya/ pog phor ⑤sum cu rtsa gnyis gzhag par bya zhing / bdug spos sna tshogs mang pos bdug par bya/spos sna brgya rtsa (nyubargyad dang ldan pa'i til mar gyi mar me bltam ⑦par bya/dkyil 'khor gyi khor yug tu pad+ma'i phreng ba bri bar bya'o/ /rig sngags 'chang gtsang mas gos gtsang ma bgo bar bya zhing / dus gsum du khrus byas la gos gsum bgo narabar bya/ grogs gtsang poram bsgrub par bya'o/ /'jug pa'i cho ga byas pa nas don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying pos dbang bskur ⑩ba'i bar tsam gyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyis yongs su gzung phonyezhing / 'jig rten mgon pos byin gyis brlabs snyipa dang / pad+ma'i rigs pad+ma 'chang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po don na yod pa'i zhags pa'i misnying po'i dngos grub la mngon du phyogs par 'gyur ro/ /gang bsams 8pa thams cad de kho na bzhin byed par 'gyur ro/ /dam tshig thams cad la 8don yod par 'jug go/ /chos nyid thams cad kyis ⑩rnam par grol ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi chos la dam tshig grub par 'gyur ro/ /las kyi sgrib pa thams cad las 37rnam par grol ba dang / bde ba thams cad kyi rjes su 'gro zhing lha dang mi'i dpal thams cad myong bar 'gyur ro/ /lha dang / lha ma yin dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po'i tshogs kyi bgo 4)skal la dbang 92—212

bar 'gyur ro/ /rnal 'byor gyi dkyil 'khor dang gsang sngags la brten 0)par 'gyur ro/ /brdeg pa dang / spyo ba dang phur bus gdab pa dang / bsreg pa dang ②bsdigs pa dang g.yeng ba dang / gsad 9 ripa dang / dbang du bya bas 53mi tshugs so/ /gang dag de lta bu byed pa de nyid kyi lus sam/ mgo la brgya phrag stong gyur (5)du 'bab par (5)'gyur zhing / gzhan gyis 97)phyir bzlas shing dgrol (8)bar mi nus te/ rig sngags 'chang des dgrol bar bya'o/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang ⑨des ri mo'i gzugs de dkyil 'khor la mngon du phyogs par bzhag nas/ don yod pa'i zhags pa'i yi skusnying po stong rtsa brgyad bzlas la/don yod pa'i zhags pa'i phyag rgya lan brgya 67rtsa brgyad bcing bar bya zhing / khro bo'i rgyal po lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas par (12bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams las 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bum pa de yang 'bar la/ ras kyi sku gzugs de yang kha dog sna bdun du 'bar zhing /shas cher 'gul 'bar 'gyur te/ khro bo'i rig 8sngags 'chang snying dga' bar 'gyur zhing / ras kyi sku gzugs las legs so mazhes bya ba'i sgra 'byung bar 'gyur te/ rig sngags 'chang legs so legs so/ /khyod kyis 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po grub cing / khyod kyis zhags pa 'di yang grub/ khyod kyis yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i 7zhags pa'i mchog 'di yang grub kyis / khyod kyis lho las thams cad byos shig /de dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rgyas pa nyu7mchog grub nas/ bum pa spos chus bkang ba de blangs la lan brgya zhu )rtsa brgyad ( rnyabazlas te/ rgyu skar rgyal la khrus bya ba'am 22zla ba yar gyi ngo'i ()tshes grangs shis pa la khrus byas pa tsam gyi mod la/ lus thams cad dri 92—213

ma med cing yongs su dag pa 'thob par 'gyur zhing / dngos po lnga'i bdag nyid yongs su dag par 'gyur te/ rna ba lnga yongs su dag pa dang / mig lnga yongs su dag pa dang / sna lnga yongs su dag pa dang / lce lnga yongs su dag pa dang —/ rnam par shes pa lnga yongs su dag pa dang / dbang po lnga yongs su dag pa thob 0)par 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug rtag tu mchog sbyin par 'gyur zhing / rtag tu sku ston (0bzhed par yang 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad zhal ston par 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dgongs par 'gyur ro/ /lha thams cad kyang de la srung zhub dang skyob (4pa dang sba ba ⑤byed par 'gyur ro/ /brgya 6)byin dang tshangs pa la sogs pa (gedag kyang 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po chen po ⑧bzhi dpung gi 'khor dang bcas te sa'i phyogs der 'ong bar 'gyur zhing / rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par srung 6)ba dang skyob ⑩pa dang sba ba yibyed par 'gyur ro/ /sred 7med kyi bu dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / nor bu bzang po dang / gsang ba pa brgya stong phrag du ma srung hunyeb dang skyob rdzo/stepa dang sba ba tunyebyed par 'gyur zhing /zhi ba dang bde legs su byed par ⑩'gyur ro/ /shes pa don yod pa dang /shes rab don yod pa dang / thos pa dang / tshul khrims dang / brtson 'grus 'thob 7par 'gyur zhing / sbyin pa don yod pa'i sbyin par 'gyur ro/ /bsod nams kyi phung po don yod pa dang ldan par 'gyur zhing 'di lta ste pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rdzu 'phrul dpag tu med pa la mkhas par yang 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags 'chang gi cho ga zhib mo yang 'grub par 'gyur ro / /stobs dang brtson 'grus dang pha rol tsoganon pa don yod par 'gyur ro/ /92—214

sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa thob 0)par 'gyur ro//de bzhin gshegs pa gang gā'i klung gi (mibye ma gasnyed sa ya brgya 0phrag brgyad ⑤stong drug cu rtsa bzhi'i dge ba'i (7rtsa ba yongs su rdzogs par 9)yang dag par gzung 6)bar 'gyur ro/ /sems can thams cad kyis kyang mchod pa dang bkur ste bya bar 'gyur zhing thams cad dbang du 'gyur ro/ /mchod rten gyi snying po dang 'dra bar phyag bya ba'i 'os su 'gyur ro/ /dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhib mo'o// //'phags pa don yod pa'i zhags pa'i cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po/ bam po dgu pa / de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug stan las langs nas/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas/pus ⑨me g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs yite/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de 1stologs su thal mo sbyar te btud nas/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag byas yinas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag la pad+ma'i rigs la rnam par grol ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rig tu)sngags chen po'i rim rme/sgepar phye 8ba cho ga zhib mo don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po/ rig sngags kyi rgyal po chen po mchis te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar de bdag 7gis yongs su bsgrag ⑩par bgyi'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bzhin 'dzum pas/ bcom ldan 'das la lta tunyebazhin du don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po 'di smras so/ /na ma s+t+ri yad spyo nyarten ga ta pra 92—215
