tabya thā/ oṃ a mo gha skṛ nyu7da ya pra bha bi ni/ sarba bisne apra sha ma ni①/ ā ha ra ni / saṃ ( ha ra/ pad+ma r+pā (6)cho3 57)ba biṣ+ṭi/ ma ṇi ka ṇa ka 6)bi bhū ṣi ṇita/ka ma la bhu dze/ ta ra ta ra 7tā rā ya ba ra ma/ a mo gha skṛ da (7ya/ dza ye tri ne tre'age/ ba ra da bhu dze/ sma ra sma ra/ bha ga bān(ste/ sarba ta thā ga ta sa ma ya / bha ra bha ra/ bhu ru tsobyu ru/ brah+ma bhi blag dha ra bi bhu yi'i ta ta nu/ ma hā bha ya ha re/ ā 3 7lo kā ni ya/ bi lo kā 9/)ya/ sarba satā ba lo ki ni/ ba ra ba ra de swā hā/ las thams cad pa'i rig sngags te( bye/ khyad par du ni rig 6spresngags 'dis dkyil 'khor gyi gnas na 'khod pa'i (snyelas mi rnams bsrung (stebar bya'o / /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma zhu)ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya / ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tar+ya ( snyenā/ pa ra pa ra(9 ma ra ma ra/ sa ra sa ra/ ban dha ban zhu snadha/ sa man te na/ a mo gha pā phyosha ha ste ri sku / tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha no/ bud dha dharma saṃ gha sa (mkhye na swā 42hā/ thal ba la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas te don yod zhags pa'i phyag rgyas 6)yul bcing ngo / /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma zhina.ār+ya a ba lo ki zhu gete shwa rā sa)ya/ bo lgu —3dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ci ṇi kā ya/ tar+ya thā/ di shā ban dha na(1/ a mo ste( )/a pra ti )ha te/ mu ru mu ru/ su ru su ru/ tu ru tu ru/ sarba bisne bi nā ()sha ni/ pad+ma sa ra bi bhū ( ṣi te/ bud dha (gedharma ( rma gha sa (9rkye na ban dha/ a dzi ta ba ra ri de swā hā/ spyan drangs te phyi nas (3phyogs bcing bar 5 rtebya'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma 5 ko.ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo so'idhi satā ya/ ma hā satā yas / ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tabya thā/ hi li hi li/ mi li mi li si ri si ri/ pi ri pi ri/ ba ra ba ra/ pra ba ru ra bi mā na dha ra/ da snyenar da ra/92wa 236

gats+tsha gats+tsha 1bha ga bānan/ ār+ya a ba lo ki te cad shwa ra:5/ bha ga bān6/tu ru tu ru/ a mo gha pad+me swā hā/ me tog ci snyed pa la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas te snyim pa nas phul na 7slar gshegs su gsol bar 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags kyi cho ga zhib mo rim par phye ba'i cho ga'o// //de nas don yod pa'i zhags pa'i rgyal po khro bo chen po'i snying po'i mchog bsgrubs (8na/ bsgrub sla 9ba'i ras kyi sku gzugs kyi cho ga bshad par bya'o/ /cho ga zhib grub grub pa che/ /khro bo'i rgyal grub grub pa sna mchog /don yod pa ni grub pa'i mchog /rig sngags 'di ni bshad par bya'o/ /don yod rgyal po khro chen gyi/lha/ /snying po dam pa sgrub 12pa ni1lha/ /cho ga zhib grub grub pa che/ /khro bo'i rgyal po grub pa skemachog /grub pa'i mchog ste skadon yod pa/ /rig sngags 'di ni bshad par bya/ /gang brjod pa tsam gyis cho ga zhib mo'i mchog 'grub pa/sangs rgyas bye ba brgya phrag stong gis gzigs par 'gyur ba/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang gā'i 7klung gi bye 1 ma snyed 1 brgya stong mthong bar 'gyur ro19/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'bum la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed par 'gyur ba/ bsod nams kyi 2 phung po bla na med pa/ sdig pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ba/stobs dang brtson 'grus bskyed pa 1/ cho ga zhib mo thams cad don yod pa/de kho na nyid sgrub 2pa 'grub pa lha/ dran pa tsam gyi mod la ni/ /sa gzhi yang ni g.yo 'gyur la/ /sum cu'i lha rnams g.yo 25'gyur zhing / /lhar bcas rgya mtsho lhun por bcas/ /klu rnams 'dar 0ni yed yed 2 cing / /gnod sbyin srin po /'bros 'gyur ba/ /lha dang lha min g.yul na 'gyed tshe/ /rig sngags 92—237

rgyal po bla med kyis/ /phyag na rdo rje gnod sbyin bcas/ /dpung dang bcas shing bzhon 1bcas pa'i/ /luse skyes 'bar ba'i phreng tshon can kun/ /'dar zhing kun du 'dar yid yid/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi po yi/ /gnas mchog dag ni g.yo 'gyur zhing / /de dag thams cad 'dus 'gyur nas/ /'jig rten dbang la skyabs dong zhing / /bcom ldan lamagon po bskyab 5tu gsol / /thugs rje'i bdag nyid bskyab 7tu gsol/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug /bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste /phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag la grub pa don yod pa'i snying po'i 9rig sngags rgyal po'i snying po 'di gang gis bklags pa tsam gyis don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po myur du rab tu 1 'grub cing / dran pa tsam gyis 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug lha'i lus kyis 11lus ston par 'gyur ba/ dngos grub dang mchog thams cad sbyin par 'gyur ba mchis te/ bcom ldan 'das de bdag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi 12spyan sngar/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor 'di'i nang du bsgrags par bgyi'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥ7a mi tā bhā maya/ta thā ga tā 17ya/ na ma 1 ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo 18rnyi satā 19ya/ ma hā 2 satā 21ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi na kā ya/ tabya da thā/ oṃ pad+me pad+me/ pad+ma dha ra bi bhū 25'i ta/ bhu dze/ tsa ra tsa ra/ brah+ma be ṣa dha ra/ bha ra bha dgar/ bi tsi 2 tra mo la dha ra/ ma ṇi ka na ka badz+ra be+e ḍū〉 9lo kri sdo ta sha rī da1ra/ ta ra ta ra/ ta rā ya ta rā ya 5/ bha ga ba te pā ra ṇa/ dhu ru dhu ru/ a mo gha pā gisha ha ste tsi / ba ra ba ra ba ra dā ri ya ka /sa man ta a ba lo ki te na/ ma hā bo dhi 92—238

satwa 37ba ra da pad+mā (nasan pad+ma tsho gi ra/ dz+wa la dz+wa la sarba 4ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka /a bhi ṣe 5ka te ma hā kā 6ru ṇi kā ya / ba la ba la/ ma hā be nag dha ra bi kṛ ta smyon ya khon/ rda: 11ka rā la ma hā te dzaḥsna dha ra dha ra bi pu la dza na ba ra da ma hā kā 1 ru ṇi kā ya/ ma hā pa tshashu pa ti dbe ṣa ladha ra/ sa ra sa ra/ pra ba ra pu t+ma 1 sam bhā 18ra/ su ga ta dh+yā 19na sa mā dhi / sa man ta a ba lo ki ta/ yī shwa ra 2nyam he 2 shwa ra/ duṣ+ṭa 2 da ma ka /ro 2 dra pra la ya 5da ma ka /kro dha rā dza ma hā be 2 ga dha ra/ sa ma sa ma ma hā s+thā ma māsta rje/ tsan+d+ra srur+ya a ti 2 re ka pra bha ma 9la ma la sarba ma la bi sho da dha ka sarba ṛ ṣi 1ga na danasan ta ti nam hā ma he shwa ri ra rū pa dha ra/ a mi tā da bha dzi nā dkyilang kṛ da ta dza ṭa/ dak+ṣi na tsan+d+ra lo kṛ ta shi raḥ 48/ ma tha ma tha/ sarba yak+ṣa rāk+ṣa 9sa bhū ta ga ṇa bhañdza 1ka ta ra/ta ra ta ra ga ṇa sa mā lam̐ kṛ ta / nak+ṣa tra mā la sarba bespyo na bi nā sha na ka ra/pa ra mi tri tsit+ta rim hā kā ru 0ṇi kā/ pa ra pa ra/ pa ri pūr+ṇa maṇ+ḍa la sau mya mu kha/ ṣa ṭa pā khor mi tā/ pa ri pū ri ra ka /mi li mi li/ e ṇi 51ya tsarma ni bā rinas na/ byā gh+ra tsamota ri ta ri ya/ dha ra dha ra/ sarba ta 5 thā ga ta a ba lo ki ta/ tri ne tra tri rigashu la dha ra/ badz+ra dz+wa 56la dha ra/ a mo gha pā sha ha steni / ya ma ba ga ru ṇa ku be ra rū pa dha ra/ nā ge na dra rū 59pa dha ra0 / gyi bi ma la bi shud dha sgo de ha sarba pā pa spyo sha ma ka sar+pā ne ba ra ṇi kyi bi sho dha ka /sarba ki la slobi ṣa nā sha kyi ka /s+t+ri lo kya ba shaṃ ka ra/ sarba satā spyo bi sho dha ka /bo 69dhi satā stob ra da 1/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ a dhiṣ+ṭha te/ o pad+ma bi bhū lha'i ta/shud dhe dhi ri dhi ri/ a ba lo ki ya mā na/ sa ma sa ma/ sarba kurma me sā dha beya/ a mo gha pā sha hro da ya sid dhe / gu h+ya ni ba si ni ba ra da hūṃ phaṭa/92wa 239

na mos te swā 1hā/ grub pa don yod pa rig sngags kyi rgyal po 'di bshad ma thag tu 2'byung po'i tshogs dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang /bgegs dang / log 'dren de dag thams cad kha bub tu 5)'gyel te/gcig tu 'bar bar gyur cing gnas kyang 'bar bar gyur pa ri ridang / de nas gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po phyag na rdo rje dga' bas ba spu langs te/ skrag par gyur pa'i lha 5tshogs thams cad dang / brgya 6byin dang / tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / skrag 7par 'gyur ba'i 8lha dang / lha ma yin dang / drang srong spa 59gong ba thams cad dang / rgya 1 mtsho na gnas pa'i klu'i rgyal po thams cad dang / chu bran thams cad dang / lha dang / klu gang 11dag chu na gnas pa thams cad dang / rgya 12mtsho chen po'i lha dang / lha gang dag lang ku'i 1 grong khyer na gnas pa thams cad dang / rig sngags 'chang khu'akhor los sgyur 8ba thams cad dang 17/ gang dag gnas gtsang 1 ma'i ris 12kyi lha rnams dang /nam mkha'i 19lha thams cad 2 'khrugs par gyur nas nam mkha' las babs te/bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i las dang byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug de la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ lha'i me tog rnam pa sna tshogs pad+ma dang / ku mu da 2 dang / ut+pa la dang / puṇa ḍa rī 22ka dang / man dā ge ra ba dang / man dā 2 ra ba chen po'i char dang / lha'i rgyan dang lhab lhub kyi char pus mo nub tsam ri bo po ṭa 5lar phab ste/ lha'i sil snyan dang /glu na dbyangs len cing ha ha zhes ca co dang ga zha'i sgra bton rjenas/ bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis sems can thams cad kyi 92—240

don du rig sngags 'chang (17chen po 'di bshad do zhes ched du brjod pa chen po ched du brjod do/ /de nas gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po phyag na rdo rje byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gang na ba der song ste/ lan gsum bskor nab byas nas mchod pa'i phyir mu tig ri rigi do shal brgya 4rwastong ri ba phul te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 5rig sngags chen po'i 6cho ga zhib mo thams cad kyi mchog bshad do/ /don yod pa'i zhags pa'i rgyal po rig sngags chen po'i snying po 'jig rten 7mgon po thub pa chen pos 58)bshad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das cho ga zhib 9mo mtha' dag don yod pa'i 1 rirgyal po grub 11pa'i mchog las thams cad grub pa 12bshad du gsol/de nas de'i don du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi 1 don yod pa'i zhags sapa'i snying po cho ga zhib mo grub pa don yod patsha/ rig sngags kyi rgyal po ras kyi sku tshagazugs bsgrub pa'i mchog /cho ga dang yo byad du bcas pa bshad pa / ras gru bzhi pa kun nas cha legs par phye ba/ kha tshar 1 ma bcad pa skra med pa/ ri mo mkhan gtsang 18ma khrus byas pas gos gtsang ma bgos la gso sbyong dang ldan par byas pas/ tshon lhag ma ma yin pa snod sar 19par bzhag la bri bar bya ste/ dbus su 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ral pa'i thor tshugs kyis bzhugs shing / rgyal ba 'od dpag med kyis brgyan 2 pa thor tshugs kyi nilhagayas su zla tshes kyis brgyan 2pa/ ri dgas e ne da ya'i pags na pa gyon pa / phyugs bdag gi cha lugs 'chang ba/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan 5pa/dbu 27gsum spyan gsum phyag bzhi pa/ ri'i steng na pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa/zhal dbus ma zhi ba'i zhal bzhin 'dzum pa/ zhal g.yas pa 'jigs su rung ba 92—241

khro gnyer can/ thor tshugs 'od dpag med kyis brgyan 1pa/ dbu zla tshes kyis brgyan 2pa/ zhal g.yon pa 'jigs su rung ba bzhin bsgyur cing mche ba gtsigs pa/ rgyal ba 'od dpag med dbu la bzhugs pa/ phyag gcig na pad+ma thogs pa/ gnyis pa rtse gsum thogs pa/ gsum pa don yod zhags pa sku'i phyed na 'dzin pa la/ bcom ldan 'das zhal khro gnyer can don yod zhags pa'i phyag rgya bcings pa'i phyag la spyan cagatod par bya 5zhing / bzhi pa dbugs 'byin pa'i phyag tu bya 6zhing 'od 'dom gang ba khor 7 yug 'bar ba dang ldan par bya'o/ /g.yas phyogs na lha mo sgrol ma 'gying bag dang bcas shing lus btud par mchog sbyin pa'i phyag la mig gtod par 8bya'o/ /g.yon du pad+ma'i rigs mdzes ma 'dzem 9bag dang bcas sna pa gsang sngags kyi tshul dang rjes su mthun 11zhing don yod pa'i zhags pa la mig gtod par 12bya'o/ /lha mo sgrol ma'i bar du gnod sbyin mo ral pa gcig ma bya'o/ /pad+ma'i rigs mdzes ma'i snanabar du khro gnyer can bya'o/ /phyogs gnyis par lha mo dkar mo lag na pad+ma thogs pa bya'o/ /pad+ma'i rigs mdzes ma'i 'og tu pho nya mo gsang sngags kyi rjes ngasu 'brang bar dbya'o/ /ral logacig ma'i 'og tu lha mo chen mo 'jigs 1 byed ma bya'o na / /gang 19du gnas gtsang ma'i rigs kyi lha'i bu dang brgya byin dang /tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug 21chen po me tog sna tshogs thogs te bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa 22byed par dbya'o/ /'og tu rgyal po chen po bzhi bya'o/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi 'og tu 'phags pa phyag na rdo rje 'jigs su rung ba gad rgyangs can khro bo don yod pa'i rgyal po dang smra ba 2 bya'o/ /ras kyi sku gzugs 'di mthong ba tsam gyis 'phags pa spyan ras 92—242

gzigs dbang phyug ri bo 1po ṭa nal na gzhal med khang dang bcas pa mngon sum du mthong bar rig par bya'o// //'phags pa don yod pa'i zhags pa'i cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po/ bam po bcu pa / mthong ba tsam gyis sems can dmyal ba chen po brgyad las thar bar 'gyur/'jigs pa chen po brgyad 4las yongs su grol bar 'gyur/ mtshams 5med pa lnga byed pa yongs su thar bar 'gyur/ dam pa'i chos spong ba dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams 6cad spong bas mthong ba tsam gyi mod la rnam par dag par 'gyur/ mnar med pa 7la gzhol ba'i mthar thug pa yang yongs su grol bar 'gyur ro/ /tshangs pa chen po'i bsod nams brgya stong gi dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed rinapar 'gyur/ 'jig rten pa 9thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba mchog thob par 'gyur/ 'chi ba'i dus na 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mngon sum du ston par 'gyur zhing dbugs 'byin par 'gyur/ shi nas bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams su skye bar 'gyur/ sgrib pa thams cad dang bral nas tshe rabs brgya stong phrag lnga bcu 1 rjes su dran par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub kyi 11snying po'i mthar thug gi bar du skye ba 'di tha ma yin te/ 'di mthong ba tsam gyis 1 bsod nams kyi 1 phung po dang ldan par 'gyur na/ lhag par mang du byed pa lta ci smos tes/ de ni phyir mi ldog par 'gyur/ bla na med pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo'am/ dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen tshanam/ dge bsnyen sama'am/ rgyal po dang / blon po dang / btsun mo'i 'khor dang bcas pa'am / btsun mo dam pa gang la la zhig gis ras kyi sku gzugs bsgrub par bya 92—243

ba de'i spyan sngar/ don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po dran par byed cing /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug de la yang mchod par byed 91nyen/ des na khyod kyis 'di ltar rig par bya ste/ don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po stong phrag brgya 'gyur 2du bzlas shing bzlas brjod kyi cho ga chen po byas pa yin no/ /gang zhig khro bo don yod pa'i zhags pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar mi smra bar lan gsum bzlas brjod bya ste / chus (snyedabang bskur na des na khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bdag byang chub kyi snying po la thug gi bar du dbang bskur bar 'gyur ro/ /snyam du de ltar shes par bya'o/ /gang gis don yod par grub pa'i cho ga zhib mo chen po'i gzungs6/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ras kyi sku gzugs kyi spyan sngar mngon sum du thal mo sbyar te 'dug nas lan gsum bzlas te/bskor 7ba lan bdun byas la chu'i nang du 8rimachod yon dang / lha bshos dang /bdug spos dang / me tog phul nas phyag 'tshal lo zhes smras na/ des khyod kyis 'di ltar shes par bya ste/ gzungs thams cad so sor lan stong phrag brgya bzlas par 'gyur zhing / don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po rnam par grol ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi chos kyi rnam grangs chen po 'di lan stong phrag brgya 59ribazlas par 'gyur ro/ /don yod pa'i zhags pa'i phyag rgya byas la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi zhal la mig gtad de lag pa g.yas pagayon gnyis sbyar la/snying gar 1 gzhag cing tshul 'dis phyag rgya re re nas lan stong phrag brgya byas par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo'am/ dge slong ngam na/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma'am/1292—244

rgyal po dang / rgyal po'i tsho1btsun mo dam pa gang la la zhig 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po 'di brgya stong phrag khri bzlas brjod bya bar 'dod pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa brgya stong phrag khris 2dbang bskur bar 'dod pa dang rnam par grol ba'i dkyil 'khor mtha' dag gi cho ga zhib mo 'di rdzogs par lan brgya stong khri bzlas dpar 'dod pa dang /don yod pa'i zhags pa'i phyag rgya 'di lan brgya stong phrag khri bya bar 'dod pa des ras kyi sku gzugs la brtson par bya ste/ ras kyi sku gzugs sngon 4du bzhag nas gnas gtsang zhing 5dben par phyoganas sam/ 'chag 7sa'am dgon pa'i gnas sam/ phug gam/ ri'i rtse mo'am/ gtsug lag khang ngam/ khang par gtsang sbra dang byi dor bya ste/8 ba ser mo'i lci ba legs par mnyes la/ ba las byung ba lnga dang bsres te bskus la spos sna tshogs kyi byug pas byugs nas 9ras kyi sku gzugs kyi spyan sngar tsan+dan dkar po'i dkyil 'khor byas te / gur gum gyis 37khru do'i tshad tsam bris la gla rtsi dang ga bur gyis mchod par bya'o/ /dri chab kyi bum pa dri rnam 12pa sna tshogs kyis bkang ste/ ras kyi mgul 1 chings kyis bcings la/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su gzhag par bya/ me tog dang bdug spos dri zhim po dang / 7me tog gi phreng ba nyi shu rtsa gcig gzhag par bya/ dri chab kyis bkang ba brgyad phyogs bzhir gzhag par byas/ 'o mas bkang tshaba'i snod brgyad gzhag par bya/ stegs bu'i drung du 'o mas bkang ba'i snod gzhag par bya/ 'o thug dang / sbyar thug dang / khaṇ+ḍa 1 kha bya dang / 'bras chan 1 dang / lag pan dang / bu ram dang sha kha ra dang / zhun mar gyis 19bkang ba'i snod gzhag par bya/ a ga 0ru nag po dang tsan+dan dkar po dang / ga 92—245

bur dang / kun du ru 1dang / shi ri bā sa ka dang / cung beng rnams snod dang bcas pa 2bzhag nas/ a ga ru'i yam sreg ri shing gis sbyin sreg 55nibya/me tog sna tshogs kyis brgyan snyopar bya / mar gyi mar me sum cu rtsa gnyis bltam 8par bya'o/ /de nas rig 9sngags 'chang gtsang tshams gos gtsang ma bgos shing khrus legs par byas pas 11tshes bcu bzhi nas bcwa 12lnga'i bar du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs 1 dbang phyug gi ras kyi sku gzugs la mchod par bya'o / /de'i 'og tu rig sngags 'chang gis 'khro bo'i rgyal po lan bdun bzlas te / dri chab kyis dbang bskur 15bar bya/ don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bya/ de nas mi smra bar skyil samo krung 1 du 'dug ste bzlas brjod kyi phyag rgya bcings la don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas par 1 bya de'i 'og tu don yod par grub pa'i rig sngags kyi rgyal po stong rtsa brgyad bzlas par byas na/ de nas ras kyi sku gzugs las 'od zer bdun byung nas kun tu snang bar byas te19/ lan gsum bskor )ba byas nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi dpral ba'i spyan du zhugs sa par 'gyur ro/ /zhugs pa tsam gyi mod la sa chen po g.yo 2 bar 'gyur zhing rig sngags 'chang yang snying dga' zhing ba spu ldang bar 'gyur/ mdog mdangs yongs su dag par 'gyur / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi mchog sbyin pa'i phyag gi sor mo las lha'i chu 'dzag par 'gyur/ zhabs gnyis las 'o ma 'dzag par 'gyur / don yod pa'i zhags pa'i phyag 'bar bar 'gyur/ phyag na pad+ma'i pad+ma lo ma g.yo 2 bar 'gyur25/ rtse gsum g.yo bar 'gyur zhing legs so zhes bya ba'i sgra 'byung 0bar 'gyur te/ rigs kyi bu legs so legs so/ /khyod kyis don 92—246

yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po grub kyis 1las thams cad byos shig khyod kyis nadon yod grub pa'i cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po chen po'i ri dam pa grub po zhes nas/ de nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug rang gis 4gzugs ston par 'gyur ro5/ /'dod pa thams cad kyi mchog sbyin par mdzad do/ /'di ni grub pa'i mchog bla na med pa ste/ ma bsgrubs par las byed pa'o6ri/ /de nas dbang du bya bar 'dod pas 7me tog pad+ma la lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas 8la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phul te/ gang gi ming nas brjod pa de dbang du 'gyur ro/ /sna ma'i me tog la lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te/'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phul la9/ yang lan bdun bzlas nas me tog snying po blangs nas 1 gang la byin 11pa de 12dbang du 'gyur ro/ /gdon gyis zin pa la byin na gdon 1 thams cad las yongs su grol bar 'gyur ro / /nad kyis thebs ngapa la byin na nad thams cad las yongs su grol bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po'i sgor gtor na rgyal po btsun mo'i 'khor dang bcas pa dbang du 'gyur ro/ /mi ro bsregs pa'i sa'i steng du gtor na/ sems can de sems can dmyal ba las yongs su grol bar 'gyur ros/ /mnar med pa na gnas pa'i sems can la gtor na skad cig de la yongs su grol bar 'gyur17/nyal ba'i sngas su bzhag na rmi lam chen po mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sku ston par mdzad cing yid du 'ong ba thams cad gsung bar 'gyur ro/ /skyes pa'am bud med gang gi steng du gtor ba de dbang du 'gyur zhing grib ma bzhin phyi bzhin 1 'brang bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po'i steng du gtor na de bzhin du 'gyur ro/ /lha'i gzugs brnyan gyi steng du bzhag na 92—247

'gugs tsho1par 'gyur zhing las thams cad byed par 'gyur ro/ /mig sman tsosgrub par 'dod pas ras kyi sku gzugs kyi spyan sngar mig sman ldong (geros la stong rtsa brgyad bzlas nas 5grub pa'i rtags phyiragasum ston par 'gyur te/ 'bar ba dang dbu 7ba 'byung ba dang / dud pa 'byung bar 'gyur te/ des mig la bskus nan mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /gter thams cad mthong bar 'gyur ro59ri/ /gnod sbyin gyi gnas thams cad mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /dpral bar thig le byas na phugs 7thams cad du 'jug par 'gyur/ sgo thams cad dang 'khrul 3)'khor thams cad 'bye 12bar 'gyur lha/ yan lag dang nying lag la bskus yin nam mkha' la 'gro bar 'gyur/ spyi bor thig le byas na 8'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug rtag tu lamachog sbyin par 'gyur ro/ /mig la byugs na/khyab 'jug dang dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa nya lha rnams rtag tu phyi bzhin 'brang bar 'gyur zhing / dgos pa thams cad 'grub par byed do/ /mtshan mo mig la bskus na nyin mo bzhin du mthong bar 'gyur zhing / gter thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur te/ kha phug 12nas dor bar bya'o/ /rang gi lus la byugs //na ji srid 'tsho'i bar du go cha bgos pa'i lus su 'gyur/ gnod sbyin dang srin po la sogs ri pas mi mthong bar 'gyur zhing las thams cad byed par 'gyur te nya/tshe bskal pa stong thub par 'gyur ro/ / yang na 2bza' ba dang snying gar bsku lhab byas na nag po chen po'i gzugs su 'gyur zhing lha thams cad kyi gzugs ston par 'gyur ba nas/ tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug chen po'i gzugs dang gzugs sna tshogs mang po ston par 'gyur/ zla ba dang nyi ma ston par 'gyur ro / /ldong ros dang / gi waṃ 2dang / sau 'bi rā ka dang /92wa 248

gur gum 1)dang / kra ku dha la don yod par grub tsho pa khri bzlas don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po stong rtsa brgyad bzlas khro bo'i rgyal po brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa byas te5ge/ thams cad du mi smra bar bya zhing 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi spyan sngar btags la/ ras kyi sku gzugs la mngon du phyogs te/gtsang mas gos gtsang 55ma bgos la tshes bcwa 6lnga nya la nyin zhag gcig smyung 7ba byas nas rinaphye ma zhib tu btags te/ yang don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po dang / khro bo'i (97rgyal po dang / don yod pa'i 7grub pa'i rig sngags kyi rgyal po lan brgya 3rtartsa brgyad bzlas brjod byas la/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi phyag tu bzhag ste12/ mchod pa chen po byas nas ras kyi sku gzugs la mchod pa byas la nyin 1 zhag gcig smyung 1 ba byas te/ ras kyi sku gzugs kyi spyan sngar skyil mo krung skadu 'dug pa tshal don yod pa'i zhags pa'i phyag rgya lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bya/ don yod pa'i zhags 1 pa'i snying po lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas par bya ste12/ bzlas brjod kyi phyag rgya byas la khro bo'i gsang sngags lan bdun bzlas te/ de'i 'og tu mig la bskus nas don yod par grub pa'i gzungs bzlas par byas na/ bskus pa tsam gyis 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ri bo po ṭa 19la dang bcas gzhal med khang dang bcas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs gzhal med khang dang bcas pa'i ri bo po ṭa 21la na 22gnas pa mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams mthong bar 'gyur zhing de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med chos 'chad pa mthong bar 'gyur/chos bshad pa de yang thos par 'gyur ro na/ /phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas 2 nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas 92—249

sangs rgyas kyi zhing gzhal med khang dang bcas pa mthong bar 'gyur zhing chos 'chad pa'i gsung gi sgra de yang thos par 'gyur ro/ /'di ltar rigs ngan gyi rigs su skyes pa dang / mnar med pa la gzhol ba dang / mtshams med pa lnga byed pa gang yin pa thams cad kyang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 1byin gyis brlabs 2dang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi thugs rjes gdagongs par 'gyur zhing rmi lam du ston par mdzad do/ /sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sbyong bar 'gyur/ mchog thams cad sbyin par 'gyur/don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po'i dngos grub sbyin par 'gyur/ lha'i lo stong du 'tsho bar 'gyur zhing lha'i bde ba nyams su myong bar 'gyur/ nad kyis thebs pa thams cad la mig sman 'dis bskus can nad thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ri/rims thams cad sel bar 'gyur ro/ /dug thams cad la bskus pa tsam gyis dug med par 'gyur ro/ /'jigs pa thams cad la mig la bskus 96rin mi mthong bar 'gyur/ phyir rgol ba dang dgra bo dang g.yo 7rican dang chom po dang rkun napo thams cad kyis mi mthong bar 'gyur ro9sku/ /mtshon gdab pa'i 'jigs pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur/ 'thab pa dang rtsod 7pa dang khrag khrug 11la mig la bskus 1 na thams cad las rgyal zhing lan thebs par 'gyur ro/ /g.yul ngo thams cad du mig la bskus 1snyen g.yul 'gyed pa las rgyal bar 'gyur zhing dpung gi mchog 7rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po'i pho brang du 'gro ba'i tshe mig la bskus tshan rgyal po btsun mo'i 'khor dang bcas pa dbang du 'gyur ro/ /mi smra bar grong khyer du song na skyes pa dang / bud med dang / khye'u dang / bu mo grong khyer na gnas so cog thams cad dbang du 'gyur ro/ /mig g.yas pa la 92—250

bskus na rigs bzhi'i 'jig rten gang 1mthong ba de thams cad dbang du 'gyur ro / /mig g.yon pa la bskus nan rigs ngan thams cad dbang du 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi phyag g.yas pa nas bzung 3ste/don yod pa grub pa'i rig sngags kyi rgyal po lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bya ste(4 / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la mchod pa byed zin de nas don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po dang / khro bo'i rgyal po dang / gzungs 6thams cad so sor 7lan stong phrag brgya brgya 8bzlas par 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bye ba stong phrag drug 9cu'i drung du dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed 7par 'gyur thams cad kyis ming bzung ba 11byas par 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa stong mnyes par byas par 'gyur15/ de bzhin gshegs pa stong phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi mngon sum 1 du mthong ba thob par 'gyur / 'jig rten pa'i don thams cad 'grub 7par 'gyur/ sngon gyi sgrib pas skamanar med pa'i gnas su 'gro ba yongs su dag par 'gyur/ nam yang glungan song 1 du 'gro bar mi 'gyur/ tshe rabs 1 tshe rabs su skye ba dran par 'gyur/lha thams cad kyang mchog sbyin par 'gyur zhing rtag tu bsrung lha ba dang / bskyab pa dang / sba bar 2 byed par 'gyur ro/ /phyag g.yon pa mnan 21te lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod byas na bzlas pa tsam gyi mod la lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po la sogs 2pa bkug par 'gyur zhing thams cad dbang du 'gyur te gnas so/ /gang gi tshe dgos pa byung rib de'i tshe don yod par grub pa'i rig sngags kyi rgyal po lan bdun bzlas pa byas na lha dang klu la sogs 5pa thams cad kyang las thams cad byed 27cing rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par phyi bzhin 92wa 251

'brang bar 'gyur ro/ /lte ba'i gnas su mnan te klu la sogs pa thams cad char gyi rgyun 'bebs par 'gyur ro1/ /'dzam bu'i gling mtha' dag tshim par byed par 'gyur ro snyam du lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas na gang dang gang du song ba der skyes pa'am/ bud med dam/ rgyal po'am/ rgyal mo'am/ dge sbyong ngam / bram ze'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen rin)ma la gang bsams 5)pa dang gang bcol ba dang / casmras pa'i las de thams cad bsgrub par 'gyur ro/ /dbu munas bzung ste bzlas nas 6tshangs pa'i 'jig rten gyi bar du dbang du byas par 'gyur te/ thams cad la 7chodabang bsgyur zhing 8chibasgo ba bzhin byed par 'gyur ro/ /thog mar bzlas 9brjod stong rtsa brgyad byas nas bzlas par 51 bya'o/ /zhabs gnyis mnan te stong phrag bcu bzlas pa byas na sa'i 1rta'og yan chad dbang du byas par 'gyur zhing las thams cad byed par 'gyur te/ mngag gzhug 8thams cad byed par 'gyur ro/ /pad+ma la stong rtsa brgyad bzlas 1snyenas pad+ma'i mtshe'ur bor na pad+ma zad mi shes par 7'byung zhing pad+ma dus thams cad par 'gyur ro/ /ut+pal la lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas nas ut+pa tshala'i mtshe'ur lngabor na 1 ut+pa la sngon po zad mi shes pa 'byung bar 'gyur zhing nam yang tsho nyams par mi 'gyur te/ dus thams cad du me tog 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du sna ma'i me tog dang gan dha hāk+ṣi 19ka dang / yu thi ka dang / na ba mā lha'i me tog rnams kyang dus thams cad 21du me tog 'byung bar 'gyur zhing zad mi shes par 'gyur ro/ /'bras bu dang / me tog la lan brgya nartsa brgyad bzlas rite skyed 2 mos tshal lam nags tshal gyi nang du gtor na me tog dang 'bras bu zad mi shes shing dus thams cad par 'gyur ro/ /dpal chen mo dgug par 'dod 92wa 252

pas spra zhi)tshil las lha mo dpal chen mo skyil (5)mo krung ( )phyed du 'dug pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan (4)pa lus btud pa lag pa na pad+ma thogs pa brang rgyas pa byas la 'bras bu dang / me tog dgram (5)par bya zhing ga bur dang / gla rtsi dang /tsan+dan dkar pos (ne mchod pa byas la ras kyi sku gzugs kyi spyan sngar gzhag par bya zhing sngar tsan+dan dkar po las byas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bzhin byas la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 7tshoras kyi sku gzugs la a ga 8ru'i bdug pa dbul bar bya9/ dpal lha mo chen mo la tsan+dan dkar po'i bdug pa dbul bar bya zhing gnyis ka la mchod pa dang bsnyen bkur bobya gtor ma dkar po dang dri chab dbul bar bgyi/ mchod yon stong dbul 11bar bya ste12/ rig sngags 'chang gtsang mas 1 dus gsum du khrus byas shing gos gtsang tshim bgos pas mngon du phyogs te/ skyil tshamo krung du tsha'adug nas don yod pa'i zhags pa'i phyag rgya lan bdun byas la ji snyed 1 pa'i dri dang phreng ba dang me tog la don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po lan brgya 1/rtsa brgyad 19bzlas te/ dpal lha mo chen mo'i ni nomago la gdags par bya/ me tog gzhan gyis mchod pa 37bya zhing tsan+dan dkar po la lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa'i bdug spos dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas par na bya zhing yungs kur 2 re re zhing 2 bzlas la dpal lha mo chen mo la bsnun par byas te 5/ stong rtsa brgyad tshang 24ba dang / dpal lha mo chen mo 'bar bar 'gyur zhing 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi dpral ba nas 'od zer 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dkyil 'khor gyi yo byad gang yin pa thams cad gser du snang bar 'gyur ro/ /dpal lha mo chen mo bkug par 92—253

'gyur zhing ji srid 'tsho'i bar du 'da' bar mi 'gyur ro/ /lha'i dpal rjes su spyod par 'dod na nyin re zhing 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang dpal lha mo chen mo 1la dus gsum du mchod pa bya zhing mchod yon gyi snod rinakyang gzhag par bya/ dkon mchog nagasum mchod par bya sbyin par bya/ longs spyad 4ripar bya/ bsod nams kyang bya zhing dpal lha mo chen mo la dus (5)gsum du mchod par bya'o/ /dpal lha mo chen mo rang gi gzugs kyis gnas par 'dod pas don yod pa'i rgyal po ne khro bo'i snying po stong rtsa 97ribargyad bzlas par (85bya zhing tsan+dan gyi ril bu stong rtsa brgyad kyis lus 9)bdug par bya/ yungs kur tshastong rtsa brgyad kyis bsnun par bya ste rte/ yungs kur 7stong rtsa brgyad tshang ba dang sna /dpal lha mo chen mo rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan tshapa lha'i nor bu dang gser dang mu tig gi rgyan gyis brgyan skapa'i lus snang la zhal tshapad+ma kha phye ba lta bu spyan ut+pal sngon po ltar gsal ba pad+ma bsnams nyu pa gdan pad+ma nor bu dang / rin po che tu dang / gser mang po'i 17pad+ma'i char 'bebs pa rin po che 'bar ba'i bum pa stong phrag brgya thogs pa lha'i bu mo dang gnod sbyin gyi bu mo brgya stong mang po thams cad lha'i rgyan gyis brgyan pas 1lus gsal zhing 'bar la mdzes pa mang pos yongs su bskor 2ba mdun du rina'akhod par 'gyur te/ rig sngags 'chang gi 2 'jigs par mi bya zhing sems dga' bar byas la gsang sngags 'di lan bdun bzlas par 25bya'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma na ār+ya a 2 ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bho dhi tshosatā ya/ ma ri rihā satā ya/ ma hā kā da ru ṇi kā ya/ma hā a mo gha ba ra dā ya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ pad+me ni sa pad+ma ne da tra padhe sa4ge/ pad+ma dha re pad+ma bha te gi/ pad+ma pri ye pad+ma gi rī 7pad+mā pra bho ce 7pad+mā shes na pra tikhri 692wa 254

dpal dri ma med pa zhes bya ba'i cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po mngon sum du 'gyur/ cho ga zhib mo mang po 'grub par 'gyur tshe lo stong phrag bcu thub par 'gyur/ rgyal ba 'od dpag med byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa ri1)thabs cig 2tu gzhal med khang mchog na chos bgro nib mthong bar 'gyur/ rdzu 'phrul gyis (genam mkha' la 'gro bar 'gyur/ nor bu chen po pad+ma la lta ba zhes bya ba don yod pa'i zhags pa chen po'i 'khor los sgyur 55ribar 'gyur/ rig sngags 'chang thams cad kyis ne'akhor los sgyur 7ba'i gtso bo gcig pur 'gyur/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sras su 'gyur(8ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sras gcig pur 'gyur9/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang /1 lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang 11/ mi'am ci dang /lto 'phye 12chen po rnams kyi bu'i gtso bo gcig pur 'gyur rgyal po chen po bzhi'i bu gcig pur 'gyur/ thams cad du stobs dang / pha rol gnon 1 pa dang /brtson 'grus thogs pa med pa dang ldan par 'gyur1 / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phyag rgya dang dkyil 'khor rim pa 'phye ba rig sngags kyi rgyal po gsang 17ba'i gzungs kyi rgyal po cho ga zhib mo zab pa dag mngon sum du 'gyur/lha thams cad kyi gnas dang / klu thams cad kyi gnas dang / mi'am ci thams cad kyi gnas dang / phug dang khung gi gnas thams cad sgo 'bye bar 1 'gyur / gnod sbyin dang srin po'i gnas thams cad sgo 'bye bar 18'gyur/thams cad dbang du 'gyur zhing bgyi ba ci mchis zhes 19bya ba byed cing 'dug par 'gyur/ 'jig rten thams cad kyi ston pa bla ma gcig pu 'jig rten mgon po dang 'dra bar mchod pa'i gnas su 'gyur/ 'jig rten pa 1dang 'jig 92—256

rten las 'das pa'i gsang sngags dang dkyil 'khor thams cad grub pa chen por 'gyur / dpal lha mo chen mo 'khor dang bcas pa la sbyin sreg byas na rig sngags 'chang de la bu bzhin du byams pas rang nyid bsnyen bkur 1yongs su spyad pas yongs su naspyod do/ /'dod pa thams cad dang yid du 'ong ba thams cad kyi dgos pa byed par 'gyur ro/ nor snyedang / 'bru (4dang / dbyig dang / gser dang / nor bu dang / mu tig dang / bai ḍūr+ya (nadang / shang kha 56)shi la dang / byi ru dang / sa le sbram dang / dngul dang /7 lha'i nor bu chen po 8rin po che'i bar thams cad sbyin par byed do/ /yul ka shi ku'i gos bzang po mang po sbyin par byed cing lha'i bza' ba dang / btung ba'i bar dang bdud rtsi'i ro'i 97bar du sbyin par byed do/ /gnas thams cad du song ba na yang rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par bu la byams pa'i tshul gyis rtag tu phyi bzhin 'brang zhing 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags 'chang gi 1 rang gi khyim yang rgyal po'i pho brang lcang lo can ji lta ba 11bzhin du rig sngags 'chang gi gzhal med khang mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /rnam thos kyi bu'i gnas na 'byor pa ji lta 12ba bzhin rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug chen po 1 dus kun tu 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po rdo rje 'chang yang rig sngags 'chang gi ngatshogs thams cad dang / gnod sbyin chen po gsang tshab pa'i 'khor rnams dang rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par bsrung sab dang / bskyab pa dang / sba ba 1 byed par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du dpal lha mo chen mo 'khor dang bcas pa dang rnam thos kyi bu gnod sbyin bye bas yongs su bskor bas nyin mtshan du bsrung 12ba dang / bskyab pa dang / sba ba 19byed par 'gyur ro/ /de 92—257

nas don yod pa'i rgya mtsho nor bu chen po pad+ma la lha'i 1)dpal dri ma med pa zhes bya ba don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po'i tshon cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po bklags 5pas 'grub par 'gyur zhing de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang gā'i klung byugi bye ma bye ba khrag khrig brgya 95)stong phrag (7drug cu rtsa bzhi'i rdul phra mo snyed las 7dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed (87par 'gyur 9)/ bsod nams kyi phung po chen po dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo'am / dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/kyi dge bsnyen 11ma gang la la zhig gis lha'i nor bu rin po che chen po dang nor bu rin po che chen po 12sna bdun dang / lha'i gser dang / gser gyi me tog dang / dngul gyi me tog mang po dang / lha'i gos dang / lha'i rgyan 1 dang / lha'i dri dang / me tog dang /7 me tog phreng tshadang / byug pa rnams re re zhing 'phang du ri'i rgyal po ri rab tsam gyi phung po byas nas/ de dag de bzhin gshegs pa gang gā'i 17klung gi bye ma snyed bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag sna modrug cu rtsa bzhi'i rdul phra mo snyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa re re la tshul de lta bus so sor de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la nyin re zhing / lo gcig gi bar du 'bul 38bar byed mchod pa dang bsnyen bkur /9byed cing de bzhin gshegs pa re re'i spyan sngar dri zhim po dang ldan pa'i til mar rgya mtsho tsam gyis bkang ba'i mar me bltam na par byed pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po dang ldan par 'gyur/ dge ba'i rtsa ba chen po yongs su bzung 1bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te don yod pa'i rgya mtsho'i nor bu chen po pad+ma la rnam par blta da ba'i dpal dri ma med pa don yod pa'i zhags 92—258

pa'i snying po 'di klog pa dang bzlas brjod brgya rtsa brgyad byed pa 'di ni bsod nams kyi phung po de dang ldan par 'gyur zhing / dge ba'i rtsa ba chen po dang ldan par 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs par 'gyur / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis yongs su gzung bar 1'gyur/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad sku ston par 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 5lung ston par 'gyur/ dpal lha mo chen mo de yang mchog thams cad sbyin par 'gyur/ dus kun tu de'i khyim du dpal gnas par 'gyur te / gang na ( stadapal lha mo chen mo gnas pa der 4de bzhin gshegs pa gang gā'i 5klung gi bye ma bye ba khrag khrig brgya phyistong phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi'i rdul phra mo dang mnyam pas phyogs de nyid du gnas par 'gyur te/ dpal lha mo de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 7yum yin pa'i phyir ro/ /lha dang / klu dang /tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug chen po'i gsang sngags dang /cho ga zhib mo dang / phyag rgya dang / dkyil 'khor dang / zhi ba dang / rgyas pa dang / drag shul naspyod pa dang / las sna tshogs gzhan dag pas dpal lha mo chen mo'i las 9mchog tu ston ngoto/ /dpal lha mo chen mo ni byang chub sems dpa' kyilhathams cad kyi yum skayin no/ /dpal lha mo chen mo ni don yod pa'i 1lhamachog sbyin pa'o/ /don yod pa'i zhags pa 〉sbyin pa'o/ /don yod pa'i grags pa rgya chen po sbyin pa'o/ /don yod pa'i nam mkha'i tshagazhal med khang 'chang ba'os / /don yod pa'i yon tan bsgrags 7pa'i mchog sbyin pa'o/ /dpal lha mo chen po 18ni don yod pa'i 19zla ba dang / nyi ma'i 'od byed pa gnas sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi nang na dpal lha mo chen mo mchog tu bstan to/ /de nas rig sngags 92—259

'chang gtsang mas 17khrus legs par byas pa (5nidri chus bsangs shing ba las byung ba lngas byugs pa/ gos gtsang rim bgos pas kha zas gtsang ma bza' bar bya zhing 4richang dang / sha dang big btsong 5dang / sgog skya dang ke'u rnams dang /'dres pa dang / 'bags ne pa rnams yongs su spang bar (7bya/ kha zas ngan pa dang / btung ba ngan pa dang / gos ngan pa dang / dri ma can yongs su spang bar 58bya/ sems can ngan pa dang / rten 49pa dang / ngan g.yo can dang / gsod skyen 7can dang / skye bo ngan pa can dang / khrel med pa dang / snying rje med pa dang / byams pa dang bral ba dang / thub chod /lhacan gyi skye bo ngan pa yongs su spang bar 12bya'o/ /gnas ngan pa dang / gnas rten 1 ngan pa dang /bgom khunyes dang / bza' nyes dang / grib ma ngan pa yongs su spang bar dbya/gcig gis gcig 'bags 7pa'i kha zas ngan pa yongs su spang bar 1 tshobya zhing dri dang bdug spos kyis bsangs te mi smra bar bzlas brjod bya snye/ byams pa dang /snying rje dang / dga' ba'i sems dang yid bde bar 17bya/ bkra shis tshang bar bya zhing 2 snying dga' ba dang / mgu ba dang / rab tu dga' ba'i sems su byas nas bzlas brjod bya'o/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la a ga ru'i 21bdug pa dbul 2bar bya/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la tu ru ska'i na bdug pa dbul bar bya/ dpal lha mo chen mo la tsan+dan gyi bdug spos dbul bar bya zhing dus ji lta ba'i me tog dbul ri ribar bya ste/ gsang sngags 'di lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas te thams cad la dbul ri cibar bya'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ༷ār+ya a ba lo ki 2 te shwa rā 28ya/ bo dhi 2rtosatā ya/ ma hā satā ya / ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tar+ya 1ba/ oṃ put+pa ri bi lo ki te gan dha sa ri re/92wa 260

yin na'o0)/ /bsams (na)pa dang / re ba dang / yid kyi shing rta thams cad mngon par smras pas 'grub par byed do/ /'jig rten dbang phyug gi gsung ste/rtag tu 'di dag thams cad 'grub bo/ /yi dgas rnams kyis zas rnyed cing /lha rdzas kyi gos dang rgyan mchog rab tu 'gyur ro/ /bdag gi sdig pa thams cad rtag tu grol bas dmyal ba las grol te/ dmyal ba (gumi bzad pa thams cad las grol lo/ /sdug bsngal thams cad las grol te/ skye bo bde ba la rtse bar byed do/ /bde zhing bde 'gror 'gro la bde ba thams cad du thob par byed do //bdug spos 'dis bdugs (5pas mchog gi 67dri snom par byed de / rdul dang mun pa can thams cad bdug pa bsnams pas sangs par byed de/ dper na nyi ma shar bas 'jig rten gyi mun pa rnam par sangs par byed pa bzhin no/ /bdug pa'i rgyal po 'dis sdug bsngal thams cad rnam par nyams par byed cing /dmyal ba thams cad dang sdig 8pa dang 'jigs pa thams cad las grol te/ sa bcu po thob cing bde 'gro'i lam bzang po bstan pa de'i phyir 'bad pa thams cad kyis bdug pa'i rgyal po 'di sbyar bar bya'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis bdug pa po chen po'i rgyal po chen po cho ga zhib mo dang rjes su mthun 7pa 'di gsungs so / /'jig rten mgon po'i spyan sngar/ mchod rten la sa'i phyogs gang du bdug pa 'dis bdug pa 11bya ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gnas rtag tu byin gyis brlabs pa dang / thams cad du rgyal ba dang / de bzhin du lung bstan pa'i sa'i phyogs der gang gā'i 12bye ma bye ba khrag khrig stong phrag snyed kyi sangs rgyas rnams bzhugs pa der rig sngags 'chang gis gang du bdug spos kyis 1 bdugs 92—271

pas rdo rje 'chang bye ba brgya stong phrag rnams dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi dpung dang bcas/ bzhon pa dang bcas pa dang / rtag tu ri gangs ldan dang / de bzhin du 1nor bu bzang po dang / lngas nartsen dang / gang ba bzang po dang /ke lī khri la dang / gnod sbyin chen po yang dag shes dang / mi la zhon pa dang / sangs rgyas stobs dang / stobs po che dang / sgra sgo skyong /skudang / na da kū ri ribe ra dang / rab 'joms dang / dzu ṭa ba ka dang / stobs kyi lha dang / rdzu 'phrul chen po ste pa'adi rnams sde dang bcas/ dpung dang bcas/bzhon pa dang bcas pas nyin mtshan rtag tu gnas nas de bzhin nyid du srung bar byed do/ /bdag gi 'dapal sa gsum gyi lha mo rtag 575tu mchod par byed ༄87do / /rtag tu sa gzhi gang du bdug 9pa rab tu bdug par bya ste/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dang / de bzhin nyid du gsang ba pa tshadang bcas pa dang / chos 'dzin pa la mkhas pa rnams rtag tu srung bar byed cing / de bzhin nyid du tshangs pa dang /drag po lha'i bu rnams dang bcas pa dang / de bzhin 1rtadu khyab 'jug dang /lha'i ris sum cu rtsa gnyis po thams cad du 12dus rtag tu yang srung bar byed do/ /zla ba dang / nyi ma dang / de bzhin nyid 1 du sgra gcan dang / rgyu skar dang /skar ma'i lotshogs dang / mtshan mo'i lha rnams kyis dus rtag tu srung bar byed do / /'jigs ma dang / dpal mo dang / dung can ma'i lha rnams dang /dbyangs can ma dang / sa 'dzin gyi lha rnams dang / chu lha dang / ljon pa dang / nags kyi rtse mo'i lha dang / ri'i lha dang / chu klung dang / lteng ku'i lha dang / gshin rje dang / chu'i lha dang / lus ngan gyi lha dang / gzhon nu'i lha dang / lha'i drang srong bdag nyid che ba dang / lteng ku'i 7lha dang /92wa 272

chu klung dang / lteng ka dang / lha ma yin dang bcas pa'i lha rnams dang / zla ba dang / nyi ma dang / de bzhin du lha rnams kyis rtag tu srung bar byed do/ /rtag tu rjes su 'brang zhing / nyin mtshan rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par rjes su 'brang ste/ sa'i phyogs gang du bdug spos 'dis bdugs pa'i sa phyogs su rtag tu lha'i gnas su byin gyis brlabs so/ /'jig rten dbang phyug dang / mgon po dang / bla ma dang / rnam par 'dren pa dang / 'jig rten gyi skyabs dang /mchog sbyin par de bzhin nyid 1 du rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par gnas so/ /gnas der bdug spos gang yin pa de dag gis mchog tu bdug par bya'o/ /dri mnams pa tsam gyis myur du sangs rgyas nyid thob bo zhes so/ /sems can kun la phan don phyir/ /sdug bsngal thams cad ldog byed pa'i/ /rdzas kyi ming rnams bshad bya yi/ /lha dang mi rnams mnyan par gyis/ /a ga ru dang rgya spos nyid / /de bzhin tsan+dan ser mor nabacas/ / spro ka nyid dang gi wang 4tshodang / /kun tu ru bcas ma he'i mig /ro dang sra rtsi pog nyid dang / /de bzhin gur gum na lan+da/ /a ru ra bcas dpal bskor ba/ /sā ma rka dang spang spos bcas / /pri yang ku 5bcas tu ru ska/ /ka ya sba dang ba ya sba/ /na me ru dang gla sgang bcas/ /ru rta 6a ga ru nag nyid/ /ga bur dang ni gla rtsi nyid/ /laṅka 7gser shing 'bras bu dang / /arga'i 'o ma gser 'o ma/ /snu ha'i 'o ma nyid dang ni/ /thod pa skal ba ldan nyid dang / /so ma rā dza khyab 'jug gnon / /shing dga' rgyal dang rnam rgyal nyid/ /nā ku lī dri nā ku lī/ /tshangs pa'i bu dang ku mu dang / /pad+ma'i chu ba sbrang rtsi dang / /bu ram dkar po'i khu ba dang / /'di rnams lhan cig sbyar ba yi/ /bdug pa'i mchog 'di bsgrub par bya/ /92—273

mkhas pas legs par khrus byas te/ /gtsang mas gtsang ma'i gos bgos 6)shing / /zla ba nya 'am bcu bzhi la/ /bcu gsum pa'am tshes brgyad la/ /rtag tu sbyar bya nyin mtshan gzung / /sngags la mkhas pas bdug spos 'di/ /so so so sor kun sbyar nas/ /phyag rgya dkyil 'khor gsang sngags dang / /me tog bdug spos dri rgya chen/ /mchod pa'i cho ga 'di yis dang / /gtor ma'i las la mkhas pa dang / /mchod yon snod ni gang ba dang / /mgo la'ang dri dang til mar gyi/ /mar me legs gru gnas su ni/ /legs sbas gtsang mar gnas de sgrub / /legs sbas gtsang mar gnas pa yidas/ /slob 3)ma mchog gi grogs kyis ni / /don yod zhags pa'i spyan snga ru/ /'dug nas yongs su dag pa'i lus/ /sdom dang byams pa'i sems gzhag nas/ /sems can kun la snying rje'i bdag /sangs rgyas rjes su dran sgom zhing / /gsang sngags bzlas pa mchog gyis shig /ma(4)de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la dmigs te 'jig rten dbang phyug gi zhal nas byung ba don yod pa'i zhags ( pa'i snying po stong rtsa brgyad khro bo'i rgyal po stong rtsa brgyad don yod pa grub pa'i brgya (yirtsa brgyad tshig dang yi ge shin tu gsal bar (7bzlas nas don yod pa'i rgya mtsho'i nor bu pad+ma la rnam par blta rin ba'i dpal dri ma med pa don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po 9ristong phrag bcu bzlas te/ de nas gsang sngags 'di stong phrag brgya bzlas sobo/ /o 11sarba ta thā ga ta tu a ba lo ki te a mo gha ṣ+ṭṛ da 1 yan/ tsa ra tsa khor ma hā kā bon ṇi kā ya sā dha 7ya hūṃ/a 1 bhi ṣiñtsa ya a mo gha pā sha haste swā ’ hā/ de nas gsang sngags bzlas 36brjod byas te 2 mnyam par gzhag la 1/ las thams cad la mkhas pas bdug 2spos kyi 2 mchog la bzlas 24pa tsam gyi mod la bdug spos kyi rgyal po la de bzhin 92—274

gshegs pa thams cad kyi (17byin gyi rlabs kyis byin ( gyis ri brlabs ri par 'gyur ro / /don yod pa'i zhags pa snang ba rgya che ba nor bu chen po'i sprin dri ma med pa zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis rnam par gzigs pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi mchog sbyin pa'i 'khor los sgyur 5ba zhes bya ba'i bdug pa'i rgyal po yin te/ thog mar de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la sngags 'di (rmelan bdun bzlas te bdug pa dbul bar bya'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki te ma hā a mo gha dza ya dza ya swā ( hā/ de'i 'og tu bdag rang la bdugs (85na de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 97byin gyis rlob par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' 7chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug tshostomachog sbyin pa bdugs nyu pa tsam gyi mod la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi 1 sku ston par 'gyur ro/ /dge sbyong dang bram ze'i gzugs kyis de dang lhan cig smra bar 7byed de/ gang la smras pa dang gang la gtam byas pa de thams cad tshe 'di la thams cad bo'agrub par 'gyur ro/ /de'i 'og tu mtshan mo rang gi gzugs ston par 'gyur zhing mchog sbyin par mdzad do/ /don yod pa'i zhags pa'i tshan shes thob par 'gyur/ 'jigs pa chen po brgyad las 1 yongs su grol bar 'gyur/ sngon gyi sgrib pa dang sdig pa dmyal ba'i tshor ba myong bar 'gyur ba zad cing mthar thug par 'gyur ro/ /gang dag gi 18lus la bdugs pa tsam dang mthong ba tsam gyi mod la 19thams cad dbang du 'gyur ro/ /yul 'khor dang grong khyer dang grong rdal dang ljongs dang rgyal po'i btsun 2 mo'i 'khor dang bcas pa dang / blon po dang / blon po chen po dang / bkrabs pa dang / 1 bram ze mdun rtan 'don dang bcas pa dbang du 'gyur zhing thams 92—275

cad bgyi ba ci mchis 17zhes bya ba byed par 'gyur ro/ /rigs bzhi'i 'jig rten dbang dzo du 'gyur ro/ /tshes bcu bzhi dang bcwa nalnga dang tshes brgyad la khrus legs par bya ste / gos gtsang 5)ma bgos la ba las byung ba lngas byugs pas khyim gyi phugs su dkyil 'khor byas la/ me tog dang mchod yon gyi (6)snod gzhag par bya/ gtor ma dkar po nye bar gzhag par bya/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la dmigs la 75byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la dmigs te/phyogs bzhir phyag byas la 8bdug pa'i rgyal po 'dis bdug par byas lhorin/bdugs pa tsam gyi mod la phyogs bcu mtha' yas mu med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams kyi rdul phra mo snyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pas 7yongs su gang ba la /lha'adi lta ste / sangs rgyas kyi zhing re rer / de bzhin gshegs pa gang gā'i sna klung gi bye ma snyed 1 bye ba khrag khrig stong phrag brgya la bdug pa'i sprin 'khrigs 97pa lha'i spos kyis bsgos 17pa mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'i bdug nyu tshospos chen po tsan+dan sbrul gyi snying po dang / gor shir+ṣa /shedang / ta /rtem la'i lo ma dang / bdug spos mang po nam mkha'i ngos khebs pas mchod par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor rnams dang sum cu rtsa gsum na gnas pa'i lha brgya skubyin dang / tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa 'og min gyi gnas na gnas pa'i lha'i bar du 1thams cad bdug pa'i dris rab tu dga' bar 'gyur ro na / /rgyu skar dang / skar ma'i tshogs dang / nyi ma dang zla ba thams cad dga' bar 'gyur te/ 'di la the tshom 2 mi bya zhing yid gnyis bskyed par mi bya'o / /skad chen pos don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po bzlas 25pa byas na/ des 27na sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pas legs 92—276

so zhes bya ba'i sgra 'byin par 'gyur zhing rig sngags 'chang de la yang de bzhin gshegs pas 1byin gyis na)rlob par 'gyur/ dus kun tu dgongs par 'gyur/yang dang yang du gzigs pa'i phyir byon par 'gyur ro/ /bde ba can na bzhugs pa'i ( de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med dang / byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang / mthu 5chen thob 6la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' thams cad thugs rab tu 7chodagyes par 'gyur/ rig sngags 'chang la don yod pa chen po'i dngos grub stsol bar mdzad gzigs bzhed par 'gyur ro/ /klu 8)thams cad la bdugs 9pa tsam gyis dbang du 'gyur zhing ha cang char ches na gcod par byed cing char mi 'bab na 7'bebs par byed do//rlung dang ser ba dang sprin thams cad gcod par byed bdugs 11pa tsam gyis gdon thams cad 'jig 12par byed 1 bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad phyogs bcur dpag tshad stong du 'bros par 'gyur/ ma mo'i gnas su bdugs san rlung dang ser ba dang sprin thams cad gcod par byed ma mo'i tshogs dang nag po chen po la sogs pa 'gugs dpar 'gyur zhing dbang du gyur nas 'dug par 'gyur bya ba thams cad byed par 'gyur ro/ /g.yul 'gyed pa'i tshe bdugs na dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa'i dpung salas rgyal bar 'gyur/ thams cad du bdugs nyi pa tsam gyis rgyal bar 'gyur/ 1 thams cad du 19sbyar bar byas 2 na kun tu grub pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /bdug pa'i cho ga'o// //'phags pa don yod pa'i zhags pa'i cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po/ bam po bcu gcig pa/ de nas rig sngags 'chang rnams la phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir thig 92—277

le bya ba (1)dang / gdong bkru ba dang lus bsku (geb byas na ya lad dang / go cha bgos (5)pa dang 'dra bar 'gyur ba nga bshad par bgyi yis (snyebacom ldan 'das gsan du gsol/ don yod pa'i nor bu rgya chen po rdo rje'i zhags pa zhes bya ba'i nor bu gang sbyor ba byas phyi pa tsam gyis thams cad 'grub pa bla na med pa mkhas pas mdzod spu rnams su thig le byas na tshogs kyi nang dang skye bo mang po'i nang dang tshogs pa'i nang dang 7dge 'dun gyi nang dang de bzhin du rigs byed (shekyi tshogs bzhi'i nang du tshoskar ma'i tshogs kyi nang du ⑩zla ba tshes pa bzhin du mdzes /lhashing 'jigs pa med do/ /lha rnams thams cad ya mtshan skye/ /drag po yi ni cod pan 'chang / /'jig rten mgon po'i g.yas kyi dbu'i/ /dbu rgyan rtse phran zla tshes bzhin/ /gdong bkru ba ni mchog yin no/ /zla ba nya ba'i 'od dang mtshungs / /smin ma rna ba dpral ba dang / /pad+ma dkar 12sham shin tu 'jam/ /mig gnyis ut+pal sngon po 'dra/ /sems can thams cad dga' bas blta/rnyi/ /dga' zhing rtag tu tshig btsan mu'agyur/ /de yi mig gis gang mthong ba/ /thams cad dbang du gyur par ge'agyur/ /skyes pa dag tshal bsku nyu byas na/ /rtag tu rig 18smra blo che zhing / /rtag tu ya lad nyamago bgos pa'i/ /'jigs pa med pa'i lus su 'gyur/ /'byung po rnams ni mi bzod cing / /gnod sbyin 'byung po gsang ba pas/ /rtag tu thub par mi 'gyur ro/ /stobs chen pha rol gnon pa dang / /rtag tu sred med stobs ldan zhing / /glang chen stobs kyi stobs ldan 'gyur/ /lha rnams 'dar ni yid yed cing / /klu rnams mtsho na skrag par byed/ /gal te rig sngags smra ba yisari )/ /reg na ri rab lhun po yang 21/ /g.yo bar 'gyur bar 2the tshom 35med/ /rtag tu sred na med stobs 92wa 278

ldan zhing / /stobs dang gzugs dang rtsal ldan 'gyur/ /nor bu rgyal po bla na med / /'di ni thos pa tsam gyis kyang 1ra/ /sdig pa kun las nges grol zhing tshon/ /dug rnams thams cad 'joms par byed/ /dpal dang (na skal bzang rtag thob 4'gyur / /gang gi lag tu thogs gyur pa(5)/ /sgrib pa kun las nges grol zhing / /de bzhin 'jig rten dga' bar 'gyur/ /de ni de bzhin gshegs kun gyi/ /thugs skyes gsung skyes sras su 'gyur/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug /bla ma rtag tu rjes 'brang zhing / /rig sngags smra ba dbugs 'byung 6phyir / /de bzhin du ni bsrung 97rab dang / /rtag tu mchog ni sbyin par 'gyur/ /'jig rten mgon po thub chen gyi ri/ /bsod nams phung po chen po 'thob9 /gang zhig nor bu 'di 'chang ba de 7de bzhin gshegs pa gang gā'i 17klung gi bye ma snyed 7bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi snyed las 1 dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed par 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad mthong zhing midabugs 'byin pa dang / phyi bzhin 'brang bar 'gyurang/ dpal dang skal ba bzang po thams cad dang ldan par 'gyur/ rtag tu lus dang ngag dang yid yongs su dag par 'gyur/ sems can thams cad kyis 7mchod pa gcig pur 'gyur / dgra nyu 7thams cad kyis mi sod par 'gyur/ phyag na rdo rjes de la rtag tu bsrung tunyeb dang / bskyab 39pa dang / sba ba'i phyir gnas par 'gyur ro / /phyag na pad+ma yang rtag tu mchog sbyin par 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags 'chang 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis lung bstan pa ste nya/ 'dir de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi nor bu chen po bzung bas rnyisdang ba bdud la sogs pa thams cad dang bgegs 2 dang log 'dren thams cad las rgyal te/ pha rol tsho 92wa 279

pham par mdzad nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ro/ /'dis rnga bo che la bskus te brdungs na chos kyi rnga bo che brdungs par 'gyur ro/ /gang dag sgra thos pa tsam gyis sems can thams cad kyi mtshams med pa lnga'i sdig pa rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro / /tha na dud 'gro'i skye gnas su gtogs pa'i ri dgas dang bya gang yin pa de dag thams cad 1yongs su grol bar 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa la skur (gepa 'debs pa dang / dam pa'i chos spong ba dang / mnar med pa 5skul gzhol zhing gnas pa dag las yongs su grol bar 'gyur/ dmyal ba chen po bcu drug las yongs su grol bar 'gyur/ 'jigs pa chen po brgyad las yongs su grol bar 'gyur / de la dug gi 'jigs pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur/ me'i 'jigs pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur/ mtshon gyi 'jigs pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur/ rims thams cad kyi 'jigs pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur/ 'dis 4dung la bskus te bus na chos kyi dung chen po bus par 'gyur/ tha na dung gi sgra thos pa'i bar de dag thams cad kyang slar ldog par mi 'gyur/ skyes pa dang bud med dang khye'u dang bu mo (5nodag kyang skye ba dang rga ba dang nad cadang 'chi ba dang mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa'i sdug bsngal 7las yongs su grol bar 'gyur / 'di ni skye ba phyi ma yin te shi nas 9thams cad rigs mthun 7par bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams su pad+ma las brdzus 11te skye bar 'gyur 12/ lus skyes bu chen po'i mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan lha pa rgyan thams cad kyis bklubs nyu4pa pad+ma las skyil mo krung 15bcas te skye bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub kyi snying po la thug gi bar du 'od dpag med las lamangon sum du chos kyi gtam thos 1 par 'gyur ro/ /zla 18ba yar gyi ngo 92—280

la cod pan dkar po bcings te nor bu chen po 'di rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la btags te bsgreng ba 1tsam gyi namod la chos kyi rgyal mtshan bsgreng bar 'gyur ro / /'di rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la btags pa mthong ba tsam gyis de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub kyi snying por chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang bdud 'dul ba'i rgyal mtshan sgreng ba mthong 94bar rig par bya'o/ /'di bsgreng ba 5tsam gyis 'thab pa dang / rtsod 6)pa dang khrag khrug 7thams cad zhi bar 'gyur/gnod pa thams cad dang mi ngas dang mu ge'i dgon pa rab tu zhi bar 'gyur/chom po dang g.yon can dang rkun ma dang phyir rgol ba dang mi mdza' ba na'ajig par 'gyur/ rang gi dpung dang gzhan gyi dpung dang sdang ba'i sems kyang 9rab tu zhi bar 'gyur/ dug mi bzad 7pa dang gcan gzan 11gtum po dang bya dang sbrang bu dang 12sha sbrang dang byi 1 ba dang sdig sbrul dang 'bras dang lu'u ngata dang dug dang shu ba dang lhog dpa dang mtshan bar rdol tshab dang ske bgegs 1 pa thams cad 'jig 1 par 'gyur/ snang ba'i klu dang / ser ba dang / grang ba dang / rlung 19gis mi tshugs shing nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /rna bde ba dang / dga' ba dang / lo legs pa dang / skye bo mang po dang mi mang pos yongs su gang zhing 'byor par 'gyur/ chos 'dod cing chos kyi kun dga' la dga' ba dang mgu bar 'gyur/ me tog dang / 'bras bu dang / lo tog dang / zas dang / skom ro zhim pa dang / shin tu 'jam pa phun sum tshogs par 'gyur/ thams cad du lha'i reg pa dang bcas pa'i bza' ba dang btung ba 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /21sdang ba'i gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang /'byung po dang / sha za dang / phra men ma dang / yi dgas dang / brjed 2292—281

byed dang / srul po dang / lus srul po dang / skem byed dang / grib ma dang / bza' nyes dang / bgo tsho1nyes dang / blta nyes dang / grib ma ngan pa zhi bar 'gyur zhing mi tshugs par 'gyur/ sems can de dag thams cad phan tshun du dbyams pa'i sems su 'gyur/ mchog tu yid bde ba'i gnas pas gnas par 'gyur ro/ /yon tan dang phan yon chen po de dag ni (1nonor bu'i rgyal po chen po'i byin gyis brlabs pa dzo skuyin no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga na 5bzhin 'dzum zhing mig mi 'dzums par (6)bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das grub pa'i rdzas kyi mchog nor bu gdags pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis (7byin gyis brlabs shing lung bstan pa bdag gi snying po yid bzhin gyi nor bu chen po sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir zhugs pa rjes tsho1༄su bsgrags 7par bgyi'o/ /gser dang na la da 1 dang / gi wang dang / ba bla dang / ldong ros dang / pad+ma dang / ut+pa la dang / gur gum 12dang / nā tsog pus 7pa dang / twa tsa dang /tar ga dang / tsan+dan rnam dganyis dang / spro laka dang / kā la ka 7dang /ru rta 1 dang / shu ti dang / pri 19yang ku 2 dang / ha re nu ke 3stodang / sug smel 22dang / lo dha dang / dzā ta pa kri kā gesu ma na dang / sā 24ma ka dang /sra rtsi 25pog dang / shing arka'i 27'o ma rnams bsogs te cha mnyam par byas la gser nyis 'gyur du byas te/ rgyu skar bzang po dang tshes grangs shis shing dge ba la khrus legs par byas te ri/ gos gtsang ma bgos ri rtenas nyin zhag gcig byams pa'i sems la mnyam par bzhag steni rmo/ phye ma zhib mor 1byas te don 92wa 282

yod pa'i gyo7rgyal po'i snying po'i gzungs stong rtsa brgyad bzlas/ khro bo'i rgyal po brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas tshanate/ gtor la dri chab bzang pos sbangs te/ sbyar la gser dang bsres la ga pur dang gla rtsi'i bdug pas cabadugs te nor bu zho 5gnyis pa'i tshad du byas nas phug la ras skud kyis btags te gser gyis g.yogs la yang don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po stong rtsa brgyad bzlas/ khro bo'i rgyal po brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi nespyan sngar mi smra bar sgrub pa 75byas la de nyid kyi zhabs drung du grib nam la bskam smyopar byas te / phyed dam bzhi cha gser gyis g.yogs 11par bya zhing phyed g.yogs mapar mi bya'o/ /gang la gser gyis g.yogs 1 pa 'di ni gang la don yod pa'i zhags pa skoyid bzhin gyi nor bu chen po dang ge'adra ste/ sangs rgyas kyi byang chub dang 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i tshalas chen po sgrub 1 par byed do/ /gser gyis ma g.yogs pas ni 'jig rten pa'i dgos pa thams cad sgrub 18par byed de/rte/ nad thams cad dang / gdon thams cad dang /lu 'u cita dang / 'bras dang / 'go ba'i nad dang / shu ba dang / lhog pa dang —/ mtshan bar rdol ba 1dang / phol mig dang / sha bkra dang / mig 2 nad dang / klad nad dang / gzhogs phyed na ba dang / mgul pa 'gags pa dang /zhu kha nad dang / sna nad dang / rna ba'i nad dang / so nad dang /rkan na ba dang / lce na ba dang / mchu na ba dang / snying na ba dang / rtsib logs na ba dang / lto rin ba dang / mchin 20pa na ba dang / rgyab na ba dang /gcin snyi 2 ba dang / zug gzer 28dang / 'khru 9ba dang / pho ba'i nad dang /gzhang 'brum thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur zhing rims thams cad rab tu zhi 92—283

bar 'gyur te/ rims nyin bzhi pa (1tshodang / rlung las gyur pa dang / mkhris khupa las gyur pa dang / bad kun las gyur pa dang / 'dus pa las gyur pa rnams rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /lus kyi nang gi nad thams cad la chu dron dang lhan cig sbyin no/ /pha rol gyi nad thams cad dang gnod pa thams cad la byugs pa tsam gyis yongs su grol bar 'gyur ro/ /thams cad du dgos pa thams cad la sbyar ba tsam gyis thams cad 'grub par 'gyur te the tshom 54)mi bya'o/ /gser gyis g.yogs pa dpung pa la btags na thams cad du thogs pa med par 'gyur te/ stobs dang brtson 'grus dang / pha rol gnon 5༄pa phyag na rdo rje dang / pad+ma 'chang dang 'dra bar 'gyur ro/ /dgos pa thams cad 'grub pa bla na med pa rnam pa gsum po 'di la sbyar bar byas te56/ thig le dang gdong pa bkru ba dang lus bkru ba'o / /yid la ji ltar bsam (8 pa'i dgos pa bsgrub pa'i de kho na nyid 'grub pa ste/ the tshom mi 9 bya'o/ /rgyal po btsun bomo'i 'khor 11dang bcas pa dang / skye bo dang blon por bcas pa rtag tu bgyi ba ci mchis zhes 1 bran bzhin du dbang du 'gyur ro/ /nor bu spyi gtsug tu bzhag nas rig sngags bzlas 1 na bgegs med par thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /lag pa g.yas pa la btags 1 te rig sngags bzlas bon bzlas sabarjod kyi cho ga stong phrag brgya 'gyur du byas par 'gyur te/ lan cig bzlas nyu pas stong phrag brgyar 1 rab tu 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /mgul par btags te bcangs nyurten khrus ma byas pa khrus byas par 'gyur / mi gtsang 2)ba gtsang bar 'gyur/tshangs par mi spyod pa tshangs par spyod par 'gyur/ thub par ma byas pa thub par byas par 'gyur/ smyung ba rnam byas pa smyung ba byas par 'gyur/ tshig mi 92wa 284

btsan pa tshig btsan par 'gyur/ ma grub pa grub par (1)'gyur/ dam tshig mi (nashes pa dam tshig shes par 'gyur/ byams pa'i sems dang ldan par 'gyur/sbyin pa gang cung zad ci sbyin pa chung ngu yang stong phrag brgya 'gyur du sbyin pa chen po 'phel bar 'gyur/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su ri byerdzogs par 'gyur/nor bu 'di lag mthil g.yas pa la btags na gang la reg pa de zad mi shes par 'gyur ro/ /su la yang brjod par mi bya ste de'i 'og tu de dag thams cad 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /rked 4pa la btags te chu'i nang du zhugs na chu klung chen po'i gting du slebs 5par 'gyur ro/ /de nas nor bu bsgrub par 'dod pas dngul shin tu yongs su snyodag pa las pad+ma 'dab ( rim sum cu rtsa gnyis pa kha phye ba dbus kyi snying po dang ze ba za ma tog na'adra ba sor bcu drug bcu drug 9pa'i tshad du byas la de'i dbus su gser gyi nor bu gzhag par bya'o/ /ba lang 1 gi lci ba ba lang gi gcin dang ldan pas dkyil 11'khor gru bzhi pa byas la tshon 12sna tshogs kyis bri bar bya ste/ kho ra khor yug tu pad+ma bris la pad+ma'i 12dbus kyi ze bar dngul las byas pa'i pad+ma bzhag ste/ bum pa gang ba bzhi dang gtor ma'i bum pa bzhi gzhag 7par bya zhing me tog dgram dpar bya/ tshon 7rnam pa sna tshogs kyis bri bar 1 bya/ a ga 18ru dang / tsan+dan dang / tu 19ru ska'i bdug pas 27bdug cing gtor ma dkar po gzhag par bya/ 'phan gdugs 22rnam pa sna tshogs kyis brgyan na par bya/ mar gyi mar me sum cu rtsa gnyis kyang bltam 2 ripar bya/ 'bras bu dang me tog phreng sna tshogs gzhag par bya/'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mngon du phyogs par bzhag ste/ rig sngags 'chang gtsang mas 25gos gtsang ma 27bgos la nyin mtshan gcig smyung ba 92—285

byas la/ tshes bcwa 1lnga nas nyi shu dgu dang gnam stong gi bar du tshimatshams gsum du mchod par bya zhing / pad+ma za ma tog khude dang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la'ang 5mchod pa byas la dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su mngon 6du phyogs te 'dug la bzlas brjod stong rtsa brgyad bya/ khro bo'i rgyal po stong rtsa brgyad bzlas te yungs kur tsho dang chus dbang bskur (8rabar bya/ don yod pa'i zhags pa'i phyag rgya stong rtsa brgyad bya/ de bzhin du khro bo'i rgyal po'i 97phyag rgya bya'okho/ /mi smra bar dgos pa thams cad byas nas 11de'i 'og tu tshes bcwa 12lnga zla ba nya'i nang bar gyi dus mtshams 12su nor bu'i rgyal po pad+ma dang bcas te gcig tu 'bar bar 'gyur zhing / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi zhal nas sgra 'byung bar 'gyur/ rig bsngags 'chang dga' bar 'gyur / nam mkha'i dkyil nas legs so zhes bya ba'i sgra 'byung bar 'gyur/de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku lochen po mthong bar 'gyur/ de nas rig sngags 'chang gis pad+ma 'bar ba de lag pa g.yas pas blangs te / blangs pa tsam gyi mod la nam mkha' la 'gro bar 'gyur zhing / rig sngags 'chang 〉thams cad kyi 'khor los sgyur 1 bar 'gyur/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i sna rgyal po gser gyi mdog can blta 2 na sdug 1pa chen po mdun na gnas par 'gyur / sdang ba dang phyir rgol ba dang mi mdza' 2 ba thams cad zlog ri par byed/ 'khor bye ba stong phrag bcu gnyis dang ldan pa'i rig sngags 'chang gi rgyal por 'gyur/ tshe bskal 5pa stong thub par 'gyur/ don yod pa'i rnam par blta 2 ba'i nor bu chen po rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo dang ldan pa'i ting nge 'dzin thob par 'gyur/ don yod pa'i dri ma med pa 'bar ba'i rtse mo rnam par blta 2 ba zhes bya ba'i don yod 92—286

pa'i zhags pa 'thob zhipar 'gyur/ phyogs bcu kun gyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i nacizhing gi rnam par 'phrul pa mthong bar 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad kyis dbugs 'byin par 'gyur/ nor bu chen po yongs su dag pa rdo rje la rnam par lta ba'i 'od kyis /lus rnam par dag pa 'thob par 4'gyur/lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams bgyi ba 5)ci mchi zhes rmedabang du bgyi ri tshobar 'gyur/ mgo'i rinaspyi bor btags na nor bu chen po smyo rdzu 'phrul gyis nyu nub phyogs su song nas /rtabade ba can gyi rab tu dbye ba gzhal med khang dang bcas 'khor dang bcas legs par brgyan pa'i dkyil 'khor dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa mthong bar 'gyur ro / /1 de bzhin gshegs pa de dag las chos gnang 1lhaba'i sgo'i chos bshad pa chen po thos r+shapar 'gyur/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gzugs dang rgyan dang gzhal med khang ston par 'gyur/ mgul du btags lken phug gi gnas thams cad du 'jug par 'gyur/ thams cad du rgyal ba'i rje dpon tshadang 'khor los sgyur 1 ba'i rgyal por 'gyur/ phug stong phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi'i sgo 'bye 18bar 'gyur/ dpung pa g.yas pa la btags na mi snang bar 'gyur zhing lus mi snang ba gang gā'i klung 19bye ba 2 stong phrag brgya snyed kyi lus mi snang ba rnams kyi mchog rje dpon dang rgyal por 'gyur ro/ /dpung pa g.yon pa la btags na gnod sbyin dang srin po dang 'byung po la sogs pa thams cad mi snang bar byas par 'gyur/ thams cad kyi gnas kyi gzhal med khang sgo bye zhing 'dug par 'gyur ro/ /rked pa la btags na gter thams cad 'byung bar 92—287

'gyur / pus mo g.yas pa dang brla g.yas pa 91 la btags na nags kyi phug gi gzhal med khang gi gnas thams cad kyi sgo phye zhing / sman gyi dngos po thams cad rang gi gzugs kyis tshonamadun na gnas par 'gyur zhing thams cad dbang du 'gyur ro/ /rkang pa'i rje ngar la btags na rlung gi phung po dang po'i stobs kyi shugs chen po dang ldan par 'gyur zhing / cung (5)zad tsam song bas dpag tshad stong phrag bcur 'gro zhing slar yang 'ong bar 'gyur/ nyin mtshan gcig gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams rlung chen po'i shugs kyi stobs dang brtson 'grus kyis song ste/ slar yang 'ong bar 'gyur zhing gang gis kyang gnod par mi 'gyur/ thams cad du dgos pa bsgrub pa thams cad 'grub dusapar 'gyur ro/ /rkang mthil la btags na sa'i 'og gi dngos grub chen po thob par 'gyur zhing / sa'i 'og phug gi sgo thams cad bye 5)bar 'gyur te/ rang ji ltar 'dod pa der 'jug cing 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ / khar bcug na nyi ma re re tshigs su bcad pa stong lobs par 'gyur ro/ /mid pa tsam gyis thos pa rgya mtsho bsags par 'gyur ro/ /lce'i rtse mor bzhag na lce pad+ma dang ku mu da ltar 'jam par 'gyur zhing thos pa mang po 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /lag pa la byugs na gang la reg pa de 6 bran bzhin du 'gyur ro/ /skyes pa dang / bud med dang / khye'u dang / bu mo dang /7 dge sbyong dang / bram ze 8thams cad bgyi ba ci mchis zhes 9thams cad dbang du 'gyur ro/ /nor bu bsgrub pa'i cho ga'o// //de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras 92—288

gzigs dbang phyug gis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag la don yod grub kyi bum pa rab mchog ces bgyi ba'i sgrub 1pa'i cho ga chen po mchis te/ don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i gzungs kyi mthu bstan nyapa ji lta ba der de ltar bcom ldan 'das bum pa chen po'i 4)mthu sgrub 5pa'i cho ga 'di rnam par 'phrul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa sgrub 56pa 'grub par 'gyur ri lags so/ /rig sngags 'chang rnams la phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir de kho na nyid yang dag par sgrub par 'gyur ba 8lags so / /de nas gser ram —dngul lam zangs sam kham pa'i bum pa tshad dang ldan pa 9kun nas shin tu zlum pa mgo 'am mgrin 7par phyin 17pa'i tshad 1rta'ajam zhing thag thug dang shang shong med pa/ dbyibs legs shing byi dor legs par byas pa/kun nas yongs su gang ba la mtshal 1)gyi tshon 1 gyis pad+ma 'dab tsham brgya rtsa brgyad pa bri bar bya ste/ mgrin 7par pad+ma'i snying po dang ze ba bri/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bri 1 bar bya ste/ shar phyogs su 18zhal bri/ lho ru 19mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag /nub tu dbyig 'byin gyi phyag /byang du yid bzhin nor bu rirgyan thams cad kyis brgyan 21pa skyil 22mo krung 2 du bzhugs par bya'o/ /pad+ma'i 'dab byum 25dbang phyug dang dbang phyug chen po dang / bram ze dang 30drang srong gi tshogs dang rje/ gshin rje dang / chu lha dang / rlung lha dang / khyab bdag dang / brgya 28byin dang / rdo rje 'chang dang / lha'i tshogs gzhan dag bri bar bya zhing me dang / rlung dang / nyi ma dang / zla ba dang / lha mo 29sgrol ma dang / khro gnyer can dang / pho nya mo dkar mo dang / tshogs kyi bdag po dang / gzhon nu dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / drag po dang / khyab 92wa 289

'jug bri bar bya'o/ /pad+ma'i 'dab ma'i khor yug tu pad+ma'i phreng ba bri'o/ /de nas bum pa tshon 1sna tshogs kyis bri bar bya zhing gser gyi rgyan gyis brgyan na par bya / rim pa'i cha bkra zhing mdzes par bya'o/ /de nas thang shing las pad+ma'i gdan zlum po bum pa shong ba tsam gyi tshad du byed 95)la de'i steng du bum pa bzhag la bum pa 4 de yungs kur 5dkar pos bkang ste(6cho/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan 7ripar bya/ ras dkar pos bcing bar bya/ steng du yungs kur ⑧dang gla rtsi dang ga bur dang 9gi wang dang ldong 7ros gzhag par bya/ bum pa'i kha ras 511dmar pos g.yogs 12par bya/ rin po che 12sna bdun gzhag par bya/ de nas rig sngags 'chang gtsang mas gos gtsang ma bgos la dkyil 'khor khru bzhi gru bzhi pa ñtsa'aphang du khru gang ba byas tege/ ba lang gi lci ba dang sar tshabasres pas 7legs par byugs te 1 cha mnyam par bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dri thams cad kyis byugs la dkyil 'khor gyi snying po nyudzadabus su tsan+dan dkar pos dkyil 'khor khru gang gru bzhi pa byas la/ gur gum ri lhadang me tog pad+mas mchod pa ( 2byas te na/ pad+ma 'dab ma sum cu rtsa gnyis pa bri ril pad+ma'i ze ba'i steng du bum pa gzhag ste phyo/ 'phan gdugs sna tshogs kyis brgyan par bya/ dkyil 'khor gyi snying po khor yug tu spos dang me tog sna tshogs dang byug spos sna tshogs dang / mchod yon gyi snod sna tshogs dang 22bum pa gang bar zhu mdzes pa dang bdug spos kyi phye ma rnam pa ri mang po gzhag 1par bya/ me tog rnam pa sna tshogs dang me tog phreng ci 'byor pa kun tu gzhag par bya/ mar gyi mar me bzang po bcu drug bltam da par bya/ phyi rol gyi dkyil 'khor kun nas pad+ma'i phreng ba bri sa bar bya/ sgo bzhi shin tu mdzes pa bri bar bya ri/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gi 92wa 290

mtshan ma gsal bar bya/ mda' (1)dang ba dan khor yug tu gzhag par bya/tshon (bskud sna lngas bskor ( )bar bya/ ro rnam pa sna tshogs dang dkar gsum ci 'byor ba gzhag par bya/ 'bras bu sna tshogs dang bza' ba rnam pa sna tshogs gzhag par bya/ me tog sna tshogs gzhag par bya/547 me tog sna tshogs dgram 5par bya/ me tog phreng ne bzang po kun (7tu gzhag par bya/ bdug spos kyi tshonasnod dang bum pa gang ba kun tu gzhag par bya/ pog phor bzhi gzhag par bya/dri chab kyi phor pa 9ribazhi gzhag par bya/ snod bzhi dang kham phor brgyad gzhag par bya/ ro sna tshogs kyi gtor ma dkar po rnam pa mang po gzhag par bya/mar gyi mar me gang ba drug cu rtsa gnyis dbul bar bya/ 'bras yos dang yungs kur tshadagram par bya'o11/ /chang dang sha nyanadang beg btsong 1lhadang ke'u dang nga'abags pa dang kha zas ngan pa dang btung ba ngan pa spang bar bya/ bgom bonyes spang gebar bya ste/ gtsang mas 1 gos gtsang ma bgos 1 la zla ba nya ba la 19bsgrub par bya'o/ /sung na tshoba'i cho gas bdag bsrung 1ba dang thor tshugs bcing ba ri snyedang / phyogs bcing ba dang /2 yul bcing ba dang / de bzhin du grogs bsrung na ba dang gzhan bsrung ba g.yang bya'o/ /gu gul gyi na bdug pa dang 2 mar dang yungs kur 22gyi bdug pas bdug par da(bya'o/ /tsan+dan dang / a ga ru dang / tu r+sā ru ska da dang / kun du ru'i bdug pa 'di ni yang dag par bstan cu to/ /bum pa sgrub ri tshopa 'di ni mchog ste zhag lnga smyung ra ba byas nas gsang sngags bsgrub par bya ste/ dus mtshams gsum du bum pa dang sangs rgyas la mchod par 27bya'o/ /mi smra bar dkyil 'khor la mngon du phyogs te skyil mo krung du 'dug nas lag pa g.yas pa bum pa'i steng du bzhag nas nakhro bo'i rgyal po stong 92—291

rtsa brgyad bzlas la chu dang yungs kur 1gyis dbang bskur la don yod pa'i zhags pa'i gzungs ristong phrag brgyad na cu bzlas so(4/ /yid la byed pa 95)rtse gcig pas sems can thams cad la byams pa dang snying rje lhur len cing sangs rgyas yid la bya ba sgom nel bzlas brjod bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu tshes bcwa ri rilnga nya'i thun tha ma'i nang par dbyig gi bum pa cher g.yo bar 'gyur zhing legs so zhes bya ba'i sgra chen po yang grag 8par 'gyur te9/ bum pa chen po de yang 'bar zhing 'od zer kha dog sna lnga 7'byung bar 'gyur/ rig sngags 'chang dga' bar 'gyur/dri ma med cing yongs su dag la dri ma dang bral bar 'gyur/ mdog yongs su dag cing me tog pad+ma dang ku mu da 11ltar dkar zhing 'jam par 'gyur/ bum pa de'i sku gzugs rnams rang rang gi lus las lo'od zer 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la mchod pa rgya chen po bya/ rig sngags 'chang bum pa bsgrub pa 'di ni grub bo/ /de'i 'og tu rig sngags 'chang gis dri'i 1 chu dang yungs kur tshal khro bo'i rgyal po lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas khrinas dbang bskur bar 7byas na dbang bskur 1 ma thag tu bum pa de las sgra 'byung bar 'gyur te/ rig sngags 'chang 1 chen po legs so legs so/ /khyod kyis bum pa bzang po grub ste 17bum pa bzang po ji lta ba bzhin don yod pa'i snying po'i bum pa bzang po yid bzhin kyi nor bu chen po yang de bzhin 2 gyis ji ltar 'dod par 1longs spyod cig /yid la ji ltar bsams shing bcol ba na thams cad grub par gyur cig /de nas mchod pa chen pos gzhal med khang chen po mchod de bum pa bzang po de gzung snyebar bya zhing mchod pa byas na yid la ji ltar 'thad pa dang 'dod pa thams cad grub par 92wa 292

'gyur te/ legs par bshad pa'am gtsug lag gam/ snyan dngags 1dang gar gyi bstan 95tshobacos dang rtsis chos dang byā ka ra ṇa dang cho ga zhib mo smra ba 4dang gsang sngags smra ba dang / nags sgrub pa dang phug sgrub pa dang 5bcud kyis len pa dang mig sman dang / gter smra ba dang / rig byed kyi sngags dang mdo (64sde dang / dbyangs kyis 75bsnyad pa'i sde la sogs pa chos dang 'dul ba smra ba de dag thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'di lta ste zas dang / skom dang /gos dang / rgyan dang / spud pa dang / gser dang / dngul dang / sa le sbram dang / mu tig dang / in+d+ra nī 8la dang / margad spyodang / ke ke ru dang / shel dang / mu sa ra dang / bai ḍūr+ya khodang / mthon ka dang /mthon ka chen po dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu dang / gos dang / mal 1 cha dang / gnas dang / khang pa dang / longs spyod dang / rtsed mo rgya chen po dang rgyal po la 'os pa'i lha'i gzhal med khang chen po rnams sems kyis 12bsams nya pa tsam gyi mod la 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /mig 'phrul gyi gzhal med khang dang sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa dang /rdo rje 'chang gi sprul pa dang 7lha dang / klu dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / dri za dang / lto 'phye bochen po'i gzhal med khang dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / 'byung po'i bdag po'i gzhal med khang de thams cad bsams 7pa tsam gyis 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /char ha cang che ba 1 tshodang char mi 'bab pa dang / dus ma yin pa'i char dang /1 grang ba dang / rlung dang / sprin dang / ser ba dang chu zlog 19par byed pa de 2 thams cad ston par byed pa sde 1ston par byed pa 2 g.yul 'gyed pa ston par 92wa 293

byed pa'am/ gnas dang gzhal med khang dang / dpal ston par byed pa de thams cad ston par byed/ de la sogs pa thams cad bsams 93)pa tsam dang /smon pa tsam gyis 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /nor bu rinanodang / 'bru dang / 'bras bu dang / me tog dang / gzhal med khang 'byung bar 'gyur ro(ge/ /ji ltar ④bsams 5pa de thams cad 'byor bar 'gyur ro/ /gla rtsi de blangs la gi (6niwang dang ga pur dang bsres te shing arka'i 7sku'o mas sbrus te/ ril bu (8)byas nas ba ser mo'i 'o ma la bdar 9te dpral bar thig le byas na nam mkha' la 'gro bar 'gyur / rig sngags 'chang bye ba stong phrag bcu'i 'khor dang ldan par 'gyur/snying gar 7thig le byas na mi snang bar 'gyur zhing gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / 'byung po thams cad kyi rje dpon du 'gyur ro/ /lce'i rtse mo la reg //nyen nyin re zhing tshigs su bcad pa stong bklags shing 'dzin par 'gyur/ mid na nyurtelo stong phrag bcur 'tsho 1 bar 'gyur/ 'o ma dang lhan cig yi'athungs na thos pa mang po rgya mtsho bsags par 'gyur/ shing arka'i lo skom dang lhan cig skrezos na rig sngags 'chang thams cad kyi 1 'khor los sgyur 32bar 'gyur/ cho ga zhib mo dang / gsang sngags dang dkyil 'khor dang / phyag rgya thams cad mngon du 'gyur / lte 19ba'i gnas su thig le byas te chu klung chen po'i nang du zhugs na gting du 'bying bar mi 'gyur zhing pha rol tu phyin par 'gyur/ rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu yang phyin par 'gyur/ spyi bor thig le byas te g.yul ngor zhugs na dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi las 2 rgyal bar 'gyur/ zhun mar dang lhan cig zhu1zos na glang po chen po na stong gi stobs dang ldan par 'gyur zhing zhuge/ lag pa ya gcig 2 gis glang po che bskyod pa dang nam mkha' la 'phen cing slar yang 'dzin 92wa 294

to / /ril bu 'dis lag pa la bskus trin mi stong thub par 'gyur ro/ / ril bu (ge'adi lha'i gnas su brkos ri te gzhag na lha thams cad dbang du 'gyur te/dus dus su char 'bebs shing sad 47dang rlung dang sprin dang / ser ba gcod par byed do5)/ /rgyal po'i sgor brkos 6)te bzhag na rgyal po'i btsun mo ri 'khor dang bcas pa dang bka' la gtogs pa dang zhang blon 8)dang bram ze mdun na 'don dang bcas pa dbang du 'gyur ro/ /gtsug lag khang gi sgor brkos 9te bzhag na dge slong thams cad bde ba'i reg pa la gnas pas gnas par 'gyur1 /rtag tu byams pa'i sems kyis gnas par 'gyur ro11/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun gyi nang du rgan pa'i mthar brkos 12te bzhag na dge slong thams cad zas dang skom 'dod dgu 15thob par 'gyur ro/ /lhung bzed kyi nang du bzhag ste grong khyer mang por bsod snyoms la song la 7kha zas ro bro ba'i mchog rnam pa sna tshogs 'bad mi dgos par 8thob par 'gyur ro/ /sku gdung dang bcas pa'i mchod rten gyi gnas su brkos 10te bzhag la mchod rten la mchod pa byas na/ril bu ji srid du mchod rten 1 gnas na gnas pa nyanade srid du mchod rten chen po brgyad la nyin re zhing 19mchod pa chen 2 po byas par 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gnas su 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi zhabs drung du brkos nyute bzhag la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la mchod pa byas te/ don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po lan brgya 2rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod 2 byas na ril bu ji srid gnas kyi bar du nyi ma re re zhing 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs 2 phodabang phyug la mchod pa byas par 'gyur ro/ /lam po cher brkos gite bzhag na chom po dang g.yon can dang / rkun ma dang / mi dang mi ma yin 92—295
