zos pa tsam gyis (1)nam mkha' la 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /'byung po chen po'i bdag po dang / dbang phyug chen po 'dra bar 'gyur ro/ /lha'i lo stong du 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /oṃ 2zhes bya bas dbyug pas btsir ri la bsdigs pa byas na de nas lce 'byin par 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags 'chang bas bcad la rig sngags 'chang bas blang bar 54)bya'o/ /blangs pa tsam gyis nam mkha' la 'gro bar 'gyur ro / /rig sngags 'chang ba ral gri'i 'khor los sgyur 5 ribar 'gyur ro/ /lo stong phrag bcur 'tsho bar 'gyur ro6tsho/ /rig sngags 'chang ba bcwa 97brgyad kyi 'khor gyis bskor 8bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang bas mi ro'i spyi bor dbyug pas brdabs na sgra 'byung bar 'gyur zhing shi ba'i ro gcig tu mkhregs ri9 pa'i gser yin pas blang ba byas na srang gcig gis zangs srang stong gser du 'gyur ro/ /de dag ni 'jig rten pa sgrub pa'i cho ga yin no// //de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs 1 snadabang phyug gis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de dag ni sems can thams cad la snying brtse 11ba'i phyir bdag gi 'jig rten 12pa'i cho ga lags so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shākya 1 thub pas bka' stsal pa/ sems can chen po sems can thams cad la snying brtse ba'i phyir/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i cho ga dam pa gsang ba'i snying po dang / dkyil 'khor dang ngablo brtan po 'jigs pa med pa thob par 'gyur ba dang / rig sngags 'chang thams cad kyi 15dam pa sgrub par byed pa de kho na nyid grub 17par 'gyur ba dang /bklags nyu pa dang / dran pa tsam dang / sgrub par byed pa 1 tsam gyis de dag 92wa 345

thams cad grub pa chen po thob par 'gyur ba dang / bsam 6)pa chen po yongs su rdzogs par nagrub par 'gyur ba dang / mchog grub pa chen po so sor thob par 'gyur ba dang / rig sngags 'chang ba'i 'dod par gtogs pa bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par grub par 'gyur ba smros shig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bcom ldan 'das kyi drung nas dbugs 'byin pa dang / bsgo ba thos nas shin tu yid dga' ba chen por gyur ri rite/ de stan las langs nas bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar te/ pus mo g.yas pa'i 4)lha nga sa la btsugs nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar te55/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ me tog dang / bdug pa dang / dri dang /phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / chos gos dang / gdugs dang /rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / gos dang / rgyan sna tshogs dang / spud pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyis bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa dang bsnyen (5)bkur chen po byas te mchod nas 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor mang por 57dbyang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang dag dkyil 'khor gyi lhar gtogs pa dang / gang dag rig 'dzin grub pa dang / gang dag lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang /dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / gang dag don na yod pa'i 9zhags pa'i rnam par grol ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dam tshig la rjes su zhugs pa dang / gang dag ri bo po ṭa tshal la 11gnas pa de dag thams cad kyis 1 me tog dang / bdug pa dang / dri dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / gos dang / rgyan sna tshogs dang /92—346

chas dang / spud pa sna tshogs kyis mchod pa byas te 91 yid dga' bar gyur to(5) / /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis rin)bcom ldan 'das la stong phrag brgya bskor 54)ba byas 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor de la yang mchod pa byas nas / bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar te btud nas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar mig mi 'dzums (55par 'dug steci tsho/ bcom ldan 'das la tshig (7)'jam pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag la mchis pa ni rmad du byung ba rnam par lta ba don yod pa'i cho 'phrul/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi (8)snying po rnam par grol ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rmad du byung ba de kho na nyid rnam par 'phrul pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi byin gyis brlabs 9dang / dam tshig chen po'i 1 dkyil 'khor don yod pa'i rnam par lta ba'i zhags pa'i snying po dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bklag tshonapa dang / sgrub par byed pa grub 12pa mchog tu gyur pa'i snying po dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mchog sgrub nyusnyepa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis sabyin gyis brlabs shing lung bstan pa lags tetsha/ de bdag tshagis bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar bcom ldan 'das kyi 1 byin gyis brlabs 18kyis rig sngags 'chang thams cad mchog tu grub 19par bya ba'i phyir dang /sems can thams cad bsgral ba'i phyir dmyal ba dang / yi dgas kyi gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten sel ba sngon gyi sgrib pa dang / sdig pa mi zad 21pa 'joms pa ngan song thams cad sel ba/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa nges par sreg par byed pa/ yongs su bsgrags na par bgyi'o/ /mtshams med pa lnga dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems 92—347

dpa' spong ba dang / dam pa'i chos spong ba dang / mamyodroms med pa la gzhol ba dang / 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la 'khu ba dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad spong bar byed pa de 1dag gis mnyan 2pa dang / mthong ba tsam dang / sdom pa tsam dang /lan cig 'bad pa dang / 'chad 45pa tsam gyis thams cad byang bar 'gyur ro//nga ciramathong ba tsam gyis thams cad zad par 'gyur/ byang bar 'gyur ro/ /rims thams cad dang / nad thams cad dang / dri ma dang / ser sna dang phrag dog thams cad dang 6bral bar 'gyur ro/ /nyon mongs pa dang / sgrib pa thams cad las yongs su grol bar 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sdug bsngal skye ba dang / rga ba dang / 'chi ba dang / nad dang mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /'thab pa dang / rtsod pa dang / 'gyed pa dang / phung bar byed pa dang / brdeg (35pa dang / bsdigs pa dang /gsod pa dang / g.yul 'gyed pa dang / shags 'gyed pa dang / btson (8)du 'dzin pa dang / lcags su 'jug pa dang / rkun ma dang / zol ba dang /mi rgod dang / seng ge dang / glang po che dang / ma he dang / nad ngan pa dang / dmu chu dang / sha bkra dang / mdze dang / 'brum bu dang / g.yon can dang / shu ba dang / shu bran dang / g.yan pa dang / klad (9 pa na ba tsodang / gzhogs phyed na ba dang / dom dang / dred dang / gnod sbyin dang /srin po dang / yi dgas dang / sha za dang / brjed 11byed dang / sbrul ma rungs pa dang / kha 12gdug pa dang / sbrul nag po dang / srog chags go na 92—348

dang / dug (1)dang bcas pa'i srog chags 'jigs pa sna tshogs dang bcas pa dang / me dang / chu dang / dug dang / mtshon dang / g.yang sa dang /khyim rdib pa dang / grang ba rdzunadang / rlung dadang / nyi tshan 4)dang / byi ba kha gdug (5)pa'i 'jigs pa thams cad ni/ bklags 6)pa dang / kha ton 7)byas pa dang / mthong ba tsam gyis thams cad rnam par zhig par 'gyur/ phung bar 'gyur / mod la phye namar brlag 9)par 'gyur ro/ /yongs su thar bar 'gyur ba 'di la dogs par mi bya/ yid gnyis bskyed 1rtapar mi bya/ the tshom 11mi bya/sems gnyis su 'gyur ba nyu2bskyed par mi bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag rtag tu mngon du dran par bgyi ba dang / rtag tu yid la byed pa'i blo 'byung bar bgyi'o/lha / /don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po dang / khro bo'i rgyal po'i snying po yang bzlas par mibagyi'o/ /rmad du byung ba rnam par lta skab/ don yod pa rnam par 'phrul pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po rnam par grol ba'i dkyil 'khor de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rmad du byung laba'i cho 'phrul rnam par snang mdzad kyi byin gyis brlabs 17/ dam tshig chen po'i dkyil 'khor don yod par nyugernam par lta ba'i zhags pa'i snying po ni 19rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad 2 par dus thams cad du yid la kha ton 21du brjod par bya'o/ /rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad 22par rjes su dran pa bsgom par bya'o/ /de dag dran pa bsgoms 2 pa tsam dang /dran pa tsam gyis 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa thams cad thob par 'gyur ro/ /phyir mi ldog pa zhes bya'o/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i gnas la rab tu gnas par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dgongs pa dang / lung ston pa dang / byin gyis rlob 2 par 'gyur na/92wa 349

lta ba dang / klog pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi 1dbang phyug mthong ste phyag 'tshal ba dang / mchod pa dang / dran pa dang / dus gsum du shin tu gsal rinaribar yid la byed pa dang / mchod cing phyag byed pa de lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ sems can de ni nga dang 'dra ba yin par rig par bya'o/ /'jig rten dbang phyug gis ( dbyin gyis brlabs (7pa'i lus yin par rig par bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis 55byin gyis brlabs pa dang / dbang bskur du )bas dbang bskur ba yin par rig par bya'o/ /gang zhig lan mang du shin tu lhag par byed pa lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ sems can de ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po yin par rig par bya'o/ /bdag kyang dus thams cad du rtag tu rjes su dran par bgyi'o/ /dus thams cad du mthong ba sbyin par bgyi'o57)/ /bsam pa dang re ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bgyi'o/ /de'i tshe bdag gis sems can thams cad myur ba 2myur bar 595byang chub kyi snying por 'gro ba dang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor tshebar gzhag par bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag ni go cha chen po brtan par khas blangs pa la 'chel 11ba lags pas sems can thams cad tho snyebasgral 1 ba'i phyir re ba'i mchog thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bgyi'o/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa mispyan ras gzigs kyi cidabang phyug la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sems can dag pa'i mchog legs so legs so / /'di ni mchog tu dkon pa ste/ / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i cho ga de'i ming 'dzin pa tsam gyis sems can yongs su grol bar 'gyur nyunyen/ lta ba dang / klog pa 92wa 350

dang ske/ sgrub pa dang / smyung 1ba'i cho ga byed pa dang / sdom pa la gnas pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/ sems can de ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro/ /sems can dag pa dus la bab pa gang yin par shes na smros shig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan naras gzigs dbang phyug bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal du lta 8zhing bzhin 'dzum ste/ don yod pa rnam par lta ba'i zhags pa'i snying po smras so/ /dus gsum du gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang sangs rgyas dang 'phags pa nyan thos kyi dge 'dun thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa byams pa 4la sogs pa 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa rdo rje 'chang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha gshin rje dang / chu lha dang / lus ngan po dang / drang srong gi tshogs kyi mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo / /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang phyug thugs 57rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di lta ste/ oṃ ri sarba ta thā ga ta/ a ba lo ki 57te pā sha hre 8)da yi9/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ dharma dhā khotu gar+bhe/lku/tsa ra tsa ra/ ma hā nyi bad+ma pad+ma 1 bhu dze/ dha ra dha ra/ ma hā 1 /pā sha dha re/ ba ra ba ra ba ra das/ rasmi sha ta sa ha sra/ pra ti glu maṇ+ḍi ta1 tsho/ sha rī re/ ta ra ta ra/ bi pu la te dza dha renyan/ bha ra bha ra/ ṣaṭa pā ra mi tā 19pa ri pū ra ṇi /ka la ka la/ ma hā brah+ma 1/ be ṣa na dha re/ ma la ma la/ sarba pā pa ā dab ra ṇa ma 2 la kilbi na ṣa/ nā 24sha ni / dhu ru dhu ru/ bo nasadhi satwa/ bi shud dhe 29bhu ru bhu ru/ ma hā satwa tsho/ ba da 1sa le/ ya ma ba ru ṇi 2ku be ra na lham skṛ ri92—351

te / hu ru hu ru brah+ma/ bistu(1ci/ ma he shwa ra/ ku mā ra/ nan di ke (gesha ra/khri ri hrīshwa ra/ ma he ca shwa ra de ba 95nipra tra/ ban+di (phyirata/ bsdi ri7)ta/ na ma skṛ tezhu)/bi bi dha ma ṇi mo li dha 99nire/ a mi tā bhā 0dzi na/ ma (steku ṭa/ dha re/ di mebya / ma ṇi kyi ka na ka / badz+ra bai ḍūr+ya'i / ma ra ka ta/ pad+ma rā gtso /in+d+ra ⑩nī la di bya mu ka nyu ti ka /a lo kṛ 18ta/ sha rī tu ra/ shwe ta yad ( tshozlo pa bī ta dha ra 1/ dza ṭa ma 2ku ṭa/ maṇ+ḍi na ta nā ma/ tsan+d+ra rā khrichedzi ta/ pad+ma dha ra/pad+ma ā sa na/ pad+ma bhu dza/ tri dge'o tsa rilhan/ tri shu la ( :dha ra/ bā shu)sha dha ra te/sarba ta thā ga 1ta/ a bhi ṣe ka ci ta/ sa ra sa ra/ sarba ( /pā pa pra ༷ gesha ma na ka ra/ ma hā kā 2ru ṇi 7ka /tu ru tu ru/ sarba ba ra dā zhu /ya ka /bo dhi bo dhi/sarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki te/ bo dhi maṇ+ḍaṭa 8/ a ba lo ki te/ lo ke shwa ra/ma he shwa ra 9/ ma hā tsin tā ma ṇi/ dhā (1ra bi shwa rū 82pa/ ma hā sau mya ba da ce na / ma hā kā liru ṇi ka / bud dha bud dha de/ bo dha ya bo dha ya/ bha ga bān(snyi/sarba ta thā ga ta/ a ba lo ki ta 4 gar+bhe/ ma hā purgyasirnya/ te dza dha ra pra ba ra sid dhi ka ra sarba byā 9snyi ha ra/ sarba satā ya pa ra ri sarba duḥkha(nya/ pra mo tsa ka /ma hā kā ru ṇi ri ka na mo stu te swā 5 hā/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gi 'di ni rmad du byung ba rnam par lta ba'i zhags 5 ripa'i snying po'o lde/ /don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po'o/ /rnam par grol ba'i dkyil 'khor 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gzungs kyi snying po'ogatsi/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi snying po'og / /gzugs sna tshogs chen po sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin rnam par 'phrul pa / phyag stong mnga' ba/ dbu stong mnga' ri ba/ spyan stong gis 87rnam par gzigs pa/ phyag brgya tsi stong gis byin gyis brlabs 015pa/ gang gā'i rdzo klung bye 92—352

ba khrag khrig stong phrag bcu'i bye ma'i rdul shin tu phra ba dang mnyam pa'i dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor du rjes su zhugs pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi de kho na nyid gsang ba la 'jug pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zhing du 'jug pa/byang chub kyi snying por bgrod 91)pa/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba/ chos kyi sgron me 'bar ba/ bdud la sogs pa ma rungs pa thams cad kyi bdud 'joms pa/chos kyi dung 'bud pa/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan sgreng na ba/ dmyal ba thams cad sel ba/ cho ga zhib mo thams cad grub par mdzad pa/ cho ga sgrub dpa thams cad kyi mchog sa bcu chen po la 4so sor 'jog pa/ phyir mi ldog pa'i gnas la rjes su 'jug pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa 5thams cad kyis dbang bskur ri ba dang / byin gyi rlabs 7kyis byin gyis brlabs 8pa/ don yod pa'i mchog phun sum tshogs pa thob par mdzad pa/ don yod pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa'i rnam par sprul 9pa/ don yod par sems rgya mtsho snyed 1 yang dag par 'dzin pa/don yod par sems can sa bon la so sor 'jog pa/ don yod par byang chub sems dpa'i rnam 31par 'phrul pa la 'jug pa/ don yod par de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rnam par 'phrul pa yongs su sgrogs 12pa/ don yod par de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mchod pa dang / bsnyen bkur 1 gyi sprin rab tu byed pa/ don yod par sems can thams cad mi 'jigs pa'i khyim du 'dzud pa/ don yod par sbyin pa chen po'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs pa/ don yod par lha rdzas kyi ngame tog dang / bdug pa dang / dri dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / chos gos dang /gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / gos dang / rgyan dang /92—353

chos gos sna tshogs dang / rin po che bdun gyi char 'bebs pahubye/ don yod pa'i 92tshe yongs su brjes 55te sangs rgyas kyi zhing kun tu brgyan (gepa sna tshogs su de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad yang dag par lta ba/ don yod par bsod nams kyi phung po chen po rab tu rdzogs pa/ don yod par (5)dge ba'i rtsa ba chen po skyed 6)pa/ don yod par de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad yang dag par mthong ba dang / grub pa dang / cho 'phrul gyi rnam par 'phrul pa ston pa/ don yod par dbang phyug sgrub pa/ don yod par rig sngags dang / dkyil 'khor dang / phyag rgya dang / rim 97)par phye ba dang / cho ga zhib mo yang dag par ston pa/ don yod par grub (8pa mthong ba/ don yod par cho ga mthong ba/don yod par tshe rab tu 'phel ba/ don yod par snyan par grags pa rab tu ston pa/ don yod par 'khor ba las rab tu sgrol ba/ don yod par skye ba dang / rga ba dang / 'chi 9rib las yongs su sgrol ba/ don yod par mchog rab tu sbyin pa/ don yod par bzlas brjod dang cho ga rab tu rdzogs pa/ don yod par dran pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rab tu rdzogs pa/ don yod par rig 'dzin 'khor los sgyur 1 ba thob pa 11yang dag par ston pa/ don yod par lha'i gnas dang / gzhal med khang sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi lha'i gnas su 'jug pa/ don yod par dga' ldan gyi gnas su 'jug pa/ don yod par 'og min gyi 12gnas kyi bar du 'jug pa/ don yod par sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas su brgya nyunyebyin lha'i rgyal por 'jug pa/ don yod par ri rab chen po lag pa gcig gis skul tsho ba / don yod par rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs ston pa/ don yod par mi snang ba 8ston pa / don yod par stobs 'phel ba/ don yod par gling bzhi la dbang ba'i 92—354

'khor los sgyur (1)ba so sor 'thob pa ston pa/ don yod par yid bzhin gyi nor bu chen po'i rin po che sna tshogs kyi char 'bebs pa/ don yod par 'bru'i char 'bebs pa/ don yod par gos kyi char 'bebs pa/ don yod par rgyan dang /chos gos dang / mu tig gi chun 'phyang 95nodang / gdub kor ( nodang / gser gyi tsong tsong dang / gdu bu dang / dpung rgyan sna tshogs kyi char 'bebs pa yang dag par ston pa/ don yod par ro rnam pa sna tshogs ro'i mchog ro brgya'i (4)kha zas kyi char 'bebs pa/ don yod par sems can sna tshogs grol ba (5)ston pa / don yod par bstan bcos dang / tshig le'ur byas (65pa dang / tshul dang 'dul ba dang / mdo sde dang / lung bstan pa dang / tshigs su bcad pa dang / ched du brjod pa dang / gleng gzhi dang / de lta bu byung 7rab dang /skyes pa'i rabs (8༄dang / shin tu rgyas pa dang / rmad du byung ba'i chos kyi man ngag sna tshogs dang / chos mngon pa dang 9/ tshogs kyi gtam yang dag par ston pa dang / don yod par theg pa chen po rnam pa sna tshogs rgya mtsho la 'jug pa dang 7rab tu ston pa/ don yod par gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang /'byung po dang / sha za dang / yi dgas dang / grul bum dang / brjed 3lhabyed dang / bgegs dang / log 'dren sna tshogs nyes pa dang / gsod pa 12dang shin tu sel ba yang dag par ston pa yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar na yon tan chen po can gyi gzungs ngan song thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ba/thams cad du mi 'jigs pa'i gnas 1 rab tu ston pa/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam legs pa'i lam rab tu ston pa/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i lam rab tu ston pa/ phyir mi ldog pa'i gnas dang / sangs rgyas nyid sbyin par mdzad pa 92wa 355

lags te1/ bcom ldan 'das don yod par rnam par lta ba'i zhags pa'i snying po'i gzungs chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi snying po yon tan khyad par yongs su bsgrags 2pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po gsang ba la rab tu gnas pa lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya nathub pas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 0spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sems dpa' chen po mchog tu dkon pa'i gzungs 'di'i snying po 'jig rten las 'das pa rnam par 'phrul pa bshad pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad rdzu 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pa/ gsang ba'i snying po yongs su bsgrags 5pa legs so legs so/ /de dag ni sems can thams cad la lam mchog shin tu mchog tu gyur pa/ gya rnam pa/ bla ma/ bla na med pa / mchog tu dkon pa'i gzungs kyi 6 snying po gsang ba yongs su bsgrags pa geste / gang gi 8'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i chu bo chen po dang / srid pa'i rgya mtsho las sems can pha rol tu sgrol ba yin no/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug rigs kyi bu pho'am/ rigs kyi bu mo'am/ dge slong pha'am/ dge slong ma'am59)/ dge bsnyen 1 pha'am/ dge bsnyen 11ma'am/ dge sbyong ngam/ bram ze'am/ rgyal rigs dang / rje'u rigs dang / dmangs 12rigs gang la la zhig gam/sems can gzhan gang yang rung bas don yod par rnam par lta ba'i snying po 'di dang / rmad 1 du byung ba rnam par lta ba don yod pa'i snying po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po rnam par grol ba'i dkyil 'khor de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rmad du byung ba'i de kho na nyid rnam par 'phrul pa/ rnam par snang 92—356

mdzad kyi (1)byin gyis brlabs pa(nas/ dam tshig chen po dkyil 'khor gyi ming 'dzin pa tsam gyis kyang dge ba'i rtsa ba chen po sogs dadapar 'gyur ro/ /bsod nams shekyi phung po chen po dang ldan par yongs su 'dzin par yang 'gyur ro/ /gang gā'i (5niklung 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig dgu bcu rtsa gnyis kyi bye ma'i rdul phra rab dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mngon du 6rimathong ba dang / mngon du chos thos pa dang /mngon du dbyangs thos pa dang / mngon du lung bstan 57pa thos napar 'gyur ba'i sems can chen po de dag gis 9ni bsod nams kyi phung po shin tu che ba dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba chen po yongs su gzung 1 tshobar 'gyur ro/ /sems can de gzungs 1rtagang yin pa dang / dkyil 'khor dang / cho ga dang / ming 12sna tshogs da tsho ltar thos 7pa dang / yang na klog pa lodang / yang na lta ba tsam mthong ba ni de dang mnyam pa yin te/ rigs kyi bu pho'ams/ rigs kyi bu mo de ni bsod nams kyi phung po chen po'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang ldan par 'gyur ba yang de dang mnyam pa yin na/ dka' ba byed pa lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang 1 mnyam pa nyid du thos pa dang mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /gang dag gzungs 1 'di'i dkyil 'khor 'bad de stobs dang brtson 'grus pha rol gnon par byed pa dang / tshol ba dang /19 'dri 2 tshob dang / klog pa dang / bzlas brjod kyi cho ga byed pa dang / dkyil 'khor gyi cho gas 1sgrub par byed pa dang / 'bad par byed pa de ni dka' ba chen po la zhugs pa yin te dz+wa / de dang mnyam pa yin no/ /dka' ba gang zhe 2lhan/ ji ltar de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pas 92—357

bskal pa 1grangs med pa gsum du dka' ba la zhugs pa dang / sangs rgyas te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor rinaba'i bar yin no/ /rigs kyi bu pho'am/ rigs kyi bu mo'am / dge slong pa'am/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen zhupha'am/ dge bsnyen rgya rima'am/ dge sbyong ngamachos / bram ze'am/ rgyal rigs sam/ rje'u rigs dang 56/ dmangs 47rigs gang yin pa'am/ sems can gzhan gang yang rung bas gzungs 'di'i dkyil 'khor dang / cho ga stobs chen po dang /pha rol gnon pa'i brtson 'grus kyis sgrub par byed pa 'di ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'i cho ga 'tshol 8chib yin no/ /'di lta ste/ 'dri (9rab dang / klog pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang / bzlas brjod dang / cho ga dang / dkyil 'khor lta ba dang / 'jug pa dang / dam tshig dang / phyag rgya bcings te sgrub pa dang / 'di lta ste/ thos pa dang / 'dzin pa dang / klog pa dang /kun chub par byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa dang / sems pa ⑩dang / dus gsum du lan gsum don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po dran pa dang /khro bo'i rgyal pos dbang bskur 11ba dang / gzungs 'di yang lan nyi shu rtsa gcig tu bzlas brjod dang / cho ga dran pa dang / byams pa dang / snying rje dang / byams pas 12snying brlan pa dang / sems can thams cad la snying brtse 1 ba lhur byed pa de ni dka' ba 7spyod pa chen po la zhugs pa yin no/ /bskal 15pa grangs med pa gsum du dka' ba spyod pa la zhugs pa dang 'dra ba'am/lhag pa yin no/ /de'i tshe 'di nyid la 'bras bu chen po thob par 'gyur ba dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa zhes bya ba dang / sangs rgyas nyid du so sor gnas pa yin no// //92wa 358

'phags pa don yod pa'i 07zhags pa'i tshonasacho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po/ bam po bcu gsum pa/ bsod nams kyi phung po chen po'i dge ba'i rtsa ba bsags par 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu 'jig rten dbang phyug rjes su 'brang ( nibar 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu phyag g.yas pa byang chub sems dpa' de'i spyi bo la 'jog par 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu mchog sbyin pa (gemadzad par 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu zhal mthong bar 'gyur ro / /de ltar na yon tan chen po brjod pa'i gzungs dang / dkyil 'khor dang phyag rgya dang / cho ga 'di ni mchog tu dkon pa yin no/ /5) zodakyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'di thos pa tsam dang / rna ba'i bu gar 'di'i sgra lan bdun nges par lhung na/ de 'chi 'pho ba tsam dang bsams 967pa tsam gyis bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams su skye bar 'gyur te/ 'od dpag med kyi spyan sngar zhabs kyi drung du pad+ma las rdzus 57te skye bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan 98)pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsungs pa'i mdo sde dang / cho ga zhib mo dang / dkyil 'khor dang / phyag rgya rnams kha ton du kun du gnas shing tshe rabs dran par yang 'gyur ro/ /dbang po drug yongs su dag pa dang / mngon par shes pa lnga yang so sor thob bo/ /tsam la rab tu skye bar 'gyur ro9)/ /lha'i gzugs dang / kha dog dang / rtags dang /dbyibs yongs su dag pa de'i phyir stobs dang brtson 'grus kyis sems can thams cad sna tshogs 'dzin pa dang / mnyan par bgyi/ bklag 3 par bgyi/kha ton du bgyi/ ser sna'i dri ma dang bral ba dang / phrag dog dang bral bar bgyi / sems can thams cad byams pa dang / snying rje la sogs pa mchog dang yang dag par ldan pas bgyi'o/ /gzungs dang / dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'di 92—359

mnyan par bgyi/ blta 1bar bgyi/ 'jug par bgyi'o/ /phyi ma'i dus dang /phyi ma'i tshe ma yin par phul du byung ba'i don la brtson par bgyi'o zhes pa'o/ /'jig rten las 'das pa'i sgrub thabs kyi cho ga 'di ni bla na med pa zhes bgyi'o/ /mang du smos ci 'tshal te/ de la 'gran sems kyis kyang mnyan par bgyi'o zhes so / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis gzungs 'di gsungs pa'i de ma thag tu skad cig thang cig 2yud tsam gyis po ṭa la'i ri bo 'di rin po che sna bdun gyi rang bzhin du gyur to/ /me tog gi shing ljon pa dang / 'bras bu'i shing ljon pa gang yin pa rnams kyang rin po che sna bdun gyi rang bzhin gyi khang pa brtsegs par rab tu gyur to / /gang gā'i klung gi bye ma bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag rnams 'bum phrag bye ba dgu bcu rtsa dgu'i rdul phra rab dang mnyam par rab tu gyur to/ /lha rdzas kyi me tog dang 'bras bu rnam par bkra ba rnam pa sna tshogs pa rnams pham par byas pa'i rgyan rnam par bkra bas rnam par bkra zhing / dril bu g.yer kya'i dra ba dang / gser gyi dril bu 'khrol ba'i bla res dpyangs pa rnams dang / lha rdzas kyi seng ge'i khri yongs su bshams pa rnams kyang re re zhing khang pa brtsegs pa'i dbus na/ seng ge'i khri bshams pa brgya stong phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgur rab tu byung bar gyur te/ seng ge'i khri thams cad la phyogs bcu nas de bzhin gshegs pa yang dag par byon te bzhugs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyang phyag gser gyi kha dog can brkyang nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi spyi bo'i gtsug tu phyag 'jog par mdzad cing / legs so zhes bya ba'i sgra brjod par mdzad do/ /spyan ras 92—360

gzigs dbang phyug legs so legs so mchog tu khyad par du 'phags pa'i 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam chen por rab tu bstan 1)pas/ sems can thams cad pha rol tu 'gro bar byed pa dang / gang gis thos pa tsam gyis 'jig rten las 'das pa so sor khyad par du 'phags pa'i sangs rgyas nyid kyi lam tshol ba la rjes su 'gro'o/ /'on kyang bzlas pa dang / 'dri dunacib dang / klog pa dang /dkyil 'khor mthong ba dang / 'jug pa ches mang po'i nanodabang du byas pa'i sems can rnams dam tshig la rjes su 'jug par 'gyur ba 4de/ skye ba 'di nyid la de bzhin gshegs pa'i lus su rig tshonapar bya'o/ /de nas po ṭa la'i gnas kyi ri bo dang / rtswa dang / shing gel pa dang / sman dang / nags de rnams thams cad la mi gang tsam du mtho ba nyid dang / shing rta'i 'khor lo'i tshad tsam pa'i rin po che sna bdun gyi rang bzhin can gyi pad+ma rnams rab tu byung ste / 'dab 96)ma kha dog sna tshogs pa dang / sdong bu bai ḍūr+ya dang / 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser gyi kha dog ltar dmar ba'i mu tig gi ze'u 'bru dang / lha rdzas kyi mu tig gi ge sar gyis 7khor yug tu bskor ba gang yin pa la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams bzhugs te/ byang chub sems dpa' de rnams thams cad kyang chos la gus pas thams cad pus mo btsugs te/gzungs 'di'i dkyil 'khor dang phyag rgya mthong ba'i don du mu tig gi do shal brgya stong ri ba byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la mngon par bkab par gyur to/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams rdo rje'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs pa 'di yang ches cher g.yos par gyur to/ /lha'i me tog gi char chen po mang po rab tu phab 92wa 361

ste1 / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mchod pa'i don dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mchod pa'i don dang / gzungs 'di'i dkyil 'khor dam pa la mchod pa'i don du char rab tu phab bo/ /de nas yang gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rjes bzhin 'dzum zhing rdo rje bskor bzhin du bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ste lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to / /bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gzungs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'di ni shin tu rnyed par dka' ba ste/ 'di lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam par 'phrul pa dang / cho 'phrul ni de bzhin gshegs pa bskyed pa blta bar bgyi/chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar blta bar bgyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang mnyam pa nyid du blta bar bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das mthu chen po 'di 'dzam bu'i gling na mchog tu dkon par blta bar bgyi ste/ 'di ni phyi ma'i dus phyi ma'i tshe na/de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdzad pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa byed par 'gyur ro / /gang gis thos pa tsam gyis 'di lta bu'i yon tan dang phan yon so sor thob bo / /kun tu snang bar byed par 'gyur ba 'di nyid ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ma gtogs par sems can thams cad kyi nang na gzhan su yang ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lag na rdo rje ji skad smras pa de de bzhin no/ /lag na rdo rje 'dzam bu'i gling pa'i sems can thams cad ma dang phar gyur pa 'di gzungs kyi dkyil 'khor 'di dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 'di sems can thams cad kyi re ba 92—362

skong ba dang / skyob pa dang / skyabs dang / 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dpung gnyen byed pa nas/ ji srid bud med dang / skyes pa dang /khye'u dang / bu mo sems can thams cad sangs rgyas nyid kyi bdag nyid kyi bar la rab tu 'god par byed do/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi stobs dang / brtson 'grus dang / pha rol gnon pas sngon sems can rnams la phan pa'i don du zhugs pa yin no/ /de nas gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje/ nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi snying po dri ma med pa zhes bya ba'i nor bu rin po che chen po thogs nas1/byang chub sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gang na ba der dong ste lhags nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas / nor bu rin po che chen po de yang mngon par dgab par na7phul lo/ /lha rdzas kyi me tog sna tshogs pas gcal nadu bkram pa/ mchod pa'i don du rab tu bkod nas rang gi stan la 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa don yod pa dri ma med cing rnam par dag pa rab tu gsal 4ba'i 'od zer zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa gang gis spyi bo'i gtsug tu gdugs kyi rnam pa'i khang pa brtsegs pa kun tu gnas par gyur to/ /khang pa brtsegs pa de las kyang 'od zer rnam pa sna tshogs pa byung ngo / /'od zer sna tshogs pa'i snang ba des kyang nam mkha'i mthil du rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam par 'phrul pa dang / cho 'phrul chen po sna 92—363

tshogs pa bstan to/ /'od zer gyi snang ba re res kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gang gā'i 17klung gi bye ma bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu rab tu bstan non/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku de rnams thams cad kyis kyang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ sems can chen po mchog tu rnyed par dka' ba'i gzungs kyi dkyil 'khor dang / phyag rgya 'di bshad pa 'di legs so legs so/ /'jig rten las 'das pa shin tu khyad par du 'phags pa'i byang chub kyi snying por 'gro bar byed pa'i lam/ chos kyi 'khor lo skor ( )bar byed pa'i lam/ chos kyi rnam 'phrul 'bar bar byed pa/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan sgreng gebar byed pa/ chos kyi dung 'bud par byed pa/ bdud bzhi'i dkyil 'khor las rnam par rgyal bar byed pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcus gnon par byed pa/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwa 5brgyad rab tu rdzogs par byed pa/ mi 'jigs pa bzhis gnon par byed pa de bzhin nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' pha rol gnon par byed pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa bcu rab tu rdzogs par byed pa'o/ /'di ni 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad sgom par byed pa'o/ /'di ni lam rab tu nyams pa rnams kyi lam du 'chags zhi par byed pa/ bsam pa rab tu nyams pa rnams kyi bsam pa yongs su dag pa/ ngan song du 'gro bar rgyu ba rnams kyi bde 'gro'i lam du 'gro bar byed pa/ 'di ni byang chub chen po'i sa bon dang / 'bras bu rab tu ston par byed pa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas byang chub sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sems can dag 92—364

pa 'jig rten las 'das pa khyad par du 'phags pa rnam par thar pa'i dkyil 'khor don yod pa'i zhags pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi nye bar spyod pa'i cho ga shod cig /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas bskul ba thob nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i cho ga dang / dkyil 'khor gyi nye bar spyod pa'i cho ga dang /sgrub thabs gsungs so/ /gnas bzang sa gzhi dge ba dang / /sa gzhi gtsang zhing ne'u gsing 1)la/ /ljon shing me tog 'bras bus khyab/ /me tog 'khri shing 'gram dang ni/ /sa gzhi mnyen la dag pa dang / /gang du chu bo 'bab pa dang //gzi brjid ldan zhing yid dga' ba/ /sa gzhi sems ni dga' bar 'os /yid kyi shing rta rgyas byed cing / /go skabs legs par gnas pa dang / /shin tu dag cing thun tshags bral/ /rus pa gseg ma gyo mo dang / /phub ma sol ba yongs su spangs/ /gtsang zhing gtsang la legs dag pa'i/ /sa gzhi yongs su zlum pa der/ /mkhas pas rgyar ni gzings tshad du/ /gzhal nas shin tu rnam 'byes shing / /gtsang zhing mnyen 2la 'jam par phye/ /gnas der dkyil 'khor legs par bsgrubs/ /sangs rgyas byang chub bla na med/ /'jig rten las 'das khyad 'phags par/ /de bzhin gshegs kun gyis byin brlabs/ /sa yi cha las dpangs 3su ni/ /mi gang tshad du brko bar bya/ /ma gzungs dang dkyil 'khor 55skudamar po'am/ /yang na gur gum 6kha dog dang / /sa rdul dkar po snum pa ni/ /mar sar 7'dra ba 'jam pa yin/ /sa yi khyad par dbye ba de/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyis bsngags / /byang chub snying po sa der 92—365

mtshungs / /ring bsrel bzhugs pa'i mchod rten dang / /de ni mtshungs par gyur pa yin/ /brkos 1pa'i nang du mkhas pa yis/ /slar yang sa de ②dgang bar /bya/ /ji srid dong bu mnyam par gang/ /de ni dkyil 'khor yang dag pa'o / /nyung ri dang lhag pa bsngags pa min/ /'dir ni 'grub pa med par bstan / /khru ni sum cu rtsa gnyis tshad/ /mkhas pas dkyil 'khor thig dag gdab / /yang na khru ni bcu drug dang / /yang na khru ni bco lngar (5)bya/ /mnyam zhing grwa bzhir 6legs par dbye/ /ba yi lci ba dag dang ni/ /sa dang bsres te bsku bya ba/ /shin tu zhen par bsdig (7)pa dang / /'jam zhing mnyen ⑧par bya ba yin9/ /de la dkyil 1 'khor thig gdab pa/ /sna tshogs tshon /3gyis kun tu dbye/ /sgo bzhi rnam par 'byes 12pa dang / /rta babs bzhi dang ldan par 1 bya/ /dkyil 'khor dbus kyi snying po ni/ /rnam par phye ste gru bzhi tshadabo/ /khru gsum yang na khru bzhi ni/ /thig skud tshon mgyis rnam par dbye/ /nang gi thig ni 7tshad dag tu/ /mdung rtse gsum pa dag dang ni/ /nor bu rin chen sna tshogs bya/ /bar gyi thig gi tshad dag tu/ /pad+ma yo dang ni rdo rje dganyashe /kun tu bri bar bya ba yin/ /phyi yi thig gi tshad dag tu/ /rdo rje rnam pa'i stegs 1gebu dang / /rin chen sna tshogs gzhal med khang / /stegs bu dag kyang bri bar bya/ /pad+ma'i dbus su gzhal med khang / /gzhal yas khang pa gnas par bya/ /dkyil 'khor dbus kyi pad+ma la/ /rnam par snang mdzad thub pa bya/ /g.yon du 'od ni dpag med pa/ /g.yas phyogs su ni de bzhin gshegs/ /shākya'i rgyal po dag dang ni/ /don yod rgyal po 'jig rten gyi/ /dbang phyug mgon la mngon sum 2 du/ /btud de thal mo sbyor ba ni/ /phyag bzhi par ni bya ba yin/ /92—366

phyag gnyis kyis nyu ni sna tshogs pa'i/ /me tog rnams ni 'chang (2ba dang / /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan dpar bya/ /'od dpag med pa'i mdun du ni/ /khro bo'i rgyal po phyag bzhi pa/ /btud de thal mo sbyor ba dang / /lha rdzas me tog sna tshogs pa/ /lag pa gnyis na thogs pa dang / /sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyan 4par bya/ /dbus kyi dkyil 'khor legs brgyan pa5)/ /sna tshogs dar gyis mdzes par bya/ /don yod zhags pa'i phyag rgya che/ / pad+ma gdan (67dang rnam rgyan 'chipa/ /'bar ba'i nang na yod par bya/ / grwa bzhir nadag ni byas na ni/ /gnyis kyi bar gyi cha bzhi ste/ /dbus kyi gnas su 'jigs med pa/ /shar gyi gnas su gnas pa ni/ /lha mo sgrol ma rnam par brgyan9/ /g.yas kyi gnas su gnas pa ni/ /gos dkar mo ni rnam par brgyan1 / /nub kyi gnas na gnas pa ni/ /lha mo dkar mo rnam par brgyan11/ /byang gi gnas na gnas pa ni/ /lha mo pad+ma mdzes dga' brgyan12/ /dkyil 'khor phyi rim grwa 1 rnams su/ /rgyal chen bzhi ni gzhag par bya/ /bar gyi gnas su gzhag pa ni/ /ral pa gcig pa gtum mo sashar/ /nub tu pho nya bzhin sgyur ma/ /g.yas phyogs su ni bzhin sgyur ma/ /rdo rje lcags sgrog skabya ba yin/ /byang du srin mo khro gnyer gdong 17/ /kun kyang me dbus 'jigs pa med/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su dgod pa bzhin/ /phyi rol thig le pad+mo'i phreng 1 / /rdo rje rtse gsum gzhag pa ni/ /kun tu 'bar ba phreng /2bar bcas/ /phyi rol dkyil 'khor kun tu ni/ /bri bya rtag 19dang phyag rgya dang / /lha ni dbang phyug dbang phyug che/ /tshangs pa khyab 'jug gshin rje dang / /chu lha dbang po lus ngan po/ /dbang sgyur dga' ldan gnas dag gi/ /lha nas 'og min gnas kyi bar/ /lha rnams bri bar bya ba yin/ /sum cu rtsa 92—367

gsum lha rnams dang / /rtags 1 ni rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /kun kyang pad+mo'i gdan 5)la gnas/ /de bzhin chos kyi 'khor lo dang / /rdo rje rtse lnga rdo rje dang / /zhags pa dang ni dgra sta dang / /legs mthong 'khor lo de bzhin no/ /mdung (kyirtse gsum dang pas sa sku/ / ngos la 55skadabyug pa tho ba dang / /rdo rje dkyil 'khor pad+ma'i phreng / /'khor lo dung cadang ga dā (3)dang / /ral gri dang (sheni to (()ma ro/ / /bum pa gang ba dag dang ni/ /mi snang ba yi 'bag sha dang nyunye/ /pad+ma dang ni ut+pa la/ /rgyal mtshan gdugs dang nor bu dang / /dbyug pa dang ni rdo rje dang / / grwa bzhir 12rdo rjes mtshan pa 1 yin/ /nor bu rdo rje dag dang ni/ /dgra sta rdo rje dag dang ni/ /phyag rgya bzhi dang dga' ba 'khyil/ /bya ma bum dang kun di ngadang / /ril ba lhang ga 15ri dang ni/ /ri dgas e na'i pags pa dang glu/ /mchod phyir thogs pa'i snam bu dang / /steng du rgyu skar nyu bcas pa yi / /zla ba nyi ma de bzhin no/ /kun kyang 'bar ba'i nang du 'dug /so sor (2cha ni dbye bar bya/ /mkhas pas shar gyi sgor bri ba/ /'gying bag mthong (rten 'jigs su rung / /lag na rdo rje 'jigs pa med/ /rdo rje 'chang ba 'bar ba'i nang / / ki li ki la 2 gtum po che/ /lho phyogs kyi ni sgo ru gzhag /nub tu rdo rje ping ga la/ /mthong na 'jigs su rung ba yi kā/ /byang du nges par gnod mdzes 22bya/ /phyi rol dkyil 'khor kun tu ni/ /pad+ma'i phreng dang ut+pal phreng / /grwa na dag dang ni grwa 2 rnams su/ /klu yi rgyal po bzhi rnams bri/ /sgo srung ba dag bri ba ni/ /nor bu bzang dang gang ba bzang / /stobs kyi lha dang lngas rtsen yin / /sgo yi gnas kyi bar dag tu/ /chu bo bzhi ni bri bya ba/ /gang gā 2snyedang ni si 7ta dang / /pak+ṣu 2 dang ni sirtu 28yin/ /phreng ba'i nang rol thog dag tu/ /92wa 368

dpal gyi lha mo ba san khri1)/ /dpe med ma dang sa yi lha/ /lo tog na sman gyi lha mo dang / /sgra )dbyangs ma dang 'jigs ldan ma/ /de bzhin mi 4yi lha dag dang / /'phrog ma dang ni dung can ma/ /gtum pa mo dang〉de me tog so/ /de dag bri bar bya ba yin/ /khrus byas 'dri nemakhan gtsang 7ma yis/ /gtsang ma'i snod du tshon 8)rnams ni/ /lhag ma min pas kun tu bri/ /zas ni dkar gsum grub par bya/ /khyad par 'dod pas zas ngan pa/ /spang bar bya ba nya dang sha(9) /btsong tshedang sgog skya 11ke'u rnams dang / /'dres pa spang 1rtabar bya ba ni/ /log 'dren glags tshol spang phyir ro/ /khrus byas gos ni sar nyi ba bgos/ri/ /gtsang mas dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /dkyil 'khor rnam pa sna tshogs kyisaslo/ /kun tu brgyan 7par bya ba ni/ /ba dan rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs mda' nyu tshodang ni/ /lha rdzas dar ni dpyang ba 18dang / /ba dan yang ni dpyang bar 69bya/ /tshon 2 skud sna lnga'i srad 1bu yis/ /kun tu yongs su bskor 22bar bya/ /zangs las byas pa'i pad+ma'i tshad/ /sor bzhi 'dab nam bye ba de dī/ /mdzes 25pa grwa ni5bzhir gzugs par bya/ /snying po 2 dkyil 'khor grwa rnams su/ /pad+ma brgyad hūṃ snyeni gzhal 29ba dag /gser las byas pa bzhi gzhag cing / /de bzhin dngul las byas pa bzhi/ /kun tu byi da ru'i phreng ba dang / /mu tig phreng ba de bzhin no/ /kun tu gser gyi srad bu dang / /rin chen sna tshogs gzhag par bya/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor thig bar du/ /gser gyi snod ni bzhi dag dang / /dngul gyi snod ni bzhi gzhag 1go/ /dngul gyi bum pa gang ba da bzhi la dngul dang / gser dang / zangs sharnyilas byas pa'i me tog spras pa'i mgo lcogs kyis spras pa gzhag par bya'o/ /gser gyi bum pa bzhi gzhag 5pa la mu 92—369

tig dang / byi 1ru dang / pad+ma rā ga (snyedang / margad dang / in+d+ra nī ③la dang / dngul dang / gser dang / me tog gis spras pa'i mgo lcogs ④ gzhag par bya'o/ /gla 55sirtsi dang / ga pur dang / gur gum zhi༄dang / lha rdzas kyi tsan+dan gyi 75phye mas gser gyi snod bkang ba dang / dngul gyi snod kyi nang du gser gyi me tog dang / dngul gyi me tog dang / zangs kyi me tog mu tig gis brgyan nacing rin po che rnam pa 99sna tshogs tshespras pa gzhag par bya/ cod pan gyi rgyal mtshan bzhi gzhag par bya/ rin po che'i rgyal mtshan bzhi gzhag par bya/tshon 11sna tshogs can dang / dar dmar po dpyang bar 8bya/ dngul gyi pog (dephor bzhi gzhag ste/ tsan+dan dang / gla rtsi dang /kha ga bur dang / gur gum skagyi bdug pas 7bdug par bya/ sa las byas pa'i bum pa gser gyis g.yogs pa'i nang du dri chab rnam pa sna tshogs kyis bkang ste/ rin po che sna bdun dang ldan par bgyis la bkang ba la dar gyis bcings la rgyan rnam pa sna tshogs kyis brgyan 1 pa'i steng du zangs las byas pa'i me tog bzhag nas snying po'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du pad+ma'i steng du gzhag par bya'o/ /de nas phyi rol gyi dkyil 'khor thog thag 18tu dri dang / phye ma dang / byug the pa dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu la sogs pa rnam pa sna tshogs dang / mchod yon gyi chab kyis dngul gyi snod dang / zangs kyi snod bkang ba drug cu rtsa bzhi gzhag par bya'o/ /lcags kyi snod bum pa gang ba drug cu rtsa bzhi gzhag par bya'o/ /me tog dang /mgo lcogs 2 dang / pog phor bkang ba drug cu rtsa bzhi gzhag par bya'o/ /gzhag par bya ste bdug pa sna tshogs kyis bdug par bya'o/ /sgo bzhir dri chab kyi bum pa dar gyis brgyan cing spud 21pa gzhag par bya'o/ /sna ma'i me tog gi gdu 3292—370

bu'i steng du (1)mda' la ba dan btags pa drug cu rtsa bzhi btsugs te/ tshon rinasna tshogs kyis bkra bar byas pa'i mda' dang / nor bu'i phreng ba rnam pa sna tshogs kyis dkyil 'khor brgyan dpar bya'o/ /de nas phyi rol gyi dkyil 'khor thog thag tu tsunyes dang bsres 5pa'i ba'i lci bas dkyil 'khor byas la dri chab kyis bskus te/tshon (6)sna lnga'i srad bus thig btab la sgo bzhi rnam par phye ste/ seng ldeng gi phur bu (7)tshad sor bcu gnyis pa drug cu rtsa bzhi gdab bo/ /tshon 8sna lnga'i srad bus dkyil 'khor kun du bskor bar bya'o/ /bum bu 9dang / bum pa dang / bya ma bum drug cu rtsa bzhi tshegator ma sna tshogs kyis bkang 11ba gzhag go/ /kham por zlum po drug cu rtsa bzhi gtor sna ma sna tshogs kyis bkang ba gzhag go/ /gtor ma tshul sna tshogs pa drug cu rtsa bzhi so sor gzhag go12/ /7 snod tshon sna lnga pa drug cu rtsa bzhi kha zas rnam pa sna tshogs kyis bkang ba dang / bca' ba rnam pa sna tshogs blugs pa dang / gtor ma dkar po rnam pa sna tshogs gzhag go/ /yo byad thams cad kyis yongs su gang ba/ ro rnam pa sna 15tshogs kyi gtor ma gzhag go/ /'bras bu sna tshogs dang / me tog tshasna tshogs dgram 1 mo/ /phreng 1 ba brgya nyi shu rtsa gcig dkyil 'khor du dpyang 19bar bya ste/ byang phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor la drug cu rtsa bzhi snying po'i dkyil 'khor la sum cu rtsa gnyis gdags so/ /me mar gyi sdong bu bzhi bud par bya'o/ /gtor ma brgya drug cu rtsa bzhi dang dkyil 'khor thog thag tu mar me bud par bya'o/ /chang dang sha dang / beg btsong 2 dang /sgog skya dang / ke'u dang / tshod sngon dang / la phug spangs pa'i gtor ma gzhan rnam pa sna tshogs gzhag par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol grwa 21bzhir don yod pa'i zhags pa'i mdo sde bklag 2par bya'o ri/ /sgo re rer bcom ldan 92—371

'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bklag 51)par bya'o(2/ /chos klog pa legs par khrus byas te/ lha rdzas kyi gos 54༄kyis dkris du te/ gtsang 96)ma la dri rnam pa sna tshogs kyis bsgos pa'i gos gtsang ri ni/ma sar pa 'byebagos te/ chos kyi stan shin tu brgyan ri9pa lha rdzas kyi stan la 'dug nas tshig 'jam po 7tshig mnyen 11pos bklag 12par bya'o/ /nub kyi phyogs kyi cha la dkyil 8'khor mthon po la bde ba can gyi 15bkod pa bris 17pa 'od dpag med dang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang phyug dang / mthu chen 3 thob pa'i gzugs bri ba'i yinyeras kyi sku gzugs dkyil 'khor la mngon du phyogs par gzhag par bya'o/ /shar gyi phyogs cha la dkyil 'khor grwa 19bzhi mthon po byas la rnam par grol ba'i dkyil 'khor la shākya thub pa dang / 'phags pa rdo rje 'chang ba dang / don yod pa'i zhags pa'i khro bo'i gzugs bris pa ras kyi sku gzugs dkyil 'khor la mngon du phyogs par gzhag go/ /lho'i 2 phyogs cha la ri 'dra ba'i gnas mthon po byas la de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal po dang / 'jam dpal dang /sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba dang / don yod pa'i 2)zhags pa ras la bris pa'i dkyil 'khor la mngon du phyogs par gzhag go/ /byang gi phyogs cha la khro bo'i rgyal po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad dang /byams pa dang / sa'i snying po bris pa'i ras kyi sku gzugs dkyil 'khor la mngon du phyogs par gzhag go/ /stegs bu'i rnam par mthon por na byas pa thams cad legs par brgyan na par bya'o/ /dar gyi phreng 3 /bas brgyan 25par bya'o / /rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan 7pa dang / bum pa gang ba gzhag pa na dang / dris dkyil 'khor bya ba dang / ro'i mchog rnam pa sna tshogs bza' 92—372

ba'i ngo bo rnam pa (1du ma'i kha (5)zas kyi ro 'bul ri ba dang / 'bras bu rnam pa sna tshogs dang ldan pa'i bsod snyoms gzhag pa dang / tsan+dan dang / a ga —ru dang / du ruska dang / ga bur 55)dang / gla rtsi dang / gur gum dang bsres 6pa'i bdug pa ras kyi sku gzugs la dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang bas dus gsum du khrus bya zhing / gos lan gsum brjes 7te/ dus gsum du bzlas brjod dang cho ga bya'o/ /tshes brgyad nas brtsams te tshes bco 8lnga tshang gi bar du don yod pa'i zhags pa lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod bya'o/ /khro bo'i rgyal po lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod bya'o/ /don yod pa'i zhags pa'i lcags kyu nyi shu rtsa gcig dang / don yod pa rnam par lta 9ba'i zhags pa'i snying po dang ⑩'jig rten las 'das pa rnam par 'phrul pa lan nyi shu rtsa gcig dang / rnam par grol ba'i dkyil 'khor byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis phyag byas pa stong rtsa 17brgyad bzlas 12brjod bya ba dang / rnam par grol ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi zhags pa'i snying po stong rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bya'o/ /zla ba nya la tsho thug gi bar du zas dkar gsum bza' bar bya'o/ /tshes bco 7lnga'i nyin mtshan thog thag 'atu don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po dpag tu med par bzlas brjod bya'o/ /mtshan thog thag bzlas brjod byas kyang ngal ba med pa dang /lus snyom sapa dang bral bas bzlas 1 brjod bya'o/ /byams pa dang / snying rje'i lhag pa'i bsam pa'i sems su bya'o bzlas brjod kyi cho ga zin nas dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba mtshams bcad pa dang / phyogs bcing ba dang / bdag srung 12ba dang / gzhan srung 19ba dang dkyil 'khor bsdam pa byas nas/ de nas 'khor rnams dkyil 'khor du dam tshig la gzhug 2 par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor du gzhug 2192—373

pa dang / dkyil 'khor gyi las zin nas mchod pa brtsam 5)mo/ /mchod pa'i cho ga zin pa dang / de nas bzlas (2 brjod brtsam par bya ste/ don yod pa'i zhags pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi spyan sngar 'dug nas/ don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po bzlas brjod byas la/ khro bo'i rgyal po brgya rtsa brgyad kyis dbang bskur tshonaro / /bzlas brjod lan nyi shu rtsa gcig dang / dbang bskur ma thag tu ras kyi sku gzugs dang / dkyil 'khor thams cad kun tu 'bar zhing 'od zer sna tshogs 'byin cing legs so zhes bya ba'i sgra 'byin par 'gyur ro/ /rig ( stesngags 'chang ba'i snying dga' zhing lus 'bar bar 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug shin tu 'bar zhing 'od 'phro ba nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i 'od zer can don yod pa'i zhags pa tshangs 5 pa'i cha byad 'chang ba dkyil 'khor gyi dbus kyi nang nas mngon du gshegs te/ phyogs bcu'i dkyil 'khor kun la rnam par gzigs shing rig sngags 'chang ba legs so zhes bya ba'i sgra phyung ste/phyag g.yas pa brkyang ste rig sngags 'chang ba'i spyi bo la bzhag ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi mchog shin tu brgyan cing spras pa 'di ni shin tu bzang ba yin te/ legs so legs so/ /'di rnam par grol ba'i dkyil 'khor don yod pa'i zhags pa rnam par 'phrul pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis (6)byin gyis brlabs pa/byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis phyag byas pa de bzhin gshegs pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi gsang ba/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / srin po rnams kyi dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor bdud thams cad pham par byed pa'i dkyil 'khor bshegs dang / rnam par 7no92—374

log 'dren thams cad 'joms pa/ bud med dang / skyes pa dang / khye'u dang / bu mo dang / dge sbyong dang / bram ze dang / rje'u'i rigs dang /dmangs 1)rigs dang / tha na byol song gi skye tshogeganas su gtogs pa'i bya'ang rirung ste/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i gcong ri norong las sgrol ba yin no/ /'di ni sdig pa dang / sgrib pa thams cad dang / dmyal ba dang / sdug bsngal dang / nad dang / skye ba dang / rga ba dang / 'chi ba las yongs su thar bar byed cing 'jigs pa med pa'i khyim du 'jug par byed pa yin no/ /'di ni rnam par thar par byed pa dkyil 'khor chen po snying po dang / gsang sngags su bcas pa rnam par grol ba'i dkyil 'khor byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis phyag byas pa 'di rig sngags 'chang ba de dang des ming brjod pa dang /gang dran pa tsam la sogs pa dang / lta ba dang / nyan pa dang / ming 'dzin pa yang 'khor ba'i pha rol tu rgal debar 'gyur ro/ /phyir mi ldog pa nyid du sa bcu bgrod nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa thob (6)par 'gyur ro/ /de gang zhe na/ gang zhig dkyil 'khor chen po 'di 'dra ba mngon du mthong ba dang / rnam par grol ba'i gzungs 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gsang sngags kyi tshig bzlas 7brjod byed pa dang / klog pa dang /dran pa dang / 'chad pa dang / lan 'ga' sgyur 8bas mthong ba dang / thang cig poradang / skad cig 7dang / yud tsam gyis mthong ba ni nga dang mnyam pa dang / mi nyu1mnyam pa yin no zhes smra'o/ /bdag ni sems can de la 12de bzhin gshegs pa yin par yang 'dzin te/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa yin pas spyi bos dbang bskur 1 bar bgyi'o/ /rig sngags 'chang 92—375

bas zung shig 1dang / mchog ji ltar 'dod pa dang / ji ltar yid la re ba dang / bsam pa 2thams cad rjes su gzung zhing nisbyin par mdzad do/ /de'i tshe rig sngags 'chang bas yid la ji ltar bsams (4༄pa'i mchog smras na/ de thams cad sbyin par mdzad cing don yod pa'i ye shes bkod 52pa rnam par grol ba dri ma med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang gang gā'i 6klung gi bye ma dang mnyam pa khrag khrig stong phrag bcu'i ting nge ri7)'dzin thob par 'gyur ro/ /rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha' la 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /dkyil 'khor de'i dam tshig tu zhugs pa ni dam tshig shes pa'i rjes su zhugs pa yin te/ de dag thams cad sa bcu la rab tu gnas pa yin/ 'di lta ste/bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ba'i phyir mi ldog pa thob par 'gyur ba yin/ lung bstan pa dang byin gyis brlabs (8ripar 'gyur ba yin/ de ni mngal na gnas par skye ba'i tha ma ste/ phyis 59rimangal na gnas pa'i dri mas gos par mi 'gyur ro/ /shi nas bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de pad+mo'i nang nas rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan tsopar rdzus te skyes par 11'gyur ro/ /tshe rabs kun tu tshe rabs dran par 'gyur ro/ /don yod pa'i rgyal po'i phun sum tshogs pa cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po rnam 12par grol ba'i dkyil 'khor de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byang chub kyi 1 snying po chos kyi 'khor lo bskor 1 ba/ dam tshig chen po 'di kha ton 7byed na phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad sangs rgyas kyi zhing na byang chub kyi snying po la bzhugs 7pa mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi spyan sngar legs so zhes bya ba thob par 'gyur te/ rigs kyi bu skye ba blangs pa 92—376

legs par skye ba yin pas legs so legs so/ /phyir mi ldog par bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la rab tu gnas pa yin no/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams 'od zer 'bum phrag 917bye bas mdzes par gyur cing bsod nams kyis brgyan (5)pa'i phyag gser gyi mdog can brkyang 4rinas spyi bor phyag 'jog cing dbugs 'byin par yang mdzad do/ /byang chub kyi snying po la thug gi bar du chos 'bel 95raba'i gtam mngon sum 'du sgrogs 7par mdzad do/ /tha na dkyil 'khor chen po rol mo'i sgra rnga rin bo che dang / rnga bran dang / dung dang / rdza rnga dang /rol mo'i sgra gang dag grag pa la sems can gang dag gis sgra de thos nas rna 9ba'i bu ga tsam du song ba de thams cad phyir mi ldog par 'gyur zhing bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la rab tu gnas par 'gyur ro/ /tha na byol song gi skye gnas su gtogs par 1 7bya'i rna bar sgra thos pa de dag thams cad kyang phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar na rnam par 'phrul ba'i cho 'phrul chen po dang ldan pa rnam par thar pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga mthu chen po rnam par 'phrul pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu pho'am/ rigs kyi bu mo'am/ dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen 11nam/ dge bsnyen 12ma'am/ sems can gzhan gang yang rung ba dge sbyong 1dngam/ bram ze'am/ rgyal rigs sam/ rje'u'i rigs sam/ dmangs 1 rigs sam/ 'ga' zhig gis 15rnam par grol ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'di 'khor mang 7po'i nang du klog pa dang sems can gang gis sgra de thos nas sgra dbyangs de dang ming thos pa rna 1 ba'i bu gar song bar gyur 1 pa de dag thams cad sgrib pa dang / sdig pa mi zad 19pa las bral 92—377

bar 'gyur ro/ /sngon gyi sgrib pa dang / sdig pa las rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro / /phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 0)sras su rig par bya'o/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sras kyi thu kugyibo yin no/ /rtag par 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang phyug grogs mdzad cing rjes su 'brang bar 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu dbugs 'byin pa (5)mdzad par 'gyur ro/ /mthar byang chub kyi snying po la gnas kyi bar du rtag tu zhi)rjes su srung bar mdzad do/ /sems can gang zhig dkyil 'khor de'i sa phyogs su song ste/sa gzhi 5snang ba tsam mthong ba de dag thams cad kyang phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro//nyon mongs pa thams cad bsregs 6shing sgrib pa thams cad las 7)yongs su grol bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i sa rdul rlung gis bdas te lus la phog pa gang yin pa de dang / tha na sems can rinangan pa yang rung ste/ de dag thams cad phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ba'i gnas la rab tu gnas par 'gyur ro/ /sdig pa thams cad las yongs su grol ba dang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug rtag tu mthong ba dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dgongs par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis dbugs phyung bar 'gyur ro/ /lha thams cad kyis bsrung bar 9'gyur ro/ /bsod nams kyi phung po chen po yongs su gzung 1 bar 'gyur ro/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba chen po dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar na sgra thos pa tsam dang / ming 'dzin pa tsam gyis 'bras bu chen po thob par 'gyur ro/ /de nas rnam par grol ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi sbyin sreg 11gi cho ga bshad par bya ste/ sdig pa dang / sgrib pa thams cad sreg cing sdug bsngal 12drag po las rnam par grol bar 'gyur ba dang / nyon 92—378

mongs pa drag po'i rgya mtsho dang / 'khor ba las sgrol ba 'grub pa phyir mi ldog pa'i gnas bla na med par dbugs 'byin par mdzad pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i lam ༅ston pa/ sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' ston pa/ lha'i stegs sbyin sreg nabyas pa tsam gyi mod la the tshom dmed par me lha dang / dbang po dang / khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / dbang phyug dang / gshin rje dang / chu lha dang / lus ngan po dang / gzhon nu rnams sbyin sreg byas pa 'di tsam gyi tsho mod la thams cad 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /the tshom 45med par lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang /dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye 56)chen po dang / srin po dang / sha za dang / grul 7bum thams cad 'ong bar 'gyur zhing / de'i mod la rig sngags 'chang ba'i rkang 2pa gnyis la rtag tu 'dud par byed do/ /de bzhin du nyin mtshan du kun tu srung 9bar 'gyur ro//rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / phyag na rdo rje bdag nyid chen po dang / gnod sbyin gyi dbang po chen po bcu yang phyogs bcur srung bar 1 byed de11/ mi srun pa ma rungs pa sel cing dmyal ba dang / 'jigs pa mi bzad 12pa dang / dug drag po dang / sems can ma rungs pa rnams sel bar byed do/ /de ma thag tu bsod nams chen po'i lhun po 1 dang / bsod nams chen po'i phung po bla na med pa skye bar 'gyur ro/ /tsan+dan srang nyi shu dang / a ga 1 ru srang lnga dang /du ru ska 7srang bdun dang / ga bur dang / gla rtsi lasung gcig gi bzhi cha re re dang / gur gum 1 srang gcig dang / lce pog kun du ra srang lnga dang / gu 92—379

gul srang bdun dang 'di rnams gcig tu bsres ca1)te/ phye mar byas la kha ra dkar 2po dang / sbrang rtsis ril bu /zho re'i tshad tsam du byas pa stong rtsa brgyad dang / yungs kur cadang / 'bras yos bsres 5)te/ ril bu (6)dang bsres nas mar gyi nang du smyugs 7te sbyin sreg 8bya'o/ /shing sru (1)ra bhi dang / shing arka 1 dang / shing sha mya'i 11yam sreg sna shing gi 35me sbar te sbyin sreg gi cho ga bya'o / /gang dang 1 gang gi tshe stong rtsa brgyad sbyin sreg byas na de dang de'i tshe sdig pa dang / sgrib pa drag po thams cad sreg 'apar 'gyur ro/ /de dang de'i tshe de nad thams cad las yongs su grol bar 'gyur ro/ /de dang de'i tshe gcong thams cad las yongs su grol bar 'gyur ro/ /de dang de'i tshe 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can bud med dang / skyes pa dang / khye'u dang / bu mo dang /dge sbyong lodang / bram ze dang / rgyal rigs dang / rje'u rigs nyu tshodang /dmangs 18rigs la sogs pa thams cad kyi 1 sdig pa dang / sgrib pa thams cad byang bar 'gyur ro/ /sdig pa thams cad dang / byur thams cad dang /gnod pa thams cad dang / 'khrug pa thams cad dang / 'thab pa dang /rtsod pa dang / g.yul 'gyed pa dang / shags 'gyed pa thams cad dang /rang gi 'khor dang / gzhan gyi 'khor gyi 'jigs pa thams cad dang / phyir rgol 2 ba'i dgras 'jigs pa thams cad dang / sems can ma rungs pa thams cad dang / rkun 21po dang / zol ba dang / mi rgod pa dang / gcan gzan 2gtum po'i 'jigs pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /sems can de dag thams cad 'jigs pa med par 'gyur ro/ /bud med dang / skyes pa dang / khye'u dang / bu mo dang / dge sbyong dang / bram ze dang / rgyal 92wa 380

rigs dang / rje'u rigs 0ridang / dmangs (5)rigs gang dag gis de'i dri tshor ba de dag thams cad kyang phyir mi ldog par 'gyur zhing /ri/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la rab tu gnas par 'gyur ro/ /tshe brjes 4nas thams cad bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams su 'gro bar 'gyur zhing /pad+mo'i nang nas rdzus 457te skye bar 'gyur ro/ /byol song gi skye gnas su gtogs pa rkang gnyis pa 6)dang / rkang bzhi pa rnams kyis de'i dri tshor ba tsam gyis thams cad nges par phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur zhing mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /rig sngags 'chang ba de ji lta ji ltar sbyin sreg byed pa de lta de ltar de'i lus dri ma med cing yongs su dag par 'gyur ro/ /stong rtsa brgyad tshang na rig dzo sngags 'chang ba'i lus 'bar bar 'gyur ro/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas mang po'i sku mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku de dag gis rig sngags 'chang ba la 8legs so zhes bya ba'i sgra 'byin te/ rig 9sngags 'chang ba legs so legs so/ /'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 1 gsang ba'i mchog /rnam par grol ba'i dkyil 'khor 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga yin no/ /'di ni bdud thams cad rab tu 'joms pa'i sbyin sreg chen po'i cho ga yin no/ /'di ni gnod sbyin dang /srin po dang / 'byung po dang / brjed byed dang / bgegs dang / log 'dren tshar gcod 11pa'i sbyin sreg chen po'i cho ga yin no/ /'di ni byang chub kyi snying por song ste/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor 1 ba'i sbyin sreg chen po'i cho ga yin no / /'di ni byang chub kyi lam bla na med pa yin no/ /de nas de bzhin 92—381

gshegs pa'i sku de dag thams cad kyis (1)phyag g.yas pa gser gyi ( kha dog lta bu brkyang ste/ rig sngags 'chang ba'i mgo'i chod spyi bo la phyag 'jog par mdzad do/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi rang gi ngo bo nyid kyi rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan 4pa/ don yod pa'i zhags pa dang / tshangs pa'i cha byad 'chang ba/dbu lcang 5lo cod pan gyis brgyan 64pa/ pad+ma dang / mdung rtse gsum pa dang /zhags pa thogs pa/ rig sngags 'chang ba'i mdun na bzhugs 7)te bka' stsol dushepa / rig sngags 'chang ba khyod kyis don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po rnam par grol ba'i dkyil 'khor 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga chen po grub pa legs so legs so/ /zung 9shig dang / mchog ji lta ba dang / ji ltar 'dod pa de thams cad sbyin no/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang bas ji ltar 'dod pa'i mchog smras na de thams cad thob par 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi 7dbang phyug gis phyag brkyang nyurtaste/ rig sngags 'chang ba'i mgo'i spyi bo la phyag bzhag pa dang / phyag bzhag ma thag tu rig tu sngags 'chang nyunyenam mkha' la 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /phyogs ngabacu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du 'gro bar 'gyur ro15/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mngon sum du mthong ba thob par 'gyur ro/ /phyir mi ldog pa dang / phyir mi ldog pa'i gnas thob par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zhing du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dbang bskur lob thob par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zhing la bsnyen bkur 17byas nas bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams su 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dang bcas pa chos 'chad pa/ byang chub kyi snying po la thug gi bar du mngon sum 92—382

du thob par 'gyur ro/ /de nas hom khung bshad par bya ste/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sbyin sreg gi gnas bla na med pa'i ri 1)pad+ma kha bye ba 'dra bar byas pa/zlum lapo khru gsum pa sa dang ba'i lci ba bsres pa dang ldan par byas te(5)/pad+ma'i snying po la hom khung zabs su brko ba dang / thab 4༄ka kun tu khru gang ba brko bar bya'o/ /nang du pad+ma bcu drug pa 'bur du byas pa bzhag la/ tshon sna tshogs kyis pad+ma de brgyan 59par bya'o/ /pad+ma'i phyi 'khor du dkyil 'khor gru bzhir byas la dri sna tshogs kyis gtor ba dang brgyan par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor kun tu bum pa gang ba bzhi dang / dngul gyi snod gang ba bzhi dang / mchod yon gyi chus bkang ba gser gyi snod bzhi dang / ro sna tshogs kyi gtor ma gzhag pa ni gtor ma dkar gsum rnam pa sna tshogs dang 'bras bu rnam pa sna tshogs gzhag pa dang / dri dang me tog 96sna tshogs kyis gtor te/ phreng ba rnam pa sna tshogs dpyangs 57)la/ dkyil 'khor kun du tshon sna lnga'i ba dan gyis mda' la brgyan te gzugs pa dang / sgo bzhi cha dbye ba dang / bum pa gzhag pa ni legs par brgyan 8)cing dri chus yongs su bkang bar 99bya'o/ /sgo bzhir chos smra ba ⑩shin tu brgyan pa'i stan la 'dug ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bklag 11par bya'o/ /grwa kyi bzhir chos smra ba chos kyi stan legs par brgyan pa la 'dug nas don yod pa'i zhags pa'i mdo sna sde bklag 7par bya'o/ /gser gyi me tog dang / dngul gyi me tog dang / zangs kyi me tog dang / rin po che sna bdun gyis gemachod par bya'o/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang bas khrus byas gos gtsang ma bgos dri zhim pos bgos khote/ gtsang mar byas pa 1 la ril bu 18la don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po brgya rtsa 19brgyad bzlas brjod bya'o/ /khro bo'i rgyal po 92—383

brgya rtsa brgyad kyis dbang bskur 1ro/ /don yod pa rnam par lta ba'i snying po brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bya'o/ /de nas don yod pa rnam par lta ba'i 98)'bar ba rnam par grol ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi zhags pa'i snying pos stong rtsa brgyad sbyin sreg dbya ba ni mi smra bar byams 4pa'i sems dang / snying thag pa 5nonas brtse ba dang / snying rje bar bya ba ni 6las bla na med pa yin no/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di lta ste/oṃ pad+ma pyapā ṇi / tsa ra tsa ra pad+ma bhu dze/ dz+wa la dz+wa la 591hū tā sha de⑩/ bhu ru bhu ru / bi mo k+ṣa bhu dze/ da ha da ha/ sarba ma lānatsholha/ a mo gha pā nyu2ni ba ra de/hūṃ hūṃ nir da ha/ pā paṃ/ sha ma sha ma ni ri/ lo kot+ta tshar ṇi/ sa man+ta tsharakhyi tsheb ra de1 / tu ru tu 18ru/ pra ba re/ a mo gha sid dhi/ oṃ 23 19ba/ na mo stu te swā 2 hā/ de ni rnam par grol ba'i dkyil 'khor 'bar ba zhags pa chen po'i snying po dang / gzungs kyi sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'jig rten las 'das pa bla na med pa yin no/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang bas thal ba des rmad du byung ba chen po'i bya ba thams cad bya'o/ /thal ba des gang gi 21lus la byugs pa de ni sgrib pa dang sdig pa thams cad las grol bar 'gyur ro/ /dpral bar thig le byas na de ma thag tu zhag bzhi pa'i rims las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /zhag gnyis pa dang /zhag gsum pa dang / mtshan mo pa 22dang / nyin par pa dang / nam 2 phyed pa dang / nyin 2 phyed pa dang / lo gcig pa dang / zla ba gcig pa dang / zhag bdun pa dang / rtag pa'i rims na lan 'ga' yang gnas shing phyir 'ong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /dpag tshad brgya 7'das te 'bros par 'gyur ro/ /mtshog mar 92—384

thig le byas na gdon 1stong phrag brgyad cu nartsa bzhi las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /thams cad kyang phyogs bcur dpag tshad stong du 'bros par 'gyur ro/ /thal ba'i rdul bya rog gi mchu la gos pa phyogs kyi gnas gang du lhung ba der gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / 'byung po dang / sha za dang / yi dgas dang /grul bum na dang / brjed byed dang / bgegs dang / log 'dren 4phyir gnas par mi 'gyur ro/ /thams cad 'bros so5/ /phyogs kyi gnas der lhung na slar po'ong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /snying gar 7thig le byas na nad thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /lte ba'i gnas su thig le byas na lto ba'i nang gi nad thams cad mod la sos par 'gyur ro/ /gdug 8pas zin pa la bskus na dug med par 'gyur ro/ /dug gis myos pa la byin na dug med par 'gyur ro / /thal bas khrus byas na byad dang / g.yengs 9byed dang / sngags dang / dug thams cad rnam par zhig par 'gyur ro/ /sha bkra dang / mdze dang / 'bras dang / shu phran mched 1 pa dang / 'brum bu dang / lhog pa 11dang / me dbal dang / 'brum phran rnams byung na chu dron po dang sbyar te bskus 12la mar la lan bdun bzlas brjod byas pas bskus 1 na mod la nad thams cad las yongs su thar bar 'gyur ro/ /sprin logs su gtor 1 na sad dang / saser ba thams cad mi 'bab bo/ /rlung ldang ba'i 7logs su gtor na rlung bsdams par 'gyur ro/ /phyogs bzhir gtor na mtshams 1 chen po bcad par 'gyur ro/ /yul 'khor kun tu gtor 1 na me tog dang / 'bras bu dang 19/ lo tog dang /me tog gi ljon shing dang / shing gi yal ga dang / ldum ra dang / kun dga' ra ba dang / ri dang / rtswa dang / shing gel pa dang / sman dang / 192—385

nags tshal thams cad legs par bsrungs par ga1)'gyur ro/ /yul 'khor la dpag tshad brgya tshun cad nakun tu mtshams chen po gcad 57pa byas par 'gyur ro / /grong khyer gyi sgo bzhir gtor na der 'jug pa dang / phyir 'byung ba'i sems can bud med dang / skyes pa dang / khye'u dang / bu mo dang / dge sbyong dang / bram ze dang / rgyal rigs dang / rje'u (gerigs dang / dmangs 5)rigs dang / byol song gi skye gnas su gtogs 57pa rkang gnyis pa dang / rkang bzhi pa dang / ri dgas dang / bya de dag thams cad sgrib pa dang / sdig pa dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /dgongs pa tsam gyis nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad las grol bar 'gyur ro/ /nad thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /tshe yongs su brjes 7nas bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams su 'gro zhing /sangs rgyas nyid du gnas kyi bar du phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ba'i gnas thob par 'gyur ro/ /dur khrod dam / ro bsregs tsho)pa'i steng du thal bas gtor na/dmyal bar skyes —1 pa'i sems can de dag thams cad mod la dmyal ba nas thar te / mngon par dga' ba'am/ bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /grong khyer ram / gtsug 11lag khang ngam/ lha'i gnas sam/ grong ngam/ khyim mam/dgon pa'i gnas sam/ yul 'khor kun tu gtor na mtshams 12chen po bcad cing zhi ba chen por 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po'i pho brang gi sgor gtor na rgyal po dang btsun mo'i 'khor dgra thams cad las legs par bsrungs /2par 'gyur ro/ /skye bo mang po'i nang du gtor na 1 skye bo mang po de dag thams cad sgrib pa dang / sdig pa thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /tshand thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang bye ba stong phrag brgya sabyed pas rang 'dod pa la rang 92—386

gi hu)blos thams cad du sbyar bar bya'o/ /de nas rnam par grol ba'i dkyil 'khor don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sku gzugs ras la bri ba (2bshad par bya'o/ /dar ram ras gtsang ma ri legs par btags pa tshad khru do'am/ khru gsum mam(4)/ khru bzhi pa de'i dbus su don yod pa'i zhags pa/ 'jig rten dbang phyug /tshangs pa'i cha byad 'chang ba/dbu lcang chi55lo cod pan gyis brgyan 96pa/ cod pan rgyal ba 'od dpag med dang g.yas su zla ba tshes pa can gyis brgyan 57pa/ phyag bzhi pa/ rgyan 85thams cad kyis bārgyan pa/ skyil 59nomo krung 1rtabacas te bzhugs pa bri 11ba ni ri bo po ṭa 12la lcug (lhem me tog can sna tshogs kyis gang ba/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi lcug mas gang ba bya'o/ /de'i steng du rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ seng ge'i skakhri bya'o / /seng ge'i khri'i steng du pad+ma'i gdan bya'o/ /de'i steng du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bzhugs par bya ste/ pad+ma dang / mdung rtse gsum pa dang / zhags pa thogs shing gzugs de phyag dbugs 35'byin pa tshabya'o / /dbu'i gong man chad gzhal 1 med khang chen po lha rdzas rin po che sna tshogs kyis spras pa/ dbus su mtho ba dang bcas pa bya'o/ /dbus mtho ba'i steng du de bzhin gshegs pa bdun tshad dang mthun 18par pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs shing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan 19pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de'i gong gi dbus su de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad dang / 'od dpag med dang / spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 'od dang / de bzhin gshegs pa gsum rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ skyil mo krung 2 bcas te gzhal med khang gi nang na bzhugs par bya'o/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 92—387

gi 'od 'dom tshogang la na 'khor bar de bzhin gshegs pa sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis brgyan par bya/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i cinye 'khor kun tu 'od zer ge'abar ba sna tshogs 5dang / mdung rtse gsum pa'i phreng ba bya'o/ /de nyid kyi nye 'khor du lha sum cu rtsa gnyis bya'o/ /gong gi dbus su rdo rje 'chang ba khro gnyer can rdo rje gsor bar bya'o/ /de nas tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / lha'i dbang phyug chen po dang / sum cu rtsa gsum gyi 'dabang po dang / 'og min gnas kyi tsho7)lha'i bu dang rinas/ dga' ldan gyi lha'i bu dang / 'phrul dga'i lha'i bu dang / zla ba dang / nyi ma'i 9)lha'i bu dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / gshin rje dang / chu lha dang / lus ngan po dang / gzhon nu dang / me lha dang / nag po chen po dang / dga' ba'i dbang phyug dang / dga' bo dang / nye dga' bo dang / stobs lha dang /gang ba bzang 1 po dang / nor bu bzang po dang / gnas gtsang 11ma'i rigs kyi lha dang / sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha'i bu 15rnams me tog sna tshogs dang / nor bu rin po che sna tshogs lag pa nas 'phrul pa dang / mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs par bya// //'phags pa don yod 1 zhags pa'i cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po/ bam po bcu bzhi pa/ lha rnams kyi phyi rol thog thag tu pad+ma'i phreng ba rdo rje dang / mdung sartse gsum pas spras pa'i pad+ma'i phreng bas kun tu 'khor bar bya/ g.yas 12phyogs su 'phags ma sgrol ma skyil tshemo krung 1 phyed du bcas te bzhugs pa/ ut+pa la dang / nor bu rin po che phyag na thogs pa/ rgyan 18thams cad kyis brgyan pa/'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi zhal du blta 19bar bya'o/ /de'i rgyab 92wa 388

tu khro gnyer ma me tog sna tshogs 'chang ba/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan 1pa bya'o / /g.yon du dkar mo zhes bya ba ni skyil (2mo krung phyed du bcas te bzhugs pa/ ku mu da dang / nor bu rin po che lag na thogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan 45pa/ 'phags pa 45spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la blta 6bar bya'o/ /dkar mo de'i rgyab tu pad+ma mdzes 7dga' ma me tog sna tshogs thogs pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa 8bya'o/ /lha mo sgrol ma dang /dkar mo'i 'og tu pha rol tu phyin pa bcu'i lha mo thams cad kyang dbu 9yid tsam 1 'dud pa/ na bza' 11dkar po 1 gsol ba/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa bzhengs pa 1snyebya'o/ /g.yas phyogs su srin mo ral pa gcig ma gtum 1 mo skyil mo krung maphyed du bcas te bzhugs pa/ phyag bzhi la zhags pa dang / dgra sta dang / ral gri dang / rdo rje lag na thogs pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la blta tsho7bar bya'o/ /g.yon du pho nya mo zhal mche ba gtsigs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa 1 phyag bzhi la rdo rje 18dang / dgra sta dang / zhags pa tsho)dang / mdung rtse 2 gsum pa 2 phyag na thogs pa/ skyil mo krung phyed du 22bcas te bzhugs pa/ 'bar ba'i nang na 'jig rten dbang phyug la blta 2 bar bya'o / /ri bo po ṭa 2 la'i ngos kyi gseb tu klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang / nye 25dga' bo dang / klu'i bu mo klu'i gnas dang bcas pa bya ste/ me tog sna tshogs thogs shing / gong du bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug la 'thor 20bar bya'o/ /ri'i smad du lha mo dpe med ma dang / lha mo ba sa na ti dang /sa'i lha mo dang / dpal lha mo dang / lha mo 'jigs byed ma dang / sgra dbyangs ma dang / lcags sgrog 28ma dang / dung can ma ste/ rgyan thams cad 92—389

kyis brgyan pa/ me tog sna tshogs dang / nor bu rin po che thogs pa bya'o/ /gzhal med khang gi gong du mchod rten chen po brgyad phreng bar sbrengs la mchod rten gyi rgyan ji lta bar (1ribargyan par bya'o/ /mchod rten gyi 'og g.yas rol du bcom ldan 'das byang chub kyi snying por gshegs pa la 'jig rten dbang phyug mngon du mchod pa mdzad pa bya'o/ /'phags pa rdo rje 'chang ba phyag na rnga yab thogs pa bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu drang srong dang / lha'i bu me tog sna tshogs kyis bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa bya'o/ /g.yon phyogs su bcom ldan 'das chos kyi 'khor lo bskor 2ba bya ste/ kun dga' bo dang / rdo rje 'chang ba lag na rnga yab kyis bcom ldan 'das la mngon du g.yob par bya'o/ /g.yas phyogs su 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug don yod pa'i zhags pa bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byed pa bya'o/ /g.yon phyogs su khro bo'i rgyal po bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byed pa bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu drang srong dang / lha'i tshogs bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byed pa bya'o/ / ras kyi bsku gzugs kyi g.yon dang g.yas kyi phyi rol thog thag 4tu de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs brgya (gertsa brgyad pad+mo'i gdan la tshad ji 6ribazhin du skyil rdo mo krung 8bcas te bzhugs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan 9par bya'o/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi seng ge'i gdan gyi zhabs drung du rig sngags 'chang ba pus mo btsugs 9/ byete / me tog dang / pog por dang / bgrang phreng lag na thogs te 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la mngon du blta tsho17bar bya'o/ /ri mo mkhan khrus byas shing gos gtsang ma bgos te/ gtsang bar byas la ro sna tshogs pa'i zas dkar 12gsum bza' bar 1 bya'o/ /snod sar thupa yigatsang ma'i nang nas 92—390

tshon lhag ma ma yin pas bri bar bya'o/ /'di'ang 91 kha zas mi gtsang ba sna tshogs dang / gos ngan pa mi gtsang ba yongs su spang bar bya'o/ /tshig ngan pa dang /sems ngan pa yongs su spang bar bya'o/ /chang dang / sha dang / beg btsong nadang / sgog skya dang / ke'u dang 'dres pa yongs su spang ri bar bya'o/ /nyi ma re re zhing ba'i rnam lnga la reg par 4bya'o/ /dri ma dang bral zhing ser sna dang /phrag dog dang bral bar 5)bya'o/ /byams pa dang / snying rje'i lhag pa'i bsam pa dang / dkon mchog gsum la dang ba lhag par bya ste ras kyi sku gzugs bri 6bar bya'o/ /ga pur dang / gla rtsis bsgos pa'i tshon sna tshogs kyis bri 7ribar bya'o / /dben zhing 'du 'dzi 8yongs su spang bar bya'o/ /rmugs pa dang /gnyid yongs su spang bar bya'o/ /de ltar ri mo bri ba ni las legs par byas pa yin no/ /zla ba yar gyi ngo la bri bar bya'o/ /rgyu skar shin tu bkra shis pa dang /tshes grangs dang nyi ma shin tu bkra shis pa la brtsam 9)par bya'o/ /rgyu 1 skar rgyal ni bkra shis pa yin te de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bsngags 11pa/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis 12byin gyis brlabs 12pa/ lha thams cad kyis rjes su bzung beb yin no/ /rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mo dang / dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen skadang / dge bsnyen tsham dang /dge sbyong dang / bram ze dang / rgyal rigs dang / rje'u rigs dang /dmangs rigs dang / bud med dang / skyes pa dang / khye'u dang / bu mo gang la la zhig don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis phyag byas pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rnam par 17gzigs pa/byang chub chen po'i dkyil 'khor gsang ba/ rnam par grol ba'i dkyil 'khor 92—391

gsang ba/ ras kyi sku gzugs chen po mthong ba ni 91)sku gzugs mthong ba tsam gyi mod la sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad las rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro/ /mtshams med pa lnga byed pa dang / mtshams na)med pa la gzhol ba dang / dam pa'i chos yongs su spong ba dang / 'phags pa la skur pa 'debs pa dang /sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad spong bar byed pa rnams kyang mthong ba tsam la sogs pas sdig pa thams cad phye mar rlog dgo/ /rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro/ /sdom pa chen po yang dag par 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /gang gā'i gi klung gi bye ma bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu snyed 5kyi de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub 6snying po la mngon du gshegs pa dang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor 7)ba mthong ba dang 'dra bar rig par bya'o/ /ras kyi sku gzugs 'di mthong ba ni gzhal med khang dang bcas pa'i ri bo po ṭa 8la na 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas te mngon du bzhugs pa mngon du mthong ba dang 9'dra ste/ 'di la the tshom 1 mi bya'o/ /yid gnyis bskyed 17par mi bya'o/ /sems kyis 1 skad cig gcig rab tu dang ba byas na/ bsod nams kyi phung po chen po yongs su gzung 1 bar 'gyur ro/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba chen po sogs pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis dgongs te mchog sbyin par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis yongs su gzung chibar 'gyur ro/ /lus dang sems yid las byung ba'i 7yongs su dag par 'gyur ro/ /dbang po thams cad yongs su dag par 'gyur ro/ /dri ma dang bral zhing ser sna dang / phrag dog dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten 92—392

pa (1)thams cad dga' ba dang / bla mar tshonalta bar 'gyur ro/ /tshe ring por 'gyur ro/ /nad thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /shi nas bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams su skal ba mnyam par skye bar 'gyur ro/ /tshe rabs dran par 'gyur ro/ /pad+ma'i nang nas rdzus da te skye bar 'gyur ro/ /mthong ba tsam gyi (4)mod la phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag tu med pa'i sku gzugs 'di gang gis mchod pa de ni phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mchod par 'gyur ro/ /'di ni mngal na gnas pa'i tha ma yin te/ phyis ma rig pa'i mun pa'i nang du ltung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de ltar na mi mnyam pa dang 'dra ba yin te/ ras kyi sku gzugs kyi cho ga 'jig rten las 'das pa sgrub pa'i cho ga 'di ni dam pa yin no/ /de nas gsang sngags kyi cho ga 'jig rten las 'das pa sgrub pa brjod par bya'o/ /gang gis dran pa tsam gyi mod la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mngon sum du mthong nas 'dug pa dang /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad sgo phye ste 'dug pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis 5mngon du mthong ba sbyin par mdzad pa dang /dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad mngon du bsrung dzib dang / skyob pa dang / sbed par mdzad pa dang / dkyil 'khor dang / phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags dang /snying po dang / cho ga zhib mo thams cad mngon du 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten las 'das pa'i lus 7su 'gro ba yongs su dag par 'gyur ro/ /dus gsum du gshegs shing so so na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' nachen po'i 'phags pa'i tshogs mchog thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa rdo rje 'chang ba dang / dkyil 'khor gyi lha 9thams cad 92—393
