dang / rig pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ a mo gha a ba lo ki te ma hā maṇ+ḍa gi1la pad+ma sarba bo (gedhi satwa (5)na ma skṛ (3)te/ bha ra bha ra/ sa man+ta a ba lo ki te / a mo gha ma hā brah+ma / be ṣa gtsidha ra/ dha ra dha ra/ ma hā kā ru ṇi ka (7bo dha ya/ bo dha ya/ ma hā 2bo dha ni/ bo (9)dhi bo dhi/ pad+ma bi bo dha 7ni/sarba pā pa an dha kā 11ra/ pra sha ma ni/ sarba durga yo ti/ bha yonyer ka /ma hā kā boru ṇi dka /ba hu bi bi dha/ be ṣa ladha ra/ sarba ta thā ga ta gar+bhe/ hu ru hu ru/a mo gha 1 gar+bhe/ tu ru tu 18ru/ a mo gha pā 17sha haste/ mu ru mu ru/ bi mo k+ṣa bhu dze/ k+ṣi ṇi k+ṣi ṇi/ sarba ā ba ra ṇa bi shud dhe/ bha ra bha ra/ sarba ta thā ga ta / pa ri pū ra ṇi 1/ ta ra ta ra/ tā ra ya du )mān/ a ba lo kā zhugeya/pad+ma bhu dze/ ma ṇi ka na ka /bi bhu ṣi ta/ bā hu(ste/ da ma da ma/ dur dran tā nān/ ma hā bo dhi satwa ba ra da/ ma hā kā ru ṇi ka /sarba de ba ga ṇa na ma skṛ 55ta/ ṛ ṣi 2dzig ṇa / sta bi ta/ sha ta sa (2ha sra tsan+t+ra srur+ya/ a hi re kuna'o /rasmi / a 1ba bhā si ta 2/ ma hā pa shu pa ti/ be ṣa sa:dha ra/ pa ra ma / shud dha satwa/ a ba lo ki te / lo ke ri shwa ra/ ma he shwa ra na/ pa ra ma / kā ru ṇi ka /maṇ+ḍa ri le shwa ra/ su pra bud dha/ ma hā pad+ma/ bhu dze shwa nusnyer/ma hā bibyā (dha re shwa ra / dhi ri ji dhi ri/ ma hā kā ru ṇi ka /ma hā ce bi mo k+ṣa/maṇ+ḍa la dha ra/ sarba ta thā ga ta tshog h+ya/ mu drwa (snyes ma ya rte4dha ra/ ma hā ba la bit+yā dha ra/ ma hā ma ṇi/ mo li dha ra/ a mi tā bha/ mu 59ku ṭa dha ra/ dhu ru dhu ru/ sa man+ta/ a ba lo ki ta/ lo ke shwa ra/ ma he shwa ra/ pā thu )sha dha re 4stoshwa ra/ pa ra pa ra/ pa ra ma/ ma hā mi rigatri/ a ba lo ki te5rte/ sarba satwa/san+ta rā 54ga /sid dhi/ sid+dhā shā55/ pa ri pū ra ka /ma hā ba ra/ pra mo dathug/92wa 394

na mo stu te swā hunyehā/ 'di ni thams cad rnam par grol ba'i dkyil 'khor byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis phyag byas (2)pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi snying po'i mchog /gsang ba (55sdig pa dang / sgrib pa thams cad yongs su sbyong ba/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam rnam par sbyong ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs ④'jug pa yin no/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum du gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 5la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ bī ra bī ra/ ma hā maṇ+ḍa ci la/ bi shwa rū 7pa ṣa ṭa pā ra mi tā/ pa ri pū ra ka /sarba bo ri dhi satwa/ na ma skṛ 59ta/ pa ra ma bi pu la7/ bi mo k+ṣa /kādha ra/ ma hā pā sha /bi lo ki ta12/ a mo gha pā sha dz+wa 15li ta 8ma hā dz+wa la a ba 7lo ki tās/ ma hā ma ṇi biṣ+ṭa 1 dha ra/ sa man+ta a ba bhā si ta/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ ma hā gam dhī 18ra/ bi mo k+ṣa pā 19sha dha ra/ ba la bo rgyang ga /ā /sgo ka /oṃ brah+ma rū pa/ ma hā a mo gha pā sha hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa/sarba satwa/ bi lo ki ta/ pa ra pra da/ na mo stu te swā hā/ 'di ni rnam par grol ba'i dkyil 'khor don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa'o/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ bi bud 21rgya/ bi bud dha na/ ma hā kā ru ṇi ka / ta ra ta ra tā ra ya ri/ ma hā arna 2 ba pa ra na pa/ ma hā bhu dza bi lo kā 35ya hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa 92wa 395

spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ a mo gha pā (1)sha /ma hā dā na pā ra mi tān/ pa ri pū ra ya55)/ hūṃ da ra da ra/ bi bi dha0)/bi tsi trepa/ sarba satwa u 6pa bho ga /sarba ta thā ga ta/ ma hā dā na/ pū dzā (7tshome gha / pra brta 9ya/ ta ra ta ra/ tā lha )ra ya/ ma hā pad+ma pā ṇi hūṃ phaṭa swā hā / 'di ni sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i zhags pa nyurtachen po'i snying po ste/gang gis yungs 'bru 12tsam yang sbyin pa byin 1 te dran pa tsam gyis lan bdun bzlas brjod byas na mchod sbyin sbyin pa rnam par 'phrul pa chen po shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs sadabang phyug thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo / /oṃ a mo gha shī la/ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra/ bha ra bha ra/ ma hā shud dha satwa'i/pad+ma bi bhū 17'i ta bhu dza dha ra dha ra/ sa man+ta/ a ba lo ki tekyi / hūm̐ phaṭa 1shes hā/gzungs 'di smyung 19ba byas te/ gso sbyong gi yan lag brgyad bzung so tshonas mi smra bar na lan nyi shu rtsa gcig dran par bya'o/ /de nas don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po bzlas brjod bya'o/ /bzlas brjod byas pa tsam gyi mod la tshul khrims yongs su dag pa chen po dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /tshul khrims kyi 22pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /tshul khrims kyi dri zhim po'i dri snyemang po lus las 'byung zhing phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten du grags par 'gyur ro/ /gang zhig nyi ma re re zhing gzungs 'di dran na 2 de ni rtag tu tshul khrims yongs su dag par 'gyur ro/ /dge slong 25gang la la 27zhig tshul khrims zhig cing 2 nyams par smyung na ba byas te/ 'di bzlas 9brjod byas pa tsam gyi mod la tshul khrims yongs 92wa 396

su dag par 'gyur ro/ /tshul khrims mang po dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po (1)'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ ma hā bīr+ya/ a mo gha bi lo ki te/ ba ra ba ra/ dri ho/bīr+ya(5ri / ma hā ba la/ ba la ba la/ ma hā bo dh+yaṅga (da/ ba la bo 4dha ni/ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ gzungs 'di dus rtag tu yongs su dag pa'i yid kyis dran par byas na dran pa tsam gyi mod la brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub kyi snying po la thug gi bar du nam yang brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang bral bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs 55)dbang phyug thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ a mo gha glan ti(6) / sarba bo dhi satwa ri nik+ṣa mi ṇa/ k+ṣa ṇa na k+ṣa 99/ ma hā mi tri/ kā 7ru ṇa/sarba satānyurta/ ba ta 512sa la/ ma hā kā ru ṇi ka /sarba satwa k+ṣa mi ṇa/ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ gzungs 'di sems can du gyur pa thams cad la bzod pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang /12 brtse khaba'i sems kyis dmyal ba na gnas pa dang /byol song gi skye gnas su gtogs pa ri dgas dang / bya gang dag 'das pa gang yin pa dang / gnas pa tshagang yin pa dang / skye ba gang yin pa de rnams la snying rje ba'i phyir gang zhig gzungs kyi mchog dran par byed na/ dmyal ba'i sems can las thar bar 'gyur zhing skye bo mang po gnas pa gang yin pa rnams grol bar 'gyur ro/ /nam sangs rgyas kyi zhing la gnas kyi bar du bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams 92—397

cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' 6)chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs (nadabang phyug thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ ma hā a mo gha/ kā ru ṇa/ dh+yā (gun sa mā ④snyi/ sarba bi mo k+ṣa/a pra ka ma pya (5ka /tsu ru tsu ru hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ gzungs 'di 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la dmigs nas yid (7rtse gcig tu byas te dran par byas na57ri / dran pa tsam gyi ri rimod la des gshenabasam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang ting nge 'dzin stong phrag brgya 7so sor thob par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du bzhugs (glepar 'gyur ro / /bzlas brjod byas pa tsam gyis ting nge 'dzin thams cad la dbang sgyur bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po la phyag 'a65la lo/ /o a mo gha/ ma hā pradz+nyā/ a ba bhā sa/s+pha spyi ra ṇa/ bud 41 / pra sa ra pra sa ra/ sa man+ta bud dhi/ a ba lo ki taski /bha ga bān dzapradz+nyā/ a ba lo ki ta/ tsak+ṣu ṣe tsom hā pradz+nyā/ / ba ra nānye'u/ pā ḍi19 / ma hā pradz+nyā/ pad+ma 2 dha ri ṇa/ bhu ( rmidze hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ gzungs 'di dran pa tsam gyi mod la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro / /thabs dang shes rab sna tshogs kyi zhu dge ba ge chen po'i blo 'phel bar 'gyur ro / /rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad na par pha rol tu phyin pa bcu'i blo dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ri snyedang / 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i shes rab dang blor 'gyur ro/ /lan 'ga' yang pha rol tu phyin pa ri drug dang bral 92wa 398

bar mi 'gyur ro/ /sbyin pa dang / tshul khrims dang / bzod pa dang /brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan dang / shes rab kyi blo nyams par mi 'gyur ro / /byang chub la thug gi bar du (1skurab tu rmongs par mi 'gyur ro/ /don yod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi gzungs chen po yin no/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje tsho chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ o ( ni.a mo gha bi mo (yak+ṣa/ maṇ+ḍal ma hā (5 da bhū 6)ta bi ma le/ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi rirdzi / ma hā da bhū 58)ta/ a mi tā 59)rta/ ma ku ṭa/ dha ra hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/dkyil 'khor der yungs kur bodang / dri chab dang 37ldan pa'i bum pa la sngags bzlas tshubarjod byas nas/ chus kun tu chag chag btab 1snyen chag chag btab 7pa tsam gyi mod la dkyil 'khor kun tu dpag tshad gcig gi nang du mas sbyangs te yongs su dag par 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar shel gong dang / rin po che sna tshogs pa sadag pa dri ma med pa mdzes pa de 'dra ba'i sa gzhir 1 7'gyur ro/ /shin tu dag pa dang / shin tu dri ma med pa dang /12 shin tu nyams dga' ba dang / shin tu yid du 'ong ba'i sa gzhir 19'gyur ro/ /shin tu sa gzhi spa tshobar 'gyur ro/ /sa phyogs de'i bud med dang / skyes pa dang / khye'u dang / bu mo dang /dge sbyong dang / bram ze dang / rgyal rigs dang / rje'u rigs dang /dmangs rigs gang dag 'khod pa de dag thams cad phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la rab tu gnas par 'gyur ro/ /de dag thams cad phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro/ /shi nas bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /tshe rabs dran par 'gyur ro/ /nam bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon 92wa 399

par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'i (1bar du bsod nams kyi phung po chen (shepo'i dge ba'i rtsa ba chen po sogs na par 'gyur ro/ /gang dag byol song gi skye gnas su gtogs pa'i ri dgas ri nodang / bya de dag phyogs der 'gro zhing rab tu 'jug pa de dag thams cad yongs su grol bar 'gyur ro/ /bde 'gro'i lam la rab tu gnas par 'gyur ro/ /gang gis de'i sa lag par 'ongs te reg pa de dag thams cad nad dang bral ba dang / nyon mongs pa dang bral ba dang /rims dang bral ba dang / sgrib pa med pa dang / sdig pa dang bral bar 'gyur ro / /de dag phyis lus la tshor ba'i nad 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu bde bas tshim pa'i lus su 'gyur ro/ /sa yongs su sbyong ba'i rig sngags so/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo / /tabya thā/ oṃ a mo gha dru ma/ la ta py-i k+ṣa sku/ sha (65kha pa tra put+pa ༷7)pha la/ ba ṭi pa ā ro ha na hi na ḍā ga /push+ka ri ṇa(9)/ uta tsos ṣ+ṭṛ /stod/ sun da ra pra sra 12ba ṇi da/ bi bi dha/ bi tsi 1 ritra/ pa ri sho 9gedha ya/ pad+ma bhu dze/ sa ma sa ma / sa madhe na/ pa ri maṇ+ḍal/ pa ri sho dha ya/ ma la ma la bi ma la bi ma la / nirma la lasu pa ri 1 shud dha/ pad+ma ut+pa /geli bha dza la ma lā na 36bi shud dha / sho dha ya sho dha ya/ pa ra ma ma hā shud dhā ya satā 27lhu phaṭa/ na mo tri bhu ba ne hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ 'dis tsan+dan dang / zopad+ma dang / chu dang yungs kur la yongs su bzlas te/ ljon pa'i sdong po dang / me tog gi shing dang / 'bras bu'i shing dang / sna tshogs pa'i lcug ma dang / rtswa dang / shing gel ba dang / sman dang / chu klung dang / mtsho bran dang 2na/ lteng ka dang /92wa 400

rdzing bu dang / 'bab chu mdzes pa'i steng du gtor bar bya ste/ de rnams thams cad la bdud rtsi blug par 'gyur ro/ /de rnams thams cad la lha rdzas kyi me tog dang 'bras bur 'gyur ro/ /tha na lha'i rtswa 17dang / shing gel ba dang /sman dang nags kyi bdag por 'gyur ro/ /gang la reg pa tsam gyis reg pa de thams cad ser sna'i dri ma dang bral zhing / phrag dog spangs par 'gyur ro/ /mkhris pa dang / bad yin dang / mchil ma dang bral zhing / lus kyi phyi dang nang gi dri mi zhim pa thams cad yongs su dag par 'gyur ro/ /gang yang lus kyi nang gi nad dang / gnod pa sna tshogs pa de thams cad yongs su grol bar 'gyur zhing / rnam par dag pa dang / rnam par nyams pa dang / legs par yongs su dag pa dang / dri ma med par 'gyur ro zhes so/ /de la chus khrus byas pa gang yin pa de rnams kyang lha'i chu dang / byang chub kyi 2yan lag gi chus khrus byas par 'gyur ro/ /sdig pa dang sgrib pa'i dri ma thams cad bkrus par 'gyur ro/ / yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chus bkrus par 'gyur ro/ / tshodes so shing zos pa gang yin pa de rnams kyang sangs rgyas kyi ye shes rjes su dran pa chen po 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /mya ngan thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur zhing zhags pa thams cad yongs su spangs pa cadang / rtag tu kha nas ut+pa la'i dri bro 5bar 'gyur ro/ /ngag 'jam zhing snyan par yang 'gyur zhing ngag mnyen par yang 'gyur ro/ /dga' ba'i gtam byed par 'gyur zhing / skye bo thams cad yid dga' bar yang 'gyur ro/ /mi'am ci'i dbyangs su yang 'gyur ro/ /bstan bcos dang / cho ga zhib mo dang / gsang sngags dang / theg pa chen po thams cad thos pa tsam gyis kun du 'dzin par byed cing kha ton du yang gnas 92—401

par byed do/ /me tog de la mnams pa dang / phreng ba mgul par 'ching bar byed pa gang yin pa de rnams kyang byang chub yan lag gi me tog gi phreng ba bcings par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbang gis mngon par dbang bskur bar yang 'gyur ro/ /sna tshogs su dag par yang 'gyur te/ lha'i dri dang / reg pa dang / yang dag par ldan par 'gyur ro/ /lce pad+ma'i 'dab 07ma dang mtshungs par yongs su dag par 'gyur ro/ /lha'i so dang mtshungs pa'i kha dog tu 'gyur/ bud med dang / skyes pa dang / khye'u dang / bu mo gang la gtam smras pa de rtag tu dbang du 'gyur ro/ /shi 'phos shing skye ba (2brjes nas bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams su skye bar 'gyur te/ pad+ma las rdzus ༷ te skye bar 'gyur ro/ /tshe rabs pa dran par yang 'gyur ro zhes pa'o/ /'bras bu dang / me tog dang / chu dang / nags kyi bdag po dang / rtswa snyedang /shing gel pa dang / sman yongs su sbyong ba'i sngags so/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ oṃ a mo gha a ma le tri ma le/ bi 6ma le7ri/ nirma ri le/ di bya pa ri shudhe sasba ma lo pa kuk+ṣi te/ ma hā bo dhi satwa ba ra de pra ba ra pa ri shudhe/ ma hā ma ṇi rat+ta 5)kā ya pa ri shudhe ma ṇi ma ṇi sho dha ni ma hā a mo gha tsin+ta ma ṇi shudhe/ skṛ 7da ya shudhe/kā ya nirma la ma hā ma ṇi pa ri shurnye/ hu ru hu ru pra 47ba ra pā ṇi nyusnyem hā bhu sna dza ba ra de/ tu ru tu ru/ ma hā satwa ba ta sa le pa ri sho dha khaya māṃ sarba pā 8su bi shud+dha ma le swā hā/ rig sngags 'dis rig sngags 'chang gi bdag nyid kyi lus yongs su sbyang bar bya ste/ tsan+dan gyi chu tshadang / gur gum dang / gla rtsi'i chu 92—402

dang / ga pur gyi chu dang / yungs kur 1)dang ba byung lnga bsres pas/ rdza gsar pa'i bum pa bkang ste (57rig sngags 'di stong rtsa brgyad 95)bzlas ( par bya'o/ /ras dkar pos bkru bar bya zhing lan tsher) bdun du ri stabatung bar bya'o/ /khrus byas pa tsam gyi mod la khro bo'i rgyal pos bdag nyid dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /khrus byas pa tsam dang / dbang bskur 7rib tsam gyis bdag rang gi phyi nang yongs su dag cing dri ma med par 'gyur ro/ /sdig pa dang / sgrib pa dang /dug dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /nyon mongs pa dang nad na dang bral bar 'gyur ro / /rga ba la sogs pa dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /bgegs dang / log 'dren dang / bdud la sogs pa thams cad las yongs su thar bar 'gyur ro/ /gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / 'byung po dang / sha za la sogs pa thams cad yongs su spangs par 'gyur zhing bar chad bya ba'i phyir rig sngags 'chang ba'i drung du slar 'ong nus par mi 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags 'chang bde bar sgrub pa dang / bde bar nyal ba dang / bde bar sad pa dang / nam 'tsho'i bar du bde bar gnas pa dang / dri ma thams cad spang ba 9dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mthong ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mngon sum du mthong ste shi ba'i dus byed par 'gyur ro/ /bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi 7khams su skal ba mnyam par skye bar 'gyur ro/ /pad+mo'i nang nas rdzus 17te skyes nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med mngon sum du mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan 12pa dang / lus mtshan dang dpe byad /dkyis brgyan pa dang /tshe rabs dran par 'gyur ro/ /mthar byang chub la thug gi bar du sangs rgyas kyi 92—403

zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /rnam par grol ba'i dkyil 'khor don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po cho ga zhib mo 'di mtha' dag rdzogs par kha ton 1byed par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang de bzhin gshegs pas bka' stsal pa'i mdo sde gzhung sna tshogs rnam pa du ma kha ton byed par 'gyur ro/ /bskal pa stong phrag brgya 92tshun chad du skye ba dran par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ a mo gha pad+ma/ bi ma le / pra sa ra/ sa man+ta/ mu khe sa swā hā/ dkyil 'khor 4char phye ste thig gdab pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ a mo gha bi bi dhirigaci/ rū pa bi tsi tsitra/ gan dha ra san dha ra/ pra ba ra/ bhu dze swā hā/ tshon 7nirtsi'i sngags dang / sku gzugs gzhag pa dang / mtshon cha'i 84rtags bri ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ a mo gha sa man+ta 9pa ri maṇ+ḍa la/ pā sha ban+dhe lartsu/ yungs kur 31la lan bdun bzlas brjod byas pas dkyil 'khor bsdam 12par bya'o/ /oṃ a mo gha/ sa man+ta/ da sha dig 1 ma hā sī saman/ ban 1ridha ya/ dhu ru dhu ru/ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ yungs kur dang chu tshal lan bdun bzlas brjod byas pas mtshams gcad yo pa'o/ /oṃ a mo gha rak+ṣa ṇa / pā sha ha ste/ bhu ru bhu ru swā hā1ge/ yungs kur 19dang dri chab tshol lan bdun bzlas brjod byas pas bdag bsrung 21ba'o/ /o a mo gha tsū ḍa 22ma ṇi/ hū ru hū 2 ru/ nā 2 ga bā na sha ban ༷dhe hūm̐ swā hā/ lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod byas pas spyi gtsug bcing ba'i sngags so rmo/ / zo.o a mo gha rak+ṣa( she/ sa marnye na/ ma hā pā she 9/ dhu ru dhu ru swā hā/ slob ma dang grogs rnams bsrung ri1ba ste 2yungs kur nadang / thal ba la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas da brjod byas te bsrung 5bar bya'o/ /tshe 5i a mo gha/ dza rko la bi ma le/ su ru su ru swā hā/ dri chu la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod byas pas khrus bya ba'i sngags 92wa 404

so / /oṃ a mo gha a mṛ 1ta bin du tsa ra tsa ra swā smyonahā/ nye reg bya ba'i sngags so / /oṃ a mo gha di bya ba ste tshotshu ru tsu ru swā hā/ gos kyi sngags so/ /oṃ a mo gha bhu dza 194) /ka ba tsa/ ba ra de/ tsi ri tsi ri swā hā/ go cha'i sngags yin te yungs kur (5)dang gur gum 96)gyi chus bya'o/ /oṃ a mo gha brah+ma bhu dze pār+ya 7na te na pra sa ra swā hā/ mchod phyir thogs kyi sngags so/ /oṃ a mo gha tsū ḍā (8ma ṇi pad+me / a bhi ṣiñtsa (95ya/ ma dzim sarba ta thā ga 11ta a bhi ṣe ka 1 ma ṇi ma ṇi swā 1 hā/dbang bskur skeba'i sngags saso/ /oṃ a mo gha pad+ma ba lasun dha ra/ dha ra dha ra/dha ra ṇi'i/ maṇ+ḍi 38rgyu/ stan gyi gsang sngags so/ /oṃ a mo gha sa man+ta pa byang ke16 / bhu bi swā hā/ skyil mo krung bca' 2 ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ a mo gha su ra dhi / pad+ma 27pa ra pa ra hūm̐/ me tog gi sngags so/ /oṃ a mo gha bi bi dha/ gan+dha/pra sa re na/ pur+ṇa 2 bhu dze swā hā/ dri'i sngags so/ /oṃ a mo gha 2 bi bi dha le pa na pra ba re pi ri pi ri swā hā/ byug pa'i sngags so/ / oṃ a mo gha ga ga na s+pha ra ṇa/ 5ma yi ‘ 9byu ru bhu ru 2 hūm̐/ bdug pa'i sngags so/ /o a mo gha shu kla nas ra sa ra sa a gra 3/dha ra bi snadha ra hūm̐/ gtor ma'i sngags te thams cad du bya'o/ /oṃ a mo gha pra ba ra/ nu pi 21lo ki ni/ ki ri ki ri hūm̐/ zas dang gtor ma'i sngags so/ /oṃ bi bi dha/ a mo gha/ pha nal/ pa ra pa ra hūm̐/ 'bras bu'i sngags so/ /oṃ a mo gha yod bhu ta rnyi lhan dha ba re gartsu/ mchod yon gyi sngags so / /oṃ a mo gha/ bi bi dha/ ma ṇi/ bhū ṣa ṇa ne/ ba re/ dz+wa la dz+wa la hūm̐/rgyan dang / thod dang / dar dpyang ba rtedang / mda' dang / tshon sna lnga dang / thig skud kyi sngags so/ /oṃ a mo gha/ bi /bi dha/ bhā 9dza ni / dza ya dza ya swā hā/ snod kyi sngags te thams cad du sbyar ro/ /oṃ a mo gha pra ba 41ra 92wa 405

bha ba na bhu be tha ra tha ra swā hā/ gzhug (1)pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ a mo gha nam ska ②ra ṇa/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ oṃ dza /ri )le hūm̐/ phyag 'tshal ba (snyadang thal mo sbyar (geba'i sngags so/ /oṃ a mo gha tsakre du ru du (6༄ru pra du ru swā hā/ bskor ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ a mo gha sa man+ta bha ba ne bha ba 7)lha ba swā hā/ spyan drang ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ a mo gha tsin+ta nam ṇi ā 59rukar+ṣa ya du ru du ru swā hā/ gsol ba gdab 1 pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ a mo gha ni rman+t+ra 11 ṇa bi mo k+ṣa maṇ+ḍa le 12mi li mi li tunyeswā hā/ snyan gsan dbab pa'i sngags so/ /o a mo gha ma hā rasmi dz+wa tshal sa ha sra tshang la dz+wa la sa samadhe swā hā17/ mar me'i sngags so/ /oṃ a mo gha pā sha ha (sheste pra sa ra gats+tsha 19su bhā ba rna 2 bi sardzi to zhunyasi sa ra sa ra sa rtsu phaṭa swā hā/ slar gshegs su gsol ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ a mo gha pā sha ban dha 6ges man+ta dgem hā sa ma ya dṛ 25nye hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ dam tshig gi sngags so/ /oṃ a mo gha sa marnye/ pra ba 0ra/ sa ra sa ra/ pra sa ra ma hā da /bhu te shwa ༷ sher/ dhi ri dhi ri hūm̐ hūm̐ zhu/phaṭa swā hā/ gsang sngags 'dis la du dang / mo da ka ra ra )dang / zan dang / rtsa ba dang / sdong bu dang / gtor ma dkar po dang / tshogs chen po'i bdag po'i 21gtor ma sbyin pa dang / me tog dang / bdug zhu pa'i sbyin pa byas na phyis bgegs byed da nus par mi 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten ra 'das pa'i (6dkyil 'khor gyi/ /phyag rgya de nas brjod /bya ste/ /gang (7gis gzung ba tsam gyis ni / /sdig pa thams cad zhi bar 'gyur bya/ /las dang nyon mongs sgrib pa dang / /dug rnams thams cad rnam par bcom/ /rnam grol dkyil 'khor rigs kyi ni/ /dam tshig phyag rgya yang dag yin/ /lag gnyis pad+ma 'drar byas la/ /sor mo rnams ni mnyam gzhag ste/ /gung mo lcags kyu 'dra bar bya/ /lag gnyis 92wa 406

mnyam par gzhag pa yi/ /phyag rgya rnam grol dam tshig 'di/ /don yod zhags par byin gyis brlabs/ /'jig rten 'das pa khyad par gyi51ri/ /lam gyi 'bras bu thob par byed/ /oṃ pad+ma bhu dze (2pad+ma bi ma le swā hā/ dam tshig rtse mo'i rtse shes pas/ /rdo rje pad+ma rtag tu bya/ /gung mo cung zad bskums nas ni/ /lag gnyis pad+mo 'dra bar bya/ /gang gis phyag rgya 5)'di mthong ba/ /'jig rten rnams kyi dbang phyug dag /mtshungs pa med par 'gyur ba yin/ /rnam grol phyag rgyas dogs (5)med par/ /sangs rgyas mtshungs med 'gyur ba yin/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun gyis ni/ /phyag byas pa yi 56phyag rgya 'di/ /rnam grol dkyil 'khor rmad du byung / /oṃ pad+me su pad+me ri bi mo k+ṣa maṇ+ḍa la/ 87pad+ma bhu dze swā hā / rdo rje bcing ba mnyam gzhag ste9/ /rdo rje pad+mo gung mo ni/ /bskums na de bzhin gshegs kun gyi/ /rnam grol gsung ba'i phyag rgya 'di/ /yang dag grol rtabar rab tu bstan11/ /phyag rgya 'di ni bstan pas ni/ /ngan par byas pa thams cad 'jig /o a mo gha badz+ra pad+ma bhu dze mi li mi li swā hā/ lag gnyis thal mo khong rnyeng las/ /mdor 12na nor bu 'dra bar bcing / /nor bu'i phyag rgya rdo rje 'dra/ /yid bzhin nor bur brjod pa yin/ /las ni don yod thams cad byed/ /don yod mchod pa'i char 'bebs shing / /don yod pha rol phyin drug rdzogs/ /don yod sangs rgyas rnams dang ni/ /byang chub sems dpa' mthong ba yin/ /don yod rnam grol dkyil 'khor gsang / /mtshams med lnga po sbyong bar mdzad1lha/ /oṃ a mo gha ma ngaṇi ma ṇi/ ma hā ma ṇi pad+ma ma ṇi saswā hā/rdo rje pad+ma'i thal mo sbyar/ /pad+ma kha bye la'adra bar rgyas/ /gung mo lcags kyu 'dra ba yi/ /phyag rgya nyurte'adi ni mchog tu bzang / /phyag rgya 'di ni mthong tsam 92wa 407

gyis / /'bras bu chen po mod du byung / /'jig rten 'das pa khyad par 'phags / /dus gsum sangs rgyas mthong ba yin/ /oṃ a mo gha/ badz+re ma hā parlemi / dza nale su dza le ma hā dza le swā hā/ snying gar 4)rdo rje pad+ma nyid/ /rdo rje bcing ba phun sum tshogs/ /mdzub 55mo lcags kyu 6'dra ba ni/ /bcing bar bya ba 7phyag rgya 'di/ /gzi brjid chen po dag dang ni/ /stobs chen pha rol gnon pa dang / /thams cad grub par byed pa'i gnas/ /thams cad grub 8par rab tu sbyin/ /'jig 9rten 'das pa grub pa che/ /sangs rgyas nyid phyir bla na med/ /sdig pa thams cad 'phrog pa grub/ /gsang sngags grub pa bla na med/ /oṃ a mo gha sid zhi1 / sarba ta thā ga tshomata sid 412/ a ba lo kā 1nyaya sid dhi / ma hā bi pu la sid dhiska/ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ rdo rje thal mo mnyam tshabazhag ste/ /gung mo gshibs 1 te bsgreng 18ba dang / /srin lag mthe bo 19so sor 'gyed / /gung mo yid tsam dgug bya ba/ /pad+ma'i dbang phyug sems dpa' che/ /'jig 2 rten dbang phyug bla ma ste/ /rtag tu rnam grol dkyil 'khor ni/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis/ /phyag rgya byas pa 'di yin no/ /phyag rgya 'di dang na don yod pa'i zhags pa'i na snying po'i na phyag rgya dang / phyag rgya de dag mthong ba ni 'jig 2 rten dbang phyug mthong ba dang 'dra ba yin no/ /phyag rgya mchog 'di mthong ba ni rnam par grol ba'i dkyil 'khor mthong ba dang 'dra ba yin te/ phyir mi ldog pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /phyag rgya 'di bcings pa tsam lhamathong ba'i 27mod la dam tshig thams cad shes par 'gyur ro/ /mthong ba dang gzung na ba tsam gyi 2 mod la 'bras bu chen po 'thob cing mod la sangs rgyas dang 28byang chub bla na med pa yin no/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang 92wa 408

chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /o a ba lo ki ta ma hā 1)shud dha satwa sa ra sa ra/ sa man+ta/ a ba bhā nyananos/ kuṇ+ḍa ri kyil/ dha la/(4 a mi tā bha/ ma 55ku ṭa dha ra5phyir/ dza (7)〈 ma ku ṭa/ na ba badz+ren+d+ra / maṇ+ḍi ta9ri/ tsa ra tsa ra/sam+bha ra/ bhu ba ne 7shā ra pad+ma bhu dze swā hā/ phyag rgya chen po bdun po de (11dag ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'i 12byang chub snying po'i lam gyi 'bras bu ston pa/ rtag tu 'jig rten dbang phyug bla mnyan/ 'jig rten mgon po'i chos kyi 'khor lo 7bskor mib yin no/ /phyag rgya bdun ni phyag rgya chen po bye ba phrag bdun gyis yongs su bskor tshab yin te1 / phyag rgya chen po bdun po de gang du bcings shing 1 phyag rgya mchog gzung 17ba ni phyag rgya chen po bye ba phrag brgya bcings par 'gyur ro//gzung )bar 'gyur ro/ /de dag thams cad mchod pa dang / bsnyen bkur 21byas par 'gyur ro/ /bstod ri par 'gyur ro/ /ming 'dzin pa byas par 'gyur rozhin / /phyag rgya bdun po de dag ni gsang sngags sgrub pa thams cad dang /kun du las thams cad la sbyar bar 2 bya'o/ /las 25thams cad byed pa'i phyag rgya dzo'ajig rten las 'das pa'i lam bla na med pa yin no/ /gang zhig phyag rgya de dag bcings pa mthong zhing khrus legs par byas te/ gtsang mas sgrub par byed pa 'di ni ngan 'gror 'gro bar mi 'gyur/ sngon gyi sgrib pas dmyal ba mthong bar 2 mi 'gyur/ phyag rgya bcings pa tsam gyi 22mod la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag bdun gyi drung du dge ba'i rtsa ba bsags 9par 'gyur ro/ /bsod nams kyi phung po chen po kun du gzung bar 'gyur 1ro/ /pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /sa bcu la rab tu gnas 92wa 409

par 'gyur ro/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i gnas rab tu thob par 'gyur ro/ /mtshams med pa lnga byed pa dang / dam pa'i chos spong ba dang / 'phags pa (1)la skur 7ba 'debs pa dang / mnar med pa la gzhol ba rnams kyis ji zhuste phyag rgya gzung ri ba tsam dang / bstan (5)pa tsam gyi (6)mod la sdig pa de dag thams cad rnam par zhig par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis yongs su gzung ri7zhibar 'gyur ro/ /lha dang / klu dang /gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / 'byung po dang / sha za la sogs pa (8 rarnams las legs par bsrungs par 9'gyur ro/ /dbang phyug dang dbang phyug chen po dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / gshin rje dang / chu lha dang / lus ngan dang /(1 gzhon nu rnams rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad 37par bsrung hurteb dang / bskyab pa dang /1 sba ba'i phyir rgyun du rjes su 'brang ba 7byed par 'gyur ro/ /sems can thams cad dga' ba mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /mchod rten du gyur pa ⑫yin par 'dod pa dang / lus ring bsrel 'gyi snying po yin par 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje ltar mkhregs sna pa'i lus su 'gyur ro/ /dug gis mi tshugs/ mes ma yin/mtshon gyis ma yin/ chus ma yin/ dbyig dug gi 62'jigs pas ma yin/seng shes ma yin/ gcan gzan 19rigatum pos ma yin/ dug mi bzad so )pas ma yin / rkun po dang / mi rgod kyis ma yin/ khyim rdib pas ma yin/ gnod sbyin dang / srin po'i gdon yang 'ong bar mi 'gyur ro spe/ /nad thams cad 'jug par mi 'gyur/ lus la dug sbyar ma dang / byad dang sbod gtong zhu gi 'jigs gepa 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu sdig pa can gyi rmi lam mthong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu de bzhin gshegs pa lta ba mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /92wa 410

byang chub sems dpa' lta ba mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mthong ste/ rtag tu mchog sbyin pa mdzad par 'gyur rol/ /lha thams cad kyang rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par 'dis mthong bar dgyes par 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu yon tan dang bsod nams 'bar ro/ /dpal gyis 1lus la ④shin tu 'bar ba'i lus su 'gyur ro/ /thams cad du 'di mchod par 'os pa chen por 'gyur te/ rgyal po dang / blon po dang / bram ze dang / khyim bdag dang / btsun mo'i 'khor gyis mchod par 'os pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /lha'i gnas sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi bar du yang dgyes par 'gyur te/ mchod par byed do/ /lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin lha'i bdag po dang / tshangs pa dang ske/ khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / gshin rje dang / chu lha dang / lus ngan po dang / gzhon nu dang / drang srong gi tshogs rnams kyis mchod par 'os pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /sems can thams cad kyang rtag tu de mthong bar 'dod par 'gyur ro/ //rtag tu dgyes par ston pa tsho bzhed par 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags 'chang bas khrus byas gos gtsang ma bgos te gtsang 5mar byas la dri sna tshogs kyis 6lus bsku ba 7dang / bdug pa sna tshogs kyis bdug pa byas la/ tsan+dan dkar po dang / gur gum nagyis lag pa gnyis bskus (9)te/ ga pur dang / gla 7rtsis bsgos 11pa'i sa phyogs gtsang mar ras kyi sku gzugs kyi spyan snga'am/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs kyi spyan snga'am/'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sku 12gzugs kyi spyan sngar skyil mo krung kyi bcas te 'dug nas phyag rgya 'di bcing bar sabya'o/ /mchod rten ring bsrel macan gyi drung du phyag rgya bcing bar bya'o/ /sangs rgyas la mchod pa'i 92—411

tshogs yon chab 1skul sogs pa dbul bar bya'o/ /byams pa dang snying rje'i sems su bya'o/ /sems can thams cad la lhag par brtse ba dang (ge/ snying rje'i sems bsgom par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad la bu gcig pa dang 'dra bar shes par bya'o/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug yid la dran par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas yid la byed pa dran pa bsgom par bya ste/ phyag rgya chen po bdun po de (gedag bcing ba byas na phyag rgya bye ba phrag bdun bcings par (4)'gyur ro/ /de nas mthu brjod par bya'o/ /mthu ni 'jig rten las 'das pa yang dag par mthong ba dang / don yod pa'i zhags pa'i cho 'phrul dang / rang bzhin gyi sku mngon du mthong ba yin no/ /rgyal po'am5)/ btsun mo'i nang du'am/ skye bo mang po'i nang 'du tshogs pa dang / dge slong gi tshogs kyi dge 'dun gyi nang du'am / 'khor du bcad pa'i nang du'am/ rig byed bzhi tshoge tshogs pa dang /dge sbyong dang / bram ze dang / rgyal rigs dang / bud med dang / skyes pa dang / khye'u dang / bu mo dang / rje'u rigs dang / dmangs rigs dang bcas pa ri de dag gi nang du 9de dag 7don yod pa'i zhags pa'i cho 'phrul 'jig rten las 'das pa mod la mngon du mthong ba dang / 'das pa'am/ ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i 'chi ba dang / skye ba dang / skyes nas yang dag par dge ba dang / mi dge ba'i 'bras bu dang / dge ba dang mi dge bas shi ba dang / skyes nas phyug po'am/ dbul po'am/ rgyal po thob pa'am/ lha'i longs spyod dang / lha'i gnas sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / brgya 11byin dang /tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / rtag tu dbang phyug chen 72por 'gyur ba dang / klu'i skye gnas dang / yi dgas dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po 92wa 412

gsang ba pa rnams kyis dmyal ba mi bzad (1)par skye ba dang / mtshams (5med pa la thug gi bar du mthong ba dang / bram ze'i rigs sam/ rgyal rigs sam gzhan yang rigs du ma sna tshogs par skye 8)bar mthong ba dag 'jig rten mgon po'i mthus mngon sum (4)du mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten pa'i las bsgrub par bya ba de dag thams cad bstan 5)par bya ste/ rgyal ba dang / rnam par rgyal ba dang / bde ba dang / lo legs pa dang / mi ngas dang / yams kyi nad dang / pha rol gyi 'khor ram/ rang gi 'khor la gnod pa dang /dgra dang / phyir rgol ba dang / 'gyed pa dang / g.yul sprod pa dang / tshe ring ba dang / tshe thung ba dang / nad 'byung ba dang / nad med pa dang /phyichar 'bab pa dang / shin tu char 'bab pa dang / char mi 'bab pa dang /dus ma yin par 'bab pa dang / dar ba dang / rgyad pa dang / 'byor pa dang / mi 'byor pa dang / 'ong ba dang / 'gro ba dang / nor dang / 'bru rnyed pa dang / 'phel ba dang / 'bri ba dang / lo nyes pa mthong ba dang /'khor ba na da ltar gyi las gang cung zad legs par byed pa dang / nyes par 7byed pa dang / dge ba'am/ mi dge ba'am/ 'bri ba'am/ 'phel ba'am/ skye ba 58)legs par skye ba'am/ ngan par skye ba dang / bu 'byung ba/ bu pho'am / bu mo'am/ bu bzang po'am/ bu ngan pa'am/ bsod nams can nam / bsod nams med pa mngal na gnas pa de dag bden pa nyid du mthong ste / las kyi cho ga legs par byas pas the tshom 9mi bya'o/ /tshes ’ grangs dang /rgyu skar dang / nyin mtshan brjod par bya 11mi dgos kyi bzlas brjod dang /gtor ma dang / gtsang sbra dang / bkru bshal dang / shin tu khrus bya ba dang /92—413

gos gtsang 1 ma bcang ba dang / bden par smra ba dang / byams pa'i sems dang / bla ma la nalegs par mnyan ri pa de gzung cirab kho nar bya'o/ /zas dang / skom gtsang ma dang / chang dang / sha dang / beg btsong (5)dang /sgog skya dang / ke'u dang / 'dres par byas pa'i 'dres pa'i zas yongs su spang ba dang / shin tu spags 6pa dang / de dag ni khyad chosapar 'dod pas yongs su spang bar 8byas na las 9'di ni mod la thams cad mngon du mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /dka' thub spyod pa la brnyas sems mi bya/ ma gus pa mi bya'i lkog tu'ang 1 mi bya'o/ /rjes su bstan 31pa de dag ni mchog yin no/ /bsgrub par bya ba mchog de dag ni 'jig rten dbang phyug mgon pos bka' stsal pa yin no / /dngul las me long chu zheng 12du sor bcu drug pa byas la zangs las pad+mo'i gdan khru gang gi tshad 15sdong bu dang bcas par bya'o/ /me long gi gong du dngul lam / gser las 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug don yod pa'i zhags pa bya ste 1 tshad sor bzhi pa/ gdan pad+mo phyag bzhi la mdung rtse gsum pa dang / zhags pa dang / pad+ma dang / nor bu gerin po che thogs par bya ba ni 'jog sbyong legs par byas pa/ 'jam po 'od phyin pa tsam du sbyang bar bya'o/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang bas me long gi gong gi 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sku la ring bsrel gzhag par bya'o/ /ga pur dang / gla 7rtsis sku la mchod par bya'o/ /me 1 long gi nye 'khor thog thag tu dngul gyi me tog dang / gser gyi me tog rin po che sna tshogs kyis spras pa'i phreng ba gdags par bya'o/ /dbang bskur /snyeba'i dar gdags par bya'o/ / ༅de nas rig sngags 'chang bas me 19long de la nyi ma re re zhing dus gsum du don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas 92wa 414

brjod bya ste/ ji ru1tsam brgya nastong tshang gi (5)bar du bya'o/ /khro bo'i rgyal pos 54dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /75de nas me long 'bar bar 'gyur ro/ /gcig kho nar kha dog sna tshogs par 6'bar bar 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten dbang phyug gi sku gzugs de las lha rdzas kyi chu 'dzag go/ /'od zer sna tshogs 'byung ngo / /de nas rig sngags 'chang ba'i lus 'bar zhing dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /don yod par dga' ba dri ma med pa zhes bya ba don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po cho ga zhib mo grub pa 'thob 575par 'gyur ro/ /lus shin tu dri ma med cing yongs su dag par 'gyur ro/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang bas 'jig rten thams cad kyi mngon sum don yod pa'i zhags pa rnam par 'phrul pa 'grub pa bstan par bya dgos pas / de nas rig sngags 'chang bas sa dang ba'i lci ba bsres 8pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyar khru bzhi 'phang 9du khru do pa byas la shin tu mkhregs pa shin tu 'jam par bya'o/ /thig skud kyis rnam par phye ste/ tshon sna tshogs rnam par dbye zhing sgo bzhi rnam par phye nas dkyil 'khor gyi sgo rnam par phye ste/ pad+ma 'dab 1 ma brgyad tshon gyis gsal bar bri zhing pad+ma'i dkyil du ge sar dang ze ba bya'o/ /stegs bu gru 1lhabazhi la rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan 1 pa dang / stegs bu grwa / bzhir rgyal po chen po bzhi go cha bgos pa gtum pa 'jigs par byed pa'i gzugs bri bar bya'o/ /stegs bu'i dbus kyi gnas par bar du lha dbang phyug dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / gshin rje dang / chu lha dang / gzhon nu dang / lus ngan po dang / tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / lha dbang phyug dang / phyag na rdo rje dang / ral pa gcig pa dang / sgrol ma dang / dkar mo dang / khro gnyer ma dang / rdo rje pho nya mo 92—415

rnams tshon 1sna tshogs kyis bri 2zhing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan (da pa/ me tog sna tshogs thogs pa bya'o/ /stegs bu'i phyi rol du mdung rtse gsum pa'i phreng ba dang / rdo rje'i phreng ba dang / pad+ma'i phreng ba kun du bya'o/ /phreng ba'i bar dbus dang / grwa'i bar du lha mo brgyad dang 'jigs byed ma dang / dpe med ma dang / ba san ti 5dang / dpal sgra dbyangs dang / sa'i lha mo dang /dung can ma dang / pus pa dan ti rnams rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan 567pa/ me tog sna tshogs dang 7rin po che'i snod thogs par 8)bya'o/ /phyi rol thog thag tu phreng ba'i bar bar 9du dri sna tshogs kyis dkyil 'khor bsku zhing tsan+dan dkar po dang / gur gum gyis 1 mchod pa sna tshogs bya'o/ /ga pur dang / gla /1rtsis mchod cing / dkyil 'khor kun du dar sna tshon sna lnga'i rgyal mtshan dang /mda' dang / rta babs kyis brgyan 12par bya'o/ /dngul gyi snod bzhi cung peng 12gis bkang ste gzhag par bya'o/ /dngul gyi snod bzhi 'gator ma dkar gsum gyis dgang bar bya'o/ /dngul gyi snod bzhir mchod yon gyi chu gzhag par bya'o/ /snod brgyad ro 15sna tshogs kyi gtor mas dgang bar bya'o/ /'bras bu rnam pa sna tshogs gzhag par bya'o/ /kha zas bza' ba dang / gtor ma rnam pa lasna tshogs gzhag par bya'o/ /dri sna tshogs dang / byug 17pas dngul gyi snod bkang ste gzhag par bya'o/ / bodangul gyi pog phor brgyad 518tsan+dan dang / a ga ru dang / tu ru ska 19dang / ga pur dang / gla rtsi dang / gur gum dang / sra rtsi pog dang / pog 2 gis gang bar bya zhing bdug 21spos sna tshogs pa sreg 22go/ /dngul dang / zangs dang / gser gyi me tog gi snying po'i dkyil 'khor du gcal na du dgram mo/ /phyi'i dkyil 'khor du ji ltar rnyed pa'i me tog gcal 2 du 92wa 416

dgram par bya ste/ phreng ba rnams khor yug tu bskor nas bzhag 1ste/ de la yang me long legs par brgyan 2par byas nas/ dbus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi pad+ma'i ge sar dang ze'u 'bru la shar du phyogs par gzhag par bya'o/ /rig sngags 'chang gtsang ma khrus byas gos gtsang ma bgo bar bya ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi las dang / bya ba thams cad byas nas me long la mngon du phyogs te/ skyil mo krung du 'dug par gyur nas 'phags pa don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po bzlas brjod dbul bar bya ste/ bzlas brjod brgya rtsa brgyad rdzogs pa dang /khro bo'i rgyal pos dbang bskur ro/ /dbang bskur ba tsam gyi mod la 'jig rten thams cad kyi mngon sum dang / 'khor chen po'i dbus su me long gi dbus der 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug rang gi gzugs kyis mthong ste/me long gi dbus de nas rig sngags 'chang de la legs so zhes bya ba sbyin par mdzad do/ /rig sngags 'chang chen po legs so legs so/ /bdag la don yod pa'i me long la 'bebs pa'i de kho na nyid dam par gyur pa 'di thams cad yang dag par mthong ste/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i las kyi 'bras bu bla na med pa zhes 4bya ba yongs su dag pa nyid do/ /rig sngags 'chang khyod kyis 'bras bu chen po'i 5'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam mtshungs pa med pa thob bo/ /khyod kyis don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po'i 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sgrub pa'i cho ga dang / cho ga zhib mo dang / dkyil 'khor dang phyag rgya grub bo/ /rig sngags 'chang 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mchog tshigang 'dod pa smros shig /de thams cad sbyin par bya'o zhes so/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis mchog gang don du gnyer ba de blangs nas 8thams 92—417

cad 'phral nyid du sbyin par byed do/ /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor gang yin pa der/kun nas 'ongs pa'i bud med dang / skyes pa dang / khye'u dang / bu mo dang /dge sbyong dang / bram ze dang / rgyal rigs dang / dmangs 15)rigs dang /rje'u narigs dang / rgyal po dang / blon po dang / bkrabs pa dang /mdun na 'don dang / btsun mo'i 'khor du kun 'ongs pa dang / bsod nams 3dang ldan pa'am/ bsod nams dang mi ldan pa'am/ yongs su dag pa'am / lta ba ngan pa'am/ gzhan dmyal ba pa'i sems can gti mug gi mun pa la lhung ba / mnar med pa la gzhol ba/ mtshams med pa lnga byed pa/'phags pa la skur pa 'debs pa/ dam pa'i chos spong ba gang yin pa de rnams thams cad la'ang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi lus de la ston par byed/ thams cad du smra bar byed/ yang dag par dbugs 'byin par byed / thams cad du rang gi las la dge ba'am/ mi dge ba'i 'bras bu rnam par smin pa de thams cad ston par byed do5ri/ /rig sngags kyis chom rkun dang /gdol pa dang / rig sngags spong zhing nyams par byed pa dang / rig sngags sun 'byin par byed pa dang / rig sngags la ma 6dad cing gus pas mi nyan pa de'i mi mthong ba ni ma gtogs te/ gzhan du na rang gi las kyi 'bras bu sdug bsngal rnam pa sna tshogs nges par 'byung bar mthong ngo / /de nas sems can de rnams gang 'dod pa'i don yid la byed pa 'jug ste/ 'jig rten pa'am 'jig rten las 'das pa de thams cad 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor chen po ru 7norang rang gi 'bras bu nges par 'byung ba bsod nams dang / bsod nams ma yin pa'i 'bras bu mthong bar byed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sangs rgyas 92—418

kyi zhing mthong ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku chen po dang / khang pa brtsegs pa dang bcas pa'i gzhal yas khang mthong ngo / /po ṭa la ku'i ri bo'i gzhal yas khang rnams bcom ldan 'das kyi rnam par 'phrul pa dang bcas pa dang /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas pa gzhal yas khang na lha dang klus yongs su bskor ba mthong ngo / /gzhan ji ltar da ltar gyi dge ba dang mi dge ba'am/ lo legs pa dang / lo nyes pa'am/ nad dang / 'chi ba dang / tshe thung ba dang / tshe ring ba dang / rang gi dmag tshogs dang /pha rol gyi dmag tshogs dang / g.yul dang / 'khrug pa dang / 'jigs pa dang / rgyal ba'am/ 'pham pa'am/ rlag 1pa'am/ ma brlags 2pa'am/yams dang / char ches pa'am / dus ma yin pa'i char ram char med pa'am / rlung ngam/ sad dam/ tshangs 4pa yang rung ste de dag thams cad mthong ngo / /nor dang ldan pa'am/ nyams pa'am 'phel ba'am lo thog gam / me tog gam/ 'bras bu 'phel ba yang rung ste/ de dag thams cad mthong ngo / /chom rkun dang / rkun po dang / dug dang / mtshon cha'i 'jigs pa'am/ rgyal po'i 'jigs pa'am/ gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang /'byung po dang / mkha' 'gro ma dang / brjed byed kyi 'jigs pa de thams cad mthong ngo / /nor chen po'am/ nor med pa de thams cad mthong ngo / /'chi 'pho ba dang / skye ba mthong ngo / /bu thob pa dang / grong dang / grong khyer dang / yul dang / ljongs thob pa dang / bud med thob pa de thams cad mthong ste/ 'di la dogs pa dang / yid gnyis dang / the tsom sgrubaskyed par mi bya zhing / mchog tu dad pa dang gus pas shin tu 'bad de cho ga 'di 92—419

bsgyur bar 1)bya'o/ /don yod zhags pa'i rnam par thar pa'i dkyil 'khor du 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sgrub thabs kyi cho ga rdzogs so// //de nas yang gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis don yod pa'i 92rizhags pa'i snying po gsungs pa cho ga zhib mo'i nye bar spyod pa dang bcas pa dang /dkyil 'khor dang / phyag rgya rim par phye ba dang / ras ris shin tu zab pa/shin tu gting dpag dka' zhing / shin tu rgya che ri la/ shin tu sgrub dka' ba dang / dkyil 'khor mang po dang / phyag rgya mang po dang / gsang sngags mang po dang / ras ris mang po yongs su bsgrags pa rnams ni rab rib dang bral bar mthong ste/ bcom ldan 'das rgya mtsho chen po dug can pa zab pa lta bu/lhun po chen po dang mtshungs pa lta bu/ smig rgyu lta bu/ rdul phra rab lta bu de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes dang mtshungs pa lta bu/ bgrang ba las yang dag par 'das pa/ mtshungs 4pa med pa/ gzhal du med pa/ tshad med pa/ bskal pa'i grangs kyis bgrang bar bya ba med pa'i bskal pa'i tshad ma dang / bskal pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshad ma dang / lha'i yul gyi tshad ma dang / klu'i yul gyi tshad ma dang / sems can gyi tshad ma dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshad ma dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan la snang ba'i tshad ma dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes la 5kun du snang ba'i tshad ma dang /byang chub sems dpa'i ye shes kyi tshad ma dang / bdud kyi yul gyi tshad ma rnams 92—420

kyis thog mar dmigs pa ma lags so/ / bcom ldan 'das bar du yang dmigs pa ma lags/1 bcom ldan 'das bar du yang dmigs pa ma lags so//tha mar yang ma lags na/ bcom ldan 'das de ci ltar yongs su shes par bgyi/sgrub thabs kyi cho gas bsgrub par bya ba ni du zhig lags/ gsang sngags ni du zhig /phyag rgya ni du zhig /dkyil 'khor ni du zhig /bri bar bya ba'i phyag rgya ni du zhig /lag pa'i phyag rgya ni du zhig /bdug pa'i sbyor ba ni du zhig /mig sman ni du zhig /ril bu ni du zhig /bdug pa ni du zhig /ras ris 2ni du zhig /rtsa ba'i gsang sngags ni du zhig /snying po ni du zhig /nye ba'i snying po ni 87du zhig /khro bo'i gsang sngags ni du zhig /drag po ni du zhig /zhi ba ni du zhig /yi ge gcig pa ni du zhig /yi ge gnyis pa ni du zhig /yi ge gsum pa ni du zhig /yi ge bzhi pa ni du zhig /yi ge lnga pa ni du zhig /yi ge drug pa ni du zhig /yi ge bdun pa ni du zhig /yi ge brgyad pa ni du zhig /yi ge dgu pa ni du zhig /yi ge bcu pa ni du zhig lags/ smyung bar gnas pa ci ltar lags/ nyin mo dang mtshan mo ni ci ltar/ khrus kyi cho ga ni ci ltar/gos bgo 4 ba ni ci ltar/ phyogs bcing ba ni ci ltar/ dkyil 'khor bcing ba ni ci ltar/ gtsug tor bcing ba ni ci ltar/ bdag srung ba ni ci ltar/gzhan srung ba ni ci ltar/ grogs srung ba ni ci ltar/ slob ma srung ba ni ci ltar/rab tu 'jug pa ni ci ltar/ phyag bya ba ni ci ltar/ bskor ba bya ba ni ci ltar/mchod yon dang / zhabs bsil 'bul 5ba ni ci ltar/ gtor ma 'bul ba ni ci ltar/ me tog 'bul ba ni ci ltar/ bdug pa ni ci ltar/ dri ni ci ltar/mar me ni ci ltar/ nye reg ni ci ltar/ lho bshos tshoni ci ltar/ thams cad 92—421

du spyan drang ba ni ci ltar/ snyan gsan dbab pa ni ci ltar/ rmi lam bskul ba ni ci ltar/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga ni ci ltar lags/ zhi ba can ni du zhig lags/rgyas pa can ni du zhig /mngon spyod can ni du zhig /zhags pa ni du zhig /rdo rje ni du zhig /pad+ma ni du zhig /gshegs su gsol ba ni du zhig /nye bar 'pho bar byed pa'i bya ba ni du zhig lags/ bcom ldan 'das de dag gi zhirwamatshan nyid ci 'dra ba dang / rgyu mtshan ci 'dra ba dang / kun tu spyod par 'gyur ba ni mi shes so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag las sgrub pa'i cho ga du zhig gi rjes su 'brang bar bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das ci ltar phyi ma'i dus phyi ma'i tshe na/sems can rnams kyi rjes su 'brang bar 'gyur / dngos grub du zhig rjes su stsal bar bgyi/ ci ltar sems can bla na med par 'gyur bar bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das 'di dag la bdag 'khrugs par gyur cing / bdag la spobs pa med do / /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis shes par mi nus na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis cho ga'i mtshan nyid ji lta ba de dag bdag la gsung du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das bdag la the tshom mchis pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag gi the tshom bcad du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pas zhu ba yongs su zhus par gyur pa gsan nas/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces ( bka' stsal to/ /lag na rdo rje mchog tu rnyed par dka' ba 'di dri ba yongs su dris pa ni legs so/ /legs so/ /lag na rdo rje khyod 47la yongs su 'dri bar byed pa'i spobs pa skyes pa ni lag na rdo rje sems can thams cad la phan pa'i phyir don gyi ched yongs su zhus pa'i phyir dang / rig sngags 'chang thams cad 92—422

kyi mchog 'grub pa'i don du yongs su zhus 1pa'i phyir dang / lag na rdo rje 'di ni mchog tu rmad du byung bas te/ phyi bzhin du rjes su 'brang ngo 2/ /lag na rdo rje 'di ni sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin dang mtshungs pa'o/ /lag na rdo rje don yod zhags pa'i snying po'i cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po chen po'i cho ga /rgya mtsho chen po dug can pa dang / zab par mtshungs pas te/ 'di ni gting dpag dka' ba'o / /lag na rdo rje rgya mtsho chen po thigs pa'i grangs kyis bgrang bar nus kyi/lag na rdo rje don yod zhags pa'i snying po'i tshad ni gzung 4bar mi nus so/ /lag na rdo rje ri'i rgyal po ri rab ni rdul phra rab tu gtor ba'i grangs kyis 5mthar thug par bya bar nus shing / slar yang ri'i rgyal po ri rab tu gnas par 'dod pas rang gi gnas su rab tu bzhag par nus kyi don yod zhags pa'i snying po'i cho ga zhib mo'i tshad ni gzung bar mi nus so/ /de ltar rgya che ba/ de ltar gting dpag dka' ba/ de ltar zab pa ste/ lag na rdo rje/ 'das pa dang /ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyis mkhyen pa dang / gting dpag par mi nus so/ /don yod zhags pa'i snying po'i cho ga zhib mo'i tshad 'dzin par ni mi nus so/ /lag na rdo rje sgyu ma lta bu gang yin pa de dang / snying po dang / ting nge 'dzin gang yin pa de dang /zhags pa dang / sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam par 'phrul pa 'di/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis 6sems can rnams kyi gzugs dang / kha dog dang / dbyibs sna tshogs pa 7chodang / tshul sna tshogs su mthong bar byed de/ sems can thams cad bsgral ba'i ched dang / rig sngags 'chang thams cad kyi dngos grub kyi mchog 92—423

sgrub 1par byed pa'o/ /lag na rdo rje 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thams cad du mnyam par 'gro ba ste/ gang du chu dang 'o ma mnyam pas mnyam pa bzhin no/ /thams cad du mnyam pas byams pa dang snying rje chen po rgyas par byed do/ /don yod pa'i zhags pas 'gugs par byed la sgrol bar byed do/ /'chi ba med pa'i thad rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du 'jog par byed do/ /dman pa dang / mchog dang /bar ma dang / rigs mthon po dang / dma' ba dang / dmyal ba dang /byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten la sogs pa rnams thams cad du mnyam par dran par byed cing ming smos pa tsam gyis 'dzin par byed cing /sems can thams cad bla na med par byed la dub pa dang / ngal ba dang /yid la gcags 2par 'gyur ba med do/ /lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / srin po dang / 'byung po dang / brjed byed dang / yi dgas dang / nags dang / gshin rje'i gnas ji srid du sa 'og gi nang du son pa rnams dang / srid pa'i rtse mo nas mnar med pa'i mthar thug pa dang / ji srid du 'og min gyi srid pa'i bar du gcig tu sems bskyed pas yongs su rgyug go/ /lha dang / klu dang bcas pa nas ji srid dud 'gro'i skye gnas kyi bar thams cad dang / bud med dang / skyes pa dang / khye'u dang /bu mo rnams bla na med par byed do/ /dper na nyi ma'i 'od zer ni mun pas mdongs pa thams cad sel bar byed de / 'dzam bu'i ragling thams cad du mnyam par snang bar byed do/ /de bzhin nyid du byang chub sems dpa' sems 92—424

dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thams cad du snying rje chen pos kun du snang bar byed cing thams cad la thams cad du mnyam par gnas te/ sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba dang / 'jigs pa mi bzad pa dang / nad dang / mya ngan dang / sdug bsngal gyi 'ching ba rnams thams cad yongs su grol bar byed do/ /skye ba dang / rga ba dang / 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal yongs su grol bar byed do/ /mtho ris la gzhol ba la sogs pa'i lam thams cad du 'god par byed do/ /de ltar na snying rje chen po dang / byams pa chen pos thams cad du mnyam par rjes su 'gro ste/ thams cad du mnyam par mchog tu byed cing / thams cad du mnyam par byang chub kyi lam la rab tu 'god 1par byed do/ /thams cad du mnyam par skyabs 2dang / dpung gnyen du 'gyur ro//lag na rdo rje de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ni/ brtan pa dang / go cha dang / spro ba chen pos rig sngags 'chang 3thams cad dang / sems can thams cad kyi don gyi ched du zhugs pa'o/ /lag na rdo rje 'di ni thabs cig tu 'jug pa chen po ste/sems can thams cad 'jigs pa chen po'i lam las so sor ldog par byed pa'o/ /bde ba nas bde bar gshegs pa'i lam du 'god par byed pa'o/ /rtog pa med cing rnam par rtog pa med la bsam pa rnam pa gzhan du 'gyur ba 5med do/ /sems kyis yid la gcags 6par 'gyur ba med do/ /de nas yang gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po phyag na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi yon tan bsngags pa chen po 'di thos nas dga' 7ba dang / mgu ba dang /92—425

yi 1rangs pa dang / rab tu rangs pa dang / dga' ba dang / yid bde ba skyes nas ched du brjod pa ni ched du brjod par gyur to/ /e ma mgon po 'jig rten dbang phyug /e ma 'jig rten dbang phyug bla ma/ /khyod kyi ming gi yon tan bskyed pas/ /ngan 'gro thams cad grol bar byed do/ /phyag na rdo rjes (mibyang chub sems dpa' la smras pa/ 'di ni 'jig rten gyi bla ma mgon po/'di ni 'jig rten gyi yab chen po/ 'di ni 'jig rten sgrol bar byed pa'i mgon po/ thub pa nyin mo'i nyi ma'o/ /bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /de lta bur lag na rdo rje ji ltar smra bar bgyid/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lag na rdo rje byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug can song la/ mngon par phyag 'tshal nas yongs su zhus shig /mchog tu gyur pa'i tshig gis cho ga ji lta ba bzhin du snying po dang /de kho na nyid kyi rang bzhin de rnams ston par byed do/ /don yod zhags pa'i snying po'i cho ga zhib mo sgrub pa'i dngos grub ji lta ba bzhin du ston par 'gyur zhing lung 'bogs par byed do/ /de nas gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rjes zab mo zab pa rtogs shing khong du chud de seng ge'i rtsal gyis 'gro zhing /rdo rje bskor bar byed bzhin pas zla ba mdzes pa dri ma med pa'i me tog bzung nas / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ga la ba der dong ste lhags nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags 4pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas/ lan gsum bskor ba byas te/ zla ba mdzes pa dri ma med pa'i me tog phul te/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga 5sa la btsugs 67te/92—426

byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag ni shin tu rmongs pa dang ldan pa dran pa yongs su nyams pa blo'i dpa' zhum pa ste/ don yod zhags pa'i snying po'i gsang sngags dang phyag rgya mang po dang / ras ris kyi sgrub pa'i cho ga shin tu rgyas pa 'di dang de dag mi shes so/ /sngon ma ni du zhig /bar ma ni du zhig /tha ma ni du zhig /rtsa ba'i gsang sngags ni du zhig /snying po ni du zhig /nye ba'i snying po ni du zhig /ji srid du yi ge bcu pa'i bar gyi gsang sngags ni du zhig /dkyil 'khor dang / cho ga zhib mo dang / ras ris ni 1du zhig lags/ bcom ldan 'das bdag la skabs dbye bar gsol zhes so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 2chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis phyag na rdo rje la brtse ba'i don du zla ba mdzes pa dri ma med pa'i me tog blangs nas / bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i don du nam mkha'i dbyings su gtor ro(gyi / /gtor ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu'i steng gi mtshams su 'khor lo'i rnam par gnas so/ /dpag tshad lnga brgyar khyab cing sa gzhi las gyen du 'phags pa nyid kyi paji srid 'og min gyi gnas kyi bar du gnas te/ bai ḍūr+ya sngon po chen po'i sdong bu la 'dzam bu 5chu bo'i gser gyi dril bu dpyangs pa'i ba dan bcings pas mdzes shing 'bar bar yongs su gyur to/ /'khor lo'i rnam pa legs par yongs su 'khor ba ni nyi ma bye ba brgya stong phrag pas lhag pa'i kun tu snang ba legs par yongs su dag pa/ yongs su byang ba shin tu dri ma med pa'i gser gyi mchod sdong rnam par mdzes par shin tu gnas pa/ nor bu rin po che chen po sna tshogs pas spras pa dga' bar bya ba/ yid kyi shing rta rab tu tshim par 92—427

byed pa dang / dga' bar bya ba mthong ba lha dang / lha ma yin gyis (1)phyag bya bar 'os pa dang / rjed par bya bar 'os pa dang / drang srong rnams kyis (gebastod par 'os pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis lung bstan par 'os pa ste/ thams cad du zla ba mdzes pa dri ma med pa'i me tog gi ge sar la / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku bzhugs pa'i rin po che sna bdun gyi khang pa brtsegs pa 3'khor gyi dkyil 4'khor gyis 5)yongs su bskor nas bzhugs pa la/gdugs kun nas yongs su 'khor ba'i lha rdzas kyi gzhal med khang dang / lha dang / klu dang / chus byung dang / lha'i bu mo dang / klu'i bu mo dang /mi'am ci'i bu mo dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang /lha ma yin dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / rig sngags 'chang dang / rig pa 'dzin pa brgya stong phrag gis lha rdzas kyi me tog sna tshogs pa'i gzhal med khang dang / lha rdzas kyi rgyan dang / gos dang / lhab lhub kyis brgyan cing / dar dpyangs dang / ba dan dang / dri dang / phreng ba dang /byug pa dang / phye ma dang / chos gos dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan rnams thogs te/ bcom ldan 'das dang 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor la mchod pa byed par gyur 6te/ lha rdzas sna tshogs pa'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi char 'bab par gyur cing lha'i dri za'i glu 7dbyangs yang dag par len cing /rnga dang / pheg rdob rnams kyis rnamachod pa'i don du rol mo byed par gyur to/ /po ṭa la'i ri bor gzhal med khang 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa rusmyo/ca co'i sgra chen po sgrogs 1 par gyur to/ /po ṭa la kur gnas pa'i lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding 92—428

dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po gang yin pa rnams kyang sems tshim pa thob cing / rmad du byung ba thob bo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor ba'i lha gang yin pa rnams dang / pad+ma'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha gang yin pa rnams dang / rdo rje'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor pa'i lha gang yin pa rnams dang / nor bu'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 1lha gang yin pa rnams dang /glang po'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor ba'i 2lha gang yin pa rnams dang / dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha gang yin pa de rnams thams cad mchog tu ya mtshan pa dang ldan zhing / rmad du byung ba thob ste/ sems tshim pa skyes la ngo mtshar ba thob nas / bcom ldan 'das la lta 4bar byed rabazhin du kun du gnas par gyur to//zla ba dang / nyi ma dang / rgyu skar dang / skar ma'i tshogs dang / lha dang /mtshan mo'i lha dang / dbang po dang / tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang /dbang phyug chen po dang / gzhon nu dang / dga' byed dbang phyug dang /tshogs kyi dbang phyug dang / nag po chen po dang / dbang phyug dang / dbang phyug chen po dang tshangs ris kyi lha'i bu dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / nor bu bzang po dang / gang ba bzang po dang / stobs kyi lha dang / gshin rje dang / chu lha dang / lus ngan gyi lha rnams dang / gzhon nu'i lha rnams gdugs kyi yu ba nas bzung nas/ bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byed par gyur to / /lha'i gzhal med khang chen po lha'i rnam par sprul pa'i mchod pa'i sprin gyis 6mchod pa byed do/ /gdugs kyi rnam pa'i khor yug gi nang du dga' ldan gyi lha dang / 'og min gyi lha dang / lha'i gnas thams cad du lha'i bus yongs su bskor ba gang yin pa de nam mkha' la mchod pa'i sprin chen pos bcom ldan 92—429

'das shākya thub pa dang / spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang phyug 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor la mchod pa byed do/ /sa'i lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang /srin po dang / dri za gang yin pa rnams dang / sa gzhi'i 0)lha dang / chu'i lha dang / nags kyi lha dang / lo thog gi lha dang / sman gyi lha gang yin pa de rnams thams cad sa'i mthil gyi gzhal yas khang de sbyong bar byed par gyur te/dri sna tshogs pa'i chus chag chag 'debs shing / dri sna tshogs pa'i phye mas byug par byed/ me tog sna tshogs gcal 25du 'grems shing ( kyi/ bdug pa sna tshogs kyis bdugs nas sa'i dkyil 'khor yang dag par brgyan (4)par gyur to/ /de ltar rnam par 'phrul pa'i go skabs rgya chen po ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i khyu mchog de bzhin gshegs pa'i dam tshig byin gyis brlab ri 45)pa'o/ /de nas gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rjes/ de lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam par 'phrul pa chen po yangs pa rgya chen po mthong nas/ shin tu ya mtshan pa thob cing rmad du byung ba thob ste/ 'di ltar sems par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi bstan pa ni shin tu ya mtshan no / /de nas gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rjes/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la slar yang gsol ba btab bo/ /bcom ldan 'das skabs dbye bar mdzod cig de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /lag na rdo rje dogs pa bsal 6ba dang / the tshom gcod pa la rjes su bzung nya tshongo / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras 92—430

gzigs dbang phyug stan las langs te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de 1logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas lan gsum bskor ba byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'khod nas/ mig mi 'dzums shing nabazhin rab tu 'dzum pa lus 'od zer 'bar bas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag la don yod zhags pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / pad+ma yangs pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa dang / pad+ma gtsug tor gyi nor bu'i dkyil 'khor dang /don yod zhags pa'i gsang ba sgyu ma lta bu'i snying po dang phyag rgya dang / kun du spyan ras gzigs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i rim par phye ba mchis te/ bcom ldan 'das de dag bdag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar yongs su bsgrag napar bgyi'o/ /sgrub pa bla 4zhing bklags pas grub 5pa dam tshig mchog tu gyur pa'i snying po nye bar bstan par bgyi'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas phyag gser gyi kha dog can/ 'od zer sna tshogs pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag gis 6yang dag par brgyan pa 7brkyang nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi spyi bo'i gtsug tu phyag na'ajog par mdzad cing sems can dag pa chen po legs so legs so / /spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang phyug /da lta de'i dus la bab par shes na smros shig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bskul bar rig nas phyogs bcur kun du bltas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag byas nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la kun du bltas te/ rtsa ba'i gsang sngags don yod zhags pa'i pad+ma gtsug tor gyi nor bu don yod zhags pa'i snying po gsungs 92—431

so / /don yod pa'i snying po'i dkyil 'khor du pad+ma gtsug tor gyi gsang ba'i rnam par 'phrul pa dris 1pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dang po ni/ dus gsum du gshegs shing rab tu bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor don yod pa gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i rang sangs rgyas dang / 'phags pa nyan thos kyi dge 'dun thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i rigs kyi snying po'i dam tshig rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang dag par song ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang dag par zhugs pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /blo gros chen po 'phags pa sha 2ra dwa ti'i bu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa byams pa la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa'i tshogs kyi mchog rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'phags pa 'od dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pad+mo'i gtsug tor gyi dkyil 'khor 'chang ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /drang srong chen po 'phags pa'i tshogs kyi mchog rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par thar pa'i dkyil 'khor 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi zhal nas gsungs pa/ don yod pa'i rgyal po'i pad+ma gtsug tor gyi snying po de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan sngar gsungs pa 'di/ bdag gis da ltar 'khor chen po la bshad par bgyi'o/ /tar+ya thā/ oṃ parlosnri ṣa bar 92—432

da hūṃ/ tsa ra tsa ra/ tsi ri tsi ri/ tsu ru tsu ru/ ma hā kā ru ṇi ka /tsi ri tsi ri/ pi ri pi ri/ tsi ri tsi ri/ pa ra ma kā ru ṇi 11 /si ri si ri dzi ri tsi ri/ pi ri pi ri/ bi ri bi ri/ ma hā pad+ma haste/ ka la ka la/ ki li ki li / kā gelu ku lu / ma hā shud+dha satwa/ e h+ye hi/ bu dh+ya bu dh+ya/ dhā ba dhā ba/ka ṇa ka ṇa/ mi/ ṇi mi/ ṇi/ ku ṇa ṭa/ ṇa/ pa zang ma 〈gud+dha bzhutwa/ ka zad ka zar/ :go ri ki ri/ ku ru ku ru/ ma hā sbru ma māsta / tsa la tsa la/ sañtsa la/ bi tsa la / e ṭa ṭa/ e ṭa ṭa/ bha ra bha ra/ bhi ri bhi ri/ bhu ru bhu ru/ ma hā bi ma la/ parlosnri ṣa bi ra dza sā dha ya hūṃ hūṃ/ e h+ye hi/ ma hā kā 5ru ṇi ka /ma hā pa shu pa ti/ be 6khi dha ra/ dha ra dha ra/ ma hā parlosnri ṣa dha ra/ sa ra sa ra / sarba ā ba ra ṇa ha ra/ tsa ra tsa ra/ sarba bit+yā madha ra na ma skṛ 8te/ ha ra ha ra/ sarba kilpi ṣa ha ra/ hā hā hā hā/ tī tī tī tī/ hū hū hū hū/ oṃ kā ra brah+ma be ṣa dha ra/ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ ma hā pad+ma dz+wa la dha ra/ ta ra ta ra/ sa ra sa ra/ pa ra pa ra/ pad+ma pā 9sha dha ra/ tsa ra tsa ra / ba ra ba ra/ ba ra rasmi sha ta sa ha 1 sra/ pra ti maṇ+ḍi ta sha rī rā ya/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ ta pa ta pa/ bha ga bā na 11so ma ā di t+ya ya ma/ ba ru ṇa12/ ku be ra / brah+ma/ in+d+ra na/ ṛ 1 ṣi ga ṇa/ de ba ga ṇa/ a bh+ya rtsi ta/ tsa ra ṇa/su ru su ru/ tsu ru tsu ru/ pu ru pu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ san ta ku mā ra/ ru tra / bā sa ba/ bisnu/ dha na da/ de ba ṛ 5k+ṣi/ nā ya ka /ba hu/ bi bi dha / be ṣa dha ra/ ma hā pad+ma daṇ+ḍa dha ra/ pā sha dha ra/ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri / dhu ru dhu ru/ tha ra tha ra/ gha ra gha ra/ ya ra ya ra la ra la ra ha ra ha ra/ pa ra pa ra sa ra sa ra/ tsa ra tsa ra/ ba ra ba ra/ ma hā ba ra 92wa 433

dā ya ka /sa man+ta maṇ+ḍal/ a ba lo ki ta/ lo ke (17sha ra/ ma he shwa ra/ mu hu mu hu/ mu ru mu ru/ mu ya mu ya/ muñtsa muñtsa/ bha ga bān dzoX.ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa ra/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ ma ma sarba bha ye bh+yaḥ/ sarba bha ye bh+yaḥ/ sarba u pa dra be bh+yaḥ / sarba gra he bh+yaḥ/ sarba dz+wa re bh+yaḥ/ sarba byā ri dhi bh+yaḥ/ bad+dha ban+dha na tā ḍa 5na tardzan/ rā 6dza/ tso ra/ taskar/ asna/ u da ka /bi ṣa/ shasta/pa ri mo tsa ka /ka ṇa ka ṇa/ ki ṇi ki ṇi/ ku ṇa ku ṇa/ tsa ra tsa ra in+d+ra ya 7rib la/ bo sbyi ga /tsa tu rār+ya sa t+ya saṃ pra kā sha ka /ta ma ta ma/ da ma da ma / sa ma sa ma/ sa ma sa ma/ ma hā ta mon+dha ka ra bi 87snya man9)/ ṣaṭa pā ra mi tā pa ri pū ra 1 ka /mi li mi li/ ṭa ṭa ṭa ṭa/ ṭha ṭha ṭha ṭha/ ṭi ṭi ṭi ṭi/ṣ+ṭha ṣ+ṭha ṣ+ṭha ṣ+ṭha/ ṭu ṭu ṭu ṭu/ ṭhā ṭhā ṭhā ṭhā/ e ne 11ya tsarma kṛ ta 12pa ri kur e h+ye hi / yī shwa ra/ ma he 1 shwa ra/ pad+me shwa ra/ ma hā bhū muta ga ṇa/ saṃ bhañdza ka /ma hā sid+dhi swa ra/ ku ru ku ru/ ba ra ba ra/ ka ṭa ka ṭa/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/ bi shud+dha bi ṣa ya/ ni bā si na/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā /shwe ta yarnyo pa bī ta rat+na ma ku ṭa mā lā dha ra/ sarba dz+nyā shi ra si kṛ 7ta ma ku ṭa ma ha: taḥ7ka ma lā lam̐ kṛ ta/ka ra ta la/ dh+yā 1 na sa mā 1 dhi/ bi mo k+ṣa pra gaspa/ ba hu satwa 19san+ta ti /pa ri pā tsa ka /ma hā kā ru ṇi ka /sarba kurma ā ba ra ṇa bi sho dha ka /sarba byā (21dhi pra mo tsa ka /sarba ā shā pa ri pū ra kuḥri nasarba satwa/ sa mā shā 2nyis ka /oṃ parlosnri ṣa pā sha ṣ+ṭṛ da ya maṇ+ḍa la na mastu te swā hā/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis/ don yod zhags pa'i pad+ma gtsug tor gyi gsang ba'i snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di gsungs ma thag tu stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sa gzhi cher g.yos par gyur te ni/ ri dang / nags dang / dgon 92wa 434

par bcas pa rnam par 'gyur ba drug tu g.yos par gyur to/ /kun nas sa'i mthil 'di yang rin po che sna bdun gyi rang bzhin gyi pad+ma'i gdan kun nas bting bar gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das phyag na pad+ma'i lte ba'i gnas na pad+ma chen po gyen du 'phags pa 'dab 1ma stong pa/ rin po che sna bdun gyi rang bzhin / bai ḍūr+ya sngon po chen po'i sdong bu dang / 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser gyi snying po dang / mu tig dmar po'i ze na'abru dang / lha'i mu tig chen po'i ge sar tsho dang gcig 4tu 'bar bar 5gyur pa 'od zer sna tshogs pa 'byin par byed pas te/ 'di lta ste sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po dang / btsod cadang / shel dang / dngul gyi kha dog tu snang bzhin pas 'bar zhing / rnam par gsal ba 7lhang nge'o/ /phyogs bcu kun du sangs rgyas sakyi zhing rnams su kun du snang bar byed do/ /lha'i gnas dang / klu'i gnas dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po'i gnas dang / dri za'i gnas dang / lha ma yin gyi gnas dang / nam mkha' lding gi gnas dang / mi'am ci'i gnas dang / lto 'phye chen po'i gnas rnams kun du snang bar byed do/ /rab tu tshim par byed do/ /yang dag par skul 8bar byed do/ /yang dag par dbugs 'byin par byed do/ /dmyal ba chen po bcu drug po rnams kun du snang zhing reg pas dmyal ba chen po de rnams kyang pad+ma can chen por skyes par gyur to/ /sems can dmyal ba de rnams kyang 9kun nas snang zhing reg pa tsam gyis de rnams thams cad yongs su grol te/ bsams pa tsam gyi med la bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams su pad+ma las rdzus 1 te skyes shing / lha'i lus la rgyan 11lhab lhub dang / gos dang / spud 12pas rnam par brgyan 1 cing / skye ba nas skye ba 92—435

ru 1skye ba dran par skyes so/ /de bzhin du dud 'gro'i skye gnas su song ba rnams kun nas 2snang bas/ ri dgas dang / bya de dag thams cad kyang dud 'gro'i skye gnas las yongs su grol te/ mtho ris su rna rgyan dri ma med cing g.yo ba 'dzin par skyes so/ /de bzhin du phyogs bcu kun du sems can thams cad kun du snang zhing reg pa de rnams thams cad sa chen po brgyad pa la rab tu gnas par gyur to/ /des kyang 'khor chen por kun du 'ongs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs chen po de rnams /thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu phyir mi ldog pa nyid la rab tu bkod 4par gyur to/ /rig sngags 'chang gi 'khor gang yin pa thams cad kyang don yod pa pad+ma'i gtsug tor chen po'i snying po gsang ba don yod zhags pa'i dngos grub so sor thob par gyur to/ /klu'i rgyal po'i 'khor gang yin pa de rnams 5thams cad kyang yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan so sor snang bar gyur to/ /lha'i 'khor gang yin pa de rnams thams cad kyang 'od 'bar ba'i ting nge 'dzin so sor thob bo / /gnod sbyin dang srin po gang yin pa de rnams thams cad rin po che'i gzhal med khang du gnas par gyur to/ /'byung po'i 'khor gang yin pa de rnams thams cad gzi brjid dri ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin so sor thob par gyur to / /lha ma yin gyi 'khor gang yin pa de rnams thams cad rdo rje'i go cha dang rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi ya lad bgos par 'gyur te ri/ nam mkha' lding gi 'khor gang yin pa thams cad 8rdo rje mchu rtse mo chen po'i 9stobs kyi shugs rjes su thob par gyur to/ /mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po'i 'khor gang yin pa thams cad kyang lus dang ngag dang yid yongs su dag par gyur to/ /dge bsnyen dang /92—436

dge bsnyen ma dang / bud med dang / skyes pa dang / khye'u dang / bu mo gang yin pa de rnams thams cad skye ba dang / rga ba dang / 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal las yongs su grol bar gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang sku las nyi ma'i tog ces bya ba'i 'od zer chen po rnam par spros te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi thugs kur 1)rjes su zhugs so/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi thugs kur 2zhugs ma thag tu gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /lag na rdo rje don yod zhags pa'i pad+ma gtsug tor gyi gsang ba'i rnam par 'phrul pa la ltos shig /lag na rdo rjes gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gis mthong lags so/ /sems dpa' dag pa bdag gis mthong lags so//sems dpa' chen po dag pa 'di'i rnam par 'phrul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa 3pad+ma'i dbang phyug don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po pad+ma gtsug tor gyi gsang ba'i snying po'i dkyil 'khor shin tu zab pa/ shin tu rgya che ba/ rmad du byung ba chen po dngos grub mchog sgrub par byed pa ni bcom ldan 'das mtha' dag rgyas par gsungs shig /gsang sngags rim par phye ba dang / rig sngags dang /dkyil 'khor rmad du byung ba nye bar spyod pa'i cho ga dang bcas pa ni sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa rnam par 'joms pa'i don dang / rig sngags 'chang rnams kyi mchog 'grub pa'i don du de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan sngar gsungs shig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /lag na rdo rje don yod zhags pa'i snying po 4mchog tu gsang ba 92—437

gtsug tor thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor sems can thams cad kyi don gyi ched du sdig pa thams cad nyams par byed pa/ sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sbyong bar byed pa/ dri ma dang / rnyog ma thams cad sel bar byed pa/ nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa/ bkra mi shis pa thams cad zlog nya)par byed pa/ sdig pa dang / ma rungs pa'i sems can phyir rgol ba dang / dgra'i 'jigs pa rab tu zhi bar byed pa/ bgegs dang / log par 'dren pa thams cad tshar gcod par byed pa/ bdud la sogs pa'i ma rungs pa thams cad 'joms par byed pa dug dang / mtshon cha dang / me dang / chu'i 'jigs pa dang / mche ba'i dug dang / seng ge dang / rgyal po dang / gnod sbyin rnams zlog tsho par byed pa/ dug dang / byad stems dang / g.yeng byed dang / phye yinasama'i sbyor ba thams cad rnam par nyams par byed pa/ don yod zhags pa'i snying po de kho na nyid gces pa rmad du byung ba de kho na nyid kyi snying po'i sgrub pa bla na med pa bklags pas grub pa ca'adi rjes su zung shig55 /de nas gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje bzhin 'dzum cing / gdong khro gnyer dang bral bas rdo rje bskor bar byed bzhin du/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bcom ldan 'das don yod pa'i 6zhags pa'i snying po dam par gyur pa gsang ba pad+ma gtsug tor gyi dkyil 'khor de rnams du zhig lags / de dag bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs shig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po ri48)lag na rdo rjes 9gsol ba btab par rig nas/ phyag g.yas pas lte ba'i pad+ma'i phyag rgya'i 92—438

rnam pa la reg go/ /reg ma thag tu phyag g.yas pa'i pad+ma la/ snying po'i 1rig sngags de yang pad+ma'i steng du (5ste/ rang gi ngo bo gzhal med khang tshangs pa'i cha byad 'chang ba don yod pa'i gzugs spyan gsum pa/ phyag bzhi pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis rmo rirnam par brgyan pa/ nor bu gser gyi cod pan can/ 'od dpag med kyi cod pan gyis brgyan pa/ ral pa'i cod pan pad+ma'i gtsug tor gyis spud (4pa/ zla ba phyed pas rnam par mdzes pa/ zhags pa 'chang ba/pad+ma'i gtsug tor 'chang ba dang / nor bu'i dbyug 5pa 'chang ba dang / rdo rje'i dbyug pa 'chang ba/ skyil mo 6klung gis bzhugs pa/ 'od zer 'bar bas yang dag par brgyan 7pa/ gos rnam par bkra ba sna tshogs dang / spyan 8nyi ma dang zla bas lhag par 'bar bas rnam par mdzes pa/ pad+ma rnams kyi steng na mdzes bzhin pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad thugs mnyes par byed pa/byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis 9phyag bya bar 'os pa/ lha thams cad kyis mchod par 'os pa/ klu thams cad kyis rjes su gzung bar 'os pa/ drang srong thams cad kyis dga' bar 'os pa/ lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po thams cad kyis rjes su 'gro bar 'os pa / sems can thams cad kyi bla mar 'os pa mthong ste/ de lta bu'i snang ba rgya chen po byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis/ de kho na nyid gces pa'i snying por gyur pa'i 1 snying po nye bar bstan to/lha/ /de nas gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rjes/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor chen po de mthong ba tsam gyi mod la/ snying po gsang ba/ don yod pa'i pad+ma dri ma med pa'i gtsug tor 'od zer 'bar ba'i ting nge 'dzin so 92—439

sor thob par gyur to/ /ting nge 'dzin so sor thob pa gang gis sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi nang du chud par gyur to/ /de rnams thams cad rab tu mgu ba'i yid kyis zhabs dag gi rjes la phyag 'tshal bar gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis/don yod zhags pa'i snying po'i gsang sngags 'di smras so/ /oṃ a mo gha pā sha hro nya1)da ya parlosnri ṣa ku mā ra be 2ga dha ra/ pad+me shwa ra/ ā be sha ya/ sarba a mo gha ku la sa ma ya hro da ya/ sarba sirnyi a mo gha pra yats+tsha pad+ma/ pad+ma hūm̐ hūm̐ na mastu girite swā hā/ 'di ni don yod zhags pa'i snying po bklags pas grub pa'i sgrub thabs so/ /oṃ a mo gha parlosnri ṣe shwa ra/ pad+me shwa ra/ sa man+ta 5ya sarba ta thā ga tā 64/ a mo gha parlosnri ṣa sa ma ya )ā kur+sha ya/ pra be sha ya/ sarba kurma sidhisme napra yats+tsha 9a ba lo ki 1 te shwa ra hūṃ hūṃ/ ma hā parlosnri ṣa bhu dze swā hā/rigs kyi rgyal po'i gsang sngags so/ /oṃ ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa 11pad+me shwa ra bi 1 bi dha rū pa/bi ka ṭa/ pad+ma rda ṣ+ṭa 1 ka rā 1 la dhī ṣa ṇa/ bāk+ta 15sarba duṣ+ṭa hre da yaṃ/ khā da ya/ bi gha 816/ pad+ma sgri ku1 /tsi ṭi/ dri 1 ṭi hūṃ swā 16hā/ khro bo'i rgyal po'i rigs kyi snying po'o/ /nang gi dkyil 'khor 2 gsang ba'i las rnams so/ /o a mo gha parlosnri ṣa pad+ma pā sha gro dha ka /ma 31ya kurma pra be sha ya ma hā pā shu pa ti na/ya ma/ ba ru ṇa/ ku be ra/ brah+ma be ṣa dha ra/ ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa 2 be ga /a mo gha ku la sa ma ya/ pad+me hūṃ hūṃ/ khro bo'i rgyal po don yod zhags pa'i pad+ma gtsug tor gyi snying po'o/ /de nas don yod pa'i snying po'i las rnams 'gyur te/dran pa tsam gyi mod la/ dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang mnyam pas gcig tu mtshungs par 'gyur ro/ /tshe dpag med dang mnyam pa'i 92wa 440

lus su 'gyur ro/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad dang / mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang mtshungs shing mnyam pa nyid du 'gyur ro / /mtshungs shing mnyam pa nyid kyis 17de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyam pa nyid du mthong ngo / /pad+ma'i phyag gi ting nge 'dzin rnams dang / pad+ma'i gtsug tor gyi phyag gis 'jig rten dbang phyug dang mnyam pa nyid du 'gyur ro/ /pad+ma'i gtsug tor bcings pa nyid kyis spyi bo'i gtsug tu mngon par dbang bskur na / dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mngon par dbang bskur ro/ /pad+ma'i gtsug tor gyis don yod par dbang bskur ba gang yin pa de / pad+ma gtsug tor gyi snying po rgyas par gyur pa thob ste/ ting nge 'dzin brgya stong phrag dang / bla na med pa'i dpal thob 2bo/ /rigs kyi rgyal po'i gsang sngags rgyas par gyur pa pad+ma gtsug tor gyi dkyil 'khor du rigs kyi rgyal po legs par grub par 'gyur te/ thams cad du rigs kyi rgyal po'i dngos grub bzang po rnams ri sku'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi rgyal po'i gsang sngags kyi rgyal po dang / rig sngags kyi rgyal po mchog gi dngos grub thams cad rab tu sbyin par byed do/ /pad+mo'i 5phyag gis rjes su 'jug cing / don yod pa'i rigs kyi dngos grub ji lta ba bzhin du 'grub ste/ bklags pas grub pa 'di la the tshom med do/ /pad+ma gtsug tor gyi rigs kyi dngos grub dang / pad+ma yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor ram/ don yod zhags pa'i dkyil 'khor du bklags nas bzlas pa tsam gyis 'grub ste/ rigs kyi rgyal po dang / rig sngags kyi rgyal po gang yin pa de thams cad du dbang phyug tu 'gyur ro/ /dkyil 'khor rnams kyi cho ga zhib mo dang / phyag rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi rigs thun mong 92wa 441

ba thams cad du rgyal po'i bya ba byed par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong phrag rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing brgya phrag rnams dang / gang gā'i klung gi bye ma dang mnyam pa'i zhing du rgyal por 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi rig pas lha'i dbang phyug dang / lha'i tshogs rnams kyi dbang phyug tu 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu yang gnod sbyin rnams dang / srin po rnams su gyur pa dang / dri za rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / srin po rnams kyi de bzhin nyid du thams cad du rgyal po dang / dbang phyug tu rtag tu 'gyur te the tshom med do/ /nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams dang /thams cad du ji srid byang chub la yang dag par gnas kyi bar du rigs kyi rgyal por 'gyur ro/ /de nas khro bo'i rgyal po dran pa tsam dang drag po de yid la sems pa tsam gyi mod la/ 'phral du ri rab ltung bar byed cing / khor yug gi ri rnam par 'thor bar byed do/ /rgya mtsho chen po kun nas dkrug cing / rgya mtsho chen po nye bar skye bar byed do/ /kun du gsal bar byed do/ /klu'i gnas thams cad du klu'i gnas 'bar bar yang byed do/ /bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad kyi skad cig tsam gyis steng du bdug (15par byed do/ /gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / 'byung po dang / gza' dang / brjed byed dang / mi bzad pa de rnams thams cad khro bo'i rgyal po dran pa tsam gyis 'jigs par 'gyur ro/ /khro bo'i rgyal po'i gsang ba pa thams cad kyi rigs kyi dam tshig la gnas pa dang / dkyil 'khor du phyag rgya gnas pa dang / gsang sngags kyi lha gzhan gang yin pa rnams kyis khro bo'i rgyal po dran pa tsam gyis de rnams thams cad rig sngags 'chang la skyabs su 'gro bar byed do/ /de rnams 92—442
