thams cad rjes su 'brang bar 'gyur zhing gnas par byed do/ /'ga' zhig gang du 'gro ba'am 'dug pa de la dbang po dang / skabs gsum pa'i lha dang /tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / gshin rje dang / chu lha dang / klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho dang / dga' bo dang / nye dga' bo dang / gzhon nu dang / sde dpon dang / de bzhin du rgyal po chen po bzhi dus rtag tu rig sngags 'chang gi rjes su 'brang bar byed do/ /the tshom med do/ /khros pa'i las rnams sam/ de bzhin du drag po'i las rnams thams cad kyang hūṃ yig tsam gyis de la dngos grub mthong ngo / /phyir rgol ba dang / dgra dang /sems can ma rungs pa shin tu mi bzad 1pa rnams dang / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs dang 'jigs pa dang / rnam par 'gras pa'i skye bo dang / sdig pa de rnams thams cad hūṃ yig gis mchog tu gzir ba tsam gyis thal bar 'jig par 'gyur ro/ /sdang ba dang / ngan sems pa'i sems can dang / byas pa mi gzo (2ba dang / byas pa la 'khon pa thams cad drag po'i hūṃ yig bzlas pa tsam gyis skad cig la bsreg ste / dper na me yis phye ma leb bzhin no/ /las gzhan stong phrag rnams dang / las brgya stong phrag nyid bzlas pa tsam gyis 5'grub ste/ dran pa tsam gyi mod la/ las thams cad 'grub bo/ /de nas don yod pa pad+ma'i gtsug tor dran pa tsam gyis/ bya ba thams cad ni gnyis su 'gyur te/ ji ltar gang cung zad yid la 6byed pas las byed do/ /dkyil 'khor ram/ gnas rnam pa gzhan thams cad du/ ji ltar yid la byed pa'i bya ba thams cad du byed do// //778'phags pa don yod pa'i zhags pa'i cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po/ bam po bcwa 992—443

lnga pa/ de nas gsang sngags la 'jug pa rnams kyi dgos (1)pa thams cad so sor 'grub par 'gyur ba ni/ oṃ zhes bya ba don yod pa'i zhags pa pad+ma gtsug tor nagyi dkyil 'khor thams cad du gsang sngags yi ge gcig pa'o/ /'jig rten mgon po'i spyan sngar 'bum dran par byas na sa dang po la gnas par 'gyur ro / /sngon gyi sdig pa bsags pa sems can dmyal ba mi bzad 5༄pa gang ci yang rung ba 4 de dag thams cad ji ltar rlung gis phyag dar gtor ba bzhin 'jig 55)par 'gyur/ dngos grub thams cad thob par 'gyur ro/ /don thams cad rjes su 'jug par 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / gang dkyil 'khor gyi lha gzhan dag kyang dgyes par 'gyur la/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug rtag tu mchog sbyin pa mdzad do/ /gsang sngags oṃ zhes bya ba dran nas tshe 'phos pa ni 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du 'gro bar 'gyur ro / /gsang sngags kyi yi ge gcig pa'o/ /oṃ bhu yi ge gnyis pa 'bum bzlas brjod byas na sa gnyis pa 'thob 6par 'gyur ri/ de bzhin gshegs pa snang ba mtha' yas kyi spyan sngar 'dug par 'gyur zhing mchog thams cad rjes su sbyin par mdzadan/ sdig pa thams cad kyang rnam par dag par mdzad/ sngon 9gyi nad kyang 1 sos par 'gyur/ nor gyi dbang phyug nor bu bzang po'i bu dbang dugyur zhing nye bar gnas par 'gyur ro/ /mi gang gis kyang phyir zhing bar chad byed nus par mi 'gyur/ tshe 'phos nas ri gru 'dzin du skye bar 'gyur/ don yod pa'i zhags pa'i 11dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ pad+me 12gsang sngags kyi yi ge gsum pa 'bum bzlas 1 brjod byas na sa gsum pa la yang dag par 'jug par 'gyur/ pad+ma yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyag rgya dang /92wa 444

gsang (1)sngags gang yin pa thams cad la zhugs par 'gyur/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gzhon nu'i cha byad can mdun na bzhus par 'gyur zhing 'dod pa thams cad kyi mchog rjes su sbyin par mdzad/ don yod pa'i zhags pa'i rinasapad+ma gtsug tor gyi nadakyil 'khor ston par mdzad/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor rnams ston par mdzad/thams cad du canodangos grub rjes su sbyin par mdzad do/ /oṃ pad+ma hrīr/ gsang sngags yi ge bzhi pa 'bum bzlas brjod byas na sa bzhi pa la 'jug par 'gyur/'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs pa'i sku mdog gser gyi kha dog can mdun na bzhugs shing dpung pa brkyang nas phyag spyi bor 'jog par mdzad la/rig sngags 'chang ba la 6legs so zhes bya ba rjes su sbyin par mdzad de/ rig 7sngags 'chang tshur shog /khyod kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad yongs su dag ste / rang gi ngo bo thams cad shin tu dri ma med par 8yongs su dag go/ /mi'i 'jig rten 'di nas tshe 'phos nas nga'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'ong zhing tshe rabs dran par 'gyur/ phyir zhing nam yang mngal na gnas pas gos par mi 'gyur/'jig rten pa'i 9dgos pa thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ pad+ma bhu dze/gsang sngags yi ge lnga pa 'bum bzlas 1 brjod byas na sa lnga pa la gnas par 'gyur11 / de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas pad+ma'i bla ma rab tu ston par 1 mdzad/ sgrib pa thams cad yongs su zad par 'gyur/ rig sngags 'chang la legs so zhes bya ba'i sgra 'byin par 'gyur te/rig sngags 'chang legs so legs 12so/ /khyod la bsod nams kyi phung po chen po skyes te/ rig sngags 'chang khyod dge ba'i rtsa ba chen po bskyed pas rig 92—445

sngags 'chang khyod tshe brjes (1non de bzhin gshegs pa bye ba khrag khrig dgu bcu (gertsa gnyis kyi drung du dge ba'i rtsa ba mtshungs par bskyed par 'gyur zhing nga'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing du skye bar 'gyur/ khyod kyis don yod pa'i zhags pa pad+ma (5)gtsug tor gyi snying po dang / gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / phyag rgya chen po rim par phye ba grub cing rig sngags 'chang khyod sgrib pa dang sdig pa thams cad spangs kyis 4bya ba thams cad gyis shig /yid la bya ba'i sgrub pa thams cad ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin de dag thams cad shin tu grub (5)par 'gyur ro/dzi/ /oṃ pad+ma a ba 7lo ki te/ gzungs sngags yi ge 58)drug pa 'bum bzlas tho)brjod byas na sa drug pa 'thob 1 ste 'jug par 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad snang ba 11mdzad par 'gyur/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul phra mo snyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams gzigs shing mngon sum du ston pa mdzad/dbugs 'byin par mdzad do/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas pad+ma gzigs pa'i rgyal mtshan rig sngags 'chang de la yang dag par dbugs 'byin par mdzad do/ /rig sngags 'chang nga'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas 12byang chub kyi sna snying po'i mthar thug gi bar du tshur shog /las byas pa ni 3 shin tu yongs su zad cing khyod kyis sems can dmyal ba'i sgo rnams bcad/ khyod kyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi sgo rnams ni phye/khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sa bon dang / rigs kyi spyi ni khong du chud/ khyod kyis don yod pa'i zhags pa pad+ma gtsug tor 'gyi snying po dang /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor ni grub/ khyod kyis thams cad du gnas kyi sgo rnams ni 92wa 446

phye bas 'jig rten dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i las sgrub pa 517rnams ji ltar yid la byas pa bzhin las thams cad byos shig /oṃ pad+ma dz+wa (5la hūm̐ lhaka( /yi ge bdun pa 'bum bzlas brjod byas ma thag tu ting nge ( 'dzin pad+ma dri ma med pa sgrib pa dang bral ba dag pa zhes bya ba thob par 'gyur la/ ting nge 'dzin gang thob pas lus shin tu 'bar bar 'gyur zhing 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs su 'gyur/sa bdun pa la gnas par 'gyur/ lus kyi snang ba gang gis 5stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi gnas rnams snang bar byed cing / gang dang gang du 'od zer rin po che 'bar ba sna tshogs dag 'bab pa las me tog gi char sna tshogs pa rnams 'byung bar 'gyur la/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dri ma med pa'i pad+ma rine'od zer 'bar ba gser gyi mdog can dpung pa brkyang ste/ phyag g.yas pas 7rig sngags 'chang gi spyi bor 'jog cing legs so zhes bya ba yang sbyin la dbugs 'byin (3)par mdzad de/ rig sngags 'chang legs so legs so/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi snying po gsang ba bzlas brjod kyi cho ga mchod pa'i mchog yin no/ /'di ni 'phags pa /spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi snying po gsang ba gces 9pa'i dkyil 'khor don yod pa'i zhags pa pad+ma gtsug tor gyi snying po yang dag pa'o/ /rig sngags 'chang khyod kyis dkyil 'khor mtha' dag rdzogs pa dang / pad+ma gtsug tor gyi snying po cho ga zhib mo dang / don yod pa'i zhags pa rnam par sprul 11pa grub kyis 12rig sngags 'chang nga'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing du song la sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa gyis shig /oṃ a mo gha ma ṇi 1 pad+me/92—447

gzungs sngags kyi snying po yi ge 1 brgyad pa 'bum bzlas gebarjod byas na lus shin tu yongs su dag cing dri ma med par 'gyur/ bzlas brjod byas pa tsam gyis nor bu rin po che chen po shel ltar phyi nang shin tu yongs su dag ste/ de ltar rig sngags 'chang gi lus yongs su dag par 'gyur/ sa brgyad pa la gnas par 'gyur / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug rang gi lus yongs su dag pa rang gi gzugs kyi ngo bo ston cing / rig sngags 'chang gi mdun na gnas la rig sngags 'chang yang dag par dbugs 'byin par mdzad de/ phyag g.yas pa mgo'i spyi bor riga'ajog par mdzad / legs so zhes bya ba'ang 455sbyin par mdzad de/ rig sngags 'chang legs so legs so/ /rig sngags 'chang khyod lhag pa'i bsam (6)pa dam pa dga' ba la zhugs so/ /rig sngags 'chang sangs rgyas kyi zhing mnyam par 'brel ba'i 'jig rten rnam par blta 7bar tshur nashog /der khyod kyis sangs 9rgyas kyi mdzad pa byed par 'gyur ro/ /khyod kyis don yod pa'i zhags pa pad+ma gtsug tor gyi snying po dkyil 'khor gsang ba grub kyis 1 tsho'ajig rten dang 'jig rten 11las 'das pa'i sgrub pa dam pa bya ba thams cad gyis shig /oṃ pad+ma lo tsa ni 1 hu ru lhu15/ gzungs 1 sngags kyi snying po yi ge dgu po 15'bum bzlas glubarjod byas na sa dgu pa la gnas par 'gyur17/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sras kyi gtso 1 bor 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig dgu bcu rtsa dgu dag rig sngags 'chang la mngon sum du ston cing / sangs rgyas kyi yul rnam par sprul 19pa sna tshogs ston par mdzad/ rig sngags 'chang gi spyi bor 2 thams cad kyi 21phyag 'jog par 92—448

mdzad / legs so zhes bya ba yang sbyin par mdzad de/ rig sngags 'chang chen po legs so legs so/ /khyod kyis 1nga la zhing sbyang ldeba'i las legs par bsgrub pa byas so/ /khyod kyis 'jig rten pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa sangs rgyas nyid du sgrub pa ste/ don yod pa'i zhags pa'i dkyil 'khor cho ga zhib mo sgrub pa dang mdo sde lung bcas pa sgrub pa 'jig rten gyi 'dren pas bstan 4pa gang yin pa de dag thams cad grub pa yin no/ /oṃ parlosnri 5ga dzibi ma le hūm̐ phaṭa/gsang sngags kyi snying po yi ge bcu pa 'bum bzlas brjod byas na phyir mi ldog pa nyid du gyur nas sa 7bcu pa 8la gnas par 'gyur zhing / lha dang mi'i skye dgu 9dag 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'o zhes brjod la bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur/ don yod pa'i pad+ma gtsug tor gyi 'khor los sgyur bar 'gyur 1 te the tshom 11mi bya'o/ /gsang sngags bcu pa'i sgrub pa de kho na nyid kyi dngos grub bla na med pa 'di ni don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po rnam par sprul pa bzlas 1 brjod tsam gyis 'grub pa yin te/ bdag gis sngar bstan 1 pa thams cad la lhag 1 par zhen pa/ gtsang ma/ gtsang sbra spyod pa/ gos gtsang ma bgos pa/ byams pa'i sems dang snying rje skyes pa/bden pa 7smra ba/ bla ma la gus pa/ dkon mchog gsum la dad pa che ba bla ma dang slob dpon la rtag tu mchod pa byed pa 'di ni bzlas tshibarjod kyi cho ga yin te / sangs rgyas kyi byang chub bla na med par bstan 1 to/ /de nas gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po 18lag na rdo rje byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la rab tu 'dzum la lag na rdo rje skor 19bzhin du mgo btud nas smras pa/ sems dpa' chen po gzungs kyi gsang 92—449

sngags kyi gzhi don yod pa'i zhags pa pad+ma gtsug tor gyi (1)dkyil 'khor gyi snying po gsang ba chen po rgyal po 2'di ni shin tu rnyed par dka' ste/ gzungs sngags kyi snying po re re po 'di dag ni bzlas brjod tsam gyis sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa byed par 'gyur na/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gang ches ngal zhing dub par bzlas cabarjod bsgrub pa dang / cho ga rgyas par bsgrub pa lta smos kyang ci dgos / nyin zhag gcig bsnyen 5gnas la gnas shing zas bslangs 6pa dang /'bras bu dang / ldum bu dang / rtsa ba bza' ba zos nas rig sngags 'di bsgrubs na spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug de'i dngos grub ji lta bu zhig 'byung bar 'gyur/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis smras pa/ lag na rdo rje nyin zhag gcig smyung 7ba la gnas shing nyin zhag gcig tsam 8ribazlas brjod byas pa tsam gyis 'bras bu 'grub 9 par 'gyur ba ni lag na rdo rje nyu )rigs kyi bu'am/rigs kyi bu mo'am/ dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen skyanam/dge bsnyen lhanama'am/ gzhan yang dge sbyong mgo bregs pa/ rigs kyi gtso bo bram ze'am/ rgyal rigs sam/ skyes pa'am/ bud med dam/ khye'u'am/bu mo'am/ rje'u rigs sam/ dmangs kyi rigs gang la la skad cig thang cig (geyud tsam mam15/ dus tshigs tshagacig gam/ dus cirdogs gnyis sam/ dus tshigs gsum yongs su rdzogs par 1 gzhan mi smra bar don yod pa'i zhags pa pad+ma gtsug tor gyi snying po khro bo'i rigs kyi gsang sngags rim par phye ba gzungs /shesngags chen po'i snying po bcu 19po 'di 2 tsholan cig 21dran nam/ klog gam/ ming gzung ba'ang 22dran nam/ lag na rdo rje dus tshigs gcig tu dran pa tsam gyis kyang de'i mtshams med pa byed pa mnar med par gzhol ba/ bskal ri snyepar 92wa 450

gnas pa yang de yis 91)thams cad rnam par dag par 'gyur la/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa bsags pa rnams zad par 'gyur/ lus yongs su dag cing dri ma med par 'gyur/ sgrib pa dang sdig pa dang bral bar 'gyur/ tshe 2'phos nas 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du pad+ma dag las rdzus te skye bar 'gyur/ tshe rabs su tshe rabs dran par 'gyur/ nams kyang cangan 'gror 'gro bar mi 'gyur / bskal 5pa bye ba 'bum phrag brgyad cur 'khor los sgyur 6ba mchog tu 'gyur / bskal 7 pa bye ba 'bum phrag brgyad cur 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du bde ba myong bar 'gyur/ bskal 8pa 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa gnyis su 'jig rten gyi khams mngon par dga' bar 9bde ba myong bar 'gyur/ bskal pa 'bum phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis su 'jig rten gyi khams 'jig rten rnam par gzigs par skye bar 'gyur/ tshe rabs su tshe rabs dran par 'gyur/ bskal 1 pa 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa gnyis su nor bu 'chang 11ba'i 'khor los sgyur 12bar 'gyur / bskal 1 pa khri phrag 1 brgyad cur 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gnas ri gru 'dzin du bde ba myong bar 'gyur/ bskal 15pa stong phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgur 'og min gyi lha rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur/ bskal lapa 'bum phrag brgyad 1 cur dga' ldan gyi lha rnams kyi nang du bde ba myong 1 bar 'gyur / bskal tsho pa 'bum phrag sum cu rtsa gsum gyi nang du brgya byin nyid byed par 'gyur/ bskal 1pa 'bum phrag lnga bcu rtsa gnyis su phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams na su 'jug par 'gyur/ bskal pa stong phrag nyi shur 'khor los sgyur sa ba'i rgyal srid la spyod par 'gyur te nams kyang 25ma'i 27mngal du skye bar mi 'gyur zhing gang dang gang du skye bar 'gyur ba thams cad du rdzus 2 te skye 92wa 451

bar 'gyur/ thams cad du tshe rabs dran par 'gyur te/ lag na rdo rje de ltar rig sngags lan cig 1dran pa tsam gyis dge ba'i rtsa ba bsod nams kyi phung po chen po dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /lag na rdo rje gal te gang zhig zhag gcig gam / lan cig smyung 2ba la gnas te bzlas brjod dang bcas pa byas na lag na rdo rje de ni tshe 'di nyid la mi bdag nyid kyi ngo bo nyid sgrib pa dang bral nas don yod pa chen po dri ma med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin 'thob 4bo/ /don yod pa bkod pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'thob 5bo/ /pad+ma gsal ba rnam par 'phrul pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'thob bo/ /don yod pa'i 'dri ma med par 7snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 8'dzin 'thob 9bo/ /don yod pa rnam par gzigs pa'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin 'thob bo/ /pad+ma gtsug tor mthar phyin pa'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin 'thob 1 bo/ /don yod pa 'bar ba'i gtsug tor gyi snying po gsang ba grub 11pa 'thob bo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bye ba khrag khrig dgu bcu 1 rtsa gnyis dang / de bzhin gshegs pa gang gā'i /lhaklung gi bye ma snyed la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed 7par 'gyur/ bsod nams kyi phung po chen po dang ldan par 'gyur/ tshe brjes 15nas 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du pad+ma dag las rdzus 7te skye bar 'gyur ro17/ /'di ni don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po cho ga zhib mo dang / don yod pa pad+ma gtsug tor gyi cho ga mtha' dag rdzogs pa dang / phyag rgya dang bcas pa cho ga zhib mo 1 mtha' dag 19rdzogs par kha ton du lobs par 'gyur zhing / don yod pa'i rig sngags 'chang 'khor los sgyur bar 'gyur ro/ /don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po pad+ma gtsug tor 21gyi dkyil 'khor gyi snying po gsang sngags grub da pa'i cho ga ste/ sgrub 2 pa'i 92—452

cho ga gnyis pa'o// //de nas gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rjes byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bcom ldan 'das don yod pa pad+ma gtsug tor gyi dkyil 'khor don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po 1bya ba'i cho ga dang sgrub 2pa'i cho ga dang dbacas pa bshad par gsol/ bcom ldan 'das rig sngags 'chang kun gyis 'grub 4pa/bsam pa yongs su rdzogs pa/ dngos grub sgrub 5pa'i cho ga de kho na bshad du gsol / de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /lag na rdo rje bya ba'i cho ga dang sgrub pa'i cho ga bshad par bya yis 96 nyon cig /lag na rdo rje gsang sngags rtsa ba don yod pa'i zhags pa pad+ma gtsug tor gyi snying po gsang ba 7'di'i rig sngags 'chang rigs kyi bu'am/rigs kyi bu mo'am/ dge slong ngaman/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen smyonam/dge bsnyen 1 ma lan cig 1 tsam dran pa yid la byed pa yongs su dag pa'i bdag nyid snying rje chen po dang / byams pa dang ldan pa'i lhag pa'i bsam pas 12sems can la dmigs pa'i sems can gang yang rung ba 1dngan song gsum du skye bar mi 'gyur te/ sems can dmyal ba'am/ dud 'gro'i skye khoganas sam/yi dgas kyi yul rnams kyi gnas de dag med de/ de ltar sems can thams cad sgrub pa dge ba'i rtsa ba chen po dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /lan gnyis brjod pa tsam gyis nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /lan gsum brjod pa 92—453

tsam gyis 1 dug dang / 'brum bu dang / 'bras dang / lhog pa dang / rkang shu dang / mdze dang / g.yan 2pa la sogs pa thams cad 'jig (5)par 'gyur ro / /lan bzhi brjod pa tsam gyis dbyig dug dang / byad thams cad sel bar 'gyur ro/ /lan lnga brjod pa tsam gyis 'thab pa dang / 'thab tshogemo dang /rtsod pa dang / 'gyed pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /lan drug brjod pa tsam gyis 'jigs 5pa dang / gdon dang / rims thams cad 'jig par 'gyur ro/ /lan bdun brjod pa tsam gyis dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 6'jigs pa thams cad dang / sems can thams cad kyi nad dang /yams kyi nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /lag na rdo rje de lta bas na sems can thams cad kyi don du nyin re zhing gzhan mi smra bar lan bdun dran par bya'o/ /sems can gang la la sems can dmyal bar gzhol ba shi ba dang /dge slong gang la la bslab pa'i sdom pa dang / tshul khrims kyi sdom pa ral ba dang / mkhan po dang / slob dpon la gus par ma byas pa shi ba de'i don du bye ma gtsang ma blangs la lan bdun bzlas brjod byas na/ dur khrod dam/ ro bsregs pa'am7/ 'chad pa nader bye ma gtor bar bya'o/ /gang dang gang na sems can gang dag gi rus pa yod sar 9bye ma gtor ma thag tu de dang der bye ma bab pa'i sems can dmyal ba'am/ yi dgas sam/ sha zar skyes pa'am/gnod sbyin nam/ srin po'i skye gnas su skyes na de 7de'i mod la tshe brjes nyunyenas thams cad mtho ris su gzhol bar 'gyur zhing nams kyang 12sems can dmyal bar gzhol bar mi 'gyur ro/ /yang na gro ga la bris nas mchod rten gyi nang du bcug pa'i gnas der 1 rkang pa 7gnyis pa'am/ rkang pa mabazhi pa gang dag yinye 92—454

bar 'ongs pa (1)de dag thams cad grib ma phog pa tsam gyis sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad rnam par dag cing thams cad mtho ris su gzhol bar 'gyur ro/ /tha na ri dgas dang / bya dang / tha na ldang sko ska nadang / ne'u le dang /sdig pa dang / sbrul dang / khyi dang / rus nasbal dang / lag 'gro dang /dkyil 'khor de la grib ma bab 4pa tsam gyis thams cad kyi las kyi ri sgrib pa rnams (6rnam par dag par 'gyur zhing de dag thams cad mtho ris kyi 'jig rten du gzhol bar 'gyur ro/ /dung la lan bdun bzlas brjod 7byas nas gnas mthon por bus na sems can gang dag dung de'i sgra thos pa skyes pa dang / bud med dang / khye'u dang / bu mo dang / ri dgas dang / bya dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas su gtogs pa de dag thams cad mtho ris kyi 'jig rten du gzhol bar 'gyur ro/ /gang dag tshul khrims yongs su dag pa dang / sems can gang dag sbyin pa la dga' ba dang / gang dag bsnyen gnas la nye bar gnas pa dang / gang dag skyabs gsum bzung 8ba dang / gang dag byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pas bsdams pa de dag kyang dung gi sgra thos nas 9sems can de dag thams cad phyir mi ldog par 'gyur zhing bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'thob par 'gyur la/ tshe brjes 1 nas 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur te11/ tshe rabs su 12tshe rabs dran par 'gyur ro/ /tsan+dan la lan bdun bzlas 1 brjod byas nas 1 dge 'dun gyi kun dga' ra ba'am/ mchod rten gyi 15'khor sa'am/ dge 'dun gyi nang ngam/skye bo mang po'i nang ngam/ rgyal po'i pho brang du bdugs na gang dag der dri mnams 9pa'i sems can de dag thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sku yongs su rdzogs 92wa 455

par 'gyur ro/ /chos gos la bdugs 1rinas gang gi (2)lus la gyon pa de'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad rnam par 'jig par 'gyur ro/ /lus la bab pa tsam gyis dri ma dang / ser sna dang / skyon thams cad spangs par 'gyur ro/ /gos bcangs pa tsam 3gyis 'jig rten thams cad dbang du 'gyur ro/ /bdag nyid kyis gos de bdugs canas rgyal po'i pho brang du zhugs na rgyal po btsun mo dang / 'khor dang bcas pa dbang du 'gyur/ mchod gnas chen por 'gyur/'jig rten thams cad kyi bla mar yang 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun gyi nang du zhugs na dge slong thams cad kyi mchod gnas chen por 'os par 'gyur ro / /skye bo mang po'i nang du zhugs na nor chen po 5'phel bar 'gyur zhing mchod pa chen po'i 'os su 'gyur ro/ /ri'i rtse mo ne nyi ma 'char ba'i khar bdugs nas gsang sngags rtsa ba lan bdun bzlas brjod byas na mod la nyi ma 'bab 7par 'gyur zhing 'dod pa mchog kun rjes su na sbyin par 95byed do/ /gu gul dang bsres nas lha chen po'i mdun du bdug par bya zhing gsang sngags rtsa ba lan bdun byab pa 11byas na 12mod nyid la lha chen po 'bab par 'gyur zhing rig sngags 'chang gi mdun du 'dug nas bsam pa thams cad yongs su skong byed do/ /bo la dang / tsan+dan dang / gu gul bsres 1lhanas sred med kyi bu'i mdun du bdug par bya zhing gsang sngags rtsa ba 1 lan nyi shu 1gegacig lus kyi yan lag la byab pa byas na sred med kyi bu rang gi gzugs kyis mdun na 'dug cing 'dod pa mchog kun rjes su sbyin 7par byed la/ dngos po sna tshogs kyang sbyin par byed do/ /yungs kur lha dang bsres 18nas tshangs pa la bdug cing kyirtegasang sngags rtsa ba lan bcu bzhi byab pa byas na/ tshangs pa rang gi 51gzugs 92wa 456

kyis mdun na 'dug la mchog thams cad 1sbyin par byed do/ /pad+ma'i phye ma dang bsres nas nag po chen po dang / ma mo'i tshogs la bdugs na nanag po chen po dang / ma mo'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rang gi gzugs kyis mdun na 'dug cing mchog dang / bya ba sgrub pa thams cad sbyin par byed do/ /nā 3ga put+pa dang / sbrul gyi shun pa dang / bsres 4)pa'i bdug pa klu'i mtshor bdug 5cing gsang sngags rtsa ba lan bdun yungs kur 6la bzlas brjod byas nas 7klu'i mtshor gtor la/ don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po'i mdo lan cig 8brjod cing dran par byas na klu dang / klu mo dang / klu'i bu pho dang / klu'i bu mo thams cad gnas kun nas byung nas rig sngags 'chang gi rkang pa gnyis la 'dud cing gang bsgo 59ba de dag thams cad byed la 'dod pa thams cad sbyin zhing 1 )dbang du 'gyur ro/ /lan gsum sbyar 11na klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho'ang 1 'ong ngo / /klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang / nye dga' bo yang 'ong zhing thams cad bsgo 15ba bzhin byed la dbang du gyur nas 'dug 1 go/ /gnod sbyin dang / srin po dgug par 'dod pas dur khrod kyi nang du mi ro bsregs 15pa'i sol bas bdugs 1 ‘la / gsang sngags rtsa ba gsang mthon pos lan bdun brjod cing dran 1 na gnod sbyin dang srin po dag rgyug cing 'ong la/ rig sngags 'chang gi rkang pa gnyis la btud nas rje btsun 1 bka' stsol cig 19ces zer ba dang / de'i tshe rig sngags 'chang gis de bsgo 2 ba ji lta ba bzhin du byas na bsgo 21ba thams cad byed la namangag pa'i las byed par 'gyur zhing da ji srid 'tsho'i bar du 'dug go//thod pa sbyar ba 2 la lan bdun bzlas 25brjod byas nas thod pa bkang ba'i bdug pa sa bdugs smon 'byung po thams cad kun nas 'ong zhing thams cad dbang du 92wa 457

'gyur la/ las byed par 'gyur ro/ /gnod sbyin mo dbab 4)par 'dod pas btsag gis gnod sbyin 2mo bris la/ ba lang gi lci ba'i dkyil 'khor byas par phyes pad+ma'i ri mo bri /zhing phye'i gtor ma pad+ma ci lta bur byas pa bzhag la bdug pa 'dis bdug cing / gsang sngags brgya 55)rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bya/ yungs kur nel lan 7 bdun bzlas 8brjod byas na tsaraganod sbyin mo la brdeg pa byas na gnod sbyin mo rang gi gzugs kyis mdun 7du 'dug cing / lha'i 'jig rten gyi bar du 'gro la slar yang 'ong ste/ don gsang ba zhumathams cad bsgo 12ba tsam gyis byed par 'gyur ro/ /yang na ma'am chung ma'am/ sring mo yin no zhes smra bar bya ste/ gal te mar byas na bu la sdug pa longs spyod dang / gzhal med khang thams cad kyi nang du 'jug la rgyal po'i bu bzhin yongs su skyong bar byed do/ /gal te sring mor byas na rnam thos la 'gran par 'gyur ro/ /gal te chung mar byas na sum cu rtsa gsum gyi bdag po sna ltar dga' ba'i longs spyod dag la rtser 'jug par byed do/ /lha mo dpal la bdugs skol gsang sngags rtsa ba lan bdun bzlas brjod bya zhing lha mo dpal gyi mgo la byugs na lha mo chen mo dpal rang gi gzugs kyis 15mdun na 'dug cing / nor gyi phung po chen po 8'bul bar byed de1 / nam 'tsho'i bar du khyim na 'dug cing nor chen po nyid 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /rnam thos kyi bu la bdugs na /shegaser srang stong sbyin par byed do / /nor bu bzang po'i bu la bdugs na gser gyi /smyodong tse rdu tshostong sbyin par byed do/ /tshal gseb tu bdugs na tshal na gnas pa'i lha rang gi gzugs kyis mdun na 'dug cing rdzas dang / sman thams cad rang gi gzugs kyis 21mdun na 'dug 22go/ /ri rnams 2 la bdugs na rtswa dang / shing gel pa dang /92—458

sman dang rdzas thams cad 'bar bar 'gyur ro/ /grong khyer bzhi'i sgo rnams su bdugs na grong khyer kun du yams kyi nad dang / gnod pa dang / nad 'go ba dang / nad thams cad dang / 'thab pa dang / 'thab 1mo dang / rtsod 2pa dang / 'gyed pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /'brog tu bdugs na rkun mo 5)dang / g.yon can dang / gnod byed dang / seng ge dang /stag dang / sbrul dang / dred dang / dom gyi 'jigs pa thams cad 'byung bar mi 'gyur zhing ri dgas gtum po'i 'jigs pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar 4'gyur ro/ /rims thams cad la bdugs na rims thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /sdig pa thams cad 'gegs 5pa tsan+dan gyi bdug pa bsgrub pa'i cho ga ste gsum pa'o// //de nas thig le yang dag par bshad par bya ste/ rigs kyi rgyal po'i gsang sngags bsgrubs (phyirapa ni nyi ma'i gzi brjid dang mtshungs shing skar ma'i rnam pa ltar 'bar ba yin te/ gzi brjid kyi rgyal po de gnyis kyis 'bar bar 'gyur ba ni bsod nams kyi phung po rnam par 7'phel lo/ /lha rnams kyi nang na lha'i 8dbang po dang / tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug chen po dang bcas pas rtag tu mchod pa'i gnas su 'gyur gyis 9rig sngags 'chang gis the tshom 1 mi bya'o / /dpral ba'i steng du thig le byed pa ni rtag tu mdzes pa yin te/ nyi ma ltar 'od zer gyi dra ba stong gis gsal shing shel ltar dag pa mdog dkar ba 11dri zhim pa dang / glang po che'i bya ba 12dang / dpral ba dang / ba lang gi gnas ltar skyon med cing mnyam par mthun ril shin tu dul ba/ ded dpon gcig 92wa 459

pu'i tsho1 nor bur na gyur cing dgasang sngags 'bum bzlas pas legs par bsgrubs (4ripa / gser dang / gos ltar kun du 'bar ba ni thig le yin no/ /smin mtshams kyi bar dpral ba na 5shin tu phra ba rtag tu rtag par mdzes pa ni zla ba nya ba mkha' la 'gro ba lta bu yin la/ skye bo'i dbus na gsal ba ni rgyu skar gyi rgyal po zla ba dbus na gnas pa bzhin rang gi 'khor gyi dbus na lha rnams kyi rgyal po dbang po 6brgya byin lta bu yin la/ skye bo'i dbus na ni 'jig rten gyi rgyal po gdugs 7rigacig pa ltar 'bar ba yin/ 'jig rten gyi nang na gdugs gcig pa bde bar gshegs pa ltar 8shin tu dul ba yin la/ shākya'i rigs kyi rgyud ( 9)ltar sems can thams cad la phan par 'dod pa de bzhin du nor bu mchog rnam par dag pa ni sems can thams cad la phan par 'dod pa yin no/ /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na ji ltar 'jig rten dbang phyug gcig 1 rīpu ltar mchog dang / rab mchog sems can thams cad kyi don du sbyin par byed de de ltar thig le nor bu'i mthu ni 'dod pa thams cad rab tu sbyin par byed do/ /lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang bcas pa dbang du 'gyur zhing sum cu rtsa gsum gyi bdag po 11dbang du 'gyur bar rjes su 'gro ba dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang /12 nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po 'dong bar 13gyur pa thams cad kyang dbang du 'gyur ba ni ngamakha' la skar ma ltar dpral bar rtag tu dbang du gyur pa yin te/ sems can thams cad kyi mgo bos rkang pa'i drung du rtag tu 'dud la me yis lomi 'tshig / chu yis sami 'khyer 1 zhing lus la dug dang / sbyar ba'i dug dang / phye ma'i dug dang /byad mi bzad pa dang / ngan sngags dang / sdang ba'i rnam pas mi tshugs par 92wa 460

'gyur ro(1ni/ /nor bu lta bu'i mthus de dag thams cad kyis mi tshugs par 'gyur ro/ /rims dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / nad dang / rlung dang /klad (snyend chen po la thig le byas pa lta bur mod la de dag thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur/ sems can btson (da du gzung caba'am/ chad pas bcad pa'am/bcing bar 'os pa la thig le lta bu byas pas de dag thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /smin mtshams dpral bar thig le lta bu byas na de'i mod la gnod sbyin stong dang srin po drag 5po'i gzugs can gdon brgya 6stong rnams lus la 'jug par mi 'gyur zhing / glang po che dang / ri dgas kyi bdag po'i khyu dang / chom rkun dang / shod kyi lam dang / ri'i lam dang / ri sul dang /ngam grog dang / glog dang / glang 7dang / sprul dang / sngang 'jigs kyi 'jigs pa thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /thig le lta bu'i mthus dgra'i sde stong snyed kyi nang na 'gyed 8pa las myur ba nyid du rgyal bar 'gyur/g.yul dang /'thab mo dang / tha snyad mod nyid la zhi bar 'gyur9/ de'i tshe nor bu gtsug gi spyi bor btags pa gang yin pa dang / thig le yang byas nas 'khor lo la byugs la pha rol gyi dmag tshogs g.yul gyi nang du zhugs na bdag nyid gcig pus dpung gi 1 tshogs yan lag bzhi pa las rgyal bar 'gyur/ 'dis thams cad du zhugs pa tsam gyis pham pa byas par 'gyur zhing phyogs bcur 'bros 11la thams cad 'jigs par 'gyur ro/ /thig le byas nas rgyal po'i pho brang du zhugs na rgyal po dang / btsun mo dang / 'khor dang bcas pa dbang du gyur nas nye bar 'khod do/ /ji srid 'tsho'i bar du 1 mchod gnas su 'gyur ro/ /dpung pa g.yas par nor bu btags la yan lag dang / yan 1 lag dag tu 92wa 461

thig le byas na thams cad du rgyal ba 'thob cing reg pa tsam gyis dbang du 'gyur la / don gang dang gang bsgrub nyupa de dang de thams cad 'thob par 'gyur ro/ / ril bu (bdag ni khar bcug nas/ /lhan cig 'dug la smras na ni/ /thams cad dbang du 'ong bar 'gyur/ /rgyal po dang ni btsun mo 'am/ /dge sbyong dang ni bram ze dang / /rgyal rigs dang ni dmangs 55)rigs nyid/ /skyes pa dang ni bud med dang / /khye'u dang bu mo ril rnams kyang rung / /de dag thams cad dbang du 'gyur5/ /kun du mngag pa'i las rnams byed/ / ril bu dunazos pa tsam gyis ni/ /nad rnams thams cad rnam par 'jig /gang gi nyin bzhi pa yi rims/ /gang dag khong skem metshond kyis nyams/ /gang zhig rtag 8pa'i rims kyis btab/ /gang du 'thab mo 'byung ba dang / /de bzhin skye bo sdang sems can/ /bdag la grib gnon gzhan grib gnon/ /skem byed skem pa brjed byed dang / /gang zhig gdon gzhan mi bzad ri9pa/ /sdig pa'i las ni kun du spyod/ /sngon gyi las ni mi zad ⑩pa/ /de kun skad cig tsam gyis 1rta'ajig / ril bus 12khrus byas tsam gyis ni/ /'bras dang shu bar 'gyur 1gernams dang / /lhog pa dang ni rkang shu dang / /mtshan par rdol dang me dbal dang / /khyi rngo mdze dang rkang pa'i nad/ /mi bzad 57de rnams kun dang ni/ /gang dag 15nor rgyas sdang bas zin/ /byugs pa tsam gyi tshamod la ni/ /thams cad dug med zhi bar 'gyur17/ / ril bu 18thams cad las byed pa/ /lha rdzas shi ba sos par byed/ / ril bu 19dag ni 'chang byed cing / /thig le dag ni byas pa yis/ /thams cad du ni mchod pa 'thob/ /thams cad du ni nor dag 'du / /dpal 'dod pa ni dpal 'thob 2 7cing / /'bru 'dod 'bru yi 1phung po 92—462

'phel / /lha rnams dag ni dga' 'gyur zhing / /klu rnams kyang ni dga' dang bcas / /gnod sbyin srin po dri za dang / /lha min mkha' lding mi'am ci lto 'phye chen po thams cad dang / /'byung po rnams kyang dga' dang bcas/ /rtag tu phyag bya'i gnas 'gyur zhing / /thams cad dbang du gyur nas 'khod/ /'khod kun bran byed ci bya zer/ /gang zhig ril bu 1de dag brtenan/ / ril bu (5)thig le rtag byed la/ /de bzhin gshegs kun dgongs pa mdzad/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang / /de nyid rig la rtag tu ni/ /mchog sbyin dus ༅kun gzigs par mdzad/ /bsod nams phung po stong dag ni/ /nyi ma re re sogs (3)par byed/ /'jig rten pa yi 6bde spyad cing / /'jig rten pha rol shin tu bde/ /tshe brje 7ba ni 'phos nas su/ /bde ba can du mod la 'gro / /gang dang gang du skye bar 8ni/ /tshe rabs rtag tu tshe rabs dran/ /lag na rdo rje gnod sbyin che/ /9gnod sbyin bye bas yongs bskor 1 cing / /g.yel ba med par nyin mtshan du/ /dus kun du ni srung ba dang / /skyob dang sbed dang srung bar byed/ /gang zhig bu ni med pa dang / /bu 11med bu ni 'dod pa la/ / ril bu 12gcig ni 1 sbyar nas su/ /mnyam par bzhag pas gsang sngags ni/ /mkhas pas zla ba yar gyi ngor/ /'bum ni tshang bar bzlas nas su//zla ba nya ste bcwa 1 lnga la/ /skyes pa bud med khrus bya zhing / /yan lag yan lag thig le bya/ /dkon mchog gsum ni legs mchod cing / /bram ze dag kyang mchod ston byed/ /bsrung tshaba'i cho ga byas nas su/ /gtor ma dkar gsum mang po bshamatsha/ /bdag nyid rgyan gyis brgyan nas su/ /gos gtsang rnams ni bgo bar 17bya/ /byams pa'i sems la yang dag gnas/ /snying rje sems can 92—463

sdug par byed/ /bsam pa dag cing des pa dang / /bla ma (1)rtag tu gus par bya / /me tog sna tshogs rab dgang 2zhing / /spos dang byug pa sna tshogs dang / /du rus chodaratsan+dan sā la kyiri no/ /lha yi bdug pas bdug bya zhing / /bu ram 'o ma bdun dang ni/ / ril bu ra legs sbyar bza' bar bya/ /gsang ba 'di 'thungs 6 mod la ni/ /btung dang kha zas bza' bar bya/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang / /mchog sbyin mdzad par mchod par bya/ /byams mdzad de yi zhabs drung du/ /mtshan mo nyal dang nang par ni/ /mthong ba mchog 'di thob par 'gyur/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang / /mchog sbyin rang gzugs ston mdzad cing / /mchog nyid dam pa sbyin par mdzad/ /bud med de ni bu skyed 7cing / /gzugs bzang mchog tu blta 8na sdug /stobs ldan gzugs ni phun sum tshogs/ /lha yi dpal gyi rjes su 'gro/ /chos 895ldan mkhas shing gsal ba dang / /tshe ring dbang phyug tshad med 'gyur/ /dpa' bo dgra las rgyal ba dang / /snang ba thams cad 'joms par 'gyur/ /yang na dran pa'i blo bskyed par 'dod pas thos pa la brten nas 'dug cing rig sngags 'chang gtsang ma zhag bdun du nyin re zhing mar dang 'o ma bskol ba der ril bu 1 bdun bcug ste / zan ma zos pa'i sngon rol du lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod byas nas 'jam tsam 11pa 'thungs la phyis kha zas bza' bar bya/ zhag bdun gyis thos pa'i rgya mtsho chen po bsags par 'gyur te bstan bcos thams cad dang / chos lugs dang / 'dul ba dang / snyan dngags 15dang / brda 1 sprod pa dang /mdo'i 1 sde dang / dbyangs kyis 15bsnyad pa'i sde dang / tshigs su bcad pa'i sde dang / gleng tshigazhi'i sde dang / ched du brjod pa'i sde dang / de lta bu byung 92wa 464

ba'i sde dang / skyes pa rabs kyi sde dang / chos mngon pa dang / rtsis dang /cho ga zhib mo dang / gsang sngags dang / phyag rgya thams cad dang / theg pa chen po thams cad kha ton du lobs par 'gyur ro/ /zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig tu sbyar ba byas na stobs chen po'i brtson 'grus kyi 1pa rol gnon par 'gyur te/ glang po che khri'i stobs su 'gyur ro/ /zla ba gcig tsam sbyar ba byas 2na lo lnga brgyar 'tsho zhing gnyer ma dang / skra dkar spangs la skra lcang lo 'khyil zhing 'khyil par 'gyur ba dang / lus kyi mdog dkar sham lta bur 'gyur ro5/ /lo gcig tu sbyar na lha'i sman bcud kyis len mchog la 'jug cing nam mkha'i steng du lha rnams dang lhan cig mthun 6par 'gyur la/ brgya byin dang yang lhan cig 'gran par 'gyur/ lha rnams kyi lha mo'i tshogs dang / lha'i gzhal med khang na rtse zhing dga' bar byed la rin po che sna bdun gyi gzhal med khang gi gnas na gnas par 'gyur/ nyi ma lta bur 'od 7gtong zhing rgyu la gnas pa bzang po rnams kyis 'gro bar byed/ gzi brjid shin tu gsal ba mi bzod cing rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /zhes bya ba la the tshom 8mi bya'o/ /las thams cad bsgrub pa'i thig le dang / ril bu 9bsgrub pa'i cho ga ste 1 bzhi pa'o// //de nas mi snang bar bya ba dang / nam mkha' la 'gro ba sman gyi mchog don yod pa'i mthus grub par 11bshad par bya ste/ rig sngags 'chang ba rnams kyi grub pa'i mchog de kho na nyid yin no/ /sman dngul chu dang / prad+mā 1 k+ṣi ra dang /su bar ṇa k+ṣi ra dang / shel sngo sangs dang / ku k+ṣi dang / su gan dhi dang /king kuṣ+ṭha 1/skyon med pa dang / ut+pa la bzang po dang / pad+ma k+ṣa dang 1 / gu 92wa 465

gul dang / phe lu pad 71〉tra dang / gur gum tshan)dang / na (8)ga put+pa dang bcas pa dang / spang 4 spos dang / shi ri ṣa'i me tog dang / tsan+dan dkar po dang bcas pa bsres nas zhib tu btags pa'i phye ma la don yod pa pad+ma gtsug tor gyi gsang ba 5rigs kyi rgyal po'i sngags kyis shin tu brtson par lan brgyad brgya bzlas brjod bya zhing khro bo'i gsang sngags lan brgyad stong bzlas brjod byas pas lan nyi shu rtsa gcig tu dbang bskur la/ yi ge gcig pa 56rilan 'bum bzlas brjod bya/ de'i tshe gzungs 7sngags bcu po so sor lan nyi shu rtsa re re bzlas brjod bya ste/ gsang sngags thams cad rdzogs par bzlas brjod byas nas sman don yod pa 8rgya che ba gsal ba zhes bya ba sman gyi mchog /bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi zhabs drung du bzhag la grib ma la bskam par bya'o/ /yang don yod pa'i zhags pa'i gtsug tor gyis lan brgya rtsa brgyad smyo bzlas brjod byas nas snod gtsang ma'i 3 rinang du bcug la nam dgos pa byung ba de'i tshe thams cad du bsgrub 11pa'i dgos pa thams cad la sbyar bar bya'o//de 12nas rig sngags 'chang gtsang mar gyur pas lus legs par khrus byas la spos chus byugs te/ gos gtsang ma bgo bar bya/ sman gyi mchog 'di yungs nyi mar gyis sbrus la rang gi lus la byug 7par bya ste/ lan cig gebaskus pa tsam gyis mi snang bar 'gyur la/ gnas gsang bar bya ba'i sgo bcad pa thams cad mthong bar 'gyur/ gnas thams cad du ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du 'jug par 'gyur/don thams cad byed par 'gyur/ 'byung po dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / sha za la sogs lapa'i gtso bo rgyal por 'gyur zhing de dag thams cad dbang du 'gyur te/ ci bgyi zhes bya ba byed la ji srid 'tsho'i bar du nye bar 92wa 466

gnas nas las su bya ba'i dgos pa thams cad kyi rjes su 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /klu'i gnas kyi sgo bcad pa thams cad na 'dug 17la klu 'khor nadang bcas pa thams cad mdun du 'khod nas bya ba thams cad la ci bgyi zhes bya ba byed par 'gyur zhing las su byed pa dang / dgos pa thams cad byed par 'gyur/ ji srid 'cho3re bar du nye bar 'khod cing nyin mtshan du gnas la/ de nas klu thams cad bsgo ba bzhin byed par 'gyur ro/ /sman la sing ha dzi hwa cadang /ba'i 'o ma dang sbyar bas mgo kun byugs na ji lta ba yid la byas pa dang / rang gi blos 'dod pa'i ngo bo sna tshogs 5par byed dophyi/ /gnas su gtogs pa thams cad ji ltar 'dug pa bzhin ston par byed/ gnas su gtogs pa thams cad 'khor gyi nang na ji ltar rnam par sprul pa'i gzugs sna tshogs ston par byed/ji srid 'tsho'i bar du 'phel ba rnams ston par byed cing bya ba thams cad byed do / /spos kyi til mar dang sbrus 7nas byin pa dang / rkang pa la bskus na nam mkha' la 'phags par 'gyur zhing / nam mkha' la 'gro bar 'gyur la gang du 'dod pa der 'gro bar 'gyur/ chu'i steng du 'gro zhing nams kyang phyis sa 8la rkang pa 'jog par mi 'gyur/ lag pa 9g.yas pa la bskus na gang dang gang la lag pa reg pa de 'ong bar 'gyur la sus kyang mthong bar mi 'gyur/ bud med gzhon nu'i 'o ma dang bsres nas mig la bskus nas rgyal po'i pho brang du zhugs na mthong bar mi 'gyur zhing don 'dod pa gang 7yin pa byed do/ /don gyi rdzas 1lhagang yin pa blangs kyang 1 sus kyang mi mthong ngo / /bud med gang dang phrad na sus kyang mi mthong la ji srid 'tsho'i bar du 'dug kyang sus kyang mi shes so / /khar byugs 12nas gang dang gang na bro gar byed pa dang / bzhad 92—467

gad byed pa nyid kyi nang du zhugs na bya ba thams cad byed la lus ni sus kyang mi mthong ngo / /bum pa la byugs nas chus bkang na chu'i 1)rgyun snang la bum pa de ni mi mngon nodari/ /gzhong pa chus bkang ba de'i dbus su byugs na chu de gang bar snang la gzhong pa de ni mi snang ngo / /bdag nyid la byugs nas bum pa chus bkang ba lag na thogs na bum pa las chu 'byung ba ni snang la mi de'i lus ni mi snang ngo / /mig la bskus nas skye bo mang po'i nang du zhugs na mi mthong bar 'gyur la/ de'i sgra ni thos shing rang gi lus ni mi mngon no/ /gnas su gtogs pa thams cad du zhugs na rang gi lus khrus ma byas kyi bar du mi mthong ngo / /su yang rung ba'i mig la bskus la lus la yang bskus na de dag thams cad mi mthong bar 'gyur zhing / gang dang gang 5du 'gro ba de dang der mi snang bar 'gyur la khrus byas pa tsam gyis phyir snang bar 'gyur ro/ /lus kun la 'chibaskus nas mdzod chen po'i nang du zhugs na 7mi mthong bar 'gyur la gser dang /dngul dang / phra 8men dang / nor bu dang / mu tig dang / byi 9ru dang /dung dang / man shel dang / rdo rje dang / bai ḍūr+ya 7dang / margad dang /mthon ka 11dang / gos dang / spud pa dang / rgyan dang / lhab lhub gang yang rung ba nyid 'dod na thams cad blangs nas song na sus kyang mi mthong la gar 15dga' bar 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /ji srid du khrus ma byas pa de srid du rang mi mthong 15la khrus byas na thams cad 'du mthong ngo / /rig sngags 'chang bud med kyi nang du 'jug par 'dod pas sagatsang mar khrus bya'o/ /de nas spos chus khrus bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu ba gcin gyis sakhrus bya'o/ /yang na 1 gur gum 18gyis khrus bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu ba'i rnam lngas khrus bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu ba'i til 92—468

mar dang lhan cig 1bsres pa des lus bsku bar bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu bud med gzhon nu'i nu tshon)zho dang sbyar bas mig la bskus la de nas ril bu gsum dpung pa g.yas pa la gdags 4par bya'o/ /de nas gos gtsang ma bgos nas gsang sngags brjod cing dran par byas la rgyal po'i pho brang du zhugs na mi mthong bar 'gyur te lus sus kyang mi mthong ngo / /nyi ma gcig gam/ nyi ma gnyis sam/nyi ma bdun nam/ nyi ma bcu bzhi'am/ nyi ma nyi shu rtsa gcig tu khrus byas la bud med de dag gi nang na rtse zhing dga' bar byed la/ yongs su spyod par byed kyang sus kyang mi shes la 'jug cing phyir 'gro ba na sus kyang glags mi rnyed de/ji srid du khrus ma byas pa'i bar du parang gi 6lus mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /phug (7༄tu 'jug na lus kun spos kyi til mar gyis byugs la phug tu zhugs na phug gi sgo thams cad phye bar 'gyur gyis / gnas de'i nang du zhugs la ji lta 9ji ltar las su bya ba de lta de ltar gyis shig /chu'i nang du zhugs na ji ltar khyim gyi nang na 'dug pa bzhin chus 1 mi rlan 11la/ chus 1 gos par yang mi 'gyur ro/ /me'i nang du zhugs na mes lus la mi 1 reg cing tsan+dan ltar bsil bar 'gyur ro/ /klu'i gnas mtshor zhugs na gnas na 1 'khod pa rnams kyis de mi mthong gis 15ji ltar rang gis yid la las su bya bar 'dod pa'i las kyi rnam pa gzhan dag kyang gyis shig /mi snang bar bya ba ril bu sgrub sa pa'i cho ga'o// //'phags pa don yod pa'i zhags pa'i cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po/ bam po bcu drug pa/ bode nas sbyin sreg gi cho ga bshad par bya ste/ las thams cad kyi don sgrub par byed pa/ dngos grub thams cad byed pa'i gnas/ sdig pa 92wa 469

thams cad 'phrog pa/ de bzhin du sgrib pa thams cad rnam par dag pa/ rig sngags thams cad kyi dngos grub bla na med pa/ gnod sbyin thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa/ sdig pa thams cad 'joms par byed pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi legs par rgyal ba sbyin pa/ dgra thams cad zlog (1༄par byed pa/'thab pa dang / rtsod pa nyid dang / 'gyed pa dang / mtshon cha'i dra ba thams cad las sgrol bar byed pa/ grub pa don yod pa mchog tu rnyed par dka' ba/ rig sngags 'chang thams cad kyi dngos grub thams cad du gsang sngags dang dkyil 'khor gyi dngos grub phyag rgya 'pho ba dang / de kho na nyid kyi rim par phye ba'i sgrub pa las thams cad du mchog gi dngos grub kyang 'grub ste ②'di la the tshom med do/ /bde ba thams cad rtag tu rab tu sbyin pa dang /dbang phyug ma yin pa thams cad kyi sgrub pa dang 'gugs pa dang / lha dang /klu thams cad spyan 'dren pa dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po thams cad rab tu 'joms pa dang / bdud dang / 'byung po dang / sha za dang /gdon mi bzad pa dang / brjed byed mi bzad pa dang / tshangs pa'i srin po rnams thams cad thams cad du sgrol bar byed par grub pa dang / nyin mo dang mtshan mo'i dus rtag tu tshar gcod par the tshom 45med do/ /rims thams cad rtag tu rab tu zhi bar byed pa/ nad thams cad zlog ra par byed pa/ dug thams cad gsod par byed pa/ 'phral du sreg 6)blugs byin pa tsam gyis thams cad du rtag tu gnang chen po dang / thams cad du ri rimathong na dga' ba dang /'jig rten thams cad kyi bla mar mchod par bya ba dang / thams cad du stobs dang / brtson 'grus dang pha rol gnon pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rtag 92—470

tu mthong ba yang sbyin par 'gyur te 'di la the tshom 1med do/ /byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu kun du snang ba dang / dus thams cad kyi tshe las thams cad la shin tu dga' ba dang / skye ba nas skye bar tshig btsun par 'gyur ro/ /thams cad du bla ma la sri (2)zhu che ba dang / thams cad du mchod par 'os pa'i bla ma'o/ /de nas dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin pas rtag tu yang srung ba dang / yongs su skyong bar byed pa dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi dadang / gshin rje dang / chu lha nyid kyis kyang / dus rtag tu srung ba dang / skyob pa dang / sba bar byed par the tshom med do(4)/ /dbang phyug dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / lha'i bu stong phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu dang / lha'i bu rdzu 'phrul che ba rnams kyis srung ba dang /skyob ⑤pa dang / sba bar byed cing rtag tu legs par kha 6los sgyur 7bar gnas par 'gyur ro/ /tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / drag po dang / gzhon nu dang / nor bu bzang po dang / stobs kyi lha (8)dang / gang ba bzang po dang / lngas rtsen 9dang / gar mkhan mchog ste tso'adi rnams kyis rtag tu srung ba dang / skyob 11par byed cing gnas te 'di la the tshom med do/ /me'i lha gzi brjid chen po dang / nyi ma dang / zla ba dang / rgyu skar gyi lha rnams kyis srung ba dang / skyob 1 pa dang / sba bar byed cing / mchog tu mchod pa byed pas gnas par 'gyur ro/ /sbyin sreg tsam 'di ni/ bya ba thams cad bla na med pa'i dngos grub rnams la'o15 'bras thug 8po che dang / yungs kur dang / gu gul dang / mar dang sbrang rtsi bsres pas sbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad byas na/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis thams cad mchog sbyin par 'gyur te/ bya ba thams cad sgrub par byed 92—471

par 'gyur ro/ /tsan+dan dang / pad+ma'i chu ba dang / 'bras yos dang /yungs kur dang / a ga 1ru dang / zho dang / sbrang rtsi dang / mar bsres pas / sa mā'i 2shing gi zhi ba'i me sbar te stong phrag brgyad du sbyin sreg ribya'o/ /de nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug rang gi gzugs kyis mdun du nye bar gnas te/ mchog thams cad sbyin par 'gyur ro/ /bya ba thams cad kyi dngos grub tu yang 'gyur ro/ /yid kyi shing rta thams cad yongs su rdzogs par yang 'gyur ro/ /cho ga zhib mo thams cad kyi dngos grub tu yang 'gyur ro/ /thams cad du don yod pa thogs pa med pa'i dngos grub tu yang 'gyur ro/ /bsod nams thams cad 'gugs pa'i dngos grub tu yang 'gyur ro/ /dkyil 'khor dang / phyag rgya rim par phye ba dang / cho ga zhib mo dang / sgrub pa'i cho ga thams cad kyi mchog gi dngos grub tu 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs kyi dam tshig gsang ba la rjes su zhugs par 'gyur ro/ /seng ldeng dang / nim pa'i shing gi yam shing gi ca'abras sā 45lu dang / til dang / yungs kur dang / zho dang / mar dang / lan tshwa dang 'chibasres pa 7sbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad byas na/ bgegs dang / log par 'dren pa dang /gnod sbyin dang / srin po'i gdon thams cad dang / gdug pa dang / phyir rgol ba dang / dgra thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed do/ /'thab pa dang /rtsod pa dang / 'gyed pa thams cad las sgrol bar byed do/ /mtshon cha thams cad las rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /pha rol gyi dmag tshogs dang / phyir rgol ba dang / dgra thams cad las rgyal ba sbyin par 'gyur ro/ /tsan+dan dang /'bras yos dang / zho dang / sbrang rtsi dang / mar bsres pa'i pad+ma'i sbyin sreg 92—472

stong phrag brgyad byas na/ yul 'khor dang / ri brags 1skudang / grong dang /grong khyer dang / ljongs rnams su/ kun nas dpag tshad stong phrag gcig kho ra 2khor yug tu zhi ba chen por 'gyur ro/ /sems can thams cad dang / bud med dang / skyes pa dang / khye'u dang / bu mo rnams la bsrung ba dang /bskyab pa'i ched du yang dag par sgrub par 'gyur ro/ /nad thams cad thams cad du rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /gcan gzan gtum capo thams cad dang /sbrul gdug pa dang / ma rungs pa 5thams cad byams par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po dang / yul 'khor dang / btsun mo'i 'khor gyis yongs su bskor ba thams cad shis pa dang bde bar 'gyur ro/ /ma tam ga dang / yungs kur dang /mar dang / klu shing gi me tog dang / 'bras yos rnams bsres pas arka'i shing gi yam shing gi me sbar la stong phrag brgyad du 6sbyin sreg byas na char mi 'bab par byed pa la/ de nas klu chen po rnams kyis char gyi rgyun 'byin par byed de ji srid char pa 'bab par 'dod pa'i bar du'o/ /lo thog dang / shing dang /rtswa dang / shing shel pa dang / sman gyi rdzas dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /legs par yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro / /klu'i rgyal po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyis dga' ba chen por 'gyur zhing / dus dus su ji lta ba bzhin du char gyi rgyun 'byin par byed do / /ha cang char ches na de nyid kyi thal bas stong phrag brgyad du sbyin sreg byas na ha cang char ches pa 7rab tu zhi bar byed do/ /'bras yos dang / go la dang / yungs kur dang / gtum po'i sa bon mar dang bsres pa'i sbyin sreg byas na/ rlung dang ser ba thams cad zlog 8par byed do/ /dpag tshad stong 92—473

phrag khor yug tu mtshams chen po bcing bar byas par 'gyur ro/ /rlung bcing ba la yungs kur dang 'bras thug po che'i sbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad byas na/rlung gi dkyil 'khor thams cad bcing bar byas par 'gyur te/ ji srid du be ram bha'i rlung gi bar du bcings par 'gyur ro/ /klu bcing ba la ni yungs kur dang / til gyi sbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad byas na/ lo bcu gnyis su klu bcing 517ba byas par 'gyur ro/ /nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar bya ba la ni/ yungs gar mar dang bsres pa'i sbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad byas na nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed do/ /pha rol gyi dmag tshogs zlog napa la ni/ ka (gur bī 94tshora'i shing gis me sbar te/ nim pa'i 'dab 5rim dang / lan tshwa dang / phub 56rima'i sbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad byas na/ pha rol gyi dmag tshogs dang / phyir rgol ba dang / dgra thams cad rnam par nyams par byed de ri/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du phyis 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /phyogs bcing ba la dpag tshad stong phrag khor yug gis so/ /til dang / yungs kur dang / 'bras yos dang / pad+ma'i 'dab 8ma mar dang bsres pas sbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad byas na/ dpag tshad stong phrag khor yug tu mtshams chen po bcing ri9ba byas par 'gyur ro/ /log 'dren thams cad bcing ba la ni/ yungs kur nag po dang / til nag dang /sran ma dang / til dang mar bsres 1 tshopas sbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad byas 1nyan bgegs 1 dang / log 'dren dang / bdud la sogs pa ma rungs pa dang /gnod sbyin dang srin po rnams bcing ba byas par 'gyur ro/ /gnod sbyin 'byin pa la ni/ r+ghaṃ ga'i sa bon dang / lan tshwa dang / til 1rimar 7bsres pas sbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad byas na/ gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / 'byung po 92—474

dang / sha za dang / brjed byed la sogs pa thams cad 'jig rten thams cad kyi mngon sum du nges par 'byin par 'gyur ro/ /yams dang / nye bar 'tshe ba dang / nad 'go ba thams cad dang / 'jigs pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /dge legs thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bram ze dbang du byed (17pa la/ 'bras yos dang / arka'i yam 2shing mar gyis btags pas sbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad byas na bram ze thams cad dbang du 'gyur ro/ /rgyal rigs dbang du byed pa la/ bu ram dang / mar dang /'bras yos dang / arka'i 'dab mas sbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad byas na/rgyal rigs thams cad dbang du byed par 'gyur ro/ /dmangs rigs dbang du byed pa la/ myos byed kyi 'bras bu dang / dong ku'i sbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad byas na/ dmangs rigs thams cad dbang 4du byed pa'i mchog 'grub bo/ /rje rigs dbang du byed pa la/ mar rnam pa gsum gyis bsres pa'i sbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad byas na/ rje rigs thams cad dbang du byed do/ /sna ma'i me tog mar gyis btags pa'i sbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad byas na/ bud med thams cad dbang du byed par 'gyur ro/ /gzhon nu ma dbang du byed pa la/ chu'i me tog mar gyis btags pa'i sbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad byas na/ gzhon nu ma thams cad dbang du byed par 'gyur ro/ /'jigs pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa la/ 'bru dang mar gyi sbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad byas na/ 'jigs pa dang / 'thab mo dang / 'thab pa dang / rtsod pa dang / 'gyed 5pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed do/ /nor dang 'bru 'phel bar byed pa la/'bru bdun mar gyis btags pa'i sbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad byas na nor dang 92—475

'bru 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /dbang phyug thob pa la/ yungs kur dang / mad+dhāḥdang / sbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad byas na dbang phyug chen po 'phel bar 'gyur ro / /yul thob pa la/ tsha ba gsum mar dang / mad+dhāḥ(1)dang bsres pa'i sbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad byas na/ yul chen po thob par 'gyur ro/ /grong gi don du ka rinaskur bī /nora'i me tog dang / yungs kur dang / 'bras yos mar gyis btags pa'i sbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad byas na grong rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /gter gdon pa la ni/ pad+ma'i chu ba mar dang bsres pa'i sbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad byas na gter chen po so sor rnyed do/ /gnod sbyin spyan drang bar 'dod pas/gu gul dang / gtum po'i sa bon dang / sbrang rtsi mar gyis btags pa'i sbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad byas na/ gnod sbyin rang gi gzugs kyis mdun du nye bar 'dug ste/ ci bsgo ba byed cing las thams cad byed par 'gyur ro/ /'dod pa'i gzugs can ma spyan drang bar 'dod pas 'bras yos dang / yungs kur dang / zho dang / sbrang rtsi dang / mar gyis btags pa'i dri dang / pri yang ku'i sa ka car bī 5ra'i shing gi 6niyam shing gis 75me sbar nas sbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad byas na de'i 'og tu 'dod pa'i gzugs can ma 'ongs te/ ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du spyod par byed do/ /rnam pa gsum brjod par bya ste/ ma dang /chung ma dang / sring mo'o/ /gal te ma yin na bu la zhen pas/ nor dang / 'bru dang / longs spyod chen po rnam par 'phel zhing phun sum tshogs par byed de/ji srid 'tsho'i bar du mi 'bral bar kun du gnas par byed do/ /gal te chung ma yin na/ rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i dga' ba du mas rtse zhing / longs spyod la yongs su spyod par byed de/ rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i gos dang / rgyan dang /92—476

lhab lhub dang / dri dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / bza' ba dang /btung ba rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i ro bro ba'i longs spyod la yongs su spyod cing /rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i mal stan dang / nor dang / 'bru dang / mdzod dang /bang ba dang bcas pa rnam par 'phel ba la yongs su spyod de/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du grib ma bzhin du rjes su 'brang bar 'gyur ro/ /srog kyang yongs su gtong bar byed do/ /gal te sring mo yin na de'i tshe/ rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i dbang phyug dang / lha'i gzhal med khang na longs spyod la yongs su spyod cing /ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bsnyen bkur dang rim gro byed do/ /pha rol gyi dmag tshogs bzlog pa la phub (1ma dang / lan tshwa'i sbyin sreg gis dpag tshad brgya stong phrag gi nang du dgra mi 'byung ste/ sbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad byas na g.yul dang 'khrug pa chen po las rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /nyi ma 'bab par byed pa la/ri'i rtse mor sbrang rtsi dang / na le sham dang / 'bras thug napo che dang mar gyis btags pa'i sbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad byas na nyin re re zhing nyi ma 'bab par byed dori ri/ /mchog thams cad rjes su stsol bar byed cing / ji srid 'tsho'i bar du 'dod pa tsam gyis bsnyen bkur dang / rim gro byed cing nye bar gnas so/ /zla ba dang / rgyu skar dang / skar ma'i tshogs 'bab par 'dod pas gnas mthon por tsha ba gsum dang / rgyam tshwa dang / lan tshwa dang / 'o ma dang / sbrang 4rtsi dang mar gyis btags pa'i sbyin sreg byas na zla ba dang / rgyu skar dang / skar ma'i tshogs 'bab par byed de/ 'dod pa dang / yid kyi shing rta dang / bskal 5pa dang / dbang phyug thams cad cher 'phel ba rab tu sbyin no/ /ji srid 'tsho'i bar du nye bar gnas te/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du srung ba dang / skyob pa dang /92—477

sba ba byed par 'gyur ro917/ /nyi ma re re zhing mthong bar 'dod na 'bab par byed do/ /lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang /nam mkha' (25lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang / mi ma yin pa dang / bud med dang / skyes pa dang / khye'u dang / bu mo dang / dge sbyong dang / bram ze dang / rgyal rigs dang / rje rigs dang / dmangs rigs thams cad 'gugs pa la til dang / yungs kur dang / 'bras thug ①po che dang /sman sna tshogs dang / zho dang / sbrang rtsi dang / mar gyis btags stipa'i sbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad byas na/ 'gugs pa chen po'i dngos grub tu 'gyur te/'jig rten thams cad dga' bar yang 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po dang / btsun mo'i 'khor dang g.yog tu bcas pa 'khor du 'gyur te/ rtag tu de nyid kyi rjes su 'brang bar 'gyur la ngag gi rjes su 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /bdag nyid kyis sam nor gyis kyang rung ste/ thams cad du bla ma gcig pur mchod pa chen po byed par 'gyur ro/ /sbyin sreg 5gi cho ga'i sgrub thabs so// //de nas mig 'phrul bshad par bya ste/ don yod pa pad+ma gtsug tor gyi rig sngags kyis sems can thams cad la phan pa'i don gyi ched du las thams cad byed pa/ dge ba la mkhas pa rnams kyi bde ba sbyin pa/ rtag tu dbul po rnams kyis 6 bde ba thob par byed pa'o/ /de nas rtogs pa'i mod la 'bru mchog tu 'phel bar 'gyur zhing / 'jig rten thams cad kyi bla ma nyid du mchod par bya ba dang / mi 'jigs pa dang / dbang phyug sbyin zhing / longs spyod chen po 'phel ba dang / rgyal po'i bde ba dang ldan pa dang phyogs phyogs su 92—478

rab mchog sbyin par byed do/ /gi wang dang / cu gang dang / ldong ros dang ske/ mu zi dang / pad+ma ge sar dang / ut+pal sngon po dang / li kha ra dang /gur gum dang / rgya mtsho zhi)lhu ba dang / gnyis dang / gser gyi 'dab zhon)ma stong phrag sbyar te③/ phye ma shin tu zhib mor byas la legs par bsgongs la ga pur dang / gla rtsi tsam gyi 4)blangs la/ sngags kyi stong phrag brgyad bzlas pa/mkhas pas rnam pa gsum du sbyar bar bya ste/ skye bos gang ba nyid la lnga mnyam pa'o / /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis mig sman gyi snying pos stong rtsa brgyad bzlas la mig la byug par bya ste mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /skye bo 5mang po'i dbus su nam mkha' la nye bar gnas par byed do/ /hūm̐ yig gis mthong bar bya'o/ /nam mkha' la 'gro bar byed do/ /gnas par byed do/ /nyal bar byed do/ /rgyug par (7byed do/ /bskus na lus la me 'bar bar mthong ste/ de ston par byed do/ /du ba'i rgyal mtshan ston par byed do/ /rkang pa'i mthil la kun du byugs na/ chu bo dang / chu klung chen po'i steng nas 'gro ste rkang pa la chus gos par mi 'gyur ro/ /me 97)chen po 'bar ba'i nang du 'jug ste/ sreg par mi byed cing / ba spu'i khung bu gcig kyang 'byi bar mi 'gyur ro/ /phye mas phyogs bzhir nam mkha' kun du gtor na/ me tog dang / 'bras bu sna tshogs pa'i char gyi rgyun ltung bar byed do/ /rin po che sna tshogs kyi gzhal med khang mthong bar byed do/ /lus mtha' dag la byug par bya zhing / skye bo'i mig sman bsku zhing phye mas gtor nas/ ljongs chen po'i nang du 'jug par bya ste/ de cung zad kyang mi mthong ngo / /ji ltar yid la byed pa bzhin du rmongs pa chen po'i sgyu ma ston par byed de/ rgyal po dang / dmag sde chen po dang / drang srong gi 92—479

gzugs (1dang / gser gyi bum pa can dang / mi'i seng ge dang / phag dang /dga' byed kyi mtshan nyid dang / rol snyed nam phrogs ( dpa dang / zla 'od mgo bo yongs su gtong cab ston par byed do/ /'joms pa dang / gsod (5)pa dang /srog 'dor ba ston par byed do/ /me tog gi char ram/ 'bras bu'i char ram/rlung dang / sprin dang / ser ba dang / 'bru'i char ston par byed do/ /rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i rnam 'gyur rnams ston par byed de56/ gzhal med khang chen po'i rnam pa rnams bsams 7pa tsam gyis ston par byed do/ /dge 'dun gyi nang du 'jug na/ rnam par 'phrul pa rnam pa sna tshogs pa la sogs pa ya ma zung gzhal du med pa ston par byed do/ /bdag nyid kyi mgo bo la bskus nas mgrin pa tsam gyis dri za/ til mar bsgos pa'i phye mas gtor bar bya zhing / mig sman gyis byug par bya/ phye mas lus mtha' dag la bdug 8)par bya rkang pa la byug par bya ste/ dge 'dun gyi 9nang du zhugs na yang dag par shes bzhin dang / zhi ba dang / dul ba dang / zung tsam du mthong ngo / /de nas zhugs pa tsam gyis me'i khams su mthong bar byed do/ /sems par mthong bar byed do/ /nam mkha' la gnas par byed do/ /'chag par byed do/ /'dug par byed cing mal stan la rtog par byed do/ /'ong bar byed cing 'gro bar byed do/ /me tog 'bab par byed do/ /nam mkha' la rnga'i sgra ston par byed do/ /rig byed bzhi pa'i nang du shing arka'i 1 'o mas bsgos nas byugs pa tsam gyis 'jig rten gsum pa'i gzugs su mthong bar byed do/ /lha'i gar mkhan sna tshogs pa'i gzugs su mthong bar byed do/ /ji lta ji ltar yid 11la byed 12bzhin pa'i bhā 1 ra ta dang / dga' byed rnams mthong bar byed do/ /'khor chen po'i dbus su 92—480

rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i gar mkhan rnams su ston par byed do/ /rgyal po'i pho brang (1du rgyal po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ lha'i gar mkhan sna tshogs pa rnams su mthong bar byed do/ /gling gi dbang phyug 'khor los sgyur naba'i rgyal po sna tshogs pa dang / mān dhā 5ta dang / yid ldan dang / shing rta bcu pa dang / rin chen 'od dang / drag pos 'od byin dang / mi bdag dang /mnga' bdag dang / tshong pa dang / ded dpon dang / zhi ba dang / mche bzang dang / snying rje can dang / pad+ma dkar po la sogs pa rnams dang lhan cig pa'i gar mkhan rnams su mthong ngo / /rin po che'i char dang / gos kyi char dang / spud 4)pa'i char dang / lhab lhub kyi char mthong bar byed do/ /me tog gi gzhal med khang dang / 'bras bu'i gzhal med khang mthong bar byed do/ /gzhal med khang la sogs pa rnam pa sna tshogs pa mthong bar byed do/ /de ltar na mig sman dang phye ma mthu chen po bsku ba dang sbyor bas gzhal med khang dang /gar mkhan dang/ gzhal med khang mthong bar byed de/ ji srid sgra sgrogs 5dang / 'jigs byed dang / bum pa dang / gzhal med khang mthong ba dang /ha nu ma'i gzhal med khang mthong bar byed pa dang / gar mkhan rmongs pa chen po'i gzhal med khang mthong bar byed do/ /ji srid bdud 'joms pa la sogs pa dmag sde sna tshogs pa'i mchog gi gzugs kyi bar du mthong bar byed do/ /stobs dang / brtson 'grus chen po mthong bar byed do/ /mig sman dang phye nema'i sbyor ba gsum gyi ri dngos grub ni/ bsku ba dang / bklags 8pa dang /yang dag par sbyar bas tshe'i dngos grub chen por 'gyur ro/ /sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul sna tshogs pa 'grub ste9/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu ji lta ba de bzhin du rab 92—481

tu sbyor ba'i dngos grub tu 'gyur ro/ /rab tu sbyar ba tsam gyis 6)dngos grub chen po rgya che ba 'jig rten thams cad kyi mngon sum du 'grub par 'gyur ro(ge/ /sgrub pa'i dngos grub bla na med pa'i cho ga rmongs pa chen po'i cho ga'o// //de nas dkyil 'khor bshad par bya ste/ de kho na nyid kyi dngos grub bla na med pa dang / don yod zhags pa'i pad+ma gtsug tor gyi dngos grub dang /rig pa 'dzin pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyi de kho na nyid bla na med pa'o/ /dang por sdig pa zad par byed pa de bzhin du sgrib pa thams cad rnam par nyams par byed pa/ 'dod pa thams cad kyi dngos grub dang / don yod pa'i dngos grub bla na med pa dang / sngags kyi dngos grub dang / mchog gi dngos grub dang / gzungs thob pa'i dngos grub rnams dang / sa bcu la rab tu 'jug par byed pa grub pa/ sangs rgyas nyid kyi sgrub thabs de kho na nyid mthong ba rmad du byung ba/ byang chub kyi snying por nye bar 'gro bar byed pa/ rdo rje gdan gyi gnas su yang dag par lhag par gnas pa/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar byed pa / bdud 'joms shing tshar gcod pa/ bgegs thams cad lhung bar byed pa/sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi gnas mthong bar byed pa/ de nyid las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis rlob 4pa'i gnas dang mnyam pa/ sems can thams cad dang thun mong ba'o/ /de nas po ṭa la ma'i gzhal med khang dang mnyam pa'i gnas/ don yod pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gnas/ skad cig la mnar med pa'i gnas dang / mtshams med pa lnga rnam par sbyong bar byed pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i gnas dang mnyam pa/92—482

de bzhin du sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rigs kyi mchog byang chub sems dpa'i gzhi'i gnas de bzhin du rdo rje snying po'i dge ba 'phel ba de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi rig sngags kyi dngos grub dang / de bzhin du pad+ma'i rigs dang /de bzhin du nor bu'i rigs dang / de bzhin du rdo rje'i rigs kyi dngos grub dang / dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo gcig pur zhugs pa dkyil 'khor gyi mchog ri rab chen po dang mnyam pa'i gnas/ de bzhin du rgya mtsho chen po lta bu/ khyad par du 'phags pa'i gnas thams cad du son pa/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i mchog rab tu sbyin pa/ dpag bsam shing dang mtshungs pa'i gnas/ yid kyi shing rta thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa/ re ba phun sum tshogs par byed pa'i gnas thams cad du mchog sbyin pa po 'di ni byang chub kyi sa bon gyi gnas te/ sems can thams cad rtag tu sgrol bar byed pa/ don yod pa'i gnas gsang zhing rdo rje byin gyis rlob pa bla na med pa'o/ /bsod nams thams cad 'gugs par byed pa'i gnas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad rnam par 'phel bar byed pa/ 'di ni bsod nams kyi phung po'i gnas/ chos kyi mdzod dang rtag tu mnyam pa/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzod/ mdzod chen po spyan ras gzigs kyi mdzod la mkhas pa rtag tu pad+ma'i mdzod/ de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mdzod/ rdo rje'i mdzod/ de bzhin du nor bu chen po nyid kyi mdzod / rgya mtsho chen po ltar zab pa/ mi g.yo ba/ mi 'gul ba/ zil gyis mi non 511pa'o/ /bdud dang / log par 'dren pa/ bgegs dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / 'byung po dang / srin po thams cad kyis sdang ba'i sems kyis 'jug par mi nus so/ /de la mi g.yo ba'i gnas rnyed dka' 92—483

zhing bla na med pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor gru bzhi par bya ste/ ba byung dang yang dag par ldan pa/ khru sum cu rtsa gnyis pa bya'o/ /yang na khru brgyad par bya ste/ de phyed dang gnyis kyi khru'i tshad kyi thig skud kyis tshad rnam par phye ste gdab par bya'o / /grwa 1bzhi mnyam par phye ba/ logs bzhi legs par rnam par phye ba/shin tu 'jam pa/ shin tu legs par bcags tshanasapa/ bsnyen tshul 'jam shing brgyan 4pa/ sa gzhi be+e ḍūr+ya'i kha dog la dkyil 'khor mdzes pa thig gis char rnam pa 5dbye bar bya ste/ sgo bzhi rnam par phye ba/ skud pa la tshon sna lnga byin te/dbus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi snying por gru bzhi par rnam par dbye'o/ /khru 6riganyis kyi tshad kyis 75re khā 2lnga rnam par dbye'o/ /dbus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi snying por pad+ma 'dab 9ma sum cu rtsa gnyis pa kun nas rgyas pa bri bar bya ste/ dbus kyi pad+ma'i ge sar la/ don yod pa pad+ma'i gtsug tor bya ste/ pad+ma phyed kha bye ba'i pad+ma'i 'dab 1 ma'i steng du/ pad+ma la zhal gsum par bri bar bya ste/ bde ba'i gzugs 11dang mtshan gyis brgyan 12pa/ gtsug tor gyi rnam pa 'bar ba'i snying po la khor yug tu yongs su bskor ba bri'o/ /gzhogs g.yas su 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gzugs ral pa'i cod pan gyis brgyan 1 pa dbu la 'od dpag med 'bar ba'i snying po'i lus can no/ /gzhogs g.yon du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gzugs ral pa dang rgyan bcings sna 〉pa/'bar ba'i snying po'i lus dang dbu la pad+ma gtsug tor gyi khor yug tu 'od zer sna tshogs 'bar ba'o/ /phyi rol du tsam pa ka dang / hāk+ṣi ka dang / ut+pal sngon po'i me tog gi phreng ba bcing bar 15bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi snying po'i grwa tshebazhi'i gnas rnams su rgyal po chen po bzhi bri bar bya ste/ go cha dang ya lad 92—484

bgos 0)pa drag po'i gzugs can 'jigs par byed pa 'bar ba'i phreng ba'i snying po'i lus so/ /dkyil 'khor gyi re khā tshon sngon ma la/ rdo rje dang mdung rtse gsum pa'i re khā (5)'bar ba dang bcas pa bri bar bya'o/ /re khā 4)rim par phye ba gnyis pa la me tog gi re khā ri bri bar bya'o/ /gsum pa la nor bu rin po che chen po'i skud pa re khā tre bri bar bya'o/ /re khā 7bzhi pa la lag pa'i phyag rgya mtshon cha sna tshogs pa 'dzin pa bri bar bya'o/ /re khā 8lnga pa la kha khyer gyi rnam pa 95bri bar bya ste / tshon sna tshogs pas rnam par phye ba rnam par bkra ba'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi phyi'i khor yug tu mtshan ma'i phyag rgya mtshon cha sna tshogs pa rnams bri bar bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhi rnams su gnod sbyin chen po 1 bzhi bya ste/ drag po drag tu rgod pa'i gzugs can mche ba gtsigs pa bzhin rnam par 'gyur ba 911bum pa gang ba thogs pa/ skra brjes pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa thod pa'i cod pan can 'bar ba'i snying po'i lus can ri bo'i gdan la gnas par bya'o / /dkyil 'khor gyi re khra'i 12phyi rol du phreng gsum /lha'agyur du bri bar bya'o/ /pad+ma dang / ut+pa la sngon po dang / tsam pa ka dang / sna ma'i me tog dang /pāk+ṣi laka dang / a dhi muk+ta ka rnams rnam par dbye bar bya'o/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis dkyil 'khor legs par bri bar byas nas shin tu rnam par phye ba / shin tu mkhas pa dkyil 'khor gyi khor yug tu rgyan dang / rta babs bzhis skamadzes par byas pa/ khor yug tu mda' dang / tshon sna tshogs kyis rnam par bkra ba'i ba dan dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / bla re dang / dar dpyangs dang / khor yug tu bum pa gang ba bcu drug dang / gtor ma'i bum pa bcu drug dang / de bzhin du bdug pa'i snod 92—485

bcu drug dang / gzhing pa bcu drug tu rab tu brjod do/ /kham phor 6)bcu drug tu bshad pa dang / dri sna tshogs pa'i snod dang / lhung bzed bcu drug nyid dang / mchod yon gyi snod bcu drug dang / dngul gyi snod bzhi dang /dri'i phye ma rnams bzhag cing gtor ma'i bum pa bcu drug bzhag nas pog phor bzhi'i nang du tsan+dan dang / a ga ru dang du ru ska 92dang pog dang / gu gul gyi bdug pa sreg cing de bzhin du smṛ ka nadang / sra rtsi pog dang / gur gum dang / gla rtsi dang / bo 4la dang / ga pur tsam dang yang dag par ldan pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad kyi byug pa 'di nye bar gzhag par bya'o/ /tsan+dan dang / gur gum dang / de bzhin du dzi (5)lha dang / bsri ku'i phye ma rnams thams cad yang dag par sbyar ba 'dis phye mar sbyar bas bsgos pa'o/ /me tog sna tshogs gcal du bkram zhing ji ltar 'dod pa/ ji ltar stong pa dang /ji ltar thob pa'i me tog mdzes pa mngon par gtor bar bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi khor yug tu dri'i chus gang ba'i bum pa ma reg pa dang gser dang / dngul las byung ba'i snod gsar pa nyid dang / zangs dang sa las byung ba'i mchog dang / dri sna tshogs sbyar bas dgang bar bya'o/ /bum pa dang bkra shis bcing bar bya zhing pi wang dang / gos bzang po dang / rgyan dang / lhab lhub rnams kyis brgyan par bya'o/ /ring bsrel pad+ma'i steng du bzhag nas bum pa dang / gtsug tor gyi mtshan nyid dang / sna ma'i me tog dang / gdu bu byas nas gzhag par bya'o/ /dbus kyi 0snying po'i dkyil 'khor du snying po dang / nye ba'i snying po nyid kyi gsang sngags stong phrag brgyad bzlas so/ /de nas gtor ma'i las la mnyam par bzhag nas sna tshogs pa'i gzugs rnam pa sna tshogs dang /92—486

dkar po dang / de bzhin du sna tshogs pa'i gzugs nyid dang sna tshogs pa'i ro gzhag par bya'o/ /rnam pa sna tshogs su phye ba'i sna tshogs pa'i gzugs dang /sna tshogs pa'i rnam pa dang / sna tshogs pa'i kha dog dang ro nyid dang sna tshogs pa'i yul du rgyu ba ste/ 'di ni gtor mar brjod de/ 'byor pa'i gtor mar bshad do/ /dkyil 'khor gyi khor yug tu rgyan gdags 1te sna tshogs pa'i 'bras bu rgya chen po dang / sna tshogs pa'i lo ma sngon po'i phreng ba dang / mar me'i phreng ba brgya rtsa brgyad dang / ji ltar rnyed pa'i mar dang til mar gyis (5kun nas bkang ba brgya rtsa brgyad do/ /bdag dngos grub 'dod pa rnams phye dang /la phug dang / dkar dang / la du dang / sran ma mud ga'i la du dang /'bras bu rnams de bzhin du log 'dren la gtor mar byin pas las thams cad bde blag tu 'grub bo/ /phye'i zan dang / zho'i nying khu dang / lo ma sngon po nyid (5)gnod sbyin dang / srin po kun nas phyogs bzhir gnas pa rnams la gtor mar sbyin par bya'o/ /zhi'i zan dang 'o ma 4yang ste/ 'di ni 'byung po'i gtor mar bshad do/ /lo ma'i gong bu dang / phye dang / 'bras thug 5po che'i zan dang / de bzhin du 'khur ba zlum po ste/ 'di ni phyogs bzhir yi dgas dang sha za rnams la gtor mar sbyin par bya'o/ /'bras thug ( po che dang / 'o ma'i zan ni zla ba dang / nyi ma'i tshogs kyis 7lhan cig pa'i lha dang rgyu skar rnams kyi gtor mar bya'o/ /rtag tu tsan+dan gyi chu dang / de bzhin du me tog dang 'o ma'i zan ni mtshan mo'i lha la gtor mar sbyin par bya ste las kyi dngos grub bla na med pa'o/ /'bru bdun mdzes pa chen po dang / shing snu ha mchog tu mdzes pa/ 'bras ā ma khu ba skol ba mdzes pa dang / zho dang 'o ma so sor 92—487

mnyam pa dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu dang bcas pa rnam pa bdun po sa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha la gtor mar sbyin par bya'o/ /sa kurba (1)dang / rtsab mo dang / 'bras thug tshon po che btsos pa'i khu ba dang ldan pa 'di rlung lha'i gtor mar brjod de / rlung gi dkyil 'khor thams cad dgyes par byed do/ /zho dang 'o ma bskol ba dang / 'bras thug tsho nopo che dang / hwags dang bcas shing bu ram dang bcas par ldan pa 'khur ba zlum po dang / mar gyis gang ba'i 'khur ba 'di ni klu'i rgyal po rnams kyi 5gtor mar brjod de las thams cad sgrub pa'o/ /'khur ba zlum po dang / ba byung lnga dang / pu shel tse dang /ma la ya'i tsan+dan dang / 'bras thug phyi po che dang / zhabs bsil dang /mchod yon rnams bdud kyi dkyil 'khor la gtor mar sbyin par bya'o/ /gur gum gyi chu dang 'bras thug 7 po che la dri bzang pos bsgos te/ chu klung gi rgyal po la gtor mar sbyin par bya'o/ /thams cad du las thams cad sgrub par rin byed do / / rtswa drar 9ba'i chu dang / 'o ma dang / gtum pa'i sa bon btsos 7pa dang / 'bras thug 11po che ni tshangs pa'i srin po 12nyid dang / gsang ba pa /rmogernams la gtor mar dbul bar bya ste thams cad rig 1 pas so/ /'di ni gtor mar brjod de15/ bgegs rnams kyi dkyil 'khor sgrub par byed pa la bgegs rnams ji srid 'tsho'i bar du dga' bar 'gyur sate the tsom nyi tshomed do/ /de'i phyir rig sngags 'chang mkhas pas thams cad legs par bsgrub par bya'o/ /zho dang 'o ma dang 'o thug dang / bu ram dang mar dang / li kha ra dang ldan pa 'dis bdag skyes pa'i rgyu skar gyi lha la gtor mar sbyin par bya ste/ che'i dngos grub dang / de bzhin du rgyas pa dang / zhi ba dang / sdig pa thams cad zlog tshon92—488

par byed do6)/ /'di ni gtor mar brjod de narig sngags 'chang rnams kyi bde ba thob pa'o/ /bya ba gang yin pa de rnams la bdag gi gtor ma thun gsum du byas na/ rig sngags 'chang rnams kyi rig sngags dang / gsang sngags bde blag tu 'grub ste zhu the tsom ri4)med do/ /de'i bgegs thams cad dang sdig pa dang / sdang ba rnams nam 5yang bar du gcod par mi nus te nam yang phyis sdig pa mi 'byung ngo / /rtag tu gtor ma rgyas pa thob par byed cing / stobs dang brtson 'grus dang ldan pa dang thams cad thogs pa med par 'gyur 6ro/ /de lta bu byed bzhin pa'i rig sngags smra ba'i mkhas pa de bgegs rnams thams cad kyis de nam du yang mthong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / 'byung po dang sha zas sdang bar byed pa med do/ /nad med cing rgyal po'i tsodapal min med la skem byed dang / skem pa med la brjed byed dang /klu dang / gza' dang / rims med cing thams cad kyi tshe cung zad kyang med do / /dug med cing sbyar ba'i dug nyid kyang med la byad stems thams cad kyang nam yang mi yong ste/ kun nas dpag tshad stong phrag tu ring du 'bros par byed do / /kun nas stobs nyid rgyas pa dang de bzhin du yang dga' ba dang / de bzhin du yang stobs dang brtson 'grus dang gzi brjid 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /thams cad du phyag rgya dang gsang sngags dang cho ga zhib mo thams cad kyi dngos grub thob par byed do/ /tshe ring du 'phel zhing lha dang mi rnams kyi mchod pa'i 'os su 'gyur ro/ /skyes pa'i rgyu skar gyi lha gang yin pa yang dri yongs su 'dzin par 'gyur zhing de rnams thams cad kyi ji srid 'tsho'i bar du stobs dang brtson 'grus 'phel bar byed par the tsom 8med do/ /de la dgra mi 'byung zhing nam du 92—489

yang phyir rgol ba dang dgra bo med de phyag rgya 'dzin pa nyid med kyang dkyil 'khor gyi mchog tu zhugs pa tsam gyi mod la'am/ yang na 'jug pa'i dkyil 'khor mthong ba tsam la de rnams kyi lus de bzhin gshegs pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag bcu'i byin gyis brlabs pa'i lus su 'gyur ro//de bzhin gshegs pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i drung du bsod nams kyi phung po rab tu skye bar 'gyur 6)te/ri rab chen po dang mnyam pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po chen po yongs su 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag gang gā'i klung tshonagi bye ma snyed dgu bcu rtsa dgu dang mnyam pa'i drung du dge ba'i rtsa ba chen po dang yang dag par ldan par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs kyi dam tshig gsang ba dang / cho ga zhib mo dang / gsang sngags rnams kyi dngos grub chen po so sor rnyed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi ris thun mong ba'i tshogs bsdus pa'i sar bgrod ( dade phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi lha'i gnas na gnas pa dang / lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang /sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha'i tshogs dang lhan cig thams cad du srung ( skab dang bskyab pa dang sba ba'i ched du yang dag par sgrub par 'gyur ro/ /lag na rdo rje dang rig pa 'dzin pa'i dbang po du ma rig pa 'dzin pa byed pa'i tshogs kyis (5)yongs su bskor zhing rtag tu rjes su 'brang ba rnams srung phyirab dang bskyab pa dang sba ba'i ched du yang dag par sgrub 7par 'gyur ro/ /stobs chen po dang brtson 'grus dang pha rol gnon pa dang mdangs kyi rnam pa so sor rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /dkyil 'khor mthong ba tsam gyi mod la bskal pa bye bar brgyud nas bsags pa'i 92—490

sdig pa dang sgrib pa dang / mtshams med pa lnga'i 'gro ba rnams dang mnar med pa la gzhol ba de thams cad yongs su zad cing yongs su gtugs par 'gyur ro//thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed do/ /don yod pa'i bya ba'i dngos grub so sor rnyed do/ /sgrib pa dang nyon mongs pa'i rnyog pa'i dri ma dang ser sna'i dri ma thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten thams cad dga' ba dang bla ma chen po mchod par 'os par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mthong bar 'dod par yang 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis 1tshortag tu mchog stsol bar byed cing bla mar 'gyur ro/ /'chi 'phos te skye ba rje ba nan bsams (kyepa nyid kyi mod la bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams su pad+ma las rdzus ④te skye bar 'gyur ro/ /dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig gi bla mar shes par bya/ mchod par bya/ 'od dpag med dang / spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang mthu chen thob kyi bkod pa dang 'dra bar blta bar bya'o/ / des na 55rig sngags 'chang dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon des kyang dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa byas nas kun nas mtshams bcing ba byas shing / srung ba'i phyi cho ga byas la bdag bcing ba dang / gtsug tor bcing ba dang mtshams bcing ba byas te / de'i 'og tu kha shar du phyogs te dkyil 'khor la mngon du phyogs pas naskyil mo krung gis 'dug la don yod pa pad+ma'i 5)gtsug tor stong phrag brgyad bzlas 1 par bya'o/ /gu gul la lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa'i bdug spos dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dbus kyi snying po'i dkyil 'khor du pad+ma'i ge sar gyi dbus su tshangs pa'i cha byad 'chang ba pad+ma dang zhags pa thogs te/ bzhengs nas 92—491

phyogs bcur rnam par gzigs par mdzad de rig sngags 'chang la bka' stsal pa/rig sngags 'chang legs so legs so/ /khyod kyis 0)rig pa 'dzin pa grub po don yod pa'i zhags pa pad+ma gtsug tor gyi rig pa'i rgyal po 'di rjes su zung shig(5) /rig sngags 'chang ji ltar yid la byed pa bzhin du 'dod pa'i mchog thams cad sbyin par 'gyur ro/ /'di ni rig sngags 'chang de rnams kyi mngal du gnas pa'i skye ba'i tha ma yin te skye ba brjes 5)nas thams cad du pad+ma las rdzus risate skye bar 'gyur ro/ / thams cad du tshe rabs dran par 'gyur zhing thams cad du skye ba dran par 'gyur ro/ /5skye ba nas skye ba thams cad du don yod zhags pa'i dkyil 'khor mtha' dag dang cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po mtha' dag kha ton du byed do/ /don yod zhags pa'i gtsug tor dri ma med pa kha ton du kun tu gnas so / /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi zhabs drung du mchod yon dang zhabs bsil dbul bar bya/ a ga (5skuru'i bdug pa 57skudabul bar bya/ me tog ji ltar 'byor pa dbul bar bya/ gshegs su gsol bar bya ste/ de nas na 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /de lta bu byas nas rig sngags 'chang nam mkha' tshoral 'gro'o/ /don yod pa'i gtsug tor pad+ma dri ma med pa'i 'od zer gyi bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin so sor thob ste1 / rig pa 'dzin pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag drug cu rtsa bzhis yongs su bskor bar 'gyur zhing pad+ma'i ris 11kyi 'khor los sgyur 1 bar 'gyur ro/ /tshe lo bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag dgu bcu 1 rtsa dgur 'gyur ro/ /dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dang sgrub thabs kyi cho ga'o// //92—492
