de nas de'i ras ris bshad par bya ste/ don yod pa'i zhags pa pad+ma gtsug tor gyi rig pas ras khru bzhi pa byas nas sam yang na dar la bal tshon sna tshogs pas rnam par phye ste/ lha'i gzugs mchog tu mdzes pa phyag gnyis pa 'od zer gyis (1)'khor bar bya'o/ /ras ris sgrub pa ni dkar po'i phyogs kyi tshes bcwa rdzu lnga la tshon lhag ma min pa snod gsar par bzhag pas ri mo mkhan gtsang ma legs par khrus byas pas 'drir zhigazhug par bya'o/ /dbus su 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug tshangs pa'i cha byad 'chang ba pad+ma rgyas pas yongs su bskor ba bya ste/ khor yug tu 'od 'dom gang ba kun nas 'bar ba'i phreng ba can phyag bzhi pa/ zhal gsum pa ral pa'i cod pan gyis brgyan 4pa zla ba tshes pas spras pa/ 'od dpag med kyi cod pan 'chang ba mdung rtse gsum 'chang ba/pad+ma'i 'dab po ma rnam par bkra ba'i pad+ma'i zhags pa 'chang ba/ phyag g.yon par pad+ma 'chang ba pad+ma'i steng du pad+ma gtsug tor bya'o/ /'dab tshim phyed kha bye ba'i dbus kyi pad+ma'i 'dab tsho ma la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mgul yan chad tsam cod pan 'chang ba dbu 'bar ba'i snying por yod par bri bar bya'o/ /phyag gcig ni dbugs 'byin pa 'chang zhing rin po che'i char 'bebs pa/ 'bar ba'i snying po can rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa sna tshogs pa'i gos 'chang ba bya'o/ /pad+ma'i gdan la klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang nye dga' bo mgo bo dgu pa/ klus na yongs su bskor ba dang bcas pa thal mo 'chang zhing lus phyed 9)par bya'o/ /nya dang chu srin dang / me tog sna tshogs dang / nor bu shel dang / ngang pa dang / ngur pa dang / shang shang te'us yang dag par brgyan 1 pa'i kha khyer dang bcas pas spras pa'o/ /gzhogs g.yas 92—493

su sgrol (1)ma rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ thal mo sbyar ba smad de 'dzin pa/'bar ba'i snying po'i lus can bya'o/ /g.yon du gos dkar mo gos dkar po 'chang ba rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa 'bar ba'i snying po'i lus can thal mo snang (gede 'chang ba'o/ /gzhogs g.yas su khro gnyer can skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu dkar sham ma gos dkar po 'chang ba bya'o58ri / /g.yon du srin mo chen mo nanoral pa gcig ma bya ste/ phyag brgyad pa drag mo drag tu rgod pa'i pho nya mo bya'o/ /bzhin khro gnyer can thams cad skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa rgyan thams cad kyis (5)rnam par brgyan pa thams cad pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs 6pa bya'o/ /steng du tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang /dbang phyug chen po dang / lha'i dbang po rnams nam mkha' nas bcom ldan 'das dang bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byed bzhin pa bya'o/ /'og tu pad+ma la gshin rje dang chu lha dang / lus ngan dang gzhon nu rnams khrus bya ste skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa bya'o/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi rnams bya ste/ drag po'i gzugs skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs te de rnams thams cad kyang pad+ma 'dzin pa'i gzugs su bya'o/ /rig sngags 'chang ni bcom ldan 'das dang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi zhabs drung du pad+ma'i gdan la rig sngags 'chang pus mo btsugs 7pa bya ste/ pog phor dang lag na me tog gi phor pa dang / bgrang phreng na'adzin pa bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal la lta 59 bar byed bzhin pa bya'o/ /de lta bu'i 1 ras ris kyi bya ba pad+ma yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor mtha' dang / ras ris dkyil 'khor mtha' dag gi nang du gtogs par 'gyur ro/ /mthong ba tsam gyi mod la sdug bsngal dang sdig pa dang ngan 'gro thams cad rnam par nyams par 92—494

byed do/ /thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /'gro ba thams cad gcod par 'gyur ro/ / nyes par 51)byas pa thams cad 'joms par yang 'gyur ro/ /sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dang mtshams med pa lnga las rnam par thar (5)bar byed do/ /mthong ba tsam gyi mod la don yod pa'i dngos grub so sor thob bo/ /sems can thams cad kyis ( rikun du bskor bar bya ba dang mchod par bya ba'i 'os su 'gyur ro/ /dgongs pa thams cad legs par grub par byed par 'gyur ro / /bde bar byed par 'gyur ro/ /nor dang / gzugs byed pa dang /bkra shis dang / longs spyod dang / rigs cadang / dbang phyug dang /stobs dang / spobs pa dang / bsod nams dang / skal ba 5)bzang por byed pa dang / bdag nyid chen po'i yon tan gyi bye brag 67'phel ba dang bsod nams bsags pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba mngon par 'phel ba dang phun sum tshogs par byed do/ /mthong ba tsam gyi 7)mod la las su bya bar 'os pa'i bya ba thams cad byed do/ /de ltar ras ris mthong ba tsam gyi mod la yon tan gyi bye brag lhag par rtogs par 'gyur ro zhes so/ /ras ris sgrub pa'i cho ga dang sgrub (8)thabs kyi cho ga'o// //de nas phyag rgya bshad par bya ste/ phyag rgya rnams kyi don yod pa'i 'khor los sgyur 49)ba phyag rgya chen po bla na med pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi 1 rgyas btab pa / sems can thams cad la phan par byed pa don yod pa'i phyag rgya thams cad dang sgrub thabs thams cad kyi dngos grub bla na med pa/ sdig pa thams cad zad par byed pa nyid dang phyag rgya'i dam tshig gi dngos grub bla na med pa/92wa 495

phyag rgya gzung 1)ba tsam gyis mnar med pa yang skems du par byed pa dmyal ba pa rnams skems 3)par byed pa ste/ gang gis bzung ba tsam la sogs pas dmyal ba pa'i sems can thams cad grol bar byed cing skems 54par byed do/ /dus gsum pa'i 55de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rgyal ba de rnams thams cad kyis dgongs par 'gyur ro/ /phyogs bcu kun du gzigs par 'gyur te the tsom 56med do/ /dus gsum pa'i 7rgyal ba dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad dang / de bzhin du pad+ma'i phyag gi 58)rtag tu mchog sbyin pa dang rtag tu mthong bar 'dod pa dang / lha rnams kyis rtag tu srung bar byed cing dga' ba dang / 'og min gyi lha dang lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha thams cad kyis srung 9 bar byed cing kun nas yongs su skyong bar byed de/thams cad la cho ga bzhin du bdag nyid kyi snying las skyes pa'i bu bzhin du dge ba dang zhi ba dang / stobs dang / brtson 'grus nyid dang / mdangs kyang rab tu 'jug par byed cing de bzhin du yang tshe 'phel lo/ /phyag rgya 'di rnams bzung bas 1 bkra mi shis pa thams cad nyams par byed do/ /bgegs thams cad nyams par byed cing / bdud dang / log par 'dren pa dang / gdug nyu1pa'i gnod sbyin rnam par nyams par byed do/ /gdug pa'i srin po dang yi dgas thams cad kyang phyag rgya 'dzin bzhin pa'i skad cig de la mgo bo tshal pa bdun du 'gas shing mig 'byin par byed do/ /brgya byin dang tshogs dang bcas pa'i gdug pa thams cad rab tu nyams par byed do/ /de'i phyir yang dag par 'dzin par byed pa la 12lag pa'i thal mo pad+ma 'dra ba pad+ma 'byung ba'i gtsug tor don yod zhags pa'i phyag rgyas sdigs 1 mdzub yongs su dkris la mthe bong gi sor 92wa 496

mo dang / gung mo'i sor mo rab tu brkyangs la lcags kyu'i rnam par bkug ste 1ming med dang / mthe'u chung lag pa'i nang du bcug nas rtag tu snying ga'i 5gnas su gzhag par bya ste/ 'di ni don yod pa pad+ma gtsug tor gyi rtsa ba'i gsang sngags kyi sngags dang phyag rgyar brjod do/ /de bzung ba tsam dang phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags brjod pa nyid kyis dus gsum du gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad rnam par 'gyur ba drug tu g.yos te char 'bab par byed do//me tog gi char dang / lha rdzas kyi gos dang / rgyan dang / lhab lhub rnams mchod pa'i don du kun nas char bab 4bo/ /dus gsum du gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i 5tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad kyis 6bsod nams kyi phung po chen po stong phrag bskyed do/ /phyag rgya de bzung 7ba tsam gyis 8skad cig de la phyag rgya gang gā'i 9klung gi bye ma dang mnyam pa bye ba stong phrag bye ba'i grangs su bgrangs pa'i phyag rgya bcings par 'gyur ro/ /phyag rgya 1 bzung ba tsam gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / de bzhin du thub pa rnam par sna nga mdzad kyi phyag rgyas 11byin gyis rlob 1 bo/ /ri rab kyi tshad dang mnyam pa'i rin po che sna bdun gyi rin po che'i phung por byas te/ dus gsum du gshegs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa so so so so la phul ba dang / rgyal ba thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi phung po chen po 1 thob pa'i grangs kyi tshogs nyid kyang phyag rgya bcings pa tsam gyis 'di'i 1 'bras bur 'gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pas nyin mtshan rtag tu rnam par gzigs par the tsom 15med do zhes so/ /phyag rgya 'di nyid las g.yas pa'i mdzub mo brkyangs te rtsa ba'i gsang sngags lan cig 10brjod do/ /phyag rgya 'di ni don yod zhags pa'i gtsug tor dri ma med pa'i chu 92—497

skyes kyi stobs spyan ras gzigs kyi snying po zhes bya ste/ thams cad du las thams cad legs par thob par byed do/ /phyag rgya 'di bcings pa tsam gyis kyang bsod nams kyi tshogs thams cad dang spyan ras gzigs don yod pa dri ma med pa'i dngos grub tu yang 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gzigs pa dag pa'i snying po'i phyag rgya yang dag par 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /sdig pa dang ngan 'gro dang log par ltung ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /phyag rgya 'di bzung ba tsam dang dang po bcings pa tsam gyis 1)ri rab chen po ltar 'gyur te/ bdud dang bgegs la sogs pa thams cad dang / 'byung po dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po thams cad kyis mi 'gul zhing mi g.yo la zil gyis mi non par yang 'gyur ro/ /phyir rgol ba dang dgra'i 'jigs pa thams cad nas yongs su grol lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma dang mnyam pa bye ba brgya stong phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu'i drung du dge ba'i bsod nams kyi tshogs chen po kun du 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku mngon sum du mthong ba dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /phyag rgya'i (gegasang ba'i lhag par 'dren pa 'di 'ching bzhin pa de de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyag rgya gang cung zad yod pa de mig gis gsal 4)bar mthong ngo/ /thams cad du 45)rab tu 'ching zhing 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /gang yang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 6 'dzin gyi phyag rgya gang yin pa dang / phyag stong gi phyag rgya gang yin pa dang / nor bu'i 7)rigs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi phyag rgya gang yin pa dang / glang po'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi phyag rgya gang yin pa dang /92—498

don yod zhags pa'i yangs pa rgya chen po'i dkyil 'khor gang yin pa dang / rta mgrin (1)gyi phyag rgya gang yin pa dang / mgrin sngon gyi phyag rgya gang yin pa dang /gzhan phyag rgya'i dam tshig gsang ba rnam pa sna tshogs pa gang yin pa de rnams thams cad kyang phyag rgya 'di gcig pu bcings pa tsam gyis de rnams thams cad bcings par 'gyur zhing yang dag par bzung 95bar 'gyur la/ kun du bcangs ①pa dang mchod par yang 'gyur ro/ /'di ni phyag rgya thams cad kyi phyag rgya'i gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du gdugs gcig tsho pur gyur pa ste/ ji ltar 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam par 'phrul pa bzhin du phyag rgya 'di ni sgyu ma lta bu'i phyag rgya'i rnam par 'phrul pa ste / las thams cad la phyag rgya 'di sbyar na/ gang dang gang la rab tu sbyar ba de thogs pa med par 'grub bo/ /phyag rgya 'di nyid las mdzub 5mo'i sor mo gnyis brkyangs la lcags kyu'i 6rnam pa tsam du bkug pa 'di ni gnas pa'i phyag rgya 'di spyan drang ba 7)dang / bod 8pa dang yang dag par bskul ba dang /mchod pa'i sprin nyid kyang yin te/ dam tshig dang / phyag byed pa dang /'jug pa dang / bskor ba byed pa nyid dag 9rigadan dang / phyogs bcing ba 1 dang / dkyil 'khor bcing ba 1lhadang / mtshams bcing ba /gzhes pa dang /gtsug tor bcing ba dang / bdag srung ba dang / gzhan srung ba dang / de bzhin nyid du grogs srung ba dang / khrus dang / gos bgo ba /lhadang / nye reg byed pa nyid dang/ sbyin sreg dang / de bzhin du sngags skabazlas pa dang /bdug 7pa dang / me tog dang / dri dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang /gtor ma 'bul ba'i las dang / de bzhin du gshegs su gsol ba nyid dang /92wa 499

de bzhin du 'gugs pa ste/ thams cad la phyag rgya 'di bya'o/ /sa bcu gnon pa'i phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags bcu la yang phyag rgya 'di bya ste/ snying po dang /nye ba'i snying po 'di nyid kyang thams cad du sbyar bar bya'o/ /khro bo'i rgyal po nyid dang / mngon par dbang bskur ba dang / rigs kyi gsang sngags dang /gzhan la yang phyag rgya 'di dang / phyag rgya 'di'i snying po dang / nye ba'i snying po nyid kyang rab tu sbyar bar bya'o/ /khro bo'i rgyal po'i mngon par dbang bskur ba dang / rigs kyi gsang sngags gzhan la yang gnas thams cad du sbyar bar bya'o zhes so/ /phyag rgya'i cho ga dang sgrub thabs kyi cho ga'o// //7911phyag rgya gsum ni rnam sprul pa/ /phyag rgya de dag yang dag bstan/ /bzang po gtso bo chen po ste/ /mchog dang rab mchog nyid yin no/ /phyag rgya gya rnam bla 2na med/ /'jig rten 'dren pas bstan pa yin/ /snying po de nyid gyur pa ste / /phyag rgya dkyil chen legs par bsgrubs/ /sangs rgyas byang chub phyag rgya 'di / /dus gsum gtogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs/ /kun gyis 'di ni byin gyis brlabs/ /phyag rgya dus gsum gshegs pa yi/ /de bzhin gshegs pas phyag rgyar btab/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas chen po pa/ /thub pa snang mdzad kyis kyang btab/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs dkyil gyi/ /gsang nyid kun du bzhugs pa yin/ /de nas gsang sngags gsang ba nyid/ /dngos grub bla med bshad par bya/ /oṃ a mo gha ṣ+ṭṛ da ya pad+ma usnri 4rig 95༄r+sā dha ya/ bha ra sam bha ra / ma hā pad+me swā hā/ bskul ba dang spyan drang ba dang / gshegs su gsol ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ pad+ma usnri 6ga a mo gha maṇ+ḍa le hūm̐/ dkyil 'khor bsrung 7ri92—500

ba dang / phyogs bcing ba 91nodang / mtshams bcad pa dang / dri chab dang /chu dang / yungs kur tshonabasres pa la lan bdun bzlas brjod byas pas bya'o/ /oṃ pad+ma shi kha re )rtsu/ spyi gtsug bcing ba yin te/ lan bdun bzlas brjod byas pas so/ /oṃ pad+ma usnri (cig a ri5mo gha dza le sgyu rtsu/ khrus bya ba'i sngags te yungs kur 97tshodang / chu la lan bdun bzlas brjod byas pas so i bi ma le shud dhe hūm̐/ nye reg bya ba'i sngags naso/ /oṃ saṃ ts+tsha 9da ya pad+me hūm̐/ gos bgo ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ mi li mi li shud dhe hūm̐/ lus yongs su sbyang ba'i sngags te/ba'i rnam lnga'i chu la lan bdun bzlas brjod byas pas so/ /oṃ pad+ma usnri mig 17a mo gha a bhi ṣiñtsa ād+ma 12shud dhe hūm̐/ dbang bskur ba'i sngags te dri chab la lan bdun bzlas brjod byas pas so/ /oṃ pad+ma ka ba tse dṛ 12nye ban dha hūm̐ dz+wa la swā hā / go cha'i sngags te/ lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod byas pas so o badz+ra a rnyiṣ+ṭha lon pad+me hūm̐/ byin gyis brlab pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ dz+wa la pad+me dha ra dha ger hūm̐/ sa'i sngags so/ /oṃ pad+ma tshas shra ya/ ru ha tsa la tsa la hūm̐/gdan gyi sngags so/ /oṃ di 51 bya pad+me mi/ me tog gi sngags so/ /oṃ pad+ma a mo gha saṃ ba ra ṇi sna swā hā/ bdug spos kyi sngags so/ /oṃ pad+ma gan dha yī 39shwa ri )rtsu/byug spos kyi sngags so/ /oṃ pad+ma pra kiṇ+ḍa 21snya ra ṇi sa me swā 22hā/ 'bras yos dang me tog dgram pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ pad+ma dza na le su gan dha ba ti hūm̐/ mchod yon dbul ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ shu ga la bā 4re rā pas ya shud dhe hūm̐/ lha bshos kyi sngags so/ /oṃ su ru su ru kum bha ba ti swā hā/ gtor ma'i sngags so / /oṃ ma hā pad+ma a shi ni sā na dha ya hūm̐/ gtor ma zar gzhug pa'i sngags so / /oṃ pha la bi shud dhe pra ba ra hūm̐/ 'bras bu'i sngags so/ /oṃ pra ba ra pukhye 92wa 501

dza ya swā hā/ phreng ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la 0)ya ra chas ra sā kṛ ṇi ni:/gtor ma bcos pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ pad+ma dī ④pa ya dz+wa la hūṃ/ mar me'i sngags so / /oṃ sa ma pad+ma bhu 5rib ne ṣā yis ra hūm̐/ 'jug pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ pad+ma usnri 7ga a mo gha mu ni hūm̐/ phyag bya na ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ tsakra maṇ+ḍa le sa man+ta ⑨pad+me hūm̐/ bskor ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ sa man+ta pra kyir ṇa ⑩pad+me saṃ bha ra hūm̐/ me tog dor ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ pad+ma sa ma ya usnri ṣa ma hā a mo gha sa ma ya hūm̐/dam tshig gi sngags so/ /oṃ sa man+ta sā dha tumar ṇi dha ra pho pad+me hūm̐ phaṭa/ skyil mo krung 1 gi sngags so/ /oṃ a pa ri mi tā rnying la pad+me hūm̐/ bgrang phreng gi sngags so//oṃ sha ta sa ha sra 15tsa li ta 7pad+me dha ra dha ra hūm̐/ bzlas brjod kyi sngags so/ /oṃ sa man+ta dar+ṣa 1 pad+me hūm̐/ rmi lam gyi sngags so/ /oṃ sa man+ta rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ni lhoshepad+me hūm̐/ srung 19ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ sa man+ta me ni )ru dṛ 27nye sbri ()ri hūm̐/ ra ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ sa man+ta dz+wa lā na ma la gar+bhe / dz+wa la dz+wa la/ ma hā pad+me py-i gleng le hūm̐/me'i sngags so/ /oṃ dhu ru dhu ru pra sa ra/ dhu sa (9ri man tre 6 tshog hā/ sbyin sreg gi sngags so/ /oṃ sa man+ta pra dz+wa li te byud dhe sa ma ya hūm̐/( —snye sreg blugs ()kyi sngags so/ /oṃ sa man+ta a ba lo ki ta ༷ )gu h+ye bā yu dzā (1be pad+ma be gi du nyeni swā hā/nam mkha' la /'gro ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ shu bha sha s+t+ra dhā ri rdo staṇi (nyepad+ma bhu dze (lhahūm̐ / mtshon cha'i sngags so/ /oṃ sa man+ta ā kur+sha ṇi 6)pra sa ra gu h+ye hūṃ/ drang ba'i sngags so/ /na mo tri /bhu ba na/ sī shwa rā ya(pe/ lo ke shwa rā 4 )ya/ ma he 1shwa rā ya ge/ dha ra dha ra/ sa man+ta/ a ba lo ki ta( / gu h+ye/ ā gats+tsha bha ga bā na / dhi ri dhi ri/ ma hā bi ri/ ma ṇi kun ka sa badz+ra be+e (lhaḍūr+ya(rte/ ma ra ka ta pad+ma rā rnag /in+d+ra nī la/ ma hā musti ge'i tsho/ bi bhū 5gle'i ta sha rī 5 ra/92—502

ma hā pad+ma bhu 6nyedza/ a mo gha pā sha dha ra/ sa man+ta/ a ba lo ki ta/ ba rinasar dā ba ra dā ya ka /dz+wa la dz+wa la/ sa man+ta/ a ba lo ki ta( ci/ ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha ) / bha ga bān(5ri/ shī s+t+waṃ (6)sa ma ya/ ma nu sma ra/ bi bi dha be ṣa dha ra/ya ma ba ru ṇa/ ku be ra/ na ma skṛ 7)ta/ yī shwa ra/ ma he shwa ra/ pad+me shwa ra / (8)e (she༄gyi bha ga bān7/ shī s+t+waṃ ā gats+tsha/1/ sarba bit+yā nyanamaṇ+ḍa la/ sa ma ya 3 snyem nu sma ra/ da ri yisha na swa sna'i/ bi bi dha late dza dha ra/ sa man+ta rasmi/dz+wa /tsho snal gar+bha sha rī ra12/ ma hā kā ru ṇi 19ka ya / sau 21ma su 2myu kha/ pa ri pū ra ṇa rte/ tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la/ na ba 2 tsan+d+ra dza ṭa nadha ra tsho/ a mi tā bha 7/ mu 2nyaku ṭa sarkyesnya ra ya dī/ ma hā brah+ma dmabe ṣa nadha ra/ tri lo tsa na a mo gha ba ra dā snye/bhu ru bhu ru/ ma hā kā ru ṇi ka /pad+ma pā sha tsho gis ba lo ki te/ shud dha satwa/ba ra dā ya(6/ na mo stu te swā hā/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gshegs su gsol ba'i sngags so/ rig sngags 'dis gu gul nag po la lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod byas nas/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la bdug par bya'o/ /bdugs 7pa tsam gyi mod nyid la/ 'phags pa spyan ras (shegazigs dbang phyug gi gzugs kyis sa ston par mdzad cing / mchog thams cad sbyin par mdzad do/ /gal te mtshams med pa lnga byed pa mnar med par gzhol ba des kyang / bdugs pa tsam gyis nges par ston par mdzad na/dge slong tshangs par legs par spyod pa bsam pa dag pa/ dad pa 1can mos pa la ( lta smos kyang ci dgos/ mod nyid la rang gi gzugs rang gi ngo bo yongs su dag pa mngon sum du lhaston par mdzad cing / mchog thams cad sbyin par mdzad la don yod pa chen po'i dngos grub sbyin par mdzad do/ /drag po la 92wa 503

bdugs na gzugs mngon sum du mdun 17na 'dug cing / 'dod pa dang / dgos pa'i nadangos grub thams cad sbyin par byed do/ /srid med kyi bu la bdugs na gzugs brnyan 'gul zhing / tshig 'byin la yid la bsams skupa thams cad yongs su rdzogs capar byed/ rtag tu rjes su 'brang 5ribar 'gyur/stobs dang / shugs dang / brtson 'grus dang / pha rol gnon par byed (6)pa'i dngos grub sbyin par byed do/ /ma mo'i gnas su nag po chen po la bdugs (7rin nag po chen po ma mo'i 8tshogs dang bcas pa dbang du gyur nas 'dug la las dang bya ba thams cad grub par byed/ thams cad du dngos grub 9richen po sgrub par byed do/ /tshogs kyi dbang phyug la bdugs na/ bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad bcings par 'gyur ro/ /'dod pa'i dbang phyug la bdugs na sdang ba 1 dang / gdug pa 11dang / bar chad byed pa gzhan gang yin pa de dag thams cad bcings par 'gyur zhing mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po'i sgor bdugs na rgyal po'i btsun mo'i 12'khor dang bcas pa bkug nas dbang du gyur /rite / nye bar gnas pa 1 'dod pa dang bya ba thams cad byed do/ /nyi ma shar ba'i tshe nyi ma la 15mngon du phyogs nas bdugs na nyi ma 'bab cing 'dod pa'i dngos grub 17thams cad sbyin par byed do/ /zla ba nya la bdugs na zla ba 'bab cing dbang phyug 'byor pa chen po sbyin par byed do/ /rnam thos kyi bu la bdugs na nor 'phel 1 ba chen po sbyin par byed do/ /lha mo chen mo dpal la bdugs na dpal 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /gdon thams cad la bdugs na 18bdugs pa tsam gyis 'bab cing phyogs bcur 'bros so/ /zin pa'am ma zin pa la bdugs 19na mod la 'ong ngo / /dur khrod kyi mi ro la bdugs na ro langs ldang bar 'gyur 92wa 504

ro / /thod pa la bdugs na 'bab cing gar byed/ glu len rgyug par byed cing sbod gtong 0)byed do/ /rdo rje la bdugs na 'bar ro/ /mdung rtse gsum pa la bdugs na 'bab par byed do/ /'khor lo la bdugs na nam mkha' la 'gro'o/ /thag pa la bdugs na sbrul bzhin 'khril bar byed don/ /rdza ma dang / bum pa la bdugs na 'bab par byed cing rang nyid 'gyur bar byed la phan tshun 'gro bar byed do/ /lhung bzed 3la bdugs na rang nyid 'gro bar byed do/ /ral gri la bdugs can 'bab par byed cing 'bar bar byed la rang nyid 'gro bar byed do/ /dung la bdugs nas bus na sgra gang du grag 5pa de dag thams cad du 6'thab pa dang / 'thab 7mo dang / rtsod pa dang / 'gyed pa dang / yams kyi nad dang / gnod pa dang / 'go ba'i nad dang / 'khrug pa dang / nad thams cad dang / nyon mongs pa thams cad dang / sdig pa dang / gdug 8pa thams cad dang / dgra 19thams cad las thar bar 'gyur zhing sgrib pa thams cad zad par 'gyur ro/ /rims thams cad la bdugs na/ rims 1 thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /rims nyin bzhi pa la bdugs shing 11gsang sngags kyang rjes su dran na rims nyin bzhi pa ku 12co 'don cing 'bros par 'gyur ro/ /klu'i mtshor bdugs na mod nyid la char gyi 1 rgyun chen po 'bebs 1 par byed do/ /char ches na gnas mthon por bdugs na char ches pa gcod par byed do/ /sprin la mngon du phyogs nas bdugs na grang lhags dang / rlung dang / ser ba thams cad gcod par byed la15/ lo gcig gi bar du mtshams chen po bcad ’ par 'gyur ro/ /ri mthon po'i rtser bdugs na/ phyogs bzhi thams cad kyi pha rol gyi dmag tshogs dang / phyir rgol ba dang / phas kyi dgra thams cad dang /92wa bya(35

dpag tshad stong gi bar du rmugs pa dang / rengs pa dang / bcings par 'gyur la dpag tshad stong gi bar du mtshams chen po bcad par 'gyur ro/ /bdag nyid la bdugs na sems can thams cad la mchod pa'i gnas chen por 'gyur la sems can thams cad dbang du 'gyur ro/ /bu mo la bdugs na bag mar blangs par 'gyur ro/ /tshong zong la bdugs na rin che bar lon 0)par 'gyur ro/ /bang ba la bdugs na 'bru 'phel ba mang por 'gyur ro/ /btung ba'i gnas su bdugs na btung ba 'phel ba namang por 'gyur ro/ /gos la bdugs na gos thob par 'gyur ro/ /me tog dang 'bras bu la bdugs nas (migang la byin la pa de dag bdag nyid dam 5༄nor gyi sgo nas dbang du 'gyur ro/ /phreng ba la bdugs la 6gsang sngags lan bdun bzlas brjod byas na gang gi mgo la bcings pa de la 'bab par byed cing / ya mtshan byung ba dang 'byung ba smra'o//'phags pa rdo rje 'chang la bdugs na rig (7)sngags chen po'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur zhing / 'phags pa rdo rje 'chang ston par mdzad la dgos pa thams cad sgrub 8)par mdzad do/ /gnod sbyin mo'i ri9)gzugs bris pa tshel bdugs la gsang sngags lan bdun dran par byas na/ gnod sbyin mo 'ongs nas 'dod pa thams cad sbyin zhing las thams cad 11byed par 'gyur la ji srid 'tsho'i bar du nye bar 'dug go/ /sbyor ba mo la bdugs na/ sbyor ba mo thams cad dang /mkha' 'gro ma thams cad dbang du gyur nas ji srid 'tsho'i bar du nye bar 'dug go / /'dod dgur 15sgyur ba'i gzugs can ma snarnyil bdugs thun 'dod dgur 7sgyur ba'i gzugs can ma 'ongs nas chung mar bya'o zhes smra na ji srid 'tsho'i bar du yo byad dang / longs spyod du bya ba thams cad sgrub par byed la 'dod pa'i 92wa 506

yon tan lnga la rtse bas dga' bar 'gyur ba dang / rnam thos kyi bu la 'gran par 'gyur ro/ /dril bu la bdugs nas sgra dkrol na 'jigs pa thams cad las thar bar 'gyur la/ srung 51)ba chen po byas par 'gyur khyim gyi nang du dkrol na 'byung po dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / yi dgas dang / brjed byed dang / grib gnon thams cad byung nas phyogs bcur bros 2par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ a mo gha pā sha pad+ma usnri ṣa/ ta ra ta ra/ a pa ta ra da tu/bha ④ba na gats+tsha (57tu/ swa ri tibhā ba nan47/ tu ru tu ru/ ma hā pad+ma bhu dze swā hā/slar gshegs su gsol ba'i sngags te ri/ bdug (spos gu gul dang / chu dang yungs kur yodang bsres pa la lan bdun bzlas brjod byas na thams cad du slar gshegs su gsol ba'i sngags byas par 'gyur ro/ /gsang sngags rim par phye ba'i cho ga dang bsgrub pa'i cho ga'o// //de nas lha mo chen mo sgrol ma byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' 11chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas lha'i mchod pa'i sprin chen pos mchod de / lan gsum bskor ba byas nas mgo btud de thal mo sbyar nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bcom ldan 'das rig sngags chen po 'jig rten du cher bstan lags so/ /gsang ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor dang / phyag rgya rim par phye ba dang / cho ga zhib mo dang / don yod pa'i zhags pa pad+ma gtsug 92—507

tor gyi 1rig sngags kyi rgyal po chen po'i snying po rig sngags 'chang thams cad kyi don dang / sems can thams cad la phan pa dang / bde bar bgyi ba'i slad du 'dzam bu'i 2gleng du gzhag lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang don yod pa pad+ma gtsug tor gyi rig sngags kyi rgyal po de'i snying po dang (snye/ cho ga zhib mo don yod par sgrol ba dri ma med pa pad+ma gtsug tor gyi zhags pa zhes bgyi ba rig 4sngags kyi rgyal po'i snying po bshad par bgyi ste/ rig sngags 'chang gang gis dran pa tsam gyis 5bdag bkug cing g.yar drangs par 'gyur/ rig sngags 'chang gi 6rig sngags sgrub 7 cing yongs su spyod pa la rim gro (shebagyi ba dang / rig sngags 'chang 9sgrub pa'i dngos grub tsomachog stsol (gebar bgyi ba dang / bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du yongs su bskang zhibar bgyi ba de bdag 1 gis bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'khor mang po 'dus pa'i mngon sum ñtsadu rig sngags kyi rgyal po bshad par bgyi'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas lha mo sgrol ma la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /lha mo chen mo sgrol ma rang gi rig sngags kyi rgyal po de bzhin gshegs pa nga'i /'byin gyi rlabs yikyi phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs kyis 1 shod cig /de nas lha mo chen mo /shesgrol ma bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar don yod par sgrol ba dri ma med pa pad+ma gtsug tor gyi zhags pa zhes bya ba rig sngags kyi snying po smras pa/ na maḥsteya dhī 19ka ṭ+wāṃ/ta 2 thā ga tā māṃ 21shākya rā dzā da ya a dhiṣ+ṭha 2lhan na ma skṛ sa tā ṭ+wāṃ/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya 27a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ na mastu rā yi / ma hā de bi/ oṃ tā ra ge'i tā ra ṇi tā re / pad+ma bi bhū 29k+ṣi ta tā re/ ma ṇi ka na ka bi tsi da tri ta mā nal/ dza ṭa ma ku 92—508

ṭa nan/ di ta pad+me/ dhu ru dhu ru/ pad+ma pā sha bhu dza1ri/ a mo gha pā sha ha ste/tā ra ya bha ga ba ti(na/ ma hā sid dhi ba ra de/ tu ru tu ru/ ma hā tā ra ṇi/ba ra de/ sā dha )ya sā dha 4)ya/ sid dhe/ a mo gha ba ra de 5swā hā/ oṃ a mo gha pad+me (6)ni tā re swā hā/ snying po'o/ oṃ ma ṇi 7ritā re hūm̐/ nye ba'i snying po'o//bcom ldan 'das 'di ni bdag gi 98gsang sngags nor bu rin po che chen po'i snying po/ don yod pa'i zhags pa pad+ma gtsug tor gyi rig sngags kyi snying po'i zhags pa cho ga zhib mo'i 79rig sngags 'chang ba rnams kyi bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par bgyi ba dang / sems can thams cad la mchog stsal ba rab tu stsal bar bgyi skaba'i slad du rjes su stsal ba lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das rig sngags kyi rgyal po 'di'i yo byad dang / cho ga bshad par bgyi ste/ du ru ska 11dang / gu gul dang / spro 12ka gcig tu bgyis la gsang sngags kyi snying po 'dis sna lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis 1 nas bcom ldan 'das bdag la bdugs na dbadugs pa tsam gyi mod la bcom ldan 'das bdag dgug pa dang / g.yar drangs 7par 'gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das rig sngags 'di sgrub pa'i tshe rang gi gzugs kyis mdun na mchis shing bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du dngos grub rjes su stsal bar bgyi/ bgegs dang / log 'dren thams cad bzlog par bgyi/ gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / 'byung po dang / sha za thams cad bzlog par bgyi/ 'thab pa dang / 'thab 1 mo dang /rtsod pa dang / 'gyed pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar bgyi/ bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du rdzogs par bgyi/ mchog stsal bar bgyi/1 bde legs dang / dge legs bsrung 19ba dang / bskyab pa dang / sba bar bgyi'o/ /92wa 509

bcom ldan 'das mchis nyal ba na bdug spos kyi rgyal po 'dis bdag la bdugs shing / bdag gi snying po nor bu rin po che chen po'i snying po gsum po de dag lan nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod na bdugs pa tsam gyi mod dang / dran pa tsam gyis 1bcom ldan 'das bdag nyid kyi ngo bo rang gi gzugs yongs su dag pa bstan cing / mngon sum du mchis par bgyi/ mchog thams cad rjes su stsal bar bgyi/ byung ba dang 'byung ba'i bka' mchid bgyi'o/ /dran pa tsam gyi mod la don yod dpad+ma gtsug tor gyi zhags pa'i snying po 'di dran pa tsam gyis/bcom ldan 'das bdag rig sngags 'chang de'i mdun du mchis shing bsam 50pa thams cad yid bzhin du yongs su rdzogs par bgyi 4)/ sdang ba dang / sdig pa thams cad dang / bgegs dang / log 'dren thams cad so sor bzlog par bgyi / dngos grub chen po bsgrub pa rjes su stsal bar bgyi/ bkra shis kyi sgra thams cad 'byung bar bgyi/ rig sngags kyi dngos grub thams cad rjes su stsal bar bgyi/ cho ga zhib mo dang / dkyil 'khor dang / phyag rgya rim par phye ba'i dngos grub thams cad rjes su stsal bar bgyi/ bsod nams dran pa'i 55ridangos grub thams cad rjes su stsal bar bgyi/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba thams cad so sor bzlog 6par bgyi/ sdig pa dang / sgrib pa thems cad rnam par dag par bgyi/ rtag tu rjes su 'brang bar bgyi/ rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par rig sngags 'chang gi bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad so sor bzlog par bgyi/nad thams cad bsal bar bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das rig sngags 'chang 'gum pa'i tshe rnam par shes pa tha ma la bab pa de / bcom ldan 'das bdag gis 8rtag tu mngon sum du bstan cing mdun na nye bar mchis par bgyi/92—510

sangs rgyas yid la bgyid pa shin tu dran pas dus las 'da' bar bgyis pa dang /ji ltar sbrul pags pa brjes 1pa bzhin du nalus brjes rinas 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can gyi skal ba dang mnyam par pad+ma dag las rdzus ri te skye la rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa dang / tshe rabs su tshe rabs dran par 'gyur5/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis ri yongs su bzung 7zhing byin gyis brlab 8par 'gyur / lus rdo rjer 'gyur/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du chud par 'gyur / sa bcu la gnas par yang 'gyur/ phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la gnas par yang 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis lung bstan par yang 'gyur/dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad bskyed par yang 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mngon sum du ston par 'gyur/ bsod nams kyi tshogs thams cad bsags par 'gyur/ sdig pa dang / sgrib pa dang / sdig pa thams cad yongs su dag par 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba'i 9dam tshig rtogs pa dang / gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i dam tshig byang chub kyi snying po'i mthar thug pa'i bar du 'tshal bar 'gyur ba lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas kholha mo chen mo sgrol 11ma la legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ lha mo chen mo legs so legs so/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal po 'di khyod kyis bshad pa mchog tu legs so/ /cho ga zhib mo 'di yongs su rdzogs par bya ba dang / rig sngags 'chang de yang yongs su bsrung 12ba'i phyir dang / yongs su bskyang ba'i phyir dang / dngos grub rab tu sbyin pa'i phyir khyod kyis yongs su bskyang bar bya'o/ /de nas gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug 92—511

dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin dang /tshogs kyi bdag po nag po chen po dang / rig sngags dang dkyil 'khor kyi lha du ma dang / nor bu bzang po'i bu dang / lngas rtsen 51)dang / gar mkhan mchog dang / stobs can dang / stobs po che dang / ljang sngo dang / dung can dang / de bzhin du 'jigs byed dang / dbyangs (5)ldan ma dang / dpe med ma dang / lha mo chen mo dpal dang / ral pa gcig ma dang / me tog tshems te thams cad 'dus nas mthun 4par stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar gnas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs 6༄te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar nas btud de/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag kyang phyi ri rima'i dus phyi ma'i tshe rig sngags 'chang de dang / rig sngags smra ba 8rigs kyi bu'am/rigs kyi bu mo'am/ dge slong ngam/ dge slong mtham/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma'am/ gzhan yang skyes pa'am/ bud med dam/ khye'u'am/ bu mo gang zhig don yod pa'i zhags pa gtsug tor 'di sgrub par bgyid dam/ klog par bgyid dam/ 'don nam / tha na ming tsam yang 'dzin par bgyid na/ bcom ldan 'das de la bdag cag kun nas mthun 1 par rtag tu rjes su 'brang zhing bsrung 1 bar bgyi/ yongs su bskyang bar bgyi/ gzi brjid gzhug 12par bgyi/dngos grub chen po'i bsam pa yongs 1 su rdzogs par bgyi/ bsam pa thams cad kyi mchog yongs su rdzogs par bgyi/ nyes par 7bgyis pa thams cad so sor bzlog par bgyi/ sdig pa dang / sgrib pa thams cad yongs su sbyang bar bgyi/byang chub kyi snying po la 15mthar thug gi bar du rtag tu rjes su 'brang bar bgyi'o/ /92—512

bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di 1skad du grogs po dag legs so legs so/ /khyod nakyis bya ba de ltar yin te rig sngags kyi rgyal po chen po 'di ngas gtams shing yongs su gtang ngo zhes bka' stsal to/ /don yod pa'i zhags pa pad+ma gtsug tor gyi ri rdo rje chen po'i snying po gsang ba rdzogs sor// //rnam par thar pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi snying po gsang ba bstan pa bklags 6pas 7grub pa cho ga zhib mo rgyas pa mchog tu gsang ba mtha' dag rdzogs pa yongs su rdzogs son// //de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la gtugs smyonas mig mi 'dzums 51 par bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal du bltas 11nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di 1 na bdag la pad+ma yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor pad+ma'i rigs kyi snying por gyur pa gsang ba de kho na nyid bstan pa mchis te/ rnam par thar pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi gsang ba'i don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po khro bo'i rgyal po rig sngags kyi rgyal po'i snying po bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar ngo bo tha dad pa dang / phyag rgya tha dad pa dang / sngags tha dad pa dang 15/ dkyil 'khor dang / gzugs bri ba yongs su bsgrags par bgyi/sems can thams cad rjes su gzung 1 ba'i slad du/ rig sngags 'chang ba rnams kyi de kho nar gyur pa ni 'di lags te/ rig 15sngags 'chang ba thams cad kyi gnas gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor pad+ma yangs pa'i dam tshig don yod pa'i zhags pa bsgrub sa pa'i cho ga rjes su stsal bar bgyi na bcom ldan 'das de bdag 92—513

la gnang bar mdzad cing / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs kyi dam tshig byin gyis brlabs 1pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs dang /pad+ma'i rigs dang / nor bu'i rigs dang / rdo rje'i rigs dang / spyi'i dam tshig 'grub par 'gyur/ spyi'i byin gyis brlabs 5nodang / rig (bsngags kyi rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor dang / gzugs bri ba dang / phyag rgya rim par phye ba la rjes su 'jug par 'gyur/ cho ga zhib mo sgrub 45pa thams cad kyi dngos grub de kho na nyid du 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 5nasangs rgyas kyi (6)zhing dang /byang chub sems dpa'i 7 dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i dam tshig 58)byin gyis brlabs 9kyi de kho na nyid du 'gyur lags so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pas byang chub sems dpa' 7sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa nyu1spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ snying rje chen po dang ldan pa don yod pa'i mazhags pa'i dam tshig rnam par thar pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor rnam par 'phrul pa/byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi dam tshig dkyil 'khor chen po dang / phyag rgya rim par phye ba cho ga zhib mo de'i dus la bab hu par shes na shod 7cig /ngas byin gyis brlabs shing rjes su yi rang skol phyag rgya chen pos btab nas byin gyis brlabs so/ sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa gang gā'i 9klung gi bye ma bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyi brlabs kyis 1 byin gyis brlabs so/ /sems can thams cad kyi don du de kho na nyid kyi dngos grub bla na med pa phyag rgya dang / dkyil 'khor dang / dam tshig chen por byin gyis brlabs so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems 92—514

dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bzhin 'dzum zhing / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba rnam par thar pa'i dkyil 'khor rnam par 'phrul pa bkod pa/ don yod pa mthong ba'i ting nge 'dzin mngon 91 du byas nas ting nge 'dzin des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad 'od zer gyis snang bar byas/ lha'i gnas thams cad snang bar byas/ klu'i gnas thams cad snang bar byas/ gnod sbyin dang srin po'i gnas thams cad snang bar byas/ 'byung po'i gnas thams cad snang bar byas/ lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po'i gnas thams cad snang bar byas/ sa'i 'og tu gtogs pa 'og na gnas pa thams cad snang bar byas/ bar snang gi gnas nam mkha' la rgyu ba'i lha rnams snang bar byas shing stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kun nas g.yo ba chen por gyur 2pa dang / g.yo ba'i mthu des de dag thams cad bskul bar gyur tor ci/ /bskul ba tsam gyi mod nyid la/ de dag thams cad lhags te/ ri gru 'dzin na 'khor mang po 'dus par mthun 5par lhags nas 'khod do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 'khor mang po 'dus par mkhyen nas don yod pa'i zhags pa'i cha byad du zhugs shing bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug nas/'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba thams cad du rigs spyi'i dam tshig gi tshul du zhugs la/ ral pa'i thor tshugs kyis brgyan zhing 6/ rgyal ba 'od dpag med thor tshugs su thogs pa/ tshangs pa'i gzugs can phyag bco 7brgyad pa 8)rang gi ngo bo zhags pa thogs pa/ thal mo sbyar ba/ sku phyed na phyag 92—515

g.yon pa brten pa/ mdung rtse gsum pa bsnams pa/ ril ba spyi blugs dang /bgrang phreng bsnams pa/ pad+ma bsnams pa/ pad+ma'i phyag rgya bsnams pa/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang / rgyal mtshan bsnams pa/ me tog gi phur ma dang / bī dza pū 1ra bsnams pa/ dbugs 'byin par mdzad pa/ rin po che'i char 'bebs par mdzad pa/ thal mo sbyar ba'i phyag rgya mdzad pa/ spyi bor phyag rgya mdzad pa/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ pad+ma yangs pa'i phyag rgya mdzad pa/rdo rje'i rigs kyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya 2mdzad pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang /nor bu'i phyag rgya mdzad pa/ gzugs zhi ba/ spyan gsum pa/ mchod phyir thogs pa/ gdan pad+ma/ sku 'od zer sna tshogs 'bar ba/ sgrol ma bdun rjes su 'brang ba/ pha rol tu phyin pa bcus bskor ba/ brgya byin dang /tshangs pa dang / gshin rje dang / chu lha dang / lus ngan pos bskor ba/dbang phyug dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / tshangs pa dang / lha'i bu dang /srid med kyi bu dang / dbang chen dang / rgya mtsho dang / dga' bo dang /nye dga' bo 'khor dang bcas pa bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i spyan sngar 'khod nas mig mi 'dzums shing cabazhin 'dzum 5pas/ me tog sna tshogs pa rnams bcom ldan 'das la 'thor te/ 'di lta ste/ me tog shwa la dang / ta ma la dang / tsam pa ka 6dang / a ti mug ta 7ka dang / sho kā bar ta sha 8dang / kha bye 'khyil pa dang / gan dha par ṣi 9ka dang / mthon ka 7dang /mthon ka lha chen po dang / ka dam pa dang / mdog mdzes pa dang / su ma 12n+ya ka dang / skya snar dang / cher gsal ba dang / dri med gzi brjid dang /dri dga' dang / rab sim dang / pa lā 1 sha dang / za ba dang / ma raṇ+ḍa r+sā92—516

ka dang / gzi 1brjid bsil dang / dri med dang / gzi yangs ldan dang /shin tu bstan dang / lha dga' dang / yid dga' dang / yu thi ka dang /pad+ma dang / ku mu da dang / pad+ma dkar po dang / ut+pa la dang / ut+pa la dmar po dang / ta ra ṇa gu h+ya nadang / gser dang / dngul dang / rin po che rnam pa sna tshogs kyi me tog rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byed pa ni mngon sum du rnam par thar pa'i dkyil 'khor gsang ba don yod pa'i rgyal po 'di smras so/ /dus gsum du gshegs shing bzhugs pa sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba rigs kyi dam tshig la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal po don yod pa rnam par thar pa'i dkyil 'khor kyi 5rigs dang / phyag rgya thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i rang kyisangs rgyas dang / nyan thos kyi dge 'dun thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo / /yang dag par rtogs 7pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang dag par zhugs pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /blo gros 8chen po dang ldan pa sha ra dwa /ti'i bu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa la sogs pa 'phags pa'i tshogs 1 kyi mchog rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med tsho11la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thugs rje 1 chen po dang ldan pa 'phags pa spyan ras 1 gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /drang srong chen po de dag dang / 'phags pa'i tshogs kyi mchog de dag la phyag 'tshal nas 'phags pa spyan 92—517

ras gzigs dbang phyug gi zhal nas byung ba/ don yod pa'i rgyal po rnam par thar pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi snying po de bzhin gshegs pas zhi)mngon sum du gsungs pa 'di 'khor mang po'i nang du bdag gis da bzlas kyis(gyi/ bdag gi dgos ①pa thams cad grub par gyur cig /'jigs pa thams cad du srung zhedabar gyur cig/ //tar+ya thā/ oṃ tsa ra tsa ra/ tsi ri tsi ri/ tsu ru tsu ru/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā(5)/bi ri bi ri 'i ri pi ri/ tsi ri tsi ri/ pa ra ma ma 16)hā kā (7)ru ṇi kā(8)/ si ri si ri/ tsi ri tsi ri/ pi ri pi ri/ bi ri bi ri/ ma hā pad+ma hasta ste/ ka la ka la / ki li ki li/ ku lu ku lu/ ma hā shud dha/ satwa/ e h+ye hi bud dh+ya bud dha / dhā ba dhā ba/ ka ṇa ka ṇa/ ki ṇi ki khyi11/ ku ṇa ku ṇa'agye/ pa ra ma shud dha satwa/ ka ra ka ra/ ki ri ki ri/ ku ru ku ru/ ma hā s+tha 4)ma māstayi/ tsa la byurga la/ sañtsa la/ sadzo/ la/da be labyu5 95/ bi byurga 95/ skyes ṭa ṭa/ skyon ṭa ṭa/bha ra 1 bha ra/ bhi ri bhi ri/ bhu ru bhu ru/ e h+ye hi ma hā kā ru ṇi kānyunye/ ma hā pa 19thu pa ti/ be ṣa dha ra/ dha ra dha ra/ sa ra sa ra/ tsa ra tsa ra/ ha ra ha ra/ hā hā hā hā/ tī tī tī tī/ hū hū hū hū/zhunya ma kā zhuger brah+ma be ṣa du lhedha ra/ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri 2 dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ ta ra ta ra/ sa ra sa ra/pa ra pa ra/ tsa ra tsa ra/ bha ra bha ra/ rasmi sha ta sa ha gesu pra zhugati maṇ+ḍi ta sha rī ra / dz+wa la dz+wa la/ ta pa ta pa/ bha ga bānasashe/ sau sa ma ā di khyanu )/ ya ma / ba ru ṇa/ ku be ra/ brah+ma/ in+d+ra/ ṛ 51k+ṣi/ de ba ga ṇa/ a bh+yartsi ta tsa sha ra ṇa/ su ru su ru/ tsu ru tsu ru/ pu ru pu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ sa nad ku mā ra ri/ ru dra bā sa ba/ bisnur / dha na dā snye/ bā yu/sa6 de ba ṛ ṣi nā shu 92—518

ya ka / bi nā ya ga(4) /ba hu (9bi bi dha be ṣa na dha ra/ dha ra dha ra/ snyi ri dhi ri / dhu ru dhu ru/ tha ra tha ra/ gha ra gha ra/ ya ra ya ra/ la ra la ra ha ra ha ra/ ma ra ma ra/ pa ra pa ra/ tsa ra tsa ra/ ba ra ba ra/ 4ba ra dā 5ya ka /sa man+ta a ba lo ki te/ bi lo ki te/ lo ke 6shwa ra/ ma he shwa ra/ mu hu mu hu/ mu ru mu ru/7) mu ya mu ya/ muñtsa muñtsa 8// //bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bdag dang sems can thams cad 'jigs pa thams cad dang / gnod pa thams cad dang /yams kyi nad thams cad dang / gdon 59thams cad dang / nad thams cad las bsrung 7du gsol/ bsrung 17du gsol/ gnod pa dang / 'ching ba dang /brdeg (19pa dang / bsdigs pa 1 dang / rgyal po dang / chom rkun dang /gnod byed dang / me dang / chu dang / dug dang / mtshon las yongs su thar bar mdzad pa/ ka ṇa 1 tshoka ṇa/ ki ṇi ki ṇi / ku ṇa ku ṇas/ tsa ra tsa ra/asgri lco 7ya/ ba la po rgyang ga /mārga 18ka /tsa 16tu rā r+ya sat+ya/ sam 2 pra kā sha 1ka /ta ma ta ma/ da ma da ma/ sha ma sha ma/ sa ma sa ma/ ma hā ta mo3n+dha kā ( ger/ bi dha zhu)man/ ṣa ṭa pā ra mi tā/ pa 2 tshori pū ra ka /mi li mi li/ṭa ṭa ṭa ṭa/ ṭha ṭha ṭha ṭha/ ṭi ṭi ṭi ṭi/ ṭu ṭu ṭu khu lha/ ṣ+ṭha ṣ+ṭha ṣ+ṭha ṣ+ṭha/ ṭhā ṭhā mu ṭhā / su ma ne 3 7ya tsa ra ma kri ṭa snye/ pa ri ka ra/ / e h+ye hi ma hā kā ru ṇi ka ma he bye shwa ra/ ma hā ta 41byu ta/ ga na bhañdza ra ka /ku ru ku ru/ pa ra pa ra/ka ṭa ka ṭa/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/ bi shud dha/ bi ṣa ya/ ni bā sa ni snye/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā (3/ shwe ta zhugeyarto pa bī 5ta ya/ rat+na ma ku ṭa/ mā ri lā dha ra/ sarba dz+nyā shi ra si kṛ sa ta/ dza ṭā gi ma kuṭa ma hā ta bhu ta/ ka ma la kṛ ta/ sto ka ra ta 92wa 519

la dh+yā 1na sa mā ridhi/ bi mo k+ṣa/ a pra kum pya/ ba hu satwa/ san+ta ti/ pa ri pā /tsa ka ma hā kā ru ṇi kā / sarba kurma ā sgrub ra ṇa phyobi sho dha ka /sarba byā 57ridhi pa ri 8mo tsa ka /sarba ā shā 9pa ri pū 1 ra ka /sarba satwa/ sa mā shā sa na nyu1ka ra/ na mo stu te swā hā/ oṃ brah+ma/ be ṣa 1 dha ra/ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri snyi ri/dhu ru dhu ru/ sa man+ta/ dz+wa la a mo gha hūm̐/ don yod pa'i snying po/ a yi ge gcig po ni kun nas gsang ba de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi dam tshig dang /pad+ma yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa rigs thams cad kyi spyi'i yin te/bklags 1 pas grub pa'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis 7snying po yi ge gcig po kun nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs kyi gsang ba spyi'i rnam par thar pa'i dkyil 'khor smras pa tsam gyis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rnam pa drug tu g.yos shing lha'i me tog gi char rab tu bab las/ kun nas rin po che'i char rab tu bab bo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gang gā'i 7klung gi bye ma snyed bye ba khrag khrig stong kun nas gshegs nas nam mkha'i dkyil la rdzu 'phrul gyis bzhugs so/ /don yod pa'i rim par phye ba'i sprin lha'i rin po che 1 sna bdun phab la 'bab pas khebs pa dang / lha'i rin po che sna bdun gyi me tog rnams dang / lha'i rgyan dang / gos sna tshogs pa'i char bcom ldan 'das dang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs don yod pa'i rgyal po'i tshul du zhugs pa la mchod pa dang / bkur snyi bya ba'i phyir rab tu phab bo/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis kyang legs so zhes bya ba'i sgra 'byin par mdzad de19/sems 0dag pa chen po khyod kyis sangs rgyas 'byung ba mchog bstan pa legs so 2192—520

legs so/ /'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs kyi gsang ba'i phyag rgya dang / dkyil 'khor dang / rig sngags kyi gnas rim par phye ba rnam par thar pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / yi ge gcig pa'i rjes su zhugs pa ni stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams su nyi ma gcig shar ba yin no/ /gang 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams rdul phra mo snyed kyi sangs rgyas 'byung ba rdzogs par sangs rgyas 'byung ba gcig gis thams cad kyi rjes su zhugs pa yin zhing / snying po yi ge gcig gis 1rjes su zhugs pa yin la phyag rgya dang / dkyil 'khor rim par phye ba dang / dam tshig gcig gis rjes su zhugs pa yin no/ /don yod pa'i 2rnam par 'phrul pa rnam par thar pa'i dkyil 'khor de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba bzang po 'di ni don yod pa'i gsang sngags kyi zhags pas drangs shing sku gcig gi dam tshig la bkod pa yin te / de nas don yod pa'i zhags pa zhes bya bar byin gyis brlabs so/ /snying po yi ge gcig pa'i gzungs sngags ni rtag tu bklags pas grub pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 5byin gyis brlabs 6pa yin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzi gas dbang phyug la legs 7so/ /zhes bya ba byin te/ snying rje chen po dang ldan pa legs so legs so/ /de kho na nyid bsgrub pa grub pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs spyi'i dam tshig thams cad grub pa/don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po bsgrub pa bklags 8pas 'grub pa 'di ni mchog tu bzang ba yin gyis 9yon tan gyi phung po shod cig /snying po yi ge 7'di ni 92—521

don yod pa'i zhags pa sgrub pa'i cho ga bsgrub 15pa bde ba/ bklags pon pas grub pa phyag rgya dang / dkyil 'khor dang / sku gzugs ri mo dang bcas pa bsgrub pa'i cho ga bla na med pa yin no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das don yod pa'i zhags pa pad+ma yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / pad+ma'i rigs kyi rnam par thar pa'i dkyil 'khor dang /de kho na nyid kyi dam tshig gsang ba chen po dang / rigs spyi'i sgrub (5)pa bklags (gepas 'grub pa 'di'i yo byad dang / cho ga bshad par bgyi yis (5)bcom ldan 'das kyis 6byin gyis brlab 7tu gsol/ bcom ldan 'das gang gis dran pa tsam gyis bdag mdun na nye bar mchis shing bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du yongs su rdzogs par bgyi/ rig sngags kyi dngos grub thams cad rjes su stsal bar bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug legs so legs so/ /de ltar khyod kyis gshesems can thams cad bsgral bar bya zhing / rig sngags 'chang rnams kyi dngos grub dam pa mchog de khyod kyis rab tu sbyin par gyis shig /don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po gsang ba'i dam tshig dang / yi ge gcig po rigs spyi'i rjes su zhugs pas 59༄de bzhin gshegs pas byin gyis brlabs kyis 7yo byad dang / sgrub nyu7pa'i cho ga shod cig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bcom ldan 'das kyis dbugs phyung ba dag thos nas/ snying shin tu dga' ste/ yo byad dang / cho ga smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis tshamangon sum nyid du sdig pa bsreg 15cing ma lus par zad par bgyid pa/ sems can 92—522

dmyal ba rtsa ba 6)nas 'byin pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga smras pa/ dkyil 'khor gru bzhir byas nas su/ /dbus su pad+ma'i 'khor lo bya/ /tshon rtsi sna tshogs rnam par dbye/ /pad+ma (0ze ba'i dbus su ni/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang bzhugs par bya/ /bum pa bkang dang 'phan ri skurnams kyis / /dkyil 'khor kun nas brgyan par bya/ /me tog sna tshogs legs par dgram/ /spos dri bzang pos bsgos pa yi/ /mar me'i phreng zhi ba kun tu byed ri/ /mchod yon chu dag gzhag par bya/ / gu gul dang ni sal la ki/ /57༄a ga ru dang du ru ska/ /bdug spos snod bzhi dag nas bdug /rig sngags 'chang ba khrus byas 8nas/ /gos gtsang bgos te smyung ba la/ /nye bar gnas nas tshes brgyad dam/ /bcu bzhi'am tshes ni bcwa (9)lnga ste/ /zla ba yar gyi ngo la bsgrub/ /shar du kha bltas 'dug nas su/ /don yod zhags pa dus gsum du/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod bya/ /snying po'am 7brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas/ /yi ge gcig po 'bum du ni / /mtshan mo bar chad med par bzlas/ /skya rengs 11shar nas 'jig rten dbang / /ze ba'i dbus na 'bar 'gyur zhing / /'gul 'gyur 'gul 1 ba de yis ni/ /dmyal ba chen po bcu drug gi/ /sgo rnams dag ni bye 12bar 'gyural/ /dmyal ba'i gnas nas shugs chen gyis/ /g.yo la g.yos pa tsam des ni / /dmyal ba'i tshor khukun rnam par 'jig /dmyal ba de yang rnam par 'joms / /sems can dmyal ba de dag ni/ /thar nas phyogs bcur brgyug sapa yi/ /dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal kun las grol/ /mtho ris lam du zhugs par 'gyur / /dud 'gro'i skye gnas kyi sdug bsngal thams cad du tshadud 'gro rnams las yongs su grol bar 'gyur/ bdag nyid kyi sgrib pa dang / sdig pa dang /92—523

sdug bsngal mi bzad pa thams cad mthar gtugs par yongs su zad par 'gyur/'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad las yongs su grol bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te sdig pa thams cad zad par gyur 1na/ de'i tshe 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sku mdog gser gyi mdog can du na ston par mdzad la mchog thams cad sbyin par mdzad do/ /don yod pa dri ma med pa'i ye shes rgya mtsho bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob par 'gyur / sgrib pa dang bral 4)ba sems 545dkyi rgyan rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid kyi 6ngo bo thob par 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa gang gā'i klung gi 7bye ma bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu po rnams mod nyid la mngon sum du ston par mdzad la/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad kyi /phyag g.yas pa mgo'i spyi bor 'jog par mdzad/ bsod nams kyi phung po chen po dang ldan par 'gyur/ dge ba'i rtsa ba chen po yongs su gzung 9bar 'gyur/ 'jig rten pa kun gyis gcig pu mchod pa chen po byas par 'gyur/ gshin rje dang / chu lha dang / lus ngan dang / zla ba dang /nyi ma dang / tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug chen po rang gi gzugs kyis mngon sum du ston cing nye 1 'khor 11la kun nas srung 12ba dang /skyob pa dang / sbed pa byed par 'gyur/ dngos grub dang / dgos pa thams cad grub par 'gyur/ gal te sdig pa thams cad zad par ma gyur na/ de'i tshe 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sku mdog gser gyi kha dog can du mi mthong des sgrib pa dang / sdig pa lhag 1rim lus par shes par bya ste/ de nyid du bzlas brjod kyi cho ga smyung ba gnyis pa 7byas pa dang / sdig pa dang /sgrib pa thams cad rtsa ba dang bcas pa thams cad phyung bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te 92—524

bzlas brjod kyi cho ga smyung ba gsum pa 1byed na bzlas brjod kyi cho ga gsum nardzogs pa dang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi phyag g.yas pa brkyang nas rig sngags 'chang bteg ste mod la 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du 'od dpag med kyi spyan sngar 'jog par mdzad la mngon sum du bzhugs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med kyis dbugs 'byin par mdzad cing phyag spyi bor 'jog par mdzad de/ tshe dpag tu med par 'gyur ro/ /gal te sems can gzhan rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo'am/ dge sbyong ngam/ bram ze'am/ skyes pa'am / bud med dam/ khye'u'am/ bu mo'am/ tha na dud 'gro'i skye gnas su song ba gang zhig sdig pa dang / sgrib pa cazad par 'dod na rig sngags 'chang khrus byas la gos gtsang ma bgos5/ smyung ba byas pa des dkyil 'khor la mngon du phyogs par bzhag la/ rig sngags 'chang cho ga byed pas gsang sngags rjes su dran par byas nas rma bya'i sgros byab par bya'o/ /de tsam gyis dziyon tan gyi 7khyad par thob par 'gyur te/ sdig pa dang / sgrib pa thams cad zad par 'gyur / nad thams cad dang / gdug napa thams cad dang / na ba thams cad dang / mtshams med pa thams cad zad par 'gyur te/ the tshom 9med do / /sgrib pa dang bral ba nyid thob par 'gyur zhing tshig gzung bar 'os par 'gyur / lha thams cad kyis gzung 7zhing kun nas bsrung 11bar 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung thob par 'gyur/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gzigs 12bzhed par 'gyur/ tshe ring ba dang / sgrib pa dang /nad dang bral bar 'gyur/ tshe 'phos nas 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur/ tshe rabs su tshe rabs dran par 'gyur/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bsod 92—525

nams kyi tshogs thams cad dang ldan par 1'gyur te/ snying rje (snyedang / byams pa chen po yid la bya ba rtse gcig tu bya zhing smyung ba dang / bzlas brjod bya'o/ /sdig pa dang sgrib pa zad par bya ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i cho ga'o// //'phags pa don yod pa'i zhags pa'i cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po/ bam po bcu bdun pa/ bode nas rtag tu bzlas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bshad par bya ste/dkyil 'khor gyi tshad ji lta ba bzhin du/ legs par phye ba/ gru bzhi pa/ rgyar gzings kyi tshad kyis shin tu rnam par phye ba bya ste/ dri'i tshon rtsi rnam par bkra ba kun nas pad+ma'i phreng ba dang / rdo rje'i ge sar la brten pa'i dbus su pad+ma bya'o//rdo rje'i thig skud kyis kun nas bskor ba'i dbus kyi pad+ma'i ge sar la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug tshangs pa'i cha byad 'dzin pa dgod par bya'o/ /nyi ma re re zhing me tog dang bdug pa dbul ri cibar bya zhing nyi ma re re zhing a ga ru'i bdug pa dang / khrus byas gos gtsang ma bgos te/ don yod rgyal po'i bzlas brjod dang / phyag rgya bcing bar bya'o/ /yi ge gcig pa'i 4 snying po'i bzlas brjod thun gsum du lan gsum mam/ lan bdun nam/ lan nyi shu rtsa gcig tu bzlas so/ /zas ngan pa bcu yongs su spang bar 5)bya zhing / sems can ngan pa yang spang bar ( bya'o/ /sgrub thabs kyi de kho na nyid las thams cad du 'jig rten pa'i bya ba thams cad 'grub bo/ /'jigs pa chen po mi bzad pa brgyad po de rnams las grol lo/ /don yod pa'i rgyal po dran pas nad thams cad rnam par nyams par byed do/ /dug dang sbyar dug dang / byad stems dang / gdon thams cad dang / 'jigs pa dang / sdang ba dang / skrag pa 92—526

dang / rims dang / nad thams cad dang / phol mig dang / lhog pa dang /mtshan par rdol ba dang / g.yan pa dang / rkang shu dang / mdze dang / mgo bo na ba dang / mig na ba dang / rna ba na ba dang / sna na ba dang / kha na ba dang / rkan na ba dang / mgul na ba dang / snying na ba dang / lto na ba dang / so dang mchu na ba dang / lag pa na ba dang / rtsib logs 1rin ba dang /chu so na ba dang / pho ba'i nad dang / ma zhu ba dang / rkang pa na ba dang /rgyab na ba dang / yan lag dang / nying lag thams cad na ba dang / tshad pa dang / gzhang nad dang / gcin nad dang / gsud pa dang / 'khogs dpa la lan cig 0brjod de (gebyas pa tsam (༄gyis thams cad sel bar byed de/ myur du rab tu zhi bar byed cing skad cig de nyid la yang yang dag par gnas par byed do/ /'jig rten pa'i bya ba gzhan thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu'i 'dage ba'i rtsa ba nyi ma re re zhing bskyed par 'gyur ro/ /bsod nams chen po dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /tshig 7ribatsun par yang 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten thams cad kyi bla mar yang 'gyur ro/ /mchod pa'i 'os chen por 'gyur ro/ /don che zhing che ba dag 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /dbang phyug dang / dpon po lhun gyis grub pa nyid du rnyed do/ /rgyal po dang / btsun mo'i 'khor dang / g.yog tu bcas pas gcig tu mchod par 'os par 'gyur ro/ /nyi ma re re zhing 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku mthong ba so sor thob po/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing yang dag par brgyan pa mthong ngo / /tshes 8)brgyad dang bco lnga la po ṭa la ku'i ri bo'i gzhal med khang 'phags 92—527

pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gnas na/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bzhugs te/ 'khor chen po la chos ston par mdzad bzhin —17pa dang /'od dpag med bde ba can gyi gnas na zhugs napa mthong ste ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar du mthong ngo / /'chi 'phos pa na bsam dpa nyid kyi mod la bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams su skye bar 'gyur te/ rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan par pad+ma las brdzus te skye bar 'gyur ro/ /sgrib pa dang bral zhing rnam par 'phrul pa byin gyis rlob pa don yod pa'i 'od zer zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin so sor thob po/ /ting nge 'dzin gang zhig thob pas sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang gā'i 5klung gi bye ma bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag snyed las 'das pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mngon par phyag byas nas/ se gol gtogs pa tsam nyid la slar yang 'ong ba de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin so sor thob po/ /ting nge 'dzin gzhan khrag khrig brgya stong phrag so sor thob cing / bzlas pa'i cho ga gcig pus las thams cad sgrub par 'gyur ro zhes so/ /bzlas pa'i 5chodakyil 'khor chen po'i cho ga'o// //de nas khrus kyi dkyil 'khor bshad par bya ste/ khrus byed pa la mkhas pa gang gis dri ma thams cad sel bar byed cing mdzes pa/ sdig pa thams cad rnam par nyams par byed pa/ dngos grub thams cad byed pa'i de kho na nyid bsod nams dang gzi brjid rab tu 'phel bar byed pa/ nad thams cad sel bar grub pa/ sdig pa dang / sdig to nyams par byed pa/ de bzhin du zad pa dang nyams pa bcom pa/ dug dang byad stems nyams pa/ nad yun ring po 92—528

yongs su spangs pa/ de bzhin du gcong yun ring po dang rims yongs su spangs pa 1ste 'di dag khrus kyis 'grub ste/ rig sngags gang yin pa des 'grub par don yod pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis yongs su bsgrags so/ /bgegs kyis reg pa gang yin pa dang / grib gnon gyi gdon mi bzad pas reg 2pa gang yin pa dang / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs kyi 'jigs pa mi bzad pa dang / 'thab pa dang / rtsod pa la yang / dgra rnams kyis pham pa dang /skye bo sdang ba dang / gang gi 'khrug pa'i g.yul du song ba dang / rgyu skar gyis bcom pa gang yin pa dang / blo'i skye ba zad pa dang / ma ning dang / nyams pa'i ma ning dang / dbang po nyams pa'i bar gang yin pa rnams dang bu mi 'tsho ba gang yin pa rnams kyi bu mthun 4par skye bar 'gyur ro/ /bsad cing gzhom pa thob pa gang yin pa dang / 'ching ba dang / gsod 5par song ba gang yin pa dang / chom rkun nam/ rkun mo'i nang ngam/ gnod sbyin nam srin po'i nang du song ba gang yin pa dang / gcan gzan 6gtum po'i nang du song ba gang yin pa dang / mche ba gdug pa dang / dug gi khrod du song bas dug 'jigs pa mi bzad pa zos pa gang yin pa dang / khyim rdib 7pa dang /g.yang sa dang / byi ba kha gdug pa'i 'jigs pa rnams dang / mi mngon par sdig pa byed pa gang yin pa dang / mtshams med pa byed pa gang yin pa dang /'phags pa la skur 8pa 'debs pa dang / dam pa'i chos spong ba 'di rnams dkyil 'khor du khrus byas pas thams cad yang dag par zad par 'gro zhing /myur du thams cad rnam par nyams par byed de rtswa 9rnams mes khosreg pa bzhin du sngon bsags pa'i mi bzad pa'i las 'di dag thams cad rnam par nyams 92—529

par byed do/ /'jig rten thams cad kyi bla ma dang / rtag tu mchod par 'os par 'gyur ro/ /tshe yun ring por gnas te/ rtag tu bde ba dang / dga' bar byed do/ /ji srid 'tsho'i bar du nad med cing rims med pa nyid du gnas so / /bde blag tu bya ba byed cing / de'i skye ba bdun dran par 'gyur ro/ /lha rnams kyis rtag tu srung bar byed cing / mthar thug rtag tu dpal 'bar bar byed do/ /sangs rgyas rnams rtag tu mthong ba dang / rtag tu 'jig rten dbang phyug gi mchog sbyin par byed pa dang / rtag 0)tu mthong bar 'dod pa yang thun mtshams rtag tu mngon sum du mthong bas gnas par byed do/ /rtag tu rig sngags dang / dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang / rig sngags kyi dngos grub tu 'gyur te/ rtag tu dkyil 'khor gyi mchog gang yin pa yang sgrub par byed do/ /rgyar gzings 2kyi tshad kyi dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa bya ste/ tshon sna tshogs pas rnam par phye ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi mchog bri bar bya'o/ /me tog dang 'bras bu sna tshogs pas bkra ba/ sgo bzhi kun nas rnam par phye ba dang / las rnams legs par zin nas dbus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi snying por/ 'khor lo yang dag par bri'o/ /pad+ma'i lte ba dang snying po nyid kyang 'bar bar bya'o/ /zur dang zur rnams su/ zhags pa 'bar ba pad+ma la gnas pa bya'o/ /rig sngags 'dod pas khrus dang gtor ma dkar po yang 'dir dgod par bya'o/ /a ga ru'i bdug pa dbul zhing / dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ji lta ba bzhin du/ dkyil 'khor legs par brgyan par bya'o/ /las gzhan sgrub pa ni ro sna tshogs pa'i gtor mas mchod par bya zhing sna tshogs pa'i bdug spos dbul lo/ /bum pa chus bkang nas rdzas kyi phye ma rnams der gzhug cing / rin chen sna bdun 92—530

bcug ste/ de la rgya dar gyis bcings la/ don yod zhags pa brgya dang /snying po nyid kyang lan brgyar bzlas so/ /yi ge gcig pa brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas so / /tsan+dan dang / sa sī dang / si ri ṣa dang / hab shang tsi'u 1dang /gur gum dang / yungs kur dang pad+ma ge sar rnams legs par btags nas bum pa bkang bar bya ste/ 'di rnams kyis 2khrus bya'o/ /nye'u shing / shu ti dang / bil ba ste 'di rnams kyis nyed dpa dang / rtag tu sngon tu byab par byas la/ de nas mkhas pas khrus bya'o/ /de nas srung ba'i cho ga ni don yod rgyal pos bya'o/ /de nas rtswa dur dzo ba bting nas/ de la skyil mo krung gis 5'dug ste/ bum pa'i chus khrus bya zhing pad+ma'i phyag rgya yang byed du gzhug go/ /de nas gtsang ma gos gtsang ma bgos 0te/ gtsug tor bcing bar bya zhing /sngon du bzlas pa 'bul ba dang bskor ba byas nas/ sgo dang sgo nas phyag bya'o/ /shar gyi sgo ru zhugs la dbus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi snying por/ skyil krung gis 'dug la/ don yod pa'i rgyal pos lan bdun du byab par bya'o/ /lag tu rdo rje dang / bgrang phreng tsho gis mngon par dbang bskur zhing / chu dang /yungs kur dang phyag rgyas dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /de nas dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa bya'o/ /'di ni khrus kyi gtso bor 'jig rten dbang phyug gis gsungs so/ /sems can thams cad la phan pa'i don gyi ched dang / rig sngags 'chang rnams la khyad par du/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis 8byin gyis brlabs 9)pa dang / lha thams cad kyis 7mchod pa dang / don yod pa'i phun sum tshogs pa gdon mi za bar byed do/ /gang dang gang du las la nges par sbyar ba thams cad du don yod pa'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur te/ thams cad du 92—531

'di 1la the tshom med do/ /sngags kyi dngos grub bla na med pa ma grub pa yang grub par 'gyur te/ don yod pa'i dngos grub thob cing 'phral nyid du 'bras bu mthong ba yin no/ /lus yongs su dag cing shin tu dri ma med pa dang / legs par khrus byas par de brjod par bya'o/ /sdig pa thams cad nyams par byed pa/nyon mongs pa thams cad zad par byed pa/ nad thams cad las yongs su grol bar byed pa ste/ mdor na/ thams cad du dngos grub so sor rnyed cing /dpal chen por lhag par 'gro'o/ /rig sngags don du gnyer ba thob ste/rig sngags don yod pa'i dngos grub kyi de kho na nyid las bu 'dod pas ni bu thob bo/ /nor 'dod pas ni nor thob bo/ /dbang phyug 'dod pas ni dbang phyug thob po/ /myur du dpal 'dod pas ni dpal thob bo/ /mngon par 'dod pa thams cad 'phral 2du yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /zhes so/ /khrus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'o// //de nas nor bu'i sgrub thabs kyi cho ga dang / dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bshad par bya ste/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i sgrub pa rmad du byung ba don yod pa'i nor bu'i cadangos grub dang / bya ba thams cad sgrub par byed pa/ thams cad du ltung ba'i sdug bsngal las byung ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad las skyob par byed pa gsod 5thob pa mngon par thar bar byed pa/ mtshon cha dang / khong sgril phyigacog par byed par the com 7med do/ /sdig pa thams cad rnam par nyams par byed pa/ mtshams med pa zad par byed pa/ rtag tu gsod pa med pa'i gnas thams cad nadu son par byed pa/ rtag tu 'khrugs pa dang / g.yul ngo 92—532

las rgyal ba sbyin par 'gyur ro/ /chom rkun gyi nang nas grol bar 'gyur zhing /rkun mo las kyang sgrol bar byed do/ /gcan gzan 1gtum po seng ge dang /glang po che dang / dom dang / gzig dang / dred dang / khyi dang / phag dang / ce 2spyang rnams las nor bu'i rgyal po gang du gnas pa'i mod la thams cad du sgrol bar byed do/ /dug dang / sprul thams cad dam/ mche ba sdug snapa dang / sbrul go na sa dang / bta sa nā bha dang / dug nyid dang / dug shing ga dang / dug mu sta ka nyid dang / da ra da'i dug dang / lus la byas pa dang / mi bzad pa'i dug dang / dug ha la ha la dang / sdig pa la sogs pa gang yin pa dang / mthong ba'i dug gang yin pa dang / dbugs kyi dug mi bzad 4pa gang yin pa dang / reg pa'i dug 'jigs pa dang / 'jog po yis 5 kyang zin pa dang / gzhan yang srog chags mi bzad 6pa rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i dug mi bzad pa rnams dkyil 'khor mthong ba tsam dang / nor bu reg pa tsam gyis de rnams thams cad 'phral du dug med par 'gyur ro/ /gal te gang gar 'bab pa'i dug 'thungs kyang 'phral du 'joms 7par byed do/ /nam mkha' lding gis sprul nyid dang klu bzhin no/ / me yis 8mi 'tshig go/ /slar yang chus 'khyer bar mi 'gyur ro/ /byi ba kha gdug pa'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung /de la rgyal po khro bar mi byed do/ /nam yang / phyir rgol ba dang / dgra dang /'thab ma 9dang / 'khrul 'khor byed pa khodang / sdang ba gang yin pa de rnams med de/ cho ga 'di ni mchog go/ /dug dang byad stems dang / phye ma'i sbyor ba la sogs pa thams cad skad cig de la nyams par byed do/ /gnod sbyin dang /srin po dang / 'byung po dang / yi dgas dang / skem byed dang / brjed 1 92—533

byed dang / gsang ba pa dang / bgegs dang / log 'dren 6)rnams dkyil 'khor mthong ba tsam dang / nor bu bzung ba nyid kyis ( thams cad 'bros par byed de 'di la the tsom med do/ /'di thams cad kyis thun mong du nor bu'i dkyil 'khor mthong ba la/ bsam pa gang yin pa'i bsam pa de thams cad yid la don du gnyer bar bya ba gang yin pa rnams kyang nor bu bzung (geb nyid la thams cad myur du phun sum tshogs par byed do/ /tshe 'phel ba dang / sngags kyi dngos grub bla na med pa grub 5bo/ /bkra shis pa dang / dam pa dang /bsod nams dang / dag pa dang / sdig pa nyams pa dang / rmi lam ngan pa nyams pa dang / 'phral du rmi lam bzang por byed pa nyid dang / rtag tu sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' mthong ba dang / rtag tu lha rnams 'gugs 6pa nyid dang / rtag tu 'byor pa thams cad byed pa dang / rtag tu zla ba nya ba ltar 'od zer 'bar bas rnam par mdzes pa dang / tshig btsun ri pa dang / rtag tu dga' ba dang / thams cad du mchod par bya ba'o(8ri/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis /rdzas kyi sbyor ba bya ste/ cha mnyam par legs par phye la gtso bo'i rjes su 'brang bar bya'o/ /'di lta ste/ rgyal ba dang / rnam par rgyal ba dang / nā ku li dang / dri'i nā ku li dang / a ru ra dang /lag pa dang / dbang po lag pa dang / dri'i pri 1 yang ku dang / rgya spos dang /'khor lo dang / 'khor lo chen po dang / khyab 'jug gnon pa dang / so ma rā dza dang / su nan da dang / pad+ma ge sar dang / ma la ya'i tsan+dan na la da 11dang / gur gum dang / ba bla dang /15 ut+pa la sngon po dang / klu shing gi me tog dang / tsam pa ma'i me tog dang / pa ḍā / dang / brag skyes dang 8/92wa 534

spang spos dang sā ma (1)ka rnams mnyam par byas te phye ma zhib 2mor legs par btags la pu shel tse nodang / tsan+dan gyi chus sbrus te/ zangs kyi snod du bzhag la / khrus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bkod de / don yod zhags pa'i snying po brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas snying po brgya rtsa brgyad nyid dang / yi ge gcig pa 'bum du bzlas pas rdzas kyi snod 'bar bar byed do/ /de nas nor bu mgo bo la bcings (5 pa'am/ lag pa la bcings la gzung nebar bya ste/ mchog tu skal ba bzang po thob cing / dbang phyug gi mchog dang dpon po thob bo/ /rje rigs bu med pas kyang mi dang nor 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po dang / dgra rab tu 'joms shing / srung ba'i mchog tu 4rnyed par dka' ba sten/ nor bu gang du gnas pa der/ glog gi gnod pa med do/ /der byi ba kha gdug pa'i 'jigs pa dang / g.yo ba mi 'byung ngo / /nor bu'i rgyal po gang du gnas pa'i gnas 'di mchod rten du bkur 9ro/ /sum cu rtsa gsum na gnas pa'i lha rnams kyis bortag tu srung bar byed cing / rtag tu yang rgyal po chen po bzhi dang /lag na rdo rje stobs po ches rtag tu yang srung zhing / dus rtag tu rjes su 'brang bar 'gyur te the tsom 11med do// //dkyil 'khor bshad par bya ste/ rgyar gzings kyi tshad kyi logs bzhi pa zur bzhi pa shin tu bcags pa/ legs par sbyar ba mchog tu mdzes pa bya'o/ /khor yug tu me tog sna tshogs kyi mgo lcogs kyis 12bkra ba bris la shar gyi sgo rnam par phye ste dbus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi pad+ma rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyis 12yongs su bskor ba'i dbus kyi pad+ma'i ge sar la yang / 'jig rten 7dbang phyug dgod skapar bya'o/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi zhabs drung du/ rdzas 92—535

kyi snod gzhag par bya zhing / me tog gcal du bkram par bya la/ dkyil 'khor brgyan 1par bya ste/ dri dang / yon chab dbul tshonatshobar bya zhing / tsan+dan gyi bdug pa sreg rigo/ /nyin mtshan du gos gtsang ma bgo ( zhing bcing bar parabya/shin tu dri ma med pa'i sems su 'gyur bar bya/ byams pa dang / snying rje mchog tu 'gyur bar bya zhing / de nas nor bu'i rdzas sgrub ri po zhes so/ /nor bu'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'o// //de nas ldong ros kyi mig sman gyi cho ga'i dkyil 'khor bshad par bya ste/rgyar gzings kyi cha'i mthar thug pas dkyil 'khor gru rin bzhi pa byas te/ dri sna tshogs dang / rnam par bkra ba'i rig sngags 'chang ni/ grwa 9rnams su mkhas pas bri bar bya'o/ /dbus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi snying por/ pad+ma 'dab ma phyed kha bye ba'o/ /lag pa gnyis kyi dbus su pad+ma ge sar rgyas pa 'chang ba'o/ /shar gyi sgo rnam par phye ba bya ste/ ldong ros dngul gyi snod du bzhag nas dkyil 'khor du pad+ma'i steng du dgod par bya'o/ /snod kyi khor yug tu/ dar dmar po'i gos bzang pos g.yog 1 par bya'o/ /yang na pad+ma'i 'dab 11ma'am yang na byang chub shing gi 'dab 12ma'am/ yang na shing 'dzam bu'i 'dab 1 mas g.yog 7par bya'o/ /a ga ru'i bdug pa dbul bar bya'o/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug don yod zhags pa'i gzugs 'dzin pa pad+ma'i 'dab ma'i drung du dgod par bya'o/ /me tog dang / dris mchod pa dbya/ rig sngags 'chang gis dkar gsum zos la 'phags pa'i yan lag brgyad kyi bsnyen gnas su 'gyur bar bya'o/ /yang na nyin mtshan du smyung bar gnas pa 9bya/ zla ba yar 92—536

ngo'am / tshes bco 17lnga'i nya'aman/ tshes bcu bzhi'am/ tshes brgyad la/gtsang mar khrus byas te/ gos gtsang ma bgo bar bya/ don yod zhags pa'i snying po brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas shing / snying po brgya rtsa brgyad kyang bzlas par 5bya / yi ge gcig pa stong phrag bcur bzlas la/ dkyil 'khor nye bar spras shing me tog dang / bdug pa dang / dri dang / mar me dang / gtor ma dbul 6bar bya'o/ /de nas yungs kur la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas par 7bya ste/dkyil 'khor gyi steng du 'phang bar bya'o/ /'phangs pa tsam gyi mod la/'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi lus las 'od zer sna tshogs 'byin par byed do/ /ldong ros kyi snod de yang 'bar bar byed de/ 'bar ba tsam gyi mod la mig la bskus na nam mkha' la 'gro'o/ /don yod pa'i ye shes yangs pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i 'od zer gyi bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin so sor thob bo/ /don yod pa'i 'khor lo kun nas rnam par gzigs pa zhes bya ba'i rig sngags 'chang gi 'khor los sgyur 8bar 'gyur te/ rig sngags 'chang gi 'khor los sgyur 9ba gang gā'i 7klung gi bye ma bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgus yongs su bskor bar 'gyur ro/ /thams cad du gnas kyi mnga' bdag rgyal por 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du 'gro zhing / tshe bskal pa dpag tu med par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal ba 'od dpag med kyi cod pan 1 'chang bar 'gyur ro/ /don yod pa dri ma med pa'i spyan zhes bya ba'i rdzu 'phrul so sor thob ste/ rdzu 'phrul gang gis 1 se gol gtogs 1 pa tsam gyis/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing / gang gā'i 7klung 5bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgur 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi don yod pa'i dngos 92—537

grub yangs pa'i mchod pa byed —1)par 'gyur zhing skad cig gis slar yang 'ong bar byed don/ /rang gi lus la 'od zer brgya stong phrag du ma 'bar bar byed do / /gang 'dod pa thams cad byed do/ /de nas du ba 'thul bzhin pa ni bskus na mi snang bar 'gyur te/ mi snang ba'i rig pa 'dzin pa thams cad kyi 'khor los sgyur dab rig sngags 'chang gi rgyal por 'gyur ro/ /lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / 'byung po dang / lha ma yin dang /nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po'i gnas kyi sgo thams cad bye nas gnas te/ gang du 'dod pa der 'jug par byed do/ /gnas thams cad na gnas pa rnams 'bangs su gyur nas gnas te/ ci bsgo ba byed do / /sems can thams cad kyang rjes su 'brang bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po dang btsun mo'i 'khor g.yog cadang bcas pas mchod pa dang / bla mar bya ba'i gnas gcig pur 'gyur ro/ /bka' bsgo ba yang / bdag nyid dang / nor gyis kyang byed cing gnas so/ /dbu ba 'byung bzhin pa bskus na/ cho ga zhib mo dang / phyag rgya dang / dkyil 'khor thams cad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rigs kyi gsang ba'i dam tshig mngon du gyur nas gnas te/ 'das pa dang /ri ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsungs pa rnams sngon 6du gyur nas gnas so/ /lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / 'byung po thams cad yang dag par rjes su 'brang zhing / srung 7ba dang / bskyab pa dang / sba ba'i ched du rtag pa kho nar rjes su 'gro'o/ /sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mngon sum du mthong ba sbyin par 'gyur ro/ /don yod pa'i 'od zer dang 92—538

ldan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin so sor thob ste/ sa'i steng nas sor bzhi tshad du 'phags pa'i nam mkha' la gnas so/ /ldong ros la bzlas nas mig la bskus nas/ mig gis gang mthong ba de dbang du gyur nas gnas te/ rgyal po dang / btsun mo'i 'khor dang / blon po dang / bkrabs pa dang / mdun 1na 'don dang / dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi dang / bud med dang / skyes pa dang / khye'u dang / bu mo dang / dge sbyong nadang / bram ze dang / rgyal rigs dang / rje rigs dang / dmangs rigs rnams dbang du gyur nas gnas so/ /tha na ri dgas dang / bya yang lta bar byed bzhin du dbang du gyur nas nye bar gnas so/ /'dis byugs pa'i mig gi nad dang / gnod pa dang / sdig pa dang / sgrib pa thams cad rnam par nyams par byed do/ /lus kyi gdung ba dang / sems kyi gdung ba thams cad dang / rmi lam ngan pa dang / mtshan ma ngan pa dang / bkra mi shis par gyur pa thams cad rnam par nyams par byed do/ /skye ba brjes canas kyang spyan lnga yongs su dag pa so sor thob po/ /tshe rabs dran par yang skye bar 'gyur ro/ /'jigs pa dang /sgrib pa dang bral zhing / don yod pa 5legs par rab tu gnas pa kun tu gzigs pa zhes bya ba'i lus dag pa so sor thob po/ /kun nas don yod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi gsang ba de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig so sor thob po/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kun tu gzigs pa'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i dbang bskur ba so sor thob po/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang rtag tu yang 'grogs shing gnas pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis lung bstan par 'gyur ro/ /zhes so 6mig 92—539

sman gyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'o// //de nas 1bdug pa rim par phye ba'i cho ga bshad nga ra bya ste/ rig sngags 'chang thams cad kyi mchog tu rmad du byung ba/ sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mchod pa'i don dang / de bzhin nyid ri40du 'jig rten gsum po thams cad 'gugs pa grub pa dang / lha thams cad spyan drang ba dang /dbang po dang / tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug chen po rnams bsdigs dpar byed pa/ gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / sha za dang /gdon ma rungs pa de rnams thams cad bdug pa'i dris 'bros par byed par 4)the tsom med do/ /bgegs dang log par 'dren pa nyid dang / sdang ba dang /de bzhin du bdud kyang rung ste/ bdug pa'i dris rnam par zhig par 'gyur zhing / yan lag dang nying lag rnam par 'thor bar byed do/ /rang gi dmag dang / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs dang / shin tu 'gras 6pa dang / phyir rgol ba dang / de bzhin du dgra bo nyid dang / skye bo snang ba dang / gang du 'thab pa dang / rtsod pa dang / 'gyed pa dang / g.yul nyid kyang bdug pa'i dris thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur bar the tshom med do/ /gal te skyes pa'am/bud med dam/ khye'u'am/ bu mo'am / dge sbyong ngam/ bram ze nyid dang /de bzhin du dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma dang / dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / rgyal po'am/ rgyal phran dang / de bzhin du rgyal mo dang /btsun mo'i 'khor kyang rung ste/ legs par khrus byas/ gos gtsang ma bgos nas bdug spos 'dis bdugs na gang gis bdugs 8pa'i dri mnams pa dang /92—540

de lus la reg pa tsam gyis sdig pa thams cad las rnam par grol lo/ /sgrib pa thams cad rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid thob par 'gyur te/ 'di la the tshom med do/ /mtshams med pa lnga'i sdig pa rnams 'phral du thams cad rnam par dag par 'gyur ro zhes so/ /bdug pa 'di tsam gyis/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams dris kun tu 'gengs te/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha'i gnas nas ji srid tshangs pa'i 'jig rten gyi bar dris kun tu 'gengs so/ /stobs dang shugs chen pos lha'i gnas thams cad 'gul bar byed cing skyod 1par byed do/ /chu rgyun gyi klu rnams 'gul bar byed cing / ri rab las gzhan pa'i ri gang yin pa 'dar yid yed byed do/ /gsang bar gnas pa rnams rnam par skrag par byed do/ /dmyal ba bcu drug gi 'jigs pa rnams rnam par zhig par byed do/ /de bzhin du/ sa'i mthil thams cad kyang dkar bsil du snang bar 'gyur ro/ /dmyal ba 2pa'i sems can rnams shin tu sbyangs pa dang /sdug bsngal mi bzad pa de rnams thams cad yongs su grol te/ bde ba can du yang 'gro'o/ /mtho ris thams cad du ji lta ba bzhin du gnas so/ /dmyal ba thams cad nyams te/ pad+ma can du rab tu 'gyur ro/ /nyi tshe ba'i dmyal ba rnam pa sna tshogs pa gzhan rnams dang / sa 'og gi nang du song ba gang yin pa dang / dgon pa dang / ri dang / tshang tshing dang / dgon dung 3dang /g.yang sar gnas pa'i dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal myong ba gang yin pa de rnams thams cad bdug 4pa'i dris yongs su grol lo/ /mi gtsang ba za ba'i gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / 'byung po dang / sha za gang yin pa rnams dang /bshang ba dang / gci sgrub za ba gang yin pa rnams dang / mchil ma dang /92—541

snabs za ba gang yin pa rnams dang / 'dres pa za ba gang yin pa de rnams thams cad bdug pa'i dri mnams pa tsam gyis yongs su grol nas 'phral (1)nyid du lha'i 'jig rten du skye'o/ /rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i ro bro ba'i mchog dang / dri zhim po'i kha zas rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /dud 'gro'i skye gnas su song ba'i srog chags ri dgas dang / bya rnams thams cad dri la mnams pa tsam gyis nad thams cad las yongs su grol lo/ /bdug pa mnams pa tsam 'dis nad thams cad las yongs su grol lo/ /rims thams cad las yongs su grol lo/ /na ba thams cad las yongs su grol lo/ /'bras dang / phol mig dang / lhog pa dang / me dbal dang / shu ba dang / mdze dang / g.yan pa dang / mig na ba dang / mgo bo 2na ba dang / gzhogs daphyed na ba dang / rna ba na rigab dang / sna na ba dang / so na ba dang / kha na ba dang / sba ba dang /'jigs pa dang / skrag pa dang / nad 'go ba dang / 'khrug pa'i sdug bsngal thams cad bdug pa'i dri bsnams 55pa tsam gyis rab tu zhi bar byed do/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug de dang / don yod pa'i rgyal po'i snying po'i mthu yis 6sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur ba'i las kyi sgrib pa thams cad rnam par nyams par byed cing / rnam par grol te mi 'jigs pa'i grong du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas rdzas rnams kyi rang gi 7 cha shas rnam par phye ba dang ldan pa bshad par bya ste/ tsan+dan srang gsum dang / a ga ru nasrang gsum dang / du 9ru ska srang lnga dang / gur gum srang bcu dang / spro 7ka srang gnyis dang / na lan da srang gnyis dang / ma he'i mig srang nyi shu dang / sra rtsi pog srang bcu dang / bo la srang gsum dang / sal+la tī 11srang brgyad dang / rgya spos srang 92wa 542
