gnyis dang / spang spos srang gcig dang / shā ma ka srang gcig dang / garnya pa tra srang gcig dang / pad+ma ge sar srang gcig dang / shri rī ma'i me tog srang gcig dang / li kha ra dkar po srang bcu dang / dri'i pri (1yang ku srang gcig dang ske/ pu shel tsi ( srang lnga dang / stag sen srang gcig dang / sug smel srang gsum dang / pā la ka srang lnga dang / gur gum dang / gla rtsi tshor ba ste/thams cad legs (gupar rnam par dbye bar byas nas/ phye mar byas la mthar thams cad gcig tu bsdoms te/ sbrang rtsis sbru bar bya'o/ /tshes bco lnga la/rgyu skar dang / tshes grangs kyi lha dge ba la/ rig sngags 'chang gtsang mar gyur (༅pas gos gtsang ma bgos /5)te/ legs par khrus byas par gyur pas brtul zhugs spyad pas bdug pa'i mchog sbyar bar bya'o/ /de nas bdug pa'i 6rgyal po sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa tshad shin tu rnam par phye ba bya ste/ gzings kyi tshad kyi shin tu bcags pa/ 'jam zhing bsnyen pa la/ tshon rnam pa sna tshogs pas sgo 'a༄bzhi shin tu rnam par phye ba/ mdzes par bri bar bya'o/ /dbus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi snying por/ pad+ma'i phreng ba bri'o/ /dbus kyi pad+ma phyed kha bye 8ba'i phreng ba bri ste/ lag pa gnyis 'thon 99nas sna tshogs pa'i sprin 'khrigs pa 'dzin par byed pa'o/ /de'i steng du bdug pa'i snod bkod nas/ me'i kha dog can gyi 97gos kyis g.yogs la/ dkyil 'khor gyi grwa bzhi rnams su/ rlung gi rgyal po bri'o/ /sgo bzhir zhags pa bris nas khor yug tu lag pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /pad+ma'i phreng ba las nges par 'thon 11pa'o/ /bdug spos 'khyil pa 'chang 1 bar byed pa dkyil 'khor gyi steng du spras par bya'o/ /ji ltar 'byor pa'i gtor ma dang me tog dbul bar bya/ mchod yon gyi snod dang / gang ba'i bum pa dang /92—543

ba dan dang / rgyan dang / skud pa dmar pos mtshams bcing ba 1)dang /dkyil 'khor la dngul dang / gser bzhag cing / khor yug tu mar me'i phreng ba dang / dri sna tshogs rgya chen po'o/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bkod nas kha shar du phyogs nas pad+ma'i phreng ba la nye bar dgod par bya'o / /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis bdug pa'i rgyal po la yongs su bzlas (5par bya ste/ nyi ma bdun la thun gsum du don yod pa'i rgyal po brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas shing snying po brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas so/ /don yod pa'i snying po yi ge gcig pa'i bzlas brjod 'bum rdzogs pa ste/ stong phrag brgya rdzogs pa ni bzlas brjod kyi cho ga'o/ /de nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la mchod pa bya zhing / slar yang don yod pa'i rgyal po'i bzlas brjod nyi shu rtsa gcig dang /khro bo'i rgyal po'i bzlas brjod nyi shu rtsa gcig bya'o/ /de nas thog mar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bdug pa dbul bar bya/ de nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la bdug pa dbul lo/ /'di ni bdug pa sgrub pa'i cho ga grub par 'gyur ro/ /bdug pa'i rgyal po 'dis bya ba de sgrub par 'gyur ro/ /gal te rig sngags 'chang gis yungs kur gyi 'bras bu gcig gi tshad tsam gyi bdug pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mchod par 'dod pa dang / stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams dri gcig gis rgyas par 'dod pa dang / bdug pa'i sprin 'khrigs pas kun nas g.yogs par 'dod pa dang /dri sna tshogs pa'i char 'bebs par byed par 'dod pa des/ bdug pa'i rgyal pos bdug pa de/ rig sngags 'chang gis rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par mngon par brtson par bya'o/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis nyi ma re re zhing sangs rgyas 92—544

bcom ldan 'das dang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi spyan sngar dkyil 'khor byas la me tog gcal du bkram par bya'o/ /mchod yon dang /zhabs bsil yang gzhag par bya/ bdug pa'i rgyal po 'dis bdug par bya zhing /don yod pa'i rgyal po dus gcig tu brjod par bya ste/ phyogs bcur bdug pa'i pog 17phor dbul bar bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad yid la byed par 'gyur ba dang / sems can 'byung po thams cad la byams pa bsgom par bya/sangs rgyas kyi zhing du gtogs pa thams cad dri ma med pa'i sems kyis yid la bsgom par bya/ dkyil 'khor la me tog dang bdug pa dang / mchod yon dang / zhabs bsil phul te yi ge gcig pa yid la brjod cing / phyag rgya yang lan cig 2bcings la phyag bya'o zhes so/ /phul ba tsam gyi mod la phyogs re re zhing gang gā'i klung gi bye ba 4khrag khrig brgya stong phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu'i sangs rgyas bye ba la dris khyab par byed cing / bdug pa chen po 'khrigs pas nam mkha'i mthil du khyab par 'gyur ro/ /dri sna tshogs kyi char 'bab par 'gyur te/bcom ldan 'das mchod pa'i las sangs rgyas kyi zhing re re zhing gang gā'i 5klung gi bye ma khrag khrig brgya stong phrag bye ba dgu bcu rtsa dgu'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la mchod par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mchod pas de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams thams cad rig sngags 'chang la dus dus su don yod pa'i rgyal po dran par byed pa srung 6ba'i don dang / phyag rgya 'ching bar byed pa de srung 7ba'i don du/ legs so zhes bya ba'i sgra rjod 8par byed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad byams pa rgyas par byed pa de bzhin du bya'o/ /don yod pa chen po'i dngos grub kyang sbyin par byed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 92—545

de rnams kyi drung du bsod nams kyi tshogs chen po nye bar sog 0)par byed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa re re zhing / bye ba brgya stong phrag gi drung du bsod nams kyi phung po dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba nye bar sog napar byed do/ /ji ltar rig sngags 'chang de bzhin gshegs pa mchod pa'i cho ga byed byed pa de bzhin du/ rnam pa du ma de bzhin gshegs pa re re zhing gi spyan sngar rab tu 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags 'chang nyi ma bdun du rab tu brtson pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang / bla ma mchod do/ /phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mngon sum du mthong ba stsol bar byed do/ /de rnams thams cad kyi cidabugs 'byin par byed la mchog rab tu stsol bar 'gyur ro/ /don yod pa'i dngos grub rjes su stsol bar 'gyur ro/ /phyir mi ldog pa la rab tu gnas par 'gyur ro/ /sa bcu yang dag par gnon te mngon par shes pa lngar 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten pa'i bdug pa sgrub pa'i cho ga'o/ /de bzhin nyid du 'jig rten las 'das pa la 'chi 'pho ba na de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan snga'i zhabs drung du pad+ma las rdzus (5)te skye bar 'gyur ro/ /tshe rabs dran par yang 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang dang gang du 'gro bar byed pa de thams cad du yang /de bzhin gshegs pas 6rig sngags 'chang la lung ston par 'gyur ro/ /phyis kyang skye ba gzhan 7du skye bar mi 'gyur ro/ /lus 'di nyid kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la bsnyen bkur nas/ bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams su song ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar byed do/ /tshe dpag tu med par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag tu med pa ji lta ba de bzhin du/ 'di'i rdzu 'phrul dang rnam par 'phrul pa'i khyad 92—546

par so sor thob po/ /'di ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bdug pa sgrub pa'i khyad par ro/ /de nas 'jig rten pa'i bdug pa sgrub pa'i cho ga brgya stong phrag du ma 'grub par byed do/ /ji lta 6)ji ltar bdug pa nyid yid la byed pa de lta de ltar thams cad yang dag par 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /klu'i gnas su bdugs na/bdugs pa tsam gyi mod la/ klu'i rgyal pos char rgyun chen po 'byin par byed do/ /rgyal po'i sgo ru (nadabadugs na/ rgyal po dang / btsun mo'i 'khor g.yog dang bcas pa dbang du gyur nas gnas so/ /skye bo mang po'i dbus su bdugs na/rigs bzhi'i 'jig rten dbang du gyur nas gnas so/ /bdag nyid la bdugs na / thams cad du mchod pa'i 'os chen por 'gyur ro/ /nad thams cad la bdugs na/ nad thams cad yongs su grol bar byed do/ /dug la bdugs na dug med par 'gyur ro/ /mtshams kyi nang du bdugs na me tog dang /'bras bu thams cad ro zhim pa dang / legs par bsrungs par 'gyur ro/ /lo thog la bdugs ( rin/ 'bru'i phung po chen por 'gyur ro/ /khyim mam /gtsug lag khang ngam/ grong ngam/ grong khyer la bdugs na/ dug dang /sbyar dug dang / dug dang bcas pa'i srog chags thams cad nam yang mi 'byung ngo 95ci/ /g.yul gyi dbus su bdugs na cher rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /bdag nyid dam/ gzhan rnams sam/ don mthun 6pa rnams la bdugs na/lam du 'gro ba na chom rkun dang / g.yon can dang / rkun mo dang / gcan gzan 57)gtum po'i 'jigs pa thams cad mi snang bar 'gyur zhing / bde ba dang legs pas rang gi khyim du 'ong ngo / /dpag tshad stong du 'gro yang ngal ba med cing / slar yang 'ong bar byed do/ /dung la bdugs nas mthon napor 92—547

bus na ji srid dung gi sgra thos pa de srid du gnod pa thams cad dang / 'jigs pa thams cad dang / nad thams cad dang / mtshon cha dang / 'thab mo dang / 'thab pa dang / rtsod pa dang / 'gyed pa dang / phyir rgol ba dang /dgra bo dang / sdang ba dang / rab tu sdang ba'i sems can thams cad rnam par nyams par byed do/ /yams thams cad dang / nye bar 'tshe ba dang /nad 'go ba thams cad dang / 'khrugs pa thams cad rnam par nyams par byed do / /bde ba dang / lo legs pa dang / dga' bar 'os par 'gyur ro/ /dge ba'i rtsa 1ba thams cad 'dod par 'gyur ro/ /nad med pa dang / gnod pa med pa dang / rims med pa dang / thang chad pa med par ji srid 'tsho'i bar du gnas so/ /khang pa'i steng mthon por phyogs bzhir bdugs na/ rlung dang / sad dang sprin gyi ser ba thams cad bcing bar dzona'agyur te/ ji srid yid la byed pa nar mar yod pa de srid du mtshams bcing bar da byas par 'gyur ro / /khyim gyi nang du bdugs na/ bud med dang / skyes pa dang / khye'u dang / bu mo dang / bran pho dang / bran mo thams cad dang / ji srid du rkang gnyis pa dang / rkang bzhi pa thams cad byams pa'i yid du 'gyur te dbang du gyur nas gnas so/ /ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bsnyen bkur byed do/ /slar yang yid gzhan du mi 'gyur ro/ /'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe/ bdugs na/dri mnams pa'i mthu des/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa skyes te/ de bzhin gshegs pa bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu mngon sum du mthong ba so sor thob ste /phyis kyang ngan 'gro log par ltung bar 'gro bar mi 'gyur ro/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba'i tshogs thams cad yang dag par 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /'chi 'pho ba na bde ba 92—548

can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams sam/ mngon par dga' bar skyes te 'di la dogs pa dang / yid gnyis bskyed par mi bya zhing / the tshom bskyed par mi bya'o/ /zhes so/ /ma mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi khyim la bdugs na/ nag po chen po la sogs pa/ ma mo'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ dbang du gyur par 1'gyur te/ mdun du nye bar gnas par byed do/ /lha dang / klu dang /gnod sbyin dang / srin po thams cad dang / nag po chen po'i gzugs brnyan (2gyi spyi bo'i gtsug tu bdugs na/ bdugs pa tsam gyi mod la/ kha nas khrag skyug go/ /rig sngags 'chang gis de blangs te/ thig le byas nas nam mkha' la lding bar byed do/ /mig la byugs na mi snang bar 'gyur te/ bde blag tu 'byung po'i bdag po chen por 'gyur ro/ /lto bar yongs su byugs na/ gnod sbyin dang srin po'i dpon po'o/ /lus mtha' dag la byugs na/ stobs dang /brtson 'grus dang / rtsal /chen po nag po chen po dang mtshungs pa'i shugs su 'gyur te/ de nyid kyi cagazugs su 'gyur ro/ /'khor gyi tshogs chen por yang 'gyur ro/ /tshangs pa la bdugs na/ bdugs pa tsam gyi 5mod la/ 'o ma 'dzag pa blang bar bya ste/ lus la byug par bya'o/ /tshangs pa dang 'dra neba'i stobs dang shugs su 'gyur te nam mkha' la 'gro bar byed do/ /khyab 'jug la bdugs na/ bdugs pa tsam gyi mod la lus la pa lā 7sha'i kha dog gi dri'i chu 'dzag sten/ rig sngags 'chang gi lus la byug 9par bya'o/ /sred med kyi bu'i gzugs dang / stobs dang / shugs 'chang bar 'gyur te/ lag na 'khor lo thogs pas nam mkha' la 'gro'o/ /dbang phyug chen po la bdugs na/dbang phyug 7chen po'i lus la rngul 'byung ste1rta/ rig sngags 'chang gi lus la 92—549

byug par bya'o/ /dbang phyug 17chen po'i gzugs su 'gyur te/ lag na mdung rtse gsum dang / stobs dang / brtson 'grus dang / rtsal (2)gyis 'byung po'i bdag po chen por 'gyur te nam mkha' la 'gro'o/ /thams cad la don yod rgyal po'i bzlas brjod lan gsum gsum rnam par sbyin par bya'o/ /snying po yi ge gcig pas spyi bor bzlas brjod lan bdun du bzlas brjod sbyin par bya'o/ /spra tshil las byung ba'i klu mgo bo dgu pa sor bzhi pa'i tshad du bya ste gser gyis g.yog dpar bya zhing dri'i dkyil 'khor bya ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi steng du gzhag par bya'o/ /don yod pa'i rgyal pos lan brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas so/ /bdug pa 'dis bdugs pas klu ldang bar byed do/ /rig sngags 'chang gis 'jigs pa med par bya ste/ khro bo'i rgyal po yungs kur la bzlas 4)te/ spyi bo'i gtsug tu brdegs mun/ lding bar byed do/ /gang du 'dod pa der gnas nas/klu chen po'i mtsho dang / gnas dang / gzhal med khang rab tu 'byung ngo 6)/ /chu gang yin pa de rnams kyang 'thung bar byed pa dang / khrus byed pa'i bud med dang / skyes pa dang / khye'u dang / bu mo'am/ tha na dud 'gro'i skye gnas su song bas 'thung ba dang khrus byed pa de rnams thams cad kyang nad rnams dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /sdig pa dang / sgrib pa dang bral ba dang / 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral bar yang 'gyur ro/ /klu rnams kyang dus dus su char gyi rgyun chen po 'byin par byed cing / char 'bebs par byed do/ /dus dus su me tog dang / 'bras bu dang / lo thog rnams rdzogs par byed de/ ro zhim po'i ro myong bar 'gyur ro/ /phyir zhing log par ltung bar 'gro bar mi 'gyur ro / /phug dang khung bu'i sgo ru 'khrul 7'khor gyi sgo glegs la bdugs na bye zhing 92—550

gcog hunyepar 'gyur ro/ /'khrug (gepa'i dus su bdugs na/ 'pham ( )par 'gyur ro/ /lag mthil la bdugs na/ gang dang gang la reg pa thams cad du dbang du byed do/ /bdug pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'o// //de nas sman gyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bshad par bya ste/ don yod par thams cad du gzhan gyis mi thub pa nad thams cad sel bar grub pa/ thams cad du dug 'joms par byed pa/ na ba thams cad sel bar grub pa/ sdang ba thams cad ldog par byed pa/ 'byung po thams cad la mi 'jigs pa/mtshon dang / me dang / chu dang / dug rab tu 'joms pa/ rtag tu srung ba dang bskyab 74pa dang sba bar byed pa/ dgra rnams dang / gzhan rgyal ba ldog 95ripar byed pa/ rgyal po dang / rgyal phran nam/ btsun mo'i 'khor du song ba dang gtso bo rtag tu dbang du byed cing thams cad du thogs pa med par 'gyur ro / /pha rol gyi dmag tshogs dang / 'khrug pa dang / g.yul rnams rtag tu rab tu 'joms par byed pa/ gang gi tshe chom rkun gyi nang du song ba nyid dang /don mthun 96)gyi nang dang / rkun mo dang / seng ge dang / stag thugi nang du song ba de'i tshe/ thams cad du sman gyi rgyal ba ster ro/ /tshe ring por 'gyur te/rtag tu pad+ma'i phyag gi namachog sbyin par 'gyur ro/ /lha rnams kyis rtag tu srung bar byed do/ /gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / klu dang / lha ma yin dang /nam mkha' lding nyid dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po nyid dang / mi ma yin gdug pa gang yin pa de rnams thams cad nyin dang mtshan du sung 9ba'i don du yang dag par sgrub par 'gyur te the tshom med do/ /rgyal po chen po rnam 1 tsho92—551

thos sras dang / rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung dang / rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po dang / mig mi bzang dpung dang bzhon (1 pa dang bcas pa dang / skabs gsum pa'i lha'i dbang po dang / tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / lha de rnams thams cad mthun 2pas rtag tu srung bar byed do/ /sangs rgyas kyis rnam par gzigs shing / rtag tu yang mthong ba stsol bar mdzad do/ /gang sman lag tu phyin par 'gyur ba 'di/yang nas yang du rig sngags kyi dngos grub myur du thob bo/ /byad stems 'pho ba med do/ /de la dug med cing sdig pa med la/ mi bzad pa'i sbyor ba dang /phye ma'i sbyor bas gnon par mi 'gyur ro/ /sngon gyi sgrib pa nyams par byed de/de bzhin du yang / sdig pa thams cad dang / rmi lam ngan pa dang / mtshan ma ngan pa gang yin pa dang / gzhan rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i sdang ba nyid de/ de rnams thams cad myur du rnam par nyams par byed do/ /sman gang du gnas pa'i dpag tshad khor yug tu srung ba dang / de bzhin nyid du mtshams bcing ribar byed do/ /bgegs cadang / log par 'dren pa thams cad dang / de bzhin du/ bdud dam sdang ba de rnams thams cad rab tu 'bros par byed do/ /sman gang du gnas par gdon rab tu 'bros 5par byed do/ /mkha' 'gro ma gang yin pa dang / rnal 'byor ma gang yin pa dang / skem byed dang /gza' dang brjed byed dang / grib gnon gang yin pa dang / mi bzad pa de rnams thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /lha rnams der gnas par byed cing / 'khrul 'khor la sman a ga da 6de mchog go zhes so/ /rgyal bas dbugs 'byin par mdzad cing / dngos grub thams cad kyi de kho na nyid 92—55 2

stsol bar mdzad do/ /rtag tu 'jig rten dbang phyug gi 1mchog stsol zhing /rtag pa'i mthar mthong ba stsol bar 'gyur ro/ /don yod pa'i zhags pa myur du 'grub ste/ sman 'chang ba la/ sman gang du gnas par gang gis kyang glags 2mi rnyed do/ /don yod pa'i mchog sbyin pa zhes bya ba yid bzhin gyi nor bu sman gyi mchog rab tu 'bad pas bcangs pas 47legs par bsgrub par 5bya ba dngos grub kyi mchog las thams cad byed pa de nyid de'i tshe shi ba yang dag par 'tsho bar byed pa/ lo rdzogs par bsten te/ sngags dang phyag rgyas gso bar bya'o/ /lo stong phrag tu rtag tu 6bde ba dang / dga' bar byed do/ /dbang phyug dang /nor thob pa dang / 'bru 'phel ba dang / bla na med pa dang / rgyal po dga' bar 'gyur te rtag tu gnas so / /'bangs dang / ci bgyi dang / mchod pa chen po rnyed do/ /thams cad du de 8rtag tu tshig btsun pa'o/ /thos pas dngos grub mchog gyur pa'i/ /rdzas kyang 'dir ni bshad bya ste/ /tsan+dan rgya spos ru rta 9dang / /spro 1 ka shing tsha bā la ka /brag skyes spang spos sā ma gang / /sug smel gla sgang 11na la da/ /pad+ma ut+pal pri 12yang ku/ /shing kun 'dab rim tsha ba gsum/ /shi rī ngasha yi me tog dang / /de bzhin pa ri bai la ba 'di rnams cha ni mnyam par ldan/ /thams cad legs gzhal legs par sbyar/ /gsang sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la/ /khro bo'i rgyal pos dbang bskur te/ /yi ge gcig pas stong phrag bcur bzlas so/ /'dir sman rnams bgrang phreng gi tshad tsam du bsgongs nas grib ma la 7yongs su bskam par bya'o/ /gla rtsi dang /ga bur gyi blangs tshal legs par sbyong ba'i bya ba byas pa dang / dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa ni/ ji lta ba bzhin du dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba dang / phyag rgya dang /92—553

gsang sngags dang / dam tshig la rab tu 'jug pa la/ shar gyi sgo ru 0)phyag byas nas/ dkyil 'khor mchog la bskor ba bya ste/ sgo dang sgo ru phyag bya zhing /shar gyi sgo ru 'jug par bya'o/ /dbus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi snying por/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la mngon du phyogs par pad+ma'i ge sar la 'dug nas / don yod pa'i rgyal po'i bzlas brjod brgya rtsa brgyad dang / khro bo'i rgyal po'i bzlas brjod brgya rtsa brgyad bya ste/ mngon par dbang bskur bar bya zhing /phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags legs par sgrub 90bo/ /de nas mchod pas 'jig rten mgon po'i dngos grub mthong bar byed cing rtag tu g.yo bar byed la 'jig rten mgon po'i 'od zer gyi sbyin sreg rab tu grol lo/ /za( gyidakyil 'khor bshad par bya ste/ gru labazhi po ko la'i tshad du cha 5legs par phye ba gru (6༄bzhi dang /sgo bzhi yod pa/ them skas kyi rim pa can du tshon sna tshogs kyi skud pas thig gdab cing dkyil 'khor gyi snying po mdzes par bya/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus kyi snying po pad+ma mchog kha phye ba 'dab 7rim brgya rtsa brgyad 98 pa/ snying po dang / ze ba shin tu mdzes pa/ snying po las pad+ma byung ba/ kha phyed bye ba dang / lag pa gnyis byung bas pad+ma'i 'dab ma 'dzin pa bris par dngul gyi snod kyi nang du sman bkang ste dar gyis kha g.yogs nas pad+ma'i 'dab tsasama'i steng du gzhag par bya/'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug rtag tu tshangs pa'i cha byad du bzhugs patso / dar gyi cod pan bcings shing 11brgyan pa pad+ma'i steng du bzhugs par bya'o / /dkyil 'khor phyi rol kun tu phyag rgya'i rtags rnams gsal bar bri'o/ /sgo sgor don yod pa'i zhags pa 1 pad+ma'i steng du bzhag 1 pa kha dog dang 'od zer 'bar ba bri'o/ / grwa grwar khubum pa gang ba 'bri'o/ /dkyil 'khor kun du 92wa 554

'phan dang / bum pa gang ba dang / 'bras bu dang / me tog bsres pa mdzes pas brgyan par bya'o/ /gtor ma rnam pa sna tshogs gzhag par bya'o/ /mchod yon gyi chu dbul bar bya/ tsan+dan dang / a ga ru'i bdug spos dang /spos sna tshogs dbul bar bya/ dkyil 'khor kun tu mar (17me'i phreng ba dang /me tog phreng ba dgod cing kun du 'bras yos (2)dang / yungs kur tsho nodagram par bya'o/ /rig ( nisngags 'chang gtsang mar gyur pas legs par khrus bya zhing /gos gtsang ma bgos pa 'jigs pa med pas zla ba yar gyi ngo nya la bsgrub par bya ste / sems can thams cad la brtse bar gyur cing byams pa'i sems dang /snying rje'i bdag nyid can gyis bsgrub par bya'o/ /gang gis lag gis gzung 57ba tsam dang / reg pa tsam gyi mod la de dga' ba 'thob cing sdig pa thams cad 'jig ri nopar 'gyur ge/ sngon gyi sgrib pa rnams 'jig 8par 'gyur/ mtshams med pa byed pa rnams las grol bar 'gyur/ mod la nad thams cad 'byang zhing ngan 'gro thams cad 'jig 97par byed pa bsod nams chen po'i stobs kyi dngos grub sman gyi de kho na nyid mthong ba 7ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyis lung bstan cing de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 11byin gyis 12brlabs pa/ byang chub sems dpa'arnams kyis bsngags pa/ 'dren pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gis sprul pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad kyis bsngags pa/ rig sngags 'chang gi dbang po lha thams cad kyis phyag byas pa/ lha thams cad kyis bsrung ba1 /klu'i dbang po thams cad rjes su 'brang ba/ sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha'i dbang po dang / tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug chen po dang /gshin rje dang / chu lha dang / ku be ra dang / nyi ma dang / zla bas mchod pa/92wa 555

de bzhin du rgyu skar gyi tshogs dang / gza' kun dang / mjug rings (1)dang /de bzhin du gza'i khyim dang / thams cad du bkra shis kyis mchod pa/ cho ga zhib mo thams cad dang / de bzhin du dkyil 'khor dang / phyag rgya dang /bzlas brjod thams cad dang / gsang sngags thams cad kyi rjes su zhugs pa/rigs spyi'i de bzhin gshegs pa gang gā'i (nasaklung da bye ma snyed bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis sman gyi mchog dbang bskur ba/ dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis lung bstan pa/yid bzhin gyi nor bu thams cad dang mthun skurapa'i tsho sman gyi rdzas 'chibakra shis pa bye ba khrag khrig gam/ lhag par gyur pa gzhan gang yang 7med do/ /sman de lta bu ni rtag tu mchog gtso bo 'byin pa/ 'jig rten dbang phyug dang 'dra ba yin no/ /de'i phyir thams cad sman 'chang bar 'dod pas gnas gang yang rung bar sbyar bar bya ste/ gtsang nam legs par khrus byas pa des sbyar bar bya'o/ /ji lta ji ltar bkra shis kyi bsam pa yid la byed pa de lta de ltar bsam 9)pa yid la byed pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur te/ sbyar ba tsam gyi mod la thams cad 'grub par 'gyur / 'dod pa thams cad kyi bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur/ rig sngags 'chang gtsang mar gyur pa/ gos gtsang ma bgos pa spos chus legs par khrus byas la nyin re sman re re don yod pa'i rgyal pos bzlas brjod byas te zos tson / zos pa tsam gyi mod la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' 1 thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis dgongs shing snang ba rnam par dag pa 1 'thob par 'gyur / nyin zhag gsum du sbyar na ngag rnam par dag pa 'thob bo/ /nyin 92—556

zhag lngar sbyar na dran pa rnam par dag pa 'thob 1bo/ /nyin zhag bdun du sbyar na rig sngags chen po'i cho ga zhib mo rnam par dag pa 'thob bo/ /nyin zhag 5bcu bzhir sbyar na don yod pa'i zhags pa de kho na nyid kyi dngos grub kyi dam tshig chen po 'thob bo/ /nyin zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig tu sbyar na de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs kyi dam tshig dang / phyag rgya dang / dkyil 'khor chen po'i dam tshig gi dngos grub 'thob bo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi dam tshig gi dngos grub 'thob 4bo/ /zla ba gcig gi bar du sbyar na 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi 5dngos grub sgyu ma lta bus brgyan 6pa thob cing tshe lo stong thub par 'gyur ro/ /zla ba gsum du sbyar na lus yongs su dag pa dang / mdog yongs su dag pa 'thob bo/ /lo gcig tshang bar sbyar na don yod pa'i dngos grub rig sngags 'chang 'khor los sgyur bar 'gyur te/ mig mthon mthing 7mdog bung ba lta bu skra ral bu 'khyil bar 'gyur / tshe lo bdun pa lta bu'i gzugs dang mthun 8par 'gyur la/ tshe bskal pa 'bum 79thub par 'gyur ro/ /bdar nas bdag nyid la byugs na/gang dri mnams 7pa tsam gyis 11bgegs dang / log 'dren dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin 12po dang / 'byung po dang / sha za dang / yi dgas dang /skem byed dang / brjed byed dang / grib gnon thams cad dang / gdon thams cad dang / gdug 1 pa thams cad dang / dgra thams cad dpag tshad stong du 'bros so/ /gal te myur du mi 'bros na ni spyi bo dum bu 'bum du 'gas shing yan lag dang / yan 1 lag rnams zhig par 'gyur la/ bu dang chung mar bcas pa 'jigs 15par 'gyur/ sngon gyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa rnams kyis mi 92—557

tshugs 1par 'gyur/ sems can dmyal ba myong bar 'gyur ba mtshams med pa lnga dag 'jig par 'gyur/ rmi lam ngan pa dang / ltas ngan pa dang / mi shis pa dang / bkra mi shis pa'i dngos po thams cad 'jig par 'gyur/ spos bsnams napa tsam gyis rgyal po dang / rgyal po'i blon po dang / bram (5)ze dang /khyim bdag dang / rgyal rigs dang / rje'u rigs dang / dmangs rigs ci bgyi zhes bya ba byed cal dbang du gyur ldanas 'khod do/ /byugs pa tsam gyis 'bras dang / phol mig dang / lhog pa dang / me dbal dang / rkang shu dang / g.yan 6pa dang / mdze dang / khyi rngo dang / shu ba dang / 'brum bu phra mo dang / rma dang / khong gi rma yongs su sos par 'gyur/ dug tham sa cad dang / zos pa dang / dug myos dang / sbyar dug drag po dang / dug sbyar ma dang / sbyar dug phye ma dang / byad rnams la bskus pa tsam dang / chu dron po 'thungs pa tsam gyis dug med par 'gyur ro/ /dri tsam gyis klu'i rgyal po 'jog po'i dug kyang med par 'gyur ro/ /rims nyin bzhi pas thebs pa la dpral bar bskus na ku co 'don cing 'bros so/ /rims thams cad dang /nyin gcig pa nadang / nyin gnyis pa dang / nyin gsum pa dang / rlung las gyur pa dang / mkhris 9pa las gyur pa dang / bad kun las gyur pa dang /'dus pa las gyur pa dang / lba ba dang / pho ba'i nad dang / mchin pa na ba dang / lto 7na ba dang / skran 11dang / gcin sri ba dang / snying na ba dang /12rtsib logs na ba dang / mgul pa na ba dang / kha na ba dang / 'khyil zhing na ba dang / tshad pa dang / mdoms 1rin ba dang / yan lag dang nying lag na ba chu dron po 'thungs pa tsam gyis yongs su sos par 'gyur ro/ /gzhogs phyed 92—558

na ba dang / mgo na ba dang / mig na ba dang / rna ba na ba la bskus pa tsam gyis sos par 'gyur 6)ro/ /thig le byas na chom rkun dang / gnod byed dang /me dang / chu dang / byi (5)ba za bas 'jigs pa dang / gcan gzan 5)khro bo'i (4'jigs pa las thar bar 'gyur zhing / 'jigs pa thams cad las yongs su thar bar 'gyur ro/ / nyes par byas pa thams cad yongs su thar bar 'gyur ro / /(5)lag pa gdengs pa'i 'jigs pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur/ mi ma yin pa gang gis kyang mdangs 'phrog par mi nus shing bar chad bya bar mi nus so/ /mkha' 'gro ma thams cad mthong ba tsam gyis dbang du gyur nas 'khod do/ /rgyal po btsun (6)mo dang / 'khor dang bcas pa'i mchod gnas chen por 'gyur rozhir / /gzhan yang gang dang gang du sbyar ba rang gi blos bye ba phrag 'bum sbyar na las grub (8)par byed de/ sman gyi mchog shin tu 'bad pas bsgrub par bya'o/ /sman gyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'o// //de nas de'i phyir gser gyi ril bu'i ri97dkyil 'khor bshad par bya ste/'jig rten dbang phyug gi don yod pa'i snying po/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi don yod pa'i 7rnam par gzigs pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa pad+ma gtsug tor gyi rgyal po zhes bya bas byin gyis brlabs pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rin 11chen snying pos byin gyis brlabs pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten dbang phyug 'od kyis bka' stsal pa / gzhan yang de bzhin gshegs pa gang gā'i 1lhaklung gi bye ma snyed 1 bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgus gsungs shing bsngags pa/ byin gyis 92wa 559

brlabs pa/ dbang bskur ba/ rjes su thugs rangs 1par mdzad pa/ lung bstan pa/ mgon po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gtsug tor gyi 2nor bu cod pan 'chang ba/ rgyal po 'od dpag med kyi gtsug 4tor gyi mtshan nyid kyi thig le yid bzhin gyi nor bu rgyal mtshan gyi nor bu chen po'i rgyal po mchog tu grub 5pa/ rig sngags dang / dkyil 'khor dang / phyag rgya dang /cho ga zhib mo thams cad kyi gsang ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs kyi tshodam tshig spyi/ sku'i snying po gang gis mthong ba tsam la sogs pa 'dis tshad 7bstan par lta su 8zhig gis nus mod kyi/ 'on kyang de bzhin gshegs pa gang gā'i / klung gi bye ma snyed bye ba dang / dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rdzogs par mngon sum du mthong ba dang 'dra bar 'gyur zhing / de bzhin gshegs pa de 1 dag nyid mngon sum du mchod par gzung 11ba dang /lung ston pa 1 'thob par 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gi mngon sum du dge ba'i rtsa ba bsod nams kyi phung po dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /nor bu gser gyi kha dog tu bstan pa'i ril bu 1 'di gang gis mthong zhing 'chang ba ni dge ba'i rtsa ba bsod nams kyi phung po chen po bskyed bskyed 7par 'gyur/ nor bu ril bu 15'di mthong ba tsam gyis sgrib pa dang / sdig pa tshadang / gdug pa dang /mtshams med pa lnga dang / mnar med par gzhol ba dang / dam pa'i chos spong ba dang / 'phags pa la skur pa 'debs pa dang / sngon gyi tshe rabs nas bsags pa'i sgrib pa thams cad rnam par 'jig cing spangs par 1 'gyur/rims dang / nad thams cad las yongs su thar bar 'gyur/ gang gi lag na sman 'di yod par gyur pa'i 1 sems can de ni lung bstan par 'gyur ro/ /92wa 560

ril bu 41gang la yod pa ni/ /phyir mi ldog par lung bstan cing / /mgon po sa bcu dag la gnas/ /rtag tu mchod rten gyur pa 5ste/ /sku gdung snying po'i bdag nyid can/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas bdag nyid 'gyur/ /dus gsum dag la zhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas de bzhin gshegs pa gang / /sangs rgyas dpa' bo de kun gyi/ /sras gcig tu ni brjod pa yin/ /'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sras / /thugs las skyes dang zhal las skyes/ /chos kyi dbyings sprul chos las skyes / /'jig rten dbang phyug camachog sbyin mgon/ /rtag tu rjes su 'brang bar 'gyur/ /phyag g.yas rtag tu spyi bor ni/ /'jog mdzad 'di ni the tsom 5med / / ril bu 6mthong ba tsam gyis ni/ /sdug bsngal kun las rab tu grol/ / sdig pa thams cad rnam par 'tshed/ /)sgrib pa thams cad rnam 8par 'dag9de ni ngan 'gror 'gro mi 'gyur/ /phyir zhing gnas mchog zhi ba 'thob/ /'jig rten 'dren pa 'od dpag med/ /mgon po rtag tu mngon sum mthong / /bde ba can du 'jug par byed/ /gang na de yi mngon dga' ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs pa/ /rtag 7tu mi 'khrugs par 'gyur zhing / /de bzhin mi g.yo mi 'gul te/ /sems dpa' ri rab che 11dang mnyam/ /gzung du med pas mtsho dang 'dra/ /de la bgegs dang log 'dren dag / nams kyang 1 'jug par mi 'gyur la/ /sems dpa' phyag bya'i gnas su 'gyur/ /gang la nor 1 rgyal 'di yod la/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi po dag /dpung dang bcas pa bkol dang bcas/ /rtag tu bsrung 7phyir gnas byed de/ /'dir ni nyin mtshan de bzhin no/ /lha tshogs thams cad bsrung 5bar ni/ /the tshom 7med par byed par 'gyur/ /gzi brjid dpal yang rab tu 'phel/ /de la legs 92—561

par 'jug par 'gyur/ /'jigs 1med rtag tu rmi lam ni/ /dngos po chen po sna tshogs mthong / /gru 'dzin ri la gzhal med khang / /tshal dang bcas shing rin chen bcas/ /gnas dang bcas pa mthong bar 'gyur/ /lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang / /dri za lha min gsang ba pa/ /nam mkha' lding dang mi 'am ci / /de bzhin lto 'phye 'khor dang bcas/ /byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor rnams ni/ /kun nas bskor ba mthong bar 'gyur/ /rin chen lha yi seng ge'i gdan / /khang pa brtsegs pa rin chen dang / /nor bu chen pos brgyan (gepa dang / /'jig rten dbang phyug thub pa'i gtso/ /pad+ma'i (misnying po la zhugs nas / /don yod zhags pa'i phyag rgya dang / /dkyil 'khor bcas pa'i chos ston 4to/ /gsung kun thob par gyur nas ni/ /thub pa rang gi ngo bo mthong / /de ltar rmi lam bzang rmi ba/ /nyin gcig 5ribazhin du mthong bar 'gyur/ /nor bu rgyal po'i mthu ni de 'dra 6bas/ /de bas mi yis 'bad pa chen pos zung ( sku/ /dge sbyong bram ze nyid dang rgyal rigs dang / /dmangs rigs nyid dam yang na rgyal po 'am/ /btsun mo 8skas sam dpung gi gtso bo 'am/ /skyes pa'am bud med khye'u dang bu mo dag /nor bu'i 9༄rgyal po rtag tu 'chang byed pa/ /de ni ston pa nyid dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /chom rkun gyis ni mi slus shing tsha/ /gnod byed kyis ni 'jigs mi 'gyur/ /'jigs pa mi bzad brgyad las thar/ /de la dug dang sbyar ba'i dug /sbyar dug drag pos mi tshugs shing / /de la byad kyis tshugs mi 'gyur/ /gang la nor bu'i rgyal po yod/ /de la nad kyis mi tshugs shing / /na bas ma yin sdig pas min/ /pad+ma chu yis mi chags ltar/ /rtag tu chags pa med par gnas/ /g.yul 'gyed 1nyepa yi /denang na 'am/ /92—562

'thab bam 6)'gyed pa'am (5)rtsod pa na/ /lan thebs rtag tu rgyal bar ni/ /thob par 'gyur te the tsom ( med/ /de nas rdzas ni bshad bya ste/ /sman ni bkra shis dang ldan pa/ /grub pa'i mtha' ste mchog tu gtsang / /'jig rten mgon dang mnyam par gsungs/ a ga ri4)ru dang / tsan+dan dang / pad+ma dang /ut+pal dang / shi ri sha'i me tog dang / a bā 5marga dang / me ru dang / na la da ri skudang / chu srin gyi sen mo dang / ka na ma'i 'bras bu dang / tsan+dan gyi 'bras bu dang / pad+ma'i 'bras bu dang / rdo dreg dang / ma med dang /btsod dang / sru ka ri dang / ma ka ṭī dang / dzā naya dang / bi dzā 9ya dang /pa ri pe 7la pa dang / ra sa dang / bī rā dang / dh+ya ma ka 11dang / rgya spos dang 12/ bu sā dang / a par ta ka dang / ru rta 1 dang / bya gra khan kha dang / pa da atra dang / tra tsa dang / ka dam ba sarā dang / pri yang rkye 1 tshodzo dang / gi'u wang 1shedang / spro sna ka dang / smyig 2 rkang dang / yungs kur lkudang / nā 2steg put+pa 2nadang / e lā 7dang / ldong ros dang / gur gum dang /ga pur dang / gla rtsi dang / spang spos dang / na le sham dkar po dang / su ma dang / nye'u shing dang / shu ti dang / sbrang rtsi dang / tsam pa shāka ste/de bzhin rdzas ni de dag kun/ /su bar ṇa ni 25dkar pos ( sbyar/ / ril bu 28nam gcig 27tsam du ni/ /skyes bu mkhas pas bya ba yin/ /su bar ṇas ra tshoni bkab nas su/ /rdzas rnams bsres nas sbyar bar bya/ /cha rnams 'phel bar bya ba ste/ /gla rtsi yis ni dri bskyed do/ /phye ma zhib mor btags nas su/ /tsan+dan dkar po'i chu sbyar nas/ /grib ma la ni bskam ristopar bya/ /tshes brgyad nas ni da brtsams nas su lha/ /tshes ni bcwa 4lnga nya yi bar/ /nyin gcig dag92wa 563

bzhin du don yod pa'i/ /rgyal pos 1brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas/ /khro bo'i rgyal po 2nyin gcig bzhin/ /lan bdun bar du dbang bskur ro/ /phyag rgyas dbang bskur bar yang bya/ /de nas tshes ni bcwa calnga ste/ /nya la chu dang yungs gar 5dag /dkyil 'khor du ni gzhag par bya/ /de nas nor bu'i rgyal po dang 6/ /gzhag pa'i dkyil 'khor bshad par bya/ /cha rnams ma nor legs par dbye / /rgyar ni ko la'i tshad 8du bya/ /shin tu 'jam la phyi bdar 9legs / /tshon rtsi sna tshogs mdzes pa 1 dang / /dkyil 'khor mchog ni thig gdab bo/ /sgo bzhi gdod lha cing grwa 1 bzhi gdodami / /kun nas shin tu cha phye 7zhing / /dkyil 'khor snying po cha phye ba/ /tshad dang shin tu ldan par bya/ /pad+ma chen po bzhi dag dang / /de bzhin phyag dang spyan du bcas/ /don yod dngos grub bri bar bya/ /nor bu rgyal po 'chang ba yis/ /phyag rgyar bcas pa bri bar bya/ /chu yi rgya mtsho'i nang du ni/ /las kyi rdo rje legs par bri/ /dkyil 'khor snying po dam pa la/ /kun nas kha khyer rnam pa dang / /me tog sna tshogs pa dag bri/ /dkyil 'khor phyi rol kun du ni/ /nor bu pad+ma legs par bri/ /sgo bzhi yi ni gnas rnams su/ /pad+ma zhags pa mdung 'irtse gsum/ /rdo rje'i tshul mchog legs par bri/ /grwa slobazhi yi ni gnas rnams su/ /lag na 1 nor bu yod pa 18byi/ /pad+ma'i steng na rab tu gnas/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po phan 17phran dang / /bum pa bkang dang me tog dang / /bdug pa 'bras bu rnams kyis brgyan / /gtor ma rnam pa sna tshogs dag /ci bdog bungs cher 22gzhag par bya/ /kun du mar me phreng ba dang / /mchod yon chu dang a ga ru/ /tsan+dan bdug spos dbul bar bya/ /nor bu rgyal po 'jigs med pa/ /snod 92wa 564

bzang —1 legs par bkang nas su/ /rgya dar la yis kha g.yogs te/ /dkyil 'khor de na nyid rig pas gzhag /dkyil 'khor snying por 'jig rten dbang / /gzhag ste de nas las rdo rje/ /snod kyi steng du bzhag pa ni/ /nor bu dkyil 'khor bya ba yin/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis don yod pa'i rgyal po lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod bya/ khro bo'i rgyal pos lan bdun dbang bskur bar bya/de nas gsang sngags yi ge gcig po 'bum tshang bar bzlas brjod bya ste/ 'bum bzlas brjod byas na nor bu'i rgyal po 'bar bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gi lag /g.yas dang ldan pas bzung nas ni/ /chang lapa dam du bsdam 5 par bya/ /bsdams pa tsam gyi mod dag la/ /rdzu 'phrul gyis ni mkha' la 'gro/ /nor bu dri ma med pa don yod pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa bkod pa zhes bya ba/ rig sngags 'chang gi 'khor los sgyur 6ba 'thob la 'khor rig sngags 'chang 'khor los sgyur skyab bye ba phrag 'bum yod par 'gyur/ khung gi nasgo thams cad phye bar 'gyur/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad phye bar 'gyur9/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs kyi dam tshig dang / dkyil 'khor dang / phyag rgya dag kha ton du lobs par 'gyur/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du 'jug par 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal ba dang / 'dud pa dag gis gsong por smra bar byed/ thams cad du yang don yod pa'i dkyil 'khor rnam par thar ba'i dkyil 'khor rnam par phye ba thob par 'gyur / tshe bskal pa 'bum phrag bdun cu 7rtsa gnyis su ring bar 'gyur/don yod pa'i pad+ma'i 'khor lo mdun nas 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te 'bar bar ma gyur na sngar bstan pa'i yon tan gyi khyad par rnams thob par 'gyur la/92—565

mnyam pa 1nyid kyis de bzhin gshegs pa dang 'dra ba'i nor bu rgyal po'i ril bu ②ni 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i las rnams sgrub pa yin no/ /tshe brjes rinas 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur la/ gang dang gang du skye ba'i tshe rabs thams cad du tshe rabs dran par 'gyur/ nor bu'i ril bu ca'adi mthong ba tsam gyis dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa mngon sum du mthong zhing blta 5bar 'gyur/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mngon du mthong zhing rtag tu blta 6bar 'gyur/ ril bu smyo norang gi lus la yod pa de yang phyir mi ldog par rig par bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel gyi snying po mchod rten dang mnyam pa zhes bya ba ste/ 'di la som nyi (8)dang yid gnyis bskyed par mi bya'o/ /mthong ba dang reg pa tsam gyi mod la sngon gyi las kyi sgrib pa grangs dang bgrang ba'i tshul gyis 9)bskal pa 'bum du bsags pa/mnar med pa'i gnas su 'gro bar 'gyur ba/ mtshams med pa lnga byed pa/'phags pa la skur 1 pa 'debs pa/ dam pa'i chos spong ba de dag thams cad dus gsum gyi bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gi mthu dang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi nor bu'i rgyal po'i mthus thams cad zad par 'gyur/ sems can dmyal ba'i 'gro ba dag las yongs su thar bar 'gyur/ bde 'gro'i lam la gzhol bar 'gyur/ tshe brjes 1 nas 'jig 12rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de lta bas na legs par sgrub pa /ldemathar thug par bya zhing bsgrub par bya/ mthu stobs kyis sbyar bar bya/ shin tu gsal zhing rab tu gsal ba'i bsam pa r+sā'abad pas sbyar bar bya/ rang gi sha dang khrag kyang yongs 92wa 566

su btang nas btsal bar bya zhing cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po yongs su btsal bar bya ba yin na phyi rol gyi dngos po nor dang / 'bru dang / dbyig tsho 1skudang / gser dang / dngul dang / gos dang / rgyan rnams yongs su btang nas yongs su btsal bar bya ba lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ srog gtang (5bar bya'i de gtang ri cibar mi bya'o/ /don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po 45rnam par thar ba'i dkyil 'khor rim par phye ba sgrub 5pa 'di btsal ri stabar bya zhing bsgrub par bya'o/ /'di'i 7)dus phyi ma'i tshe na sems can thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa byed par 'gyur/ sems can thams cad yang dag pa nyid kyi dad pas sangs rgyas nyid du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur/ phyir mi ldog par 'gyur zhing nams kyang ngan na'agro log par 'gro bar mi 'gyur ro/ /nor bu'i ril bu ri9risgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'o// //de nas de'i phyir don yod pa yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po don yod pa chen po'i rnam par 'phrul pa'i dngos grub kyi sman nor bu dang / gsang sngags rnams bshad par bya ste/ sman nor bu dang / gsang sngags dang / dkyil 'khor dang / phyag rgya'i mthu 7des phyi ma'i dus phyi ma'i tshe na rig sngags 'chang rnams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs kyi dam tshig spyi'i gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor rnam pa sna tshogs sgyu ma lta bu'i ngo bo nyid bstan pa yang dag par ston par mdzad/ bklags 11pas grub pa/ rigs kyi dam tshig spyi'i gsang ba 12thams cad du tsho nye bar ston par mdzad do/ /rig sngags 'chang rnams kyi ngal ba 〉'bras bu med pa gzhan du 'gyur tshab med do/ /ngal ba dang / dub pa 92wa 567

dang / 'bad pa'i bzlas brjod kyi cho ga 'bras bu med par mi 'gyur bar bya ba'i phyir rang gi sems kyi rgyud dad pa dang / gus pa dang / gsang chen dang /gsang bar bya 1ba gzhan la 2bstan par mi bya ste/ dngos grub med par mi 'gyur ro/ /de lta bas na gsang sngags sgrub pa ni shin tu gsang bar bya zhing legs par smyung ba byas la 'bad par bya/ kha zas ngan pa spang bar bya/ gos ngan pa dang / sems ngan pa yang yongs su spang bar bya/ mi srun pa dang /mi bden pa dang / phra ma dang / sems can sun 'byin 4par byed pa dang /gsang sngags rku ba dang / cho ga zhib mo rku 5bar byed pa 56dang / phyag rgya dang / dkyil 'khor rku bar byed pa de dag gi rtogs pa ni gang na yang med de/dus gsum gyi mgon pos smad cing byang chub sems dpas kyang 7slad la/mgon po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis kyang smad pa yin no/ /sems can sdong dum bsregs pa 'di / /gsang ba sun 9'byin ma rungs pa/ /'jig rten 'di dang 1 pha rol tu/ /rtag tu smad 11par bya ba yin/ /lha rnams kyis ni yongs su btang / /ma rungs pas ni bdud kyis zos/ /ma rungs pas ni bgegs kyis zos/ /bslab gzhi 12tshul khrims nyams 1 pa dang / /mgon po'i bstan 1 pa sun 'byin pa/ /de 'il dngos grub ji ltar 'byung / /de la skyob pa gang yang med/ /mgon lomed kun tu smad pa yin/ /de bas de la dngos grub 1 ni/ /chung ngu'ang med la nyes pa yis/ /gsang sngags dang ni sman mi 'grub / /nyes pa de dag rang gis byas/ /gzhan yang ma rungs byed pa yin / /de bas sems can mkhas la sbyin/ /slob pa 'dod cing yon tan dga' / /snying rje'i bdag nyid byams la 9gnas/ /sems can kun la brtse 92—568

ba'i mchog /de yi lag tu sbyin bya ste/ /de yi dngos grub bla na med/ /gsang ba 'di ni shin tu gsang ba yin te/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gi snying po gsang ba de yang rig sngags 'chang rnams kyi de kho na nyid kyi gsang ba dang / gsang sngags dang / phyag rgya sgrub 1sla ste/ bklags 2pas 'grub pa de bzhin du sman nor bu 'di la rtag tu 'jug cing dngos grub kyi de kho na nyid rab tu ston par byed pa yin no/ /rig sngags 'chang ni bdag nyid kyis/ /mchog tu gsang ba bsgrub bya ba/ /rig sngags 'chang ni gtsang ma yis/ /khrus byas gos gtsang gyon byed la/ /'dir ni nyin zhag smyung 4ba dang / /dad dang gus pas mchod pa bya/ /don yod 'khor lo sgrub byed pas/ /dngos grub dkyil 'khor dam pa bsgrub / /sman spro muka dang / tsan+dan gyi phye ma dang / a ga ru dang / pad+ma ge 6sar dang / pad+ma dang / pad+ma'i ldum bu dang / pad+ma'i 'dab 7ma dang / de bzhin du gi'u nawang dang / ldong ros dang / tsam pa ka dang / su ma na ste/de bzhin cha ni mnyam sbyar te/ /phye ma dag tu byas nas ni/ /de nas don yod rgyal po yis/ /tshes brgyad nas ni bcwa 9lnga'i bar/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas brjod bya/ /khro bo'i rgyal pos brgya rtsa brgyad/ /bzlas brjod byas nas dbang bskur ro/ /de'i 'og tu cha lngar bya ste/ mig bsku ba dang / ril bu 1 dang /phye ma dang / til mar tshos pa dang kha gdong bkru 11zhing khrus bya'o/ /mig sman ni so'u byi re dang lhan cig sbrus la don yod pa'i rgyal pos brgya stong bzlas 1 brjod bya'o/ / ril bu 1 ni sbrang rtsi dkar po dang lhan cig sbru'o1 / /phye ma ni 'jig rten dbang phyug la phul ba'i me tog dang lhan cig sbru'o/ /til mar btsos pa ni brah+ma sati la ste/ shing pa la sha'i mar dang lhan cig sbru'o/ / kha 92wa 569

gdong 1bkru ba ni tsan+dan dkar po'i chu dang lhan cig sbru zhing su ma na dang /gur gum dang / spos chus lhan cig sbrus nal so sor brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bya/ khro bo'i rgyal pos nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod byas nas dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang nyin zhag gcig smyung ( rab byas pas gcig tu sbrus te/ dngul gyi snod kyi nang du bcug la so sor brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod byas nas shar phyogs kyi sgo nas dkyil 'khor du gzhag par bya ste/dkyil 'khor mchog la phyag dang bskor ba byas la de nas so sor dar gyis kha bcad de/ dkyil 'khor gyi snying por bzhag la don yod pa'i rgyal po brgya rtsa ( gebargyad bzlas brjod bya/ khro bo'i rgyal po brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod ༷yebyas nas tsodabang bskur 8bar bya/ dbang bskur bar ri9)byas nas kyang rig tsosngags 'chang gis dbang bskur bar bya/ de nas dkyil 'khor snying por ni/ /'jig rten dbang phyug mchod bya ste/ /bdug spos lnga dag dbul bya ba/ /a ga ru dang tsan+dan dang / / spro ka gu gul 11du ru skasku/ /mchod yon snod ni lnga dbul ⑫zhing / /gtor ma lnga ni dgang 5bya ste/ /ro ldan sna tshogs dag gis dgang / /ro ldan 'bras bu sna tshogs pa'i/ /gtor ma cha lnga dbul bar bya/ /kun tu phreng ba nyi shu dang d+ku/ /mar me nyi shu lnga dag dang / /spos kyi phye ma lnga dag dang / /spos kyi cha lngar phye bas byug /'phan saphran nyi shu rtsa lnga gdags/ /tshon rtsi lnga yis mdzes par bya/ /gser dang dngul gyis g.yogs pa yi/ /bum pa gang ba nyi shu lnga/ /rin po che 1 ni lnga gzhug go/ /sgo bzhi grwa 3 bzhir bum pa brgyad/ /brgya dang nyi shu rtsa lnga nyid/ /dkyil 'khor me tog 'bras yos 19dang / /yungs kur nyid kyis mngon par dgram / /slob dpon bla ma mchod pa ni/ /gos 92—570

dang snod dang yon 4)gyis so/ /thub pa 'jig rten dbang phyug ltar/ /ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed nas su/ /dkyil 'khor slob dpon mchod byas nas/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gshegs par gsol/ /de nas las rnams bya ba ni/ /ji ltar yid la sna tshogs bya/ /don yod chen po'i gzhal (5)med khang / /rig sngags 'chang gis rtag tu gsang / /de nyid dngos grub bsgrub sla ba/ /de bzhin nor bu sman sngags so/ /don 'di shin tu bkra shis te(5)/ /mkhas pa mi yis la bya ba yin / /phra ma'i tshig kyang mi bsten rigate/ /brdzun ni nam yang 6smra mi bya/ /'di ni bsgrub 7pa'i de nyid de/ /de la 'grub pa the tsom ri med/ /'dir ni dkyil 'khor bshad par bya/ /kun nas gru bzhi lham pa ste/ /grwa 9bzhi cha ni legs par dbye'o/ /ko la'i tshad de legs pa dang / /sna tshogs tshon gyi thig skud kyis/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa thig gdab bo/ /dkyil 'khor dbus kyi snying por ni/ /'khor lo bzang po bri bar bya/ /dbus kyi lte bar pad+mo yis11/ /'khor lo gsal ba bri bar 12bya/ /pad+ma'i snying po gser dang ni/ /dngul lam tsan+dan las byas pa/ /'bar bar 1 'jig rten dbang phyug bzhugs/ /'khor lo kun tu rtsibs dang ni/ /mu khyud dag gis cha dbye'o/ /dkyil 'khor snying po'i grwa thurnams der/ /lha yi dbang po tshangs pa dang / /khyab 'jug dbang phyug chen po bri/ /kun tu kha khyer rnam pa dang / /pad+mas 'phreng ba rnams bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor phyi rol kun tu ni/ /rtags dang phyag rgya rnams bri ste/ /rdo rje dgra sta mdung rtse gsum/ /ral gri zhags pa tho ba dang / /gshin rje be con pad+ma gdugs / /dbyug to mda' bo che rnams so/ /grwa 7rnams kun tu phreng ba dang / /me tog rnam pa sna tshogs dgram/ /sgo sgo der ni dkyil 'khor gyi/ /lha ste gshin 92—571

rje chu lha dang / /lus ngan dang ni gzhon nu bri/ /dkyil 'khor grwa (1)bzhi rnams su ni/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi po dag /go cha legs par bgos pa dang / /khro bar lta ba 'jigs byed bri/ /'di ni dkyil 'khor mchog yin te/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni dgos pa rnams/ /legs par yongs su rdzogs par ni/ /rig nastasngags ji bzhin bstan pa yin/ /de nas legs par khrus byas la/ /gos gtsang bgos pa 'jigs med pas/ /sman mchog bzung ste las bya'o/ /rmongs pa'i dra 4ba sna tshogs dang / /sgyu ma lta bu'i rnam sprul pa/ /gang gis ngan 'gro thar 'gyur ba/ /sems can kun la bstan par bya/ /rtag tu dga' dang dad pa dang / /gus pa de nyid thob par 'gyur/ /rig sngags 'chang gis bsgrub pa'i mchog /dngos grub de nyid thob par 'gyur/ /rig sngags 'chang gis sngar khrus byas la rdzas kyi dri chab gtsang ma don yod pa'i rgyal pos brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bya/ tsan+dan gyi chu la rabargya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod byas nas skra yan chad tsam byugs la tshod zin par bskus snyonas kha gdong bkru bar bya'o/ /mig sman la brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod byas nas bskus na mig bzang bar 'gyur ro/ /brgya rtsa brgyad tshang bar bzlas brjod byas nas bdag nyid dang phyogs bcur gtor ro/ /de bzhin du til mar 8brgya rtsa 9brgyad bzlas brjod byas nas skra yan chad bsku ba dang / tshod zin par bsku ba dang / lus rkang mthil yan chad bsku'o/ /yi ge gcig po yid la bya ba la sems byams pa nyid la gnas nas rgyal po dang / btsun mo'i sgo'am/ skye bo'i nang ngam/ 'dus pa chen po'am / dge 'dun gyi nang ngam/ tshogs dang phrad pa'am/ de bzhin du gzhan dag kyang rung ste/ de dag thams cad kyis 'jig rten mgon po'i 92—572

gzugs dang kha dog (1)tu mthong zhing sa'i steng nas rkang pa khru gang tsam gyis spags te 'dug la/ ji lta ji ltar 'dul ba rnams kyi dad pa de lta de ltar gzugs rnams ston par byed de/ rgyal po'am/ 'khor los sgyur 5ba'am/mi'i seng ge'am/ phag dgam/ sred med kyi bur ston pa'am/ tshangs pa'am /sum cu rtsa gsum gyi dbang po'am/ dbang phyug 5chen po mig gsum pa'am/gzhon nu'am/ chu lha'am/ gshin rje'am/ rnam thos kyi bu'am/ de bzhin du rgyal po chen po bzhi'am/ nag po chen po'am/ dga' byed dbang phyug gam/ser skya'am/ gsang ba pa'am/ lag na rdo rje stobs po che'am/ nor bu bzang phyi po'i bu'am/ gang ba bzang po'am/ stobs kyi lha'am / gar mkhan mchog gam/ rlung lha'am / drang srong nyid de ji ltar gzugs rnam pa sna tshogs yid la byas pa thams cad ston par byed do/ /me tog dang / 'bras bu sna tshogs pa nyid 'byung bar byed do/ /de bzhin du dge 'dun gyi nang du zhugs na de sangs rgyas kyi gzugs dang / gzugs sna tshogs su snang zhing gzhal med khang gi rnam pa dag kyang ston par byed do/ /ji ltar 'dod par 'gyur ba yid la byas pa de ltar gzugs rnams ston par byed do/ /'khor tshogs pa'am/dgon pa'am/ 'chag sa dag kyang sman nor bu dang / gsang sngags kyi mthus gzugs sna tshogs su ston par byed do/ /'gron po 'brog gi nang du phyin pa nyam 9thag pa/ 'jigs pa mi bzad 1 pa/ chu med pa/ dgon par mgon med pa/sdug bsngal drag po de lta bu'i nang du chud pa'i skye bo sdug par gyur 11pa/ skyabs med pa/ mgon med par gyur pa/ skyob pa med pa/ dpung gnyen med par gyur pa na 1 de la rig sngags 'chang gis phye ma 'dis phyogs bzhir mtshams gcad 1292—573

par bya/ phye mas dkyil 'khor gyi tshul du ri mo bris la ril bu lnga 6)dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su gzhag go/ /yungs kur (nasal til mar gyi rgyal pos bskus la don yod pa'i rgyal po ribargya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bya/ khro bo'i rgyal pos brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod byas te dbang bskur nas khro bo'i rgyal po hūm̐ zhes bya bas ④phyag rgya bcings la sa la bsnun cing phyogs bzhir gtor (5)bar bya ba phyag rgya dang ldan par byas pa tsam gyis chu bzang po rnam pa sna tshogs 'bab cing rdzing 'byung bar 'gyur/ tshal dang / nye ba'i tshal dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu sna tshogs dang ldan pa'i gzhal med khang 'byung bar 'gyur/ phye nema'i dkyil 'khor de 7las grong khyer dang / khang bzangs 'byung 8)bar 'gyur/ khyim gyi gnas lnga stong 'byung bar 'gyur zhing bde ba dang / lo legs pa dang /nyams dga' ba dang / skye bo dang / mi mang pos gang ba 'byung bar 'gyur/nyo tshong dang / ba lang dang / ma he dang / rta dang / glang po'i nyusteganas dag 'byung bar 'gyur/ dge sbyong dang / bram ze dang / tshong pa dang / khyim dang / khang pa bzang po dag 'byung bar 'gyur te/ ji srid du bsams dzipa de srid du 'dug go/ /chu dang yungs kur la nyunyelan bdun bzlas brjod byas nas phyogs bzhir gtor na mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /yungs kur 8de g.yul 'gyed pa'i nang du gtor na dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi dang ldan par 'byung bar 'gyur te/ des pha rol gyi dmag tshogs dang / dgra 'jigs shing 'joms par byed pa las rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /grong khyer gyi //phyogs bzhi kun tu gtor na gtor ba tsam gyi mod la chi'obs bcad macing ra ba kha khyer gyis bskor la grong khyer kun tu skyes bu go cha bgos pa dag snang bas grong khyer mnan 10pa'am/92—574

gtse bar sus kyang mi nus so/ /mtshan mo'i ( 1)dri'i til mar de nyid yungs shar la bskus te/ brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod byas nas chang ( pa gang me'i nang du gtor / chang (5)pa gang phyogs bzhi kun tu gtor na kun nas mar me 4phreng ba 'byung bar 'gyur la/ ji srid dgos pa de srid du 'bar ro/ /gtsug lag khang ngam/ dgon pa'am/ ri'am/ phug gam/ 'chag sa'i (5tshoganas sam/khyim du gtor na mar me'i phreng (6ba 'byung bar 'gyur la/ chu dang yungs kur gyis mi snang bar 'gyur/ grong khyer gyi sgor yungs kur gtor na gtor ba tsam gyi mod la dgra thams cad dang / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs kyi grong khyer mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /gang na phyir rgol ba dang / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs gnas pa'i grong ngam/ grong khyer ram/ tshal 7gyi nang ngam/ dgon pa'i gnas su gtor na 'brog dgon pa 'byung bar 'gyur la/ thams cad phan tshun ngo mi shes nas 'jigs shing skrag pa chen pos rab tu 'bros 8par byed do/ /dgra'i tshogs kyi nang du gtor na mtshon cha thams cad dang / 'gyed pa'i go cha thams cad mi snang zhing gcer bur 'gyur ro/ /zhal che 'gyed pa'i nang du gtor na 'gyed zla gtso bo de gcer bur 'gyur ro/ /dgra'i steng du gtor na me 'bar ba 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de dag la sogs pa yid la ji ltar byas pa'i las 'bum snyed 9byed do/ /de nas las rgya chen po byed par 'dod 7pa'i rig sngags 'chang gtsang ma legs par khrus byas pa spos kyis lus bskus pa des/ yungs kur 11dang / til mar gyi rgyal pos bskus pa la brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod byas nas / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la gtor bar bya/ khro bo'i rgyal pos lan bdun dbang bskur nas phyag rgya bcas pa'i lag pas ril bu 12spyi 92—575

bor bzhag la phye mas gdab par bya/ til mar gyi rgyal pos rkang pa la byug par bya / don yod pa'i rgyal po lan cig 1dran par bya ste/ yongs su sbyang ba'i las lhan cig bya ba legs par byas pas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi nyan gzugs g.yo ste gar dga' bar 'gro la/ gzugs brnyan gang du 'gro ba de nyid du rang 'gro'o / /lha'i 4steng du gtor na lha 5)lha'i gnas nas 'pho zhing gar dga' ba der 'gro'o/ /phye mas lha'i steng du gtor la 6khro bo'i rgyal po hūṃ zhes bya ba 7mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /til mar gyi rgyal po la lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod byas la 8bdag nyid kyi pus mo dang / byin pa la bskus na nam mkha' la 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /rkang mthil la bskus na sa'i steng na rkang pa sor bzhi tsam mi reg go/ /rdo'i steng du rkang pa bzhag pa dang / rkang rjes 59)byung ba'i steng du rdza ma dang / bum pa dang / bum bu bzhag pa'i rkub khol bskus na sor bzhi tsam gyi tshad du nam mkha' la 'dug go/ /yungs shar la bzlas brjod byas nas mes sbyin sreg 1 byas pa'i thal ba de blangs nas lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod byas la/ til mar gyis sbrus pa la khro bo'i rgyal pos brgya rtsa brgyad dbang bskur nas mig la bskus na mig gsum ston cing dbang phyug chen po'i gzugs su ston par byed do/ /thal bas lus la byugs na tshangs pa'i gzugs su ston to/ /shing pa la 12sha dang parna sha bsres 1 pas lus khubyugs na sred med kyi bu'i stobs dang / shugs dang / gzugs su ston to/ /til mar chen pos khar bskus la thal bas dpral bar thig le byas na gzhon nu'i gzugs su ston to/ /yungs kur gyi 'bru kha dog sna tshogs can la til mar chen po byugs pas bskus la don yod pa'i rgyal pos brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bya/ phyag rgyas brgya rtsa brgyad 92—576

dbang bskur cing khro bo'i rgyal pos brgya rtsa brgyad dbang bskur la/ de nas dngul gyi snod kyi nang du gzhag /de nas las thams cad byed de nam mkha' 1la gtor na nor bu dang rin po che'i char 'bab par ston to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mchod pa'i tshe nam mkha' la gtor na me tog gi char sna tshogs 'bab par 'gyur/ 'dus pa'i nang du nam mkha' la gtor na 'bras bu dang nor gyi rgyun sna tshogs pa ston to/ /tshal gyi nang du gtor na me tog dang 'bras bu sna tshogs pa ston to/ /ri phug tu gtor na rdzas dang sman sna tshogs ston to/ /mchod rten rnying 2pa'am/ gtsug lag khang ngam/ lha'i gnas su gtor na yo byad thams cad kyis yongs su gang zhing rdzogs pa khang pa bzang po yangs pa gnas kyi mchog ston to/ /grong khyer stong par gtor na 'tsho ba'i yo byad thams cad phun sum 4tshogs shing yongs su rdzogs pa dang / yul gyi 5rgyal po dang / slas 'dang / bkrabs pa dang / mdun 7na 'don pa dang / blon po dang / skyes pa dang / bud med dang / khye'u dang / bu mo dag ston to/ /yang /khro bo'i rgyal po'i 9rtsu zhes bya bas gtor na dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa ston to/ /dur khrod kyi nang du gtor na shi ba'i rus pa gang dang gang la bab pa de dang de gang du sems can dmyal ba'am/ dud 'gro'i skye 1 gnas sam/gshin rje'i 'jig rten nam/ lha ma yin nam/ nam mkha' lding ngam/ dri za'am / mi'am ci'am/ lto 'phye chen po'am/ bya'am/ nya'am11/ ru 12sbal gyi rigs su skyes pa'am/ lha'i 'jig rten nam/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing du skyes pa de'i 1 rus pa'am/ thod pa la tshig 'byung bar 'gyur la gang du skyes pa de'i gtam yang smra'o/ /gang dang gang gi skye 1 gnas su skyes pa de thams cad smra la 92—577

thabs ji ltar bya ba de smra'o/ /yungs kur 4)des kyang rus gong 'brel pa'amami/shi ba'i ro'am/ rus pa 'thor ba la bab na bab pa tsam gyi (mimod la sems can dmyal ba las yongs su thar nas 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /zong bkram pa'i nang du gtor na thams cad mi mngon par 'gyur ro / /nam mkha' la gtor na skar ma rnams mi mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /skye bo mang po'i nang du gtor na thams cad gcer bur 'gyur ro/ /'dus pa'i nang du gtor na thams cad bro rdung ri bar byed do/ /dge 'dun gyi nang du gtor na dge slong thams cad bsam gtan thob (5)par 'gyur ro/phyir/ /tshogs kyi gtso bo la gtor na rnal 'byor spyod par 'gyur ro/ /mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs kyi nang du gtor na thams cad bong bu dang / wa dang / khyi'i gzugs can du 'gyur ro/ /sbyor ma'i sgor gtor na sbyor ma thams cad 'bar la ma he'i (7)gzugs can du snang ngo / /shi ba'i steng du gtor na bro rdung (8)bar byed do/ /thod pa'i steng du gtor na bro rdung 9bar byed cing rgyug la phan tshun rgyug par byed do/ /lam gyi bzhi 1 mdor gtor na gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / 'byung po thams cad rang gi gzugs kyis mdun na nye bar 'khod la ji srid 'tsho'i 1skyedabang du gyur (1genas 'khod do/ /nyin gcig bzhin bdag nyid la gtor na mchod pa chen po'i gnas su 'gyur te/ gzhan yang rang gi blo rnams kyis las 'bum snyed byed do / /don yod pa chen po rnam par 'phrul pa'i dkyil 'khor sgyu ma lta bu'i cho ga'o// //'phags pa don yod pa'i zhags pa'i nyu cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po/ bam po 92—578

bcwa 0)brgyad pa/ de nas de'i phyir 'gugs 90pa chen po dang / lag na rdo rje'i gzugs bstan pa'i cho ga bshad par bya ste/ gang gis lha rnams myur du 'ong ba dang / phyag na rdo rje'i gzugs myur du ston to/ /rdo rje'i sku dang stobs po che/ /rta mgrin (5)dang ni mgul sngon dang / /de bzhin rta ni rgod ma'i kha/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil (4)ldan gzugs po che/ /log 'dren rnams ni rab 'joms dang / /khro rgyal de bzhin 'jigs byed spyan/ / ki li ki li'i rgyal po che ri/ /khro bo chol 6pa stobs po che ri/ /de bzhin rdo rje sa 'og gzugs/ /rdo rje rtse mo de nyid dang / /klu chen rab 'joms spyan yangs nadang / /sog ma med ni 'dul ba dang / /de bzhin thigs khro khros chen dang / /de bzhin mche ba gtsigs mdzad dang / /rgyal po chen po rdo rje'i sgrog /klu 95yi dbang po stobs kyis gnon/ /mgon po gos sngon gyon pa dang / /dbyug sngon dgra las rgyal ba dang / /'jig rten dbang phyug pad+ma'i lte/ /phyag na pad+ma pad+ma phyug1 /de bzhin 'jigs pa brgyad sel dang / /de bzhin mchod rten 'jig rten bla/ /sna tshogs gzugs te nyu1bzang po dang / /sred med bu dang tshangs pa dang / /drag po dang ni 12dbang phyug dang / /nag po chen po gzhon nu dang / /gshin nyu rje dang ni chu lha nyid/ /nyi ma dang ni zla ba dang / /rgyu skar sgra gcan khamajug rings skadang / /de bzhin gza' 7dang lha ma yin/ /nam mkha' lding dang mi 'am ci/ /gnod sbyin srin po lto 'phye che/ /'byung po dpal ldan rnam thos bu/ /de bzhin yul skyong mig mi bzang / /'phags skyes de nyid mthong ba dang / /mi'u thung dang ni drang srong gzugs / /nor bu bzang sras gang ba dang 1 tsho/ /sna tshogs gzugs can ston pa dang / /rgyal po dang ni ded dpon dang / /tshong dpon de bzhin khyim bdag 92—579

dang / /bram ze dang ni rgyal rigs dang / /dge sbyong stag 91)dang seng ge dang / /khyu mchog de bzhin nags kyi lha/ /2shing lha de bzhin lo tog rin)lha/ / gang gā si tā )ya mu nāzha/ /zla ba skal ldan ru 6)sbal nya/ /lag (3)'gro dang ni thod pa can / /skal yod 8de bzhin 'bras bu dang / /me tog rgyal (9)rlabs chen po dang / /sna tshogs gzugs dang rnam sna tshogs/ /de ltar dgug 〉pa bstan pa dang / /de ltar slar gshegs gsol ba nyid/ /sbyin sreg 17dra ba 'di nyid ni12/ /sgyu 1 'phrul rmad byung sagasang sngags grub/ /rdzas grub nor bu til mar grub/ /don yod zhags pa bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /de nyid dngos grub rab ston pa/ /mchod rten dgon pa gtsug lag khang / /lha yi gnas dang de bzhin grong / /grong khyer nyid dang 'bab chu'i dngo 15/ /mtshe'u dang lteng ka sachu bo dang / /rdzing dang de bzhin char 'bab dang / /'brug sgrogs nyu dang ni glog 'gyu 18dang / /gzhan yang me ni 'bar ba dang / /dud pa'i phung po bde 'gyed dang / /skyes bu go cha gyon pa dang / /de bzhin mtshon cha sna tshogs mthong / /khyu mthong grub pa mthong ba dang / /de nyid rmad du byung ba ste/ /rdzas nyung sbyar ba nyung gyur kyang / /de nyid dngos grub bla na med/ /sems can rnams la phan 'tshal nas//bcom ldan de nyid bdag gis bshad/ /rig 19sngags 'chang rnams bklags rdu tshopas 'grub/ /dbul po 21rnams ni nor 'thob cing / /sdang ba rnams ni byams par bgyid na/ /mu stegs gzhan rnams dad par bgyid/ /mkhas pa rnams ni dga' bar bgyid/ /gdul dka' da rnams ni thar bar 2 'tshal/ /dge slong rnams ni bsam gtan thob25/ /ting 'dzin bla na med pa thob tsi/ /chos 'dod rnams ni sangs rgyas mthong / /sdig pa byed rnams sdig pa 'jig /mi rigs 92—580

byas rnams thar pa 'thob1/ /mtshams med lnga rnams rnam nadag don/ /dbugs ma phyin rnams dbugs 'byin mchog /ma dul ba rnams de bzhin 'dul / /ma brgal ba rnams sgrol ba'i gru/ /thar pa'i lam du 'gro bar gnas / /ma grol ngan 'gro kun las 'grol / /sdig pa kun las rnam par grol / /lung ma bstan 5pa lung ston byed/ /skyon dang dri ma sdig pa rnams/ /thams cad mod la spong bgyid de / /de la sogs pa'i las rnams ni/ /bklags (7)pas grub pa bgyid pa lags/ /'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten 'das//don gyi dngos grub bla na med/ /gang dang gang du sbyor ba bgyid/ /dgos pa thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /yid la bsams rinapa 'grub par 9'gyur/ /'dir ni yid kyis rnam bsams 1 pa/ /ji ltar yid la 'dod pa dang / /ji ltar ngo bo kun bsams 11pa/ /de ltar rnam 'phrul ston par bgyi/ /tshes grangs rgyu skar sbyar mi 'tshal/ /smyung 12ba bgyi ba mi 'tshal te/ /cho ga ji bzhin dus ci bzhin / /cho ga rig sngags rgyal po 1 bzlas/ /rig sngags 'chang ba gtsang gyur cing / /legs par khrus bgyis gos gtsang dag /bgos 1 tshopa bden par smra ba dang / /bla ma la ni gus byed pa/ /rtag tu byams pa'i sems la gnas/ /sems can kun la brtse ba'i mchog /sdom la gnas shing tshangs par spyod/ /chos ma yin pa spong byed pa/ /gal 7te de nyid grub kho'adod na/ / chang dang /rtesha dang kun 18dong dang / /'dres dang za 'phro sbags pa spang 19/ /sems can ngan pa sun 'byin ( pa/ /rig sngags rku dang cho ga rku/ /chos rku 21gsang sngags rku ba dang / /de bzhin rkun mo chom rkun 22dang / /ser sna rtag tu spang /bar gyis / /de dag la ni dngos grub med/ /ma rungs pa yis dam tshig nyams/ /92—581

yid gcugs 1)pa ni med par byed/ /sdig 8)pa'i chos ni kun du spyod/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyis smad/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis smad/ /rtag tu chos kyi sdong dum 'gyur/ /shi nas sems can dmyal bar gzhol/ /rtag tu smad ripa'i gnas su 'gyur/ /dbul po lus ni skams (pepa dang / /mdze dang khyi rngos 'debs pa dang / /sdug bsngal rkun ma chos sun 'byin/ /chos rku ba yi 55lus can ni/ /'jig rten 'dir ni bder mi 'gyur/ /'jig rten pha rol ga la bde/ /sems can dmyal bar gzhol ba yin/ /de lta bas na chen po 'dod pas ni rtag tu dam pa'i chos kyi rjes su 'brang bar bya zhing rtag tu dkon mchog gsum dang / pha dang ma dang bla ma dang / ston (6)pa ni skyob 9)pa dang /skyabs 8dang / dpung gnyen 9mdzad pa/ ston pa/ mchog sbyin pa/ dngos grub dang / mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa/ rga shi las thar bar byed pa/ dbang phyug sbyin pa/ nor sbyin pa/ longs spyod sbyin pa/ dang ba 97mchog bskyed pa de nyid 'jig rten gyi bla ma/ mgon po 11'jig rten dbang phyug chen po dbang phyug mgon po/ mchog sbyin par mdzad pa/ gzugs sna tshogs ston par mdzad pa12/ dngos grub sna tshogs sbyin par bgyid pa/ mgon po sdug bsngal sna tshogs las yongs su thar bar bgyid pa/ nad sna tshogs sbyong bar grub pa/rin po che skyo sna tshogs rab tu sbyin par bgyid pa/ 'jig rten tsasdig pa sna tshogs sel bar bgyid pa/ bla ma la gus pa sna tshogs bgyid pa lags te/ de lta bas na rtag tu 'bad pas dgos pa thams cad rab tu sbyin par bgyid pa/ rtag tu 'bad pas shin tu gus par bgyis 7pa lags so/ /de nas rdzas kyi sman grub ⑩pa dang / bzlas brjod kyi cho ga bshad par bgyi ste1 tsho/ seng ge'i lce dang /92—582

snying dang / mig dang / de bzhin du nya phyis 1)kyi phye (snyedang / ldong ros dang / brah+ma'i 'o (5)ma dang / gu gul dang / pad+ma dang / pad+ma'i ze ba dang /ut+pa la sngon po dang / nā (4)ga pus pa dang / li shi dang / rgya spos (snyedang /de bzhin du gi'u 6)wang dang / gla rtsi dang / ga bur dang / gur gum (7)dang /tsan+dan dkar po dang / spro ka 8)dang / te dza ba ti ste de ltar cha mnyam par byas pa de dag thams cad phye ༷9)ma zhib mor 7byas la dngul gyi snod bkang ste dar gyis g.yogs(1/ don yod pa'i rgyal po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi mdun du dus gsum du khri bzlas brjod bya'o/ /dus gsum du khro bo'i rgyal pos 1gelan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod byas pas dbang bskur zhing phyag rgyas kyang nyi shu rtsa gcig tu dbang bskur ro/ /khri tshang nas cha lnga byas te phye ma dang / til mar dang / nor bu dang / mig bsku ba 32dang / til mar tshos pa dang cha lnga'o/ /phye ma'i pad+ma mu ru ku'i phye ḍim dang sbyar la bzlas brjod bya'o/ /khro bo'i rgyal pos ni 7lnga stong ngo / /til mar ni ma hā ru dhi tsoras 'grub ste /rtebargya stong bzlas brjod bya'o/ /khro bo'i rgyal pos bzhi stong ngo / /nor bu ni sbrul gyi khrag gis sbrus te khri chig stong bzlas brjod bya'o/ /khro bo'i rgyal pos lnga stong lnga brgya'o32/ /mig sman ni rma bya'i mig chu dang / 'ug pa'i mig dang / klad 4)pa dang sbyar la khri chig ( )stong bzlas brjod bya'o/ /khro bo'i rgyal po stong rtsa brgyad do/ / brah+ma tai solkul srang nyi shu/ gan dha ra ba tai la du srang brgyad/ yungs mar la sung bcu drug /'o ma la srang brgya/ ba ser mo grub pa'i 2na'o ma dang / ba'i lci ba dang /ba gcin srang bdun/ du ru ska'i mar khu snyesung gnyis te rdzas 2ge'adi rnams chu dang bsres du lhanas pad+ma'i sdong 3)bus dkrug cing ni zangs snod du btso'odage/ /92wa 583

mnyam par gzhag pas gsang sngags bzlas/ /cho ga dag gis bsrung bar bya/ /cho ga bzhin du gtor ma sbyar/ /me tog bdug spos dag gis bdug /til mar mchog ni bsgrub par bya/ /chung ngur me bud 91)grub pa mchog /spos kyi shing gis bud pa bzang / /'di ltar grub par shes pa dang / /khro bo'i rgyal pos dbang bskur ba/ /nyi shu gcig tu dbang bskur ro/ /til dzod mar de ni snod gtsang ma/ /zangs snod yang na dngul snod bzang / /spyig ma'i snod du gzhag par bya/ /de nas rig sngags brgyad stong dang / /khro bo'i rgyal po brgyad stong nyid / /so so cadag tu bzlas brjod bya/ /dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa der gzhag par bya ba ni ji ltar dkyil 'khor gyi cho gar bya ba de ltar byas nas gzhag cing slob dpon gyi las kyang bya ste/ ji ltar dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa dang /'jug pa dang / dam tshig dang / phyag rgya dang / dbang bskur ba dang /mchod pa dang / dkyil 'khor bskor ba dang / phyag bya ba dang / spyi'u gtsug bcing ba dang / phyag rgya bcing ba dang / srung ba'i 5cho ga dang / nye reg bya ba 'dang / gos bgo ba dang / mchod phyir thogs pa ste dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon kun gyi 7de dag thams cad bstan par bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus kyi snying por bzhag la rig sngags 'chang sbyang 8)ba'i cho ga byas pas 'phags pa don yod pa'i zhags pa'i 9snying po stong rtsa brgyad 1 bzlas brjod bya/khro bo'i rgyal pos kyang 11stong rtsa brgyad du dbang bskur/ phyag rgyas kyang stong rtsa brgyad du dbang bskur la/ phyag rgya bcings 12nas rnam pa gsum 'dra bar dbang bskur ro/ /de nas las thams cad byas te yungs kur dkar po grub pa la 1 rig sngags 'chang gis brgyad stong bzlas brjod byas la pad+ma'i mchog gtso bo 92—584

gtsang 1)ba/ gtsang mar byas pa/ legs par bkrus 2pa/ sbyangs pa/ phye ma zhib tu btags pa thal ba lta bu la brgyad stong bzlas brjod byas nas snod dgang / gu gul dang / tsan+dan dang / a ga )ru dang / spro ri rika la brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod byas nas snod kyi nang du bkang la/ dbus kyi dkyil 'khor dam pa'i steng du so sor 55)gzhag go/ /de nas khro bo'i rgyal pos dbang bskur cing phyag rgyas kyang dbang bskur ba byas na/ gang gi tshe don du bya ba byung ba'i tshe bya ba thams cad byed do/ /gser ram/ yang na dngul lam/ zangs las pad+ma'i tshad (6)du byas pa 'dab ma nyi shu rtsa gcig dang / snying po dang / ze ba can dang / de bzhin du sor 7bcu gnyis pa'i tshad la 89sdong bu sor bcu drug pa'i tshad rdo rje'i rnam pa can du bya/ skud pa dmar po'i zhags pa pad+ma'i tshon dmar pos bzhen pa/ gzhon nus bkal smyo ba grub pa1 / de dag la brgya stong bzlas brjod bya/ khro bo'i rgyal pos dbang bskur cing phyag rgyas kyang dbang bskur ba byas la mkhas pas gsang ba'i gnas su gzhag go/ /gang gi tshe don du bya ba byung ba de'i tshe las thams cad grub pa stan 1lhato/ /shin tu gtsang zhing gtsang bar bya ste/ su la yang mi sbyin no/ /sangs rgyas rnams la sku brnyas par gyur pa/ dam tshig nyams pa 12la bgegs 'jug par 'gyur zhing / 'phral du mtshams med pa lnga byed pa rmongs pa'i dra ba de la dngos grub rnams kyang 15shes par mi 'gyur ro/ /1 gzhan ni bla ma la gus shing / /sangs rgyas chos la rten 7byed pa/ /'phags pa'i tshogs la dang ba sadang / /byams sems snying rje'i 1 bdag nyid can/ /de yi 18lag tu rab tu sbyin/ /bdag gi srog bzhin gtad par 19bya/ /de dag dngos grub mchog sbyin te/ /bklags 2 dang mthong ba tsam na 92—585

gyis ni/ /ji ltar yid la byas pa bzhin/ /rjes su mthun 6)pa'i las byed do/ /'jig rten 'dir ②ni rtag tu bde/ /'jig rten pha rol bde ba yin/ /'gro ba lam ni bde bar 'gro/ /gang na 'od dpag med pa bzhugs/ /bde ba can du rtag tu 'gro/ /brdzus ris)te skye ba'i 4)pad+ma las/ /rgyan rtags ⑤kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /tshe rabs dag ni dran 'gyur te/ /sngon gyi tshe rabs dran par 'gyur / /de nas rig sngags 'chang rmongs pa chen po'i dam tshig ston par 'dod pa gtsang mas legs par khrus bya/ gos gtsang ma bgos nas nyin yizhag gcig smyung (7)ba byas pas lag na rdo rje dang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal mngon du bzhag ste/ me tog dang bdug spos dbul zhing 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sku gzugs dang / phyag na rdo rje'i sku gzugs la mchod pa yang bya/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la a ga (sheru'i bdug spos kyis bdug /lag na rdo rje la tsa)gu gul gyi bdug spos kyis bdugaskyo /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la lha bshos dkar po 'bul(1/ lag na rdo rje la ro sna tshogs dang ldan pa'i lha bshos phul la/ nyin par don yod pa'i rgyal po bzlas brjod bya/ mtshan mo khro bo'i rgyal po ngal ba med par bzlas brjod bya 12ste/ kha gdong khro gnyer med pa dang / dri ma dang ser sna med pas nam langs kyi bar du bzlas brjod byas pa dang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 'bar bar 'gyur la/ lag na rdo rje yang pus 512mo 'dzugs par 'gyur te/ de gnyis kyi mig nas 'dzag skopa/ rig sngags 'chang gis blangs nas thig le byas na mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /mig la bskus na nam mkha' la 'gro'o / /khar bcug na rig sngags dang cho ga zhib mo dang / gsang sngags 92—586

dang / 6) dkyil 'khor mngon du 'gyur ro/ /lag na rdo rje'i stobs dang /shugs dang / brtson 'grus kyis pha rol gnon par 'gyur/ lag na rdo rje'i rang gi gzugs kyis mdun na nye bar 'dug cing 'dod pa thams cad kyi mchog rjes su sbyin par byed la/ rang gi gzugs kyis spyod par byed/ lag na rdo rje'i stobs dang / shugs dang / brtson 'grus kyis ( pa rol gnon pa rjes su sbyin par byed/ de ltar lag na rdo rjes 'gugs par 'gyur ro/ /nyi ma 'char ba'i dus su til mar chen po ran par bdag nyid la bsku/ mig sman gyis mig byug /phye mas gtor zhing bdag nyid dzo thig le bya/ nor bu mgo la bzhag nas gu gul gyis bdug /bdag nyid gos ngur smrig 4)bgos nas sangs rgyas yid la bya ba sgom ⑤zhing / zhi ba dang dul ba'i yid kyis sde can gyi nang ngam dge 'dun gyi nang du 'jug par bya'o/ /de nas dge slong de dag gi 6)sde can gyi nang du zhugs sam/ dge 'dun gyi nang du zhugs pa'i rig sngags 'chang de bcom ldan 'das kyi sku dang / mdog dang / rtags dang / spyod lam du mthong ste/mtshan nyi shu rtsa brgyad yod pa 'od 'dom 7rigang ba/ stan pad+ma/ brgya byin dang /tshangs pa'i mdun gyi 8)bdar ba'i lha tshogs sna tshogs 9kyis gzugs mthong bar ston to/ /dge slong de dag gis kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku dang / mdog tu mthong nas thams cad zhabs gnyis la 'dud par 1 byed do/ /rig sngags 'chang /lhades brnyas 12par mi bya zhing / bdag la bstod par yang mi bya/brnyas pa tsam gyis khyod kyi bsod nams yongs su nyams par mi 'gyur bar bya'o/ /'phags pa'i dge slong gi dge 'dun rdzu 'phrul chen pos stobs 18bcu dang ldan par dbugs dbyung bar bya 1 ste/ rgyu des na brnyas par mi bya'o/ /de nas grong 92—587

khyer dang / rgyal po'i pho brang du 'jug par bya/ de nas 'dus pa'i nang du 'jug par bya/ de nas grong dang / tshang tshing dang / yul dang / ri brags kyi 1nonang du 'jug par bya/ de nas btsun mo'i nang du 'jug par bya ste/ yul gyi skyes pa dang / bud med dang / khye'u dang / bu mo de dag thams cad kyis kyang sangs rgyas kyi sku dang / mdog dang / rtags dang / dbyibs su mthong (gezhing mchod pa chen po dang / rim gro sna tshogs byed par 'gyur la/ de bzhin gshegs pa sangs rgyas yin no zhes smra ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i cho ga 'thob bo / /yungs kur dang / til mar gyis rang gi 'khor gyi du nispyi bor gtor 4)cing byugs na/ thams cad lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang /lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po'i gzugs su ston to/ /rkang pa til mar gyis bskus na sa'i steng nas sor brgyad tsam gyis spags 5te nam mkha' la 'gro ste/ ji srid du ma bkrus (6༄pa de srid du sangs rgyas kyi cha byad du ston to/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs mthong bar 'dod pa'i rig sngags 'chang de nang par sngar langs nas gtsang ma khrus byas te/gos gtsang ma bgos nas khang steng du 'dug la yungs kur la til mar gyis byugs nas phyogs bzhir gtor na/ rgyal po dang / blon po dang / rgyal rigs dang / bram ze dang / btsun mo dang / skyes pa dang / bud med dang / khye'u dang / bu mo thams cad sgyu ma chen pos rmongs par 'gyur ro/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang des nor bu bzhis dbu rgyan 7dang phreng ba byas la mgo la gdags so/ /til mar gyis yan lag tsam la bsku bar bya/ dpral bar rinasathig le bya/ mig sman gyis mig bsku/ phye mas bdag nyid la gdab/ ras 92—588

bzang po yug gcig bgo/ byang chub sems dpa'i cha byad du bgyi ba dang (1)/nor (2)bu dang / gdu bu dang / dpung rgyan dang / gser skud kyis bcings na de dag thams cad rgyan dang / spud pa dang / nor bu dang / dngul dang /rdo rje dang / bai drur+ya ris sna tshogs kyis 547lus brgyan (5)par snang ngo / /lag na pad+ma thogs na/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gzugs su snang ngo / /yid la ji ltar bsams 65pa don yod pa'i zhags pa'i tshul dang /'jigs pa brgyad dang / tshangs pa'i tshul dang / yid bzhin nor bu dang /rgod ma'i kha dang / mgul sngon dang / rta mgrin du ston to/ /ji ltar gzugs yid la byas pa de ltar ston te/ ji srid du thig le yod cing dbu rgyan thogs pa de srid du tshul sna tshogs ston par byed do/ /til mar dang / yungs kur dang bsres na/ kying kuṣ+ṭha 7dang lhan cig sbrus nas lag pa g.yas na rdo rje/dpral 8bar dbang phyug chen po'i thig le byas nas pad+ma'i phye mas 9gtor la/nor bu spyi gtsug tu bcing / mig sman gyis mig bsku/ gu gul gyis bdugs la shes rab can khro bo'i lta 1 ba'i tshul byas na mngon sum 1lhadu rdo rje 'chang gi gzugs su snang ste12/ de la the tshom lha mi bya'o/ /ji srid du bdag khrus ma byas pa de srid du rdo rje'i gzugs can du snang la las sna tshogs byed cing mi dang /'jig rten thams cad kyis rdo rje 'chang nyid du sems te/ de la the tshom 1 mi bya'o / /seng ge'i khrag gis til mar dang nor bu sbrus nas lus la bskus 15na mi'i seng ge chen po'i gzugs su ston to/ /phag gi khrag gis sbrus nas lus la bskus na phag gi gzugs chen por ston to/ /til mar dang / phye ma lhan cig tshisbrus nas yung 1 ba dang / shing pa la sha'i mdog tu byas la lus la bskus na srid 92wa 589

med kyi bu'i gzugs su ston to/ /rig sngags 'chang gis pad+ma dang / til mar lhan cig sbrus la lus la 51)bskus na dbang phyug chen po'i gzugs su ston to//shing arka'i 'o (nam dang / til mar dang / mnyam par sbyar la lus la bskus ④na tshangs pa'i gzugs su ston to/ / glang po che'i khrag dang ④til mar (5)sbyar nas lus la bskus na tshogs kyi dbang phyug chen po'i gzugs su ston to/ /ra'i khrag dang sbrus nas lus la byugs 56)na ra'i gzugs su ston to/ /til mar dang /thing shing dang / pad+ma'i phye ma dang / glang po che'i khrag dang lhan cig sbyar nas lus la bskus na nag po chen po'i 57)gzugs mngon sum du rang gi gzugs su (9ston la/ gang dang gang dag la thig le byas na ma mo'i tshogs kyi thorigazugs su ston to/ /sprul gyi khrag dang / pags 7pa dang / til mar gyi rgyal po dang lhan cig sbrus la sgal 11tshigs su bsku gezhing / dpung pa g.yon par yang bskus na sna klu'i rgyal po chen po'i gzugs su ston te(lo/ ji lta ji ltar khrag dang sbyar zhing ji lta ji ltar yid la bsams 6pa de lta de ltar gzugs ston to/ /de nas gzhal med khang lta bar 'dod na yungs kur la til mar gyis bskus nas dge 'dun gyi nang du steng 'og tu gtor/ phye tshams nor bu rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo kun tu bskus na dge 'dun rgan rims su nyu bkod pa'i dbus su gzhal 12med khang chen po rgyan gyis brgyan pa ston16/ dge slong rnams kyi )steng du gtor na dge slong thams cad gzugs sna tshogs yid 27la ji ltar byas pa bzhin rgyal po'i gzugs su snang ba dang / gzhan dag blon po dang / gzhan dag bkrabs 2pa dang / gzhan dag mdun lhan 'don pa dang / gzhan dag yongs su spyod pa'i 2 gzugs su ston la/ yungs kur la bskus pas gtor na slar yang dge slong 92wa 590

rnams su snang ngo / /shing arka'i 0)'o ma yungs kur la bskus nas dge 'dun gyi (gedabus su dge slong rnams kyis (5)mal stan gyi steng du gtor na/ ji ltar dge slong thams cad 'khod pa ltar snang ngo / /ral pa'i thor tshugs kyis brgyan (45pa la gtor na rgan po 'khar ba (gethogs pa skur po ltag dgye skra dkar can nyam (6)chung bar snang ngo / /mal stan gyi steng du yungs kur gtor ba gal te mtshan thog thag bzhag na gzugs gzhan du mi 'gyur ro/ /lug gi steng na snod yod pa la gtor na de thur ma'i gzeb dang / sbrul nag po (7)snang ngo / /snod kyi steng du gtor na kham phor ⑤du snang bar 'gyur ro/ /btung 59)ba'i snod sbrang rtsis byugs pa'i steng du gtor na phyag dar gyi phung por snang ngo / /grong khyer gyi sgo dang grong khyer kun du gtor na grong khyer kun nas mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /grong khyer kun la 7yungs kur dang pad+ma'i phye ma gtor na skyes pa dang / bud med dang /khye'u dang / bu mo mi snang ba thams cad snang bar 'gyur ro/ /seng ge'i khrag dang sbyar nas dud 'gro'i skye gnas kyi k+ṣ-i/nyusteng du gtor na lam gyi bzhi mdo thams cad du seng ge'i gzugs su ston to/ /sde 12drag cing gtum /snyel yan lag mchog gi gzugs dang 0ldan pa'i steng du gtor na thams cad wa'i gzugs su snang la phyogs bcur rgyug go/ /g.yul 'gyed sar dgator na thams cad gnyid log par byas par 'gyur la mtshon cha thams cad dang / go cha tshathams cad mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /me'i nyurtenang du gtor na mi snang ba rnams snang bar 'gyur ro/ /til mar dang sbyar nas me'i nang du gtor na rtag tu 'bar bar 'gyur ro/ /chu'i nang du gtor na chu mi mngon par 'gyur ro/ /bum pa chus bkang ba la gtor na srog chags chu'i nang na 18gnas pa thams cad chu'i nang nas 'byung zhing 92wa 591

thang la gnas so/ /tshal gyi nang du yungs kur gyis (1)gtor na me tog dang 'bras bu mi snang bar gyur pa thams cad snang zhing shing skam po dang / tshal gyi mthar me tog dang 'bras bu thams cad ston to/ /nam mkha' la gtor na phyogs bzhi'i dge 'dun gyi nang ngam/ 'dus pa'i nang ngam/ skye bo mang po'i risanang du me tog gi char rnam pa sna tshogs dag 'bab ste/ lha'i dri legs par smin pa yid dga' ba sim par byed pa 'bab bo/ /las dang ldan pa'am/ bzo'i gnas kyi las te/ las kyi snod thams cad la til mar gyi rgyal pos byugs la phye ( ne+ems bsku/ pad+ma chen po'i phye mas ri ni'akhor gyi gnas bsku/ 45)yungs kur gyis (6)phyogs bzhir gtor la/ de nas las kyi bzo bzang po ji lta ba bzhin ston par 'dod na las kyi snod de dang de dag nyid g.yo la/ las kyi bzo'i tshul bzang pos mthar phyin pa rnam pa du ma dag ston par byed la nyo tshong byed pa 'byung ste/gal te phyir bzlog 7pa ma byas na rin ji lta ji lta 58ba de lta (9)de ltar nyo tshong byed do / /chu dang yungs gar gyis bzlog pa byas na mi snang bar 'gyur la dpag tshad brgya stong 1 tsam gyi bar du khrid na de dang de nyid du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /rdza mkhan gyi 'khor lo la phye mas byug cing yungs kur chags par byas la/ pad+ma chen po'i phye mas gtor nas 11'jim pa bzhag la snod kyi ngo bo ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin bya ste/ snod kyi 12ngo bo dngul las byas pa'am/ gser las byas pa'am/zangs las byas pa'am/ lcags las byas pa'am/ lcags lnga las byas pa rin po che bzang po sna tshogs kyis spras 1 pa ji lta ba de lta bu'i snod bkra 7ba rnam pa sna tshogs dag 'byung bar 'gyur la/ nyo tshong byed pa yang 'byung ste/ rin chen pos tshong byed do/ /yungs kur gyi phye ma dang / pad+ma'i phye ma lhan cig sbyar nas 92—592
