tshong dus (1 kyi dbus su gtor na kun tu zong bkram pa'i snod mi snang bar byas pa thams cad snang bar byed do/ /thag pa'i steng du gtor 2na sbrul chen po ston to//khyim dang / ra ba'i ngos dang / sgo dang / shing sbyar ba dang / ka ba'i steng du gtor na khang pa dang / ra ba dang / 'khor gyi khyams rnams sprul du ston to / /ji srid du chu dang yungs kur gyis bzlog pa ma byas pa/ de srid du sbrul narnams 'dug go/ /bzlog pa byas na mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /gtsug lag khang ngam / lha'i gnas sam/ khang bzangs kyi langos la gtor na sbrul chen por snang ngo / /lha'i steng du gtor la mig sman gyis bsku/ ril bus 5thig le byas na lha'i gzugs brnyan 6de ku co 'don cing 'gro ste/ gar 'dod pa der 'gro'o / /bzlog pa byas na phyir 'dug go/ /sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs kyi zhabs la byugs la phye mas gtor na sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs g.yo bar mdzad/bzhud par mdzad do/ /'jug par mdzad do/ /'chag 8par mdzad do/ /tsan+dan la bzlas brjod byas nas bdugs na phyir bzhugs so/ /bum pa sbrang rtsis bskus pa rnams la gtor na g.yo bar byed do/ /ji tsam du phyir bzlog pa ma byas pa de tsam du g.yo'o/ /chu dang yungs kur gyis bzlog na phyir 'dug go/ /de nas rdo rje bskyod 9par 'dod na spos kyi dkyil 'khor byas la me tog bkram ste/gu gul gyis 7bdug pas bdug /de yang yungs shar dang / phye ma dang bcas pas 11gtor la don yod pa'i rgyal po lan bdun bzlas brjod byas na/ rdo rje dkyil 'khor las langs nas nam mkha' la 'gro bar byed12/ 'phar bar byed/'dug par byed/ 'bar bar byed cing / phan tshun 'gro bar byed/ mtho bar 'gro bar byed/ dma' bar 'gro bar byed/ rnam par 'gro bar byed/92—593

'bar ba chen pos 'bar bar byed de ji srid du bzlog 4)pa ma byas pa de srid du nam mkha' la 'gro'o/ /chu dang yungs kur gyis bzlog pa byas na de nyid du (misnang ngo / /de nas 'khor lo bskyod par 'dod na dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa byas la spos sna tshogs kyis bris nas me tog sna tshogs (gudagram pa'ang (0bya/ gu gul gyi bdug 5)pas kyang bdugs 6rinas 'khor lo la pelan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod byas la til mar gyi rgyal pos bskun / (9cilte ba'i dbus su thig le tsho )byas nas dkyil 'khor gyi 11dbus su gzhag par bya/ de la yang yungs kur dang /pad+ma chen po'i phye mas gdab par bya/ 'khor lo kun nas gu gul gyi nyu2bdug pas bdug cing se gol gyi sgra yang byas na 'khor lo de dkyil 'khor las langs nas nam mkha' la 'phar zhing snang ba thams cad la 'bab par tsho byed de/ gal te g.yul 'gyed par 'bab mun/ de'i tshe dgra thams cad kyi mgo gcod par byed / sdang ba thams cad dang phyir rgol ba thams cad la bab na 'jig par byedas / bgegs thams cad la 'bab pa dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / 'byung po dang / sha za dang / brjed pobyed dang / gdon rnams la 'bab pa dang / klu sdang ba thams cad la bab na 'jig par byed de/ ji srid du bzlog 1 pa ma byas pa de srid du 'phar ro/ /chu dang yungs kur gyis bzlog pa byas na 12slar dkyil 19'khor la 'dug go/ /mdung rtse gsum pa bskyod par 'dod na dkyil 'khor byas la thod pa gzhag par bya/ me tog dgram pa'ang ( )bya/gu gul gyi bdug pas kyang bdugs 1la/ mdung rtse gsum pa la til mar gyi rgyal pos bsku/ phye mas gdab cing thig le bya/ rtse'i rgyun gsum la pad+ma chen po'i phye mas gtor nas thod pa'i steng du gzhag par bya/ yungs kur gyis gtor 92wa 594

zhing hūm̐ zhes se gol byas na mdung rtse gsum pa 'bar bar byed/ ldang bar byed / nam mkha' la 'gro bar byed/ kun du 'bar bar byed/ 'gro bar byed / phyogs bcur 'phar 1)bar byed de(gyi/ ji srid du bzlog ( )pa ma byas pa de srid du 'phar 4)bar byed do/ /chu dang yungs kur gyis bzlog pa byas na slar dkyil 'khor la 'dug go/ /dung la til mar gyis byugs la phye mas gtor la thig le bya/ yungs mar gyis kyang phyi nang gtor la bus na 5)ji srid du sgra thos pa de srid kyi skyes pa dang / bud med dang / khye'u dang / bu mo thams cad bro rdung (6)bar byed/ rgyug par byed/ mchod par byed cing phyogs bcur rab tu rgyug par byed do/ /g.yul ngor bus na 'gyed pa'i mi thams cad dang /mtshon cha thams cad dang / go cha thams cad btang nas bro rdung 57bar byed de(8༄ / gcer bur 'byung bar byed/ phyogs bcur rgyug par byed do/ /gal te dung lan bdun bus na phyir rgol ba dang / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs des nyon mongs pa skyed par 'gyur te9ri/ ji srid du bzlog ⑩pa ma byas pa de srid du 11mchong zhing phyogs bcur rgyug go/ /spos chus bzlog cing khrus byas na phyir bde bar gnas par 'gyur la/ rtag tu rgyal ba dang / dpal gyi mchog sbyin par 'gyur ro/ /de nas sgyu ma de kho na nyid sgrub pa'i gsang sngags dang / rnam par 'phrul pa'i dngos grub kyi 1 dkyil 'khor bshad par bya ste/ sgyu 'phrul gyi dra ba rnam par 'phrul pa'i dkyil 'khor gang du dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs shing /kun nas brgyan 15par yungs kur dang til mar gyi rgyal po dang / phye mar bsres mupas byug skapa dang / thig les kyang dbang bskur cing pad+ma chen po'i phye mas byugs la lag pa pad+ma'i 8phyag rgya dang / hūm̐ zhes bya ba'i sgra brjod na 1792wa 595

brjod pa tsam dang / yungs kur gyis 1gtor ba'i mod rten)la/ gtor ma'i snod dang / snod rdza ma dang / bum pa dang / bum pa bkang ba thams cad dang /mtshon cha thams cad dang / dkyil 'khor gyi steng ri zhinas nam mkha' la sor bzhi tsam gyis spags te/ 'dug la ji srid du dkyil 'khor gyi las su bya ba thams cad rdzogs rdzogs kyi bar du nam mkha' la 'dug go/ / rig sngags 'chang ba sa'i steng gi sor bzhi tsam gyi tshad kyi steng gi nam mkha' la 'dug go/ /5las su bya ba thams cad zin nas dkyil 'khor gyi yo byad dri chab kyi cho gas 7 dbang bskur na gtor ma dang / snod rdza ma dang / bum pa dang / bum pa na thams cad rang nyid 'phar bar byed la/ slar yang rang gi 59riganas su 'dug go/ /go cha de lta bu ni dkyil 'khor thams cad la bya ste/ thams cad du yon tan 1 tshoston par snang la/ byas pa tsam gyis las thams cad sgrub par 'gyur te/ the tsom 11mi bya'o zhes 12bshad do/ /de'i phyir pad+ma'i dngos grub bshad par bya ste/gser ram dngul lam zangs las shin tu legs shing mdzes pa snying po dang /ze ba dang bcas shing sdong bu tshad dang ldan par byas la/ 'dab 1 ma phyed kha phye ba 'khor bar 'dab sam drug cu rtsa bzhi yod pa khru gang 15tsam gyi tshad sdong bu dang / snying po dang / ze ba'i tshad sor bzhi tsam du byas pa la til tshamar gyi rgyal pos bsku/ pad+ma'i phye ma dang / mig sman dang / mig bsku ba dang /thig ler byas pa dang bcas pas kun legs par bskus la/ pad+ma'i sdong bu'i bar du nor bu rin po che bzhag nas lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bya/ khro bo'i rgyal pos lan bdun gyi bar du dbang bskur nas rig sngags 'chang gtsang ma legs par khrus byas la17/ gos gtsang ma bgos pas til mar gyis bdag 92wa 596

nyid la bsku bar bya/ mig bsku ba dang / thig le dang / bdug pas bdag nyid kyi (1)lus la bdug par bya'o/ /lag pa g.yas pa la nor bu gdags/ lag pa g.yon pa na pad+ma gzung ri la bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug ste/ 'khor gyi nang du bcom ldan 'das la pad+ma'i mchod pa 'bum bya ste/ pad+ma 'bum 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /mchod pa'i cho ga byas nas chu dang yungs kur gyis btab na yang 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /pad+ma sprul pa gang yin pa 4de dag thams cad chu'i nang du bor na pad+ma mgal 5me bskor ba ltar 'khor bar 'gyur la/ pad+ma 'bum rnams char du 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /pad+ma'i chu'i nang du gzhag par bya ba ni mtsho bran nam/ lteng ku'am/ chu bo'am/ chu bo chen po'am/ 'obs sam/rdzing rmengam/ mtsho'i nang gang yang 7rung ba'i gnas su bzhag na gnas de dang de thams cad du pad+ma'i mtsho chen po 'byung ste/ ji srid du pad+ma ma phyung ba de srid du/ dus rtag tu pad+ma'i mtshor 'dug ste/ ston ga'am / dgun nam/dpyid dam/ sos ka tsha ba'i dus su rtag tu pad+ma'i mtshor 9'dug go/ /tshal gyi 'gram du zhugs nas yungs kur la til mar gyis bskus pa phye ma dang sbyar nas me tog gang yang rung ba zhig lag gis bzung k+ṇi ste bskor la yungs kur 11gyis gtor na / tshal gyi mtha'i shing thams cad la me tog rgyas par snang ngo / /dge 'dun gyi nang ngam/ tshogs pa'i nang ngam/ rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor ram/ skye bo'i nang du me tog ji snyed pa lag gis bskor la/ yungs gar gyis gtor na me tog mang po 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /chu dang yungs kur gyis thams cad du zlog par byed pa yin no/ /'bras bu ji snyed pa lag gis bzung 1 nas yungs kur gyis gtor na 'bras bu'i char 1 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /gos lag pas bzung 1 nas 92—597

yungs gar gyis gtor te bskor 0sten gos dang bla re sna tshogs ston par byed dophyi//rgyan lag pas bzung 95)nas yungs kur gyis gtor na/ lha'i rgyan bzang po sna tshogs pa lag tu 'byung bar 'gyur zhing skye bo 'dus pa thams cad kyi rgyan du byed la thams cad la rgyan btags par 'gyur ro/ /yungs kur tshudadang chus bzlog par bya'o/ /yungs kur zhal til mar gyis bskus phye mas bsgo/ gi'u 6)wang dang / gur gum 7ridang / shing kun dang / snu ha'i rin)'o mas kyang bsgos la de dag gcig tu byas nas grib ma la bskam mo/ /de nas 'bras bu gcig khar bcug 9la phyogs bzhir gtor na kha nas me 'bar bar snang zhing lus las 'bar ba sna tshogs 'byung bar snang ste/ ji srid du yungs kur kha na 0yod pa'i bar du lus las 'od zer 'bar ba kha dog rnam pa sna tshogs 'byung ngo / /til mar dang lhan cig btags pa'i snying por bya/ kong 1rtabur til mar gyi rgyal pos bkang ste mar me 'bum ston par byed do/ /me thab khang nyu bu'i nang du bcug (snyen ji srid du ma phyung ba de srid du me 'bar bar ston to/ /mar me'i sdong bu'i nang du bcug la ma phyung na rtag tu 'bar ro/ /mgal me 'bar ba'i nang du bcug na 'bar ba'i phreng 1 ba 'bum snyed du snang ngo / /gtor ma'i rdza ma dang / bum pa'i nang du gtor na gtor ma'i rdza ma dang / bum pa thams cad 'bar bar snang ngo / /lag cha dang / mtshon cha thams cad la byugs na gcig atu 'bar bar 'gyur ro/ /bdag nyid kyi lus la byugs la ril bu tshagatsang ma spyi bor bzhag na lus thams cad gcig tu 'bar bar snang ba nas lus ril bsregs pa ltar snang ngo / /'o ma dang yungs kur gyis gtor na lus slar snang bar 'gyur ro / /lag pa dang rkang pa la bskus la/ ril bu 1 gtsang ma 'bar ba lag pa 92—598

g.yas pas gzung 0)ba'am/ rkang pa'i mthe bos bzung (5rin lag pa dang / rkang pa gcig pu 'bar ba dang / 'brel bar snang ngo / /'dus pa'i nang ngam/skye bo 'dus pa mang po'am/ rgyal po'i 'khor ram/ sde can gyi nang ngam/rig byed bzhi'i nang thams cad du yan lag nyams par snang ngo / /dri chab dang /yungs kur gyis gtor na lus slar rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /mtshan mo mar me'i ril bu (gubasregs (4)pa lam gyi bzhi mdor bzhag nas yungs kur gyis phyogs bzhir gtor na mar me 'bum phrag bye ba snang ngo / /kun nas phyogs bzhir chu dang yungs kur gyis bzlog par bya ba yin no/ /tshal chen po'i mtha' dang /nang du gtor la shing gcig la ril bu rigatsang ma bzhag na shing dang / rtswa dang /shing gel pa dang / 'dab ri ma dang / lo ma thams cad gcig tu 'bar bar snang ngo / /ri'i rtse mor mar me bus nas ri kun tu gtor na ri kun nas gcig tu 'bar zhing mched par snang la sems can thams cad kun nas ngo mtshar du 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /rkun ma dang / g.yon can dang / gnod byed dang /pha rol gyi dmag tshogs dang / sdang 7ba dang / phyir rgol ba dang / phas kyi dgra thams cad dang / sdang ri sems can nas ri dgas gtum po dang / bya la sogs pa'i bar ri la gnas pa rnams de'i mtshan mo nyid phyogs bcu kun du bros shing 97)ha ha zhes bya ba'i sgra 'byin to/ /spos chab kyis 7bzlog par 'gyur ro / /gzugs brnyan 41gyi steng du gtor la/ gtsang ma'i ril bu 12'bar bar bzhag na gzugs brnyan sna thams cad gcig tu 'bar bar kha'agyur te/ spos chu dang / yungs kur gyis bzlog par 'gyur ro/ /mar me'i ril bu grong khyer gyi bshar phyogs kyi sgor sbar te khoganas gtsang mar gzhag daskyul 'khor gcig 92wa 599

byas nas gtor ma'i cho ga bum pa bkang ba gzhag /grong khyer kun tu yungs kur gyis gtor zhing don yod pa'i rgyal po yang dran par byas na tsho1)grong khyer kun nas mar me'i phreng ba 'bar ba gcig tu snang ngo / /grong khyer gyi sgo bzhir (5dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga byas la shar phyogs kyi sgo nas zhugs na gang grong khyer na gnas pa skyes pa dang / bud med dang / khye'u dang / bu mo de dag thams cad dga' ba chen po rgya che bas tshim par 'gyur ro/ /grong khyer de na 4rigang sdang ba'i sems can phyir rgol ba dang / phas kyi dgra dang / chom rkun dang /g.yon can dang / gnod byed dang / glags 5tshol bar gyur pa/ gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / yi dgas dang / sha za dang / brjed byed dang / mi ma yin pa gang yang rung ba grong khyer de na gnas pa de dag lang 6 long du gyur cing gdugs la ngu zhing ha ha zhes sgra 'byin cing grong khyer gyi sgor byung nas phyogs bcur rab tu 'bros so/ /grong khyer de yang kun nas gnod pa med cing 'khrugs 7pa med par 'gyur/ 'jigs pa dang / gnod pa dang / nad 'go ba dang / 'khrug pa thams cad dang / nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur/mtshan mo 'das nas spos chu dang / yungs kur gyis 8grong khyer gyi 9sgor gtor zhing dbang bskur na bzlog par 'gyur ro// //'phags pa don yod pa'i zhags pa'i cho ga zhib mo'i 1 rgyal po/ bam po bcu dgu pa/ ldong ros dang / thing shun 11gyi phye ma dang / yungs kur dang /ma hā tai lha la dang / arka'i 1 'o ma dang / pha gu'i 'o ma dang / gcig tu sbyar ro / /nya'i mig mkhris 1 pa dang bcas pa dang / nā dag pus pa dang / pad+ma'i chu ba 7rnams kyang lhan cig tu phye ma 1 zhib mor bya'o/ /phye ma snga ma legs par 92wa 600

sbyar la chus ril bur 17byas pa dang / phye mas gzhan yang bcang ngo / /phye mas 'di dang pad+ma chen po'i phye ma bcang ba lhan cig tu bsres pa'i phye mas lus bskus rinal phyogs bzhir yungs mar gtor te/ ril bu na)khar bcug la hūm̐ zhes bya ba bsdams te brjod na de'i lus las chu 'dzag cing / de kho na bzhin du rna ba gnyis kyang lha (gardzas kyi chu 'byung bar snang / lus las spos kyi rigs yid du 55'ong ba rab tu sim 6)par byed pa 'byung ba ni nad thams cad grub par snang ste/rgyal ba'i phyag bzhin no/ /yungs kur gyi phye ma blangs te nam mkha' la gtor la ril bu tsuralag pas bskor na char chen po 'bab par 'gyur ro/ / ril bu 8nam mkha' la 'phangs na 9mi 'bab bo/ /g.yul chen po 'gyed pa'i nang du phye ma de yungs kur dang bsres 1 te nam mkha' la gtor la ril bu 11de yang khar bcug ste / steng du bltas 12la hūm̐ zhes bya ba'i sgras pos la/ gnam lcags chen po 'bab ste yid mi 'chad pa dang sdug bsngal bskyed par 'gyur ro1 / /chu'i nang du zhugs te phye ma de lagator la yungs kur dang / ril bu 15chu'i nang du gdab par bya/ phyogs bzhir yungs kur gtor te/ tai las 7lus la 1 bskus na klu 18chen po'i gzugs su snang ngo / / ril bu 19dang yungs kur me'i mdog lta bu chu dang bsres pa'i yungs kur nam mkha' la gtor na 'brug sgra na chen po 'byung zhing glog chen po gsal ba snang bar 'gyur ro/ /chu'i nang nas byung na 22mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /khron pa'i nang du btab 2rin chu lud nas phyogs kun tu chu 2 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /rdza ma'am/ bum pa'am/ rdze'u'am ga/ ril ba :sgo 20ra'am / ril ba na la phye mas byugs te/ de'i steng du yungs kur gyis gtor na na chus bkang ste khrus byas na de chu 'bab par snang zhing de'i snod ni mi snang bar 92wa 601

'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang dgos pa mang po byed de mchog tu grub pa yin no/ /de nas rin po che'i ched du (1)'bru mar gyi rgyal po ②byas te 'bru mar gzhan dang /de bzhin du til las (5)'bru mar gyi rgyal po de bzhin du sbyar ro/ /lag pa dang rkang pa bzhag la 'dir nyam 4skudrod kyang shes par bya'o/ /gzhag pa thams cad nyam drod shes par 5)bya ba ni mar sar bzhin du 'jam par 'gyur zhing skad cig de nyid la mtho ba dang / dma' ba ji ltar yid la 'dod pa bzhin du ri yang 'gyur ro/ /snying po thur ma 'dra ba dang / zlum po'am/ yang na lcug ma lta bur byas pas ka ba yang 'dud pa dang / ri yang dma' ba'am yang yin mthon por 'gyur bar byed do/ /yungs kur dang pad+ma chen po'i phye ma lhan cig bsres pa 'bru mar gyi rgyal pos bsgos pa phyogs bzhir kun du gtor na ri thams cad mi snang zhing 'brog dgon par 57)snang bar 'gyur ro/ / yang ri bor snang bar 'gyur ro/ /8)yang na mi (9)bgrod par mi nus pa'i ri'i rtse mo na seng ge dang /stag gis shi rigang ba 11lhug ma dang tsher ma can gyi shing ljon pa sna tshogs kyis gang ba'am / rtsub pa'am/ dub nyu2bu'am/ khong stong du snang bar 'gyur ro/ /ci ste rig sngags 'chang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi pho brang ri po ṭa lha la'i gzhal med khang mthong bar 'dod na de nas rig sngags 'chang gis zhag bdun gyi bar du nas kyi 'o thug gi bozas zos te gtsang ma shin tu khrus byas pa gos gtsang ma bgos mapas ri'i gseb tu zhugs la/ sa phyogs gtsang 7ma'i gnas der shing dri zhim po'i me sbar ba la yungs kur phye ma dang bsres pa 'bru mar gyi rgyal po dang sbyar la 'bras so ba dang bsres pa stong rtsa brgyad dzi zhag bdun du dus gsum du sbyin sreg lha bya'o/ /lha bshos dang gtor ma dkar po 'bul lo/ /92—602

de nas rig sngags 'chang gis tshes brgyad la nyin zhag gcig smyung tsho 1)ba byas la shin tu khrus byas (2pa gtsang mas spos sna tshogs kyis lus bskus gos bzang po gtsang ma bgos te/ 'bru mar gyi rgyal pos rang gi lus ri rabaskus phye mas lus smyo byugs mig sman gyis mig bskus/ thig le byas la nor bus mgo bcing zhing mgul pa dang / lag pa dang /5) dpung pa dang / rked par yang bcings la yungs kur dang mtshal bsres pas ri'i phyogs bzhir gtor bar bya/ pad+ma chen po'i (6)phye ma de yang phyogs 7)bzhir gtor/ rang gi lag pa g.yon pas zhags pa dang / pad+ma gzung 87zhing g.yas pas rnam par lta ba snang 9ba dang /don yod pa chen pos dri ma med pa'i phyag rgya bzung 7ste/ don yod pa'i zhags pa'i mdo lan cig /lhabazlas brjod byas na ji ltar don yod pa'i zhags pa'i mdo sde bshad pa las bstan pa de ltar ri po ṭa nyidala'i gzhal med khang mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags 'chang de yang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gzugs su snang bar 'gyur royis/ /ji ltar ri po ṭa sala'i gzhal med khang bzhin du ri de la yang gzhal med khang snang boste/ ri de la rin po che'i shing ljon pa sna tshogs snang ngo / /me tog sna tshogs kyi gzhal med khang snang ngo/ /sā la dang / tā la dang / ta sam la dang / tsam pa ka dang / a sho ka dang / a dhi musti 7ka dang / ba ri sha ka dang / ka dasba 1 dang / nī la dang / pā 19〈 la dang / pā (3 /lā sha dang / u dum bā 1ra dang / dong ku'i me tog sna tshogs dang / sna ma'i me tog dang / ta ra ṇa sa2dang / na ba na ma li ka dang / ku pa pya ka sna tshogs snang bar 'gyur ro/ /bya'i tshogs sna tshogs kyis legs par brgyan ri ——pa dang / ri dgas kyi tshogs sna tshogs kyis gang ba snang bar 'gyur 92wa 603

ro / /gang gi tshe phyir bsdu ba byed par 'dod pa de'i tshe gnas gzhan du 'gro bar bya'o / /gzhan yang dgos pa (1)sna tshogs la rang gi blo gros la ji ltar snang ba bzhin bya'o/ /dgos pa thams cad la rab tu sbyar ba ni bklags ②pa tsam gyis 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /don yod pa'i zhags pa ri )chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi rig sngags 'chang gi cho ga gsang ba'o// //don yod pa'i sgyu ma rnam par 'phrul pa zhes bya ba'i (4)sgrub pa'i cho ga ni/ de nas de'i 'og tu phyag rgya bri ba'i dkyil 'khor bshad par bya ste/ rtags mtshon phyag rgya'i de nyid ni/ /pad+ma rgyas dang sna tshogs mtshon/ /pad+ma kha ni phyed bye ba/ /phyag dag na ni rab tu 'dzin/ /phyag gnyis phyung zhing 5 brkyang nas kyang / /bskum pa'am 'dzin stangs 6de nyid kyis/ /kun nas phreng ba 7)'bar ba'i rtags / /mtshon cha phyag rgya bsnams pa ni/ /'di lta ste/ ral gri dang /mdung thung dang / mda' bo che dang / mdung rtse gsum pa dang / yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang / rgyal mtshan dang / rdo rje dang / rdo rje phreng zlum dang /las kyi rdo rje dang / zur gsum ma zhes bya ba dang / 'khor lo dang / dung dang / tho ba dang / zhags pa dang / dgra sta dang / dbyug tho dang / me tog gi thum po dang / bum pa gang ba dang / rin po che'i snod dang / pad+ma'i phreng ba 2dang / rdo rje'i 'phreng zlum dang / ut+pa la'i phreng ba dang / me tog gi phreng ba dang / pad+ma dang / ut+pa la dang / zla ba dang / ri rab dang /me long dang / klu 1 dang / mchod phyir thogs dang /11 zla ba dang / nyi ma'i 1 rgyal mtshan dang / gdugs dang / be con dang / gshin rje'i be con dang /92—604

chu srin gyi kha dang / sngags de'i phreng ba dang / mdung rtse gsum pa'i phreng zlum dang / bsdigs pa dang / bsgyings 3)pa dang / dbugs 'byin pa dang / mi 'jigs pa dang / mchog sbyin pa dang / thal mo sbyar ba dang / glegs bam bsnams pa dang / 'khar gsil (5)dang / lhung bzed dang / gdugs dang /dbu rgyan (5)dang / nor bu brgyus ( pa dang / gser skud dang / mu tig gi phreng ba dang / gdu bu dang / dpung rgyan dang / rna cha dang / me'i thab khung ngo / /kun nas 'bar phreng phyag rgya de/ /sna tshogs rmad du byung bas smras/ /mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnams pa yi/ /pad+ma 'dzin la rab tu gnas/ /ras la bris pa'am dkyil 'khor ram/ /rtsig pa'am gang yang rung ba la/ /tshon rtsi rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ /gang du bris pa mthong ba de/ /ngan 'gro sems can dmyal bar ni/ /phyir yang 'gro bar mi 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten dbang gis rtag mchog sbyin/ /sdig pa thams cad rnam par spangs/ /gang zhig nyes byas mi zad (5)pa/ /mtshams med lnga po byed pa nyid/ /mnar med pa yi tshoganas dang ni/ /dmyal ba gzhan du gzhol ba gang 7/ /phyag rgya de dag mthong tsam gyis / /'gro ba thams cad zad par 'gyur/ /skye dang 'chi las rnam par grol/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho brgal (8chibar 'gyur/ /de dag skye ba phyi 9rimar ni/ /phyir yang mngal gyis mi gos nyu 7te/ /yang dang yang du pad+ma las/ /rdzus 11te skye ba dag tu 'gyur / /rtag tu bde ba can du 'gro/ /gang na 'dren pa tshe dpag med/ /bzhugs pa'i spyan 12sngar rtag tu der1lha/ /skye 'gyur the tsom sami za zhing / /don rnams bde bar 'grub 'gyur zhing / /rig sngags sna tshogs bde bar 'grubs/ /bde sabar dkyil 'khor 'grub 'gyur zhing / /rtag tu mi ldog sa gnas 1792wa 605

'gyur / /phyag rgya 'di dag mthong tsam gyis/ /sangs rgyas byang chub dang mnyam 'gyur / /dus gsum gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas la/ /bla med dge rtsa bskyed par 'gyur / /'jig rten 'di dang pha rol tu/ /bsod nams phung po chen po 'thob / /de nas dkyil 'khor rab bshad pa/ /de nyid 'grub pa'i phyag rgya rnams / /'jig rten 'di dang pha rol tu/ /'dod pa thams cad rab tu sbyin/ /sdig 1)pa thams cad mod la sel/ /gang zhig mtshams med byed pa dag /mi bzad mnar med gnas pa yi/ /sdig pa thams cad 'jig par 'gyur/ /dmyal ba'i sgo rnams bcad nas ni/ /mtho ris sgo phye the tshom (gyimed/ /sgo phye gyur pa rnams la ni/ /sangs rgyas zhing rnams snang bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 3)dgongs pa/ mgon po 'jig rten dbang phyug gi phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor mthong ba tsam gyis sems can phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro/ /phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor 'di mthong na shi 'phos pa'i mod la bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /dkyil 'khor 'di (gezhugs pa tsam gyis gang na thub pa 'dren pa 'od dpag med bzhugs pa'i pho brang du myur du 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /dkyil 'khor gru bzhi lham pa la/ /kun nas cha nas (5)mdzes par bya/ /gru bzhi go la'i tshad tsam la/ /sgo bzhi them skas bzhi yis brgyan yin/ /shin tu legs par bskus dang ldan/ /'jam zhing mnyen la mnyam pa yi(7)/ /sa yi (8)cha dang ldan pa la/ /dkyil 'khor shes rab can gyis dbye/ /dkyil 'khor de nyid thig btab la/ /phyag rgya bri 9ba rnam par dbye/ /phyogs bzhi'i cha ni mnyam pa yi/ /dbus na dkyil 'khor snying po yin/ /gru bzhi pa la kun nas kha khyer gyi rnam pa dang /mdung rtse gsum pa'i phreng ba rnam par dbye'o/ /gru bzhi pa'i dbus su phyag rgya 'i92—606

don yod pa'i zhags pa'i phyag rgya kun nas 'bar ba bla na med pa dang / phyag rgya 1rgyan gyis brgyan (mipa tshon ①sna tshogs kyis bri'o/ /dbus kyi lidakyil 'khor gyi phyi rol gyi gnas su (5)phyag rgya bri ba yang shin tu 'byes (6)par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor kun nas gos dang / ba dan dang / rgyal mtshan gyis brgyan (7)la kun du yungs kur dkar (8po gtor ro/ /phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor kyi phyi rol gyi gnas su phyogs bzhi kun du bya ba ni ba lang gi rtsi ba sa dang bsres pa tsho)shin tu legs par byugs pa dang ldan pa la tshon rtsi'i phye mas kha khyer gyi rnam pa dang / kun nas pad+ma'i phreng ba rgya 7chen po dang / mtshon cha bris la 'di'i sgo bzhi /kāyang rnam par dbyes / par bri'o1snye/ /ji ltar phyag rgya dang mthun yipa'i ro sna tshogs kyi rkigator ma gzhag par bya ste/ phyag rgya re re la yang mchod yon phul la/ dbyib mo dang / phru ba dang / bum pa ngang / kham 7phor dang / rje'u gtor mas bkang la gzhag go/ /kun du bum pa 7gang ba dang / /bdug spos kyi ni snod dag dang / /me tog 'bras bu sna tshogs dang / /gtor ma dkar po dag gis bkang / /me tog rnam par bkram byas la/ /kun du phreng bas gzhag par bya/ /phreng ba bzang po bzhag nas kyang / /de bzhin kun du bdug spos dbul/ /a ga 38ru dang / tsan+dan dang / du ru ska sna dang / sa la ki dang / spro ka rna tshodang /gu rukāgul dang / sra rtsi pog dang / sgron shing dang / gla rtsi dang / ga bur gyi bdug pa 'di dag gis bdugs la/ gtor ma dang / me tog dang / lha bshos dbul lo/ /phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug pas don yod pa'i rgyal po dran par byas te bskor la 22phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor la phyag bya zhing phyag rgya na thams cad la me tog bkram zhing me tog gtor ro/ /gang phyag rgya'i de kho na nyid 92—607

gsang ba 'di dang / phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor 'di sgrub pa lho)gang dgos pa la sngar dkyil 'khor phyag rgya dang bcas pa la mchog tu mdzes par byas la/ phyis (snyelas thams cad bya'o/ /rig sngags 'chang ba gtsang ma yis/ /gtsang ma yi ni gos bgos la/ /ji ltar dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin/ /dkyil 'khor du ni gzhug dpar bya/ /ji ltar dkyil 'khor la dgos pa/ /de bzhin du ni las bya'o / /phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor bla med pa/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni zhugs tsam gyis / /thub pa snang mdzad kyis gsungs pa'i/ /spyi yi rigs ni thams cad du / /phyag rgya dkrigs dang gtams (4)rnams kyis/ /dam tshig kun du shes par 'gyur / /spyi rigs kun gyi cho ga yi(5ri/ /dam tshig rjes zhugs de bzhin no/ /dkyil 'khor kun tu zhugs pa dang / /rgyal bas lung ni bstan par 'gyur/ /kun gzigs de bzhin gshegs pa yi no/ /phyag ni spyi bor 'jog par mdzad/ /chos kyi ro ni bdud rtsi yi/ /gzi brjid mod la 'jug par 'gyur/ /rnam snang mdzad gsungs 7dkyil 'khor du/ /don yod dngos grub stsol bar rinasamadzad/ /phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor gang bzhugs pa/ /kun du spyi yi 9)rigs rnams kyi/ /don yod dngos grub mchog myur thob/ /sangs rgyas bye ba gang gā'i 1 7klung gi bye ma khrag khrig brgya stong phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i drung du dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed 11par 'gyur ro/ /bsod nams kyi phung po chen po dang ldan par 'gyur te/ yon tan gyi phan yon 'di dag lha ni tshe 'di yin par khong du chud par bya'o/ /bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams su pad+ma las rdzus te skye bar 1 'gyur ro/ /tshe rabs su tshe rabs dran zhing 'od zer bye ba 'bar ba'i lus dang ldan zhing / tshe bskal pa brgya stong dpag tu med par 'gyur ro/ /92—608

yon tan thams cad dri ma med par snang ba don yod pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa bstan pa bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin 'thob ste/ gang ting nge 'dzin thob pas sgyu ma chen po lta bu'i rnam par 'phrul pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul ston par byed do/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi lha'i spyi'i rigs de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyis byin gyis brlabs kyi —1 kyirjes su 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /lha dang / klu dang gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang / mi ma yin pa thams cad dbang du gyur nas rtag tu rjes su 'brang bar 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas dang /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis dkyil 'khor rnams rina'abyor par gzigs nas bsrung geb dang / bskyab 5pa dang sba ba mdzad par 'gyur ro/ /sems can thams cad phyi bzhin 'brang zhing mchod pa chen po byed par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po btsun mo dang / 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis mchod pa'i 'os chen por 'gyur ro/ /sems can thams cad gcig tu bla mar byed par 'gyur rodzi/ /nad thams cad med par 'gyur ro/ /sgrib pa thams cad rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /mtshan ma bri ba'i phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'o// //de nas sbyin sreg 7 gi cho ga'i dkyil 'khor bshad par bya ste/ rig sngags 'chang ba rnam dag gi/ /'di nanyid sgrub pa bsgrub 9 pa'i phyir/ /spyi yi rigs rnams thams cad kyi/ /cho ga zhib mo bla med yin/ /gang gis sbyin sreg 1 byas tsam gyis/ /phyogs kun rnam par gzigs pa yi11/ /de bzhin gshegs gnas 12byon 'gyur zhing / /byang chub sems dpa' dgongs par 'gyur/ / rig sngags 1 92—609

dngos grub rjes stsol cing / /rtag tu srung (1)ba mdzad par 'gyur/ /mgon po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ / the tsom ②med par myur du byon/ /mgon po 'khor bcas gnas nyid na/ /rang gi gzugs su mthong bar 'gyur/ /'dod pa thams cad rtag tu 46pa/ /rtag tu mchog ni 465 ba nyid/ /nyin dang mtshan du rtag par ni/ /rnam par gzigs 'gyur the tsom (5)med/ /dkyil 'khor bshad par bya ba 94)ste/ /dkyil 'khor gru bzhi shin tu mdzes par bya ba ni rgya chen po ko la'i tshad tsam la/ legs par byugs pa shin tu 'jam 55)pa/ shin tu gsal ba gru bzhi sgo bzhi dang / them skas bzhi dang ldan pa/ rnam par dbyes (6)pa mchog tu mdzes pa dbus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi snying por yang bya'o/ /me yi gnas kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ /gru bzhi nyid kyi rnam pa la/ /kun nas them skas bzhi dag dang / /steng du grwa 7ni bzhi pa bya/ /rtag tu pad+ma'i snying po dang / /snying po rgyas pa'i steng du yang / /kun nas 'dab 8)ma mdzes par bya grwa bzhir 9pad+ma'i phreng ba bya/ /de bzhin du grwa yiganyis kur rdo rje pad+ma dang bcas pa'o / /gsum par mdung rtse gsum pa 11pad+ma dang bcas pa'o/ /bzhi par 'khor lo pad+ma dang bcas pa'o/ /lnga par bum pa gang ba 12gzhag go/ /sna tshogs tshon 1 gyis rnam 1 mdzes pa'i/ /kun nas 'dab tshama'i myu gu bya/ /rin chen snod ni bkang ba dang / /me tog phreng dang ngang pa dang / / phye ma tshapad+mar bcas pa dang / /de bzhin me tog rigs dag nyid/ / /de bzhin sna tshogs brgyan 18pa'o/ /nub kyi gnas dang grwa 19dag tu/ /pad+ma'i 'dab ri snam ut+pal bcas / /bum pa drar 21bas bkang ba bri/ /rtsa ba'i bum pa dbu ( /ma la/ /'dir ni kha khyer thig kyang gdab/ /de nas dkyil 'khor mdzes bya ba/ /thig 92wa 610

gis kun nas cha mnyam zhing / /sgo bzhi mdzes par bya ba ni/ /tshon sna lnga yi hu)skud pas gdab/ /me 'bar mdog can bri ba ni/ /kun nas 'bar ba'i phreng ba can/ /grwa (midang grwar ①ni me lha bri/ /lus ni me mdog 'bar ba dang / /lag na me 'bar 'dzin pa dang / /mtshan ma sna tshogs gzhan dag kyang / /cho ga bzhin du bri bar bya/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni cho ga bzhin/ /ba dan mda' dang sna lnga yi/ /skud pas bum pa gang dkris gi)dang / /de bzhin bdug spos snod dag gis/ /kun nas dkyil 'khor brgyan par bya/ /sna tshogs gzugs can rgya che (geyi/ /sna tshogs ro yi gtor ma gzhag /rje'u dang kham phor phyi rnam gsum gyi / /dkar pos dkar (7)ba gzhag par bya/ /rje'u dang dbyib mo bum pa ni/ /gtor mas bkang ba kun du gzhag /'bras bu rnam pa sna tshogs gzhag /kun nas me tog dgram bya zhing / /phreng ba sna tshogs gzhag par bya/ /'bras yos yungs kur gtor 98)nas ni/ /kun du mar me 'bar ba dang / /sna tshogs dri dang de bzhin du/ /dri yi phye ma lha bshos dang / /dkyil 'khor kun la gzhag par bya/ /dkyil 'khor dag ni thams cad la/ /blugs gzar dur 9༄ba rtag tu gzhag /shing ni arka tsheshi mi dang / /yungs kur 'bras ni so ba dang / /zhun mar dang ni mar dkar dang / /kun du 517tsan+dan dkar po dag12 /sbyin sreg 43cho gar 'dir bzhag ste/ /dus gsum rtag tu rig 7'dzin gyis/ /sbyin sreg tsobargya rtsa brgyad du bya/ /rig pa 'dzin pa gtsang ma yisal/ /gtsang ma yi ni gos bgos la/ /dkar gsum gyi ni zas bza' zhing / /gzhan ni bza' dang spyad mi bya/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni nub sgo nas/ /dkyil 'khor shes pa 'jug bya zhing / / dar bha'i hu cistan la skyil krung 1 du/ /shar phyogs kha bltas 1rto92—611

'dug par bya/ /byams pa'i sems la mnyam bzhag ste/ /don yod rgyal po dran bya zhing / /snga dro'i dus su sbyin sreg 6)bya/ /gung la slob ma gzhug bya zhing / /spyi yi rigs kyi sreg blugs (geni/ /phyem red (1)dus su bya ba'o④/ /gang zhig dkyil 'khor du zhugs la/ /sbyin sreg (5)dkyil 'khor de nyid dang / /grub pa kun du cho ga yi/ /bdag nyid dbang bskur me kun gyi ye/ /sbyin sreg (7)byed pa'i mchog tu gsungs/ /kun du gnas ni thams cad na9kye/ /rgyas pa gnas 'jog rwa 9)gcig dang / /gar ge de bzhin phur bu dang / /mdun na 'don lha tshopa me lha ni/ /sbyin sreg 917byed pa 'jig rten par62/ /mtshungs zhes nyusnyeston pas lung bstan to/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i las sgrub pa/ /rig 'dzin dbang po chen po dang / /phyag na rdo rje tshangs pa dang / /khyab 'jug dbang phyug chen po dang / /mnyam pa bas kyang lhag pa nyid/ / me yis 8)sbyin sreg 7byed pa la/ /de bzhin gshegs kun byin gyis rlobatso/ /gal te zhag bdun dus gsum du/ /de la sogs pa'i las rnams ni/ /me la sbyin sreg 3 7byed pa la/ /mod la mngon shes lnga thob ces/ /de skad 'jig rten 'dren pa gsung nyu8/ /las ni byas nas de nas ni/ /sbyin sreg la 19ni brtsam par bya/ / sreg blugs hūṃ )sbyin sreg 21byas tsam gyis/ /las rnams thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /lha rnams rtag tu 'ong 'gyur zhing / /de bzhin gshegs kun dgyes gepar 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa' byon nas ni/ /mod la mthong ba'i sbyin par mdzad ri/ /sdig pa thams cad bsreg 2 par 'gyur/ /shin tu mi bzad 22sngon gyi 26las/ / sreg blugs na tsam gyi 2 mod la bsregs smyo/ /'bar ba'i me yis phye leb bzhin/ /de la sogs pa'i sdig pa ni/ /bsreg 'gyur 'dir ni the tsom ri lhamed/ /sdang 92—612

ba'i phyir ni rgol nyid dang / / bomi bzad phas kyi dgra rnams dang / /pha rol dpung gis 'jigs 91)pa nyid/ /de bzhin du yang rgyal po'i dpung / /de kun sbyin sreg 90byas tsam gyis ni/ /mi snang 54)bar 'gyur the tsom tsho med/ /de bzhin mi ngas gcong kun dang / /nad kun rab tu zhi bar 'gyur/ /mu ge'i dgon pa'i 'jigs nyid kyang / /sbyin sreg byas pa tsam gyis 'jig /gnod sbyin srin po 'byung po dang / /de bzhin bgegs dang log 'dren dang / /sha za brjed byed yi dgas dang / /de bzhin rnam 6)pa sna tshogs gdon/ /'di kun sbyin sreg byas tsam gyisari / /'jig par 'gyur bar the tsom na med/ /rtag tu 'jigs med lo legs shing / /gling dang bde bar 'gyur ba yin/ /rtag tu sems can thams cad ni/ /kun tu rgyal bar 'gyur ba yin/ /rgyal po dpung dang bcas pa nyid/ /btsun mor bcas pa nyid kyang ni/ /rtag par kun tu gsal bar ni/ /mi 'jigs sbyin par the tsom 95med/ /rtag tu nad med 'gyur ba dang / /mnyadaga' zhing yid ni bde ba dang / /lus can dag ni thams cad la / /rtag tu dga' bar byed cing gnas/ /rtag tu me yi lha nyid ni/ /rgyun du mthong bar 'dod pa yis/ /me la sbyin sreg 11byas tsam gyis/ /me lha nyid ni bzhugs gyur te/ /rtag tu las rnams 12thams cad mdzad/ /rgyun du phyi bzhin 'brang bar 'gyur/ /lha ni rtag tu 'ong 1 'gyur zhing / /thams cad du ni mthong ba ster/ /rgyu skar zla ba nyi ma dang / /gshin rje dang ni chu lha dang / /rgyal po chen po bzhi po dag /dpung bcas bzhon 7par bcas pa yang / /nyin dang mtshan du rtag par ni/ /rjes 'brang bsrung nga'agyur the tsom tshamed/ /ci ste rig sngags 'chang don yod pa'i rgyal po'i snying po bsgrub par 'dod na rig 1 rme92—613

sngags 'chang gtsang ma des shin tu khrus byas la gos gtsang 6)ma bgo bar bya/nyin zhag gcig smyung /geb bya zhing / shing arga'i (0yam sreg shing ④gi me sbar la pad+ma 5dang / zhun mar dang / 'bras so ba'i sbyin sreg ⑥brgyad brgya byas nas sreg 7 blugs lan cig rin byas pas mtshams med pa lnga byed pa yang 'grub 99)par 'gyur te/ 'di la the tshom tshadang yid gnyis bskyed par mi bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi spyi'i rigs kyi dngos grub 'dod na rig hu7sngags 'chang des byang chub kyi shing gi me sbar la rigs spyir pad+ma dang / ut+pa la sngon po dang / yungs shar dkar kyi po dang / zhun mar bsres pa'i sbyin sreg (/lhebargyad brgya byas na de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi spyi'i rigs kyi dngos grub 'thob ste thams cad cho ga chen po zhib mo dang / sbyin sreg tso/chen po'i cho gar 'gyur ro / /de nas pha rol gyi dmag tshogs gzhom par 'dod na rig sngags 'chang gtsang ma des shin tu khrus byas la gos gtsang tham bgos te 7seng ldeng gi me sbar la zho dang / zhun mar dang / yungs kur dang / gu gul gyi sreg tu blugs kyis sbyin sreg 1 brgyad stong byas na dpag tshad stong tshun chad kyi pha rol gyi dmag tshogs bcing ba byas par 'gyur ro/ /pha rol gyi dmag tshogs dang / dgra gzhom par 'dod pa dang / dpung gzhigs nyu7par 'dod na de nas rig sngags 'chang gis shing ka ra ba ku'i me sbar la/ sbrul gyi pags 3 )pa brjes ( mapa dang / ske tse'i na sa bon dang / lan tshwa 'bras sā dgelu dang bsres 2 skupa yungs kur khunyemar dang sbyar ba'i sbyin sreg 27byas na dpag tshad stong tshun chad kyi pha rol gyi rdo rtedamag tshogs dang / dgra la gnam /lcags chen po dang / rlung grang mo 'bab pas phongs pa dang / yid mi bde ba bskyed par 2)'gyur/ dgra thams cad 92wa 614

rnam par 0)'jig par 'gyur ro/ /klus char 'bebs par 'dod na rig sngags 'chang des nyin zhag gcig smyung (5)ba byas la/ shin tu khrus byas pa gtsang mas dri sna tshogs dang / me tog phreng ba dang / yungs kur dang / sha ta pus pa zhun mar dang sbyar ba'i sbyin sreg 55)mtshan gcig la dus gsum du (4)byas na klu'i rgyal pos char gyi 45ri/rgyun chen po 'bebs te(6)/ 'dzam bu'i gling mtha' dag tu zhag bdun gyi bar du char 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /char de nyid ha cang ches na thal ba nam mkha' la gtor na ha cang char (dzoches pa 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /yang me lha 'ong bar 'dod cing rang gi gzugs su mthong bar 'dod na rig sngags 'chang gtsang ma des gos gtsang ma bgos la nyin zhag gcig gnas par gyur pas shing sna ma'i me sbar la 'bras so ba dang / zhun mar dang / bu ram sha kha ra dang bcas pa dang / tsha ba gsum dang / sna ma'i me tog bsres 8pa brgyad stong sbyin sreg 59)bya'o/ /brgyad stong tshang ba 1 tshodang / me lha me'i nang nas lus phyed phyung ste 'dug nas rig sngags 'chang la ci bgyi bka' 46pa cig ces zer zhing ji ltar rig sngags 'chang gi cho ga'i don du 'gyur ba de bzhin du smra'o/ /thams cad sbyin pa zhes bya ba mchog thams cad sbyin pa zhes bya ba bdud rtsi 'bar ba zhes bya ba'i me'i kha/ kha'i mchog sbyin par byed do/ /gang bdud rtsi 17'bar ba'i me'i kha thob pas gang du dbugs phyung ba dang / rngubs pa der me 'bar ba 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /gang du phu zhes byas pa der me 'byung bar 12'gyur ro/ /mun gnag 12tu dbugs phyung na me 'bar te14/ snang bar 'gyur ro / /tsan+dan dkar gepo'i sbyin sreg yostong rtsa brgyad nyu byas pas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug nyid kyi gzugs ston par mdzad do/ /sa bon bdun gyi 92wa 615

sbyin sreg (1)gis nad thams cad zhi bar byed do/ /'bras so ba'i sbyin sreg (migis ni rgyal po dbang du byed do/ /phub ma dang lan tshwa'i sbyin sreg ( gis ni zhe gisa'agras par byed do/ /'bras yos dang yungs kur gyi sbyin sreg (5༄gis ni sems can thams cad dbang du byed do/ /yungs kur dang / gu gul dang / zhun mar gyi sbyin sreg 6gis ni gnod sbyin 'gugs so/ /ka ri7)ra bī nanora'i me tog dang / gu gul zhun mar dang sbyar ba'i sbyin sreg /9)gis ni srin mo 'gugs so/ /de bzhin du 'dir las thams cad byed do/ /sbyin sreg 1 tshogi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'o// //ri mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub 11pa'i cho ga bshad par bya ste/ kun tu thun mong sgrub 12pa'i mchog /dge ba'i las kun byed pa ste/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mthong 'gyur zhing 1ri/ /bla med bsod nams chen po sogs7/ /don yod rgyal po de nyid ni/ /rnam pa sna tshogs gzugs dag tu/ /'jig rten 'dren pa snang bar bya/ /mthun dadang dngos grub sna tshogs pa'i/ /'jig rten 'dren pa'i 1tshigazugs bya ba/ /grub pa sna tshogs byed pa'i gnas/ /so so'i gzugs su bya ba ni/ /ras sam yang na dar dag la/ /'jigs pa med pas gzugs bya'o//don yod pa'i 1 rgyal po ni khru gang tsam gyi tshad dam yang na tshad shin tu rnam par 'byed pa 18pad+ma'i mdog lta bu phyag brgyad pa/ dbu gsum pa/ de bzhin du spyan gsum pa/ zhi ba'i zhal du bri bar bya ste de 19bzhin du zhags pa 'dzin pa dang pad+ma 'dzin pa dang mdung rtse gsum pa dang / ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin pa dang / yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang / be con dang dbugs 'byin 2 pa 92wa 616

dang / bgrang phreng dang / me tog thum 1)po 'dzin par bya'o/ /g.yon du ni dkar mo'o(snye/ /g.yas su 'phags ma sgrol ma thal mo sbyar la dbu yid tsam 'dud pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'ori rme/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ni ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ dbu rgyan 'od dpag med kyis brgyan pa / g.yas phyogs kyi dbu zla ba tshes pas brgyan ri4)pa/ ri dgas kyi pags 75)pa mnabs 6)pa/ mchod phyir thogs pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ 'od 'dom gang dang ldan pa'o/ /nang rim 7༄du pad+ma'i phreng 8ba'o/ /rim pa gnyis par rdo rje phreng ba lcags kyu dang bcas par bya'o/ /rim pa gsum par nor bu rin po che'i phreng ba dang / rin po che sna tshogs mdzes pa'o/ /rim pa bzhi par mdung rtse gsum pa'i phreng ba'o/ /rim pa lnga par kun nas 'bar ba'i phreng ba'o/ /steng dang g.yas phyogs kyi gnas su dbang po dang / tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug chen po 95me tog sna tshogs thogs par bya'o/ /g.yon du gzhon nu dang / gshin rje dang / chu lha dang / lus ngan dang / dbang phyug dang / lha'i bu rnams bya ba ni me tog sna tshogs thogs par bya'o/ /lha mo sgrol 1 tshoma'i rgyab tu khro bo'i rgyal po don yod pa'i zhags pa bya ba ni khros pa/gtum pa'i /lhagazugs 'chang ba/ phyag bzhi pa/ 'bar ba'i nang du bzhugs nyu2pa / sku rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ ral pa 'chang ba/ 'od 1 dpag med kyi dbu rgyan can/ spyan gsum pa/ g.yas pa zla bas brgyan ngacing ral gri 'dzin pa dang zhags pa 'dzin pa dang / mdung rtse gsum pa 'dzin pa dang /dgra sta 'dzin par bya'o/ /dkar mo'i rgyab tu rig sngags kyi rgyal po dbu gsum pa bya ba ni/ zhi ba'i zhal ras can rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan dpa/ dbu rgyan 92—617

rgyal ba 0)'od dpag med can thogs pa/ pad+ma 'dzin pa/ nor bu rin po che 'dzin par bya'o/ /'og tu pho nya mo dang / dbyangs can ma (midang / dung (gecan ma dang / dpal mo dang / gnas ma ④dang / dpe med ma dang / ral pa gcig ma dang / pho nya mo zhi ba dang / lo tog (5rigi lha dang / sa'i lha dang /rgyal po chen po bzhi bya'o/ /steng dang g.yas g.yon du sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs skyil mo krung 6)bcas pa sor bzhi pa'i tshad tsam bya'o/ /nyi ma dang / zla ba'i lha rgyu skar dang bcas pa bya'o/ /ri mo'i gzugs kyi phyi rol gyi 7)rim pa kun du phyag rgya dang / phyag mtshan sna tshogs rdzogs par bri'o8)/ /klu brgyad 9)bya zhing kun nas 'bar ba dang bcas par bya'o/ /rig sngags dngos grub bla med pa'i/ /ri mo'i cho ga'i gnas 'di ni/ /sdig pa thams cad mod la sel/ /mtshams med lnga po sbyong bar 1 byed/ /phyag rgya dang / dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa ri mo'i gzugs tsho/grub pa /2'di ni spyi'i rigs thams cad du 'jug pa ston pa yin no / /phyi'i rigs thams cad kyi de kho na nyid kyi ri mo'i dkyil 'khor 'di ni dus gsum du gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / de bzhin du byang chub sems dpas kyang byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /don yod pa'i byin gyi kyi brlabs kyi ri mo 'di ni thub pa rnam par snang mdzad kyis byin gyis 'barlabs 8pa ste/ don yod pa'i zhags pa'i de kho na nyid snying por gyur pa de kho na nyid gsang ba 'di mthong ba tsam gyis rnam par thar pa 'thob cing lung bstan par 'gyur ro/ /mthong ba tsam gyis cho ga zhib mo bla na med pa thams cad 'grub bo/ /rnam par snang mdzad 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor chen ngo/ dang ldan par snang ba bye ba gegang gā'i klung gi bye ma nyu brgya stong phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu mngon sum du mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /92—618

dkyil 'khor chen po 'khor bcas kyi/ /(1)rig sngags cho ga bla med pa/ /spyi rigs yang dag 'byung ba ni/ /thub pa rnam snang mdzad kyis bstan/ /de bzhin gshegs rigs grub pa dang / /gang yang pad+ma'i rigs de bzhin/ /nor rigs de nyid 'byung ba dang / /rdo rje'i rigs gang bla med pa/ /spyi rigs 'di nyid mthong ba ni/ /ri mo mthong ba'i khyad par yin/ /phyir yang ngan 'gror mi 'gro zhing / /dmyal ba ngan 'gro'i sgo bcad de/ /mtho ris 2kyi ni sgo yang phye/ /bla na med pa ston pa yi/ /phyag rgya'i ri mo'i dkyil 'khor 'di/ /bsod nams bla na med pa yin/ /ci ste don yod pa'i 'jig rten dbang phyug gi gzugs mthong bar 'dod na rig sngags 'chang des tsan+dan dkar po las 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug don yod pa'i zhags pa sor brgyad kyi tshad tsam la/gnad kyi laganas kyi cha'i sor ④tshad shin tu rnam par mdzes pa/ dbu dang /mgur dang / rked pa dang / pus mo dang / yan lag dang / zhabs kyi tshigs dang / phyag sor dang /(5) phyag sor gyi tshigs dang / sen mo thams cad /mnyam zhing mdzes pa dang / ral pa dang / sen mo tshad shin tu 7mdzes shing cod 58)pan gyi rgyal ba'i g.yas phyogs na zla gam zhi ba'i gzugs can spyan gsum pa(9ra/ phyag bzhi shin tu mdzes pa dang / dbu skra shin tu mdzes pa/rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i gzugs dang ldan pa/ zhags pa 'dzin pa/g.yon ⑩pa 'od dpag med 1lhacan phyag na pad+ma bsnams pa/ phyag g.yas pa mdung rtse gsum pa dang / dbugs 'byin cing rtag tu mchog sbyin par mdzad pa/pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs par bya'o/ /sgrol ma dang / dkar mo yang 'od 'dom 1 gang dang bcas /gepar dgod do/ /mgon po shin tu mdzes pa/ nor bu dang /92wa 619

mu tig gi rgyan gyi ༷1)mtshams su gser gyi rgyan gyis g.yogs pa'i con ⑧pan nam/yang na spyi gtsug tu ring bsrel gzhag par byas la/ tsan+dan dkar po'i dkyil 'khor bya zhing gur gum ri nodang / gla rtsi dang / ga pur gyis mchod la dkyil 'khor gyi snying po 'di'i dbus su pad+ma ge sar dang bcas pa'i 'dab (4)ma sum cu rtsa gnyis pa bris la de'i dbus su 'jigs pa med pas 'jig rten dbang phyug dar gyi cod 5pan gyis bcings pa bzhag la/ a ga ru dang / tsan+dan gyi bdug pa dbul zhing me tog dgram par bya/ me tog gi phreng bas mchod par bya'o/ /rig sngags 'chang gtsang mar gyur pa shin tu khrus byas pa gos gtsang ma bgos pas / smyung 6ba byas la mgon po 'jig rten dbang phyug la ri snamangon du phyogs par skyil mo krung 8 bcas te 'dug la mchod yon dang / lha bshos phul la byams pa'i sems la mnyam par bzhag ste/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa bsgom (9mo / /sems can thams cad la brtse bar gyur pa'i ting nge 'dzin yang bsgom (rtazhing gtam gzhan mi smra bar 11shin tu yongs su sbyar ba 12legs par spyod cing 1rigazhan 'jigs pa med pas bdag bsrung ngab dang / phyogs bcing ba dang /dkyil 'khor bcing ba srung nyu5ba dang bcas pa yang byas la bzlas brjod de nyid stong rtsa brgyad dang / phyag rgya yang stong rtsa brgyad brtsams na 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 'bar zhing g.yo ba dang / bdag kyang 'bar ba dang snying dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi mchog sbyin par mdzad pa'i laphyag spyi bor gzhag ste legs so legs so/ /rig sngags 'chang khyod kyis mchod pa dam pa dang / gsang sngags kyi cho ga chen po byas so/ /sgrub 1 pa dam pa byas so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyi'i 18rigs 'di dang / de 92—620

bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs thams cad kyi cho ga zhib mo gsang ba dang / phyag rgya dang / dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dang / thams cad du spyi'i dngos grub rig sngags 'chang khyod la 'grub kyis/ khyod kyis (1)don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po rjes su zung (5)shig dang / rig sngags 'chang ji ltar yid la byed pa de ltar ( sta'adod pa dang / mchog thams cad ji ltar yid la bsams ris pa de thams cad rjes su sbyin no/ /'di ni khyod kyi skye ba'i 'khor ba tha ma yin te skye ba dang / rga ba dang / 'chi ba dang / mngal du gnas pa las yongs su grol bar 'gyur ro//rig sngags 'chang khyod shi 'phos nas bde ba can gyi (5)'jig rten gyi khams su pad+ma las rdzus te skye kyibar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med mngon sum du mthong bar 'gyur/ mngon sum du chos nyan par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub kyi snying po la gnas kyi bar tshe'i tshad bskal pa brgya stong dpag tu med grangs med bgrang du med par 'gyur ro zhes tshig tu gsung 77ngo / /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis khro bo'i rgyal po gang la khro bo'i rgyal po 587me tog gam/ cod pan la mngon par gtor na/ des na 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug rang gi skur bzhugs te/ rig sngags 'chang nam mkha' la 'gro zhing don yod pa'i ye shes bkod pa dri ma med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin 'thob bo/ /yangs pa chen pos rnam par thar pa'i dkyil 'khor don yod pa'i zhags pa'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro/ /sku gzugs bsgrub pa de kho na nyid ces pa 'di gal te rig sngags 'chang skal ba chung ba mnar med par gzhol ba/ mtshams med pa lnga byed pas ri95de lan cig 1 nges par bsgrubs 1lhapa tsam gyis mdun du rang gi gzugs kyis nges par mchis par 'gyur ro12/ /gal te de bzhin gshegs pa 92—621

thams cad dang dus gsum du gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas la sdang bas khrag dbyung bar sems bskyed pa des kyang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang 6)/ dus gsum du gshegs pa'i (gyisangs rgyas kyis dgongs pa'i dam tshig chen po'i (7byin gyis brlabs de rig sngags 'chang bsgrubs stin rmi ⑤lam du bdag gi yigazugs mthong ba stsal bar bgyi zhing yid la bsams ⑦pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bgyi'o/ /mchog thams cad rjes su stsal bar bgyi zhing sdig pa dang lasgrib pa thams cad rnam par dag par bgyi'o/ /dri ma med par rnam par thar pa'i 'od zer gyi dkyil 'khor la rnam par lta ba zhes bya ba 6)ting nge 'dzin 'thob bo /sad nas 'jig rten pa thams cad kyi tshimachod pa'i 'os chen po gcig pur 'gyur ro / /skye bo thams cad kyis mchod par bya ba chen por 'gyur ro/ /sgrib pa dang bral zhing rnam par dag pa/ sgo kun du dri ma med par snang ba zhes bya ba'i lus yongs su dag pa 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /sems can gang dag gis de mthong bar gyur pa de dag thams cad sgrib pa dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /nad thams cad dang bral zhing nyon mongs pa dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /gdol pas kyang dad pa 11dang / gus pas sgrub pa rnam pa gsum dang / cho ga gzhan gyis kyang nges par yid la bsams sna pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bgyi/ rang gi gzugs kyis mthong ba stsal bar bgyi na/ mir gyur pa dad pa'i rjes su 'brang ba sdom brtson can gyis lta smos kyang ci 'tshal te/ dran pa tsam gyis bdag rang gi gzugs kyis mdun na mchis par bgyi zhing yid la bsams (5pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bgyi ste/ 'di la the tsom tsodang yid gnyis bskyed 8par mi bya'o / /de lta mod kyi bcom ldan 'das 7sems can tshe gcig pu pa de la rig 92wa 622

sngags sgrub lhonyepa'i dngos grub ②rjes su stsal bar bdag gis rngo mi thogs (5)lags sol/ /gang yang phyi ma'i tshe ④phyi ma'i dus na dge slong dag dang / rig sngags 'chang ba'i sems can ser sna can/ sems gya gyu ba (5)gnyis su mi byed pa/ ngo gnyis can/ ser sna can/ byas pa mi gzo ba/ pha rol gyi rdzas la brkam (5)chags can/ gsang sngags rku ba/ yi ge rku ba/ gdug pa/ phrag dog che ba/khengs (7pa/ gzhan gyi (8)rdzas 'phrog pa/ mkhan po dang slob dpon phyag rgya dang dkyil 'khor ston pa'i bla ma la ma gus pa/ rig sngags kyi cho ga zhib mo 'di ston pa la ma gus pa nyid brkam 5)chags can/ byas pa mi gzo ba nyid dag 'byung ste/sems can de dag la bskyang tshubar bstan pa'am(1/ dngos grub bstan par rngo mi thogs lags yogeso/ /bdag tunyel yang brnyas par bgyid pa'i sems can de lta bu mang du 'byung ste/ bdag la'ang 8sun par bgyid pa/ bdag la'ang skam gus par bgyid pa/ kun nas mnar sems tshotshadang sdang bas khrag 'byin tsho1 ci par bgyid pa dag 'byung ngo yoshe/ /bdag la'ang 'khu bar 67bgyid pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / spyi'i rigs kyi dam tshig 3kāsun par bgyid pa'i sems can de ni smad par 'os pa zhes brjod par bgyi'o / /rig sngags kyi cho ga zhib mo dang / dam tshig kun nas 'joms par bgyid pa'i gdol pa zhes rig 6)par bgyi'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba kun nas 'joms pa zhes rig par bgyi'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po dang / gsang ba dang / dkyil 'khor kun nas 'joms pa zhes rig par bgyi'otsha snye/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi dam tshig dang / gsang ba 3 sadang / rig sngags 'chang gi dkyil 'khor dang / phyag rgya 92—623

kun nas 'joms pa zhes rig par bgyi'o/ /de dag gis bdag la smad pas sems can de dag gi sdig (1)pas gdol pa zhes bgyi ste/ dge slong dag dang /rig sngags 'chang de dag ni smad (na)par 'os par rig par bgyi'o/ /tshig pa ka ba 53)tshig pa lta bu/ rig sngags nyams pañtsa)/ log 'dren gyis zin pa dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad kyis smad pa zhes bgyi'o/ /'jig rten pa dang /'jig rten las 'das pa 5chud gzan pa/ rig sngags nyams pa/ dmyal bar gzhol ba de dag ni bdag gis ma nongs te/ bdag gis yongs su spangs pa ma lags so/ /de lta mod kyi dus gsum du gshegs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su spangs pa/ dus gsum du gshegs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yongs su spangs pa/ rdo rje'i ne dam tshig dang / dkyil 'khor dang / phyag rgya thams cad spangs pa/ thub pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi dam tshig chen po'i dkyil 'khor dang / dam tshig yongs su spangs pas bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad dang /sdang ba thams cad kyis zin cing nad kyis yongs su zin par 'gyur ba de dag ni bdag gis ma nongs te / bdag gis yongs su ma spangs so/ /de lta mod kyi 8rig sngags bsregs pa/ dkyil 'khor dang dam tshig bsregs pa/ phyag rgya byed pa dang bcas par bsregs pa/ gsang ba bsregs pa/95 de bzhin gshegs pa'i dam tshig dang rigs sun par byed pa/ sdig pa'i dge slong mang po de dag ni des na bskal pa mang po rdul phra mo bsags pa'i bskal par sdug bsngal nyams su myong ste/ 'jig rten 'di dang 'jig rten pha rol gyi bde ba can med do / /de lta bas na sems can rig sngags kyi ched du rig sngags rjes su sems pas 1 byams pa'i sems su bya'o/ /gang gi 1lhadrung du phyag rgya dang / gsang 92—624

sngags rim par 0)phye ba dang / rig sngags gsang ba rnyed dzo par 'gyur ba de la des ( rigs pa chen po dang / bla mar bgyi ba (4)chen po bskyed par bgyi/ pha dang ma dang 'dra ba'i sems bskyed (5)par bgyi/ pha dang ma'i gus pa ri skubagyi/ston pa'i gus pa bgyi/ rang gi sha dang / khrag dang / rkang yang gtang 7bar bgyirinas / gos dang / rgyan dang / bza' ba dang /995 btung ba dang /stan 7dang / bgo bas rim gro dang mchod pa bgyi ste/ de la ni bdag gis mchod par bgyi/ rjed pa 31dang bla mar bgyi'o/ /rtag tu rjes su lha 'brang bar bgyi/ dran pa tsam gyis kyang bdag gi gzugs mthong ba rjes su stsal bar bgyi / rgyun du rjes 1 su 'brang bar bgyi/ bdag rgyun du rjes su 'brang ba ni ji ltar chab 7kyi nang du til mar gyi thigs pa stsal ba ltar dngos grub kun du mchi bar bgyi/ rgya ma61re dus rlabs bzhin du thams cad du mchi bar bgyi'o/ /bdag gis zhags pa dang / lcags kyus dmyal ba thams cad drang bar bgyi / bde bar gshegs pa'i lam la so sor gzhag par bgyi/ stobs dang /brtson 'grus dang / gzi brjid chen po 'jug par bgyis/ thams cad du sgrub 7pa dang / dngos grub dang yi / mchog stsal bar bgyi'o/ /de nas tsan+dan gyi gzugs 'di mthong bas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug nyid kyi gzugs mthong ste/ de mtshungs par 'tshal bar bgyi ste bdag 18rang gi gzugs kyis rgyun kho nar gnas par bgyi'o/ /gang na cho ga 'di gnas pa de mchod rten dang bcas par mtshungs par rig par bgyi'o/ /sa phyogs de ni ston pa bla ma bzhugs pa'i gnas su rig par bgyi'o/ /gang na dus gsum du gshegs pa'i 3)spyi'i dam tshig gnas pa 'di sangs rgyas kyi gnas so zhes rig par 92—625

bgyi'o / /de gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor rmad du byung ba zhes rig par bgyi'o/ /lha thams cad kyi gnas dang dam tshig go zhes rig par bgyi'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs thams cad kyi gnas byang chub kyi snying po dang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / bdud 'dul ba dang / yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po yang dag par ston pa'i gnas so zhes rig par bgyi'o/ /sa phyogs 'di 0)rin po che sna bdun gyi gzhal med khang gi gnas bkod pas brgyan (snyepar rig par bgyi ste/ de la the tsom (gyidang yid gnyis bskyed par mi bya'o/ /de nas de'i 'og tu gnas thams cad du gtogs pa'i dngos grub chen po sgyu ma chen po'i rnam par 'phrul pa'i gnas byed par 'dod pa dang / dgos pa thams cad byed par 'dod na rig sngags 'chang des dri sna tshogs las (pe'aphags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gzugs sor bcu drug pa shin tu mdzes pa/ sku shin tu tshad dang ldan pa/ phyag drug pa/ de bzhin du zhal gsum pa bya ste/ dang po ni zhi ba'i zhal ras can tshangs pa'i cha byad 'chang ba/ spyan gsum pa/ral pa'i thor tshugs kyis brgyan 5)pa/ 'od dpag med pa'i dbu rgyan 'chang ba/zla gam can no/ /zhal g.yas pa ni khro bo'i rgyal po (6rigazugs can/ ri7)gzugs bsgyur ba/ spyan gsum pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs kyi steng gi ral pa la 'od dpag med pa'i dbu rgyan 'chang ba/ zla gam g.yas phyogs na gnas pa'o/ /g.yon pa ni zhal khro gnyer can/ khros pa'i lta stangs su lta ba/ spyan gsum pa/ral pa'i thor tshugs 'chang ba/ 'od dpag med pa'i dbu rgyan 8)'chang ba/g.yas phyogs zla gam can/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ 'od 'dom gang gis legs par brgyan 9pa/ zhags pa thogs pa/ pad+ma thogs pa/ mdung rtse 92—626

gsum pa thogs pa/ dgra sta thogs pa/ dbugs 'byin pa/ rin po che'i dbyug pa thogs pa6)/ pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /g.yas na lha mo sgrol ma thal mo sbyar cing 'dud pa'o/ /g.yon na dkar (gyimo thal mo sbyar te yid tsam du 'dud pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ me tog sna tshogs kyis legs par brgyan par bya'o/ /zhabs kyi drung du rig sngags 'chang gser gyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa / lag na me tog thogs pa/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la kha bltas (minas pus mo btsugs te 'dug par bya'o/ / lhag ma ma yin pa'i tshon rtsis nitshad dang tshad (5)ma 'dres par spyan (6༄dang / smin ma dang / mchu (7dang /sen mo'i gnas kyis (2)gnas su sbyar bar 6)bya'o// //'phags pa don yod pa'i zhags pa'i cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po/ bam po nyi shu pa / de nas rdzas bshad par bya ste/ 'jigs pa med pas spos kyi rigs tsan+dan dang / ta ga ra dang / pu shel tsi dang / li shi dang / nā tu 7ga pus pa 11dang / spro 8ka dang / rgya skyegs dang / kha bar hu ṇi kha dang / spang spos dang / na la da dang / gur gum chadang / gla rtsi dang / ga bur dang /sgron shing dang / gan+da (snyithi yang ku dang / kun du ru dang / sha kha ra dang /pad+ma ge sar dang / du ru ska tsodang / til mar dang / spra tshil dang / lhan cig sbyar ba'i phye ma zhib mo shin tu 'jam pa'o 7/ shin tu mnyen pa/ mchog 'di gtsang ma yoshegatsang sbra spyod pas thub pa/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dge zhing 6)shin tu dul ba/ rab tu zhi ba'i rnam par shin tu mdzes par bya'o / / gsang sngags brgyad stong ༷ stabazlas brjod byas pas/ lan cig bsgrubs zhu)pa ni mchog yin te/ 'di yongs su rdzogs nas khro bo'i ( rgya'/ pos 92—627

thams cad la mngon du gtor te de nas rig sngags 'chang gis las brtsam mo/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gtsang mar gyur pas 1)gos gtsang ma bgos ②te/shin tu khrus byas la dris byugs pas dkyil 'khor gru bzhi shin tu mdzes pa (8)gsal ba/ ko la'i tshad tsam gyi dkyil 'khor bzang po legs par byugs pa shin tu gsal ba bya'o/ /dri sna tshogs kyis byugs pa shin tu 'jam pa la tsan+dan dkar po dang / gur gum ca༄gyis dbus su las kyi dkyil 'khor rnam par phye ba bri bar bya'o / /'dir ni pad+ma'ang byas te(5ri/ 'dab tsho6)ma brgya rtsa brgyad pa ge sar dang snying por bcas pa/ shin tu mdzes pa/ shin tu bzang ba/ tsan+dan dang gur gum 7gyis bri bar bya ste/ der tshon rtsi gzhan ni spyad par mi bya'o/ /bum pa spos chus bkang ba dang / de bzhin du dri chu dang / rinaragator ma thams cad dri sna tshogs kyis bsgos pa dang / ci yod pa'i gtor ma gzhag ste/ de nas 'dir dkyil 'khor bya ba 95ni gnas sam dgon pa'am/ khyim mam bogang du gnas par gyur pa 1 der khru gang tshad dam tu khru do'am khru gsum mam /delhag nga/ra yang bya'o/ /de bzhin du bdug spos dang / tsan+dan dang / a ga nya ru dang /du ru ska tshadang / kun tu ru'o/ /ba dan kha dog sna tshogs pas dkyil 'khor kun nas brgyan par bya'o/ /me tog phreng ba dgram bya tshazhing / /dri dang byug pa de nyid dang / /kun du mar me'i phreng ba'o/ /de nas dri las byas pa'i 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su pad+ma'i ge sar gyi steng du bzhag pa la/ rig sngags 'chang mngon du phyogs par skyil 3 mo krung 3stebacas te 'dug nas gzhan mi smra bar bzlas brjod brgyad stong brtsam par bya'o/ /brgyad stong rdzogs pa dang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sku las 92—628

'od zer sna tshogs 'byung zhing (1racher g.yo bar 'gyur/ rang gi lag pa g.yas pa 'bar bar 'gyur ro/ /gzugs brnyan las rig sngags 'chang legs so legs so(snye/ /khyod kyis 'dod pa'i las thams cad grub bo(5)/ /don yod pa chen po'i 'khor lo rnam par 'phrul pa'i dngos grub dang / thams cad du dgos pa grub pa de kho na nyid grub bo/ /khyod kyis don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po 'di mchog tu grub bo ni/ /khyod kyis sgrub pa'i cho ga rgya cher mchog tu grub 5bo zhes sgra 'byung ngo / /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis (6)dgos pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ji ltar dgos par bya ste/ slob ma gzhug pa dang /dam tshig ni 'dir dgos pa zhes bya'o/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis 7gang gi tshe dgos pa byung 58)ba de'i tshe dri las byas pa'i mgon po la sngar mchod pa bya ste/de nas dgos pa thams cad 'grub par ri9'gyur ro/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mdun du bzhag la/ bzlas brjod brgyad brgya 1 byas na dgos pa sna tshogs rmi lam du ston cing ji ltar bsams 11pa thams cad ston par 'gyur ro1 / /de'i mdun du tsan+dan dkar po las dkyil 'khor byas la/tsan+dan dkar po'i sbyin sreg 51 chibargya rtsa nga brgyad bya'o/ /de nas thal ba la bzlas brjod lan brgya rtsa brgyad bya ste/ rang gi lus mtha' dag khyab par bsku zhing /thal ba de nyid dang / yungs kur 7gyi byug pa phyogs bzhir gtor na 'jig rten dbang phyug gi gzugs ji lta ba 8de ltar 'jig rten thams cad kyis mngon sum 1 du mthong ste/ ji srid du phyir bsdu ba ma byas pa de srid du 'jig rten dbang phyug gi gzugs su snang bar 'gyur ro/ /dri chu dang yungs kur gyis mngon du phyogs par kyi gtor na phyir bsdu ba byas par 'gyur ro/ /thal 92wa 629

ba des rab tu bdugs te dur 6)khrod kyi nang du zhugs na 'byung po'i dpung dang 'khor dang bcas pa mdun na nye bar gnas par 'gyur ro/ /gnod sbyin dang /srin po dang / 'byung po dang / sha za thams cad mdun na nye bar gnas shing dbang du gyur nas gnas te/ bdag dang nor gyis bgyi ba ci mchis zhes ②bya ba byed do/ /rang la byugs te tshogs kyi nang ngam / dge 'dun gyi nang du zhugs na ston pa mthong ba ji lta ba de 4ltar rig sngags 'chang snang zhing mthong ste/mchod pa'i 'os chen por 'gyur ro/ /phyag bya (geba'i 'os su 'gyur/ don dang mchod pa chen po 'thob 6par 'gyur ro/ /thal bas lus bskus te klu'i mtshor (7 zhugs na klu'i rgyal po stong phrag drug cu rtsa brgyad thams cad dbang du gyur nas gnas te bka' bzhin byed par 'gyur zhing ji srid 'tsho'i bar du nye bar gnas par 'gyur ro/ /rang la byugs te rgyal po'i pho brang du zhugs na/ rgyal po (shebatsun mo dang 'khor du bcas pa rnams dbang du 'gyur te/ ci bgyi zhes bya ba byed cing mdun na nye bar gnas par 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten gyi bla ma ji lta ba de bzhin du mchod pa chen po 'byung bar 'gyur/ don chen po dang mchod pa chen po 'thob par 'gyur9/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du nye bar gnas par 'gyur te/ston pa 'dren pa ji lta ba bzhin no/ /gang dang gang la thal bas reg pa tsam gyis de dang de'i nad thams cad bral bar 'gyur/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad rnam par dag par 'gyur ngan 'gro'i sgo thams cad gcad / ripar 'gyur/mchog tu bde ba dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /shi 'phos nas bde ba can gyi 11tsho'ajig rten gyi khams su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /byas pa mi gzo /2ba/ gsang sngags kyi gdol pa/ ma gus pa/ bla mar /lhami byed pa/ rlom sems can8/ nga rgyal 92wa 630

dang ldan pa/ bdud kyi 0)phyogs pa/ skyes bu gti mug can/ bsogs (gyipa la zhen pa/ khengs pa/ nga rgyal can de dag gis gang du yang dngos grub yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ngo / /de dag yun ring por thar pa mi rnyed pas dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / gang yang rig sngags kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyis smad pa/ skye ba brgyud par rang gi ( norgyud la dngos grub bsregs pa/ 'jig rten 'di dang pha rol gechud gson pa dag ni ma gtogs te/ de lta mod kyi 'dir bdag gis cung zad kyang ma nongs te / sdug bsngal mang po dang chen po'i sems can dgrol bar (5)rngo mi thogs 56)lags so/ /sangs rgyas thugs rje chen pos bka' stsal pa'i yid la bgyi ba bskal (7)pa bgrangs par (8)yid la bgyis cadapas dgrol bar rngo mi thogs 1 tsholags so / /de lta mod kyi sdug bsngal mang po brgyud par nyams su 3)myong bar 'gyur ro//dngos grub ni byams pas 'thob ste/ byams pa dang / gsang sngags kyi 12go cha bgos pa/ byams pa'i ral gri thogs pa/ sems can thams cad la phan 12zhing mnyes gshin pa la de kho na nyid sgrub pa'i dngos grub 'di dag 'jig rten 'dren pas rjes su gnang ngo / /mgon po 'di mthong ba tsam gyis spos kyi gzugs kyi 'jig rten mgon po mthong ba dang / 'jig rten 'dren pa rang gi gzugs su mngon sum du mthong ba mtshungs pa nyid du khong du chud par bgyi'o/ /sangs rgyas bye ba gang gā'i 6klung gi bye ma dang mnyam pa skamangon sum tshedu mthong ba kho na dang / 'jig rten gyi mgon po mthong ba mtshungs pa kho nar khong du chud par bgyi nyu tshoste/ 'di ltar shes par bya'o/ /de nas phyir mi ldog pa'i gnas rig sngags 'chang gi 'khor los sgyur 18ba chen po sgrub par 'dod pa'i dge slong ngam/92—631

rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo'am/ rgyal po 'am/(1) blon po chen po'am/rig sngags 'chang ngam/ gzhan gang yang rung ba'i rig (0sngags 'chang gis ④phyir mi ldog pa'i gnas thob par 'dod pa dang / dus gsum du gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas mthong bar 'dod pa dang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gnas mthong bar 'dod pa dang / rig sngags 'chang gi dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad mthong bar 'dod pa dang / 'phags pa rdo rje 'dzin mthong bar 'dod pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs thams cad kyi spyi'i dam tshig mthong bar 'dod can cho ga 'di bsgrub par bya ste/ snying po dang bcas/ bya ba dang bcas pa des myur ba dang / shin tu myur ba dang / mgyogs par 'jig rten thams cad kyi mngon sum du cho 'phrul rmad du byung ba 5rigasang ba ston par (yemathong ste/ 'di la som nyi dang 7nem nur bskyed par mi bya'o/ /the tsom rdzun dang yid gnyis bskyed par mi bya'o/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gser gyi mdog can sor bzhi'i tshad tsam/ tshangs pa'i cha byad 'chang ba/ ral pa'i thor tshugs kyis brgyan pa bya ste/ shin tu tshad dang ldan pa/ cha byad mdzes pa/ cha shin tu rnam par mdzes pa/ phyag gnyis pa/ spyan gsum pa/ 'od dpag med pa'i dbu rgyan snatsho can/ g.yas na zla ba tshes pa/ phyag g.yon na 7pad+ma dang / ril ba spyi blugs bsnams pa/phyag g.yas mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa/ sku'i nang ga bur dang / gla rtsi dang ring bsrel 11gyis bkang ba/ g.yas na lha mo sgrol ma dngul las byas pa thal mo sbyar te yid tsam 'dud pa/ gser gyi rgyan gyis 12brgyan pa dang / g.yon na dngul las dkar mo thal mo sbyar te yid tsam 'dud pa pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs par 92—632

bya'o / /steng gi g.yas phyogs na 'od dpag med skyil mo krung 1bcas te bzhugs pa dang / g.yon na shākya'i rgyal po skyil mo krung dbacas te bzhugs pa dgod par bya'o/ /'od 'dom gang dang bcas pas legs par brgyan par bya zhing / gnad dang gnad shin tu rnam par 'byes dpa/ skra dang / dpral 547ba dang / smin ma dang / shangs dang / snyan dang / zhal dang / mgul pa dang / dpung pa dang / nu ma dang / rked pa dang / brla dang / pus 55mo dang / byin pa dang / zhabs dang / phyag gi sor mo mnyam zhing thams cad du mdzes pa/ sku chu zheng 6rigab cing mtho 7ridaman ran pa/ mchod phyir thogs pa dkar po rin 'chang ba 59bya'o/ /las shin tu yongs su rdzogs shing shin tu mthar phyin pa dang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi 1 gzugs zin par rig nas/ de nas 11rig sngags 'chang gis rgyu skar bzang po'i zla ba nya'am12/tshes brgyad dam/ bcwa sna lnga'am/ bcu gsum mamasna / bcu bzhi'am/ rgyu skar bkra shis pa rgyal gyi nyi ma dang mthun 15pa rnyed nas dkyil 'khor bsgrub lha par bya ste/ dkyil 'khor shin tu mdzes par bya ba ni gru bzhi la cha legs par phye ba1 / ko la'i tshad tsam la them skas bzhis brgyan pa/ khru gsum par rnam par dbye bar bya ste/ chung ba dang lhag par ni 18mi bya'o/ /legs par byugs pa shin tu 'jam pa/ snyi ba/ mnyen 19pa/ dbyibs legs pa la tshon rtsi sna tshogs kyis rnam par dbye zhing dkyil 'khor dam pa thig gdab pa ni 2 shin tu rnam par mdzes pa/ sgo bzhi pa la dkyil 'khor gyi dbus kyi snying por pad+ma'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor don yod pa'i zhags pa'i dkyil 'khor bri'o/ /phyi rol gyi dkyil 'khor gyi gnas su cha rnam pa brgyad du phye la/ lho'i grwa'i na gnas su de 92—633

bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs tshon 0)sna tshogs kyis bri'o/ /de nas byang gi grwar zhubri ba ni rdo rje'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor tshon rtsi sna tshogs kyis rnam par bkra bar bri'o / /de nas nub kyi grwar (babri ba ni nor bu'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor sna tshogs kyis rnam par bkra bar bri'o/ /de nas shar gyi grwar 0glang po che'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor tshon rtsi sna tshogs kyis rtag tu shin tu mdzes pa dang / shin tu gsal bar bri'o/ /shar phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi (gesgor ri bo po ṭa (6)la me tog dang shing ljon pa sna tshogs kyis legs par brgyan (7)pa ri'i lha dang bcas pa bri'o / /lho phyogs kyi sgor ri rab klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang nye dga' bos kun nas dkris pa dang / sum cu rtsa (shegasum pa'i ris kyi lha bri'o/ /byang phyogs kyi sgor ni spos kyi ngad ldang dri za'i tshogs kyis gang ba shing ljon pa sna tshogs kyis shin tu mdzes pa bri'o/ /nub phyogs kyi sgor ri ti (1)se lha rnams kyi gnas me tog sna tshogs dang / 'khri 1 skushing dang / shing ljon pa sna tshogs mchog gis rtag tu gang ba bri'o/ /legs par 3lhazin nas kun tu ni mdung rtse gsum pa'i bar phreng ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su de bzhin gshegs pa dang / rdo rje'i rigs nyid gzhag go/ /nor bu'i rigs su de bzhin gshegs pa gzhag cing de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs dang / thams cad du (1 rdo rje 'dzin pa bzhag na spyi'i rigs 'grub lha po/ /lha mo sgrol ma ni ri bo po ṭa bol la gzhag go/ /ri rab la ni gos dkar mo'o/ /dpe med ma ni 12nyi se'i rtse mor ro/ /sgrol ma bdun ni spos kyi ngad ldang sal gzhag go/ /shar phyogs kyi sgor pho nya mo zhi ba pho nya mo hu tshobadun gyis yongs su bskor ba'o/ /lho phyogs kyi sgor ni srin mo ral pa gcig ma nyushesrin mo bdun gyis 37yongs su bskor ba'o/ /nub phyogs kyi sgor rdo rje lu gu rgyud zhu 92—634

lu gu rgyud 6)bdun gyis yongs su bskor ba'o/ /byang phyogs kyi sgor khro gnyer can mo khro gnyer can bdun gyis yongs su bskor ba'o/ /de nas 'jigs (mipa med pas mgon po 'jig rten gyi bla ma'i gzugs gser gyi mdog can ring bsrel 6)dang ldan pa don yod pa'i rgyal po rnam par 'phrul pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi snying po pad+ma rgya chen po'i dkyil 'khor du gzhag par bya'o/ /grwar (4)rgyal po chen po bzhi stobs po che go cha bgos (5)pa/ drag shul gyi gzugs can/ mtshon cha 'bar ba thogs pa gzhag par bya'o/ /gang zhig thub pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi (6stesprul pa/ spyi'i rigs yang dag par 'byung ba/ don yod pa'i rgyal po rnam par dzo ni'aphrul pa/ 'jig rten dbang phyug mchog sbyin pa dang bcas pa/ don yod pa'i (kyizhags pa rnam par 'phrul pa bsgrub pa'i ched du cho ga sna tshogs dran par 99bya'o / /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /rnam thar dkyil 'khor de nyid ni/ /legs par bsgrubs 7pa mthong tsam dang / /bklags 37pas dngos grub bla med 'gyural/ /de bas rtag tu 'bad pa yis32/ /sgrub 9/snyepar byed pa mi mimakhas so/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gtsang mar gyur pa shin tu khrus byas pa gos gtsang ma bgos pas dar dang ba dan sna tshogs bzang pos dkyil 'khor brgyan par bya'o/ /ro bro ba'i mchog rgya chen pos snod sna tshogs legs par bkang ba dang / gser dang dngul gyi snod du mchod yon dbul gezhing ro sna tshogs kyi gtor ma gzhag par bya'o/ /yide bzhin du hu 'bras bu sna tshogs gzhag par bya'o/ /gzugs rnam pa 3)sna tshogs pa'i kha zas kyi gtor ma yang bsgrub bo/ /me tog sna tshogs bkram zhing gtor ma sna tshogs kyis bkang ba dang / bum pa dang / rdze'u 19dang / phor zlum dang / kham phor 2 tshodang / dbyib du lhamo dag kyang dgang ngo / /92wa 635

kun du dri chus bsgos pa yi/ /rgya chen gtor ma kun du'o/ /sna tshogs pa yi pog phor nas/ /sna tshogs bdug spos (1nodabul ba ni/ /a ga ( ru dang /tsan+dan dang / spro ris ka dang / du ru ska (4)dang / kun tu ru dang / gu gul dang / sgron shing dang / shri beṣ+ṭa 55)ka dang / sa ra dang / sa ra dza ra sa dang / de bzhin du ga bur dang / gla rtsi dang / gur gum 'dang / sha kha ra'i (7)bdug spos rina'adi dag ni rab tu phul/ thams cad du sgrub pa bla na med pa yin no/ /sna tshogs pa yi dri dag dang / /phye ma byug 9)pa sna tshogs nyid/ /shes rab can gyis kun tu ni/ /dkyil 'khor dag la gzhag par bya/ /lha rdzas kyi rin po che sna bdun gyi me tog dang / dngul gyi me tog dang / zangs kyi me tog dang / byi ru dang ni mu tig dang / / in+d+ra nī ri la dag dang ni/ /pad+ma rā ga 1nyedag kyang ngo / /gser dang dngul gyi bum pa rin po che sna bdun can yang grwa 1gebazhir gzhag par bya'o/ /'bras yos dang / yungs kur dang bsres pas dkyil 'khor 1 kun du gtor ro/ /kun nas me tog phreng ba ni/ /rmad byung dkyil 'khor la gzhag cing / /kun nas mar me'i phreng ba yang 1 / /dkyil 'khor rmad du byung la bzhag /rig sngags 'chang nyin zhag gcig 15gnas par gyur pas yang bzlas brjod rgya cher byas la cho gas bsrung 17ba dang /phyogs bcing ba 17dang / kun nas dkyil 'khor bcing ba byas la dkyil 'khor gyi las bya'o/ /de nas slob ma gzhug 18par bya ste/ bla ma mkhan po'am/ slob dpon nam/ pha'am/ rgyal po'am/ blon po chen po la dam tshig dang / phyag rgya dang / dkyil 'khor gsang ba bstan te/ mgon po 'jig rten gyis 17bla ma mthong zhing dkyil 'khor rmad du byung ba mthong nas phyag bya zhing mchod pa dang /92—636

me tog dang / bdug spos dbul ba (1)byas la bskor ba bya'o52/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis thams cad la byams pa'i sems mnyam par bzhag ste/ skyil mo krung (gyibacas nas 'dug la mi smra bar ya mtshan du snang bar mthong gi bar du (4)don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po bzlas brjod byas la dkyil 'khor kun tu khro bo'i rgyal pos lan brgya rtsa brgyad dbang bskur zhing (5)yungs kur dang / chu dang me tog gis dkyil 'khor kun tu lan brgya rtsa brgyad gtor ba'i mod la rtag tu phyag rgya lan brgya rtsa brgyad (skubacings la dkyil 'khor kun 577tu me tog dang /bdug spos dang / dri phul nas mgon po 'jig rten dbang phyug don yod pa'i zhags pa mthong na don yod pa nyid mchod par bya'o/ /de nas mgon po phyag na rdo rje dang / rig sngags kyi rgyal po bla na med pa mchod pa byed do/ /de nas lha mo sgrol ma dang / kun du lha mo thams cad la'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad la'o/ /de nas ri'i rgyal po rnams la gnas pa'i ri'i lha thams cad la'o / /thams cad dang sgo srungs (87la rtag tu mchod pa bya'o/ /de nas phyogs bzhi (94)kun du rig sngags 'chang gis rtag tu mchod nas skyil mo krung sna tshobacas te 'dug la 'jigs pa med pas lag pa'i phyag rgya bcing bar /rtabya'o/ /byams pa'i sems dang snying rje'i lhag pa'i bsam pa nyid kyis don yod pa'i zhags pa rtag tu dran par bya zhing sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa bsgom 1 mo/ /gsang sngags brjod ma thag tu dkyil 'khor dang sa gzhi g.yo zhing gang dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa'i mod la snying dga' ba dang / sems bde ba 'thob 12bo/ /'od zer bye ba kha dog sna tshogs rnam par bkra ba mi)'byung zhing dkyil 'khor gyi snying po na don yod pa'i zhags pa ma'agul bar 'gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi snying po 'bar bar 'gyur/92—637

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / de bzhin du phyag na rdo rje 'bar bar 'gyur / dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i lha dang 0)lha mo thams cad 'bar bar 'gyur / lha g.yo bar 'gyur zhing dkyil 'khor kun nas legs so zhes sgra grag ②par 'gyur ro/ /de nas ji ltar gser bkod pa de ltar dbus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi snying po dang / mgon po de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa dang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi rdo nidabang phyug dang / phyag na rdo rje dang / sgrol ma dang /dkar mo gser gyi mdog gis bkod pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi sprinang nas bzhengs par 'gyur/ sku gser mdog can gzugs bzang pos bdag nyid kyi (5)rang gi ngo bo ston pa snang bar 'gyur/ phyogs bcu kun du rtag tu 6rigazigs par 'gyur ro/ /thams cad du rtag tu sems brtan 97)por bya ste/ rig sngags 'chang byams pa dang bcas pa'i sems brtan por gyur pas me tog dang rol mo'i sgra dbul zhing don yod pa'i rgyal po yang dran par bya'o/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pas phyag gser gyi mdog can brkyang stetsho 8)/ rig sngags 'chang gi spyi bor bzhag nas legs so zhes bya ba sbyin par mdzad cing rig sngags 'chang khyod kyis don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po dang / cho ga zhib mo mtha' dag dang /dkyil 'khor dang / phyag rgya 59)rim par phye ba grub ste/ skyes bu dam pa khyod bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi nyu )khams su lung bstan gyis /storang gi ngo bo nyid kyis yongs su dag nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas kyi bar du skyes bu dam pa khyod rang gi ngo bo phyir mi ldog pa dang / don yod pa'i rig sngags 'chang gi yige'akhor los sgyur 3 bar 'gyur bar byos shig /dkyil 'khor 'di la brten mipa'i skye bo dge ba dang lhag pa'i bsam 92—638

pa la zhugs pa/ sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i mya ngan las 'das par lung bstan gyi bar du phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro/ /ji (1༄ste sems can ngan pa rig sngags kyi gdol pa smad ②pa dag der zhugs na gzugs brnyan las khrag 'dzag cing sgra mi zad (9pa 'byung ste/ mgon po 'di mi mthong / sa 'di g.yo (4)bar mi 'gyur/ dkyil 'khor 'di 'bar bar mi 'gyur te/ de'i tshe rig sngags 'chang la rmi lam du ston te de nyid kyang gzhan du mi 'gyur ro/ /ji 55)ltar mngon sum pa (6)de bzhin du rmi lam du (7)ston cing yid (8)la bsams po)pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro⑩/ /de lta bas na rig sngags 'chang gis (17legs par brtag nyugecing so sor brtags tenyusnye/ sems can dkyil 'khor du zhugs skipar bya'o/ /sgrub pa po bden par smra ba dang / dbang po yang dag par bsdams pa/ sems can thams cad la byams pa/ sems can thams cad la brtse 8ba can/ gzhan la yang dag par smra ba/ tshig brtags pa dad pa can/gus pa dang ldan pa nyid/ mar 'dzin pa/ phar 'dzin pa/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song ba yirtag tu bla ma la gus pa nyid kyi sems can 'di dag gzhug nyu par bya'o/ /rab tu bag yod pa dang / rtag tu gtsang zhing gtsang sbra dang ldan pa dang / kha zas ngan pa dang / lhag ma dang / 'bags pa dang 'dres pa dang / kha (snyegacig tu bsres tsho pa dang / chung zad shu bkrus pa dang /chang dang / sha dang / kun (1dong dang / sgog skya dang / ke'u 2dang bsres pa'i kha zas dag spang bar bya zhing / rang gi kha 'phro yang spang bar bya'o/ /lhag ma ni rtag tu spang bar bya ste/ 'di dag sgrub pa'i cho ga la dran par bya'o/ /lag pa 'bags pas gdong la reg par mi bya/ lhung bzed dor bar mi bya'o/ /92—639

rtag tu kha ma phyed phyed du gcod pa dang / mchog tu 'bags pa 'di dag nam yang bza' bar mi bya'o/ /gtsang mas zas gtsang ma bza' zhing lag pa'i sor mo bsdams pas kha gdong la sogs 6)pa la mi reg par 'di dag za ba nyid ni mchog tu mdzes shing blo dang ldan pa yin no/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis las shin tu yongs su rdzogs par byas shing dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba legs par rdzogs na de la khrag 'dzag rinapar mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi da phyag brkyang 54)bas rig sngags 'chang gi 55)lag pa nas bzung dzinas dkyil 'khor gyi nang du 'jug par mdzad cing shin tu (7)dri ma med par snang ba zhes bya ba'i nor bu nyid kyi mgul rinapa nas bkrol nyute rig sngags 'chang gi mgul 1 du 'dogs /lhapar mdzad 12do/ /spyi bor phyag 'jog par mdzad cing 'di la sras kyi thu bo zhes gsung ngo / /mgul par nor bu bcings pa tsam gyi mod la de nam mkha' la 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi spyi'i rigs kyi nyu gsang ba'i dam tshig dang dkyil 'khor mthong bar 'gyur ro1 / /byang chub kyi snying po la thug gi bar du rigs thams cad du don yod pa'i rig 5sngags 'chang gi rgyal po 'khor los sgyur tshabar 'gyur ro/ /don yod pa'i rgyal po'i cho ga zhib mo dang / dkyil 'khor chen po rtag tu mngon du 'gyur zhing rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo nyid smin mtshams na 'dug par 'gyur ro/ /rgya chen po dri ma 17med par snang ba don yod pa'i ye shes rnam par 'phrul 18pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin 'thob 19ste/ gang ting nge 'dzin rjes su thob pas 'jig rten pa thams cad kyi dngos grub rnam par 'phrul pa'i cho 'phrul ston par 'gyur ro/ /phyag rgya dang / dkyil 'khor dang / cho ga zhib mo dang / sgrub pa dang /92wa 640

dam tshig dang / gsang ba thams cad kyi mthu chen po ston par 'gyur ro/ /don yod pa chen po'i 'khor los sgyur (1)ba'i rnam par 9mi'aphrul pa thams cad ston par 'gyur ro/ /don yod pa'i dam tshig gi byin gyis brlabs nya /nodang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba'i dam tshig mtha' yas pa thob 4riste/ gang dam tshig thob pas dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig dang mtshungs par shes par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dam tshig mnyam pa nyid kyi (gernam par 'phrul pa ston par 'gyur ro/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang (phyiradakyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i bya ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byas nas spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ring bsrel (7)dang bcas pa de yang sa phyogs dben pa'i gnas gtsang mar gos gtsang ma'i gdan 8)bshams la de'i steng du gzhag par bya'o / /a ga ru'i bdug spos 'bul zhing nyin gcig bzhin du nang par sngar gzhan mi smra bar bzlas brjod brgya rtsa brgyad bya ste/ rig sngags kyi rgyal pos mchod pa dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gzugs brnyan 'bar bar 'gyur te9ri/ nyin gcig bzhin du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 1 )gzugs brnyan smra bar 'gyur lha/ tshig 'byin par 'gyur ro/ /da tu ltar gyi bzhin du de thams cad smra bar 'gyur te/ dge ba dang / mi dge ba dang / 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i 8de thams cad smra bar 'gyur ro/ /tshe ring ba'am/ tshe yongs su zad pa de thams cad ston cing smra bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po brje 1 ba'am/ dgra 'thab pa'am / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs 'thab pa'am/ lo nyes pa dang / mi ngas rkidang / dgon pa dang / nad dang / na ba dang / gdon gludang / gnod 92wa 641
