pa dang / 'tshe ba dang / grang ba dang / rlung dang / tsha ba dang / ser ba dang / chom po'i 'jigs pa dang / rkun po'i 'jigs pa dang / gcan gzan (1)gtum po'i 'jigs pa dang / sbrul gdug pa'i 'jigs pa dang /bde ba dang / lo legs pa dang / 'bras bu 'phel ba dang / 'bru 'phel ba de thams cad smra bar 'gyur zhing de'i thabs thams cad kyang rab tu ston par 'gyur ro/ /rig nasngags 'chang la nyin gcig bzhin du khyad par du gyur pa rnam pa mang po rab tu ston par 'gyur ro/ /kha cig la bstan ①par mi bgyi ste/sdang sems can rig sngags kyi gdol pa rkun ma/ byas pa mi gzo (༄ba/ brlang (5)ba / 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la 'khu ba/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la 'phrog pa / bslab pa mi 'chi'adod pa dang yang dag par ldan pa de dag gi lag tu bstan par mi bgyi/ rna bar bsgrags 3)par mi bgyi/ skra'i rtse mo tsam du snang ba yang bstan par mi bgyi'o/ /cho ga zhib mo 'di ni yi ge'i 'bru gcig tsam yang 6)bstan par mi bgyi'o/ / rjes su 'jug par mi bgyi'o/ /6)de nas rig sngags 'chang bodangos grub mchog thob par 'gyur te/ mchog tu yid brtan pa/ rnam par thar pa mchog gi dkyil 'khor gsang ba thob par 'gyur ro/ /gang gi drung nas rig sngags kyi rgyal po'i rig sngags kyi dkyil 'khor chen po lag tu 'thob par 'gyur ba de la ston pa dang / bla ma'i 'du shes bskyed 67par bgyid/bdag dang 'dra bar mchod pa sna tshogs kyis gus par bgyid na bdag la gus pa dang bla mar bgyis 12pa lags/ mchod pa dang rjed sna pa bgyid pa lags so/ /de lta bas na dad pa'i rjes su 'brang bas byams pa bsgoms skopa dang / snying rje bskyed pas dngos grub chen po 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /ji ste bgyi ba 'di las 92—642

'da' bar mi bgyid pa'i sems can de la bdag gis rtag par rgyun mi 'chad hunyepar dran pa dang / bdag brjod pa tsam gyis rang gi shin tu yongs su dag pa'i rang gi ngo bos bdag mdun na mchis par bgyi zhing yid la re ba thams cad dang mchog yongs su rdzogs par bgyi'o/ /ji (2ste bdag ji ltar dam bcas pa las gzhan du bgyid (5)na bdag gis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag la bslus pa lags so/ /rig sngags kyi gdol pa rkun mar gyur pa la ni mi bgyid de/ dam bcas pa bzhin gdu smra bar mi bgyid de/ rig sngags 'chang gis rtag tu gtsang bar bgyi(snye/ rtag tu 'dzum pa dang / rtag tu byams pa dang / snying rje sgom 96tshopa yid la bgyid na/ de la bdag zhi)gis rtag tu yon tan phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'thob (85par 'gyur bar bgyi/ de dge ba'i spyod pa thams cad dang ldan par bgyi/ don yod pa yangs pa chen po'i dngos grub rjes su stsal bar bgyi'o / /sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bgyi ba la/ rgya mtsho'i dus rlabs 59)ltar thams cad kun tu mchi bar bgyi'o/ /ngan song dang / ngan 'gro dang / log par ltung ba thams cad yongs su zad par bgyi ba'i slad du bdag dga' bas kun tu mchi bar bgyi'o/ /sems can gang la byams pa dang / snying rje mchis pa'i sems can pha rol de rnams kyi bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa yongs su rdzogs par bgyi'o/ /de lta 7bas na rig sngags 'chang gis shin tu sdom pas bsdams shing /lharig sngags brjod par bgyi'o//yongs su gtong ba'i lag par bgyi zhing spar chums 12par mi bgyi ste/ lag pa brkyang bar bgyi'o/ /gtong ba mang bas de bzhin gshegs pa 1 dam tshig la gnas par bgyi'oge/ /sngar legs par spyad par bgyi ste/ don yod pa'i rgyal 92—643

po'i spyad pa bgyi zhing rtag tu yid la bgyi'o/ / de nas 0)bdag dang chos kyi mchog la dga' ba zhes bgyi'o/ /rang gi gzugs brnyan bya ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'o// // de nas po khro bo'i rgyal po bshad par bya ste/ don yod rgyal po rmad byung cheri ni / /kun tu dngos grub thogs med cing / /dkyil 'khor kun la dbang bskur ba/ /sdang ba thams cad rab tu 'joms/ /bdud dang bgegs ni rnam par 'jig /gnod sbyin srin po gsang ba pa/ /'byung po thams cad rab tu 'bros / /gdon gyi gtso bo skrod byed cing / /sdang ba thams cad rab tu 'joms / /sdang ba'i klu 90rnams rnam 'jig cing (5)/ / 'jigs phongs ⑥rnams la mi 'jigs stsol/ /rig 'dzin rnams la grub stsol ba/ /don yod zhags pa'i dngos grub mchog /dus gsum gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas ston/ /spyi yi rigs ni rab ston pa/ /don yod spyi yi gsang ba ni/ /rtag tu gzhan min snying po nyid/ /khro bo'i rgyal po bla med pa/ /de ni bdag gis rab tu bshad/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug don yod pa'i rgyal pos khro bo'i gzugs su gnas te sdang ba thams cad 'jigs par byed par gyur cing lag na zhags pa thogs te khro bo 'di smras so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa ra badz+ra dha re bh+yaḥ57ri/ oṃ tsa ra tsa ra/ tsu ru tsu ru/ ma hā kā ru ṇi 8༄ka /tsi ri (9)tsi ri/bi ri bi ri/ ma hā pad+ma hastang/ ka la ka /nyal/ ku lu ku lu/ ma hā s+thā ⑩ma mā /snopa tes/ tsa ra tsa ra/ tsa 7tsa ra ni yishā tsa re/ shwa (1 ra e h+ye yoshenyi/ burgyu 92—644

busgru 0)blu ba ②ṅgā ba/ ki ṇi ki ṇi/ ( pa ra ma shud+dha gosatwa/ ka ra ka ra/ ki ri ki ri/ ma hā pa shu pa ti/ be (5)ga dha ra/ hā hā tī tī hū 'i(6ni/ oṃ (7)ka ra brah+ma be (2)ga dha ra/ sa ra sa ra/ ba ra ba ra/ ba ra rasmi sha ta sa ha sra/ pra phyi)ti maṇ+ḍi ⑩ta/ sha rī rā (7ya/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ su ru su ru/ mu ru mu ru/ sa na ta ‘/2ku mā (snyer/ ru dra yibargyu bā yis bayi/ dha na dā 3/ ṛ ṣi nā yo ya ka /ba lho hu bi bi dha/ be ṣa du shādha ra/ dha ra dha ra/ sa man+ta a ba lo ki ( kāta/ bi lo ki ta( snye / lo ke shwa 6)ra/ ma he (steshā ra/ mu ya mu ya/ muñtsa muñtsazhe snye/ brnya brta(9 / tā ḍa zhunyan ta ra dza na/ rā (nyedza ta ska ra/ asdi u da ka /bi ṣa shasta 9 ṇipa ri mo ( )tsa ka /ka ṇa (7ka ṇa/ tsa la tsa la/ bo dh+ya 82ngag /tsa tsho tu rā r+ya sa t+ya saṃ dpra kā sha ku(ste /ta ma ta ma/ sa ma sa ma/ 8nyam sa ma satsho rme/ ma hā ta mo3 na zhu dha kā ( mer/ pra sha ma na/ mi li mi li/ e ne ya tsho )/ tsarma 1pa ri ka ra / e 4 h+ye hi/ ma ṭa 4lhem ri )(/ bi shud+dha bi ṣa ya/ ni bā si na/ ma hā kā ru ṇi ka /shwe (geta yasna nyapa bī ri 7ta/ rat+na ma ku ṭa mā nya' dha ra/ sarba dz+nyā rteshi ra si kṛ ri )ta/ ka ra pu ṭa/ sa mā dh+ya nuḥpra rka pya/ gaṅgā 5ger mi tā rte/ pa ri pū 5 rmer ka rigam hā/ sarba satwa 5zhesan+ta ti ba ri pā tsa ka /sarba mā s+t+waṃ ra (snyeduṣ+ṭa pra mardo 56ka /sarba sirnyi sdo rimā shā pa ri pū ra ka /a bhi ṣiñtsi sngonatu mānardzorte/ sarba ta thā ga tā gi ṣe kai sngo ra/ bha ga bān4ste/ a mo gha rā 62dza hūm̐ yiphaṭa/ na maḥstu ri te swā hā / khro bo'i rgyal po don yod pa'i zhags pa'o/ /oṃ dzinabi kṛ sdo(ta rdarje / a mo gha rdzunas ma ye ges bi ṣiñtsa rmā / sarba bibyā ges mo gha a bhe ṣe larka ra thu: mi li mi li swā hā/ de khro bo'i ngargyal po'i snying po'o/ /de nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi dzo)don yod pa chen po'i snying po gsungs ma thag tu de nas 92wa 645

ri chen po po ṭa 51)la rnam pa (ri drug tu rab tu g.yo bar brtsams te/ klu'i tshogs ni 'khrugs so/ /lha'i (5)tshogs thams cad ni lidaga' bar gyur to⑤/ /sdang ba'i gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / bgegs dang / log 96)'dren ni 'bar bar gyur to/ /bdud la sogs pa sdang ba ni yang dag par rab tu zhi bar gyur to/ /ngan song gi sdug bsngal thams cad ni rab tu zhi'o/ /dkyil ⑦'khor gyi lha thams cad ni mchog tu dga' bar 'gyur ro8/ /sdang ba dang /rab tu snang ba thams cad dang / gdon 59)thams cad ni mi snang bar gyur to/ /nad thams cad ni rab tu zhi'o/ /rims thams cad tshalas ni rnam par grol lo//nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa thams cad las ni yongs su grol lo/ /me tog gi char chen po rab tu bab ste 11de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod par gyur to/ /sems can thams cad ngan song gi sdug bsngal thams cad las yongs su grol bar gyur to / /de nas dus gsum du gshegs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dang / dkyil 'khor la brten 12pa'i lha rnams kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la tshig gcig tu 1nyelegs so zhes bya ba byin te legs so legs so/ /snying rje chen po can mchog du don yod pa'i rig sngags 'di smras zin gyis 1 de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs thams cad dang /rigs spyi'i dam tshig dang / snying po dang / khro bo'i de kho na nyid gsang ba dang / dkyil 'khor dang / sgrub tshapa'i cho ga don yod pa'i rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor rab satu smros shig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis tsho1 3don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po khro bo'i rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan sngar bshad do/ /92—646

dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa shin tu mdzes pa ko la'i tshad tsam shin tu rnam par 1)mdzes pa'i grwa (mibazhi dang / sgo bzhi dang / them skas bzhi dang / rta babs dang / mda'i kha khyer dang / kun nas (kyerdo rje'i rnam pa dag kyang bya ste/ tshon rtsi sna tshogs rnam par mdzes pa'i thig skud kyis dkyil 'khor thig gdab par bya'o / /ri mo mkhan gtsang mas snod sar (gepa dang pir gtsang mas dkyil 'khor dam pa legs par bri'o(5)/ /dkyil 'khor snying po rnam dbye ba/ /dbus su legs pa 96)rnam phye la/ /kun nas pad+ma'i phreng ba 3)dang / /rdo rje mdung rtse gsum pa dgod/ /dbus su 'khor lo rta bri ba/ /shin tu blta ri sdug 'khor lo dgod / /dbus dar 57༄rgyal ba gzhag par bya/ /shākya'i 1 rgyal po de bzhin gshegs / /g.yas su khro bo'i rgyal po yi/ /'jig rten dbang phyug 'dren pa po/ /g.yon du rdo rje 'dzin bzhag pa/ /rnga yab rdo rje lag thogs gzhag /de'i 'og tu 'od zer dang ldan par bya ba ni lcags kyu dang / dgra sta dang / go cha dang / dbyug pa dang / zhags pa dang / dgra sta lu gu rgyud can dang /mdung rtse gsum pa dang / glegs bam mo/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi 'og tu dkar sham chen mo dang / gos dkar mo dang / dkar mo chen mo ral pa can dang / dbyug pa dang / ril ba spyi blugs phyag na thogs pa bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu srin mo ral pa gcig ma zhes bya ba ni mche ba gtsigs pa nyunya'ajigs su rung zhing mi sdug pa sbrul se ral khar thogs pa/ phyag bzhi pa/g.yas pa na rdo rje dang dgra sta/ g.yon pa'i sor mo gcig lha ma yin dang log 'dren la bsdigs shing sna khrag 'dzag pa'i mgo'i 12co to nas 'dzin pa dang /khrag gi snod yongs su 'dzin pa/ glang po che'i pags 7pa rlon pa'i stod g.yogs 92—647

'phyang ba dang / smad g.yogs can bya'o/ /mtha'i grwar 0)pad+ma dang rdo rje bzhag pa ni 'bar ba'i phreng ba can shin tu bzang po gzhag par bya'o/ /shar phyogs kyi sgor rdo rje 'jigs byed mig de'i sku 'bar ba'i phreng ba can gzhag par bya'o/ /lho phyogs kyi sgor ki li tshonadakyi la rin zhes bya ba'i rdo rje'i log 'dren de nyid rdo rje dang /dgra sta dang / zhags pa phyag na thogs par bya'o/ /nub phyogs kyi sgor pad+ma chen po'i rigs mdzes cam zhes bya ba'i pho nya mo bya ba ni/ phyag na pad+ma thogs par bya'o/ /byang phyogs kyi sgor rdo rje chen po'i rtse mo zhes bya ba'i cho gas (2rdo rje dang zhags pa phyag na ridzinathogs pa'o/ /de nas 'jug pa'i sgor tsan+dan gyi chu gur gum 7chodang / gla rtsi dang / ga bur gyis bsgos pa'i chus bum pa bkang la ras dkar pos dkris na shing rgyan gyis brgyan 9 pa rin po che sna bdun can rtag tu gzhag par bya'o/ /ji snyed 1 pa'i gtor ma sna tshogs yongs su bshams pas kyang mchod par bya/ rnam pa sna tshogs pas dkyil 'khor legs par brgyan par bya'o//bdug spos kyis bkang ba dang / mar me'i phreng ba dang / me tog dang / dri dang / byug 11pas mchod par bya'o/ /ji srid 'jug gi bar du slob ma rnams cho gas bsrungs sna la/ de nas don yod pa'i snying po bzlas brjod bya zhing don yod pa'i khro bos dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /dbang bskur ba tsam gyis kyang dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis yongs su gzung bar 1 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten gyi mgon po'i byin gyi rlabs sakyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs thams cad kyi dam tshig gi rjes su zhugs par 'gyur ro/ /don yod pa'i zhags pa'i rigs kyi dam tshig dang / dngos grub thams cad mngon du 'gyur ro/ /gang bsams skapa dang gang bcol ba de thams cad 'byor bar 'gyur ro/ /de 92—648

bzhin du dam tshig thams cad kyi rjes su zhugs par 'gyur ro/ /dam tshig dang /dkyil 'khor dang / gsang sngags dang / phyag rgya 1dang / cho ga zhib mo thams cad mngon du 'gyur ro/ /sdig pa dang / gdug pa dang / las kyi sgrib pa thams cad las rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan thams cad dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /lha dang / lha ma yin dang /klu rigedang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / gsang ba pa dang / rig sngags 'chang gi gnas du phug dri ma med pa dang nam mkha'i rjes su rgyu ba dang / chu na rgyu ba dang / nags dang / skyed 4mos tshal na spyod pa'i rig sngags 'chang gi 'khor los sgyur (5)ba'i drug cha la thams cad du dbang du 6'gyur ro/ /gsang ba pa 57)thams cad kyang 'di'i mngag gzhug 8par 'gyur ro/ /gang zhig de la mi phan par 'dod pa'i lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang /lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye 9chen po dang / mi dang / mi ma yin pa gang rig sngags 'chang la mi phan par sems pa de thams cad kyi de dag gi gnas dang lus nyid rnam par gzhig pa'i phyir sdig pa rnams 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /de nas dngul las 1 khro bo'i rgyal po sor bcu gnyis kyi 11tshad tsam byas te/ shin tu mdzes pa/ shin tu tshad dang ldan pa/zhal gsum pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs kyis brgyan cing 1 rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ rgyal ba 'od dpag tu med pa'i dbu rgyan can/ zla ba dbu la thogs pa/ zhal dang po khro bo'i gzugs g.yon pa dang g.yas pa zhi ba'i gzugs zhal cung zad 'dzum pa/ spyan gsum pa/ phyag bzhi pa/ pad+ma 'dzin pa/zhags pa 'dzin pa/ ral gri dang mdung rtse gsum pa 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yas su 92wa 649

lha mo sgrol ma me tog 'bul ba/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /g.yon du lha mo rig sngags kyi (1)rgyal mo nor bu rin po che chen po 'bul ba/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /'jig rten dbang phyug gi zhabs kyi drung du rig sngags 'chang pus mo btsugs du pa/ lag na pog phor dang bgrang phreng thogs te bcom ldan 'das la blta'o/ /gzugs brnyan de nyid kyi mdun du tsan+dan dkar po'i dkyil 'khor bya zhing gur gum (bgyis mchod pa bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor de'i steng du khro bo'i rgyal po bzhag ste/ de'i spyan sngar bzlas brjod stong phrag brgya (gebya'o/ /de nas gzugs brnyan de 'gul zhing g.yo bar 'gyur/ 'chag par 'gyur/'od zer 'byung bar 'gyur/ tshig 'byin par 'gyur/ legs so zhes bya ba sbyin par 'gyur/ phyag g.yas pa spyi bor 'jog par tshoge'agyur/ yid la bsams (phyi pa dang mchog thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags 'chang (7)de yang bdag nyid 'bar bar 'gyur/ nam mkha' la 'phags par 'gyur zhing don yod pa yangs par snang ba/ dngos grub dri ma med par grags pa zhes bya ba'i rig sngags 'chang gi 'khor los sgyur (8)bar 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags 'chang gi 'khor los sgyur 9rib brgya stong phrag drug cu rtsa brgyad po rnams kyi gtso bo dang rgyal por 'gyur ro/ /tshe lha'i bskal pa khrag khrig brgya stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis su 'gyur ro/ /bskal pa'i mjug nya skurdzogs te de nyid kyi mtshan mo 'das pa dang / byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /ji ltar bde ba can bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams 'di gzhal med khang gi 17rnam par 'phrul par 'gyur zhing tshe'i tshad bskal pa dpag tu med par 'gyur ro/ /don yod pa'i rnam par thar pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / phyag rgya dang / cho ga zhib mo thams 92wa 650

cad kyi chos ston par 'gyur ro/ /de'i 'og tu 'jig rten pa'i sgrub pa ni de tinyid kyi spyan sngar bzlas brjod brgyad (gyistong bya'o/ /bzlas brjod rdzogs pa'i mod la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug khro bo'i rgyal po rang gi gzugs kyis mdun na bzhugs par 'gyur te/ 'jig rten pa'i cho ga zhib mo dang /gsang sngags dang / phyag rgya dang / dkyil 'khor thams cad dang / mig 'phrul dang / bzhad gagad dang / phur pas gdab pa tsho4)dang / bsreg (5)pa dang / 'phang ba dang / gsad (67pa dang / dbang du bya ba dang / sgyu ma bstan pa dang / bdag bsrung (7ba dang / gzhan bsrung (8)ba dang / mi snang ba'i cho ga smra ba dang / nor bsgyur 5rab smra ba dang / sa gzhi smra ba dang / rgyu ba dang / nam mkha' la 'gro ba dang / chu rgal ba dang / me dang / chu dang /dug dang / mtshon cha las rgal ba dang / rmongs byed dang / rmugs byed dang / rengs byed dang / bcing ba dang / rgya mtsho chen po bskyod pa dang /ro langs bslang ba dang / shi ba gso ba dang / zla ba dang nyi ma dbab pa dang /dgug pa dang / bden pa bstan pa dang / nad la sogs pa thams cad rab tu zhi ba dang / dgos pa thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /gnod sbyin dgug pa dang / srin po dgug pa dang / 'byung po dgug pa dang /7 klu dang lha dgug pa dang / bud med dang / skyes pa dang / khye'u dang / bu mo dgug pa dang / btang /steb dang / dgos pa la sogs pa thams cad 'grub 32par 'gyur ro/ /dran pa tsam gyi mod la dngos grub thams cad thob par 'gyur51she / las thams cad byed par 'gyur ro/ /bklags 7pa tsam gyis skilas dang / dngos grub dang / sgrub tshapa thams cad ston par 'gyur/ phyir rgol 92wa 651

ba dang / dgra dang / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs dang / 'thab pa dang / rtsod (1)pa dang / 'gyed pa dang / sdang ba'i sems can thams cad phyir zlog ②par 'gyur ro/ /dran pa tsam gyis mchog tu 'grub par 'gyur te/ skal ba ngan pa dang / nor chud za ba dang / mi ri sku'agrub pa dang / sdig pa'i rmi lam ngan pa dang / ltas ngan pa dang / sgrib pa dang / sdig pa gzhig par bya ba la mchog tu grub pa yin no/ /khro bo'i rgyal po'i zhabs nas bzung geste/ bzlas brjod stong tshon rtsa brgyad byas na sngon bsags pa'i bsod nams dang skal 6)ba mngon du 'gyur te/ tshe'i mthar thug gi bar du dpal chen po dang / che ba nyams su myong bar 'gyur ro/ /zhal du bltas te bzlas brjod stong rtsa brgyad byas na dbang phyug chen po'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro/ /rked pa'i gnas nas bzung 57riste/ bzlas brjod brgya 85rtsa brgyad byas na sngon gyi tshe rabs rjes su dran par 'gyur/ rgyal po btsun mo dang / 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dbang du gyur nas gnas te/ bdag nyid dang nor gyis ji srid 'tsho'i bar du nye bar gnas par 'gyur ro/ /cod pan la lan brgya rtsa brgyad yongs su bzlas te/khro bo'i rgyal po'i dbu la bcings na nges par dbang bskur ba 'thob par 'gyur te / 'di la the tsom 9dang yid gnyis bskyed par mi bya'o// //'phags pa don yod pa'i zhags pa'i cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po/ bam po nyi shu gcig pa/ de nas phyag na rdo rje don yod pa'i rdzu 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pa'i cho 'phrul gyi 'khor gyi 1 dkyil 'khor der nam mkha' las babs nas/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i mdun du bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa chen po dang /bkur sti mngon du byas te11/ bcom ldan 'das la lan brgya nyu2stong du bskor ba 92—652

byas nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byas nas phyag 'tshal te song nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gang na ba de (1)logs su song ste phyin nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la lha rdzas kyi (gemachod pa chen pos mchod pa byas so / /me tog dang / bdug spos dang / dri dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / gos dang / rgyan dang / lhab lhub dang / sil snyan dang / pheg rdob pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyis mchod nas lan bdun bskor ba bya ba da)byas so/ /ri po ṭa ( )la'i gzhal med khang riganon gnas pa'i lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po de dag gis kyang mchod pa byas so/ /dkyil 'khor gyi lha de dag la yang mchod pa byas so/ /'khor chen po de dag la yang mchod pa byas so / /lhan cig lhags pa'i 'khor de dag thams cad la yang mchod pa dang /mngon du bstod pa dang / phyag byas nas gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po phyag 6na rdo rje yud tsam zhig cang mi smra bar 'dug par ri gyur to/ /de nas gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po phyag ri na rdo rje 'gying 9dībag can/ brjid bag gi 'gros kyis langs nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de 7logs su song ste phyin nas rdo rje gsor zhing bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po 92—653

byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis phyag bgyis pa rnam par thar pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhib mo 'di shin tu zab pa/ shin tu rtogs par dka' btu)/rgya mtsho chen po lta bur shin tu zab pa/ ri rab chen po lta bur ②shin tu mi g.yo zhing mi skul (8)ba/ mchog tu rnyed par dka' ba shin tu gzung ④bar dka' ba'i phyag rgya mang po dang / gsang sngags mang po dang / dkyil 'khor sgrub pa mang po dang / ri mo'i 5)sku gzugs bri ba mang po dang / sgrub 4)pa gsang ba rnam pa mang po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa mang po dang /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi rnam par 'phrul pa don yod pa bklags ri pas 'grub par 'gyur ba mang po la bcom ldan 'das bdag mchog tu ya mtshan du gyur na ji ltar bsgrub par rngo thogs(she/ ji ltar nges par 59)gzung bar 1 rngo thogs 11lags/ gsang sngags 8tha dad pa dang / phyag rgya tha dad pa dang / dkyil 'khor sgrub sna pa tha dad pa dang / ras kyi ri mo'i sku gzugs tha dad pa dang / gtor ma tha dad pa dang / me tog dang / bdug spos dang /dri dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / mchod yon dang / zhabs bsil dang / spyan drang ba dang gshegs su gsol ba dang / dgug pa dang / dam tshig dang / khrus dang / smyung tshab dang / phyag rgya bcing ba dang / rab tu 'jug pa dang / bzlas brjod dang / sbyin sreg dang / slar (gshegs su gsol ba'amatsha/ nges par bzung ba'am 1 / dran par bgyi bar rngo thogs/nya/bcom ldan 'das rmongs pa chen po sems kyi spyod pa rmugs par gyur pa'i rigs kyi bu rnams sam19/ rigs kyi bu mo rnams sam/ dge slong ngam/ni ) dge slong ma'am / dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen 1ma'am/ dge sbyong ngaman bram 92wa 654

ze'am / rgyal rigs sam/ rje'u rigs sam/ dmangs 6)rigs kyis (5)rig sngags 'chang de rnams kyi (kyedon yod pa'i cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po 'di (4)nges par gzung (5)bar ji ltar rngo thogs4)/ rig sngags 'chang de rnams kyis ji ltar bsgrub par rngo thogs(7/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gi 58)snying la mchog tu ya mtshan skyes pa de dag bcom ldan 'das kyis the tshom bcad 59)pa'i slad du bka' stsal du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das the tsom bcad 1 tshopa'i slad du zhus pa lung bstan du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas/gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /lag na rdo rje dngos grub kyi spyod pa gsang ba rnam pa sna tshogs gsang sngags sgrub nyu7pa po bsgrub 42pa la gang gi tshe dngos grub las dbugs phyung ba de'i 18tshe blo gros thuchen po'i chen por 'bogs par 'gyur/ dngos grub chen po'i chen po ska'agrub par 'gyur/ bsod nams kyi phung po chen po'i chen po rab tu skye bar 'gyur / dge ba'i rtsa ba chen po'i chen po dang ldan par 'gyur/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi dngos grub chen po'i chen po 'thob par 'gyuras/ lag na rdo rjes 1 tshogasol pa/ bcom ldan 'das dngos grub gang gis bsgrub pa'i cho ga'i dngos grub 'thob par 'gyur ba'i dngos grub dam pa de gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lag na rdo rje gang la yungs kur gyi 'bru tsam gyi byang chub kyi dzishes bon gyi 'bras bu thob pa yod pa de la lag na rdo rje dngos grub dam pa mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /lag na rdo rje rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo'am49 / dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma'am / dge sbyong ngam/ bram ze'am/ rgyal rigs sam/ rje'u rigs sam/92wa 655

dmangs rigs sam/ gzhan gang 0)yang rung ba bud med dang / skyes pa dang /khye'u dang / bu mo gang gi lag tu de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i ring bsrel yungs kur gyi 'bru tsam gcig (27thob par gyur la des ring bsrel de za ma tog (7gi nang du bcug ste nyin gcig bzhin du mchod pa dang / dkyil 'khor dang / khrus la sogs pa byed cing byuthobadug pa dang / dri dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / 55 phye ma dang / gos dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dag gis mchod pa byed na lag na rdo rje rig sngags 'chang de dngos grub dam pa dang / mchog dang / bla na med pa 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /gang dang gang du dgos par sbyar ba de dang der dngos grub chen po mchog tu 'gyur ro56)/ /ring bsrel yungs kur gyi 'bru tsam zhig 57)la mchod pa byas pa de rigs kyi bu'am/rigs kyi bu mo'am/ dge sbyong ngam/ bram ze'am/(rinas rgyal rigs sam/ rje'u rigs sam/9 dmangs rigs sam/ gzhan bud med dam/ skyes pa'am/khye'u'am / bu mo 7de dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya (1stong phrag gang gā'i 15klung gi bye ma dang mnyam pa la skad cig 1lhagacig gis mchod pa byas par 'gyur/ rjed sapa dang / gus pa dang / bstod pa dang / phyag byas par 'gyur ro/ /'de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gi drung du dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed tshapar 'gyur1 / de dag gi /shedrung du bsod nams kyi phung po chen po dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gi drung du rigs kyi bu'am/rigs kyi bu mo'am/ dge slong ngam/1) dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/dge bsnyen ma'am/ gzhan gang su yang rung ba/ dge sbyong ngam/ bram ze'am/rgyal rigs sam/ rje'u rigs sam/ dmangs rigs sam/ skyes pa'am/92wa 656

bud med dam/ khye'u'am/ bu mo de dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyis byin gyis brlab (1)par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis lung bstan par 'gyur ro/ /shes rab dang / thabs la mkhas pa'i dge ba'i ( rtsa ba dpag tu med par 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags 'chang chen po'i dngos grub dpag tu med par 'gyur ro/ /don yod pa'i cho ga zhib mo'i dkyil 'khor dang / phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags kyi dngos grub dpag tu med pa 'thob (snopar 'gyur ro/ /don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis phyag byas pa rnam par thar pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po chen (4༄po'i rig sngags rim par phye ba'i dngos grub dpag tu med pa 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /lag na rdo rje de ltar ring bsrel yungs kur gyi 'bru tsam zhig 5gel mchod pa byed pa de yon tan chen po'i 6chen por brjod pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyi ri rdzu 'phrul gyi ting nge 'dzin 'thob par yang dag par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar dngos grub chen po'i 8chen po 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /de lta mod kyi lag na rdo rje khyod song la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la yongs su dris shig dang 99/ dris pa de'i lan ldon par 'gyur ro/ /de nas gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje dga' ba dang / mgu ba dang / yi khorangs pa dang / rab tu dga' ba dang / dga' ba dang /3rta yid bde ba bskyed 15nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos 1 phyag 'tshal te/ song nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gang na ba de logs su song ste phyin nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 92wa 657

'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi rkang pa gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te / lan gsum bskor ba zhi)byas nas bzhin 'dzum pa dang / gdong khro gnyer med pas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la mig mi 'dzums (snyepar lta ②zhing / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi mdun du 'dug nas rdo rje gsor zhing gdong du bltas te rtog cing 'dug go/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag (4)na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /lag na rdo rje khyod mi g.yo bar mdun du 'dug ste 55)rdo rje gsor zhing nga la ci zhig blta/ ci zhig yongs su dri bar 'dod/ ci zhig gsol ba 'debs par 'dod/ lag na rdo rje de nga la smros 6 shig /lag na rdo rje khyod la skabs phye'i (geyongs su dris shig dang / dris pa de thams cad lung bstan pas khyod kyi sems rangs par bya'o/ /de nas gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po phyag na rdo rjes byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bcom ldan 'das don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po'i cho ga zhib mo 8rishin tu rtogs par dka' ba shin tu zab pa/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis phyag bgyis pa/ rnam par thar pa'i dkyil 'khor gsang sngags mang po dang /phyag rgya mang po dang / dkyil 'khor sgrub 9)pa mang po dang / ras kyi sku gzugs bri ba mang po yongs su bsgrags pa 'di bcom ldan 'das ji ltar nges par gzung 1 bar nus/ dngos grub ji ltar shes par bgyi/ rgya mtsho chen po ltar zabs 31che ba/ ri rab dang mtshungs par mi g.yo ba/ nam mkha' ltar mtha' 1 thug pa /rim mchis pa/ shin tu rtogs gepar dka' ba/ 'di ji 7ltar 92—658

shes par bgyi/ gnas ni gang / 'gro ba ni gang / 'byung ba ni gang / sgrub pa'i gnas ni gang / dngos grub dam pa'i gnas ni gang / snga ma ni gang /phyi ma ni gang / dbus ni gang / tha ma ni gang lags/ mang (1du yongs su zhu'o / /dkyil 'khor dang phyag rgya rim par phye ba dang gsang sngags dang sgrub napa'i cho ga dang / dam tshig so so tha (gudad pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi 4 don yod pa'i rgyal po 5chen po'i cho ga zhib mo/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis phyag bgyis pa/rnam par thar pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po rim par phye ste rjes su gzung 6ba de nges par gzung ri7)bar ji ltar nus/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gi the tsom 8chen po dang / mchog tu ngo mtshar du gyur pa de thugs rje chen pos bdag la bka' stsal du gsol/ ji ltar grub na phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor rim par phye ba dang / ras kyi ri mo'i cho ga mtha' dag nges par gzung 9bar 'gyur ba/ the tsom bcad ṭa ripa'i slad du'o/ /sems dpa' chen pos bka' stsal du gsol/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po phyag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /lag na rdo rje yun ring po zhig 11nas spobs pa gang zhig tu skyes te/ nga la yongs su 'gri1ri/ lag na rdo rje nyon cig dang bshad par bya'o/ /gang yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi bzhing thams cad kyi masangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ni kha dog gcig pa/ rtags gcig pa/chos gcig la zhugs pa/ dbyings dang khams dang / snying po gcig pa/sangs rgyas 'byung ba dang / chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor ba gcig pa'o/ /92—659

de lta mod kyi lag na rdo rje gang 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa de dag ni sangs rgyas kyi zhing tsho1)sna tshogs pa nyid dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam par 'phrul pa dang / sku che'i 'du byed sna tshogs pa nyid dang / sems can yongs su smin par mdzad pa sna tshogs pa nyid dang / lung bstan pa sna tshogs pa nyid dang / nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi dge 'dun sna tshogs pa nyid dang / byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs sna tshogs pa nyid dang / gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyi sku tha dad pa nyid du yang dag par shes so/ /de lta mod kyi lag na rdo rje de bzhin du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi snying po don yod pa'i zhags pa byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis phyag byas pa/ rnam par thar pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di yang gcig nyid las de thams cad du rjes su 'gro'o/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam par 'phrul pa sna tshogs kyis rnam par 'phrul pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi du dngos grub kyi gnas dang / sems can yongs su smin par byed pa'i gnas/ bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa la ji lta ji ltar dul bar byed pa de lta de ltar dngos grub rjes su 'thob cing de lta de ltar bsam pa dag pa 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /de lta de ltar dge ba'i rtsa ba chen pos ( /bskyed par 'gyur ro/ /de lta de ltar bsod nams kyi phung po chen po dang (4 ldan par 'gyur ro/ /de lta de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 5 kyis dgongs par 'gyur ro/ /de lta de ltar byang chub sems dpa'i yul la rnam par 'phrul pa sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rdzu 'phrul gyi cho ne'aphrul dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /de lta de ltar gzungs dang / ting nge 'dzin yongs su dag par 7 'thob par 'gyur ro/ / de lta 58)de ltar dpa' bar 92—660

'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin dang /rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i dpung rgyan gyi ting nge 'dzin dang / nyon mongs pa spong ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi ting nge 'dzin dang /rnam par 'thor ba'i (1)ting nge 'dzin dang / 'od zer rab tu 'gyed pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang ge/ dga' ba spong ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / stobs bkod pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos la rnam par blta (7ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / lag na rin chen phyag rgya'i ting nge 'dzin dang / dri ma med pa'i 'byung gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin dang / rnam par snang mdzad kyi snying po'i ting nge 'dzin dang / nyi ma rab tu grol ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rin po che'i snying po'i tsho rating nge 'dzin dang / zla ba'i snying po'i ting nge 'dzin dang / kun du blta 95)ba'i 'od zer gyi ting nge 'dzin dang / chos kyi sgron ma'i ting nge 'dzin dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi spyi gtsug la rnam par blta tshone ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /yul la rnam par 'phrul pa kun du bkod pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / sgron ma 'bar ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chags pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang /phyir mi ldog pa'i 'byung gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin dang / zla ba rdzogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / shin tu rab tu gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / shin tu rab tu ri risangs rgyas pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / na 'gro ba yongs su dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / nyi ma kun du lta ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / yid gnyis yang dag par 'joms pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / kun du phyag rgya'i rnam pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / kun nas dkyil 'khor yongs su dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang /phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid la kun du lta ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / dkyil 'khor 92—661

yongs su dag pa yang gyodag par 'dzin pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / kun du lta ba'i 'od zer gyi ting nge 'dzin dang / pad+ma bkod pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang /don yod pa ( kun du lta ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / don yod pa dri ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / kun tu don yod pa dri ma med ( )pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rgya chen po dbugs 'byin pa don yod pa (4)rin po che'i ting nge 'dzin dang / dpung rgyan gyi 55ting nge 'dzin dang / dpung 6)rgyan 3)rgyal mtshan gyi ting nge 'dzin dang / rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i tshonasidapung rgyan gyi (9)ting nge 'dzin dang / sgrib pa thams cad rnam par dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang /don yod pa'i lcags kyu'i ting nge 'dzin dang / pad+ma'i lcags kyu'i ting nge 'dzin dang / dri ma med pa'i lcags kyu'i ting nge 'dzin dang / kun nas 'dren nya tshopa'i lcags kyu'i ting nge 'dzin dang / don yod pa'i 'od zer gyi lcags kyu'i ting nge 'dzin dang / kun du lta ba'i gzi brjid kyi ting nge 'dzin dang / rtogs pa dri ma med pa thob pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / kun du lta ba rab tu gsal ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rnam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang /ting nge 'dzin gyi gtso bo lnga bcu rtsa gnyis po 'di dag 'thob par 'gyur te/ting nge 'dzin re re la 11yang 'khor bye ba brgya nyurtastong phrag gang gā'i 1 klung gi bye ma dang mnyam pa de thams cad rjes su 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /lag na rdo rje don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po rnam par 'phrul pa sa'adi'i byin gyis brlabs dkyis kyang don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po klog pa dang / 'chang ba dang / brjod pa dang / sgrub pa dang / phyag rgya 'ching bas yon tan de dag 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /lag na rdo rje don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po 'chang ba dang /92wa 662

brjod pa dang / klog pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang / nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum dran par byed na 0)lag na rdo rje sems can de dngos grub don yod pa 'thob par 'gyur te/ rnam par 'phrul pa don yod pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa blta (5)ba don yod pa 'thob pa dang / gzungs don yod pa (gu'athob pa dang / ting nge 'dzin don yod pa 'thob pa dang / bsod nams sogs ri pa don yod pa 'thob pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i yul la rnam par 'phrul pa don yod pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i yul la rnam par 'phrul pa don yod pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyis rlabs kyi (5)rnam par 'phrul pa don yod pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs pa don yod pa dang / byang chub kyi snying por 'gro bar rirmedon yod pa dang / chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor ba don yod pa dang / phyir mi ldog pa'i gnas su 'gro ba don yod pa dang / blo rgyas pa don yod pa dang / shes rab zab mo rnam par 'phrul pa ri0don yod pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa bcu yongs su rdzogs pa don yod pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod pa dang / rim gro dang / bla ma dang 58)/ gus par bya ba don yod pa de'i (9)phyir lag na rdo rje don yod pa'i zhags pa zhes ming du gdags pa byas na 1 lag na rdo rje rig tshokāsngags 'chang rnams la ji ltar rmongs pa skye bar 12'gyur/ sems 'khrug nyu par 'gyur/dran pa dang blo gros rmongs par 'gyur te/ de'i gnas na sami snang na su zhig smra bar 8nus/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes ni don yod pa ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes gang yin pa de mdon yod pa nyu 7zhags pa'i ming du dmigs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ye shes ni don yod pa ste18/ ye 92wa 663

shes don yod pa gang yin pa de don yod pa'i zhags pa'i (1)ming du dmigs so/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi rnam par 'phrul pa ni 92)don yod pa ste/ sgyu ma lta bu gang yin pa de don yod pa'i zhags pa'o/ /ye shes gang yin pa de zhags pa'o/ /de la snying po'o5no/ /snying po gang yin pa de don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa 6 spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi snying po zhes don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po'i ming du dmigs so/ /gang yid la sems pa 7)dang / gang don du gnyer ba de thams cad 'dren par 'gyur/ 'gugs par 'gyur/ len par 'gyur te/ shin tu ring po nas kyang naye shes kyi zhags pas 'gugs nyu)par 'gyur ro/ /lag na rdo rje de bas na de don yod pa'i zhags pa'i misnying po'i ming du dmigs so/ /lag na rdo rje gang sis ting nge 'dzin 'di 'thob pa de la 47ji ltar rmongs pa skye bar 12'gyur/ blo dman par 'gyur te gnas 'di ni mi snang ngo / /lag na rdo rje gzhan yang gzungs kyi sgo du ma 'thob ste/ gang gis gzungs 'thob pa des don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po'i cho ga zhib mo tu 'di'i gsang sngags mtha' dag rdzogs pa dang / gsang sngags dang / phyag rgya dang /gsang sngags rim par phye ba dang / dkyil 'khor kha ton nyid du gnas te thams cad so sor khayang dag par shes so/ /'di lta ste don yod pa'i rgya mtsho zhes bya ba'i gzungs dang / don yod pa'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba'i gzungs dang /don yod pa'i pad+ma'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba'i gzungs dang / don yod par rab tu gnas pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs dang / don yod pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi za 92wa 664

ma tog ces bya ba'i gzungs dang / don yod pa lhun po'i snying po yangs pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs dang / don yod pa 0dri ma med pa'i pad+ma zhes bya ba'i gzungs dang / don yod pa'i 'od zer rab tu snang ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs dang /don yod pa'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba'i gzungs dang /don yod pa rnam par 'phrul pa'i 'od zer zhes bya ba'i gzungs dang / don yod pa'i phyag rgya zhes bya ba'i gzungs dang / don yod pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i gzungs dang / don yod pa narab tu gnas pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs dang /don yod pa yangs pa snang ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs dang / don yod pa'i dngos grub ces bya ba'i gzungs dang / don yod pa dri ma med pa'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba'i gzungs dang / don yod pa'i 87blo rgyas 4pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs dang /don yod pa'i 'bar ba'i phyag rgya zhes bya ba'i gzungs dang / don yod pa nyi ma'i snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi 5dkyil 'khor gsang ba don yod pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs 'thob ste/ gang gis gzungs de rnams thos 6 pa tsam gyis don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis phyag byas pa/rnam par thar pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags rim par phye ba'i dkyil 'khor mtha' dag rdzogs pa dang / gsang sngags dang / cho ga dang / cho ga zhib mo rgya chen po kha ton du 7gnas shing thams cad so sor na yang dag par shes te/ gang gis mthu 'di rab tu thob pa la nyarmongs pa skye bar mi nyu sna'agyur / dran pa nyams par mi 'gyur/ dran pa zhan par mi 'gyur/ dran pa rmugs par mi 'gyur/ dran pa 'khums par mi 'gyur/ dran pa mi brtan 11 92wa 665

par mi 'gyur/ dran pa gzhan du rgyu bar mi 'gyur/ 'dod chags dang / zhe snang dang / gti mug dang / nga rgyal dang / ser sna dang / phrag dog gi rjes su 'gro bar mi 'gyur/ dran pa sdig pa can du mi 'gyur0)/ dran (kyepa 'jig rten pa'i mi dge ba byed par mi 'gyur te/ rtag tu blo yangs shing rab tu gsal bar 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu mi mnyam 6)pa dang mnyam pa'i dran pa dang /blo rgya mtsho lta bur 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu dran pa zab cing rgya mtsho chen po bsags pa lta bur 'gyur ro/ /lag na rdo rje don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po'i gzungs cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po cirade ltar go skabs yangs pa la gang gis gzungs 'di thob pa de lag na rdo rje ji ltar dran pa rmongs par 'gyur/ gzhan yang tshad med grangs med dpag tu med pa'i lus yongs su dag pa dang / yid yongs su dag pa dang / sems yongs su dag pa dang / mdangs yongs su dag pa dang /mig yongs su dag pa dang / rna ba yongs su dag pa dang / sna yongs su dag pa dang / lce yongs su dag pa dang / dbang po yongs su dag pa (ge'athob par 'gyur ro/ /don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po bklags (phyirapa tsam dang / mnyan pa tsam dang / mthong ba tsam dang / lhag pa'i bsam pa tsam gyis de rnams yon tan gyi phan yon chen po'i chen po 57ri'adi thob (87ste/ gang gis mthu 'di rab tu thob pa de la lag na rdo rje ji ltar rmongs pa skye bar 'gyur/ de lta mod kyi lag na rdo rje yud tsam zhig sdod cig dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor mang po'i dbus su ji ltar mngon sum du 'gyur ba bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar bab par bstan par bya'o/ /don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po 9 byang chub sems dpa' 3 thams cad kyis phyag byas pa rnam par thar pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 92wa 666

rnam par 'phrul pa'i cho 'phrul gyi rdzu 'phrul dam pa'i yul gyi mthu chen po'i (1)chen po bstan par bya'o/ /de nas gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po phyag na rdo rjes (khubyang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi drung nas don yod pa'i yon tan bkod pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'di dag dang / gzungs kyi sgo 'di dag mngon sum (5)du thos nas dga' ba dang / mgu ba dang / yi dzoparangs pa dang / rab tu dga' ba dang / yid bde ba skyes te/ snying dga' bas dga' ba chen po nyid thob par gyur nas smras pa / bdag lus dang sems shin tu sbyangs pas yongs su dga' ba yid la bgyid pas nges par (5)gnas par bgyi'o/ /yid la bgyid pa mchog tu dga' ba dang ༷6)ngo mtshar du gyur pa dang / som nyir 7)gyur pa dang bral ba dang / 'gyod pa ma mchis pas gnas par bgyi'o/ /rnam par thar pa'i dkyil 'khor byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis phyag bgyis pa/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi 8)don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po'i mthu'i rnam par 'phrul pa 'di ni mchog tu rnyed par dka' ba'o/ /de nas gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po phyag na rdo rjes byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la dri ma med par kun tu snang ba'i nor bu rin po che chen po chos kyi 59 dga' bar phul 1 nas rkang pa gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas nas11/lan gsum bskor ba byas nas song ste ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod cing 'gying bag dang / brjid bag gi 12'gros kyis song nas rang gi stan la 'dug ste / bzhin 'dzum pas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal du bltas nas snying yongs su dga' bas bcom ldan 'das la rtog cing 'dug go/ /de nas byang chub sems 92—667

dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ngo mtshar mchog tu rmad du byung ba snying rje dam pa rgya chen po'i lhag pa'i bsam pa'i dmigs pas sems can thams cad bsgral zhi ba'i phyir 'od zer dri ma med par snang ba'i nor bu rin po che chen po de phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phul te nam mkha' la 'phags so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis (nanor bu rin po che de nam mkha'i (5)dkyil du 'phags ma thag tu stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di cher g.yos par gyur to/ /'od zer gyi snang ba chen po nyi ma bye ba brgya (4)stong bas lhag pa'i 'od zer byung bar gyur to/ /snang ba gang gis 'dzam (5)bu'i gling gi sems can thams cad kyi 6)lus la reg pa tsam gyis sdig pa thams cad dang / dmyal ba dang / yi dgas dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang /gshin rje'i 'jig rten du ngan song gi 'gro ba las tsu)yongs su grol bar gyur to/ /gang yang gling bzhi pa'i yi dgas dang / dmyal ba de dag la yang snang ba des snang bar gyur pas nyi tshe ba'i dmyal ba rnams kyi gtub 8pa med par gyur te/sems can de dag kyang yongs su thar nas bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams su skal ba mnyam par skyes te/ lus yongs su dag par gyur to/ /gang yang mnar med pa'i dmyal ba chen po bcu drug po de dag kyang 9'od zer gyi snang 1 rib des reg pas dmyal ba de dag thams cad du pad+ma'i mtsho byung bar gyur cing 31/sems can de dag kyang yongs su thar nas rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan te/ bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams su skal ba mnyam par pad+ma las rdzus 12te skyes so/ /grang ba'i dmyal ba gang yin pa de dag kyang dro zhing bde ba dang / reg na bde 92—668

bar gyur to/ /tsha ba'i dmyal ba gang yin pa de dag kyang bsil bar gyur cing /reg na bde ba dang / rab tu dga' bar gyur to/ /gang yang dud 'gro'i skye (1)gnas su song ba ri dgas dang / bya dang / tha na sbrang bu dang / sha sbrang dag kyang 'od zer des reg pas dud 'gro'i skye (miganas su song ba de dag thams cad dga' ldan du lha rnams kyi nang du skyes so/ /sems can gang dag bcings par gyur pa de dag kyang 'od zer des reg pas sems can bcings pa las yongs su grol bar gyur to/ /su mi 'dod pa dang / lcags ((sgrog dang /lcags kyu lu gu rgyud kyis bcing 3)ba de dag kyang dum bur gyur to/ /gang snod ma yin pa de yang 'od zer des phog pas mthong ba yongs su dag pa 'thob bo/ /gang sha bkra dang marje'i nad kyis zhalag pa dang / rkang pa dang / rna ba dang /sna ma tshang ba khayang 'od zer des phog pas lus yongs su rdzogs pa dang / lus yongs su dag par gyur to/ /gang 'bras bu'i shing ljon pa dang / me tog gi shing ljon pa'i shing 7)smon na pa yongs su skams 9par gyur pa yang 'od zer des reg pas me tog dang / 'dab 1 ma dang / 'bras bu byung bar gyur to11/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing du gtogs pa gang du 'od zer bab pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing du gtogs pa de 12na yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing so so'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya 1 stong phrag gang gā'i laklung gi bye ma dgu bcu rtsa dgu snyed bzhugs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa so so'i rin po che sna bdun gyi khang pa brtsegs pa'i gzhal med khang dang /seng ge'i khri dang bcas pa'i gzhal med khang byung bar gyur to/ /nam mkha'i dkyil gang du 'od zer gyi gesnang bas reg tshepa'i nam mkha'i dkyil der yang 92wa 669

phyogs bcur kun zhi)du rin po che'i rang bzhin gyi (9sprin brtsegs pas khebs par gyur ( )te lha rdzas kyi nor bu rin po che chen po sna tshogs kyi char rab tu 'bab bo / /lha rdzas kyi rgyan dang / cod pan dang / dpung rgyan dang / gdu bu dang —/ do shal dang / se mo do dang / rna rgyan ④dang / gser gyi skud pa sna tshogs kyi char rab tu 'bab bo/ /tshon kha dog rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i lha rdzas kyi gos rmad du byung ba sna tshogs kyi char rab tu 'bab bo/ /lha rdzas kyi me tog sna tshogs kyi char rab tu 'bab bo/ /lha rdzas kyi byug (nyepa sna tshogs kyi char rab tu 'bab bo/ /lha rdzas kyi bdug pa sna tshogs dang / tsan+dan sbrul gyi snying po'i ⑥char rab tu 'bab bo/ /tshon kha don sna tshogs pa'i lha rdzas kyi gos dang / ba dan sna tshogs kyi char (7skurab tu 'bab bo/ /lha rdzas kyi (2)me tog sna tshogs pad+ma dang / ku 9rimu da 7dang / pad+ma dkar po dang / ut+pal sngon po dang / pa 67ri 1 risha ka dang / tsam pa ka dang / a ti mug ta ()ka dang / a sho ka chadang /skya snar dang / ka dam pa dang / man dā skur ba dang / man dā yir ba chen po'i me tog gi 1 char rab tu babs (12te/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod pa'i las byed do/ /bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i yang rin po che sna bdun gyi khang pa brtsegs pa yang dag par gnas par gyur te/ gru bzhi pa ka ba bzhi dang / sgo bzhi dang ldan pa shin tu 'bar ba/ lha rdzas kyi me tog sna tshogs 19lan kun gyis yongs su bskor cing mu ci )tig gi dra ba sna tshogs kyis brgyan 1pa gser gyi dril bu sna tshogs 'phyang zhu 2ba gos sna tshogs kyi phreng bas mdzes par byas pa/ chu shing gi rgyal da mtshan sna tshogs bsgreng baX ste/ nor bu rin po che sna tshogs bkram pa/ grwar sa lha rdzas kyi rnga yab sna tshogs kyis mdzes 92—670

par byas panyunye/ go skabs rgya che ba'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor chen po 'byung zhing snang ngo / /nam mkha'i dkyil na yang lha rnams (0lha rdzas rnams (0kyi me tog dang /bdug nyaspos dang / dri dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang /chos gos dang / gdugs (5)dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / rol mo'i sgra sna tshogs dang / sil snyan dang / pheg rdob pas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byed cing 'khod de/ de ltar don yod pa'i cho 'phrul gyi rnam par 'phrul pa'i byin gyis rlabs (nyarmad du byung ba chen po'i chen po (7)rab tu bstan cing ya mtshan rmad du byung ba'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam par 'phrul pa (8)chen po'i chen por bstan to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam par 'phrul pa'i cho 'phrul 'di bstan nas rnam par 'phrul pa'i bkod pa chen pos rang gi stan las langs te / bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das la lan brgya stong du mar bskor ba byas te/ bcom ldan 'das la mngon du bltas nas bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar te/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs 5stanas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag la don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po rnam par thar pa'i dkyil 'khor byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis phyag bgyis pa/ phyag rgya dang / dkyil 'khor rim par phye ba/ gsang sngags kyi snying po gsang ba rig sngags kyi rgyal po chen po bdag gi snying po gsang ba/ rig sngags kyi rgyal po don yod pa'i lcags kyu dang / don yod pa'i khro bo'i lcags kyu dang / rig sngags kyi rgyal po don yod 92—671

par 'dren pa/ nor bu rin po che chen po gsum mchis te/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gis de bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'khor mang po'i nang du yongs su bsgrags 0)par bgyi'o/ /gang gi (2)dran pa tsam gyis don yod pa'i snying po'i cho ga zhib mo'i 3phyag rgya dang / dkyil 'khor dang / gsang sngags dang cho ga rim par phye ba mtha' dag rdzogs par mngon du gnas par 'gyur te thams cad so so nyid du gnas so/ /gsang sngags 'dis gzir bas thams cad 94)mdun du gnas so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la legs so/ /zhes bya ba byin te/ sems can dag pa chen po khyod kyis spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi snying po rig sngags kyi rgyal po don yod pa'i lcags kyu smras pa legs so legs so/ /rig sngags 'chang thams cad kyi don dang / sems can thams cad kyi don chen po'i phyir sems can thams cad 5)dag pa chen po khyod kyis de'i 'dus la bab par shes na da smros shig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis bcom ldan 'das kyis 7 bskul bar rig nas bzhin 'dzum zhing mig mi 'dzums 8)par bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su mngon du phyogs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'khor mang po'i nang du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi snying po'i lcags kyu don yod pa'i zhags pa 'di smras so/ /dus gsum du gshegs shing so so na bzhugs 9)pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa rdo rje 'dzin rig sngags kyi dbang po chen po 'khor gyi tshogs dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkyil 92—672

'khor gyi rig sngags kyi lha thams cad dang / phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags rim par phye ba dang / cho ga zhib mo thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo rang sangs rgyas dang / 'phags pa nyan thos kyi dge 'dun 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa byams pa la sogs pa dga' ldan gyi byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'khor gyi tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med bde ba can na gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' 1)chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyogs bcu mtha' yas mu med pa'i 'jig rten gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dang / dkyil 'khor gsang ba dang / gsang sngags dang /(25 phyag rgya rim par phye ba cho ga zhib mo dang bcas pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po snying rje chen po dang ldan pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug rig sngags dang / dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi sku sems can thams cad la byams pa kun nas don yod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rig sngags kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bgegs dang / log 'dren dang / sdang ba dang / bdud la sogs pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar mdzad pa'i sems dpa' chen po mchog sbyin lcags kyu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ oṃ ā gar+sha ya/pad+ma hasta / ma 41hā a 2mo gha e ku shi / tsa ra tsa ra/ tsa tsa ra/ sañtsa 7ra/sa madhe na/ ma hā pā sha /e ku ciXsha /bhu dza ba rad bhu dza e ku ri9sha pā sha dha ra/dha ra dha ra/ sa man+ta mu dā/ )/ man+t+ra 11maṇ+ḍa nyanal/ pa ṭa la dha ra e ku sha /pā she na / dhā ra /snyeya hūm̐ (6/ ma hā brad+mas/ be lag dha ra/ a mo gha rū 17pa/92—673

e ku 0)sha dha ra/ ta ra ta ra/ ta ta ra(snye/ (rin san tā ra ④ya/ ma hā mu dru(mi/maṇ+ḍa la(6ni/ a mo gha e ku (/sha ba 6)ra da/ ma hā kā (9)ru ṇi ka /tri yilo tsa na/pa shu pa ti/ be ṣa (1snya ra/ sī 3)shwa ra/ (snyem he snyishwa ra8/ pa ra ma kā tsoru ṇi ka /ma hā: tu tshote shwa ra ya ma ba ru ṇahu)/ na ma skṛ (7ta/ ku mā ra/ tre+e lo kya ba ra da/ da ma zhi )ka /sha ( stom ka /shā sa ka / rak+ṣa ku( she /ma hā biṅgā(nye/a mo gha/ maṇ+ḍa la/ pū dzi ( steta/ rat+na ma ku ṭa/po ge/ mā la tsodha ra/ dhu ru dhu ru / ma hā e ku sha ak+ṣa ma dha ra hūm̐ hūm̐/ bha ra bha ra/ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra/ sa man+t+ra mu drwa maṇ+ḍa sa lo pū ra ya hūm̐ hūm̐/ hri ( 7da ya e ku shi /a ba lo kā (rteya/ mān (7sā ⑫dha ya sid dhi ra/ ā du kar+ṣa 69ya/ mu dā nu man+t+ra/ maṇ+ḍa la/ pa ṭa lo / sa ma ya/mu bisne rinapra sā dha ya mā ros// ha ra ha ra/ sarba pā ( )pa ki (chel bi ṣa 8ma la / mā ta sar+ya lha/ hu ru hu ru/ ma hā yaṃ (9ku shi/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ bud+dha bud+dha/ bo dha ya bo gedha ya/ tu ru tu ru/ ma hā bo dhi satwa e ku sha rat+na pā shaṃ (nyes ra/nā nā bi tsi ༄ tra ā bha ra ṇa (smebi bhū zhe ṣi ta/ a mi tā bha( )/ dzi na ma ku ṭa dha ra/dha ra dha ra/ pad+ma pā sha e ku sha dha ra/ sarba bit+yā 6nyeman+t+ra mu dā (nyamaṇ+ḍa la/ pra ba ni ra / sā dha ya sā dha ya/ bi shwa rū ( )pa dha ra/ sa ha sra bhu dza/(ge sa ha sra na 49tra / sau mya ne mu kha/ pa ra ma ( kā (sheru ṇi rdzo )ka satwa bta rims la/ sarba man+t+ra sdon mu dru(rte / pra sā dha kug / ma hā thab ra da sa dā dhin maḥstu sdo tshote/ a mo gha e tsoku sha /pad+ma bhu dza swā hā/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis 'di smras ma thag tu ri rdzo)po ṭa kyil chen po brag dang / nags tshal dang / skyed 97mos tshal du bcas pa'i gnas kyi gzhal med khang rnam pa drug tu rab tu g.yos te/ lha rdzas kyi me tog gi char chen po bab ni92wa 674

bo / /don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis phyag byas pa/ rnam par thar pa'i dkyil 'khor phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor rim par phye ba'i cho ga zhib mo 'di'ang (1)so sor (mile'ur phye ba mtha' dag rdzogs par nam mkha' la gnas so/ / gang gsang sngags kyi yig 'bru'ang (gegaser la be+e ḍūr+yas ④yi ger bris pa sprin gyi rim pa na snang ste/ yi ge'i phreng ba mnyam zhing gsal la (9zur phyin par bris pa/thig gi phreng ba gshibs (6)pas brgyan (7)pa snang ngo / /gang lag pa'i phyag rgya'ang (8)pad+ma'i nang nas byung ba/ phyag rgya bcing ba sna tshogs 'od zer 'bar ba nam mkha' la gnas so/ /gang mtshan ma'i phyag rgya'ang 6)rin po che sna bdun gyi pad+ma la rab tu gnas pa yinam mkha' la gnas par gyur to/ /gang ras kyi ri mo'i sku gzugs / gzugs rnam pa sna tshogs 'dzin pa/ rnam par bkra ba cho ga dang /yo byad dang bcas pa rim par phye ba bris pa'ang 1)tshonam mkha' la gnas so/ /gang dkyil 'khor rim par phye ba de dkyil 'khor rnam pa sna tshogs gru bzhi pa/grwa tu)bzhi cha mnyam pa rnam par phye ba dkyil 'khor shin tu spras shing brgyan nyu pa/gzugs rnam pa sna tshogs kyis mdzes pa'i gzhal med khang yang nam mkha' la gnas socha/ /dkyil 'khor chen po na gnas pa'i rig sngags kyi lha pho nya dang /khro bo dang bcas pa gzhal med khang na rjes su rgyu ba dag kyang nam mkha'i dkyil 'in gnas te/ bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byed do/ /phyogs so so'i de bzhin gshegs pa mang po bye ba khrag khrig brgya 8stong gang gā'i 7klung gi bye ma snyed kyang phyogs bcu kun gyi nam mkha'i dkyil na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku bzhugs par gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku de dag thams cad kyis kyang byang chub 92—675

sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug legs so legs so/ /rig sngags kyi mchog dam pa don yod pa'i lcags kyu'i rig sngags kyi rgyal po mtha' dag rdzogs par smras pa gang gis don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po rnam par thar pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhib mor gsang sngags dang / phyag rgya dang /gsang sngags rim par phye ba de dag thams cad don yod pa'i lcags kyu'i gsang sngags kyi zhags pas kun nas drangs so/ /'khor 'di'i nang na nam mkha'i dkyil na rab tu gnas pa de phyi ma'i tshe phyi ma'i dus na rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo'am/ dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen 0)nam/ dge bsnyen ma'am/ dge sbyong ngam(2)/ bram ze'am/ rgyal rigs sam/ rje'u rigs sam/ dmangs rigs sam/ gzhan su yang rung ba bud med dam/skyes pa'am/ khye'u'am/ bu mo rig sngags 'dzin pa thams cad kyis don yod pa'i zhags pa'i lcags kyu 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi snying po'i gzungs 'di dran par byed na lan cig nadran pa tsam gyis kyang mod la don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis phyag byas pa/'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi snying po rnam par thar pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags dang / dkyil 'khor rim par phye ba dang / cho ga zhib mo de thams cad so sor de la kha ton nya nyid du gnas te/ de dag thams cad rim gyis dran pa dang / blo rgya mtsho bsags pa dang / shes rab 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /gsang sngags dang / phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags rim par phye ba so so la blo 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /nam yang blo dman par 92—676

mi 'gyur zhing nam yang brjed ngas 0)par mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la legs so zhes bya ba byin te/mchog chen po sbyin pa/ lag na pad+ma/ mchog tu snying rje can khyod kyis cho ga rgya chen po smras pa legs so legs so/ /de nas gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po phyag na rdo rjes rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam par 'phrul pa'i cho 'phrul gyi yon tan mtha' yas pa 'di mthong nas dbugs cher 'byin par gyur cing mchog tu dga' ba chen po (5tshothob bo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'khor 'di'i nang du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi snying po don yod pa'i lcags kyu'i bya ba'i yo byad dang cho ga bshad do/ /bcom ldan 'das de nas rig sngags 'chang gang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi snying po don yod pa'i zhags pa byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis phyag bgyis pa rnam par thar pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di bsgrub par 'tshal ba dang / gang yang rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo'am/ dge slong pha'am/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma'am/ dge sbyong ngam/ bram ze'am/ rgyal rigs sam/ rje'u rigs sam / dmangs rigs sam/ gzhan su yang rung ba bud med dang 3/ skyes pa'am / khye'u 'am/ bu mo lasadon yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po 'di klog 55par 'tshal ba dang / bstan 65par 'tshal ba dang / bzlas brjod kyi cho ga bgyi bar 'tshal ba dang / mtha' dag rdzogs par bsgrub par 'tshal ba des sngon rol du phyogs bcur thal mo sbyar te/ phyag 'tshal nas shar phyogs su kha bltas te mchis 92—677

la gzhan mi smra bar don yod pa'i lcags kyu'i snying po 'di lan gsum dran par bgyi zhing / yang thal mo sbyar te phyag bgyi'o/ / de nas tu)dran pa tsam gyi med la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bkug par 'gyur te/ ri (gepo ṭa tshila'i gzhal med khang dang bcas pa dang / 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang bcas pa bkug (4 par 'gyur ro(ge// //'phags pa don yod pa'i zhags pa'i cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po/ bam po nyi shu gnyis pa/ don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis phyag bgyis pa/ rnam par thar pa'i dkyil 'khor phyag rgya (6)dang bcas pa gsang sngags rim par phye ba'i cho ga zhib mo dang / sgrub 7)pa'i cho ga'i rnam pa rgya chen po mtha' dag rdzogs pa 'di yang bkug (87par 'gyur ro/ /dkyil 'khor na (9)gnas pa'i rig sngags kyi lha 'khor dang bcas pa bkug par 'gyur te/ thams cad yid rab tu dga' bar gyur pas dngos grub dam pa rjes su stsol bar 'gyur ro / /de nas don yod pa'i rgyal po'i snying po dran par bgyi ste/ ji ltar shin tu rgya cher yid la bgyis pa de ltar bsgrub par 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug nyid kyi kha nas dran pa mnyan zhing rgya che ba dang / blo dang mdangs dri ma ma mchis par kha'ajug par bgyid de/ zhugs pa tsam gyi mod la lce pad+ma'i 'dab /nyam lta bur 'jam par 'gyur zhing / kha nas ut+pa la'i dri 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dbyangs snyan cing mnyen pa dang / 'jam pa dang /zab pa dang / tshig rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /mi'am ci'i dbyangs dang /92—678

sgra snyan pa dang / dbyangs mnyen pa dang / dga' bar byed pa'i dbyangs su 'gyur zhing ka la ping ku'i dbyangs su 'gyur ro/ /ji zhi)ste dus gsum du lan gsum du ②dran par bgyi na)na gsang sngags dang / cho ga zhib mo dang / dkyil 'khor dang / phyag rgya rim par phye ④ba dang / cho ga thams cad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs spyi'i dngos grub de rdzogs par 'gyur zhing spyod par 'gyur ro/ /bgegs dang log 'dren dang bdud la sogs pa sdang ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /sngon gyi sgrib (gepa dang /dmyal bar mchi ba'i sdig pa thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi snying po/ rig sngags kyi rgyal po chen po don yod pa'i lcags kyu 'di lan gsum dran par bgyis pa tsam gyis chu)skad cig de nyid kyi mod la bdag rang dang / rang gi gnas kyi khang pa dang / slob ma dang / bsnyen bkur dang / 'khor dang bcas pa mi gtsang ba yang gtsang bar 'gyur / yongs su ma dag pa'ang (beshin tu yongs su dag par 'gyur ro/ /dri ma dang bcas pa'ang (0shin tu dri ma ma mchis par 'gyur ro/ /zhe sdang dang bcas pa'ang thosazhe snang dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /gti mug dang bcas pa'ang migati mug dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /'dod chags dang bcas pa'ang 31'dod chags dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /sgrib pa dang bcas pa'ang tu)sgrib pa dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /bgegs dang bcas pa dang / bdud dang log 'dren gyis yongs su zin pa'ang tsobagegs dang / log 'dren dang / bdud la sogs pa dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /sems kyi sdig pa'ang snyisdig pa dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /thun mong tsom yin pa'ang 8thun mong tsho du gyur cing bsrungs nyusnyepar 'gyur ro/ /92—679

mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs ma mchis par 0)yang mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs chen po dang ldan par 'gyur ron)/ /smyung chib ma bgyis pa'ang smyung (0ba bgyis par 'gyur ro / /rig sngags kyi gnas dang yul dang dkyil 'khor thams cad du tshangs par mi spyod pa'ang 5tshangs par spyod pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /tshangs pa'i gnas chen po la 6)gnas par 'gyur ro/ /dge ba mi spyod pa'ang 47 dge ba chen po dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /chos mi spyod pa'ang ra chos spyod pa chen po dang ldan par 'gyur ro / /bsod nams mi bgyid pa'ang ri9ribasod nams kyi phung po chen po 7'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /dul ba'i spyod pa ma mchis pa'ang 11dul ba'i spyod pa chen po dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /dkyil 'khor dang / phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags ma 12mthong ba dang / dam tshig 32ma mchis pa'ang 51 dkyil 'khor dang / phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags mthong ba dang / dam tshig 'tshal bar 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags kyi gnas dang 'khor thams cad du sangs rgyas dang / chos mthong bar mi 'tshal ba'ang 5byang chub dang / chos/ dang / dam tshig dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis ma bsams pa'ang 'byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bsams 1 par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi sa bon gyi yul du ma gyur pa'ang 12byang chub kyi 1zhes bon dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi spyod pa dang mi 'bral zhing / pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par bgyi ba la mkhas par 'gyur ro/ /tshul khrims dang mi 'bral zhing ting nge 'dzin rab tu 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /sbyin pa dang lu yongs su gtong ba dang mi 'bral zhing sbyin pa dang / yongs su gtong ba dang / sbyin pa'i tshogs chen po dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /bzod pa dang mi 'bral 27zhing 92—680

bzod pa chen po'i (1)bzod pa'i rjes su spyod par 'gyur ro/ /brtson 'grus dang mi 'bral zhing brtson 'grus kyi stobs chen po'i go cha brtan gepa bgos par 'gyur ro / /bsam gtan dang mi 'bral zhing bsam gtan chen po 'thob pa dang /ting nge 'dzin dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /shes rab dang thabs la mkhas pa zhan pa'ang shes rab dang thabs la mkhas pa ri rgya chen por 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags dang / gsang sngags (rinyams pa'ang 5/ gsang sngags dang / phyag rgya yongs su tshang ba dang / cho ga la mkhas par 'gyur ro/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang bral ba'ang dge ba'i bshes gnyen 6chen po'i lam la rab tu gnas per 'grub par 57)'gyur ro/ /'jig rten thams cad du snying du sdug pa dang / bla mar bgyis par 'gyur ro/ /sems can thams cad kyis mchod pa dang / mngon du phyag bgyi bar 'gyur ro/ /tshig btsun par yang na 'gyur ro/ /bsam pa yongs su dag par yang 'gyur ro/ /de ltar don yod pa chen po'i cho ga rgya chen po 'di dag ni thams cad du dngos grub don yod pa/ mchog tu rnyed par dka' ba/dge ba don yod pa 'di don yod pa'i lcags kyus 'dren par bgyid do/ /dngos grub thams cad 'gugs par bgyid do/ /sgrub 9pa thams cad 'dren par bgyid do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ji snyed pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwa 1 brgyad dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad dang / de bzhin nyid dang /yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / don dam pa dang / stong pa nyid 'dren par bgyid de don yod 11pa'i lcags kyu 'dis 'dren par bgyid/ yangs par bgyid / dngos grub mchog 'dren par bgyid do/ /de ltar mthu che ba dang /92—681

phan yon che ba dang / yon tan chen por brjod pas bsod nams kyi 'bras bu chen po stsol bar bgyid do/ /de ltar dge ba'i rtsa ba chen po dang ldan zhing kun tu sogs (1rwapar bgyid pas rig sngags kyi rgyal po don yod pa'i lcags kyu/'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi snying po ni mchog tu grub pa bla na med pa lags tshiso/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo'am / dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/(gyi dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma'am/ dge sbyong ngam ri/ bram ze'am/ rgyal rigs sam/ rje'u rigs sam/ dmangs rigs sam/ gzhan su yang rung ba/ bud med dam/skyes pa'am/ khye'u'am/ bu mo 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug rang gi gzugs kyis dgug par 'tshal ba dang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bdag nyid kyi rang gi gzugs su mthong bar 'tshal na des cho ga 'di bgyi'o//gtsang ma shin tu khrus bgyis pa/ gos gtsang ma bgos (snyepa/ ba'i rnam lnga'i chus bsangs (65pa'i mchod phyir thogs btags pas ras dmar po'i skud pa'i mchod phyir thogs kha dog bzang po gnas bdun du yongs su gzung (7)ste/mtshog (8)ma dang / spyi gtsug bcing ba dang / gnas gsum po 9)dpung pa gnyis su bcing ba dang 1 )/ lag ngar gnyis su bcing ba dang / de nas rked par bcings pas/1lha sa phyogs gtsang mar 'dug nas skosam/ gnas gzhan gang yang rung ba dben zhing 'khrug (snyepa ma mchis pa dang / dkyil 'khor gyi stegs gru bzhi pa shin tu rnam par mdzes pa khru 1 rabazhi'i tshad tsam la 'phang sor brgyad kyi tshad tsam kun nas zlum po legs par byugs pa shin tu 'jam pa 1lhabagyi'o / /de nas tshon sna tshogs kyi skud pas rnam par mdzes par thig gdab 92—682

cing tshon rtsi sna tshogs kyis bri bar 6)bgyi'o/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor ni khru gang tsam gyi tshad la gru bzhi pa rnam par phye ba/ shin tu mdzes pa/ gru bzhi kun nas (gyikha khyer gyi rnam pa can bgyi'o/ /dbus su pad+ma bgyi'o/ /'dab (gum brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ 'dab /sem thams cad la lcags kyu bri zhing dbus kyi snying po ge sar dang bcas pa rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan (5)pa bgyi'o/ /'od kyi phreng ba zlum po tshon rtsi sna tshogs kyis rnam par mdzes par bgyi'o/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor gyi grwa 6)bzhir lcags kyu dang zhags pa kun nas zlum po'ang (7bgyi'o/ /phyi rol gyi dkyil 'khor kun du mtshan ma'i phyag rgya sna tshogs kyang bri bar bgyi'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi grwa (8)bzhir 99༄rnam par phye bar rgyal po chen po bzhi 'bar ba'i nang na go cha bgos pa/ drag shul gyi gzugs can 'jigs par bgyid pa bri'o/ /sgo bzhi rnam par phye bar yang dkyil 'khor gyi lha bri bar bgyi ste/ shar phyogs kyi sgor rdo rje 'chang zhi ba'i gzugs can bzhin 'dzum pa/ rdo rje 'gying bag can du 'dzin pa / ri rab kyi steng na 'bar ba'i nang na mchis pa bri'o/ /lho phyogs kyi sgor khro bo'i 7rgyal po drag shul gyi gzugs can 'jigs par bgyid pa/ pad+ma dang zhags pa thogs pa/ me tog kha phye ba'i steng na 'bar ba'i nang na mchis pa'o11 / /nub phyogs kyi sgor dbang po rdo rje thogs pa/ mig gsum pa ri'i steng na 'bar ba'i nang na (snyemachis pa bri'o/ /byang phyogs kyi sgor don yod pa'i zhags pa gdong khro gnyer can/ pad+ma dang zhags pa thogs pa/ pad+ma'i 'dab 1nyama'i steng na 'bar ba'i nang na lcags kyu dang lhan cig mchis pa bri'o/ /dkyil 'khor kho ra yikhor yug tu gos dang / ba dan dang / mda' dang / rgyal mtshan kun gyis brgyan mapar bgyi'o/ /tshon tshasna lnga'i skud pas kho ra khor yug tu dkri 1 snabar 92—683

bgyi'o / /gtor ma thams cad dkar po gzhag go/ /dkyil 'khor gyi phyi 6)rol kun du dngul dang gser gyi snod rnam pa sna tshogs pa gzhag go/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor kho ra khor yug tu dngul gyi snod bkang ba bzhi dang (2)/ 'o mas bkang ba bzhi dang / mchod yon dang / zhabs bsil ba'i snod bzhi dang /dri'i snod bzhi dang / dris bkang ba'i snod bzhi dang / dngul gyi pog phor a ga ru dang / tsan+dan dang / du ru ska'i ( rabadug spos bsregs gisapa bzhi gzhag go / /phyi rol gyi dkyil 'khor kho ra khor yug tu sa las byas pa'i snod bkang ba dang / gtor ma'i snod bum pa yongs su bkang ba drug cu rtsa bzhi dang /bdug pa sna tshogs bsregs pa'i pog phor brgyad 'jigs pa med par gzhag par bgyi'o / /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis tshes bcu bzhi nas zla ba nya tshes bcwa (snyelnga'i bar gyi nyin zhag gcig smyung tshone ba bgyis pas 'bras yos dang / yungs kur tshil don yod pa'i rgyal po'i snying pos lan brgya (85rtsa brgyad yongs su bzlas pas dkyil 'khor du gtor bar bgyi'o/ /yungs kur (9ridang / dri chab la khro bo'i rgyal pos lan brgya rtsa brgyad yongs su bzlas pas dkyil 'khor kun du gtor zhing dkyil 'khor dbang bskur bar bgyi'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol du mar me drug cu rtsa bzhi spar bar bgyi'o/ /me tog ji snyed pa mang po dgram gezhing kho ra khor yug tu phreng ba gzhag par bgyi'o/ /rig sngags 'chang gis don yod pa'i lcags kyus yungs kur 11la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig yongs su bzlas pas dkyil 'khor kun dang / phyogs bzhi dang / steng dang / 'og tu gtor na dkyil 'khor bcing ba bgyis par 'gyur ro/ /phyogs bcing ba dang / spyi gtsug bcing ba dang / bdag bsrung 12ba bgyis par 'gyur ro/ /bgegs dang / log 'dren 92—684

dang / 'byung po dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po 91)dang / bdud la sogs pa thams cad bcings par (mi'agyur ro/ /lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po gang dag mthong ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i bslab pa'i gzhi 55)'dzin pa de thams cad bkug par 'gyur ro/ /dkyil 'khor kun nas bsrung ri ba'i slad du gshin rje dang / chu lha dang / gzhon nu dang /ku be ra dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi dpung dang / 'khor dang bcas pa/lcags kyu dang / zhags pas bkug par 'gyur ter/ dkyil 'khor kun nas bsrung tsho6)ba dang / bskyab pa dang / sba ba bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /'og gi sa'i lha mo sa'i 'og na gnas pa rnams dang lhan cig dkyil 'khor bsrung 7ba dang /bskyab pa dang / sba ba'i slad du mchis par 'gyur ro/ /steng nas nam mkha' la tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / brgya byin dang / mtshan mo'i lha dang / nyi ma dang / zla ba rgyu skar dang bcas par bsrung 8)ba dang / bskyab pa dang / sba ba bgyis par 'gyur ro/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis phyag bgyi ba'i ri9las bgyi ste/ rig sngags 'chang gis rtswa 1 ku sha'i steng du shar phyogs kyi sgor dkyil 'khor la mngon du phyogs par skyil 11mo krung 12bcas te/ mchis la gzhan mi smra bar don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po lan brgya rtsa brgyad yongs su bzlas pa bgyis la/ dkyil 'khor gyi snying por 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gzhag par bgyi zhing / me tog re re la bzlas brjod bgyis pas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi mdun du dor bar bgyi'o/ /de nas khro bo'i rgyal pos yungs kur sna gyi 'bru re re la lan 92—685

brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis pas gtor bar bgyi'o/ /de nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi snying po don yod pa'i zhags pa'i lcags kyus 6)bzlas brjod stong rtsa brgyad bgyis pas dbul bar bgyi'o/ / ril bu (mire re la bzlas brjod bgyis pa'i bdug spos dbul bar bgyi'o/ /yungs kur re re la bzlas brjod bgyis la/ snying po'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dor bar bgyi'o / /stong rtsa brgyad rdzogs pa dang / thun tha ma'i nam nangs (gekar gya ⑤rnam pa/yid du 'ong zhing dga' ba yidang / rab tu dga' bar bgyid par sa g.yo bar 'gyur zhing / sgra mnyen ⑦pa dang / snyan cing 'jebs (shepa dang / yid du 'ong ba zab mo zab mo dang / ka la ping ka dang / mi'am ci'i sgra dbyangs lta bu 'byung bar 'gyur te/ rig sngags 'chang gi sems brtan por bgyi zhing mchog positu dga' ba ⑨yid la bgyid pas bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi snying po nas 'od zer rnam pa sna tshogs mang po 'byung zhing phyogs dang /phyogs mtshams kun tu mchi zhing snang bar 'gyur te47/ nam mkha'i dkyil 8na sprin brtsegs pa'i phung po bzhin du 'od zer gyi gdugs su gyur nas gnas par 'gyur ro/ /de nas sngon ma byung ba'i dri zhim po 1)rmad du byung ba 'byung bar 'gyur zhing lha'i tsan+dan dang / go shir+ṣa'i 7tsan+dan dang / tsan+dan sbrul gyi snying po dang / ga bur tshadang / gla rtsi'i dri 'byung ste/ dpag tshad brgya kho ra khor yug tu dri gnas par 'gyur ro/ /lha rdzas kyi bdug spos kyi dri zhim po sngon ma byung ba rmad du byung ba sabai ḍūr+ya 1 7sngon po'i sprin brtsegs pa lta bu'i bdug spos kyi sprin nam mkha'i dkyil na gnas par yang 'gyur te/ phyogs bcu kun tu bdug spos kyi dri rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /de nas snying po'i dkyil 'khor gyi kyisnyedabus 92—686

nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bdag nyid kyi rang gi gzugs kyis 'byung bar 'gyur te/ tshangs pa bzang po'i cha lugs can/ ral pa'i thor tshugs kyis brgyan 0)pa/ don yod pa'i zhags pa'i gzugs (gyilag pa bzhi pa/pad+ma dang / zhags pa thogs pa/ rgyal ba 'od dpag tu med pa'i dbu rgyan can / dbu rgyan zla ba tshes pas brgyan (gupa/ mdung rtse gsum pa thogs shing dbugs 'byin pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad bzang pos brgyan tshudapa/ rang gi 'od dang gzi brjid kyis shin tu 'bar ba/bzhin 'dzum zhing nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i 'od zer gyi snang ba dang ldan pa/ khru brgyad tsam gyi (gelus bzang pos dkyil 'khor gyi snying po'i pad+ma'i stan 6)las langs te/ nam mkha' la mchis nas zhi ba'i gzugs can byams pa'i sems dang / snying rje chen po yid la bgyis pas dkyil 'khor kun du lta zhing phyogs bcur rtog par bgyid do/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang la legs so zhes bya ba'i sgra 'byung ste/ rig sngags 'chang chen po legs so legs so/ /lag pa g.yas pa brkyang ba'i lag mthil shin tu bzang po 'od zer bye ba brgya stong phrag stong gis legs par brgyan 6)pa'i lag pa rig sngags 'chang gi spyi bor 'jog par 'gyur ro / /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi nasilag pa spyi bor bzhag ma thag tu de nas rig sngags 'chang de nam mkha' la mchis te/ don yod pa'i zhags pa dang / lcags kyu (9ri rgya chen po 'od zer snang ba bkod pa rnam par 'phrul pa zhes bya ba sgyu ma lta bu'i shugs kyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin 'thob ste/ ting nge 'dzin gzhan yang bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gi bye ma snyed 'thob bo/ /kun du don yod par lta ba nor bu'i snying po rgya chen por grags 92—687

pa don yod pa'i lcags kyu'i gzungs(1)/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi snying po'i gzungs 'thob par 'gyur te/ gang gis gzungs thob pa'i mod la don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po'i phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags rim par (2phye ba'i cho ga zhib mo ( nibyang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis phyag bgyis pa / rnam par thar pa'i dkyil 'khor mtha' dag rdzogs par kha ton nyid du gnas so/ /gzhan yang pad+ma rgya chen po'i dkyil 'khor mtha' dag dang / rdo rje'i rigs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs dang / nor bu'i rigs dang /glang po che'i rigs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs kyi (4)dam tshig dang / gsang ba chen po'i (5risnying po dang / phyag rgya dang bcas pa'i gsang sngags rim par phye carab gsang ba dang / cho ga zhib mo'i rnam pa thams cad kha ton nyid du gnas so/ /rig sngags 'chang gi 'khor los sgyur (7ba bye ba khrag khrig brgya 8stong phrag gang gā 99 klung gi bye ma dgu bcu rtsa gnyis pa rnams kyi gtso bo dang / mchog dang rig sngags 'chang gi 'khor los sgyur 1 )ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ro/ /de nas 11'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis rig sngags 'chang de la smras pa/ rig sngags 'chang ji ltar yid la byed pa dang / bsam pa smros shig dang / mchog de thams cad rjes su sbyin par bya'o/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis ji ltar yid la bsams 1 pa dang / mchog mngon par 'dod pa de thams cad smra zhing mchog yid la re ba thams cad sbyin 1 par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang 'jig rten pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dgos pa sna tshogs da 1 ltar byung ba rnams smra zhing 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da poltar byung ba smra'o/ /lo legs pa dang / lo nyes pa dang / bde ba dang / nad 92—688

dang / 'jigs pa dang / lhag par 'jigs pa dang / 9pha rol gyi dmag tshogs dang / rang gi dmag tshogs dang / phyir rgol ba dang / dgra bo dang /yams kyi nad dang / mi ngas dang / gnod pa dang / nad 'go ba dang /'tshe ①ba dang / gza' (mi'athab pa dang / 'thab ( nomo dang / rtsod pa dang / mtshang 'dru (4)ba dang / 'gyed risapa dang / g.yul 'gyed pa dang / char ches pa dang / char dkon pa dang / dus ma yin pa'i char dang / tshe ring ba dang /tshe thung ba dang / tshe yongs su zad pa dang / dus ma yin par 'chi ba dang /'byor pa dang / rgud pa dang / dge ba dang / mi dge ba dang / skye ba dang /'gag pa dang / 'grub pa dang / mi 'grub pa dang / bgegs dang /bgegs med pa dang / bdud kyi bar chad dang / 'bru 'phel ba dang / nor 'phel ba dang / nad mang ba dang / nad dang bral bar 'gyur ba gang yin pa de 56nithams cad byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug rig sngags 'chang la smra bar 'gyur ro/ /sems can dmyal ba dang / yi dgas dang / lha ma yin gyi 'jig rten dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / 'byung po dang / sha za dang / grul bum dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa dang / dud 'gro'i skye ri7)gnas pa ri dgas dang / bya'i skye ba rin dang / 'chi ba de thams cad phyin ci ma thonalog par smra zhing sna )de dag gi 11thams cad kyang ston par 'gyur ro/ /lhar skye ba dang / klur skye ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'gro 12zhing skye ba dang /rgyal po nyid dang / bud med dang / skyes pa nyid dang / bu rnyed pa de thams cad smra bar 'gyur ro/ /bram ze'i rigs su skye ba dang / rgyal rigs su skye ba 92wa 689

dang / khyim bdag gi rigs shing sā 6)la chen po lta bur skye ba de thams cad smra bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang rigs mthon (7po dang / dma' ba dang / smad ②pa'i rigs su skye ba sna tshogs de dag thams cad ston cing smra la/ thabs kyang ston (4)par 'gyur ro/snye/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis ji ltar bsams ⑥pa'i don de thams cad 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang ⑦mngon sum du smra zhing thams cad gtam zer ro/ /gzhan yang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis rinasa'ajig rten pa'i mchog sna tshogs dang / sgrub ⑨pa dang /grub pa de thams cad de la 7stsol bar bgyid de/ 'di lta ste nor bsgyur ba smra ba dang / zhing smra ba dang / mig sman gyi dngos grub dang / mi snang ba dang /mig 'phrul 11dang / gter smra ba dang / phug tu 'jug pa dang / nags su 'jug pa dang / spo 3 ba dang / dbang du bya ba dang / dbab pa dang / ro langs bslang 1 ba dang / nad zhi bar bya ba dang / gos 'thob pa dang / grong 'thob pa dang / yul gyi bdag po nyid dang / chu klung chen po rgal ba dang /dug bza' ba dang / gsang sngags sna tshogs sgrub skopa'i dngos grub tshedang /'jigs pa chen po brgyad zhi bar bya ba dang / dgug pa dang / dran pa de thams cad stsol bar bgyid do/ /gzhan yang ji ltar yid la bgyid pa de thams cad 465 bar bgyid do/ /de dag thams cad kyi dgos pa thams cad don yod pa'i zhags pa'i lcags kyu'i yisnying pos 'dren cing / don yod pa'i zhags pas bcing bar 1 'gyur ro/ /bsams pa dang / don du gnyer ba dang / yid la re ba'i dgos pa de 12thams cad shin tu ring po nas kyang don yod pa'i zhags pas bcings nas /9thams cad drangs te lag tu thob par 'gyur ro/ /sgrub ( )pa 92wa 690
