mchog gi dngos grub kyi de kho na nyid thams cad 'grub par 'gyur te/ mi snang bar gyur/ rig sngags 'chang 6)nam mkha' la mchi bar 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten gyi khams gang du sangs rgyas kyi zhing (migang dang (kyigang du mchi 'tshal (4)ba de dang de thams cad du mchi (gebar gyur (6)te thams cad du gtso bor (7)'gyur(8)/thams cad du mchod par 'gyur ro/ /ci ste 6)mi lam du bomathong bar 'tshal na 41gu gul la lan brgya rtsa brgyad yongs su bzlas nas/ nyal kur 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la bdug spos su phul te nyal na/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug rgyal po'i cha byad du mthong ba stsol lha cing / gang bsams 1gepa dang / gang du gnyer ba dang /ske gang dris pa de thams cad smra bar 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar bsams tshepa'i mchog stsol cing sgrib pa dang sdig pa thams cad ma mchis par 'gyur ro/ /stobs dang / brtson 'grus dang / mdangs 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /tshangs pa dgug par 'tshal zhing mthong bar 'tshal na/de'i tshe shing arga'i tso'o ma dang / gu gul dang / rgya skyegs kyis ril bur 3 bgyis pa la bzlas brjod brgya rtsa brgyad bgyis la/ tshangs pa la bdug spos su phul nas(she/ tshangs pa rang gi gzugs kyis mdun na ma nyu)mchis shing mchog 'tshal ba thams cad rjes ri su stsol to spe/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten la thug pa'i bar gyi tshangs pa'i gnas dang / gzhal med khang mthong bar 'gyur zhing tshangs pa'i gzugs kyi cha byad 'chang ba'i mchog stsol bar 'gyur ro/ /lha'i gnas thams cad du mes po yin no zhes tshig mngon par brjod par 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten thams cad dang / 'dzam bu'i sno gling pa'i mi bud med dang /skyes pa dang / khye'u dang / bu mo dang / dge sbyong dang / bram ze dang /92wa 691

rgyal rigs dang / rje'u rigs dang / dmangs 6)rigs de thams cad thams cad du tshangs pa'o zhes sems par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po btsun mo dang /'khor du bcas pas mchod pa'i sprin chen po bgyid (5)par 'gyur ro/ /de nas sred med kyi bu dgug par 'tshal ba 58)des lha'i gnas su sred med kyi bu'i gzugs brnyan gyi mdun du nye bar sbyin sreg (4gi cho ga bgyi ste/ rig sngags 'chang gtsang mar gyur pa shin tu khrus bgyis pa gos gtsang ma bgos pa/ sna ma dang shing arka'i 5yam sreg shing gi me sbar ba la gu gul dang / yungs kur 76)dang / sbrang rtsi dang zhun mar bsres pa'i sbyin sreg 57)brgya stong bgyi'o/ /brgya stong rdzogs pa dang / srid med kyi bu rang gi gzugs kyis mdun na mchis shing rig sngags 'chang la rig sngags 'chang (8)legs so legs so zhes smra'o/ /sgrub smyo1rapa dam pa 'di don yod pa'i lcags kyus 'gugs shing rig sngags kyi rgyal po'i chos lugs chen pos bkug na rig sngags 'chang ci zhig bya1 / dgos pa ni ci zhig yod/ mchog ni ci zhig don du 11gnyer ba de smros shig dang / thams cad rjes su sbyin par bya'o/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis don gang yid nyanal bsams te smras pa de thams cad stsol bar 'gyur/ gzugs sna tshogs pa'i mchog kyang rjes su stsol bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang gzugs sna tshogs pa mchog gtso bo dang dgos pa'i las sgrub nyu pa'i mchog rjes su stsol bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas lha chen po dgug par 'tshal na rig sngags 'chang gtsang ma shin tu khrus bgyis pa gos gtsang ma bgos sapa des lha'i gnas su mchis pa la lha chen po'i mdun du gu gul dang / pad+ma'i phye ma dang zhun mar bsres (gepa'i sbyin sreg listong rtsa brgyad bgyi'o/ /stong rtsa brgyad rdzogs pa dang / lha chen po rang gi gzugs 92wa 692

kyis mdun na mchis par 'gyur ro/ /de nas nag po chen po dgug par 'tshal na rig sngags 'chang shin tu khrus bgyis pa gos gtsang ma bgos pas dur khrod du mchis la/ zla 6)ba mar gyi ngo'i tshes bcu bzhi la nyin zhag gcig (khusmyung ba bgyis pas pad+ma sar (geba'i phye ma dang / gu gul dang / ra'i khrag dang / yungs kur 4)dang / zhun mar dang sbyar ba brgyad stong don yod pa'i lcags kyu'i 5)bzlas brjod kyis dur khrod kyi shing gi me la bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /ra 6)khrag gi gtor ma dang 'bras thug po che'i chan gyi 7lha bshos dang / me tog dmar po dbul bar bgyi'o/ /las 'di yongs su rdzogs par bgyis na nag po chen po ma mo'i tshogs kyi 'khor dang bcas pa mdun na mchis shing rig sngags 'chang la legs so 48)zhes bya ba gsol te/ rig sngags 'chang legs so legs so/ /sgrub 9pa'i cho ga bzang po 'dis bdag yongs su ma gus 1 rig sngags 'chang smros shig dang mchog rjes su sbyin par bgyi'o/ /mchog 'dod pa thams cad rjes su long 11shig dang / ji ltar yid la byed pa re ba de thams cad rjes su sbyin par bgyi'o/ /khyod bsrung 12ba dang / yongs su bskyang ba'i don du bdag rtag tu rjes su 'brang bar bgyi'o/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis mchod yon dang zhabs bsil dbul bar bgyi'o1ri/ /ji ltar bsams 1 ripa de mngon sum du smras na/gang don du gnyer ba de thams cad 'thob cing thams cad tshedu rjes su 'brang bar 'gyur ro/ /thams cad du thams cad bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /dran pa tsam la sogs pas las thams cad bgyid 4cing nye bar gnas par 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu lta zhing spyir thams cad bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang dgos pa sna tshogs dang / las su bgyi ba bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /ma mo'i tshogs kyi 'khor 92wa 693

thams cad dbang du gyur nas gnas te/ las thams cad bsgo ba bzhin du bgyid par 'gyur te/ nam yang nyams par mi bgyid do/ /thams cad rjes su 'brang zhing 1)las thams cad bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /ci ste 'dod pa'i gzugs can ma dgug par 'tshal na de nas rig sngags 'chang gtsang ma shin tu khrus bgyis pa gos gtsang ma bgos pas shin tu ②dri zhim po'i dris lus lhag par bsgos la/ gang na me tog gi shing ljon pa mchis pa der mchis la/ zla ba mar gyi ngo'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin zhag gcig smyung ba bgyis pas shin tu dri zhim pa'i dri'i shing gi me sbar ba la pu shel tse ri byedang / ta ka ra dang / spang spos dang /yungs gar dang / zho dang sbrang rtsi dang / zhun mar dang / sbyar ba'i sbyin sreg 4skulan stong rtsa brgyad bgyi'o/ /gla rtsi dang / ga bur dang / tsan+dan gyi chus bsgos pa'i 'bras yos dang / me tog gis bkang ba'i mchod yon gyi snod bum pa sar tsho pa brgyad stsal lo/ /dkar gsum gyi gtor mas bkang ba ga bur (6)gyis bsgos pa'i gtor ma'i bum pa gsum stsal lo/ /me tog shin tu dri zhim po stsal bar bgyi zhing gla rtsi dang / tsan+dan dang / ga bur dang / kun tu ru'i bdug spos stsal bar bgyi'o/ /de nas las yongs su rdzogs pa dang / 'dod pa'i gzugs can ma bzang 9ge mo de lha'i gzhal med khang du mchi zhing mdun na mchis te/ de mthong nas ma'am/ sring mo'am/ chung ma'am/ las byed pa'am / rinasamangag gzhug ma'am/ pho nya ma rnams ji lta podabur ji ltar tshig tu brjod pa de la smros shig dang / ci ste tshamar gyur na de'i tshe bu bzhin du snying nas yongs su skyong bar bgyid nyamado/ /nor dang / 'bru dang / dbyig dang / gser dang / gos dang 42/ rgyan dang / lhab lhub dang / mal chas 92wa 694

yongs su skyong bar bgyid do/ /ci ste sring mor ①gyur na de'i tshe longs spyod thams cad kyis yongs su skyong bar bgyid do/ /ji ltar yid la bsams (7pa'i bud med dpag tshad brgya'i (kyepha rol nas kyang bkug ste/ yongs su longs spyad ④pa'i phyir yongs su spyod par bgyid (gecing phyir yang de nyid du gtong ⑥bar bgyid do / /ci ste chung mar gyur na de dang / lha rdzas kyi gzhal med khang dam pa yongs su longs spyod pa'i gzhal med khang 9)mthong ste/ lha rdzas kyi bza' ba dang btung ba dang / longs spyod stsol (8)bar bgyid do/ /ro bro ba'i mchog ro brgya dang ldan pa ches khyad par du 'phags pa'i longs spyod stsol bar bgyid do/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i rtsed mos 'dod pa'i yon tan phyo)lnga'i longs spyod la yongs su spyod ⑩par bgyid do/ /lha rdzas kyi dri dang / me tog dang phreng ba dang /byug 7pa dang / lha rdzas kyi gos dang / rgyan dang / lhab lhub yonakyis brgyan yostepa'i gzhal med khang du 'gyur ro/ /nor dang / 'bru dang / mdzod dang /bang ba yongs su gang zhing mchis par 'gyur ro/ /nor bu dang / gser dang /rdo rje dang / bai ḍūr+ya yidang / gser dang / shang ka shī skil dang / byi ru dang / dngul dang / sa le sbram dang / dngul skyog tshadapag tu med pa thob pa'i gter stsol bar bgyid do/ /rta dang / ba lang dang / ma he dang /phyugs dang / bran pho 7dang / bran mo rab tu mang po tu mang por 'phel zhing mchis par 'gyur ro/ /mal cha'i longs spyod sna tshogs stsol bar bgyid do/ /lha rdzas kyi chung ma'i longs spyod bud med gzugs sna tshogs pa'i 'khor brgya dang ldan pa nyin gcig bzhin du tshotsheganas par 'gyur ro/ /yo byad thams cad phun sum tshogs pas ji srid 'tsho'i bar du gnas par 'gyur ro/ /tshe lha'i lo stong 92wa 695

thub par 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags 'chang gis bag yod par bgyi zhi kyiste/ dkon mchog gsum la mchog tu gus pa dang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang / rdo rje 'dzin la mchog tu gus par bgyi'o/ /rtag tu sbyin pa la mngon par dga' bar bgyi zhing sems can thams cad la mchog tu snying brtse bar bgyi'o/ /gzhan du mi smra bar bgyi'o/ /gal te las byed par gyur na de'i tshe rgyal po la bgyi ba bzhin du las thams cad bgyid de/ shin tu yongs su rdzogs kyi bar du las la mngon par brtson par 'gyur ro/ /ji na ste mngag gzhug mar gyur na gnas gang du mngag 45pa de'i gnas thams cad du mchi ste(5)/dpag tshad stong gi pha rol du mchi nezhing / skad cig gis slar yang mchi'o/ /thams cad du gter chen po 'byin par bgyid 'dren par bgyid do/ /dpag tshad stong gi pha rol nas bud med 'gugs par bgyid cing / nor dang /'bru dang / glang po che dang / ma he dang / rta dag 'gugs par bgyid deg/slar yang gtong bar bgyid do/ /bag yod pas bsgo bar bgyi ste(8)/ bdag nyid shin tu ring po'i yul dang / gnas su 'phen par bgyid/ gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / 'byung po dang / lha ma yin gyi 9gnas su 'degs bipar bgyid de/ der srog gi bar 11chad du 12'gyur bar mi 1 bgyid do/ /ji ste pho nya mor gyur na phyogs bcu thams cad du mchi ste/ lha'i 'jig rten du mchi'o/ /klu'i 'jig rten du mchi'o/ /lha ma yin gyi gnas su mchi'o/ /nam mkha' lding gi gnas su mchi'o/ /mi'am ci'i gnas su mchi'o/ /lto 'phye sachen po'i gnas su mchi'o/ /gnod sbyin dang srin po'i gnas su mchi'o/ /'byung po'i gnas su mchi zhing thams cad du pho nya'i bya ba bgyis nas slar mchi'o/ /skad cig gis ge92wa 696

dpag tshad stong du mchi zhing 1)mchi'o/ /skad cig gis dpag tshad stong du thams cad du (0phyin nas pho nya'i bya ba bgyid do/ /ji ri srid sa'i 'og gi bar du 'jug cing phyir yang mchi'o/ /bya ba shin tu yongs su rdzogs par bgyis nas bag (4 yod pas yang las 55)thams cad bgyi ste/ nyin gcig bzhin du mchod yon dang /rkang pa bkru ba stsal bar bgyi'o/ /thams cad kyi gnas thams cad du phyin ne cing bya ba 'grub pa/ bla na ma mchis par 'gyur ro/ / de nas 7gnod sbyin mo dgug par 'tshal na rig (2sngags 'chang des gzhan gyis 9rim reg pa'i shing leb sar 0pa la gnod sbyin dang / gnod sbyin mo rgyan nyurtathams cad kyis brgyan pa bri bar bgyi zhing 12gnas dben zhing 'khrug pa ma mchis pa gtsang ma'i gnas su gzhag par bgyi'o/ /rig sngags 'chang gtsang ma shin tu khrus bgyis pas gos gtsang ma nyu2bgos pas 'o ma dang / 'bras thug po che'i chan gyi gtor ma stsal bar bgyi'o/ /shing ka (1 ra bī ra'i tshame sbar ba la yungs kur tshadang / gu gul dang / ra'i khrag dang / zhun mar dang bsres ’ pa'i sbyin sreg 18stong rtsa brgyad bgyi'o / /stong rtsa brgyad rdzogs pa dang / me tog dmar po stsal na gnod sbyin mo de yang rang gi gzugs kyis mdun na 519mchis te/ rig sngags 'chang slongs shig ces smra bar 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags 'chang gis khyod nga'i 2 tshoci bgyi zhes bya ba byed pa yin no/ /nga'i da las thams cad byed pa yin no/ /nga la dbyig mang po byin cig ces brjod par bgyi'o/ /de'i tshe gnod sbyin dang na gnod sbyin mo de ltar legs dzod so zhes smras nas mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /gang gi tshe dgos pa byung ba de'i tshe yungs kur dang / gu gul la yongs su bzlas ginas mer gtor na de mchi zhing ci bgyi zhes bya ba thams cad bgyid par 'gyur ro ne/ /dbyig 92—697

stong stsol bar 'gyur4)/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du mchis par 'gyur/ rtag tu ci bgyi ba'i bya ba (babagyid par 'gyur ro/ /de nas lha ma yin gyi bu mo dgug par 'tshal na (mirig sngags 'chang des spra tshil las lha ma yin gyi bu mo rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa bgyi'o/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis gnas 'khrug pa ma mchis pa dang / dben pa dang / sa phyogs gtsang ma'i gnas su gzhag par bgyi'o/ /rig sngags 'chang gtsang ma shin tu khrus bgyis pa gos gtsang ma bgos pas zhag ④gsum zan bcad 55)par bgyis la/ de'i mdun du skyil (6)mo krung 9)bcas te mchis la gu gul gyi bdug spos stsal cing dkar gsum gyi gtor ma stsal bar bgyi'o / /don yod pa'i lcags kyus (8)bzlas brjod yungs kur 5)la bzlas pas bu mo de la lan stong rtsa brgyad brdeg ⑩par bgyi'o/ /las yongs su rdzogs pa dang / de nas lha ma yin gyi bu mo de rang gi nyu7gzugs kyis tu mdun na mchis te/gang dang gang du dgos pa de dang der dgos pa'i dzinarjes su 'brang bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshulas thams cad bgyid par 'gyur/ thams cad du mchi bar 'gyur/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du mchis par 'gyur ro/ /ji skuste srin po dang / srin mo dgug tshapar 'tshal na gu gul dang / ba lang 3)gi sha skam po dang lhan cig bsres pa la don yod pa'i lcags kyus lan stong rtsa brgyad 4shebazlas brjod bgyis pas dur khrod du mtshan thog thag bdugs na srin po'i gnas thams cad kyi sgo phye bar 'gyur te srin po dang / srin mo 17rnams dbang du gyur nas gnas te/ ci bgyi ba'i bya ba bgyid par 'gyur/ ci bsgo ba de bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu phyi bzhin 'brang zhing ji srid 'tsho'i bar du mchis par 'gyur ro/ /gdugs (du snagacig bzhin du dngul chu srang khri stsol bar bgyid do/ /de nas rig sngags 92wa 698

'chang gis cha gsum du dbye bar bgyi ste/ cha gcig ni dkon mchog la mchod par bgyi'o/ /cha gnyis pa ni 1)gcig bzhin du sbyin par gtang 92)ngo / /srin mo rnams la zan dang / tshod sngon rlon pa'i (migator ma stsal bar bgyi'o/ /de nas srin po 'khor dang bcas pa de rnams tshim par 'gyur ro/ /de nas srin po (4)'khor dang bcas pa shin tu mgyogs par 'gyur te/ shugs chen pos riganodagos pa thams cad grub (7cing nam (7)yang gzhan du bgyid par mi 'gyur ro/ /gtor ma gtsang ma stsal bar bgyi'o/ /ji (8)ste sha za dang / sha za mo dgug par 'tshal na ba lang gi 6)mkhris pa dang / de'i so dang / gu gul dang / shing arka'i (7 'o ma sbyar te/ lam gyi bzhi mdor bdug par bgyi zhing / lhag ma dang 'bags (nyepa'i gtor ma stsal na/ sha za mo de mchi zhing rig sngags 'chang gi mdun du mchis te/ ci bgyi ba'i bya ba bgyid pa'i bran du 'gyur/ las thams cad bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /dpag tshad stong gi pha rol tu mchi zhing skad cig gis slar yang mchi'o/ /dgos pa thams cad sgrub par bgyid do/ /dus gsum du gtor ma lhag ma'i gtor ma sgo drung du stsal bar bgyi'o/ /nyin gcig /rtebazhin du gser gyi dong tse brgya sngas 1 su 'jog par 'gyur te'i/ des thams cad zad par bgyis na skophyir zhing 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /ji ste rgyal po'i tshabatsun mo dgug par 'tshal na rig sngags 'chang gtsang ma shin tu khrus bgyis pa gos gtsang ma bgos 1 pa des yungs kur dkar po dang / ske 18che'i sa bon dang / gi'u 67wang dang / pad+ma'i 'dab rim dang / rgyam tsha dang /lan nu1tshu bsres pa la 22lan brgya rtsa brgyad yongs su bzlas na 25phye ma'i rdzas su bgyis la yungs kur na chodang / ske rmo lhache'i sa bon dang / sbrang rtsi'i sa bon lan 92—699

cig (1)mnyes la yang lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis te/ ②rgyal po'i sgo'am / lam gyi bzhi mdo'am/ lam po che'am/ grong khyer gyi sgor gtor na gang der gom pa bor ba tsam gyis dbang du gyur nas gnas te ci bgyi ba'i bya ba bgyid do/ /rgyal po btsun mo'i 'khor dang bcas pa bkug cing dbang du 'gyur ro / /thams cad du rdo ci bgyi ba'i (4༄bya ba bgyid cing / bsgo ba bzhin bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /gang bslangs pa de ster te dngul dang / gser dang / gos dang / rgyan dang / lhab lhub dang / spud pa dang / bzhin (gepa dang /mal cha dang / 'bru la sogs pa 465 bar bgyid do/ /gang smras pa de bgyid cing gang bsgo ba bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /de'i yul gcig tu yang 'jig rten gsum po 56)thams cad kyis mchod pa chen po bgyid par 'gyur zhing thams cad tsoridabang du 'gyur rinararo/ /de nas bram ze dbang du bgyi bar (9sku'atshal na/ rig sngags 'chang des nas dang / til dang / 'bras sā 7lu dang / zho dang /sbrang rtsi dang / zhun mar dang bsres pa'i sbyin sreg stong rtsa brgyad bgyis na/skye/rig byed bzhi dang ldan pa'i bram ze thams cad kyis spyi bor bkur ba gcig pur 'gyur ro/ /thams cad du mchod pa 12bgyid par 'gyur zhing bram ze thams cad la dbang 15bgyid pa thogs pa med par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal rigs dbang du bgyi bar bo'atshal na til dang / 'bras thug ribopo che tshedang / sran mu da ga kyirtedang /zho dang / sbrang kyi rtsi dang / zhun mar bsres pa'i sbyin sreg 19bgyi ste/ sbyin sreg stong rtsa brgyad 27kyi bar du bgyis na thams cad la dbang bsgyur zhing mchod pa'i 'os chen por 'gyur ro/ /thams cad dbang du 'gyur bar bgyid do/ /ji srid 2 'tsho'i bar du bgyid de ci bgyi ba 32bgyid cing bsgo ba bzhin bgyid 92—700

par 'gyur ro/ /de nas dmangs rigs dbang du bgyi bar 'tshal na lan tshwa dang / 'bras sā 6)lu'i phub ma dang / su mu kha'i sa bon dang / zho dang /sbrang rtsi dang / zhun mar sbyar ba'i sbyin sreg (gebargya stong bgyis na dmangs ( ririgs thams cad bran du gyur nas gnas te/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du mchis par 'gyur ro/ /dgra dang phyir rgol ba dang / phas kyi dgra thams cad bzlog 4༄par 'tshal na rig sngags 'chang des shing mngar rdzu gyi shing gi me sbar pa ri la/ sa bon bdun dang / zho dang / sbrang rtsi dang / zhun (7 mar dang sbyar ba'i sbyin sreg (na brgyad stong bgyi'o/ /brgyad stong rdzogs pa dang / dgra dang phyir rgol ba dang /phas kyi dgra thams cad bzlog ri9par 'gyur ro/ /pha rol gyi dmag tshogs thams cad bzlog par yo )'tshal na shing tsher ma can gyi me sbar nyu1ba la 'bras yos dang /yungs kur (1gedang / zho dang / sbrang rtsi dang / zhun mar dang sbyar ba'i sbyin sreg 9/snyebargyad stong bgyi'o/ /brgyad stong rdzogs nyu rin pha rol gyi dmag tshogs thams cad bzlog apar 'gyur ro/ /g.yul 'gyed tshapa bzlog spepar 'tshal na ske 18che'i sa bon dang / gu gul dang / bhang ga'i 17sa bon dang / zho ga ri chu dang / zhun mar dang / sbyar ba'i sbyin sreg brgyad stong mibagyis na g.yul 'gyed pa'i nang du son pa'i sems can thams cad slar bzlog 2par 'gyur zhing /thams cad du rgyal ba ni:thob par 'gyur ro/ /de nas gdon thams cad las thar bar bgyi bar 'tshal na rig sngags 'chang des 2 7bdug pa 'di sbyar ba 'tshal zhugebar bgyi ste phyo/ k+ṣe ma ka dang shing mngar 3 dang / /4 rong dang ni gu gul dang / /mu ra ( 2ya k+ṣa /mu ra dang / /bhu sa 7ta ke 27shi mnyam par gzhal/ / phub ma dang ni pa la ka /khyim bya'i sgo nga'i shun lpags dang / /sbrul lpags dang 92wa 701

ni yung 0)rnam gnyis/ /bha (miga'i sa bon ba lang mkhris/ /nya dang legs par sbyar bgyis te/ / ra yi 5 )gcin gyis bsgos pa la/ /lcags kyu'i ④gsang sngags bzlas pa yis/ /bdug pa dam pa'i ⑤gtso bo 'di(nya/ /thams cad du ni rigs pa ste/ /stong phrag brgyad gcu rtsa bzhi (shegadon/ /gang dag sa steng gnas pa rnams/ /bdug pa'i dri 'dis 'jig 5)'gyur zhing / /mi bzad ⑩gdon rnams 'bros par 'gyur/ /phyogs bcu dag ni (lhagayo 'gyur zhing / /sum cu'i lha dang ri rab g.yo/ /gnod sbyin srin po'i gnas dag dang / /sdang ba'i srog chags chen po 'tshig /gzhan yang sna tshogs dug bcas pa'i/ /srog chags thams cad 'jig 'gyur ba/ /dri tsam gyis ni dogs pa med/ /bdug pa 'dis ni bdug sna byas na/ /der ni rims nad 8mi gnas te/ /nyin gcig pa yi 6)rims dang ni/ /nyin gnyis pa dang bzhi pa'i rims /gang yang mi bzad khyab 'jug rims/ /de dag thams cad 'jig 'gyur zhing / /skad cig gis ni gtan nas 'joms/ //'phags pa don yod pa'i 7zhags pa'i cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po/ bam po nyi shu gsum pa/ de nas mig bsku ba'i sman brjod par bya'o⑩/ /gdon thams cad 'joms pa gang gis mig 7bskus pa tsam gyis gdon ma rungs pa 'bros par 'gyur ro/ /ro stod kyi nad thams cad 'joms par 'gyur te/ mig pho bskus pa tsam gyis de thams cad med par 'gyur te dogs pa mi bya'o/ /mig gi nad ni ling tog 19dang / skya bor gyur pa dang / rab rib dang / chu bur can dang /chu zags pa dang / tshag po dang / ha sa rā 3gledza dang / byis ( nyapa'i mchi lham dang / mig tu sbe ba byung ba dang / khrag dang / rlung dang / bad gan 92—702

dang ske/ mkhris pa dang / rdul 'byung ba dang / 'brum bu dang / g.ya' ba dang / mig skams 6)pa dang / mdongs ②pa dang / klad lapa na ba dang /klad ④pa'i gzhogs (5)phyed na ba dang / kha nad dang /(6) kha na ba (7)dang /dpral ba na ba de dag thams cad (8)'joms par 'gyur ro/ /mig sman gyis mig bskus 6)pa tsam gyis rims thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ba dang /nad thams cad sel ba dang / mod la nyon mongs pa thams cad spong ba dang /sdig pa thams cad rnam ⑩par 'jig par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar na mig sman mchog tu grub pa/ bgegs thams cad sel ba dang / ma rungs pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa/ sems can thams cad la dbang byed pa/ thams cad du rgyal bar byed pa/ mig sman rtag tu mchog tu dkon pa/ gsad yi7pa la thug pa thar bar byed pa/ btson ra nas gang thar bar byed pa/ rgyal po dag gang la khros pa las dgod nyanacing smra bar 'gyur te/ nam 'tsho'i bar du rtag tu bu zhugebazhin yongs su skyong yizhing gnas pa/ dug thams cad mod la med par byed pa ni / mig sman mchog yin no/ /bsam pa ngan cing sdang 8ba'i sems can dang /dgra dang phyir rgol pa dang / dgra dang / 'gyed pa dag mig sman gyis bskus pas mthong na dbang du 'gyur te gnas so/ /ma he gtum po dang / glang po che dang / rlung dang / ser ba dang / steng ga ⑩mthon po nas g.yang du ltung tsob dang / me'i phung po dang / khyim rdib pa dang / g.yang sar ltung ba rnams mig sman gyis mig bskus pas mthong na zhi thenabar 'gyur zhing / gzhan yang bya ba rnam pa sna tshogs byed de 'di la dogs par mi bya'o/ /yung ba dang / skyer pa dang / na le 37sham dang / pi pi ming dang / shing 2 stag be ra dang /92—703

'bras bu gsum dang / ut+pal sngon po dang / ldong ros dang / gur gum zhi)la sogs pa'i mig sman dang / rgyam tsha (snyedang / spang spos dang / rgya mtsho'i spu (gyib dang / dung phye dang / 'di rnams lhan cig tu phye ma zhib mor byas pa la gsang sngags lan bdun bzlas te ga bur dang / gla rtsi bsnan (shepa'i mig bsku 95riba'i sman lcags kyu'i 56 rig sngags kyi rgyal po'i gsang sngags stong rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod byas te/ mig bskus 57)na dri ma thams cad sel zhing (8)sdig pa dang /gzhan sdug bsngal thams cad las grol bar 'gyur ro/ /mun pa thams cad kyi nang du nyi ma bzhin du skye bo thams cad kyi nang du mdzes par 'gyur ro/ /de nas ril bu 9bshad par bya ste/ sdig pa thams cad rnam par 'jig pa/ nad thams cad sel bar 'grub pa/ bgegs thams cad med par byed pa/ gdon thams cad rnam par 'joms pa/ sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sbyong ba/ mod la dug thams cad med par byed pa/ nyon mongs pa'i dri lho )ma thams cad sel ba / bcings pa thams cad gcod par byed pa/ g.yul thams cad las rgyal ba sbyin zhing dge ba/ dgra thams cad rab tu 'joms pa/ rtag tu dug 11thams cad 12'joms pa/ rgyal po'i sgor mdzes par 'gyur ba/ nor dang 'bru 'phel bar 'gyur ba/ rgyal po dang / rkun po dang / chu dang / me dang /dug dang / glang po che med par byed pa/ sprul ma rungs pa dang / byi ba'i dug gis 'jigs pa dang / khyim 'jigs pa dang / ri (12snyil ba dang /seng ge dang / stag dang / dom la sogs pa rab tu rgyu ba dang / gnod pa dang / bcings pa'i tshe 'gro bar dka' ba 'byung ba dang / nad dang rims 'joms pa dang sa/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba med par byed pa/ tshe dang nad 92—704

med par byed pa 'phel ba/ skyes pa dang / bud med dang / gzhon nu ma rnams mchog tu bde bar 'gyur ba ste/ gang gis ril bu bcangs (1na thams cad du rgyal ba 'thob cing gdon 'byung bar mi 'gyur/ rnam par log 'dren gyis ma yin no/ /gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / 'byung po dang / sha za dang / brjed byed ma rungs pa rnams ril bu (namathong ba tsam gyis phyogs bcur 'bros tsho dpar 'gyur ro/ /'dis (༄byis pa gsod par mi byed do/ /sman 'di la reg pa 55tsam gyis khyim der dus ma yin par 'chi ba dang / na ba thams cad dang / nad las yongs su grol 96)bar 'gyur ro/ /'bras dang / phol mig dang / lhog pa dang / 'brum phran 97mched pa dang / shu ba dang /g.yan pa dang / mdze dang / 'brum bu mched pa dang / sha bkra la bskus pa tsam gyis byang bar 'gyur ro/skyi /lus thams cad du zhugs pa'i nad la chu dron po 8'thungs pa tsam la sogs pas yongs su byang bar 'gyur ro/ /'jigs skrag 9pa thams cad las rtag tu rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /'jigs pa chen po las thams cad rjes su 'brang bar 'gyur ro/ /gnas thams cad du song ba la sbyar ba byas na mthams cad 'kho 11bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas rdzas su bya ba ni pu shel tse 1snyedang /tsan+dan dang / rgya spos dang / ru rta 1 dang / rdo dreg dang / bad 1 tra dang /tsham ka dang / sha mi 8dang / pad+ma pa tra dang / ut+pa la dang / na la da tshadang / 'bras bu gsum dang / tsha ba gsum dang / sug smel 1 dang /btsod dang / su ga ri dang / ra dza n+ya rnam 1 gnyis dang / spro 19ka dang /sra ri )rtsi pog dang / gur gum 21la sogs pa dang rab tu ldan pa dang / de dag kun bsres te/ zhib mor btags 22la/ kha ra dang / chu dang / sbyar bas 92wa 705

ril bu hu)byas la gsang sngags brgyad brgya bzlas brjod byas te/ grib ma la skams 95)pa de ni sman grub pa yin te/ thams cad rgyal bar byed cing dge ba ①yin no/ /rnga dang / rnga bo che dang / dung la ril bu ④mchog bskus te/gnas mthon 3)por song ste/ dung gi sgra (6)dang / rnga bo che dang / rdza rnga ji ⑦srid du thos pa de srid tsam du 'jigs pa med par 'gyur ro/ /dug dang bcas pa 58)ni thams cad dug med par 'gyur te dogs par porami bya'o/ /nad thams cad dang / mi ngas thams cad dang / yams kyi nad dang / lo nyes thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /bde zhing lo (1 )legs pa nyid du 'gyur ro/ /gang dag mtshams med pa byed pa'i sems can sdig pa can dmyal ba la gzhol ba dag gis sgra thos pa tsam gyis sdig pa thams cad byang ste/ bde bar 'chi ba'i dus byas nas bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /gos la bdugs na bdag nyid mchod pa chen po 'thob cing thams cad la dbang byed par gnas pa dang /don grub pa bla na med pa yin no/ /nor dang 'bru rab tu 'phel zhing dgos pa sgrub pa bla na med pa yin no/ /thams cad mchod pa dang / rtag tu tshig gzung ba tsho 'os par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po gang la khros pa las dgod 7cing smra bar 'gyur ro/ /bud med rnams kyi gnang chen du 3)'gyur zhing rtag tu nad med par 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu brtson 'grus dang ldan pa dang / stobs dang ldan pa dang / rtag tu dpal dang chagazi brjid dang ldan pa dang / rtag tu glang po che bcu'i stobs dang ldan pa dang / shi nas mtho ris su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis yang bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 92—706

bdag la mchis pa ni don yod pa'i zhags tu)pa'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba don yod pa'i lcags kyu'i gzungs chen po'i cho ga zhib mo'i dkyil 'khor dang / don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po dang / dkyil 'khor chen po lta ba dang / bsgrub pa dang ske/ bklags pas cha'agrub pa/ don yod pa chen po rnam par 'phrul pa/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs kyis (midam tshig grub pa lags so/ /gang gis pad+ma rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po mtha' dag dang /phyag rgya dang / rim par phye ba dang / gsang sngags dang / cho ga dang /bde bar sgrub (gepa mtha' dag ni rigs kyi spyi thams cad kyi dam tshig chen po'i rjes su 'jug pa 'grub par (5)'gyur ba lags so/ /'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs dang pad+ma'i rigs dang / rdo rje'i rigs dang / nor bu'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po 'od dpag tu 6)med pa'i snying po mchog dang po rdo rje rin po che rtse mo'i mchog dang po'i dkyil 'khor kyi dam tshig las (7)thams cad du rjes su zhugs shing dam tshig shes par 'gyur ba dang / thams cad du byin gyis brlabs (8)par 'gyur ba de rig sngags 'chang ba de thams cad mchog tu grub par bgyi ba'i phyir dang / sems can thams cad la rjes su brtse ba'i slad du bdag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'khor mang po'i dbus su bsgrag 99par bgyi'o / /rigs bzhi'i 'jig rten gyi bud med dang / skyes pa dang / khye'u dang ske/ bu mo rnams kyi sdig pa dang / sgrib pa thams cad rnam par gzhig pa'i phyir bshad par bgyi'o/ /grub pa yang dag par rjes su stsal bar bgyi'ong/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la 'di skad ces bka' stsal 92—707

to / /sems can dag pa chen po khyod kyis dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams dag cing shin tu yongs su dag pa yin te/ legs so legs so/ /rig sngags 'chang ba thams cad dang / sems can thams cad dang / dge sbyong dang / bram ze dang /rgyal rigs dang / rje'u rigs dang / dmangs rigs dang / bud med dang /skyes pa dang / khye'u dang / bu mo rnams la bstan par bya ba shod cig /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis (1)spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la rigs thams cad kyi spyi'i 2grub pa dam tshig gi rjes su 'jug par byin gyis brlabs so//ngas kyang de bzhin du ris de dag byin gyis brlabs so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thu'aphags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis (snyebacom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar don yod pa'i rgyas pa'i 6pad+ma'i snying po'i dkyil 'khor chen po bshad 97 pa/ don yod pa'i lcags kyu'i yang dag pa mchog grub (8༄ pa / sgrub 9pa dam pa ni sa dang ba'i lci bas dkyil 'khor gru bzhi bya ba ni shin tu mdzes pa shin tu 'jam por 57bya'o/ /tshon sna lngas rnam par dbye ba ni grwa tshonyadang bcas par rnam par dbye bar bya'o/ /tshon sna tshogs kyis bri ba dang /dkyil 'khor gru bzhir thig gdab nyu2pa ni mnyam par thig gis dbye bar bya ste/sgo bzhir cha dbye bar bya'o/ /chu zheng (12du zlo bzhi getshad tsam du dbye bar bya'o/ /dbus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi snying po ni tshad khru do par byas la/ tshon sna lnga'i sgal bu dang / tshon sa las dbye bar bya'o/ /dbus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi snying po la pad+ma dkar po kha bye 15ba zlum por bya'o/ /pad+ma kha bye tshaba'i dbus su zhags pa dang /lcags kyu dang / pad+ma gnas par bya ba ni klu mgo gdengs ka 'dra ba lcags kyu dang bcas pa dang / lag pa dang bcas pas pad+ma'i lcags kyus 1 tsho'adzin pa 92—708

dang / 'bar ba'i nang na 'dug par bya'o/ /tshon sna tshogs kyis bri'o/ /pad+ma kha bye 1)ba'i phyi rol gyi sgal bu ni lcags kyu dang bcas pa'i sgal bur bya'o/ /nang dang phyi'i bar du ni rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan par bya'o/ /lcags kyu'i phyi ②rol gyi sgal bu ni zla ba yid du 'ong ba dri ma med pa'i me tog gis bya'o/ /zla ba yid du 'ong ba dri ma med pa'i phyi rol gyi sgal bu ni mdung rtse gsum pa bri bar bya'o / /mdung rtse gsum pa'i phreng ba'i phyi rol gyi sgal bu ni phyag rgya phyag na thogs pa bri bar bya ste/ mtshon cha sna tshogs dang / me tog rnams so kā/ /kun la 'bar ba'i phreng ba dang / 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs bri bar bya'o/ /phyag gi phyag rgya'i phyi rol gyi sgal bu ni stegs bu dang 'dra bar bya'o/ /stegs bu'i phyi rol gyi sgal bu ni 'khor bar lcags kyu bri bar bya'o/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor gyi grwar ni rgyal po chen po (4rabazhi go bgos gepa lcags kyu dang / mdung rtse gcig pa thogs pa 'bar ba'i nang na 'dug pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan 96)pa skyil 75mo krung phyed 8)du bcas te/ pad+mo'i gdan la 'dug par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol thog thag tu 'jigs pa med pas phyag mtshan rnams thams cad pad+ma la 'dug pa 9dbyi bar bya'o/ /sgo bzhi miganas su pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams bri ba ni shar gyi sgor lag na rdo rje/ lhor ral pa gcig ma/ nub tu rdo rje lcags sgrog ma/ byang du pho nya mo dang / rig sngags kyi lha mo rnams bri bar bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol gyi sgal bu ni me tog gi stegs bu 'dra ba )smubya'o/ /phyi rol gyi dkyil 'khor ni kun du ba'i lci bas bya'o/ /phyi rol gyi dkyil 'khor de la nas phyes pad+ma bri bar bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor kun du bum pa gang ba dang / dar btags pa'i mda' dang / dri'i snod bkang bas brgyan 1 cing byug pa'i chu 92—709

dgang 0)ba dang / bdug pa'i ②sdod kyis brgyan ①pa dang / me tog sna tshogs kyis brgyan ④pa dang / dri chab dang / mchod yon gyi chab dang / 'bras bu ⑤dang —/ yon chab dang / dngul gyi me tog dang / gser gyi me tog dang /zangs kyi me tog gis 'jigs pa med par brgyan par bya'o/ /mu tig dang /byi ru dang / rin po che be+e ḍūr+ya dang rdzir/ sngon po dang / margad dang / pad+ma rā ga rnams kyis de bzhin du brgyan (7)to/ /dkyil 'khor kun du dung dang /bil ba (8༄dang / rtswa dar pokābha dang / gser dang / dngul gyis brgyan par bya'o / /dkyil 'khor gyi don du mchod pa'i phyir dkyil 'khor gyi ⑩lha bkra shis pa rnams dang / sgo bzhi'i gnas su dri chab kyi bum pa dar gyis brgyan (1te gzhag par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol thog thag tu ro sna tshogs kyi gtor ma gzhag pa dang / bum bu 'o dang / bya ma bum dang / bum pa dang / rte gu dang / kham phor spyi dang / bum pa gang ba rnams byas te gzhag go/ /pog ④phor dang / gtor ma bzang po sna tshogs dang / /me tog sna tshogs dgram par bya / /phreng ba bzang pos brgyan par bya/ /tshon sna lnga pa'i ba dan gdags/ /tshon sna lnga pa'i srad bu seng ldeng gi phur bu kyi la btags (9pa gzugs par bya(rte/kun du mar me'i 12phreng ba dang / mar me'i sdong bu bzhi yang de bzhin no/ /mkhas pas dkyil 'khor gyi 19nang du bdug pa dbul ba ni a ga ru dang /tsan+dan dang / du ru ska 2 )dang / spro 37ka rnams kyis bdug ( gepa ga bur dang /gla rtsis bsgos pa bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol gyi bdug pa ni gu gul dang /sa 2snyel ki dro stedang / kun tu ru'i sa bdug pa dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang bas gos sar (5pa bgos te/ gtsang mar byas nas maṇ+ḍal nu 7gyi 92—710

las su bya ba'i cho ga dang / lcags kyu'i rig sngags bzlas brjod bya ba dang /slob ma gzhug 6)cing dkyil 'khor gyi dam tshig dang / phyag rgya dang / ba'i rnam lnga la reg par bya ste/ mkhas pas phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags brjod cing don yod pa'i lcags kyu'i rig sngags chen po (5)ni thams cad la sbyar bar bya'o/ /mtshams bcing ba dang / phyogs bcing ba dang / spyi gtsug bcing ba dang /'jug pa dang / dam tshig dang / khrus bya ba dang / gos bgo ba dang /phyag 'tshal ba dang / bskor ba dang / de dag thams cad la sbyar bar bya'o/ /sbyin sreg sridang / bzlas brjod kyi cho ga zhi ba dang / rgyas pa dang / mngon spyod dang / dgug pa dang / spyan drang ba (4)dang / gshegs su gsol ba dang / de bzhin du yang dag par sprul pa dang / las thams cad la rig sngags 'chang bas thams cad du sbyar na myur zhing rdzogs par 'chang (5)zhing des na grub pa bla na med par 'gyur ro/ /bgrang phreng dang / mkhrig ma'i gdu yibu dang / srad bu se ral kha gtsang ma dang / rtswa (7)dar bha dang / yungs kur (2stedang / chu dang bsre ba dang / rtswa 5)dar bha'i stan la mchod phyir thogs te/skyil 7mo krung bcas /lhanas las bya zhing pad+ma dang / mchod yon gyi dkyil 'khor la dbul ba dang / de dag rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par dus thams cad du nges par bya'o/ /don yod pa'i lcags kyu'i rig sngags dran par bya ste/ grub pa mchog dang / las thams cad sgrub tu pa dang / gang dang gang dgos (snyepa la dran par bya'o/ /gsang sngags de nyid kyis slar gshegs su gsol lo/ /gsang sngags gzhan dang bsre bar mi bya ste/ phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags 'di ni dpa' bo gcig tu bklags yipas grub pa'i mchog /sangs rgyas thams 92—711

cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis 0)byin gyis brlabs pa/'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis kyang byin gyis brlabs pa ste/yang dag par 'grub cing mchog sbyin par byed pa yin no/ /don yod pa'i lcags kyu'i dkyil 'khor dam pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di mthong ba ni sdig pa thams cad rnam par 'dag (25cing sgrib pa dang / sdig pa thams cad dang / sngon gyi sgrib pa mi bzad pa rnams sngar bsags pa rnams rnam par zhig par 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten pa'i grub pa bde ba dang / 'jig rten pha rol tu 'bras bu chen po bde ba dang / shi ba'i dus byas nas bde ba can du song ste/ pad+ma'i nang nas rgyal ba'i spyan sngar rdzus ri te skye ba dang rino/ kha ton byed na tshe rabs dran par 'gyur ba dang / gang zhig 'chad pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong phrag bye ba khrag khrig snyed thams cad kyi sgo phye ste 'dug cing gang du 'dod pa der 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal ba thams cad kyis rnam par gzigs shing spyi bor phyag bzhag ste/ dbugs 'byin par mdzad cing dus kun tu bla na med pa'i byang chub tu lung ston par 'gyur ro/ /'di ni skye 55riba'i tha ma yin te/chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i bar dang / byang chub kyi snying po la 'dug gi bar du yin gyi/ gzhan du skye bar mi 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten 'di na dga' bar 'gyur zhing bla ma dang / chos can dang / nor gyi mchod pa dang / sems can kun gyis nemachod par 'os pa ni ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa bzhin du 'gyur ro/ /nor dang 'bru 'phel ba dang / gos dang rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang /rgyal po dang / btsun mor bcas pa thams cad bya ba ci yod ces bran bzhin du gnas par 'gyur ro/ /lcags kyu'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa ni phyir mi ldog pa 92—712

thob 0)par 'gyur ro/ /'di ngan 'gror yang 'gro bar mi 'gyur zhing rtag tu bde zhing dga' ba dang / sems can thams cad dga' ba dang / byams par 'gyur ro/ /lha thams cad kyis lus can shin tu bsrungs par (5)'gyur ro/ /tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug chen po rnams kyis mchod par 'gyur ro/ /bsod nams kyi phung po 'phel bar 'gyur zhing nyi ma bzhin du gzi brjid 'bar bar 'gyur ro/ /sdug cing bzang ba tsho rimachog tu blta bar 'os par 'gyur ro/ /dpal gyis dus rtag tu 'bar zhing shin tu rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig dgu bcu rtsa gnyis gang gā'i klung gi bye ma dang mnyam pa snyed kyi ( ride bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi drung nas dge ba'i rtsa ba chen po yongs su gzung (5 bar 'gyur ro/ /bsod nams chen po dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /lcags kyu'i dkyil 'khor du gang zhig zhugs pa tsam dang /dkyil 'khor de lta bu la me tog gcig dbul ba dang / ril bu gcig tsam gyi 67bdug pa dbul 57)ba'i sems can de dag ni gang gā'i 3)klung gi bye ma dgu bcu rtsa dgu pa 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig snyed kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi me tog sna tshogs kyis legs par brgyan 9par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing re rer yang gang gā'i 3 )klung gi bye ma snyed 11dgu bcu rtsa dgu 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig snyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la sna tshogs kyi /namachod pa 1 byas par 'gyur ro/ /bdug pa mang po rnam par phye ba'i sprin las tsan+dan sbrul gyi snying po dang / gor tshashir sha'i bdug pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod pa'i sprin rim par phye ba rab tu 'khrigs par 'gyur ro/ /de la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyis 15legs so zhes bya ba rab tu sbyin par 92—713

mdzad de/ rigs kyi bu legs so legs so1)/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la mchod pa 'di ni mchog tu grub pa bla na med pa yin no/ /de dag gis me tog dang ske/ bdug pas dkyil 'khor mchod pa ni bsod nams kyi phung po chen ①po'i dge ba'i rtsa ba chen po (miyongs su rdzogs pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /sgrub ④pa chen po 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug rtag tu mchog sbyin pa mdzad par 'gyur ro / /rtag tu mthong bar bzhed par 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu rjes su 'brang bar 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu don yod pa'i lcags kyu grub pa 'grub (5)par 'gyur ro/ /tshig gzung ⑥bar bya bar 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu bzhin 'dzum (7par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / gshin rje dang / chu lha dang / lus ngan po dang /gzhon nu dang / dbang phyug dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / lha'i bu rnams srung 8rib dang / sbed pa dang / skyob pa'i phyir rjes su 'brang ba chen por 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis phyag rgyas btab cing byin gyis brlabs par 'gyur ro/ /de'i sa phyogs kyang mchod rten snyam du sems shing mchod rten ring bsrel can du 'gyur ro/ /sems can gang dag de la blta ba'i phyir song ba'i sems can de dag sdig pa dang / sgrib pa dang / dug thams cad las yongs su thar bar 'gyur ro/ /'jigs pa dang / rims dang / mya ngan thams cad las bral bar 'gyur ro/ /nad dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis dgongs par 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu 'jig rten thams cad kyi (9)bla mar 'gyur ro/ /dgra thams cad las phyir rgol ba thams cad dang / mi mdza' ba'i 'jigs pa las thar 92wa 714

bar 'gyur ro/ /dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 1)'jigs pa las yongs su thar bar 'gyur ro/ /'di nas shi na (7bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /tha na ri dgas dang / bya dag gnas te phyogs su nye bar song ba de dag sgrib pa thams cad dang / de'i sngon gyi tshe la yongs su bsags pa de dag lhag ma ma lus par ( g.yongs su byang bar rtsa 'gyur ro/ /de dag thams cad bde 'gro la gzhol bar 'gyur ro/ /ngan song dang ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pa med par mthar (5)byang chub la thug gi bar du'o// //de nas don yod pa'i lcags kyu ras la sku gzugs bri ba'i cho ga brjod par bya ste/ gnas thams cad du bla na med pa grub (6)pa ni sdig pa thams cad mod la sreg ⑦par byed pa dang / nyon mongs pa thams cad 'phrog pa de bzhin du nad thams cad sel ba/ sgrib pa thams cad rnam par rinasbyong ba/ 'jigs pa thams cad las rnam par thar ba/ sems can thams cad la phan par bya ba'i phyir gang dkyil 'khor chen por kun du lung bstan pa mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa/mchog tu dkon pa yid la re ba thams cad 'phral du yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur baponye / bkra shis thams cad sgrub pa/ bsod nams thams cad sogs 7pa/myur du nor dang / 'bru sbyin par mdzad pa/ sgrub 3lhapa yang dag pa 12grub par bya ba'i phyir gsang sngags 'grub pa/ bzlas brjod 'grub pa/ yid la re ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'grub pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa bcu yongs su rdzogs pa de kho na nyid rnam par mthong ba zhes bya ba'i bsod nams chen po skye bar yo 'gyur ro/ /nam byang chub yang dag par thob gekyi bar du dge ba'i rtsa ba chen po rab tu skye bar 'gyur ro/ /don yod pa'i lcags kyu cho 'phrul chen po'i 92—715

ras kyi sku gzugs chen po mthong ba la sogs pa ni phyis ngan 'gro'i gnas su mi 'gro zhing sdig pa'i las kyis mi gos pa dang / sngon gyi sgrib pa dang / sdig pa thams cad rnam par 'jig tsho)pa dang / sdig pa thams cad rnam par sel ba dang / ngan song las thar bar 'gyur ba dang / dmyal ba mi bzad 6)pa rnams las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /tshe rabs kun du bde ba dang / da ltar gyi 'di la mchog tu dkon pa'i bde ba lhun gyis grub pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /bkren pa yang longs spyod dang / phyug po mtshungs pa med pa mchog (2)mod la thob par 'gyur ro/ /lha'i dpal thob par 'gyur ro/ /'khor bzang po bdog par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po rnams kyis bla mar bya zhing rtag tu dus thams cad du mchod par 'os par 'gyur ro/ /dge sbyong dang / bram ze dang / rgyal rigs dang /rje'u rigs dang / dmangs rigs dang / bud med dang / skyes pa rnams rtag tu dbang du bya ste/ sdug (4cing thams cad bsnyen bkur 55)byed cing 'dug 6)pa ni ras kyi 7sku gzugs la mchod pa bla na med pa yin no/ /ras gru bzhi khyon kun khru gang ngam/ khru do pa la legs par btags (85pa/ ras 'jam ༄9)po thag boran bzang po mnyen 11po shin tu dag par bkrus pa gtsang mar byas pa'am/yang na dar yug gam/ yang na mon dar ramacho nya/ shun phrags la zla ba yar gyi tshes bcwa 18lnga tshang ba'i bar du ras kyi sku gzugs bla na med pa bri bar bya'o/ /snod gtsang ma sar 1 pa'i nang du tshon lhag ma ma yin pa blugs te/ ras kyi sku gzugs gsal bar bri ba 15ni tshon sna tshogs kyis rnam par dbye bar bya'o/ /dbus su 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mgon po bri ba ni skyil tshamo krung 1 bcas te bzhugs pa/ spyan gsum pa/ zhal gsum pa/ mchog tu 92—716

bzang ba/ zhal dang po ni mdzes shing sdug pa/ dbu lcang lo dang thor tshugs kyis brgyan 1)pa/ cod pan la 'od dpag med kyis brgyan (na pa/ dbu skra 'khyil bar bya'o/ /me tog gi phreng (geb bcing bar bya'o/ /phreng ba'i gong du 'od dpag med bya'o/ /cod pan la zla ba phyed pa dang 'od 'dom gang bya'o/ /kun du lcags kyu bya'o/ /kun du 'bar ba'i phreng ba bya'o/ /phyag bzhi la phyag g.yon na pad+ma'i lcags kyu g.yas na mdung rtse gsum pa'i lcags kyu/ g.yon gcig na don yod pa'i zhags pa'i lcags kyu/ g.yas gcig na rdo rje lcags kyu dbugs 'byin par bya'o/ /gdan seng ge'i pad+mo bya'o/ /g.yon du lha mo sgrol ma'o / /g.yas su dkar mo ste/ me tog sna tshogs thogs pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal du lta ba rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa pa/ pad+ma la bzhugs pa6/'bar ba'i nang na bzhugs par bya'o/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi rgyab tu rin po che'i shing lcug phran dang / yal ga dang / chas pa 7rin po che sna tshogs kyis spras par bya'o/ /ne tso dang / ri skegs 8dang / shang shang te'u (9dang / rma bya dang / bya ka la ping ka rin po che'i gseb na rgyu bar bya'o / /shing gi gong spyi bo la khang bu rtseg 1 ma dang bcas pa'i gzhal med khang gi nang du de bzhin gshegs pa gsum rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa bzhugs par bya'o / /spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi g.yon du srin mo ral pa gcig ma bya'o/ /g.yas su lag na rdo rje khros pa'i gad mo 'byin pa'i gzugs mche ba gtsigs 11pa skra gyen du brjes pa/ lcang lo dang cod pan gyis brgyan pa/ rdo rje thogs shing rdo rje gsor ba/ nam mkha' la blta bar 12bya'o/ /smad du gshin rje dang /chu lha dang / lus ngan po dang / gzhon nu dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi bya'o/ /92—717

gong du dbang po dang / dbang phyug dang / dbang phyug chen po lha'i bu bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byed pa bya'o/ /g.yas phyogs su tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug chen po rnams btud de/ bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byed pa'o/ /g.yon du dga' bo dang / bsnyen dga' bo dang / klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho rnams bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byed pa'o/ /g.yas kyi gnas gcig tu rig sngags 'chang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi zhabs drung du pus mo btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal du lta zhing me tog sna tshogs kyi sdong bu dang / pog phor dang / bgrang phreng lag na thogs pa 6)bya'o / /phyogs bzhi ngos kun du ris bskor ba la ri dgas kyi tshogs sna tshogs kyis gang ba/ shing sna tshogs me tog dang / lcug ma can bya'o/ / rdzing bu chu zags pa bya'o/ /(ge'abras bu sna tshogs can gyi shing dang lcug ma bya'o/ /gnas so sor drang srong rnams dang / grul bum gyi shing bya'o/ /tshul de ltar don yod pa'i lcags kyu ras la bris te/ gnas gtsang ma dben par bzhag la rig sngags 'chang bas 'bad pa chen pos mchod par bya'o/ /a ga 95)ru dang / du ru ska ④dang / tsan+dan gyi bdug (35pa dbul bar bya'o/ /ci nus par don yod pa'i lcags kyu'i rig pa'i rgyal po bzlas brjod bya'o/ /nyi ma re re ras la sku gzugs bris pa mthong ba tsam gyi (6rimod la mtshams med pa lnga la sogs pa'i sdig pa dang /sgrib pa dang / mnar med par gzhol ba dang / dam pa'i chos spong ba rnams yongs su dag cing zad par 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa dang / sdug bsngal gyi 'jigs pa mi bzad pa dang / nad thams cad yongs su zad pa dang / rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /rnam par 'jig 92—718

par 'gyur ro/ /dri ma dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /ser sna dang phrag dog dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /gzungs 6)grub pa chen po so (gesor thob par 'gyur ro/ /mthong ba tsam gyi (5)mod la de ma thag (4)tu 'bras bu chen po rnyed pa rgya chen por 'gyur ro/ /lan 'ga' yang log par ltung bar 'gro bar (7mi 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mthong ba thob par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis dgongs par 'gyur ro/ /lha thams cad kyis rgyun du bsrung zhing yirjes su gzung (7)bar 'gyur ro/ /ras kyi sku gzugs 'di'i 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mthong ba tsam gyis 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal 8)mngon (9༄du mthong ba dang 'dra bar rig par bya'o/ /gang zhig ras kyi sku gzugs 'di la legs par 'gyur ba'i tshul gyis bya ba byed pa dang / mchod pa dang / bsnyen bkur yibyed pa de ni phyogs bcu kun gyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang gā'i nyunyaklung gi bye ma dgu bcu 12rtsa dgu dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig snyed kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing la mchod par 'gyur ro/ /de nas rang rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing na nye rab tu bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gi bsod nams kyi phung po chen po yongs su gzung nyinabar 'gyur ro/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya chen po dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phyir mi ldog pa'i gnas thob par 'gyur ro/ /dge ba'i 'basam pa yongs su dag pa chen po dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis rig sngags 'chang thams cad grub par bgyi ba'i phyir dang / sems can gyi 92—719

don dang / phan pa dang / bde bar bgyi ba'i phyir dang / sdig pa dang /sgrib pa thams cad las yongs su grol bar bgyi ba'i phyir don yod pa'i lcags kyu'i tsho17rig sngags kyi rgyal po rim par phye ba rnams bstan pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das yang bdag la mchis pa ni don yod pa'i lcags kyu'i khro bo'i (gergyal po'i tshon dkyil 'khor te(4ri/ rig sngags 'chang thams cad kyi (5)khro bo chen po'i las grub pa mchog ri tu 'gyur ba dang / bsam pa dang / yid la re ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ba dang / ma rungs pa brtson pa med pa/ brtse ba'i bsam pa med pa ni gnod sbyin dang / srin po thams cad dang / 'byung po dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang / mi ma yin pa thams cad thag tsho sku'ajug pa/ ma rungs pa'i bgegs dang / log 'dren thams cad rab tu dul bar mdzad pa/bdud la sogs pa ma rungs pa thams cad rab tu zhi ba dang / phung bar byed pa/sems can ma rungs pa thams cad skrag par byed pa/ phyir rgol ba dang /dgra thams cad 'ching ba dang / gcod 58pa dang / 'bigs pa dang / rdung (9ba dang / gtor ba dang / lus rnam par zhig par byed pa de ni1 tsho/ bcom ldan 'das 'dir bdag gis pad+mo rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po cho ga zhib mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi skabs su bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'khor mang po'i nang du don yod pa'i khro bo'i lcags kyu 1lhabarjod par bgyi ste/dkyil 'khor dang cho ga zhib mo thams cad du srung 12bar byed pa 'chos 32par byed pa/ dam tshig 'dzin pa gnas thams cad la rjes su skyong ba ste/ de ni sgrub par byed pa/ sgrub sapa 'grub gepar byed pa'i mchog de bcom ldan 'das 92—720

kyis thugs brtse ba chen po'i (17slad du bcom ldan 'das khro bo'i rgyal po chen po byin gyis brlab cing (2rjes su gnang ba mdzod cig dang / rig sngags 'chang ri thams cad mchog tu 'grub pa'i snying po dag sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par bgyi ba'i slad du bcom ldan 'das rjes su stsal bar bgyi'o/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug phyag rgya chen pos phyag rgyas btab ste/ ngas kyang byin gyis brlabs so / /sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis kyang phyag rgyas btab cing byin gyis brlabs kyis 5cismros shig /spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug rig sngags 'chang thams cad gsang ba pa lag 9rin rdo rje dang / rdo rje 'chang ba dang / rdo rje'i snying po thams cad dam tshig la gnas pa'i lha dang / klu dang /gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang 7/mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po thams cad kyis yongs su bzung 8ba smros shig /spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug rig sngags 'chang thams cad kyi bsam pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i go skabs dang / mchog grub par byos shig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis bcom ldan 'das kyis bkas bsgo zhing dbugs phyung ba thos 9nas snying dga' / smin ma bskums/ dpral ba phyed khros par byas/ gdong khro gnyer du byas / mche ba ni gtsigs/ spyan ras gzigs kyi 1 lus 'khor mang po'i nang du bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug nas don yod pa'i zhags pa 11khro bo'i 92—721

rgyal po 'di smras pa/ dus gsum na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / 'phags pa rdo rje 'chang ba dang / dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'das pa dang /ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i rang (1nyesangs rgyas dang / 'phags pa nyan thos kyi dge 'dun rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang dag par song ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang dag ( ri par zhugs pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sha (5)ra dwa ti'i bu blo gros can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /drang srong chen po'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo / /rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur ba byams pa la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khams gsum pa'i bdag po nag po chen po (4)ma mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khro bo'i rgyal po rig sngags kyi rgyal po chen po'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tat+ya 95)bā/ oṃ bi kṛ 65ta/ ba da ri nyen/ma hā gro dha rā dzā bha 58)yo ka ra/ ma hā rdas/ aṣ+ṭas hā (9)sabo/ dz+wa la dz+wa 1nyal ma hā dz+wa 12la/ mā la ma hā ro dra/rte/ rū pa ⑩bha yaṃ ka ra na/ ha na ha na/sarba duṣ+ṭa/ yak+ṣa/ rāk+ṣa snanas/ da ha da ha/ sarba duṣ+ṭa/ nā gā nān⑩/pa tsa pa tsa/ sarba duṣ+ṭa/ birgyu 1 mobi nā ya kān/ pā ta ya/ pā ta ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭa satā rna1snye/ bho bho /rtem hā kro dha rā dza/ ma ṇi ri tre tshoka na ka / badz+ra/ be+e ḍūr+ya ste/a lang kṛ na ti/ sha rī rānas / badz+ra pa ra shu pā sha hastu ri ciya/ ma hā pad+ma 9 snye.ang ku sha /bhu dzā ya/ ma hā pad+ma ā sa nā ya/ ma hā pad+ma bi ka tsa gaṅgā ya/ a mo 92—722

gha a pra ti ha ta/ ba la pa rā 6)kra mā ya/ sa ha (bsra/ bit+yā ④ya/ sarba bhū ( canata / bha zhi)yo ka rā ya/ sarba de ba bha ba na/ kā 6)ma pa uta (7)snya bā ya/ ma hā bi kṛ (7ta/ ba da nā ya/ nā 5)ra sing ha mu khā ya/ dha ra dha ra/ badz+ra dz+wa kyil/dhu ru dha (nyeru/ ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa/ be ga dha (ster/ tsa ra tsa ra tsa tsa ra tsa tsa ra/ni shā tsi tsor/ yī shwa yir/ skṛ tsoku ṭī 0mu kha/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ sa ra sa ra/pra sa 8pra sa ra/ sarba pā pa/ kilpi (sheṣa ha char/ ma hā ma ṇi8 )/ te dza dha ri 1)ra/pad+ma hasta/ oṃ pad+ma ang ku sha bhu dze/ ta rā ya/ man+t+ra nu ma ya/ bisdi snye/ shā sa ya/ duṣ+ṭa ༷ sten nā sha sgo ya/ sarba pā pā 3)ba ra ṇa tsho zhes phaṭa swā hā/ pā 28sha hastu ( rteya swā hā/ pad+ma dha rā ri )ya swā hā/ sa mā (1shā sa kā (2ya swā hā/ a mo gha ba sa ra dha ri rā ya swā hā/ kro dha rā dza khrisnobha yaṃ ka rā ya swā hā/ brah+ma be ṣa dha rā ya swā hā/ tre+e rme rilo kya pū dzi tā ya swā zhu tshohā/ ya ma/ ba ru ṇa/ ku be (snyer/ na maḥ kṛ tā 6ya swā hā/ badz+ra dha ra pu dzi tā ( )ya swā hā/ ma hā kā la mā dṛ chortag ṇa/ ban 2di ta(rte/ pū 'dzi tā ya swā hā/ de ba ga ṇa69/ ban dhi tā 9ya swā hā/ nā ga ā kuts+tsha 6 7ya swā hā/ oṃ bha ra bha ra/ bhi ri bhi ri/ bhu ru bhu ru/ sarba maṇ+ḍa tshal a dhiṣ+ṭha ta 4tshes ma ya swā hā/ sarba mu dā ci )a dhiṣ+ṭha ta mu drwa yi tsha1swā hā/ oṃ a mo gha ba ra snye de/ ma hā dosdig / e ku thu risha badz+re ni rgyu/ ma hā pad+ma/ ā shwa 55sa dha ra na mo stu te a mo gha e ku sha hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ khro bo'i rgyal po chen po'i gzungs 'di smras pa dang / lha'i gnas dang bcas pa dang / ri rab dang bcas pa'i rgya mtsho ce phoganas dang bcas pa dang / gzhal med khang rnams kun tu 'gul lo/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams rnam pa drug tu nisnyegayos so/ /ma rungs pa'i klu dang / lha ma yin dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po 59dang /92wa 723

'byung po dang / sha za thams cad dang / bdud la sogs pa dang / log 'dren ma rungs pa dang / gdon 1rim rungs pa rnams kha bub getu 'gyel lo/ /ma rungs pa thams cad kyi khyim kun du tshig ste ri'abar ba/ kun du 'bar/rab tu 'bar/ 'bar ba gcig tu gyur cing bsregs pa dang / ngu zhing 'gre ④ldog ste/ tshor ba drag po mi bzad pa chen po myong ngo / /lha thams cad shin tu 'khrugs shing skrag go/ /bdud kyi rigs rnams byed nas khas btags (geso/ /'jig rten gsum gyi bdag po thams cad kun du 'khrugs so/ /rgya mtshor gnas pa'i klu dang / rgya mtsho'i klu chen po dga' bo dang / bsnyen dga' bo dag kyang kun du 'khrugs shing shin tu skrag ste snying 'dar ro/ /gzhan yang sa'i steng na klu stong phrag brgya gnas pa dang / rgya mtsho'i 6chu'i nang gi klu gang dag dang / ri la gnas pa gang yin pa de dag thams cad kun du 'khrugs ri7)skrag cing (8)gcig tu 'bar bar gyur 9cing gdungs so/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi rnams gnas na 'dug na yang skrag go/ /nag po chen po dang / tshogs chen po'i gtso bo dang /ma mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba de dag thams cad skrag cing snying 'dar ro/ /gnas la brten 1 pa'i bdud kyi gnas rnams 'dar ro/ /'bar kun du 'bar te gnas dang bcas par sreg 11go/ /de nas 'khor de'i nang gi lha dang / klu rnams bcom ldan 'das kyi steng rol nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa bya ba'i phyir me tog sna tshogs 'thor ro/ /lha rdzas kyi rgyan spud pa sna tshogs dang / chos gos kyi char pa 'bebs so/ /mchod pa'i las byed cing tsan+dan gyi chu'i char pas sa la chag chag 'debs so/ /lha rdzas kyi gser dang / dngul gyi me tog dang /rin po che sna bdun rnam pa sna tshogs kyi char pas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa 92—724

byed do/ /de nas gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po phyag (2)na rdo rje lus 'bar zhing rdo rje gsor te/ shin tu 'gying bag tu seng ge'i 'gros kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ga la ba de logs su song ste nye bar phyin nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bcom ldan 'das spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas(2no / zla ba yid du 'ong ba dri ma med pa'i me tog gi rin po che sna tshogs kyis spras pa'i phreng ba bcom ldan 'das phyag na pad+ma la phul te/ zla ba yid du 'ong ba dri ma med pa'i me tog gi phreng ba rin po che sna tshogs kyis spras pa 'di dbul dalongs spyod pa'i phyir dang / bdag la thugs brtse ba'i slad du gethugs rje chen po na)bzhes su gsol/ gang gis bdag yun ring por phan pa dang / bde bar 'gyur lags so/ /khro bo chen po'i yang chen po bshad cing gang dran pa tsam gyis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams rnam pa drug tu g.yos so/ /gang dag bdud ma rungs pa dang / gang dag klu ma rungs pa dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / 'byung po dang / sha za ma rungs pa dang / log 'dren ma rungs pa rnams khyim dang bcas te/ lus kun du tshig cing rab tu 'bar nas kha bub 6tu 'gyel cing sreg 7go/ /shi la thug pa dang srog skams 8par 'gyur ba'i 9)don yod pa'i lcags kyu 1 7khro bo'i 11rgyal po ni dus thams cad du mgo'i spyi bor blang bar bgyi'o/ / bcang ngo / /bsgom 12mo/ /mchod do/ /rgyas par bgyi'o/ /rig sngags 'chang gang 1 gi lag na khro bo'i rgyal po 'chang bar 'gyur ba dang / rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mo dang / dge slong dang dzes/ dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma dang / dge 92—725

sbyong dang / bram ze dang / rgyal rigs dang / rje'u rigs dang / dmangs rigs kyi lag na thogs pa'am/ lus la thogs pa'am/ lta ba'am/ dri ①ba'am / tha na khro bo'i rgyal po nyan pa tsam de yang bcom ldan 'das bdag gis khur du bkur (5kyibar bgyi'o/ /spyi bos blang (5)bar bgyi'o/ /bsrung 6)bar bgyi'o / /yongs su bskyang (5)bar bgyi'o/ /bsam pa dang / yid la re ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bgyi'o/ /grub pa chen po'i chen po rjes su stsal bar bgyi'o/ /gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / bgegs dang / log 'dren ma rungs pa thams cad so sor bsal phyirabar bgyi'o/ /rtag tu rjes su 'brang 7rizhing bsrung 8ba dang / bskyab pa dang / sba bar bgyi'o/ /rtag tu dus thams cad du mthong ba rjes su stsal bar bgyi'o/ /rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par yo byad thams cad kyis (9)mi brel cing phun sum tshogs par yongs su bskyang bar bgyi'o/ /lus la stobs dang / brtson 'grus dang / gzi brjid bskyed cing bsod nams dang / ye shes kyi grogs bgyi'o/ /dgra thams cad so sor bsal 7bar bgyi'o11/ /nor dang / 'bru dang / bza' ba dang / btung ba dang / gos dang / spud pa dang / rgyan rjes su stsal bar bgyi'o/ /bu gcig pa 'dra bar rjes su bskyang bar bgyi'o/ /dad pa dang / gus pas dus kun du mchog tu mos par bgyi'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis sna gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces khyod kyis khas blangs pa mchog (1 ri tu bzang po byas pa 'di legs so legs so zhes smras te/ lag pa g.yas pa brkyang nas zla ba yid du 'ong ba dri ma med pa'i me tog gi phreng ba rin po che sna tshogs kyis spras pa blangs te/92—726

lag na rdo rje la rjes su brtse ba'i phyir dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis yongs su longs spyad 91)pa'i phyir dang / dkyil 'khor na (miganas pa'i lha thams cad kyis yongs su longs spyad (7pa'i phyir dang / lha dang / klu dang /gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang /mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang / mi ma yin pa thams cad dkyil 'khor gang yin pa 'dir 'dug cing dam tshig la gnas pa rnams yongs su longs spyad ri47pa'i phyir ji lta ba bzhin du 'dug ste(5)/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu'i gong du gtor ro/ /de nas phreng ba de nam mkha' (6)de la gtor ma thag tu phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi (7)dbu'i steng du zla ba yid du 'ong ba/ dri ma med pa'i me tog de khang bu brtsegs pa/ rin po che sna tshogs kyis spras pa/ 'od 'tsher ba/ ka ba bzhi dang / sgo bzhi legs par rnam par 'byes na pa/ gru bzhi lham pa/ chu zheng shin tu rgya che ba/ shin tu nang 9yangs pa / me tog ka khod l+ya 11dag gis mdzes pa/ gzhal med khang sna tshogs nyu2yongs 1 su gyur te gnas so/ /de dag byang chub sems dpa'i snyadabu'i steng thad gar yang 15de bzhin du zla ba yid du 'ong ba dri ma med pa'i me tog rin po che sna tshogs kyis tshespras pa'i khang bu brtsegs pa'i gzhal med khang du shin tu gnas so/ /de'i sna lag na rdo rje'i /shedabu'i steng gi thad kur yang zla ba yid du 'ong ba dri ma med pa'i 1/me tog khang bu brtsegs par shin tu gnas so/ /de 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi steng thog thag tu yang zla ba yid du 'ong ba'i dri ma med pa'i me tog khang bu brtsegs pa rdu rinor bu rin po che chen po sna tshogs kyis spras pa me tog ka da lus mdzes par byas te gnas so/ /khang bu brtsegs pa'i nye 92—727

'khor kun gshin rje dang / chu lha dang / lus ngan po dang / dga' bo dang /nye dga' bo dang / dbang phyug dang / dbang phyug chen po 51)lha'i bu dang /tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug chen po rnams lag na rnga yab thogs nas g.yob cing 'dug go/ /de dag kyang 'khor 'dus pa chen po mang pos yongs su bskor cing mdun du byas so/ /dkyil 'khor gyi rig pa'i rgyal po'i lha de dag thams cad kyang nam mkha' la zla ba yid du 'ong ba dri ma med pa'i me tog khang bu brtsegs nasapa'i phreng ba rin po che sna tshogs kyis spras pa'i )khang bu brtsegs la pa'i nang na 'khod pa ni nyi ma dang zla ba spa ba bzhin dang / nam mkha' la zla ba nya ba ni 55rgyu skar dang / skar ma'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba spa ba bzhin du spa bar gnas so/ /me tog de dag gi (nenang na lha rdzas kyi 75zla ba yid du 'ong ba dri ma med pa'i me tog sna tshogs dang / lha rdzas kyi pad+ma dang /ku mu da nadang / puṇ+ḍa rī 9)ka dang / man dā 1 ra ba dang / ma hā man dā 11ra ba dang / me tog ro tsa dang / ma hā ro tsa dang / me tog sa la dang / tā la ka 12dang / me tog ta ma la dang / tsam pa ka dang / me tog a dhi muka nyu ta dang / me tog a sho ka dang / me tog pa ta la dang / me tog nī nyu la dang /ma lahā nī sal dang / me tog gan dha bar+ṣa 1 ka dang / me tog su man dang /ta ra ṇa 1 dang / ku ya ku'i me tog gi 19char gyi rgyun phab bo/ /bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa dang / dkyil 'khor chen po la mchod pa'i phyir dang / lha rdzas kyi chos gos spud pa dang rgyan sna tshogs kyi char ji srid du char 'bab cing phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod do/ /de ltar na cho 'phrul che ba'i che ba dag snang ngo / /rol mo'i sgra yan lag lnga pa dag kyang ma 92—728

brdungs par nam mkha' la sgra 'byung (1ngo // //'phags pa don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po'i cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po/bam po nyi shu bzhi pa/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ sems can dag pa chen po mchog tu dkon pa'i khro bo'i rgyal po 'di smras te/ rig sngags 'chang thams cad mchog tu grub par bya ba'i phyir ma rungs pa thams cad 'joms pa/ sdig pa thams cad sreg pa bshad pa legs so legs so/ /'di ni phyi ma'i na dus na rig sngags 'chang ba rnams kyis lan cig dzo dran pa tsam gyis dgos pa thams cad byed par 'gyurari kyi / yid la re ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mthong ba 5sbyin par 'gyur/ gnas thams cad gtogs pa'i grub pa 6chen po rab tu ston par 'gyur/ rig sngags 'chang ba rnams kyis yangs shing rgya che ba'i chen po thams cad byed par 'gyur/ phyi ma'i tshe phyi ma'i dus na 'di ni 'jig rten las 'das pa gcig po mchog 'grub par 'gyur te/ las grub 7pa yang dag par grub napa'i phyir ro/ /de nas khros pa'i gad rgyangs spyi gtsug 9'bar ba zhes bya ba'i gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po gnod sbyin chen po stong phrag brgya'i bdag po stobs che ba/ dpung che ba 10brtan zhing pha rol gnon pa chen po gang gis 11lag mthil gcig gis ri'i rgyal po lhun po chen po 12'gul bar byed pa lha'i gnas gzhal med khang dang bcas te/rgya mtsho chen po na gnas te/ 'khor bye ba phal po che dang ldan pa/ drag po gzi brjid drag po stobs che ba/ pha rol gyi dpung 'joms par byed pa de stan las 92—729

langs nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su song ste nye bar phyin nas/bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la btud de 6)'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis khro bo'i rgyal po chen po'i gzungs rig sngags kyi rgyal po shin tu mi bzad (snyepa'i gsang sngags bshad pas ni bcom ldan 'das gzhal med khang dang bcas pa bsregs so/ /gnod sbyin du ma stong phrag bye ba khrag khrig 'khor dang bcas pa 'bar ba gcig tu gyur te bsregs so / /bcom ldan 'das bdag ni zhigs te (5)tshig cing zhu bar gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das de la bdag gis ji ltar bsgrub par bgyi/ bdag la skyob pa su lags/ dpung gnyen du 'gyur ba su lags/ bcom ldan 'das bdag ni srog rnam par zhig go/ /dus ④kyi zhags pas bcings so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag la phan 75)gdags su gsol/ bde bar gshegs pa bdag la bskyab yiku gsol / de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas khros pa'i gad rgyangs spyi gtsug 'bar ba gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen tsunapo la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po khyod ma 'jigs par khro bo'i rgyal po lcags kyu'i dkyil 'khor gyi rjes su song shig(nas /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la skyabs su nye bar song shig59 /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 'di ni khyod kyi skyabs dang / dpung gnyen dang /skyob pa dang / rten du 'gyur te/ gang gis 'khor gyi tshogs dang bcas pa'i 92—730

gnod sbyin 0)stong phrag brgya'i srog dang bral bar mi 'gyur ba yin no/ /kye gnod sbyin chen po myur ba myur bar song ste skyabs su 'gro bar byos shig /de nas khros pa'i gad rgyangs gtsug phud la'abar ba'i zhuganod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po bcom ldan 'das kyis dbugs phyung ba rtogs nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lispyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ga la ba de logs su song ste/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la ngu zhing brgyal (5)nas lag pa brkyang ste (6)zhabs la btud nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag bskyab (7)tu gsol/ thugs rje chen po bdag bskyab tshoshetu gsol/ bdag la srog stsal bar 5)mdzad du gsol/bcom ldan 'das bdag ni bsregs shing gcig tu 'bar bar gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das gnod sbyin du ma stong phrag brgya 7bye ba 'khor dang bcas pa srog dang 'bral bar 'gyur ro/ /shes pa ni stor nya/ stobs dang brtson 'grus spro bar byed pa ni nyams na/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gi hu lus su zhig gso bar bgyid/byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis khros pa'i gad rgyangs spyi gtsug nyunye'abar ba'i gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to / /kye gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po nyon cig /nga 'ji srid ston gyi bar du yud tsam zhig sdod cig /gnod sbyin gyi bdag po khyod kyis 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can mang po la rnam par gtse bar byas/ khyod kyis bud med dang /skyes pa dang / khye'u tshadang / bu mo mang po ni zos na khyod kyis 'phags pa'i spyan mang po ni nyams par byas/ khyod kyis rig sngags dang / dkyil 'khor dang ske/ cho ga zhib mo mang po'i bar chad ni byas/ grub pa rnams ni med par 92—731

byas / ma grub pa rnams kyang med par byas/ skal ba can mang po ni med par byas / skal ba med pa ni yod par byas/ mi 'tshe 6)ba dang / srog dang longs spyod kyi bde ba ni med par byas/ 'tshe ba dang srog rnam par 'jig pa ni 'phel bar byas/ khyod kyis legs par bshad pa ni yongs su bor/ khyod kyis nyes par bshad pa dang / ser sna ni mang du byas/ rig sngags 'chang thams cad dang / sems can thams cad la khyod nag po dang / rnam par 'jig dzoltapar rab tu gnas/ khyod kyis /ringan sems ri༄thams cad ni spel(5ci/ khyod kyis dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams ni nub par byas/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na khyod shin tu mi bzad 6pa sdig pa can yin/ gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi (7riganas dang bcas / bdud dang bcas/ tshangs pa dang bcas pa'i nang na khyod gcig pu ngan sems can bar chad byed par skyes pa yin te/ rgyu des na gnas skabs 'di 'dra ba thob pa yin pas kye gnod sbyin gyi bdag po dam tshig dang / bslab tshon pa dang / sdom pa khas blang ba 59ridang / dge ba'i chos byos shig /'on kyang 3 kho bo khyod kyi 11skyabs dang / dpung gnyen du 'gyur bar bya'o/ /khyod sdug bsngal bas nyam 12thag pa dang / bcings pa mi bzad pa dang / me 'bar ba mi bzad pa'i 'jigs pa las ngas 12yongs su thar bar bya'o/ /mtho ris 3 kyi lam du 'jug par bya'o/ /de nas khros pa'i gad rgyangs spyi gtsug 'bar ba gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po 'khor gnod sbyin bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du mas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi zhabs gnyis la btud nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom 92—732

ldan 'das deng slan chad byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug khyod kyi bka' lung bzhin bgyis te dam tshig la gnas par bgyi'o/ /chos kyi rjes su sems pa (1)dang / dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchis pa la gnas par bgyi'o/ /khro bo'i rgyal po 'di dang / rig sngags kyi rgyal po lcags kyu'i gzungs 2nodang / cho ga zhib mo dang / gang yang rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mo dang / dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang /dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma rnams yongs su bskyang bar bgyi'o/ /don yod pa'i lcags kyu'i gzungs rig sngags kyi rgyal po 'di 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / 'don pa dang / bzlas brjod kyi cho ga kun spyod pa de la ni bdag gnod sbyin brgya stong du ma rnams kyis 'og dang / bla dang / phyogs bzhi kun du bsod nams su dmigs te/ bsrung 4ba dang / sba ba dang / bskyab 5par bgyi'o / /yongs su bskyang bar bgyi'o/ /lus la stobs dang / spro ba dang /gzi byin mang du bskyed 6)par bgyi'o/ /7de'i yul phyogs su 'thab pa dang /rtsod 8 pa dang / 'gyed pa dang / mtshang 'dru 9ba dang / ma legs pa dang /lo nyes dang / mi ngas dang / rims dang / gnod pa dang / 'khrug 1 tshopa dang / nyam 11thag par byed pa'i gdon dang bcas pa dang / nad dang /gcong lha dang / nyon mongs pa dang / sgrib pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar bgyi'o / /rab tu bsal 12bar bgyi'o/ /rkun po dang / zol po 1 dang / mi rgod dang / gcan gzan 15khro bo'i 'jigs pa rnams khobasal bar bgyi'o/ /dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa las so sor bzlog par bgyi'o/ /rmi lam ngan pa dang / ltas 1 ngan pa dang / bkra mi shis pa byung ba thams cad so sor 92—733

bzlog par bgyi'o/ /char ches (1)pa dang / char mi 'bab pa (snyedang / dus ma yin pa'i char dang / sad dang / than pa dang / byi ba'i 'jigs pa rnams so sor bsal bar bgyi'o/ /dben pa dang / nyams dga' ba dang / lo legs pa dang / 'byor pa sbyar bar bgyi'o/ /sems can mi dge ba spyod pa las bzlog par bgyi'o/ /dge ba la sbyor bar bgyi'o/ /sems can dge ba spyod pa rnams kyi grogs bdag 'khor dang bcas pas bgyi'o/ /yang dag par dad pas rjes su 'brang bar (5)bsgrub par bgyi'o/ /bud med dang / skyes pa dang / khye'u dang / bu mo dang / dge sbyong dang / bram ze dang / sems can thams cad bu gcig pa bzhin du yongs su bskyang 4)bar bgyi'o/ /chos la zhugs pa'i yid dang / ngo tsha shes pa dang / khrel yod pas gnas par bgyi'o/ /thams cad 55du bdag mchi bar bgyi'o/ /ji ltar rang gi srog 'di yongs su bskyang ba bzhin du gzungs dang / rig sngags grub pa 'di yang yongs su bskyang bar bgyi'o/ /spyi bos blang bar du rabagyi'o/ /khur du bkur (7)bar bgyi'o/ / sgrub par na'agrub pa chen po stsal bar bgyi'o/ /bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad dang / sems can ma rungs pa dang / gnod sbyin chad pas 595so sor bzlog par bgyi'o/ / de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis khro bo'i tshegad rgyangs spyi gtsug 'bar ba gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po legs so legs so/ /khyod kyis de bzhin du bya bar rigs 11so/ /sems can thams cad rjes su gzung nyu2ba chen pos gzung 3)bar bya'o/ /rig sngags 'chang ba la bdag nyid kyis bsrung rngub dang / bcang 92—734

bar bya'o/ /de nas gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen 6)po de skyabs gsum la gnas shing dkyil 'khor chen po'i dam tshig dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i bslab pa'i tshig 'dzin pa la gnas par gyur to/ /rigs 9)thams cad kyi dam tshig dang ldan par gyur to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa (5)spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /yon tan gyi phung po mchog tu bzang ba la gnod sbyin gyi bdag po khas len du bcug cing bzhag pa legs so legs so/ / khro bo'i (gergyal po'i cho ga nye bar spyad pa de smros shig /rig sngags 'chang de rnams ji ltar mchog 'grub par 'gyur ba dang / lan cig dran (5)pa tsam gyis ji lta 46)ji ltar myur ba myur bar las sgrub pa 'grub par 'gyur ba 7nodang /ji ltar dran pa tsam gyis ji ltar bsams rinadapa dang / yid la re ba 'byor par 'gyur ba dang / don yod pa'i lcags kyu'i khro bo'i 9༄rgyal po 'di myur du 'grub par 'gyur ba de ltar byin gyi rlabs kyis 7byin gyis rlobs shig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' lung stsal ba rtogs nas nye bar bshad pa'i cho ga smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das rig sngags 'chang ba/ rigs kyi bu'am / rigs kyi bu mo'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma gang yin pa'am / gzhan dge sbyong dang / bram ze dang / rgyal rigs dang / rje'u rigs dang / dmangs rigs dang / bud med dang / skyes pa dang / khye'u dang / bu mo rnams khro bo'i rgyal po 'di bsgrub par 'dod na/ de nya1zla ba yar gyi ngo'i / tshes bcwa nyu lnga la 'bras 'chan dang / 'o ma za zhing nang par sngar langs 92—735

la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sku gzugs kyi spyan sngar skyil mo krung 1bcas te 'dug nas mi smra bar gaṇ+ḍi brdung (geba'i dus la bab kyi bar du 'bras chan khyor ba bkang ste/ gtor ma brgya rtsa brgyad dbul ba (5༄byas na/des (4rikhro bo'i rgyal po sgrub 95pa'i cho ga de dag 'grub par 'gyur zhing mchog tu 'grub ne par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar bsgrubs nas de nas dzo ribazlas brjod gcig dang / dran pa gcig gis thams cad du 'grub par byas na thams cad du bya ba thams cad mchog tu 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang ba las byed par 'dod cing / don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po sgrub par 'dod na khro bo'i rgyal po lan cig 8dran par bya'o/ /dran pa tsam gyi mod la bgegs dang /log 'dren thams cad skrag par 'gyur zhing dpag tshad tshun chad du rig sngags 'chang ba'i drung du 'ong bar mi nus te/ rgyang ring po ring po ri9 rin 'dug go/ /'di lan cig 1 dran pa tsam gyis bzlas brjod dang / cho ga dang / sgrub nyu1pa bde bar 'grub cing dgos pa sgrub pa thams cad grub pa bla na med pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mchog sbyin pa 12mdzad par 'gyur ro/ /dpag tshad tshun chad du 'bar ba'i lcags kyu chen po 'phang 1snyedu ri chen po tsam 'byung bar 'gyur te/ dpag tshad gsum gyi tshad tsam dang /'og tu g.yang sar gyur te/ su yang 'ong mi nus so/ /lha dang / klu dang /gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang /mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye 7chen po dang / mi dang /da mi ma yin pa dang bcas pas gnas der 'ong bar mi nus na/ mi ma yin pa phal pa dang /bgegs dang log 'dren rnams kyis 7lta smos kyang ci dgos te gnas med do/ /92—736

rig sngags 'chang ba 'jigs pa med par yang dgos pa thams cad grub pa sgrub par byed do17/ /bgegs med par thams cad du sgrub pa 'grub (2pa 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang ( skulas thams cad bya bar 'dod cing gdon bsal bar 'dod na/ gu gul dang / yungs kur ( ril lan cig (5)bzlas brjod byas te/ gdon la bdug pa sbyin par bya'o/ /yungs kur 6)gyis brdeg par bya'o/ /lan cig tsho7)dran par bya'o/ /lag pa g.yas pa'i mdzub mos 8khros pas bsdigs 59)par bya'o/ /bdug pa dang / brdeg pa dang / dran pa kholhan cig tu byas na mod la gdon thams cad 'jig 11par 'gyur ro/ /ji 12ste nag po chen po rang nyid dam/ lha nyunam yin gyi dbang po'am/ sgra gcan nam/'jigs byed kyang 'jig sapar byed na/ gdon gzhan 'ong bar lta ga la 'gyur te / mod la gcig tu 'jig dpar 'gyur ro/ /'byung po dang / gdon gyis yongs su zin pa thams cad la dur khrod kyi thal ba la lan cig tshabazlas brjod byas te/ spyi bor gtor zhing lan cig 1 dran par byas na/ mod la 'byung po dang gdon 'bros par 'gyur ro/ /na la da dang / an da ni dra ka pa tsa dang /gu gul dang / ha sa 18dang / ba la ka dang / ma tu la dang / pad+ma dang / put+pa rnam 17gnyis dang / ra dza 2 ni dang / yungs kur 21dang / shing kun dang / na ra pad+ma dang / bi sha ra dang / tsan dri na ka rnams ra'i 2lhagacin gyis sbrus ( cite/ ril bu rnalhanas kyi 'dzel 2snyom tsam byas te/ grib ma la bskams 27la / lcags kyu lan bdun bzlas pa byas nas las thams cad la bdug pa mchog gi ril bu zhugegacig bdug pa byas na stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 29'jig rten gyi khams ri dang nags tshal dang / gcong rong dang bcas pa rnams 'gul lo/ /92wa 737

rgya mtsho chen po ni 'khrugs so/ /ri rab chen po ni g.yos so/ /sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas gzhal med khang dang bcas pa ni cher g.yos te 'gul lo/ /lha thams cad skrag go/ /lha ma yin thams cad ngu zhing phyogs phyogs su 'bros so/ /sa ni g.yos so/ /klu 0)gang dag rgya mtsho na gnas pa dang / gnod sbyin dang /srin po dang / 'byung po dang / yi dgas dang / brjed byed dang /gsang ba pa (midang / tshangs pa'i srin po dang / bgegs dang / gdon mi bzad pa gzhan ma rungs pa de dag thams cad ge dri tshor ba tsam gyis rnam ④par zhig par 'gyur te/ dogs par mi bya'o/ /lus rnam par zhig par 'gyur/bcom ste rus pa lhags par 'gyur/ 'chi bdag gi zhags pa'i khar 'gro bar 'gyur / des 5)rnam par zhig par 'gyur ba de la dogs par mi bya'o/ /dug dang bcas pa ni mod la dug med par 'gyur ro(6)/ /klu 'jog po dang / nor rgyas kyis gal te zin pa'am/ sprul gyis gzin pa la bdug pa dang / byugs pa tsam gyis 85thams cad du dug med par 'gyur ro/ /gang dag 'jig rten na dug sna tshogs mi bzad 9pa yod pa la bdug pa'i dri tsam dang bskus pa dang / ril bu 9tsam gyi 11mod la dug thams cad med par 'gyur te/ the tshom 8mi bya'o / /'bras dang / phol mig dang / lu yi ta dang / shu ba cidang / sha bkra 'dang / rkang shu dang / mdze dang / 'brum bu dang / lhog pa rnam pa mang po dang / nad lamached pa dang / lba ba'i phreng ba dang / khong 'bras tu snadang / rkub na ba dang / skran dang / 'khru 18ba dang / rtsib logs na ba dang / snying ga 410na ba dang / gre ba 'gags pa dang / rna ba na ba dang / so na ba dang / mig na ba dang / mgo bo na ba dang / gzhogs ri ༄phyed na ba la 92—738

ril bus 6)bskus pa tsam dang / chu dron 'thungs pa tsam dang / bdug 95༄pa tsam dang / mnams (mipa tsam gyis thams cad de ma thag tu rab tu zhi bar 'gyur te/ thams cad la ril bu 4)dam pa lan cig 5)bzlas brjod byas te byin na thams cad du dgos pa thams cad byed pa bla na med pa yin no/ /shin tu char che ba dang / char mi 'bab pa dang / dus ma yin pa'i (6 char dang /rlung dang / ser ba dang / 'byung po dang / ma mo'i gnas (7)dang / mtsho klu (kyede dag thams cad dbang du 'gyur ro/ /char dus su 'bebs so lo tog dang / 'bras bu dang / me tog yod par 'gyur ro/ /phyis ser ba mi 'bab bo(9na/ /sad yodang rlung dang than pa mi 'byung ngo / /phun sum tshogs pa thams cad grub par byed cing bkra shis pa thams cad grub par byed do/ /rims drag po ma rungs pa kun tu 'jug pa'i rims mi bzad pa dang / 'das pa mi bzad pa drag po'i rims dang / rims drag po'i 'jigs pa chen po dang /me 'bar ba shin tu che 11ba dang / zhag bzhi pa'i rims mi bzad pa dang /grang ba'i rims sdug bsngal che ba 12dang / rims gang dag 'chi ba'i zhags pa 'bar ba/ 'khrug nyanyapa drag po mi bzad 0pa dang / zlos pa'i rims gso 1lhadaka' ba dang / nyin gcig mipa'i rims dang / nyin gnyis pa'i rims dang /nyin gsum pa'i rims dang / de bzhin du rlung las gyur pa dang / bad kun las gyur pa dang / mkhris pa las gyur pa dang / mchil ma las gyur pa'i rims dang / rims rnying sna pa dang / zug gzer 1 dang / gzhang 39'brum dang / gcin snyi ba mi bzad pa dang / rims thams cad la bdug tshopa tsam gyis the tshom ri7med par rnam par 'jig 32par 'gyur ro/ /nam mkha' lding gi 92wa 739
